comments: Karin’s “Aplace” is absolutely beautiful and cozy boutique hotel in the center of Antwerp. The Host, Karin is an amazing, warm and kind person who truly puts her hearts and soul into making her guests feel like at home. The apartment is beautifully furnished with mix of retro and modern style - I was so amazed about all of elegant details. The place is very close to almost everything in Antwerp. I highly recommend!
Karin is a wonderful host, she was really helpful ! Highly recommended for a stay in Antwerp.

Amazing flat, really close from the MAS Musem, and 15 minutes walking from the Cathedral.
Really calm, many space and light, perfect for 2 couples, perfect for a weekend.
Antwerpen is a really nice city to walk around and chill in cosy cafés.
Check out the coolest places here: (Website hidden by Airbnb)

This is a well equipped, very comfortable apartment --- the host has thought of everything.... all the kitchen equipment imaginable.  The apartment is very convenient to the old city, cathedral, museums, and restaurants.  Works very well for a family - clean, well kept, plenty of room and bathrooms.  Our host, Paul, was very responsive to us and very helpful.  Convenient grocery store, close to the river for walking.  There is a convenient bus for getting to central station for day trips in Belgium.  This was a very enjoyable experience.

This is a very nice appartement. We really liked the the modern interior of the appartement. It's a clean, pleasant and very comfortable place to stay.

We could park our car in the private indoor parking place and hired our bikes just around the corner.

Paul is a great host. It was a pleasure to stay in this apartment.

Regards,

Marcel

The appartment is beautiful, the best I've ever been in on Airbnb. Clean, huge, light, beautiful furniture, fantastic view, best location. I can really recommend this flat.

Additionally Paul was a very good host, prepared us with all important information, good tips, did answer immediately and was very helpful.

Our trip just couldn't have been better! Thanks Paul!

Enjoyed an excellent time in Antwerp.

The apartment, it's location, and Paul's helpful tips, were all top class.

I would recommend this apartment highly.

Regards,

Brian

Fantastic trip to Antwerp!

Staying in Paul's apartment near the MAS museum was a brilliant experience for the 4 of us. He is a super host; very helpful and friendly. He's put together lots of information in the apartment about great local restaurants around the docks and there is loads of detail about Antwerp as a whole.

The apartment is exactly as wonderful as the photography on the Airbnb site. It's a good big size with lot's of light through the floor to ceiling windows.

Both bedrooms are gorgeous with super comfortable beds and all the furniture and fittings are very cool with everything you could want for a short or longer stay.

The apartment is in a great location in the regenerated docklands area around the MAS museum - which is only 2 min walk away. It's only 10-15 min walk into the old quarter of Antwerp and we were actually in the Zuid area (Contemporary & Fine Art museums etc.) within a 30 min walk - all very easy. The apartment is only a 5 min taxi ride from the Centraal station too.

Very highly recommended apartment & host - book with confidence!

Wij hebben met ons drieën een volle week genoten van ons verblijf in het appartement. Deze is zeer ruim, schoon en met voldoende privacy voor een ieder vanwege de twee badkamers en gescheiden toiletten. Het is prettig dat er ruim voldoende badhanddoeken aanwezig zijn. Indien nodig kan de wasmachine zelfs gebruikt worden! De ligging is perfect. Vanaf de snelweg is het zeer makkelijk te bereiken en het hebben van een plek in de parkeergarage is super. Het is een rustige buurt, met toch ook veel gezelligheid en centraal gelegen. Dicht bij twee musea, tal van restaurants, op slechts 15 minuten loopafstand van het oude centrum. Paul Zeguers is zeer gastvrij, heeft ons rustig en duidelijk alles over het appartement en omgeving uitgelegd. Een pluspunt is dat je tegen een zeer geringe vergoeding gebruik kan maken van onder andere Nespressocups, wijn, bier, en frisdrank: handig als je iets vergeten bent en de winkels zijn dicht. Wij kunnen dit appartement aan iedereen aanbevelen.

Beautiful and spacious apartment with great interior in a lovely and hip location.
Very nice contact and simple key handover. The hosts are very nice and the apartment has all the comfort. Thank you very much, we had a great stay and Antwerp is such a nice city.

Great flat in a very nice area of Antwerp. Host was very helpful and easy going. Definitly recommend staying here to anyone.

Flat was very clean, very spacious and well equiped. Drinks in the fridge and coffee were offered for a small contribution.

Paul's apartment is excellent. The place is clean, spacious, modern, and in a trendy area of Antwerp. Check in was easy and Paul is very responsive to any messages. I would recommend this place to anyone.

Paul and Gina greeted us and told us about the apartment and the area and made us feel very welcome. We arrived a little bit early and we were able to park our car and get settled in the apartment. We truly loved our experience and highly recommend Paul and Gina as hosts and their beautiful apartment in a very trendy area near the water as a perfect place for a vacation in Antwerp!

Paul was fantastic! I emailed him late at night for a co worker that was in Belgium and needed a place to stay last minute. Paul responded quickly and answered all of my questions. The apartment was just as described, clean, and in a nice area. Will definitely be contacting Paul again next time I need a place to stay in Antwerp!

Paul was already at the apartment when I arrived so no waiting around outside. He efficiently and quickly showed me around the apartment without being too fussy. I felt completely at ease immediately. The apartment was perfect for exploring Antwerp with perhaps a ten minute walk into the centre of town. But if you don't wish to go into town there are plenty of bars, restaurants, cafe's bakeries within a very short walk of the apartment. The views from the apartment make it feel pretty special, even at night but when the curtains are drawn you have your privacy. The major boon with this apartment is the car parking. Parking a car in Antwerp is a trial sometimes but here no. Underground, very secure parking with access into the apartment block. A lot of Airbnb apartments are lived in by their owners which of course is mostly the point with this service. I do however prefer 'Pure Lets' without all the personal items of the owners surrounding you. This apartment is purely let for guests so no clothing in the wardrobes etc. A great place to stay with a decent road network in and out to the apartment too. Perfect.
Mooi en groot appartement op een goede locatie. Vriendelijke en behulpzame verhuurder. Zeker een aanrader!

An absolutely fantastic place. I have no hesitation in recommending this flat and it's gracious host. The location is great at the north end of the city centre, easy to find and has a variety of artisan shops and galleries on the doorstep with a very handy mini-market right downstairs.

The flat immediately impresses with views, and the security of the entrance. The lift is small but can still fit 2 people & suitcases.

The decor is neutral and spotlessly kept, in fact the whole flat was immaculate, with quality furniture throughout.

The listing could really do with a layout to really sell it. The living space and 2 bedrooms are far enough apart that noise isn't an issue. There is a useful office space. The 2 balconies are a useful addition to the space. Our party was 2 couples and we did not feel cramped or as if we were tripping over each other.

The kitchen is extensively kitted out with everything you need to either eat on the fly or host a diner party. The large fridge meant that we only had to shop once for our stay leaving us all the sightseeing time to enjoy.

Wir sind von dieser Wohnung total begeistert! Sie ist nicht nur super-schön und komfortabel, sondern auch perfekt ausgestattet. Alles war extrem sauber, die Betten sind sehr bequem. Die Wohnung liegt in einer ruhigen Seitenstraße; die Schlafzimmer liegen außerdem hinten am ruhigen Innenhof. Die Lage war für uns optimal. Das Hafenviertel direkt vor der Haustür bietet eine große Auswahl an sehr schönen und guten Restaurants, Cafes, Kneipen u.s.w. Das MAS ist 50 Meter entfernt. Bis zur Kathedrale im Zentrum läuft man 15 bis 20 Minuten. Eine der vielen Fahrradstationen lag direkt um die Ecke.
Die Vermieter waren sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit. Alles lief reibungslos.
Lovely, very comfortable apartment in a great neighborhood.

This is a great apartment that I would, and have already, recommend to friends. The welcome was warm and everything explained clearly. The owners are a great team and even Paul's daughter kept me up-to-date and informed. The apartment is spacious, modern (yet cosy) and, above all, super clean and uncluttered. The situation is perfect - quiet yet with a great atmosphere and reasonably close to the city centre.

Paul and Gina are amazing hosts - everything was perfect, from the initial communication about the stay to check out.
The apartment is fantastic - it's even better than on the pictures. Totally new and has everything you need for comfortable stay - from Nespresso coffee machine to shampoo. Excellent location - amazing harbor view, supermarket next door, lots of restaurants and just 15-20 min walk from the historic center.
Definitely will recommend this place to friends and will stay there again if I go to Antwerp.
Paul and Gina, thanks a lot!

Het appartement van Paul ligt op een geweldige plek, is schoon en van alle gemakken voorzien. Perfect om een weekend of langer in Antwerpen te verblijven. Parkeren onder het appartement erg gemakkelijk en ook de supermarkt in de straat is ideaal. Een aanrader!

Wij hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad in het appartement van Paul en Gina op het Eilandje in Antwerpen. Het appartement is prachtig. Het is schoon, gezellig en alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig. Paul en Gina zijn zeer vriendelijk en gastvrij. Wij komen graag in Antwerpen en dit appartement zullen we dan ook zeker nog eens boeken.

We hebben een zeer aangenaam verblijf gehad in het appartement van Gina en Paul. Het appartement is ruim, schoon, goed onderhouden en erg gerieflijk ingericht. Het zicht op het water en de flanerende mensen vanaf het balkon is erg leuk.
De ligging van het appartement is ideaal. De directe omgeving biedt veel mogelijkheden om uit eten te gaan, een terrasje te pakken. Einde van de straat het MAS waar je 's avonds van het prachtige uitzicht over de verlichte stad kunt genieten en op loopafstand van het centrum. Ideaal is ook dat je je auto onder het appartement in de garage kunt stallen. Kortom een appartement waar we graag terug willen komen. Gina en Paul, hartelijk dank voor jullie sympathieke ontvangst.

We had a wonderful few days in this apartment. It is in a great location with lots of great restaurants and bars nearby. The centre of town is an enjoyable 20 minute walk away. The apartment is beautifully furnished and the beds are very very comfortable. A great experience and we will definitely be back.

Binnen minuten ontmoetten we eigenaar Paul. Vriendelijk en behulpzaam. Hij leidde ons de garage binnen en hielp met de koffers naar boven te brengen. Zijn uitleg over het gebruik van het appartement was helder en kernachtig. Ook waren de bijzonderheden goed gedocumenteerd. Bij de documentatie behoorde ook een uitleg over de directe omgeving van het appartement.

Het appartement is ruim van maat en zo ook de afzonderlijke ruimten. Direct valt het op dat alles kraakhelder en schoon is. Badkamers en toiletten hygiënisch en blinkend schoon, royaal voorzien van handdoeken. Mooie beddenbedekking en zalige bedden. Keuken is compleet en fijn dat er een vaatwasser en Nespressomachine was met een assortiment koffiecupjes. Je bereikt het appartement per lift. Betaald parkeren belast niet gezien de ruime plek in de garage.

Aangenaam zijn de twee balkons. Die aan de woonkamer vangt de ochtendzon en die aan de werktafel de namiddagzon. De isolatie is perfect: bij gesloten schuifdeuren is het prettig stil. Direct naast de ingang is er een kleine maar goed gevulde supermarkt en heel dicht bij een superbakker met heerlijk brood. We hebben daar fijn ontbeten. Restaurants alom en het stadshart is op 2 kilometer.

Ik zal het appartement zeker aanbevelen bij vrienden die Antwerpen willen aandoen en voor onszelf houden we het adres en telefoonnummer van Paul bij de hand.
Die Wohnung ist absolut perfekt. Paul hat sich wunderbar um uns gekümmert, alles erklärt und sehr viele wichtige und interessante Informationen vorbereitet gehabt.

Die Wohnung war für uns (zwei Paare)perfekt. Sie ist sehr geschmackvoll und zweckmässig eingerichtet, hat sogar zwei Badezimmer und wir fühlten uns sehr wohl hier. Paul hat uns sehr herzlich empfangen und uns viele Informationen zur Umgebung gegeben. Die Übergabe und die Abgabe der Wohnung war unkompliziert und hat super geklappt. Die Lage nahe beim Hafen (Start der Hafenrundfahrt gleich um die Ecke) und doch nur ca 15. Minuten zu Fuss zum historischen Zentrum war optimal. In unmittelbarer Nähe gibt es gute Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sowie eine Velostation als Teil eines überaus praktischen Mietsystems, mit dem man die Stadt sehr flexibel erkunden kann. Auch wenn man mit dem Zug anreist ist die Wohnung direkt vom Bahnhof aus mit dem Bus sehr einfach zu erreichen.
Eine sehr empfehlenswerte Adresse für einen gemütlichen Aufenthalt in Antwerpen!
Herzlichen Dank Paul & Gina für eure Gastfreundschaft

Reinhart & Verena, Gaby & Jürg (Schweiz)

Heerlijk weekend in Antwerpen met vriendinnen. Een fijn ruim apartement, om de hoek bij het bijzondere MAS en tal van leuke restaurants en cafeetjes. Bakker, Supermarktje en krantenkiosk op struikelafstand. En je zit zo in het oude centrum.

Wij hebben een superweekend gehad in dit mooie appartement. Het is fijn gelegen, in de buurt van leuke tentjes. Het appartement is ruim en schoon en voldeed helemaal aan onze verwachtingen. Bovendien verliep de communicatie soepel en werden wij warm onthaald. Een absolute aanrader!
Perfect, again!

Spent a week at the apartment while in town for work.  Can't say enough about it.  The location worked our great.  Was about a 15 minute drive to the harbor area where I worked.  The bonus was when I came back in the evening.  It was just a short walk into the city center with lots of places to eat and see the sights.  Gina was there to let us in and show us the facilities and give us advise about things in the area.  I would absolutely recommend this apartment to anyone considering it and will be checking its availability the next time I return for work in the area.

My second time staying in one of Pauls apartments and nothing has changed in either the experience or the apartments. Both the first and third floor apartments offer equal comfort.

Private indoor parking, decent supermarket next door, the nicest bakery across the road and short walk to town. Nothing to dislike.

Onze eerste ervaring met airbnb was gelijk een hele goede! We zijn zeer vriendelijk ontvangen door (schoon)mama, die ons uitleg gaf over het appartement en de omgeving. Het appartement was brandschoon en van alle gemakken voorzien. Wij vonden het een fijne plek om te verblijven en hebben genoten van ons weekend.

Wat een heerlijk appartement! We hebben vaak tegen elkaar gezegd: Zou hier zo kunnen wonen. Gelegen in een trendy opkomende buurt. Fantastische bakker om de hoek, Espresso-bar en gezellig kroegje aan de overkant. Auto kon geparkeerd worden in het pand en via de sluisbrug aan het MAS zit je met 10 minuten lopen in het historisch centrum van Antwerpen. Paul ontving ons heel hartelijk en liet ons achter met de nodige tips. Absolute aanrader!
Very comfortable and nice apartment! I would definitely stay here again.
Brand new appartment fully equiped, well located in the MAS museum area. Paul was very welcoming and helpful.

The apartment is in top condition. nothing to complain:))
Paul is the perfect host.
Great apartment, fabulous location. Would definitely go back.

Voor de tweede keer gelogeerd in het mooie appartement van Paul en Gina. We wisten dat we in een mooi schoon appartement kwamen en werden niet teleurgesteld. Wederom allervriendelijkst ontvangen, en genoten van ons verblijf. De locatie is fijn. Alles wat men wenst is in het appartement aanwezig.

Huge place! Lovely with everything you could want. EXCELLENT DOCUMENTATION. There's a whole folder with all the local shops/restaurants in along with personal recommendations from Paul. Charming host & charming place. Would recommend!
Prima locatie, vriendelijke ontvangst. Handig met parkeerplaats en prima restaurants in de buurt

Wij zijn eind februari 2017 in dit prachtige appartement te gast geweest. Je bent echt te gast in dit luxe ingerichte appartement dichtbij alles waarvoor je naar Antwerpen gaat. De woonkamer is groot en toch gezellig, de open keuken is van alle gemakken voorzien. Een goed Nespresso apparaat helpt bij het wakker worden. Zo ook de meer dan lekkere douche. Het aparte bad (in badkamer 1) is ook veelvuldig gebruikt. Wij hebben Paul als gastheer getroffen en voelden ons meteen thuis. Voor extra vragen of wensen is Paul altijd bereikbaar en behulpzaam om te helpen.
Vlakbij is een meesterbakker gevestigd waar je goed kan ontbijten. En voor lunch of diner is er in de directe omgeving erg veel keus uit zeer goede restaurants. Voor een goede kop koffie kan je aan de overkant terecht. De stad is snel te bereiken met Velo Antwerp, een soort witte fietsen systeem. Echt geweldig.
Kortom, houdt je van modern en een hippe uitdagende wijk? Dan moet je hier zijn! Maar niet allemaal, wij willen namelijk wel vaker gaan.

Een ontzettend mooi appartement, op loopafstand van de oude binnenstad, de locatie is een hippe maar wel rustige wijk van Antwerpen met alle voorzieningen die je nodig hebt, een bezoek aan het museum MAS met het panorama terras is zeker een aanrader, daarnaast wil ik Paul ooppk bedanken voor zijn flexibiliteit waardoor wij op zondag op een later tijdstip het appartement konden verlaten. Wij gaan dit appartement zeker weer boeken als wij in Antwerpen zijn.
Perfect appartement en locatie. Heerlijke bedden en alles in orde. Fijne uitvalsbasis voor Antwerpen.
The host canceled this reservation 306 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

tutto ottimo !
Very nice modern apartment. Liked the area.

Just fabulous! Great location, great apartment and a great city. We really enjoyed our stay here!

A light and airy apartment, with all the amenities we would need.
Good communication from the hosts.

Amazing apartment in Antwerp. Even better than the pictures show. Great location, close to the museums, lots of restaurants and a grocery store two steps away. We loved it!

Clean and spacious apartment with all facilities required. The neighbourhood is quiet, but offers some great restaurants and cafes nearby. It's right near the MAS. And a short and pleasant walk to the action. We loved coming back to Paul's place after a busy day out.

Awesome place

Een prachtig, goed verzorgd, schoon, ruim, modern appartement. Het ligt op een in een leuke buurt van Antwerpen, Op loop afstand van het centrum. In de straat zit er een bakker en supermarkt, dat was ook heel handig en fijn. Het is goed bereikbaar en er is een parkeerplaats onder het appartement. Heerlijk en luxe, we hebben een geweldig weekend gehad in Antwerpen.

A wonderful place to stay in Antwerp. A great living room, a book with several recommendations, everything you need to know about the city is written there. The flat is big, clean, well equiped and with a nice minimalist decoration.
Het appartement is ruim en licht met goede bedden. Een heerlijke plek, ik wil er nog wel eens naar toe!
Super equipped apartment, amazingly well maintained - fast and efficient communication: A DREAM!
Fijn en ruim appartement op rustige plek. Het vele licht en ruime opzet, maken het appartement erg prettig. Alles was schoon en ontvangst warm. Keuken van alle gemakken voorzien.
Amazing apartment,location, Paul was very nice and helped me with an early check in . Definitely will book again.
Paul's place was great. Easy communication how to get keys. The flat is next to good restaurants and next to the MAS museum. Was a great stay, would recommend.

The apartment was very neat and tidy and in an excellent location. It did provide off street parking for a car but I would suggest that it be a small car. We did have issues with people blocking the driveway. Paul was very helpful and was only 5 minutes away if we needed him. Overall great apartment.
Great host and a great place to stay.
Heel mooi appartement, heel ruim en zeer veel lichtinval. Super locatie, heel gezellige buurt, alles wat je nodig hebt voor een geslaagde vakantie. Ik kom hier zeker en vadt nog eens terug .

It was a wonderful space that was great to call home. They have great coffee and a supermarket downstairs. Not to mention the ice cream store across the way!!!! What we liked best was the bikes we on our street and off we went. We were so happy not to be in the center near the hotels and shops. You can walk to the center in under 10 mins. They were great hosts as well.
simply perfect
excellent place and location. everything is a advertised and more. close to a lot of good restaurants and only 15 minutes away from the center (walking).

The apartment is in a fantastic location and it has everything you could possibly need for a comfortable stay in Antwerp. We have stayed in many Airbnb’s all over the world and this is by far the best equipped and also in a fantastic location. Highly recommended by us!

I used to live in Antwerp but moved abroad several years ago.
Every time I go back I look for a nice place to stay, and I must admit this place is one of the best so far! Very good location, clean, spacious, nice view, etc.
Can only recommend! Thanks Gina & Paul!
Mooi, schoon ruim appartement van alles voorzien. Goede locatie om het schitterende Antwerpen te ontdekken.
Always a pleasure to come to this apartment when we visit Antwerpen
It took us some time to get the keys, but the apartment was nice as shown in the pictures. We enjoyed our staying there. Very quiet and nice location to live in Antwerp.
Fantastic, stylish but even quiet place = a dream!
Everything was perfect! We enjoyed our stay very much! Strongly recommend to stay at Gina’s and Paul’s apartment!
Vielen Dank Paul, die Unterkunft war klasse, super ausgestattet und die Lage perfekt!! Kommunikation und Absprachen waren hervorragend!!!

Paul is really great ! We didn't have the chance to meet each other but instructions were really clear and we had no problem. And about the flat... it is even better than the photos !! Great host, amazing apartment, you'll not regret !

Great place to stay in an excellent location. Perfect for two couples, lots of space. We sat on the balcony and enjoyed watching the world go by. Where it is gives access to all areas of city walking. Cool bars and restaurants nearby. Voucher for the local ice cream opposite was a really nice touch. Would highly recommend and we will definitely return.

Nice, bright and spacious apartment near MAS museum, lots of bars and restaurants and walking distance to old city centre. Beds were very comfortable and instructions from owners were clear and concise. Communication was excellent and timely.
Would highly recommend Paul’s place to anyone wanting to visit Antwerp and area.
Zeer content van! Een echte aanrader
Fantastic apartment in a great location.
Prachtig appartement op een zeer mooie locatie. Veel in de buurt en op wandelafstand van het centrum. Een echte aanrader!
You will enjoy this place!

De ligging van het appartement is ideaal. Met de Velo fiets zijn de verschillende lokaties gemakkelijk te bereiken. Het centrum is op loopafstand. Het appartement voldoet exact aan de beschrijving en de foto's, het is brandschoon en goed onderhouden. Het is van alle gemakken voorzien. Op het balkon aan de voorkant schijnt 's ochtends de zon en in de middag op het balkon aan de achterkant. Het bleef ondanks de warmte koel binnen. Contact met de verhuurders verliep prima, snelle reactie op berichten. Kortom, voor herhaling vatbaar!

This apartment is hands-down one of my favorite Airbnb experiences to-date. Its location is *to die for* - not only is the overall neighborhood amazing, and well located, the specific street that this apartment is located on has *everything* you could possibly need to have an amazing stay.

Overall, the unit is exactly as described in the listing, and is actually *better* than it appears in the photos. We will 100% stay here again when we're back in Antwerp. Sitting on the front balcony for sunrise and/or sunset was my favorite part of my days while visiting. The kitchen is incredible, everything is well furnished and well maintained. Not to mention there's a parking spot included!

To reiterate - 100% amazing, would definitely stay here again and recommend to anyone :)
Spacious and well equipped apartment. Very nice location in a trendy and modern district. Stores and restaurants nearby. Good contact with the owner.
Prachtig appartement in superleuke buurt van Antwerpen!
Great apartment, very spacious and bright. Great communication from Paul and Gina through out our stay. Would definitely stay here again :)
We loved this place. Well decorated, clean everywhere, comfortable beds, location perfect! Also the communication with Paul was good and quick. We will come back.
Fantastic, very well equipped, spacious, well presented and, if you have a car, the secure parking is great. Good location on edge of old town so easy for walking. Highly recommended.
Spacious apartment at great location. 50/50 decorated with authentic and Ikea furniture. Parking underneath the apartment. Restaurants, bakery, supermarket, bicycles close by .
I've got more than I actually expected out of this place. Really spacious flat, well geared. Lots of restaurants around to be explored.
For a family or work a very nice flat. I would definitely stay again.

This is a beautiful, truly spacious apartment in a PERFECT neighborhood!  We can't emphasize enough how wonderful the street is--plenty of cozy local shops and restaurants.  Everything we needed was within a 2-minute walk!  The balcony in the front of the apartment is maybe the best feature, out of many.  Paul and Gina have arranged things to run very smoothly, and the nice touches--like a gift card for the ice cream shop across the street!--made us feel welcome and relaxed.  The guest book is full of excellent suggestions; we particularly liked La pipe d'Anvers which serves delicious traditional food in a warm, neighborhood atmosphere.  This was our second time at Paul and Gina's AirBnB and we can't wait for our next stay!
特别好看的一套房子，可以自己做饭，有停车场，楼下有超市和药店，Paul非常热情
De beste locatie! Een heel ruim en modern appartement met garage!
Trendy apartment, very clean and well appointed, great location to explore Antwerp.

Very modern and spacious apartment. It is located close to the MAS in the old harbour quarter. There are a bunch of small an cosy bars and restaurants around. The area is a little bit away from the big tourist area, through that it‘s very calm, espacially in the evening and night time.
It is about a 15 minute walk away of the historic city center.

The apartment itself was very clean and in very good conditions. The two double beds were very comfortable.
A plus is the included covered private parking space.

We would totally recommend this apartment, if you want to have calm nights and not want to be in the middle of the crowd but still close to everything you need.

Beautiful place, great location highly recommended

Appartement super: spacieux,  confortable, calme, idéalement situé, propreté impeccable. Le parking dans le bâtiment est un plus certain. Nous le recommandons sans hésitation.
Great place in a very good location, only internet not working very well.

Super host!

The owner are nice and communicative. The apartment is nice just 2 issues the Wifi in the dinning place is useless and as no curtain in the study room you have no privacy. If you arrive with car the parking space is tinny so think about the size of the car. The area has to offer a lot to do but if you plan to go more to the center and south Antwerpen this is not the pace to stay, it's far to walk and a lot of traffic with car.
In general we had OK stay there.

lopen naar historisch centrum is wel een stukje maar door gebruik te maken van het handige Velo verhuur systeem in Antwerpen was het prima te doen.
appartement ligt in een leuke trendy wijk waar van alles te vinden is bakkerij/supermarkt/ ijssalon/ terrassen.
Eigen parkeergelegenheid en een attente waardebon voor heerlijk ijs van de overbuurman .
Wij komen zeker terug!

Wij hebben net een heerlijk weekend in het appartementje achter de rug. Paul heeft alles duidelijk in orde! Het is een waargenoegen om te zitten in dit appartement en zo'n weekendje te vertoeven. Heeerlijk! Wij komen nog eens terug!

Prachtig ruim, modern, gezellig appartement met veel lichtinval. Alles was supernetjes. De ligging is top: vlakbij het Mas en toch rustig gelegen. Heel vlotte en vriendelijke communicatie met de host. Een absolute aanraden als uitvalsbasis om Antwerpen te verkennen!
Great apartment in a perfect location !

Very nice and modern apartment, in an interesting part of town.  The apartment was very clean and well maintained. Lots of shops and restaurants around within walking distance.  Paul is a nice host, and communication went very well.  I wouldn't doubt to rent this apartment again. Highly recommended!
Appartement lumineux et au calme. Propre et bien équipé. Rien à dire.
Ontzettend ruim en mooi appartement, gelegen op een hele leuke locatie.

Sehr schöne Wohnung in sehr guter Lage für vier Personen. In der Nähe findet man sehr gute Restaurants und Bars. Die Innenstadt ist fußläufig in 20 Minuten zu erreichen. Die Gastgeber waren sehr nett und aufmerksam. Gerne wieder ...

We had a lovely stay in the spacious and modern apartment of Paul. We found the listing very accurate on all fronts and so our stay very much matched our expectations. Communication was easy. Location is great, with the waterfront close to your doorstep and stores/bakery conveniently located closeby. Thanks for the stay!

Prachtig appartement gelegen op een fantastische locatie. Op 20 minuutjes wandelen van de Meir en rondom verschillende leuke cafés en restaurantjes. Appartement is voorzien van alle benodigdheden en super proper. Communicatie met Paul verliep vlot. Handige parkeergarage voor de auto.
Toplocatie, leuk appartementje, zeer netjes en vlotte communicatie! Meer moet dat niet zijn ;-).
Paul est un hôte attentionné et bienveillant, les indications étaient très claires pour trouver l'appartement et pour notre séjour
Great place!

Great flat! Also with a kid. Very cosy, big and in a nice area.
We had a great time!

Location: Great! Lovely neighbourhood with very good tram/bus connection to station/city centre/MAS. Lots of bars and restaurants near, nightshop in the same street and it seems to be a safe neighbourhood.

Room: We were with 4, and could use 2 rooms completely to ourselves. Lovely big living room (2 beds) and a dining room (2 beds). Bathroom and kitchen are shared with the owner. The rooms are decorated with style and everything is provided, very clean as well.

Cecilia, is a very nice host. She responds very quickly to emails and makes you feel very welcome!

Thank you very much Cecilia for being so helpful.
Whereas I had a trouble, you made your best to help me to find the best solution.
You always try to make your guest feeling the most comfortable and it can't be overvalued!

Wish you the best of luck!
Alexia

Cecilia was a great host and very accomodating to a family of 7. the neighbourhood is quaint. there is a mini market at the nearby square (2mins walk) in the mornings. it has been a pleasure staying at her home.

Cecilia est une excellente hôtesse. Son appartement est à la fois joli et pratique. Vous ne serez qu'à quelques stations du vieux centre ville. Nous vous recommandons chaudement cet appartement où nous avons passé un très agréable séjour.
Merci Cecilia et à une prochaine fois.

I love the space.  Very convenient location!  Cecilia was a wonderful host.  When we couldn't figure out how to open the door, we woke her up at 2am to help us get in and she was amazingly understanding!!  Cecilia will definitely take care of you.

Cécilia a été une hôte très gentille et très attentive. Elle a répondu rapidement à toutes nos questions par mail, et nous a accueilli avec un grand sourire. L'appartement est charmant, avec une grande pièce lumineuse et une petite terrasse pour l'apéro. N'hésitez pas !

When we got to Cecilia's place with a delay that was not a problem at all. She greeted us very friendly and explained the apartment and had some suggestions for us about activities. The apartment was big enough (though not as huge as we expected from the pictures) for the three of us to spread out and is situated in a very nice neighborhood with some good cafes and bars around.
As the ad here says, the apartment is vintage. That does provide a specific charm and atmosphere. As Cecilia told us she had a group of partying youngsters before, and they had wrecked some things she didn't have the chance yet to repair. That left a bit of an "unstable" impression of the place.
Overall, staying at Cecilia's apartment brought back pleasant memories of student years, and I would say it is very well suited for people looking for that kind of experience.

Spacious quirky flat equidistant between Antwerp Central station and Antwerp-Berchem railway station. Both walkable, the latter a nicer walk if your train happens to stop there (for example if you visit Bruges or Ghent). The flat is in a pleasant and interesting area with buses, trams and other amenities very close. Cecilia has been very prompt and helpful in her communication, we enjoyed our stay here.

Very nice appartment; authentic is the right word for it. Close to the Belle Epoque neighbourhoud this apartment has this atmosphere alright. Also the square just at the end of the street has a lot of nice bars and restaurants.
Miss Magnus was a very nice host, a relaxed person.

Cecilia and her family live on the bottom floor and rent out the floor above. She welcomed us and gave us a tour of the flat. We had an entire floor to ourselves, filled with interesting vintage furniture and decorations. More than enough space for 3 adults. Also a lovely little patio outside. I thought the loft bed was really comfortable, and the street is very quiet.
Only negatives: The steps to the bathroom and into the loft bed are really steep so be careful! Shower/tub doesn't have a curtain.
Had key to house so could come and go as we pleased. Bakery around the corner (towards tracks) and SUPER delicious Egyptian restaurant in the other direction. Location is about 20 minute walk from Central train station, and about a 30 or 40 minute walk into the heart of Antwerp. About 10 minutes to the beautiful Stadspark. Easy to keep track of where flat is because of proximity to train tracks.
Super close to multiple public transport options if you're not much of a walker!
If you're into Belgian Beer, be sure to visit The Kulminator!

The photos really do capture what a charming and unusual place Cecilia has, and it was great fun staying in such a quirky and beautiful apartment while in Antwerp. At the end of her street is a square full of restaurants and bars with great atmosphere, one with live music.  I would definitely recommend again as Cecilia was very helpful, the street quiet at night, and also in an interesting beautiful nieghbourhood away from the centre of Antwerp, but not too far to walk.

Cecilia has a lovely house in a very beautiful and convenient part of the city! She has been a very helpful and kind host! It has been a pleasure staying there and I recommend it for anyone coming to Antwerp!
Didn't personally stay but friends that did said it was a lovely apartment, though a little distance from the centre.  Cecilia was very helpful and responsive with any queries.

Cecilia was a fantastic host, and the apartment was perfect. We stayed for just over a week and had a great time. I would thoroughly recommend the apartment if you are looking for a cosy stay in a good location to reach all areas of Antwerp
The reservation was canceled the day before arrival. This is an automated posting.

We were welcomed nicely and the appartment looked great. Cecilia had already made the comfortable beds. The area of Antwerp around the apartment is also great and it's only a few stops to the city centre. All in all we had a lovely stay.

Voor een weekendje Antwerpen kozen wij (een groep vriendinnen) het appartement van Cecilia, een vriendelijke en hartelijke gastvrouw.
Het appartement is erg leuk en apart, alles is in orde. Wel een beetje gehorig waardoor we op ons volume moesten letten.
De ligging van het appartement is ook prima, een leuke buurt en een paar haltes verwijderd van het centrum. Al met al een super weekend gehad en een echte aanrader!
Quirky, authentic house, exactly as Celia described. it felt like staying at a friends house.
Perfecte ligging in de gezellige wijk Zurenborg. Dicht bij de metro. Sterrenrestaurants  op steenworp afstand. Goedkoop parkeren voor de deur. Oud pand. Heeft zo zijn charme.

Cecilia is very nice hoste,
the building is located in a very nice aera.
the appartement is very big.
We had a good time in Antwerpen.
Cecilia is een heel vriendelijke dame die ons goed begeleid heeft naar de kamer. Ook de communicatie liep heel vlot! Het heeft een toffe inrichting. Prijs kwaliteit wel aan de dure kant.

We, a family with 3 children, oved Cecilias beautiful and spacious apartment in an old building with original ceilings, doors and wonderful decoration.
The kitchen was very well equipped, the sleeping room very comfortable and the little terrace in the patio a nice extra.
Laura welcomed us warmly, gave a lot of information and even had some beer and chocolate as welcome presents for us (although our booking was very last minute)!

We would definitely recommend this apartment and come back!
Thank you Laura and Cecilia, you‘re amazing people and hosts!!!

Cécilia répond rapidement et clairement aux questions. Le logement est plus grand que sur les photos. Il faut aimé les vieux appartements. Le quartier est sympathique, vous avez la possibilité de prendre un tram ou un métro pour vous rendre à vos destinations.

We had a great time in Antwerp! The location is perfect, and Laura and her mother were very kind to us. Just a heads up: test the keys on the outside door multiple times. Sometimes it simply doesn’t work. We ended up locked outside at night, we had to ring to open from the inside.
Apart from that, everything went smoothly! Would definitely recommend :)

Mijn vriend en ik hebben een geweldige week hier gehad. Het is een prachtig, groot, oud pand op een fantastische locatie. Je loopt zo naar Antwerpen centrum (of je pakt het OV) en om de hoek zit zowel een héérlijk bakkertje als een heel gezellig plein.

Laura en Cecilia zijn heel vriendelijk en hebben leuke tips voor de omgeving als je dit zou willen.

We loved staying here. Great location - the area around the apartment is lovely, with lots of cafes, restaurants and shops, but the street itself is really quiet.
The apartment has a quirky, bohemian feel, with lots of space, and we felt really comfortable and at home there.
Laura is a fantastic host. She gave us great tips for things to do, was super responsive and even helped us use the bike hire system for our time in Antwerp, which made getting around the city so easy and fun.

Laura, haar man Peter en haar moeder Cecilia zijn fantastische hosts geweest voor ons weekendje weg met de vriendengroep. De communicatie was altijd erg snel en precies wat erg fijn was. Na een kleine miscommunicatie over waar te parkeren kwamen wij aan bij het mooie authentieke pand, precies zoals op de foto's. Wij hebben de auto uiteindelijk geparkeerd in een Q-park bij het Berchem station (12 min lopen).

Cecilia, die op de begane grond woont, heeft ons een snelcursus gegeven in het openmaken van de voordeur (geslaagd!) maar om eerlijk te zijn was dit niet echt een probleem voor ons. Zachte en frisse handdoeken + opgemaakte bedden = top gastvrijheid. De goede koffiemachine met verse bonenmaler was echt een aangename verrassing en zeer geapprecieerd!!

De Airbnb ligt in de wijk Zurenborg wat buiten de weekenddagen om zeer rustig maar lokaal aanvoelde. Het plein op nog geen 100m afstand zit vol met restaurants en cafés waar je iets kunt nuttigen. Zo'n 15-20 minuten lopen naar het Centraal Station en zo'n 35 minuten naar het oude centrum met alle cafeetjes en barretjes. De tramhalte ligt om de hoek, maar wij namen graag de elektrische step :)

Bedankt voor het fijne verblijf in Antwerpen!

Wir waren für 3 Tage in der wunderschönen Wohnung von Laura und Cecilia. Die Wohnung ist ein Traum und hat ganz viel Charme. Die Lage ist perfekt und der Dageraadplaats um die Ecke ist ein toller Platz zum Verweilen mit vielen schönen Bars und Cafés.
Besonders toll war es auch, dass Laura uns viele interessante Insidertipps gegeben hat.
Die beiden sind super nette Gastgeberinnen und wir freuen uns schon auf einen nächsten Besuch in dieser zauberhaften Wohnung
Jutta, Lars, Luisa & Mara
The host canceled my reservation 6 days before arrival.

The room is nice and big and has a really good bed! The location is about 20 minutes by bike from the city center and there is a tram station in the street which brings you to the city center in about 10 minutes. Geert is a nice guy who will help you when needed. Only the tidiness and hygiene of the house is under average. The first thing I did when I arrived was cleaning my room. Also the common areas are not clean. So apart from the hygiene of the house I have had a great stay!
Good sized rooms in a convenient location.

Perfect location for exploring the city, close to shops, bars and restaurants. Nicely decorated, good lay-out and great welcoming host. Bit noisy. Nice to have found a location in Antwerp to visit again when revisiting the city!

Muriel was such a fantastic host, extremely helpful and courteous, and her flat is just as it looks in the pictures: beautiful, romantic, comfortable, spacious, clean and full of light. Very well located in the heart of Antwerp, only a short walk to the Cathedral. The apartment has everything you need for a confortable stay. We would fully recommend Muriel's flat for a visit to Antwerp!

Muriel was a very gracious hostess.  We parked the car nearby and walked to meet her at a specific time.  The charming little apartment is located in a square over a small restaurant.  It is tastefully decorated, with all the lovely personal touches - candles, plants, magazines, and Antweir map, warm stove if needed.  It was a wonderful experience and Muriel deserves great accolades on her charming place.  Very central.

We had a perfect weekend at Muriels apartement. We felt very comfortable because the flat is exactly as on the pictures and you have everything you need. Its very central so you can do everything by foot or bike. The handling with Muriel is easy and without any stress :)!

Amazing apartment and amazing Muriel! Location was perfect for sightseeing. Muriel was wonderful!

The refrigerator and pantry were stocked with wonderful treats ( was nice to be able to get up in the morning and have tea or coffee and fresh fruit and yogurt or chocolate before going out).

The apartment was furnished with EVERYTHING one could need!

Lovely Lovely place to stay!!!

Excellent location - in the heart of the city, close to the restaurants/ pubs and shopping area. Apartment itself has everything one might need, well equipped kitchen, wifi, etc. Muriel is an excellent host, she allowed us to stay in till late afternoon on the departure day, cared for our breakfast and other small, but important things.

to start with Muriel was a fantastic host, giving us perfect directions on how to find the apartment, letting us store our bags there as we arrived earlier than check in time & helping us with maps & directions on places we needed. The fridge was stocked with goodies for breakfast, some fruit, some water and even a couple of local beers which was a nice touch thanks.

The apartment itself could not have been in a better position, it overlooks a beautiful square with cafes and a little pub perfect for a drink in the afternoon sun, and its a 3 minute walk from the big main church & the main square where you will find 1000 places to eat drink and go partying. Inside the apartment its great a big comfy bed in the bedroom and a large couch in the lounge room that folds out into another large double bed, a little balcony, a good size kitchen, and a shower and toilet which are both seperate which is a great plus if you are traveling with a few people like us.

If you need somewhere in Antwerp you cant go pass this apartment & Muriel is a fantastic host so you cant go Wrong...

Absolute great location, and Muriel is an extremely friendly host. We had flexible check-in and check-out times, and the location of the apartment could not have been better (close to cool shops, nice cafes and the city center). Very nicely decorated apartment! If you're thinking about going to Antwerpen, definitely think about renting this apartment!
We 've had a great stay over at Muriel's place. Cosy clean, well put together and located in the very centre of Antwerp.
This is a great place to stay! very charming, clean appartment in the middle of Antwerp. I will definitely come back next time.

This is an extremely cool and comfortable apartment, I would definitely recommend it to everyone. Everything was clean and neat. The square where it i situated is in the very heart of old town, yet still somewhat hidden and tranquil, with only a couple of cafes attended mostly by locals. A cool cafe is run by Muriel`s husband donwstairs, where guest were welcome all around the hour.

Muriel met us in a good location and was there early which was good as we were also a little earlier than planned. The Appartment was fantastic and very sweet, in a great location-an amazing location in fact, especially to see the Friday market out the window. Thank you Muriel for a great stay.

If you visit Antwerp this is the place to stay right in the centre of the city!
It's close to everything and Muriel is a fantastic host!
Very easy to pic up the key.
The flat is clean and has all the necessities you'll need, even a fridge filled with basics for breakfast etc.
Two happy Swedish couples.
Muriel was lovely and the apartment is perfectly situated – above Antwerp's coolest cafe. It had everything we needed - we'll definitely be back.

We will try to make the story brief. We met Muriel on Monday afternoon, and she was utterly charming and interested in showing us the details of the apartment. She was concerned since we were more than two that we would need more towels, and she delivered them when our other guests arrive. The location of the apartment is so central and fantastic. The space is very much as the pictures depict. The view is lovely, and the square - which is the view - offers many interesting restaurants and bar/cafes. Our only issue was that the shower was simply not able to be adjusted with any subtlety. The options were very hot, and, one notch below, cool. We were there for a week and no one said it was satisfying. After leaving Antwerp for Berlin, we tried to stay in this apartment for a couple of nights but it was unavailable. We would obviously stay there again.

Convenient location to food, shops and transportation.
Charming apartment and friendly host made for a wonderful weekend.
Thank you!

The pictures shows a flat looking nicer, much bigger and newer than it is, but basically the place ok. The view is on a small place in the historical center.
But we had a bad experience as we found the toilets very dirty and had to clean up before using it!! ... nothing that disgusts me more...
Nevertheless, the rest was clean.
The owner seem a gentle person, but this experience is not what I expect at Airbnb as its obvious that it is just a way for the owner to earn money, nothing to do with a home experience. For this price in Belgium you find really much better. I would prefer an hotel.

Amazing location!!! it really is in walking distance from everywhere and the cafe downstairs is lovely.

The apartment is well depicted in the photos. We were 4 adults and one 2 year old and we fit fine in the apartment even if it is not that big. The shower was a bit tricky but nothing bad. The kitchen is actually quite large. The apartment was perfectly clean.

We really liked that the heater is a gas stove in the living room which gave a nice atmosphere to the apartment.

Miertje was very friendly and helpful and we are especially grateful for the flexible check-out time!

The only thing that bothered my husband a bit was noise in the evening and noise from the cafe...the building is old and the walls thin - you can hear people going up the stairs and the music that is played in the cafe downstairs (very softly). The cafe closes early (8pm) so that really is not a bother but I guess we were just unlucky as there was music until very late both Friday and Saturday nights coming from somewhere else... Me and my 2-year old slept right through it but my husband found it annoying.

Still, overall, I would recommend the apartment to any of my friends and I would gladly stay there myself again too.

We had a great time at her place, she even had time to share a coffee with us. As to the flat, located on a cute and quiet square in the old part of Antwerp. The flat is lovely with all the necessities plus a nice touch with a fridge with a few things in it. Ideal for 3 (2 in the double bed, 1 on the sofa bed).
The reservation was canceled the day before arrival. This is an automated posting.
We had a great stay. The location was perfect, the appartment is truly cosy and has a nice admosphere/vibe also communication with Miertje was really smooth.
sfeervol appartement, goede locatie en prettige ontvangst!

We hadden een prima verblijf met z'n vieren in dit sfeervolle appartement midden in het centrum.. Het was schoon, er waren wat levensmiddelen (koffie, thee, melk en beleg) en de bedden waren goed. Soms wat last van de etensgeur en de muziek van het eetcafé beneden, maar dat zal ons niet weerhouden om  terug te komen!

We hebben een zeer prettig verblijf gehad in het appartement. De locatie is perfect, alles ligt op loopafstand. Er was zelfs een parkeerplek voor de deur vrijgehouden voor ons, zeer attent. Zeker een aanrader voor 4 personen omdat hotels anders een stuk duurder zijn.

Zeer prettig verblijf gehad in dit appartement. Centraal gelegen en gezellig ingericht. Ook voor ons drieën (met een dochtertje van 1,5) ruim genoeg. Wel zelf een kinderbedje meegenomen.
Parkeren voor de deur (wel betaald, behalve op zondag).
Op de Vrijdagmarkt zijn leuke café's en eet-tentjes. Verder is het erg centraal gelegen, alles lopend te doen!
Lovely apartment in the historic part of town. Antwerp is a great city and I will definitely return, its a shame I could only stay for one night. Our host was great too, no complaints at all.

Sehr schönes Apartement, sehr zentral und gut gelegen. In dierekter Nähe sind gute Kneipen und Cafés und auch das Modeviertel und das historische Zentrum sind nur 5 minuten zu Fuß entfernt. Die Wohnung ist schön, hell, angenehm eingerichtet und Miertje extrem unkompliziert. Es war ein großer Spaß da gewesen zu sein!!!

Die Wohnung ist totel niedlich und supersauber. Die Lage ist umwerfend mitten in der Altstadt. Geschäfte, Kneipen, Museen und zahlreiche Sehenswürdigkeiten- alles fußläufig super zu erreichen. Auch der Fluss ist nur einen Minispaziergang weit weg.
Sehr netter und unkomplizierter kontakt. Kann ich nur weiter empfehlen.

Ein sehr gemütliches stilvolles Apartment direkt am schönen Vrijdagmarkt in der historischen Altstadt gelegen. Sehr zu empfehlen!
Tolle Cafes, Kneipen, Restaurants und Sehenswürdigkeiten in direkter Umgebung.
Unkomplizierter und netter Kontakt, vielen Dank!

Great apartment- Simple with everything you need (host provided lots of extras). Comfortable beds, fantastic location for exploring the city. Would definitely return. Flexible, helpful and friendly host.
Wonderful apartment! I am already planning on staying here next time I come to Antwerp. Thanks Miertje.

Miertje's apartment in Vrijdagmarket was absolutely perfect for a long weekend for my girlfriend and I.  Located in central Antwerp it is close to everything the city has to offer.  Miertje was very kind and accommodating offering us what was in the fridge and cupboards and helping us decide on places to visit and places to eat.  The apartment itself is beautiful with windows opening to the busy square below.  I would highly recommend anyone visiting Antwerp to stay at Miertje's for a one-of-a-kind visit.
Really sweet appartment, perfectly located next to all the cool shops and sights! Everything was wonderfully prepared and clean. Very nice and helpful host - defenitely a place to return to!

We had a great time in Miertje's appartment. Miertje was easy to contact and she showed us everything as we arrived in Anvers. The appartment is perfectly located and has a really nice style. It is very close to all the sights of Anvers and surrounded by many cafes, restaurants and shops. We would definitly recommed this place.

We had a very sunny weekend in Antwerpen! Its a perfect town to stay. The old houses, the strong beer and the expensive diamonts just suited us perfectly! Hope to See you soon!!!!! Regards from Berlin!
Miertje was the perfect host, and the flat is beautiful and centrally located. A perfect Airbnb experience, Thanks Miertke!
Miertje's apartment is spacious and nicely decorated. Its location is great, very central and close to interesting museums and the Cathedral . There are nice cafes around the area.

My stay on this appartment was excelent! When we arrived she was already waiting us. She explained everything very well and was very gracious. The appartment is very nice, the internet connection worked well, which is important to me, and there are a lot of towels, which is good as well! The appartment is very well located. I really liked this appartment and I'm sure I will stay on it when I come back to Antwerp. Miertje is very nice and I recommend her as your host.

We had a wonderful stay in this enchanting apartment in the heart of Antwerp. The pictures on airbnb give a realistic impression. Miertje's welcoming us was warm and friendly, and we could easily get in touch with her upon arrival and departure time. The place overlooks a charming old town square and everything's very, very close by: cafés, restaurants, grocerie shops, a delicious bakery, thrift shops and and and. Even though the flat is super centrally located, the neighbourhood is not very loud. We would book this apartement again in a sec - and I'm looking forward to do so :)
The apartment is really nice and the location is just perfect. We loved our stay there. Would definately stay there again. Miertje is a great host and very helpful. Enjoy the lovely Antwerpen :)
Miertjes accomodation was in spite of it´s very central position in the centre of Antwerpen a still and comfortable place. We had a quiet good time there.

Great apartment! Can easily accommodate three people. Perfect location - only a few subway stops away from Central Station and walking distance to many cool places. Miertje was waiting for us when we arrived and helpfully gave us all the information we'd need to get going. She told us we could text her anytime with questions. The apartment itself was clean and comfy. Great place to stay!
The flat is centrally located with all the major sights at a walking distance. We really enjoyed our stay. For a family of four it´s rather small but cosy! Miertje was very nice and helpful!

Wonderful appartment in the middle of Antwerp, Miertje is a wonderful host. Just downstais a nice cafe for a coffee duringe the day, or a glass of the wonderful Belgian beer in the evening. The cafe downstairs closes at 9 and was never noisy - no problem for our two kids to fall asleep.

Our stay in Miertje'flat was great. Miertje welcomed us with all tips and maps to visit the city.
The flat is located in the olde city on a small square at 2mn walk from the cathedral and just next to nationan sreet which is the fashion designes's street.
Tere was all you need for breakfast . With these big windows the sun ligtht s the space just above that charming quiet square. Decoration is made with good taste.
We 've loved our stay in this flat.
Wij hadden een hele fijne ontvangst en heerlijk verblijf nabij het bruisende centrum van Antwerpen.

Aanrader! Miertje biedt een fijn en sfeervol appartement van alle gemakken voorzien in hartje Antwerpen op loopafstand van veel. Met zijn tweeën is het voldoende ruim. Met 3 of 4 personen zou ook kunnen, er is een bedbank. Van het onderliggende café hadden wij geen last - onhoorbaar, sluit om 20u - er is hooguit wat reuring op straat, maar dat heb je overal in het midden van de stad. Géén ontbijt, wel een goede bakker en een super om de hoek. Desgewenst heeft Miertje tips over wat er te zien en te doen is.

Miertjes apartment made our stay in Antwerp perfect! It was sooo comfy. There was everything we needed :-) The oven kept us warm :-) Also the key-handover worked out perfectly. All in all: A wonderful apartment for a wonderful visit to Antwerp!
Nice and very clean appartment, excellent location. We stayed here with four girls and had a great time.

Miertje kindly waited until almost midnight for us to get into the city, and when we arrived we found the apartment clean, pretty and with a great location. It was a pleasure to stay here and I hope to come back one day.

This is a wonderful property. We are a fit couple about 50 y.o. each, and love to shop for food in foreign countries and cook it ourselves. We love coffee, quaint living rooms and playing Scrabble. We LOVE being centrally located, and not have to take a bus or subway to get to the quaint and historic. If THIS resonates with you, then Miertje's property is for you! There isn't much to complain about, and there's MUCH to praise! The bottom line is that we had a great time and have no regrets! We were in a quiet apartment, with loads of natural light, in the heart of historic Antwerp, surrounded by coffee shops, Museums, historic squares and interesting shops. I'll start with whatever I can think of that fell short a bit: 1) The apt. is one just flight up from the street, but the steps are steep and narrow. This cuts both ways, actually. If you want the Building Code of 21st Century America, don't bother going to Europe altogether - particularly the historic districts! This wasn't a deal breaker by any stretch, but be ready to take your luggage up one piece at a time (advice: travel light!) 2) Could Miertje invest in the shower, and make it a bit more luxurious, instead of just average? I don't exactly know what her expense overhead is, but I guess she could. 3) I wish it was just a bit cheaper to rent in late January, but that's Europe, there ARE heating expenses, and it's a competitive marketplace! More than that, I can't think of anything even questionably bad to say! The apartment was 100% clean. There were a good 20-30 new towels. No laundry, but we didn't need any. The kitchen was fine, with loads of things that made life easier (utensils, coffee, salt, pepper, etc). A mixture of antiques and IKEA, everything was just right for a couple looking for a romantic weekend in historic Belgium. We got to know Miertje a bit when we arrived at around 20:30 pm. Miertje is an artsy, creative person who lived in the US for a few years in the '80s. She's a pleasant, happy humanist, with obviously great EQ. She was not in our hair, we didn't see her again, and she even let us "check out" by ourselves at 7 AM, simply by leaving the keys in the apartment and pulling shut the door from the street! Miertje lives in a different neighborhood, so we weren't running into her A gruff landlord can ruin a mood, and we didn't have that experience!
In short, if you want elevators, the hum of vacuums and room service - check into a Marriott! If you want an authentic historic "local" experience in Antwerp - this is The Genuine Article! I'D DO IT AGAIN, EXACTLY THE SAME WAY!

Het appartement op de Vrijdagmarkt in Antwerpen is een fantastische keus voor een weekendje weg in deze heerlijke stad. Het is supernetjes en schoon en erg centraal gelegen. Miertje was erg gastvrij en behulpzaam. We verbleven er met vier volwassenen wat betekent dat er twee mensen in de huiskamer op de slaapbank moeten slapen maar dat was absoluut geen straf! Heerlijke bedden, schone handdoeken en superkoffie, alles goed geregeld.
Clean, neat, warm and safe place right in the centre of Antwerp. Nice owner, everything went smoothly.

There is no better place for getting to know Antwerp than Miertje's perfect little place in the middle of the old center of the city. Everything can be reached by simply walking through the wonderful streets of Antwerp. The apt. itself is directly above a wonderful cafe which was not noticeable throughout our stay of 6 days (Try their African ginger tea, it is delicious). Miertje is a wonderful host full of good advice. She gave us a warm welcome and with her resourcefullness she also gave us a good first orientation. The apt. is just as described and it looks out on the Vrijdagmarkt which is a very relaxed little space within the liveliness of the old centre. We will gladly come back!
suesse individuelle whg mit tollem karma

Het appartement van Miertje was erg fijn. De kamers waren mooi, prettig ingericht en alles was aanwezig. De ligging is perfect, midden in het centrum van Antwerpen. Miertje was erg aardig en flexibel. Een aanrader voor wie zoekt naar een appartement in Antwerpen !
Absolutely fabulous  - wonderful host - wonderful spot - all perfect..would definitely go back!

The apartment is exactly as pictured and described and Miertje was an excellent host. Extremely central location and a comfortable home base for our family of four. Quick access to historic sites and lots of restaurants and cafes within short walking distance.

Leuk appartement aan plein in het hartje van Antwerpen met huurfietsen (Velo) om de hoek. Sfeervol ingericht en in de keuken en badkamer is werkelijk alles aanwezig wat je maar nodig kunt hebben. Voor verbetering vatbaar: de gordijnen in de slaapkamer. Die waren erg dun zodat het straatlicht ons wakker hield. Een (verduisteringen)-rolgordijntje zou hier geen kwaad kunnen. Verder prima plek!

We hebben met vier personen een heerlijk weekend gehad in het Appartement van Miertje. De locatie is perfect. er zijn veel gezellige plekjes om te eten en te winkelen en op de Vrijdagmarkt voelden we ons direct thuis.
Miertje was goed te bereiken en erg vriendelijk. Omdat het allemaal zo goed beviel zijn we zelfs nog een nacht extra gebleven.

Location was terrific - really couldn't be faulted. Right in the heart of the old city nearby the cathedral, yet quiet and relaxed in the evenings. Plenty of cafe's, restaurants and bars are very close by and Miertje is a lovely host providing more than is really necessary in the apartment which is snug and nicely furnished. The bed is also really comfy! But there isn't a washing machine and the nearest laundry is some way off. Nevertheless a lovely stay and would certainly consider it again.

We hebben een heerlijk weekend gehad in dit appartement. De locatie is top, met een mooi uitzicht op een gezellig pleintje. Het appartement is ruim en van alle nodige gemakken voorzien. Groot pluspunt: goede bedden dus we hebben erg lekker geslapen. Het enige minpuntje was de geluidsoverlast van de bovenburen. Maar dit kon de pret niet bederven. Miertje heeft goed voor ons gezorgd tijdens ons verblijf, er stonden zelfs boodschappen en verzorgingsproducten klaar voor gebruik! Wij komen zeker nog eens terug.

Amazing stay!! Miertje was very welcoming and gave great advice.  Flat was beautiful, clean (even better than the photos!); everything we could possibly want - including things for breakfast!  Location really central but also quiet.  Would definitely stay again!

Miertje was responsive, helpful and very understanding. Mutual respect goes a long way! Her cosy and clean flat is indeed located in great part of the city, we can really recommend it. Even though it's right on top of a stylish cafe, it's not annoyingly noisy during the day, and the evenings are quiet.

Fantastic host! She even goes out of her way proving great coffee(!), milk and toiletries/towels, more than one could ask for.

Miertje hat lange auf uns warten müssen, weil wir durch den Orkan in Deutschland nicht in Deutschland abfahren können. Sie hat uns herzlich empfangen. Alles war perfekt, viele Informationen über Antwerpen, Tipps, wo wir essen gehen können, die Wohnung liebevoll bis ins Detail eingerichtet, Kaffee, Tee, Milch und viele Lebensmittel standen zur Verfügung, die Küche bestens eingerichtet, das Bad sehr geschmackvoll, Wäsche vorhanden. Die Lage ist gut, in der Nacht ruhig, sehr zentral. Nur zu empfehlen.

We cannot recommend Miertje's Antwerp apartment highly enough! Even better than the pictures. Perfectly located for exploring Antwerp, spotlessly clean, lovely bedding, plenty of towels and well stocked kitchen, fridge and pantry. Miertje is a pleasure to deal with and goes above and beyond for her guests. 5 stars!

Unfortunately the apartment wasn't in a quiet part of town. There was a constant noise coming from the cafe/restaurant downstairs. No loud music or anything but it just felt like sour portent was in the middle of the cafe and we couldn't relax because of it.

It was in a convenient location walking distance to everything so that was a plus.

It was very over priced for what it was and not what we had expected, mostly because of the constant noise from downstairs which didn't stop until 11:45 one evening.

The apartment was tidy and mostly clean, but both my Mother and myself ended up with red blotchy bite marks all over out bodies which we suspected were bed bugs as the bedding for the double bed wasn't fresh and the sofa wasn't ideal either.

We couldn't relax the whole time we were there and just had to make the best of it.

Sadly I can't recommend it.

The host was very friendly and sociable though, we got a very warm welcome.
Super Week end à Anvers, Miertje a été très disponible et nous a même conseillé sur les lieux à voir. L'appartement était comme indiqué dans l'annonce, vraiment super !! Bref je vous le conseille.

Ik en mijn twee vriendinnen hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad in Miertje's appartement. We werden erg hartelijk ontvangen door Miertje en ze gaf ons veel informatie over wat er zoal te doen was in Antwerpen. Door het hele huis lagen ook allerlei boekjes met leuke adressen om te bezoeken.
De locatie van het appartement is perfect; middenin het oude centrum en op loopafstand van het openbaar vervoer. Het appartement was precies zoals op de foto's en bovendien erg schoon. Het balkonnetje was fijn. Miertje had zelfs het een en ander sapjes, eieren etc. voor ons in de koelkast. Al met al een topverblijf gehad in Antwerpen.

We werden hartelijk ontvangen door miertje met een gevulde koelkast en kabinet. We vielen met onze neus in de boter aangezien er niet 1 maar wel 2 festiviteiten op het plein te beleven waren in het weekend.

De lokatie van het appartement is zeer centraal. Wat de ervaring voor de stad antwerpen optimaliseerde. Een aanrader!

A beautifully located apartment in the middle of everything but quiet at night apart from the occasional passers-by. The market and its cafés and bars are local/ student spots and not (yet) discovered by tourists visiting the Cathedral/ Grote Markt/ Groenplaats area. The bright and cozy apartment has nice interior, a small balcony overlooking the Vrijdagmarkt, a real kitchen and a newly refurbished bathroom. Miertje is super friendly and cooperative.

Hostess was very pleasant and informative about the space and the surrounding area. Perfect location and walking distance between the old town of Antwerp, 't Zuid and the shopping high street. Apartment was very clean, spacious and included all necessary amenities along with extras provided by the hostess. Great place to stay if you're visiting Antwerp or cities nearby.

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohlgefühlt.
Ich denke das es kaum eine bessere Lage für eine Wohnung in Antwerpen gibt, wenn man gerne in gute Cafes, Restaurantes und Läden geht und etwas kulturelles erleben möchte. Es ist ALLES fußläufig erreichbar.
Die Wohnung selbst war wunderbar ausgestattet, selbst die grundlegenden Nahrungsmittel standen zur Verfügung!
Das nächste Mal kommen wir bestimmt wieder hier hin!

endroit et appartement absolument parfaits
à recommander de tous points de vue
très bon accueil de Miertje

Alles Bestens. Übergabe hat super geklappt. Wohnung war toll. Super Lage.
Kann es wärmstens weiterempfehlen.
Very elegant apartment perfect situated in central antwerpen at a nice square. Miertje was very friendly and helpful! The apartment has everything you need for your vacation in the town.
This is a lovely apartment on a wonderful square, well-located. The host was very friendly, helpful, and easy to reach. I definitely recommend staying here!

Nous sommes ravis de notre voyage à Anvers.
L’appartement est charmant, chaleureux et idéalement situé au cœur du centre historique. On se sent tout de suite chez soi. La vue donne sur une petite place très charmante avec quelques cafés.
Les petites attentions ont rendu le séjour d’autant plus agréable : serviettes, produits douches, jus d’orange, lait, café pour le petit déjeuner.
Miertje est une hôte très attentionnée, nous avons eu droit a une carte de la ville et différents guides et livres sur Anvers. Elle est également de très bons conseils pour orienter votre séjour sur les choses à faire.
Il n’est pas évident de se garer dans le centre ville, nous avons cependant pu laisser la voiture en bas de l’appartement le temps de monter nos affaires puis nous sommes allés la garer au grand parking public gratuit au sud de la ville (seulement 15 – 20 minutes à pied de l’appartement).
Une très bonne adresse que je recommande vivement.

Jean

Very nice apartment. Both the apartment and the location exceeded our expectations. The apartment was nice, bright, clean and cosy. The host was felxible on check in time, as we arrived very late, and made herself availiable for questions and information. We LOVED our stay in the flat and in Antwerp!

Zeer net appartement op goeie locatie!

Het appartement beschikt over alle basics die je je kan wensen. We sliepen er met 4 mensen, wat goed te doen is met de slaapbank. Het is er netjes en zit op een goede locatie.

Miertje is tevens een gastvrij persoon en doet er alles aan om je een aangename tijd geven in haar appartement.

We loved this apartment.  It could not have been better located for a visit to Antwerp.  It was clean, bright, comfortable and quiet at night.  Miertje was a delightful host and we definitely plan to stay here again when we return to Antwerp.  The other reviews are spot on - a real Airbnb find!

Appartement très agréable, central mais calme, et disposant de tout le nécessaire ! Miertje nous a donné quelques indications utiles, notamment sur le quartier, ce qui nous a permis d'optimiser notre court séjour anversois ! Vivement recommandé donc !
Prima appartement op een hele leuke lokatie met alles op loopafstand. Schoon en netjes! Wel gehorig door enkel glas. Vlak bij is bar met in het weekend jongeren die stappen.

Miertje made us feel very welcome as soon as we got there. The apartment was everything that we needed, great location and very clean. I would highly recomend this apartment to anyone. Thank you Miertje for our stay.
Miertje's flat is really cosy and super central ! It was very nice to stay there ! Miertje also gave us all necessary info to enjoy our stay ! Highly recommended !

Miertje was a wonderful host and her apartment is full of charm and character. It was warm and cosy, the bed was very comfortable and the shower piping hot. Meirtje communicated excellently prior to the stay and was warm and welcoming when we met, showing us all the good places to go and helped us orient ourselves. The location could not have been better either,with lovely bars and cafes in the square. We would definitely return and would not hesitate in recommending Miertje and her lovely apartment.

We had a great stay at Miertje's apt.  The location was perfect, close enough to the Groenplaats but far enough away to not be noisy, overlooking its own little square. The bed was super comfortable! Shower had great pressure. Miertje was there to welcome us even though our train was late, with lots of things to do and recommendations as well as a few little basics in the kitchen and fridge.   Very clean too. Also above a fantastic little restaurant. We loved it and would absolutely recommend it.

Wij, vier vriendinnen, hebben het erg fijn gehad hier. Het appartement is zeer centraal gelegen aan een gezellig pleintje met heerlijke terassen. Vijf minuutjes lopen van de grote markt dus zeer centraal. Verder was het erg schoon en stijlvol ingericht. Een fijne bijkomstigheid is dat er koffie, thee, jam, boter, shampoo etc. is dat je mag pakken. Ik zou dit appartement zeker aanraden en wij komen zeker nog eens terug!

We were three girlfriends for a long weekend in Antwerp.  The apartment was very comfortable and in a very strategic location.  Quiet but in the middle of the historical center.  The kitchen was well equipped and there are some nice supermarket near by so we cooked and had lunch and dinner at home during our stay.
