Miertje is a nice person and we'd choose again her place if we will come back to Antwerpen!

Heerlijke plek ❤️
Bedankt Miertje !

Appartement très agréable, lumineux, tout propre, idéalement situé sur une petite place, en plein centre, parfait pour découvrir Anvers à pieds. Super accueil de Miertje, nombreux guides touristique et cartes disponibles.
Merci Miertje, c'était juste parfait!!
Wonderful apartment in historical center of Antwerp. Very clean, accurate, there are all you need. Thank you, Miertje!

Miertje literally couldn't speak, but even without her voice she made it very easy to show us around in the apt. The Vrijdagmarkt is truly one of my most favorite hangout in Antwerpen to get an afternoon lunch or drink while shopping. It's on the best part of the center, still close to the Meir (for those interested), but smack in the middle of all the nice vintage, antique shopping streets.
The apt was spotless, fully equipped kitchen with basic breakfast amenities (granola, butter, jam etc), shower with enough shampoo etc., clean towels and lots of books/tourist info plus even some games in the living room. The apt is above a bistro, but since it closes at 9pm or so, we didn't have any noise problems.
Loved this apt so much, will book this one straight next visit. Thanks Miertje for making our stay easy and pleasurable!

Miertje is een gastvrije verhuurder. Ze legde ons van alles uit over wat er in de stad te doen was.  Het appartement was schoon en netjes en voorzien van alle gemakken. Locatie in het hart van Antwerpen is ideaal om de stad te verkennen. We hebben een heerlijk weekend gehad in Antwerpen.

This apartment was really nice. It's location in the old city of Antwerp was perfect, it was clean and very charming. Miertje was a great host! Easy to contact, greeted us well and gave us a lot of tips on what to do in Antwerp. Would recommend this place any day.
charming and cosy appartment that is toplocated in the heart of the citycenter. Kind and friendly host.

Miertje was a lovely host. The apartment had everything we needed and the bed was very comfortable. The location is superb! It is in the city center near to restaurants, shopping and the beautiful Antwerp old center. I highly recommend this lovely old world charming apartment.

My host, Miertje was very lovely and informative about the places around. The apartment was prepared by her and almost everything I needed during my stay was in place. Flat is just as it looked in the photos. Comfortable, very clean, cosy and bright. It is in the center of everything. Also very close to the Cathedral. It is definitely recommended for visitors who want to discover Antwerp by walking.

Great apartment in the heart of Antwerp  perfectly positioned to explore the city by foot. Everything we needed was provided and Miertje was a great guide, pointing out all the great places to visit on a map she gave us.
Perfect appartement op super locatie. Goed ontvangst, uitleg en goede faciliteiten, ruime hoeveelheid handdoeken. Lekker in het midden van de stad. Topper!

Great stay in this beautiful apartement ! The place is big, very clean and well decorated ! The location is perfect, in a small and Charming place with lot of restaurants and small stores. Miertje was a perfect host. Kind and helpfull. She gave us Many tips to visit the city. Thanks again, we hope to be back here some days.

We enjoyed our time at Miertje's appartment. The appartment is perfectly located in the centre of Antwerp, everything is in walking distance. Miertje is a lovely and uncomplicated host, we would go back!

Een erg leuk appartement; super centraal gelegen, alles zit erop en eraan. Miertje is een zeer vriendelijke host die de tijd nam om ons te vertellen wat leuk is om te doen in Brussel. Ik zou het appartement zeker aanraden.

We had a super time. The apartment was really nice, very tasteful and it a great location. The bar downstairs was very convenient. Miertje was also very friendly and helpful providing maps and guide books.

Het appartement wat echt super! De locatie is perfect, het is nog geen minuut lopen van alle lekkere restaurantjes, cafeetjes en van de grootste winkelstraat van Antwerpen . Het appartement is precies groot genoeg voor 2 personen. De koelkast was heerlijk gevuld toen we aan kwamen. Als je tips wil over activiteiten in de buurt mag je altijd miertje contacten. Wij hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad.
Heerlijk verblijf gehad boven de Roscam. Super schoon, heerlijk hoek appartement met top lokatie!

Supernice host! Miertje even left her job for the moment we arrived to hand us the keys and make a short introduction to the apartment. The apartment is on the corner of Frijdagmarkt in the very center of Antwerp, above the "In de Roscam" Cafè. The best neighborhood in town for shoppers and people interested in culture and museums.The Plantin-Moretus Museum is only 50 meters away from the location. A definite recommendation for Antwerp visitors!!!

We loved the stay. Location is just a 5 minutes walk from the Cathedral and Groete Markt. Miertje was waiting for us and explained all the details around the house and also about the location. She recommended that we must visit MAS, and she was so right. It was a very nice touch that she had coffee, butter, jam and even some apples in the fridge. One flight of stairs was not bad except at night when it was a bit dark. Wifi worked flawlessly.

We absolutely loved this apartment; it is in a charming square, which although has 4 or 5 bars in is still fairly quiet at night, but also really close to lots of interesting areas of Antwerp. Great for all sorts of shopping, restaurants, bars and sightseeing.
The restaurant downstairs was a particularly nice and friendly place to hang out (and closed by 9/10 pm, so no noise issues).
Miertje was easy to deal with and all plans for access etc. were well handled. She was also helpful and informative about places to visit.
The apartment is spotlessly clean and comfortable, and lots of little extras provided made for a very pleasant stay.
We will be back.
Leuk appartement aan een gezellig pleintje. Hartje Antwerpen!

This is a very cute apartment in a perfect location. Miertje was a great host, taking time to point out things to do and places to go on a map when we arrived. She also has some books about Antwerp to give us more ideas.
Very clean, light, quiet and cosy.
Great location and super quiet!

Brilliant 2 night stay at Mierjte's apartment. Set in a beautiful square just off the historic centre, corner apartment with big bay windows. We stayed during the Christmas markets, beautiful views of Christmas tree lights in the square at night with cosy fire to keep warm. Overall great experience and the bed was super comfy! (Winner) ticks all the boxes for a short stay in Antwerp.
Wat een geweldig B&B, we hebben hier een topweekend gehad, van alle gemakken voorzien. Heerlijk privé, romantisch en knus appartement vlakbij alle bezienswaardigheden.
Miertje的房子就在安特卫普市中心的中心，来逛街简直太太方便了！楼下就能逛街，而且时装博物馆就在斜对面，楼下的咖啡馆也很赞。好喜欢房子的小清新风格，干净，明亮，就在小广场边视野好。还有个小小的阳台，所有的配备都很齐全。Miertje非常的热情友好，因为火车耽误了，也耐心地等我们，到了房子还会介绍一些城市的讯息，非常棒的一次居住体验。下次还会来！
Had a great time in Antwerp and the hospitality was amazing. Miertje was very helpful and kind. If you are travelling in Antwerp for fun or business, this is a great place to stay

The location is perfect situated in the most beautiful and charming square in Antwerp and above my favourite cafe. Definitely booking again and also Miertje restaurant 'Mimi's' where we had the best Greek meal ever.
Fantastic, just as advertised. Up one flight of stairs, on lively and gorgeous little square. Warm, helpful hostess with great info.

Un endroit magique, chaleureux, apaisant  à deux pas de la grand place. Une hôtesse prévenante et quI nous a accueillis avec chaleur dans un très joli et paisible appartement. Délices à déguster juste au petit resto en dessous. J'y retournerai et vous le conseille ! Merci Kristien

We had a wonderful stay at this perfect located apartment. The place is spacious and lovely furnished. It was very clean and very easy to acess. The whole area is beautiful and the Café downstairs a very cute place to start the day with nice breakfast and a great capuccino. This would be definately the first adress to stay at when coming back to Antwerp.
Tolle Unterkunft mit ausreichend Platz, auch mit einem Baby! Sehr ruhig gelegen und trotzdem mittendrin an einem sehr schönen Platz!!! Kristien war sehr hilfsbereit. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

It was such a an amazing discovery to find such a lovely apartment !
It is in a brilliant location , central and close to all the all the places you want to visit in Antwerp.
It was quiet at night and vibrant during the day.
We really enjoyed our stay and found all we needed for a comfortable break .
We wish to be back soon on our next break from London.
Giuseppe and Karen
Great, central, clean appartment. Clear and quick communication from host.
It's really a history and traditional apartment, and it's clean and comfortable~love it!

Sehr geschmackvolle nette Wohnung, einfach aber mit allem was man braucht. Sehr nette Gastgeberin, reibungslose Kommunikation. Schöne Lage, zentral & ruhig zugleich! Preis-Leistungsverhältnis absolut überzeugend! Empfehlenswert!
Tolle Lage, der Freitagmarkt ist wunderschön!
Gut ausgestattete Wohnung. Uns hat es an nichts gefehlt. Besonders toll ist die zentrale Lage. Gerne wieder :)

L'appartement de Kristien est très bien situé proche de la cathédrale et des bars et restaurant mais donnant sur une petite place sympa et calme. Il est agréable. Kristien est très réactive pour répondre à toute question.

Heerlijk appartement gelegen op een prima locatie aan een gezellig pleintje. Alles aanwezig en zeer schoon.Door de vele ramen veel licht en zicht op het levendige plein. In de nacht is het lekker stil

Ein sehr gemütliches und gut ausgestattetes Appartment am schönsten Platz von Antwerpen. Sehr gute Lage mit vielen Cafés und Restaurants in der Umgebung.
Die Wohnung hat alles was man braucht und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.

It was a wonderful apartment near the central. The stuff members of the coffee shop downstairs were realy friendly.
I recommend Kristien and her Apartment.

Ik verbleef 2 nachten met mijn vriend in Kristien haar appartement, waar we het alleen maar fijn hebben gehad. Het uitzicht is mooi, je kan de kerkklokken horen spelen in de verte en 's nachts is de kerktoren die je door het raam kan zien prachtig verlicht. Het is een rustige buurt, maar tegelijkertijd ben je midden in het centrum. We zijn 3 dagen gebleven en hebben alles te voet gedaan: zonder moe te zijn aan het eind van de dag.
Kristien zelf was snel met reageren op berichten die ik heb gestuurd, ook tijdens mijn verblijf. Ik kan dit appartement en deze gastvrouw zeer aanbevelen.
Perfect location

The apartment is on a quiet corner above a small open market square.  It has a balcony and windows that overlook the square, which is quite charming.  Downstairs the owner has run a cafe for about 15 years, so guests do not have far to go for really delicious light food.  The cafe does not open early or close late, so there is no issue with activity downstairs during sleeping hours.  Everything in the apartment worked well and I would not hesitate to stay there again.  Kristien was a fine host and runs the cafe so is available if need be.

Een leuk appartementje op een toplocatie. Je zit dicht bij winkels, restaurantjes,...
Helaas was de geluidsoverlast zowel van buiten als van binnen een domper op het verblijf. Erg slecht kunnen slapen door het vele lawaai. Ook het te dunne gordijn in de slaapkamer, zorgt snel voor veel lichtinval want niet ideaal is.

Die Wohnung liegt sehr zentral, so dass man alles zu Fuß sehr gut erreichen kann. Sie war sehr sauber und genau wie beschrieben. Die Kommunikation mit Kristien war einfach und sehr nett. Würde ich sofort wieder buchen.
Really lovely place, great location - central and peaceful.
Een super knus appartementje op een geweldige locatie. Ik vond het erg gezellig ingericht en alles was prima in orde!
Erg leuk appartement op een pleintje in Antwerpen. Zeer centraal gelegen, maar wel rustig. Je voelt je er een echte Antwerpenaar!

Kristien’s place was amazing! Located in the old central area of Antwerp and above a cute and delicious cafe, we really enjoyed our time at this apartment. It was comfortable, clean and in a quiet, beautiful square. I look forward to returning to Antwerp and would be quite happy to stay here again.
Really cosy apartment at perfection location to explore the historical area of Antwerp with a responsive host.

Sehr zentral gelegene Unterkunft in der historischen Altstadt von Antwerpen. Sowohl die Sehenswürdigkeiten als auch Restaurants und Einkaufmöglichkeiten sind fußläufig sehr gut zu erreichen. Besonderes Event ist der Freitagsmarkt, der direkt vor den Fenstern der Wohnung zu bestaunen ist. Kristien ist eine freundliche Gastgeberin, die unten im Haus ein gemütliches Cafe betreibt.
Nice place, good location, easy communication and check-in was really smooth

We had a lovely couple of days at Kristien's apartment. It is brilliantly located - we found everything we needed within short walking distance. Dit is een pareltje om te verblijven in Antwerpen! Stijlvol, goede locatie, netjes! Alleen bleef de douche niet altijd warm.. Verder was het echt helemaal perfect!
Heel fijn verblijf gehad in het appartement. Locatie is super en schoon appartement!
Always a pleasure to stay here. Great and flexible checkin, location is the best. Highly recommend for couples who are in for a romantic break away,  shopping or just enjoy Antwerp city!
Great location.

Not only does Kristien's apartment look the same as it does in the photos, but it's BETTER in person. It's so quaint and the location is idyllic. When you stay here, you feel like you're a part of the community. Plus, it was extremely clean, something I'll admit I was a little surprised at. I would expect an apartment of this age to be a little dirty but it truly was incredibly clean.

The bed was comfy, the pillows fluffy, and the Aesop products aren't just for the photos—they're actually there IRL for you to use.

The *only* thing I would suggest being aware of is that the little square where it's located can get a touch noisy on a Friday morning or on Saturday nights. As the square is a community gathering space, it's completely understandable and 100% did not impact my enjoyment of the space. But if you are someone who is sensitive to noise, it may bother you.

Last thing: My absolute favourite part of the whole experience was sitting at the little cafe downstairs for a glass of wine and a little snack. I'll be telling anyone I know that's going to Antwerp to look up Kristien's apartment. If you stay here, you won't be disappointed.

Our stay at the place was absolutely lovely. It was clean and equipped with everything you need. Loved the furnishing and would totally recommend it. It’s situated perfect for a city trip and everything is in a short walking distance.
Very nice and clean Apartment! We come back :)

Gorgeous apartment, bright open and airy! It's in a little square that's lively during the day, but quiet at night. Very centrally located - 20 minute walk really to almost any where. Kristien was quick to respond, and the cafe below made it easy to check in and check out. She provided some local tips that ended up as our favorite places! Super clean and comfortable. I would absolutely stay again!

Great location, charmingly furnished with all the essentials, great light and windows looking out over the square. Easy check-in and checkout, and Kristien provided helpful info re local sights and restaurants

You will have a great base to discover the city.... you can reach everything easyly. The apartment has a warm and cosy bohemian atmosphere. I would recommend it anytime.
Thanks Kristien!

Perfect location in an old and beautiful building. Thoughtfully renovated and great, communicative hosts. I travelled for work, it has everything you need for a home away from home and I will be back.
Stunning apartment on a cute square, great location, helpful and kind hosts. Thanks for a great stay- will be back for sure!

A lovely quaint, comfortable, spacious apartment with lots of light and lovely views in a fabulous location. The outlook over the square, looking across to a mural of a beautiful Japanese woman was gorgeous. Comfortable bed, great shower and well equipped kitchen. We really enjoyed our stay.

The apartment is very lovely and tastefully decorated. We have a nice view to a little square and a very cosy local cafe downstairs. It is perfect  located in the center of Antwerpen and very quiet at the same time.

Wij hebben genoten van een heerlijk verblijf bij Kristien op een perfecte locatie. Het appartment was brandschoon en de sleuteloverdracht snel geregeld.  Het matras was echter toe aan vervanging (lees; kuilen in het matras). Hopelijk wordt dit snel vervangen. Je zit aan een heel gezellig pleintje, maar ervaart daardoor wel overlast van het uitgaansleven.. Overal een prettig verblijf.
Goede rustige plek vlak bij de stad

Nice and cosy appartment, very well located above a lovely square in center town.
Kristen is very attentive to the comfort of their hosts and is nice and very welcoming.
We had a great time to her lovely apartment.

Wij hebben twee heerlijke nachten gehad in Kristiens appartement. De Vrijdagmarkt is een intiem pleintje met een dorpsgevoel midden in Antwerpen. Het café waarboven het appartement gelegen is is huiselijk en rustig en je hebt er totaal geen last van. Het appartement zelf is knus, licht en comfortabel en krijgt extra punten voor de aanwezigheid van sfeerverlichting en kaarsjes.
Wij komen zeker terug!

Kristien’s apartment exceeded our expectations — it was the best two nights of sleep we had during two weeks of travel. The apartment is spacious, comfortable and clean. It’s an older building but charming and perfectly functional. The location is perfect. Check in/out is easy at the cafe downstairs. Kristien is a kind and accommodating host!
Très beau logement spacieux, très confortable et bien décoré. L'emplacement est idéal, l'hôte attentif et ayant préparé des conseils de visite, je recommande vivement!!!

Mooi appartementje in een leuke buurt, redelijk rustig (het café sluit om 21u op vrijdag) en goed gelegen, dichtbij de Nationalestraat en de Groenplaats. Vlot bereikbaar met de tram, mooie winkeltjes in de buurt, goeie uitvalsbasis voor een weekendje Antwerpen.
Heerlijke plek aan rustig plein. Boven café, maar weinig overlast.
We komen terug!!! Txs.

Location, location and location. The apartment sits in one of the fashion forward places in Antwerp. Everything from public transportation, sightseeing, restaurants and shopping is so close to the apartment.

The apartment is stylish and it is bigger than I expected. Access to it is by a set of steep stairs but manageable as you only have to go up one floor. The views from its balcony are a plus to wake up to.

Kristien responded to my inquiries fast, provided accurate information and even when out of her way to stop by late at night when the heater started having issues. She came prepared with an extra one to keep in the apartment. I am so grateful for her as she didn’t have to do this but she made sure we were comfortable and kept apologizing.

Overall one of my best Airbnb experiences.
De perfecte locatie voor een city trip (of langere periode) in Antwerpen. Het appartement is knus, gezellig en heeft een ideale ligging. Wij hebben genoten!

TOP appartement op een super goede locatie in Antwerpen. Vanaf het appartement is alles op loopafstand. Geen geluidsoverlast ‘s avonds en het appartement zelf is super schoon en van alle gemakken voorzien. Kristien reageert snel op berichten en is zeer behulpzaam. Ik zou hier zeker naar terug gaan als ik nog eens in Antwerpen zou verblijven!

Um die Innenstadt von Antwerpen zu erkunden, ein ideal gelegenes Apartment am sehr schönen Vrijdagamarktplatz. Eine sehr nette, zuvorkommende Gastgeberin und hilfsbereites Personal im darunter gelegenen Café! Die Wohnung besticht durch ihre gemütliche Atmosphäre! Ideal für zwei Personen. Frühstück im Café darunter möglich, Bäcker ist um die Ecke. Stadtplan und Museumsführer im Apartment vorhanden, sehr gute Tipps von Kristien (sehr zu empfehlen „De Zeven Schaken“ & „Den Engel“ gegenüber!). Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Was a great cosy place in a perfect area! Thanks a lot
It’s all about this fantastic location and view to a lovely square. Very comfortable stay.

Perfect location, plenty of paid street parking, many many local attractions so close by. So glad to not have a television. The fire place was so cozy. This is the right kind of place for a great Belgian holiday.

L'appartement est très beau et conforme aux photos. Idéalement situé, on s'y sent chez soi.
Kristien et son ami Arno son très réactifs si vous avez besoin de quoi que ce soit. Ce sont de véritables hôtes qui pensent au bien-être et au bon déroulement du séjour des locataires.
Nous y retournerons.

It would not be for everyone because it is a bit spartan but it was DEFINITELY for me.  there was no television- at first that concerned me because I'm used to having my tv on all the time.  but then I discovered I loved not having a tv.  I found a great radio station.  92.1 radio campus Brussels.  location is excellent; chic, quiet, but very close to the main square.  I loved feeling like I was staying in an actual Antwerp apartment, not in a multi national hotel chain.  if Im ever back in Antwerp, I will definitely hope to see here.  thanks Kristen!  your place is a winner!

Really felt like a home away from
home! The natural light is beautiful, the fire in the furnace, having breakfast with a view on the square (and Italian coffee) was delightful and so « gezellig ». Great central location, yet vert calm. We traveled with a little baby and managed to leave the stroller downstairs. The couch was large enough for her to lay on but as there is no bathtub I wouldn’t recommend it for extended stays with littles ones. Check in and check out was super convenient (keys at the cafe underneath the flat). Thanks Kristien!
Great location of apartments, everything is in 5 mins walking distance. Totally recommend staying here. Useful tips for bars and restraunts from Kristien are highly appreciated.
Schöne Wohnung im absoluten Zentrum von Antwerpen. Alles ist praktisch zu Fuß erreichbar. Sehr zufrieden.
hele fijne plek om te logeren. Midden in het centrum maar toch rustig. Het is een mooi appartement met smaak ingericht.
Héérlijk plek!
Beste Lage, nette Gastgeberinnen, gemütliche Wohnung - rund um gut!
Heel fijn verblijf. Stijlvol, knus, huiselijk, schoon en ontzettend goede locatie. Kom heel graag terug!
Great place to explore Antwerp.

Dit appartement ligt in het centrum van Antwerpen, maar toch is het niet druk in de buurt, fantastisch!
Het appartement was erg schoon en het kacheltje maakte het lekker warm en gezellig. Schuin tegenover het appartement kan je heerlijk ontbijten!
Great owner (nice et professional) , great appartment (in the middle of centrum, very charming, super clean), great people et great city
Een heerlijk appartement op een perfecte plek. Leuk ingericht, gezellige gaskachel, oog voor details.
The apartment was perfect for our short trip! We would definitely come back :)
Zeer compleet en sfeervol appartement op top locatie. Aardige ontvangst. Gratis parkeren aan de Schelde op 500m afstand. Echt precies wat je zoekt voor een weekendje Antwerpen!

L’appartement est super joli, bien décoré, propre, feng shui, bien situé... mais dormir dans le lit du salon n’est pas hyper confortable à cause des bruits de la rue et du couloir et de la lumière du couloir. Mais sinon je recommande !! Hôte super sympa et hyper réactive. Merci beaucoup
L'appartement est cosy, chaleureux et très très bien situé .
Een toppertje
Op zich prima!
Would definitely recommend Kristien's place. Was very cozy and close to everything!
Great place, great host, great stay!
Heel mooi en stijlvol verblijf op de ideale locatie!
Quaint and cosy flat. Lacked a few amenities but it's very minor. Kristien was quick to respond and very commodating. Amazing location to boot!
Chouette AirBnb et hôte très à l’écoute et disponible!

Stayed in Kristien‘s apartment for a weekend long together with my boyfriend. The description and the pictures where absolutely on point. The apartment is a perfekt cosy starting point for travellers going to discover Antwerp and all it’s perks and pearls.
Appartement conforme à la description, prope et très bien situé ! Je recommande !
Great airbnb and perfect location, Kristien was very helpful with recommendations and what to do around the city. Couldn’t ask for more!

Een fantastische plek midden in de stad en toch op een heel rustig pleintje. Eronder een gezellig café wat een leuke sfeer geeft. Ideale plek om vanuit alle leuke wijken van Antwerpen te ontdekken. Zeer zeker aan te raden

Zeer aangenaam/knus/mooi verblijfje voor een paar nachtjes om de leuke stad Antwerpen te ontmoeten. Goede/vlot verlopende communicatie met host. 's Nachts goed kunnen slapen (oftewel weinig/geen overlast) van geluid.

Marleen was very welcoming even though we had to change the itinerary (dates). We'll update our review after our actual stay.
Unsere Reise musste wegen unvorhergesehener Umstände verschoben werden. Marleen war so freundlich, ein Ausweichdatum anzubieten. Nach sehr freundlicher Korrespondenz freuen wir uns darauf, die Reise im Juni nachzuholen.
Marleen was very helpful accommodating our arrival time, and gave lots of tips for good places to go and things to see. She was very friendly and her place is lovely.

Marleen's flat is gorgeous and cozy, and is a great place to start from when seeing Antwerp. We loved it! One thing to be aware of in the winter: the heat shuts off automatically at night and during work hours, so if it's below freezing outside, you should plan on being inside a museum during the day.
Vriendelijke en warme ontvangst in een erg prettig appartement. Zeer netjes, compleet en een fijne sfeer. Op wandelafstand van het leuke Antwerpen Zuid. Wij komen er graag een keer terug!
Great place! Marleen was really helpful and made us feel right at home. Thank you so much Marleen!
Eine hübsche Wohnung, freundliche Atmosphäre, ruhiges Viertel, gut angebunden. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Het is zo fijn om je thuis te voelen wanneer je op vakantie bent in een andere stad! Leuke rustige plek, charme van het leven in de wijk,  even wandelen voor een kort ritje met de tram naar de stad die niet snel verveelt. MAS, ZOO, rondvaart door de havens, stoofpotjes en bollekes. Advies van Marleen was op maat en op afroep (Website hidden by Airbnb) en schoon appartement met veel gevoel voor detail ingericht en zelf een tuintje!

Marleen's apartment is really well equipped and beautifully decorated, the best place I've booked on airbnb so far. I was travelling with my dad, so the two bedrooms were perfect. It's located in a quiet neighborhood outside the center, and Marleen's restaurant recommendations (within 10-15 min by foot) were spot-on. If we had been there in the summer, we would have checked out the public bike system as well (there is a bike rack just at the end of the street), to see if it's accessible for tourists. All in all, a great trip.

Een heerlijk, sfeervol en kleurrijk huis met prachtige oude meubels. Het is van alle gemakken voorzien, zelfs een heel luxe kookfornuis met oven. Binnen is het heel stil en we hebben dan ook erg lekker geslapen.
Zowel lopend als met het openbaar vervoer zit je zo in het centrum. Door de omliggende bebouwing is het binnen wel een beetje donker.

Marleens apartment is very nice and I missed nothing there.
It's perfect with the small garden, bicycles from the town 1 min to walk for driving everywhere, shops, cafes - all you can find in the neighbourhood.
We felt like at home...

Es war sehr schön in Marleens Wohnung und sie gab uns gleich gute Tipps. Auch die Tatsache, dass wir verspätet waren, hat sie nicht gestört.
Ihre Wohnung ist sehr schön und gut eingerichtet. Wir haben sehr gut geschlafen. Weil das Wetter nicht so gut war, waren wir froh, so ein gemügliches Zuhause auf Zeit zu haben.

We really liked our stay at Marleen's home in Antwerp. The location was maybe not great, but because of the concept of Velo Antwerp, which was recommended by Marleen, we could reach the old centre in around 10 minutes. Marleen was really helpful and the apartment had everything we needed. Real nice place to spend your time while visiting Antwerp.

Lovely place - very homely, clean and comfortable. The house is situated on a quiet and nice street! Bus and tram stops about a 5 minute walk away, also a supermarket and cafes near!
Marleen was extremely friendly and welcoming! Upon arrival she took the time to talk to us and show and recommend places to go! Very helpful.
Pleasant stay and would definitely return!
Thank you :)

I booked Marleen's apartment for my parents, who came to visit me in Antwerp. From the start, communication with Marleen was great. She was quick to reply and very accomodating.
Due to a miscommunication we were a little late to pick up the keys, but Marleen was very understanding. She made my parents feel at home immediately and even gave them some home-made jam!
The apartment itself is spacious, comfortable, nicely decorated and clean. My parents stayed for three nights and enjoyed it very much. They slept really wel: it is a quiet neighbourhood and at night there is no noise from outside. As for the location, I can testify for myself (I live closeby) that is perfect to discover Antwerp. Either by bike, by foot or by public transport. Moreover, there are some nice cafés, restaurants, (grocery)shops and parks nearby.

My parents told me that when they will be back to visit me, they would love to stay at Marleen's again!

Lovely place - very homely, clean and comfortable. The house is situated on a quiet and nice street! Bus and tram stops about a 10 minute walk away, also a supermarket and cafes near!
One thing to be aware of in the winter: the heat shuts off automatically at night and during work hours,
Marleen was friendly and welcoming!
Pleasant stay and would definitely return!
Thank you :)
really lovely flat！we enjoyed our time in Antwerp!

We had a very enjoyable week at Marlene's appartment. It is really comfortable, and well situated in South Antwerp, which has excellent tram links into town. Marleen lives upstairs so if you have any questions, you can just ask. I would definitely recommend.

L'appartement correspond tout à fait à la description. Le quartier est à la fois calme et vivant avec les commerces pas loin.
Nous avons eu l'impression de passer une semaine chez grand'maman dans une atmosphère confortable et surannée.
Marleen et John sont absolument charmants.

Marleen was a very good host, very friendly and welcoming. I arranged the stay for two guest professors for an international project I worked on and everything went very smoothly and the guests slept comfortable and had a wonderful time at Marleen's home.
Marleen was very welcoming.  Our stay was very enjoyable, we would stay at her place again if we came back to Antwerp.

A friend and I stayed at Marlene’s from Saturday 11th – Wednesday 15th July 2015.

Marlene’s apartment was exactly as described in the Airbnb website. It was clean, comfortable and convenient.

We were greeted warmly. Being new to Antwerp it was great to be given a map of the town, details of where to catch the tram, where the local supermarkets were, and the local cafes etc.

The apartment was in a good area, close to public transport, cafes and shops.

I would definitely look to stay at Marlene’s again if I return to Antwerp, and would recommend it to friends looking for a base in Antwerp.
Vielen Dank, wir hatten einen netten Aufenthalt in Antwerpen.

Marleen was very friendly and gave us some good tips on things to do in Antwerp, and two beers in the fridge! The apartment was nicely decorated and well appointed with everything we needed. The neighbourhood was nice and well located, we walked into the centre of Antwerp and the south station and tram and bus stops  are nearby. All in all, a great stay - thanks Marleen!
Het warme onthaal van Marleen . Een parel van een B & B in Antwerpen. Niet te missen.

In Marleens und Johns Apartment haben Christel und ich uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Es begann dass schon den Parkplatz direkt vor der Tür wie für uns freigehalten war. Im vielsprachigen Bücherregal fanden wir jeder etwas zum Lesen vor dem Schlafengehen. Und geschlafen haben wir auch prima.
Danke Marleen und John.
Via e-mail een tijd afgesproken en wederom vriendelijk door Marleen ontvangen. Even wegwijs gemaakt in het appartement en nog tips gekregen voor restaurantjes. Heel plezierig contact.
A very comfortable apartment in a very nice area! Marleen and her husband were very welcoming and met us late at night after our flight was delayed. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Marleen was zeer vriendelijk en behulpzaam met veel kennis en weetjes over de beste plekken in Antwerpen centrum en de directe omgeving.
Het appartement was schoon, met een fijne sfeer, heerlijk rustig, alles werkt goed, goed bed, goed geslapen.
Very nice area not too far from city center.

Very nice an cozy place just 1/2 hour from the city center.
The place is clean and super spacious for 2 people, you have a kitchen that has everything you need for cocking and some nice supermarkets close by.
Marleen is an awesome host, she explained everything to us!
Merci Marleen pour votre accueil dans votre appartement très pratique et agréable !
Great Apartment quirky and comfortable. Quiet at night for sleeping no complaints
perfect !

L'appartement de Marleen est très confortable et plutôt bien placé : au calme mais à seulement une quinzaine de minutes de marche du centre ville. Nous y avons passé un très bon weekend. Je recommande ce logement !
De plus, Marleen est vraiment très sympathique et accueillante.

Het appartement is stijlvol, comfortabel (lekkere bedden!) en prettig ingericht, (de keuken) goed geoutilleerd en het ligt niet ver van het centrum. Marleen was flexibel en meedenkend; zij heeft ons heel gastvrij ontvangen en handige tips gegeven voor ons verblijf. Er stonden zelfs bloemen op tafel en een schaal met paaseieren, zo attent! Een absolute aanrader!

Marleen is a wonderful host and the apartment is lovely with an outdoor patio off the kitchen.  The bed was extremely comfortable and spacious.  The neighborhood is quiet and relaxing. Easy walk or drive into the old part of the city. The apartment is also on the first floor and easy to manage with luggage or a back pack. At the end of the street is a rack of city bikes you can rent.  We stayed four nights and would return again.

Marleen is very welcoming, helpful and makes you feel home.
Communication went really smooth.
The apartment is lovely, extremely cosy and have everything you need.
What a stunning place! Everything was easy and great, thank you.
really nice place in the south of the centre. bit old fashioned interior. Marleen takes care of you and provides all the basics.
Geweldig appartement. Erg sfeervol.
Marleen is very nice, I have some misunderstand at beginning, but she is very gentle for me.  Give me positive suggestions and try her best to help me. Thanks a lot! House is very Antwerpen style!
very nice hostress, super easy to reach, apartment is in an excellent condition
excellent appartment. Very nice and quiet. Comfortable beds and chairs surrounded by books! real kitchen.
I liked the appartment very much, it was comfortable, clean and well equipped and the host was so nice and had great ideas for our stay.
Marleen's place is very well equipped and comfortable. It's a little way out of the centre of town in a quiet neighborhood
Appartement très agréable, calme, avec un petit jardin pour le beau temps. Bus à proximité. Très propre.
Tres conforme aux attentes de l'annonce. Très bon séjour!!!

Marleen's apartment is cosy, comfortable and absolutely charming with antique furniture and an adjusting garden. The location is a bit away from the centre, but a plethora of lovely cafes can be found in a walking distance, and so is the Volkstraat with the best shops and cafes that Antwerp has to offer.
Lovely place to stay and everything went very smoothly including our late evening collection of the keys!

Beautiful cozy apartment in a quiet area, the house has everything you need for a comfortable life - including a library with colorful books in different languages. Charming vintage house design. A supermarket, a bakery and many pleasant places within walking distance. Marlin is a friendly and sociable hostess, we are very grateful to her.

Zeer vriendelijk ontvangen.
Fijne woning , met alles er op en er aan we komen zeker terug.

집이 위치가 약간 애매한것 빼고는 다 좋습니다.
호스트도 정말 친절하고 집도 훌륭합니다.
다만 잠자는 방들이 좀 춥습니다.참고하세요.
Un lieu spacieux, calme , cosy et très pratique dans un quartier résidentiel  charmant mais assez excentré...
Super!!:)

Cosy and authentic Appartement. Tidy with all the basics you need. Marleen is very kind, and eager to give a lot of inside information. If you are a book fan you will love the Bibliothek style of the living room, where you can sink into the variety of books or just reflect the day with a glass of great belgian beer.

We zijn vaste klant bij Marleen, regelmatig logeren er medewerkers van ons bij haar als wij in de buurt aan het werk zijn. Alleen maar positiefs, fijne communicatie en ontvangst, appartement is gezellig en proper, .. niks dan goeds. Aanrader  !

Perfect stay and hosts.
Can't wait to come back

Some spaces just have a positive ambience, and Marleen's is one of those places. Everything felt right, in terms of aesthetic, space, thoughtfulness, cleanliness; it was like a wonderful Flemish painting, with solidity, balance, and tranquility. I felt happy and secure there. I was only there a short time and did not get to meet Marleen but I somehow felt her graciousness. Highly recommended. No issues at all.
Hele aardige gastheer en gastvrouw die alles er aan doen om er een aangenaam verblijf van te maken. De tuin in de zomer is heerlijk, deze Airbnb is zeker aan te raden :)
Ze waren heel aardig en flexibel!
Zeer gastvrij! Gezellige benedenwoning met tuin in een leuke buurt van Antwerpen.
Ik voelde mij snel thuis in Marleen’s stijlvol ingerichte en met veel boeken gevulde ruime en rustige appartement.  Een hele fijne plek in een fijne buurt.
Nicely decorated and functional apartment, situated in a quiet residential area.
A nice place to stay in Antwerp, about 20 mins walk from the centre. The area is nice and quiet and clean. The apartment is warm and clean. Thanks!

The cosiest place we have stayed in! Great, calm atmosphere, super accommodating hosts.   Really hope to stay there again.. would definitely recommend if you want a nice homely feeling, or if you just like being surrounded by books. The flat is also well taken care of, has everything you need, and the neighbourhood is out of the busiest parts of the center but after a month of getting to know it, I found it to have some little gems. We will miss it! Thank you again.

It felt like home! After our long ride with the car we arrived to this appartment and they were waiting for us with fresh drinks in the fridge and Nespresso coffee! The appartment was super comfortable, Roos and his wife were very friendly, flexible and cousy guys, ready to answer all our questions. We were close to the main touristic attractions. Everything was  walking distance and finding a parking slot was easy!  If we ever go back to Antwerpen I would not think it twice, this is the place to stay!
Very kind and helpful host. A fully equipped apartment located in central Antwerpen with walking distance to everything. Thanks for 3 good weeks in Antwerpen.

We stayed this place for 4 months in total. Great location to access everywhere like the central station, shopping street, the old city, supermarket, etc. The apartment is equipped very well and so very comfortable as well as quiet inside.

Roos and her husband Yves are the nicest and most gracious hosts. The apartment has everything you need to feel at home including fast WiFi, lots of space, excellent laundry, fully functional kitchen and our favorite - a Nespresso machine! Roos was so kind to bring more Nespresso cups during our stay! The location is super - short walk to train station, supermarket, metro stop and many attractions! If we ever come back to Antwerp, this is where we'd stay!

We stayed only 2 nights in Roos's place, and It was just perfect, we felt like in our house! Very good choice for a short time, whith a little guy that was traveling with us (Nicolas - 2 years) it was perfect, enough space to explore and a confortable courtyard, fantastic in summer!

Appartement parfaitement situé pour profiter de la ville. Spacieux, avec une belle cuisine.
Il faut juste penser à emmener un appareil anti-moustique pour ne pas être déranger la nuit.

We stayed only 2 nights, but their apartment was perfect! The location was very convenient (close to Central station, and easy access to tram and bus stations, too). The apartment was just same as photos and has everything you need! They kindly offered some free drinks (beer, water, Nespresso, etc) and very helpful. They always reply a message very quickly. Thanks Roos and Yves! I highly recommend their place!
Very clean , desituner, and fully eguiped apartment . The Roos was very helpful.

everything was great!
in the heart of city center, big, clean and comfortable rooms, kitchen and garden..
fast wifi connection and cool soundsystem..
i feel like home.
highly Recommend!
thanks for everything, hope to see you soon :)

The apartment was extremely comfortable and easy to relax in. Very clean and quiet, but close to a wide variety of restaurants. excellent stay... both frank and lieve and very warm, we felt at home.

great, easy stay!

Fronk & Lieve are wonderful! They gave us great guidance and hospitality. We really enjoyed Antwerp and mostly thanks to our hosts!! Make sure you have more time than we did.... 24 hours is not enough.

Fronk and Lieve were exceptional hosts. They are extremely courteous and provide a homelike environment. The rooms are clean, peaceful, and quiet. Their kitchen is also nicely equipped. I had a very nice stay.
