The owners, a wonderful couple with two young children, also live in the house but completely respect your privacy. They are also ready to suggest places to see or somewhere to go and eat.
I would most certainly book with them again if they are available when I am looking for a place to stay in Antwerp!
An absolutely lovely apartment, in a great location. Joelle gave us great tips and was very welcoming and her daughters and mum were lovely with our son. I would highly recommend staying here.
Superleuk verblijf gehad!

It was one of your beautifullst place to stay. Its a very charming Appartement.
We had a warm welcome and Joelle and her Husband was very Fried my and helpfully hosts. Also her daughters are very lovely Kids. Thanks for this nice Holiday.
Fijn verblijf!

Very clean, spacious and beautiful place. It was on the top floor of the building the host owns so they live just down stairs but still kind of renting entire flat. The hosts were very friendly and helpful. The location was very convenient. There are very steep stairs to go to bed so you cannot use the bed if you have problem with legs. I really loved the stay so definitely will go again if I have chance.
We had a fantastic stay at Joëlle’s place - Joëlle and Darren were so welcoming and gave some great local advice on where to visit. The apartment is excellent and in a great location!

Super fijn verblijf gehad in het huisje van Joelle en Darren! We werden gastvrij ontvangen door Darren, die ons meteen op ons gemak stelde. Ook leuke tips gekregen om naartoe te gaan! Zoals restaurantjes, barretjes en bezienswaardigheden. Het verblijf is heel knus en schoon. Mega leuke airbnb!

Joelle’s and Darren’s place is awesome. The place is clean, very well maintained and well equipped. We stayed there for 2 months and we felt like home. Darren and Joelle are very attentive, always eager to help or chat, and their 2 girls are very sweet and polite. I recommend the place from the bottom of my heart. You won’t regret it.
We had a great time in Antwerp and enjoyed our stay at Joelle's and Darren's house! Thank you for everything!

Super Wohnung! Totales Wohlfühl-Ambiente! Sehr sauber und ruhig. Familie bewohnt die unteren Etagen, die Wohnung ist oben drüber. Viele gute Tipps durch den Gastgeber!

Ganz kleiner Nachteil: In der Nähe sind keine/kaum Cafés etc. und Parken war - zumindest mit einem großen Auto - eine Katastrophe.

Het is een heerlijk appartement op de bovenste verdieping van een herenhuis. Heerlijk ruim. Wel 6 trappen op en weer af. Dus minder geschikt voor mensen die niet goed kunnen traplopen.
De locatie is rustig en toch middenin de stad. Supermarkt en kroeg om de hoek en een kwartiertje lopen naar het centrum van Antwerpen. Kan niet beter!

We had a fantastic stay at Joelle‘s and Darren‘s house. Our hosts were ever so friendly and gave us many valuable hints as to places to visit, nice restaurants and so forth. Wenn  would go back to this place any time. Highly recommendable!  Uli and Momo

Joelle en Darren zijn bijzonder vriendelijke gastgevers die een ruim, lichtdoorvloed, smaakvol en compleet appartement aanbieden. De keuken is zeer volledig, de badkamer heeft een badkuip, alles is brandschoon, er zijn attente details, het interieur is smaakvol en gezellig zonder overdaad. Bovendien verliep het contact zeer open en vol behulpzaamheid. Klasse!
Great spacious apartment and awesome hosts. You can’t wish for more on Airbnb :-)

Joelle and Darren's place was absolutely lovely! Just like the pictures, and very comfortable. The location is a little way out of the center, but an easy walk to Central Station and there is a city bike station 50m away for easy transport!  Great fish restaurant (Fish House) around the corner as well. Darren gave us some great suggestions for places to visit that were the highlight of our (short) stay!
Great stay, lovely family! Really recommend it!
Een heerlijk appartement, ruim, gezellig en smaakvol. Wij hopen zeker terug te komen!
Mooi appartement
It was better than I expected and it was spacious as well

Vooral het inchecken door Darren en de girls was erg vriendelijk en gezellig en we voelde ons direct thuis. Zowel Joëlle en Darren toonde veel interesse en namen de tijd om ons te helpen. Samen met het schitterende weer maakte dit appartement ons weekend perfect!
Very nice place, very helpful people.

A perfect airbnb experience! I loved this loft apartment which is the attic of the beautiful old building Darren and Joelle's family live in. Darren was very friendly and offered great recommendations of where to go in Antwerp. The location was very convenient and only a 10 min walk to Centraal station. Also the tiny stereo sounds surpassingly good. I loved coming home every night to unwind on the couch while listening to the radio (which was tuned to a great local station).

It's 4 or 5 stories up and the stairs inside the apartment are quite steep, so if you have trouble with stairs this might not be a good place for you. But if that's not a problem for you, I could't recommend this home enough.
Great location, 10 mins walk from the main station, nice flat, in the same house as the owners. Hosts were nice but had troubles with wifi and TV.

We stayed here for 5-6 weeks and absolutely loved it. It was our favorite experience with Airbnb so far and they were such wonderful hosts! The location is great because it’s walkable distance to the city center, and the apartment is clean, spacious, and bright. We can’t recommend it enough :)
L'appartement est exactement comme sur les photos, très lumineux, joli, avec tout les équipements nécessaires et un supplément d'âme. Joëlle st une hôtesse parfaite. Je recommande.

Merci à Joelle, Daren et sans oublier le ravissant Welcoming Comittee!
Franchement un super séjour, appartement génial et calme. Merci à Daren pour ses précieux conseils de sortie, visites! N’hésitez pas une seconde! Une famille fort sympathique, accueillante et discrète. Merci beaucoup !
Een grote, gezellige leefruimte met alle nodige voorzieningen. Mooie aparte badkamer. Ze hebben op een leuke manier de slaapkamer ingericht.

Great apartment with excellent location (10-15 min walking from central station). In the apartment you find everything you need for your stay. Joelle was communicative throughout and gave us great tips to go around Antwerp.

De ruimte was fijn en Joëlle & Darren waren gastvrij. Het was wel een stukje lopen naar het centrum, maar daardoor zit je wel buiten de drukte wat prettig was. Daarnaast is er ook de mogelijkheid om een bus te pakken. In de buurt zitten ook een aantal leuke cafeetjes

Wir hatten einen perfekten Aufenthalt bei Joelle und Darren. Wir reisten Freitag mittags an und durften sofort einchecken, da wir uns schnell für Tomorrowland fertig machen wollten.
Das Appartment ist sehr gut ausgestattet, es gibt alles was das Herz begehrt.
Am 2. Tag des Festivals hat es den ganzen Tag geregnet, da lieh mir Joelle kurzerhand ihre Gummistiefel inklusive Socken, damit hat sie mir wohl das Wochenende gerettet.
Die Gastfreundschaft dieser Familie ist riesengroß, ich würde dort immer wieder buchen, wäre ich in Antwerpen :)
Also eine klare Empfehlung in jeglicher Hinsicht bei Joelle und Darren zu buchen!!!

Great hosts and a perfect appartement!
The appartement is on the top floor of an older house with those wooden floors and high ceilings. The house is close to the central station, with enough cheap (€3,80 a day) parking space in the area.
Darren opened the door and showed us the appartement, joking about things and telling us about the city. He even had a map with some personal bests (restaurants, bars, sightseeings) noted in it.
There is very much daylight in the room, and the high ceiling makes it look ever bigger. The bedroom is on a second half open floor, which is very cool. What's the stairs to this second floor because they are steep.
Darren and Joëlle are really kind, bringing us fresh grounded coffee beans and letting us stay half a day longer since there where no check-ins directly after us. Since it's a big house, you don't notice that they are living there with two kids as well. Therefore you have a lot of privacy. We would definitely recommend it.

If you want something calm, nice, cosy, clean and  affordable for your trip in Anvers you can trust Joelle's place! She's really nice and   for people who don't speak anything else, she speaks French. We really enjoyed staying in her house for our trip

Heerlijke ruimte, stukje lopen naar het centrum.
Heel gastvrij en van alle gemakken voorzien.

It was great staying in Joelle's place. Really clean and stylish. Both Joelle and her husband were really polite and gave us tips and some coffee to start our first day with. Would really recommend this accommodation!
Het huis is prachtig. Joelle en Darren zijn een hele goeie gastvrouw en gastheer, vooral heel behulpzaam! Met goeie tips en ze staan klaar voor je als je vragen hebt.
Geweldige Airbnb in een prachtig huis! Het was erg leuk om bij zulke gastvrije mensen te kunnen slapen. Dat is juist de essentie van Airbnb en die heeft Joelle helemaal begrepen.
We had a great stay. Good communication and check in went smooth. Comfortable appartment with all neccessary ammenities. Highly recommended
Great place to stay in Antwerp! Would highly recommend.
Fijne plek om te zijn! Heerlijk slapen in het ‘tentje’ boven, prettig liggen om te Netflixen op de bank, maar ook een prima ligging om de stad te verkennen.

Joëlle und Darren sind großartige Gastgeber: sehr, sehr nett, hilfreich mit Tipps, die Unterkunft liegt phantastisch, die Wohnung ist total gemütlich und toll eingerichtet. Wir würden bei einem Antwerpen-Aufenthalt jederzeit wieder zu den beiden ziehen! Vielen lieben Dank nochmals!
Zo leuk op de bovenste verdieping van een echt familie huis. Lekker centraal gelegen ten opzichte van alles eigenlijk. Heerlijk rustige plek, geen geluidsoverlast.

Op de foto's ziet het appartement er al mooi uit, maar in het echt is het appartement nog veel mooier en ruimer dan verwacht. Het verblijf zit op een relatief rustige locatie, maar wel dichtbij het centraal station en het winkelgebied. Het appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien en straalt veel rust uit. Perfect voor een weekend weg!

Joelle´s flat is great! It´s under the roof of her house but you can´t hear a thing from downstairs. As far as we could see it, the whole house is amazing! Her husband recieved us, he is very very friendly, gave us a lot uf useful tips (e.g. one of the best pizzas we ate in the last years), they gave us a brick of milk for free... Great! By the way, her daughter opend the door, but don´t get nervous (as I did) because she speaks perfectly english :) All in all we highly recommend this flat. Thanks for the great stay!
Super!

Un agréable séjour dans un appartement chaleureux et intimiste, décoré avec goût.
Des hôtes à l’écoute et charmants.
Difficile de devoir partir...
Merci !

We really enjoyed staying here - they are a super nice family and the flat itself is really cool! So cozy and well equipped. We’re already thinking about coming back in summer. Thank you so much again!!
Joelle and Darren were amazing hosts, their space is exactly what you see in the photos and more. A perfect city getaway.

Joelle und Dan sind hervorragende Gastgeber, super hilfsbereit und total herzlich. Wir fühlten uns absolut wohl bei den beiden. Das Apartment ist sehr großzügig, unglaublich liebevoll eingerichtet und mit allem ausgestattet, was man sich bei kürzeren oder auch längeren Aufenthalten wünscht. Empfehlenswert sind auch Dan‘s Gastro-Tipps!

This space is absolutely beautiful. It’s the perfect space if you are looking for a tranquil break. Dan and Joelle were extremely hospitable, responded to our request within minutes and accommodated our late check in. The space was sparkling clean and there were cute little touches that made our stay that much better. They were there whenever we needed anything. We’d definitely stay here again and didn’t want to leave in the first place!  Thank you again!
Immens gezellige penthouse met een overvloed aan ruimte en licht, en een enorm hartelijk en attent gastkoppel. Grote aanrader!!
Nice clean appartment in the center. Perfect for two people. Good host.
Prachtige ruimte met alle voorzieningen aanwezig op een mooie locatie. Heel gastvrije host. We hebben genoten!
Un nid d'aigle bien agréable où vous poser pendant votre séjour à Anvers ! La maison est magnifique et pleine de vie, l'expérience est très agréable !
Very nice!
Joelle, Darren and the kids made my last few months in Antwerp some of the best I've had. Really felt at home with some great neighbours!
Joelle was a lovely host. Communication with her was very easy and the check-in was also smooth.

De studio helemaal boven in een groot herenhuis en was nog beter en ruimer dan verwacht! Joelle gaf ons meteen een thuisgevoel, we kregen leuke tips voor in Antwerpen, vonden alles wat we nodig hadden..
Slapen onder dak was heel aangenaam en helemaal niet warm (wij kwamen midden in de zomer!) :) Er komt veel mooi licht binnen in de studio, maar de slaapruimte kan je fijn afschermen met gordijnen, prima om te slapen. Een heel fijn verblijf en een aanrader om Antwerpen te ontdekken!

We just had the best time at Joelle’s - she’s so kind and gives the best recommendations for bars, cafes, restaurants and other things to do in Antwerp.
The apartment is located at the top floor of her beautiful house and has everything you need - definitely recommended also for longer stays!
Thanks again, Joelle, really hoping to be back someday!

Die Unterkunft von Joelle ist eine wahre Ruheoase zur aufregenden Großstadt Antwerpen. Trotzdem befindet sie sich in Zentru (Hidden by Airbnb) ähe und alles durch Öffi‘s, Fahrrädern oder gut zu Fuß erreichbar.
Die Wohnung hat alles was man sich wünscht. Die Gemütlichkeit der Wohnung wird durch die liebevolle Gestaltung unterstützt und bietet das Gefühl von zuhause.
Wer mit dem Auto anreist, sollte sich bewusst sein, dass der Parkraum sehr begrenzt ist.
Très agréable séjour chez Sophie et Manu.  L'appartement est fidèle aux photos. Je recommande cette adresse ;)

Sofie & Manu hebben een fantastisch mooi appartement gemaakt in de hippe buurt 't Zuid. Precies zoals je ziet op de foto's. Het appartement is gloednieuw en heel smaakvol/minimalistisch/modern ingericht met goede meubels en een heerlijk bed. Zeer complete keuken. Veel handdoeken en extra beddengoed. Er stond een heerlijke fles wijn voor ons klaar en een lokaal cadeautje. Wij kwamen met ons jonge dochtertje waarvoor we een reisbedje meegenomen hadden. Dit  paste prima naast ons eigen bed. De badkamer heeft een heerlijke regendouche. Het huis had ook veel bergruimte. De buurt is super. Op loopafstand van mooie winkels en cafeetjes. Wij komen graag een keer terug want we hebben nog lang niet genoeg gezien van Antwerpen. Op de BG vind je een erg leuk ontbijt-koffietentje. Handig! In het appartement zelf merk (hoor/ruik) je hier niks van. Kortom; een aanrader!

Gelegen in een toffe buurt. Openbaar vervoer en Antwerpen velo zijn vlakbij, heel eenvoudig te gebruiken en heel handig om de omgeving te verkennen. Ontvangst en uitchecken gebeurt heel flexibel. Toffe eigenaars en vriendelijke ontvangst. Appartement is volledig ingericht en voorzien van alle benodigdheden. Modern, proper en netjes appartement gelegen op het hippe zuid.

Wij (koppel & zoontje van 3) hebben het geluk gehad om 6 nachten te kunnen logeren op dit kei leuke appartement! Alles was tip top in orde en met heel leuke smaak ingericht. Prima buurt, aangenaam ontvangst  met fles wijn en heerlijke antwerpse handjes. Een echte aanrader en Sofie, we komen zeker terug!
Geweldig appartement, centraal gelegen in Antwerpen Zuid. Zeer vriendelijke gastvrouw en -heer. Aan iedereen aan te bevelen!

Hallo Sofie en Manu, we hebben genoten van ons verblijf in Antwerpen. Jullie hebben een heerlijk appartement. Alles was aanwezig, een heerlijk bed, een fijne douche en het was allemaal super schoon. Bedankt voor de vriendelijke ontvangst en wij komen zeker nog een keer terug.
Light and very modern appartment in the trendy Antwerp Zuid district, located above a nice café, which is handy for lunch or breakfast.

Heerlijk appartement. Lekker flesje wijn bij aankomst. De buurt is ontzettend gezellig met heel veel leuke restaurantjes en cafe's op loopafstand. De supermarkt om de hoek is ook een pre. Op uitnodiging van de benedenburen van Tartino het nieuwe jaar na het vuurwerk op de Schelde verder ingeluid met een glaasje cava. Geweldige tijd gehad!
Echt mooi appartement en alles keurig schoon en fris. Flesje wijn bij aankomst geeft een gastvrij gevoel. Locatie Zuid is erg leuk in Antwerpen dus een echte aanrader wat ons betreft !
Very clean, nicely decorated, new, quiet apartment in a nice neighbourhood! Everything we needed was provided and wifi was good too. Really enjoyed our stay and Sofie was a great host!

We had a perfect time in Sofie's & Manu's Flat. Its very modern and clean. The neighborhood is also very nice and the restaurant below the apartment is neat and the people are very friendly. Sofie is a great host. We recommend this flat for nice days in Antwerp.

Both the apartment itself as the location are perfect for a weekend trip Antwerpen. The apartment was very nice, spacious and clean.  The location is great for those who are a bit bored by being constantly at the main squares and prefer to explore the nice upcoming neighborhoods. Many museums around the corner, Antwerpen's best shops at only a 10 min nice walk and we enjoyed some bars and restaurants on the 2 squares nearby or at the Vlaamsekaai (like our lunch at Tinsel).
Everything was easy and perfect. The  appartment was very clean.

Good Neighbourhood.
Warm Welcome.
Super cozy apartment.
No real comments to be made.

Fijne plek, zeer schoon, ruim en licht. Sofie wachtte ons al op, legde alles uitgebreid uit en er stond zelfs een fles wijn klaar voor ons. Goed geoutilleerde keuken, prettige locatie. Diverse restaurants en cafés op loopafstand. Wel jammer van de kookluchtjes uit het onderliggende lunchtentje, maar eenmaal binnen ruik je die bijna niet meer.

Wat een heerlijk weekend! Zeer gastvrije ontvangst en een heerlijk appartement in de leukste wijk van Antwerpen. Alles op loopafstand te bereiken. Appartement is voorzien van alle gemakken, heeft een lekkere douche en comfortabel bed.

Bedankt voor een zeer geslaagd verblijf!
We really enjoyed our stay in Sofie and Manu's flat. It's very comfortable, modern, and in an excellent location near the Palais de Justice. We thoroughly recommend it!

We zijn 4 dagen in het mooie appartement van Sofie en Manu geweest. Het was heel handig dat de supermarkt direct om de hoek was, de auto vlakbij gratis geparkeerd kon worden en er voldoende restaurantjes in de directe omgeving zijn. Wij hebben alles in Zuid en in het centrum te voet verkend en dat is goed te doen. Voor wie dat niet wil zijn tram- en bushalte op heel korte afstand. Kortom een prima locatie om Antwerpen te verkennen.
Zeer de leuke verblijfplaats. De ruimte is best wel voldoende groot zeg maar voor 2 tot 3 personen en natuurlijk schoon.

Alles was top geregeld !!
Super schone locatie en een warm onthaal. Communicatie was ook erg helder. De locatie is heel fijn tussen leuke barretjes en restaurants
Kortom enjoy !!!
Zie vorige recensie. Alles nog steeds helemaal top.
Excellent flat, location and hosts :)
The apartment has everything you need ; modern , neat , great location & a friendly host .

Alles wat je nodig hebt in dit basic appartement. De wijk is rustig, maar horeca op loopafstand. Fietsverhuur en tram om de hoek en gratis parkeren op 10 minuten lopen. Niet bijzonder sfeervol, maar wel heel comfortabel!
An absolutely incredible stay! Great location, very clean and tidy flat and most importantly, wonderful hosts xx

Très bel appartement. Très lumineux, confortable, beaux matériaux. Convient parfaitement pour une famille de 3 ou 4 personne. Quartier calme, un peu excentré, proche du tribunal. Facile de se garer.
Sofie nous a parfaitement accueilli.

Manu is een goede gastheer, heel flexibel en duidelijk in zijn afspraken.
Mooi en comfortabele plek om te verblijven!
The host canceled this reservation 32 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

The apartment is very very nice and comfortable for living, well equipped. Location is perfect, in trendy district Zuid. Many thanks to Manu for such warm hospitality and prompt help. We spent lovely 2 month in Antwerp. Dream to come back again!))

We really enjoyed our stay here! Great location near several bars and restaurants, close to public transportation and a 15 minute walk to the Center. Also close to the river front. Fun new area to discover and everything is within walking distance.
Heads up that there’s no elevator and the steps up to the apartment are narrow and steep. The apartment itself is very bright and quiet. The host was very accommodating and check-in / checkout was smooth. Would highly recommend!
Prima kamer en aardige verhuurders! Erg schoon en lekker bed!
Very nice stay: clean room with a good mattress, big clean bathroom and a very friendly couple to welcome you.

An was an amazing host who greeted us warmly, even after a delayed late night check in. Her house was clean and spacious with a gorgeous bathroom and comfortable accomodations. In addition to accomodating our requests, An anticipated our needs and was always prompt in her responses. If you're looking for comfort, cleanliness and a warm welcome to Belgium, An's home should be at the top of your list!

We passed a nice time at An's house. She greeted us warmly and was very flexible and helpful. The house was lovely, clean and comfortable. The center is very close if you take the train. We really recommend to stay at An's house, we would chose her again.

Hoi! 
Mijn vriendje en ik hebben ons in An’s huis echt behaaglijk gevoeld, omdat er een mooie badkamer en slaapkamer op je wachten. An en haar echtgenoot zijn heel lieve mensen en je krijgt hulp als je die nodig heeft.
Groetjes!

The whole house is very clean. We also found that the host is so considerate to prepare the stuff we might need to use. By the way, the style of the house is classy. We really had a nice stay in An's place. Thanks very much.
Simple but nice room. Our hosts were very kind and talkative. Good experience!
Nice house, nice people, we had a great time.

Our stay with An was very nice. The house was very close to a train and tram station, so getting to the Antwerp city center or Brussels was convenient. The room was as shown in the pictures and the bed was very comfortable. Thanks An!
Première expérience très sympathique, la chambre est fidèle à l'annonce : très agréable. An a partagé avec nous ce qu'elle connaissait de sa ville. des bons bien utiles pour un court séjour.

Superlekker geslapen in een heerlijk bed! Het huis is superschoon en An is vriendelijk. Heerlijk kamertje in een rustige buurt, prima te bereiken met de auto en met openbaar vervoer zit je zo in het centrum van Antwerpen. Doen.
An is ontzettend vriendelijk. Geeft goed advies over de buurt. De kamer is mooi en schoon; precies wat ik nodig had!

De ruimte was Ok,maar het was er koud op de kamer en de verwarming werkte niet !!Ook geen nachtlampje !! Dat wilde dus zeggen,dat je uit bed moest voor het licht uit te doen !!! Voor die prijs had ik me echt wel iets beters voorgesteld !!
Nice attic room and big clean bathroom in a quiet area of Antwerp. Nice bars and restaurants nearby.

We zijn heel gastvrij ontvangen door An.
De locatie is prima; lekker rustig en toch zit je zo in het centrum.
Lekker bed en hele fijne badkamer!
We vonden het een prettige logeerplek in een sfeervol huis. Alles was heel netjes en verzorgd!

We had a nice, quiet and private time in our cosy room. An was very kind to let us put our bikes in the hallway, even though this was not agreed upon on forehand. Thank you! The bathroom is very clean and large. An gave us very helpful indications on how to find nice restaurants in the neighbourhood.
Prima kamer en mooie badkamer. Het centrum is goed te bereiken, openbaar vervoer is om de hoek. Voor een ontbijtje kan je eventueel 100m verderop terecht bij een supermarkt of bakkerij.

We stayed with An and Yves for a night, and absolutely loved our stay. It is a great, affordable room in the gorgeous Antwerp. The bed was extremely comfortable and the third- storey room had a large window and view of the street which was lovely, as the street is where the locals hang out. An told us about Dagerardplatz and we are a few delicious meals there with not a tourist in sight. If you are visiting Belgium, you should definitely go to Antwerp, and An's place is a fantastic spot to relax after a hard days' eating and drinking.

we really enjoyed the stay in berchem. The sleeping room was very cleanand cosy ,also the bathroom was very clean.
the bed was super confortable, the hosts very friendly and helpful
I can only recommend

An agreed to give us the room on extremely short notice! Our decision to go to Antwerp was very impromptu, and we would definitely not have turned up if An had not quickly communicated and agreed to host us for the night.

We arrived very late, but she sorted out the check in problems. The first thing you'll notice about the house is that it is extemelyyyy clean. It's very beautiful, just look at the bathroom.

Our room was also very nice, the bed was comfortable, and the decor was very relaxed. We did not get to talk much as we arrived very late and left soon after waking up, but An and her husband seemed very nice, and the place would be great to stay for a longer time.
Lovely stay un An house... Very neir to The station... Neir also from tram and bus.  Like The place, The room was confortable.

We spent a really nice day in An's place. It was extremely easy to get there by bus from the central train station in Antwerp, and once off the bus it was only a few minutes walk to arrive to our destination. An's house is really nice, extremely well decorated, simple and elegant. The room is cozy, comfortable and really clean, as the bathroom. An and Yves were also really helpful with with suggestions for buses. I think it was a wonderful experience as my first booking with airbnb, Thanks :)

An and Yves were lovely hosts! Their place wa easy to find, the price is unbeatable, and super clean! We asked them for directions to a restaurant and even though they hadn't been to one in a while, they were very helpful in instructing us to areas where we could find a nice place to eat.

We had a great time in Antwerp. An&Yves shared their beautiful home with us - the room is tastefully decorated and our hosts were very warm and welcoming. The location is very convenient - only two minutes walk to the next train/metro station. Definitely recommended!
It is really a nice and lovely house. Near the train station(not the central station), very convenient.
Our stay with An was brief but very pleasant. She was helpful in giving us directions and the apartment was quite simple to locate. The room was clean and comfortable. Over all a great stay!

De kamer zag er knus en gezellig uit. We waren iets later maar werden goed ontvangen. We kregen nog wat tips over activiteiten in de stad en hebben genoten van ons verblijf. Alles was goed verzorgd en schoon. Zelfs de handdoekjes en een flesje shapmpo lag er voor ons klaar. Een aanrader!

An is a great host! She is offering a great room in a very nice house located 15 min walk from Antwerp center and only 3 min from train station. You've got also bike rental nearby. Our bed was comfortable and ideal for two people. Guest room was spacious and very clean. Overall it's a great deal! You won't notice that someone is in the house with you untill you want to talk to your host or ask her sth. I totally recommend An.

Very pleasant house and room! The bathroom quite charming, and everything was clean and even smelled nice. The hosts were very friendly. I look forward to my next time back!
Thanks!

An was out of town but her husband Yves was quick to greet us. The house is nice and the room is spacious. It is well locate near the Berchem station, 10 minute walk. The only issue we had was with the noise level outside at times.

The place was very clean and homely, which was great after staying in hostels! Had everything we needed; the bathroom was great. Was also very close to transport that got us into the center quite quickly. Really pleasant stay and nice people too.

A great place to say, in a very handy location (minutes from the station) on a quiet street. The room was lovely and clean and very comfortable. Great communication - everything ran extremely smoothly. Many thanks for a great experience.

I really recomend this airbnb, the house is really cozy and well decorated and she is super friendly and kind. We had a great time there, she make us feel like home.
The room was great and very private and the house well comunicate with a train station super close.

Nette kamer in een mooi huis, vlakbij station Antwerpen-Berchem.
Dichtbij de prachtige Art-Nouveauwijk. Tweede verdieping aan rustige straat. An hebben we niet veel gezien, maar wij kenden Antwerpen al.

We stayed at An's place for a few days because of the construction works going on in our own house. This is a very nice place to stay! We got exactly what we were looking for: a warm welcome and a clean and cosy room and bathroom in our neighbourhood. Thank you An!

An war sehr flexibel und hat meine Buchung angenommen, obwohl sie ihren ersten Tag im neuen Job hatte und das Zimmer nach der Arbeit noch für mich herrichten musste, daher konnte ich erst um 19 Uhr abends einchecken. Auch der Check Out war unkompliziert, ich konnte den Schlüssel einfach in den Briefkasten werfen. Das Zimmer war süß, sauber und die Matratze sehr bequem. Allerdings lag die Wohnung etwas abseits von Zentrum, bis zum nächsten Platz mit Restaurants muss man ca. 20 min laufen oder wieder mit der Bahn ins Zentrum fahren. Die Mitbenutzung der Küche ist hier nicht vorgesehen. Das hatte ich bei der Buchung übersehen, An hat mir trotzdem ihren Wasserkocher zur Verfügung gestellt um Tee zu kochen, da es relativ kühl war während meines Besuchs. Ich persönlich hätte mir einen kurzen Smalltalk mit An und ein Glas Wasser/Tee zur Begrüßung gewünscht. Dies kenne ich von anderen Airbnb Aufenthalten so. Ganz besonders wenn man alleine reist freut man sich auf einen "warming welcome". Insgesamt ist es eine gute Unterkunft wenn man etwas ruhiger, nicht direkt im Zentrum wohnen möchte.

An's apartment was really lovely! It was about a 45 minute walk from the centre but it turned out that we enjoyed spending time in her neighbourhood more than we did in the centre! Good coffee shops, bakeries and bars and the locals are so friendly! Would stay again!
Same as my previous review!

an is a really nice host who gives you privacy which you need on a long journey. she also has maps for the city for you and gives you advice if needed. we enjoyed our stay very much! especially the beautiful bathroom felt like holiday itself (:

An is a great host! My girlfriend and me stayed for two nights in her house and enjoyed it a lot! An is very friendly and helps you along and recommends you some nice places to spend some time at. Antwerpen is a great city, by the way, which we liked a lot as well. We can strongly recommend An and her nice, cosy and clean house in a calm and safe neighborhood. Everytime again!!
An est charmante et nous a bien accueilli mon fils et moi, le quartier dans lequel nous nous trouvions était sympathique, très proche en tram du centre d Anvers.
Top onderkomen! Ruime slaapkamer en badkamer, goed bed en schoon. Het centrum is goed bereikbaar met op ov.
We had a very good time in An's pretty house! Thank you!

We were happy to stay in An's apartment for 2 nights. Rooms is very cosy and clean with spacious bath. Perfect location:house located within few steps to Berchem station, not far from city historical center and close to Zurenborg area with plenty of bizarre Art Nouveau mansions.

An heeft een mooi huis net iets buiten het centrum. De kamer is prima! Ruim en schoon. De badkamer deel je dit is heel goed te doen. Het waren twee top dagen en hoop voor de mensen die na ons komen ook.
Groetjes Petra
An was nice, but we didn't see her much. Room was clean. Nice environment. Close to railway station, and a good distance from the city center. Great value for money.

An was really kind, sweet and understanding to us. Her house is relaxing, comfortable and the room she offers is great: it's spacious, private and has little touches of good mood elements. The house is real nicely located. We would definitely recommend this home as a top spot to stay in Antwerp!

It was a great experience. It was really homey and confortable. Everything was clean. It is luminous and well decorated. An was nice and helpful (as to where to park our car for example). 2 persons have all the room they may need and their privacy. It is well located with Berchem station close-by.
I had a very nice stay at An's. The room was nice and clean, and An was a good host. Getting to the city centre by public transport was really easy. Me and my sister had a really nice weekend!
A very nice host and a very nice house. Thank you for hosting us despite our troubles on the road. Definitely, a perfect place to stay!
De kamer was heel schoon en netjes. Prima locatie, en goed met het openbaar vervoer te bereiken. De kamer is aan te raden!

Nous avons été satisfait de la chambre, merci beaucoup. Après avoir visiter Anvers, nous vous avons laisser la carte de la ville dans votre boite à lettre avec des tickets de métro qui semblent pas être utilisés. Bonne année 2015.
We have very good time at An's house. An have us some advises. The room is quite big and very nice. It is 30 minutes from the centre and 10 by the tram. An, thank you for the warm welcome!
Een fijne, nette en schone kamer op loopafstand van het station Berchem. Vriendelijke gastvrouw; ik was heel tevreden.

An was very accommodating and nice to me and my sister! Even thou we only stayed at her beautiful place for one night only she made sure nothing was missing for us as soon as we came in.

She also let us breathe without trying to overwhelm us with forced hospitality. She was authentic and very nice!

Her home is beautifully decorated with wonderful photos and the whole place felt homey and well kept.

The whole experience was just what we needed, and thanks to An we had a great time in Antwerp.

Alles was keurig verzorgd. Schone en aangename kamer. Mooie ruime badkamer. Aardige gastvrouw! Kregen zelfs een lekker warm kopje thee toen we verkleumd op onze kamer aankwamen na een natte dag in de stad. Prima buurt. Dichtbij het station Antwerpen-Berchem, dus gemakkelijk om naartoe te reizen. Met het OV kon je makkelijk naar het centrum, maar dat kon ook prima te voet in een dik halfuur.
Was heel tevreden over het appartement. Het was een prima locatie, je was in vijf minuten met de trein in het centrum. De kamer was prima en bovendien was het ook schoon.
An and the room were nice, we had a good time and could always ask An when we had questions. Thanks again!

Beste An, mijn vriendin had alleen maar lovende woorden over haar verblijf bij jou. Ze had zich welkom gevoeld en vindt het voor herhaling vatbaar. Bedankt dat je haar goed ontvangen hebt in mijn plaats, ik heb er de gelegenheid (nog) niet toe.
exactly as described. a very cozy house and place to stay. Thx for sharing you house with us!

The house is beautiful and clean with perfect shower and very easy to get there.. 5-10 min walk from Antwerpen berchem station ( u can get your train here to ghents, bruges & brussels, super duper easy) and 20 min walk to Antwerpen central station. An is very warm and she gave us 2 Easter eggs!!! The room is very tidy and comfortable during my 3 nights stay. There are maps in the room, city maps, museum maps, etc...will help you a lot  i would recommend her place to anyone.

Super séjour passé chez An, l'annonce correspond bien au logement. Tout était très propre et à proximité de la ville. Le bus 21 s'arrête presque devant la maison et la gare de Berchem est tout près à pieds. Donc localisation parfaite!

An a été parfaite, elle n'a pas du tout été oppressante et nous a même proposé son aide si nous avions des questions. Aucun problème pour notre première fois avec Airbnb donc! à refaire! :)

An is a great host. She was very kind and considerate in our stay at her lovely home. She even gave us helpful advice on finding the best Belgian waffles. The next time I'm in Antwerp I plan to stay again at her wonderful home.

An was an overall fantastic host!

First she did all she could to make sure somebody was there to let my girlfriend and me in when we arrived, as she had to work around that time. We got in fine and she left us a nice note.

The room was spotless and the bed was comfortable, many extra blankets were provided. There were also numerous power outlets around the room and she had left some flyers about the city out for us.
The bathroom was beautiful, large and again very clean, absolutely no complaints.

We met An the morning after our arrival, she was very pleasant and later that night she joined us for drinks at a local bar.
All in all I would highly recommend staying here!

Al 2 maal heb ik gebruik gemaakt van de kamer bij An in Berchem-Antwerpen.
Het onthaal was goed met een vlotte uitleg over het gebruik van de Airbnb-kamer.
Een eenvoudige, verzorgde kamer gelegen in een drukke straat maar 's nachts is het er heel rustig.
Een aanrader !

I had a very pleasant stay at  An's house. The room is pretty and comfortable, and An has been really kind with me! The district is quiet and easy to reach. I am really happy with my choice and absolutely recommend it.

An excellent weekend stay at An's place.

An was a perfect host -- met us, showed us around, gave recommendations on where to go and what to see on our very short stop over in Antwerp.
I would recommend An as a host and her place to anyone planning to spend a day or two in Antwerp.

An and the room were nice! The house is located very close to a train/tram station and a bike rental is also just around the corner which makes it really easy to get around. Antwerp is a wonderful city, thank you so much for giving us nice and hospitable accommodation!

It was really nice to stay at An's beautiful place. She is very friendly and openminded. Right next to the door you can get city bike for a 10 min  ride to the city center. Very nice place to stay !!!

El lugar de An es muy bonito y en un barrio muy tranquilo, hay que salir temprano si se quieren conseguir locales abiertos (pero sucede en muchas ciudades de Bélgica). Muy linda y agradable habitación.

We stayed six nights at Ans House and had a really great time. An was always very nice and helpful. The door was a bit tricky but after some practicing it wasn't a problem anymore. We really enjoyed the days at An's House and we can highly recommend the room for other visitors.

Comfortable room, very clean, the bed is good and there is enough space to put your stuff. The room is basic but very good to spend a few nights and enjoy the city. The first time we came back, we had some problems to open the door, but after some practising it was alright. I recommend this place to stay to spend some days in Antwerp!

An is a great host, very welcoming and helpful. The room was sunny and quiet and the flat very clean. An's home is also conveniently located just minutes away from the train station Antwerp Beschem and the tram station leading to the city centre.
An was really nice and gave us a warm welcome! Room is very tidy and clean. Its good to reach the center, by tram or by car! Antwerp is wonderful, we had a very good time there :)

We hebben twee nachten gelogeerd bij An en haar man.  Het huis staat in een prettige buurt, vlakbij het Berchem station. Het huis is gezellig en schoon. An heeft ons verwelkomt en voorzien van tips; ze is erg vriendelijk en open. Kortom, top!

An was een goede host! Mijn vriendin en ik hebben daar een nachtje verbleven en dat is prima bevallen. Al met al een fijn plekje om te verblijven tijdens een bezoekje aan Antwerpen met een vriendelijke host!

An was really nice (gave us cookies and extra blankets and so on) :) The room was lovely and clean, bathroom was big (there was shower and bath), neighbourhood was calm with lots of shops,fast foods and pubs near :) We had a great time in Antverp,thank you :))

An is a perfect host. The check-in time has been very flexible. The room is very nice, clean. She left some tourist informations like maps and brochures. Bathroom was very clean too.

Next time in Antwerpen i would like to stay here again.
Thanks very much

The room was wonderful! An is a great host, she's so friendly  and welcoming. The bathroom is very nice, big and comfortable. Everything is clean. The location of this house is quiet and nice. I think, it's very nice place to stay in  Antwerpen!
it's nice

This was an interesting stay. From the first night of arrival, An seemed agitated. Perhaps because we arrived 2.5 hrs later than we had planned due to the bus delay; we let her know of our late arrival on the way from Paris. The room is on the 3rd floor. I believe the internet router is on the 1st floor, therefore, very weak signal in the room...almost non existence, but we didn't say anything about it having seen her agitated behavior. We just went down to the first floor to use our laptop and ipod in the morning when she was not there. We stayed at An's place in the beginning of October. The night temperatures were in the 40's, and our faces and noses were freezing the first night. When we asked her how we can turn the heater on in the room, she said she doesn't turn the heater on because it is not winter yet. We explained how cold we were the night before, then she reluctantly turned the heater on for a few hours during the night. We made a reservation for 5 nights at An's place. Subsequently, we bought vegetables, fruit, and milk. An was very reluctant, again, for us to keep the food in her (Website hidden by Airbnb) if she didn't expect us to use the refrigerator. It was little awkward. On the first night at An's house, I developed some type of reaction...hives all over my body. The second night, my daughter developed the same symptom. We didn't know what caused the hives. We went to see a pharmacist and we were told that they were allergy reactions to something. The only change we had from Paris to Antwerp were the bed and towels from An. Not knowing exactly what caused our allergy reactions, we informed An so that she could take a necessary action after we left...clean thoroughly, sanitize, change detergent, or something. However, she became very defensive and angry without even looking at our hives. We told her we didn't know the cause of hives either and just wanted her to be aware of it.  But she got so upset with us and told us to leave if we were not happy. Really? We ended up checking out early. This was definitely the most (and only one) uncomfortable stay we've had out of 7 airbnb places. An sent me a message saying that no guests after us have had any allergy reactions or problems.

Prettige ervaring, ben warm verwelkomt in Antwerpen.
Zeker een aanrader!
Overall good experience. The flat is clean, well decorated and inviting. An met us when we arrived and even though we only stayed for one night the bed was comfy and we slept well.

L'appartement est agréable, la chambre et la salle de bain sont spacieuses.
L'hôte est très aimable.
Je recommande !

Ann zocht vantevoren goed contact met ons om te weten of we optijd aan zouden komen. Ze was dus ook optijd. Hierna kregen we de sleutel en een rondleiding door het huis. Dit zag er allemaal goed uit. Twee goede nachten geslapen en zondags de sleutel weer ingeleverd. Niets op aan te merken!
nice bathroom and clean room.....comfortable sleep for the night

Recomiendo mucho este lugar!!!!

An is very kind and it was great from her let us check in early. House is great, super clean and well decorated and very warm. Location is very good. An tips about where to go eat were very good. Communication was excellent. It was a pity we could not use the kitchen :(.

An etait accueillante, le lit très confortable et la chambre propre.

An is a dealt friendly, relaxed and witty lady: really enjoyed my stay at her place. Thanx An!

We voelden ons direct thuis bij An. Dat lag niet alleen aan de keurige slaapkamer en badkamer die we kregen. An is ook een prettig iemand met wie je in goed vertrouwen afspraken kunt maken. An, dank je wel voor de fijne tijd!

Nice charming room near a tram station. Everything was clean and nice. The check in and out were uncomplicated and An is a very friendly host.

Everything was fine,we didn't have any problems with the door
La casa estaba a unos 20 minutos caminando hasta el centro pero muy ameno. Era un barrio autentico belga y durante el camino disfrutas cruzar un fascinante barrio judío ortodoxo.

Ans place is turning into my favorite spot to spend the evening/ night before I start working (I incidentally work in Belgium). An is a great host, very friendly and relaxed. I keep coming back!

Het huis is erg makkelijk te bereiken vanaf Antwerpen Berchem en met de tram ben je in ongeveer 15 minuten bij het station. We werden erg vriendelijk ontvangen en de verhuurster was erg behulpzaam. De kamer was knus en gezellig.

The room is as described and clean, also the bathroom.

An was very friendly and open. The communication between us was very good. The room is nice, cozy and clean. Actually the whole house is. The bathroom was also nice and clean.

Was een leuk huisje, An was erg behulpzaam en geduldig (wij waren iets later dan aangegeven bij het huisje). Het huis heeft een uitstekende locatie en is maar 10 minuten met de tram verwijderd van de stad. De kamer en de badkamer zagen er goed verzorgd uit!

We voelden ons erg welkom bij An. De kamer was netjes en schoon, net als de badkamer. Verder gaf ze ons leuke tips over waar we naartoe konden in Antwerpen. Onze eerst Airbnb ervaring is ons erg goed bevallen!
Nous avons été très bien accueillis par notre hôte, malgré notre arrivée tardive. La chambre est très agréable et confortable. Nous avons été ravi de choisir cette adresse.

Wij hebben genoten van ons weekend in Antwerpen. Mede door het super leuke appartement van An. Het was een super mooi huis, en een hele mooie gezellige sfeervolle kamer.

Merveilleusement bien accueillie. J'y retournerai bien sure !
J'ai particulièrement apprécié la précision, la politesse, la gentillesse, la flexibilité, la propreté. Top 5 étoiles !
Fatima is heel gastvrij en ik werd op een prettige wijze welkom geheten met iets te drinken. Ze heeft een heel grote en gezellige woonkeuken.
Everything was fine. Very welcoming and Fatima gave us nice tips where to go in Antwerp.
Agréable et tranquille
Prima verblijf gehad!

I stayed at Fatimas place for two nights with six friends. The house is in a nice neighborhood, outside of the city center, with plenty of places to eat or have a few beers.

The house itself was clean, but a bit cluttered. It has all the amenities you need; a proper bathroom, kitchen etc.

We shared the house with fatima and one other Airbnb guest. This would occasionally make us feel uncomfortable; it felt like we were invading her personal space all the time. We did not totally feel comfortable hanging out in the kitchen and living room as she would usually be there too. As an example, one night we got back from a bar where we drank a beer and she was sleeping on the couch in the living room.

If you don't mind being with your Airbnb host a lot and not staying in the city center, this is a good place. As a tip: close by is a very long graffiti wall which is cool to check out.
Lovely place in a nice part of the town. Bars etc nearby. A lovely host, you feel like home!
Fatima is a communicative and enjoyable host. Our stay was a nice experience.
Fatima is a very warm and welcoming person! It was a nice experience staying at her place. Her home is decorated beautifully and she is a great cook if you ever have the chance of dining with her!
Muy agradable y cerca del centro puedes llegar al centro caminando.
Je krijgt bij Fatima een warm welkom en een fijne ontspannen sfeer, huiselijk, gezellig en je voelt er je snel op je gemak.

Hilal and Sarah (whom I met briefly) were wonderful. They were super friendly, accommodative to check-in and check-out times and very comfortable to talk to. The house is amazing and really close to the centre. The room was clean with comfortable bed, sheets and a lot of pillows. I would definitely stay next time I'm in Antwerpen.
Warm en hartelijk ontvangst. Prima adres om de stad te verkennen!

Fatima's huis ligt vlakbij het levendige Zurenborg, een fijne buurt in Antwerpen met leuke café's en lekkere restaurants. Er waren twee kamers voor ons beschikbaar en we konden gebruik maken van een ruime badkamer. Alles was tip top!
Fatima's place was lovely, her roommate was wonderful and very welcoming.
Great hostel, lots of rooms and lots of space to chill, eat or play a game. I recommend this!

Fatimas is a nice and very uncomplicated host. We were able to book another room last minute. You are basically living together with Fatima and her family which is quite a dynamic and busy setting.
Me and my friends usually walked to the city center, which takes around 35-40 minutes depending where you want to go. But there is also a nice square closer to the house which has bars and restaurants.
Had a nice stay at Fatima's house. Good beds and very clean. Antwerpen is also a good place to have fun at night!
Huge, clean house, have everything you need for a comfortable stay in Antwerp. Totally recommended!

Fatima is a very friendly and nice person.
She helpt me to find everything
what was necessary for me.
She cooking extraordinary and did ones Caipirinha for me
I will recommend this Place for sure.

Fatimas house is beautiful and you see her creativity in every corner. It was a pleasure meeting her, talking to her, being included in her circle of friends and staying in her lovely upstairs room with two very comfortable beds. Thank you for trying to smoke outside!
Fatima is (Website hidden by Airbnb) was my first time in the city and she made roaming around really easy by providing details and map of the city.

Fijne plek, hartelijke gastvrouw, veel tips en adviezen. Kamer is zeer eenvoudig en wat vol met twee stapelbedden, maar als je alleen daar bent om te slapen is dat prima. Gedeelde badkamer is mooi en het hele huis is warm ingericht.

La experiencia en la casa de Fátima ha sido genial, habla bastante bien Español e Inglés, y en su casa hay total libertad para usar las zonas comunes. Además ha sido interesante conocer otros viajeros de Air bnb que se alojaban en su casa. Una experiencia fantástica. :)

Het huis is heel gezellig ingericht met een Braziliaanse smaak en een zonnige gastvrouw. Jammer was dat we het laatste kamertje kregen met 2 stapelbedden waardoor we niet lekker konden zitten voordat we gingen slapen. Verder had ik bij de reservering niet door dat het ging om een huis waarin gerookt wordt. Dat vonden we niet zo fijn. Gelukkig was de kamer wel rookvrij. En we hebben genoten van Antwerpen!

Me and my friends, we still talk about this house. It's not comparable with others. It's unique enough as if it's the most memorable time in our vacance.

Fatima this lovely woman, will give you everything you need, and will welcome you as a family.

House is organized by full of amazing. I must say that this is the airbnb's reason for being.
Fatima is a great host and a lovely person. She made me feel at home and I really enjoyed it. Thanks again Fatima and untill the next time. Cheers.
Fatima's house is a very nice place, comfortable and clean. She's a very nice host and everything was better than expected. Totally recommended.

I had such an amazing time in Antwerp and mostly because of my stay at Fatima's apartment. The location was great, very easy to get around, 10 minute walk to all the best sites in the city. Her apartment was fantastic, a traditional home of Antwerp with a lot of character and a great place to hang out at after exploring the city. The best part was that Fatima was very helpful and showed me how to get to all the touristic sites yet also provided me with her local knowledge, showing me things that only locals know about which was amazing! I would definitely recommend staying with Fatima to anyway coming to Antwerp!
Ravi d'avoir séjourné chez Fatima, de très bon restaurant juste a coté
Very well located. Close to train station and close to several restaurants. Very nice person Fátima. I perfect place to stay in Antwerpen.

Fatima was the perfect host - friendly, with a glass of wine on arrival and a coffee in the morning :) Thankyou for letting me and my cat stay the night! We were both very happy and it was a lovely break from my long drive!

I really loved staying at Fatima’s house. This was my first time using airbnb and it exceeded my expectations. Fátima is a super nice and warm person. She helped me a lot giving all kinds of tips about the city like the best places I should visit, which are the best restaurants around the area that I should try, etc.
I would strongly recommend anyone who wants to stay in Antwerp to book a room with her. For sure you won’t regret the experience.
We had that week a very warm stay! A lovely host in a nice setting!

Samen met vier vriendinnen heb ik één nacht verbleven bij Fatima. Haar huis is heel gezellig ingericht en we mochten van alles gebruik maken. Fatima is een zeer gastvrije vrouw en ik raad haar zeker aan.

Fatima offers accommodation in her traditional detached 19. century house. There are 3 bedrooms available in the 2nd floor. Fatima is friendly and hospitable. She served us warm soup when we arrived late at night. I can recommend her place.
Jeg hadde det veldig fint hos Fatima, hun var veldig gjestfri og hyggelig

Ein mal und neee wieder !!Warnung

Fatima was a great hoste to us! Very cosy place and no problem with getting in and out of the city senter easy.
Thank you for letting us stay in your home Fatima! Best regards Norwegian judo national team

Fatima est une personne agréable, drôle, polis, etc.. et sait très bien recevoir les personnes ! L'appartement en lui même est très bien entretenue. Je conseil à tout le monde Fatima ! En espérant y revenir l'année prochaine !

Voor een lezing moest ik een nacht in Antwerpen zijn en vond ik een plek bij Fatima. Het is een heel schattig, stijlvol ingericht huis met super kamers. De sleuteloverdracht ging via een box bij de deur en was heel efficiënt. Daardoor was ik minder bezwaard dat we door een file vertraging hadden opgelopen. De gedeelde badkamer is enorm (!) groot met een heerlijke douche. De kamers waren tiptop, schoon en de bedden lagen heerlijk. Mijn hond mocht ook mee, dus ook voor wie een hondje heeft, is deze plek ideaal. Fatima was 's avonds nog op toen we thuis kwamen om een glas wijn te delen. Ze is erg warm en gastvrij.

In de buurt is ook genoeg (betaalbare) parkeerplek en je zit wandelend zo in het centrum. Een aanrader!
El servicio fue inmejorable!!
Tu super adresse sur Anvers, accueil très chaleureux
Leuke gezellige locatie, vlakbij Dageraad plein.

The house is a beautiful place, located near the centre and train station in a lovely neighbourhood. Fatima was very helpful in making us feel at home. However, we didn’t like that we were told only shortly before arrival that the kitchen wasn’t available for us to use from 11am till 7pm, while the kitchen was a reason for us to book the place. Also, the cleaning lady started cleaning the rooms before check out time, while we were still using the rooms. So if you want to have a venue entirely for yourself this might not be the right place to go.
Our group of colleagues stayed for 2 weeks at Fatima's, and the stay went alright.

With a group of 9 people we had a nice stay at Fatima's house. An explanation of how everything was working was provided, the house was clean and colorful and the beds were comfortable! Towels for everyone were also provided and Fatima gave tips about nice places to go in the neighborhood. The hospitality of Fatima made it a good stay! Could recommend this house to other big groups.
house at all covenience

In het huis van Fatima hebben wij met een groep van 9 man een heerlijke overnachting gehad. Het huis voelt gelijk als een thuis: grote banken, een heerlijke moderne keuken inclusief lange tafel en een eclectische inrichting.

Het huis was brandschoon en is goed bereikbaar. Het centrum is een dik halfuur lopen. Het is makkelijker om 200m van het huis (aan de grote straat richting centrum) voor een paar euro een leenfiets te pakken. Zeker aan te raden!
Un lugar muy bonito y acogedor, 100% recomendable
The stay was fine for a group of people looking for a place to sleep in order to spend a weekend in Antwerp; bikes are closeby and the train station is walking distance

We were a group of 5 and really enjoyed our stay at Fatima's house. She is a really attentive and warm host! We were able to make flexible arrangements in terms of the check-in time. Also she recommended great places to visit, eat and drink. One of them happened to be right across the street. All in all a great place to stay in Antwerpen.

Fatima is a warm and welcoming host. We were a group of 8 students and were greeted with tea, wine and snacks. During our 4 night stay was the Belgian tradition of Saint Nicholas Day. On this day Fatima surprised us by cooking us pancakes and creating a beautiful display of biscuits, oranges and chocolates to help us celebrate! The train station is about a 20 minute walk away. This was an ideal base for exploring the city of Antwerp and also other parts of Belgium. Thank you for being so hospitable and giving us an enjoyable stay Fatima!
Fijn bezoek gehad, Fatima was erg gastvrij en werden verwelkomt met een fles champagne en wat nootjes,  leuke binnenkomst! Ze hielp ons opweg met wat tips en het huis was erg gezellig.
great host in a great location!

Photos un peu à l'avantage du logement, peut être trompeur.
Chambre un peu petite et mal disposée
Mais un Acceuil fabuleux et une liberté totale malgré la présence de Fatima.
Voor een gezellig weekend met 10 vriendinnen is dit het perfecte huis. Je voelt er je meteen thuis!

Super gast vrij
Prijs kwaliteit is goed

Fatima was a great host. We rented her place with our friend group of 8 people and still had plenty of space. Fatima’ s place is really nice. Downstairs the place has a living room, a garden and a big kitchen which could even easily fit 8 people. Also the bedrooms in the two upper floors offered enough space for all us and everything was clean and prepared for our stay. Also having only one shower didn’t bother us. When we arrived Fatima gave us nice tips for the area which we could explore during the weekend. She was very friendly and helpful in general. Additionally her place is in walking distance from the centre and nice neighbourhoods and was easy to find from the train station and by car. We had a great stay in Fatima’s place- thanks for the hospitality!

Fatima's place has a lot of character and charm, the room was comfortable and quiet and a fan was provided. The house is huge and I barely noticed anyone in it. Fatima was lovely and accommodating and her longterm guest Paul was super helpful and generous. I'd definitely stay again, however the room is at the top of 4 flights of stairs so travel light!
Lovely Brazilian hospitality. Ótimo! Highly recommended.

Ik ben voor 2 maanden bij Fatima gebleven.
In goed overleg kon ik alles in haar huis gebruiken, wat allemaal super schoon en mooi was.
Bij problemen of onduidelijkheden met iets kon ik hierover snel en makkelijk contact opnemen met Fatima en kon dit geregeld worden.

De ruimte is heel huiselijk en sfeervol. Je kan op verschillende plekken zitten met verschillende sferen.
De banken zitten allemaal geweldig, in de keuken kan je ook lekker zitten aan een lange tafel.
Verder ligt het bed ook goed en is de badkamer ruim en schoon.

Ik heb hier 2 maanden met plezier gezeten en kan Fatima en de kamer vol aanraden voor iedereen die in Antwerpen moet zijn, voor lange en korte verblijven.
Lovely place to stay close to the center of Antwerp!

Het is een groot huis met genoeg ruimte voor onze boeking van 10 personen. De locatie is goed beschreven en Fatima is bereid mee te denken over bezienswaardigheden. Bij aankomst had ze twee flessen cava koel gelegd, wat zeker gewaardeerd werd. Het is een karakteristieke woning met oude elementen.
Wat tegenviel was de netheid van de woning. De woning stond bomvol met spullen en was niet echt schoon. Op basis van de foto's hadden we anders verwacht.

We stayed for only one night but had an amazing time.
Fatima was unbelievable considerate and forthcoming, helping us with a very early check in as we had taken a night bus.
She has a beautiful home and made us feel welcome.
Fatima is an amazing host. Location perfect. Rooms clean and cozy. Toilets spacious and clean. Can use the kitchen and make meals and coffee. A lot of soul.
The host was very pleasant and kind which greatly affected the experience. However the common areas were much more chaotic and messy than is shown in the pictures. Overall, average stay.
Fatima is a very welcoming host and we found her home to be a great option for our family's vacation in Belgium

We really enjoyed staying at Fatimas place and had a great time. She is a very welcoming host.
The basement is very spacious and invites for a coffee and some leasure time while chatting with Fatima (and Friends)
The room was clean and cozy. Gladly would stay there again.
Surroundings:

La casa de Fátima es muy acogedora, está cerca de todos los supermercados y del centro.

Fátima es una persona maravillosa y hace que te sientas como en casa.

Recomiendo 100%
Muy amable y muy recomendable para cualquiera que quiera visitar Amberes y Bélgica en general

Fatima's place is very nice, clean, extraordinary. Fatima is such a warmhearted host, very helpful and open for any kind of agreement. Place is close to many destinations in the town and close to train station, what gives a freedom to explore more in Antwerpen, and even further in Belgium.  Rooms are very clean and comfortable, kitchen is big and practical. Fully equipped for all passengers need. And, ideal for those who are open to meet with people and feel friendly in homelike environment.
our toddler loved it, we loved it, all good.

Stay with Fatima is like being in a family, she helps you if you need anything (for example she let me printed out some documents, but she also cooked for me!), she is nice, kind but she is also very respectful of the personal space.. I stayed for one week and I have really liked it :)
Totally recommended!

Fatima was voor mij fantastisch. Ik had voor een dag later geboekt, geheel mijn eigen schuld, maar Fatima heeft mij enorm geholpen door een kamer vrij te maken/houden zodat ik mijn reis niet hoefde af te breken. Fatima is dus heel gastvrij en vriendelijk....en erg flexibel. ;-)
