The location is ideal and super central. Such a great experience that I've recommended this space to other friends.

To re-iterate the host's note: the stairs are narrow and steep, so if you have mobility issues or are carrying a large heavy suitcase, this probably isn't the best place for you.

For me , this was one of my favourite Airbnb stays ever.

Prachtig authentieke studio midden in het centrum van Antwerpen met een prachtig uitzicht: a room with a vieuw.
Geen enorme luxe maar des meer nostalgie en een fijne sfeer.
Prima plek op een centrale lokatie!

The BnB was in a perfect location with incredible views. The space itself was cute and spacious and we loved the convenience. Yara was communicative, quick to respond, and super accommodating!  Would absolutely recommend a stay here when in Antwerp, as long as you don’t mind stairs!

Toplocatie voor een weekendje Antwerpen. Midden in het centrum en alles bij de hand wat je nodig hebt. Ik zou er weer verblijven, maar dan wel oordoppen en een slaapmasker meenemen. Tijdens corona is het stil op straat maar ik kan me voorstellen dat het anders wat gehorig kan zijn.

Yuri et Annya ont été très accueillants, nous faisant sentir vraiment bien chez eux. La chambre est grande, toute neuve et avec tout confort. Le quartier est calme, hors partie touristique , mais on peut quand même aller a pied à la gare et vielle ville.  Quand nous retournerons à Anvers, nous reviendrons chez eux sans hésitation .

I was so lucky staying 9 nights at Yuir's place. He and his small family were amazing and more than welcoming. I didn't feel for a second I'm a stranger. They have a wonderful kid too whom I love so much.
They even shared breakfast and dinner with me.
The room was downstairs, very spacious, very clean and comfortable, with a private toilet. (exactly as described on the website.)
the location is also great, within walking distances from main landmarks and there are so nice restaurants and bars nearby.
To sum it up, I had a great experience in this gorgeous place.

Yuri, onze gastheer haalde ons op van het station wat heel prettig was. Wij voelden ons daardoor meteen welkom in de bijzondere buurt waar hij en zijn gezin wonen. Het is er rustig en toch vlakbij niet toeristische pleinen en buurten met goede restaurantjes en leuke café's.  Mede dank zij de lokale tips van Yuri hebben wij een paar topdagen in Antwerpen beleefd!

My staying in Yuri and Anna's place was just perfect.  They are both adorable and made my week in Belgium unforgettable. The room is extremely clean and comfortable, with all you need to "feel like home". There's definitely no better place to stay if you're coming in Antwerp !

Une chambre calme et immense avec vue sur le jardin, un WC privé et un petit évier. La décor est sympa et le tout est confortable :-)
Très bonne surprise le dimanche matin nos hôtes nous ont invité pour un petit déjeuner copieux et délicieux (oeufs, viennoiseries, fruits secs et bon beurre bio...). Merci! On reviendra!

Although we were really just passing through Antwerp, Yuri and his lovely family and fabulous home made us wish we were staying longer. Yuri was even kind enough to collect us from the station (which is astounding btw), even though it is easily within walking distance, very generous. There is everything you could conceivably want in the room, even a grand piano! Makes me wish I took lessons when I was younger. It was really more of a self contained open plan flat than a loungeroom. We were very well looked after.

Heerlijk verblijf gehad in ruim en comfortabele souterrain met tuin. De volgende ochtend werden we verwend met een liefdevol ontbijt bij Yuri thuis. Buurtje biedt vele mogelijkheden om lekker te genieten van een hapje en drankje. Extra leuk is het dat je de Antwerpenaar zelf daar ontmoet op het terras of in de kroeg.

yuris place has been absolutely perfect for our weekend trip to antwerp. it's really clean and nice, the area is central and it feels like having your own space, cause the room has a walk-in bathroom.
we can highly recommend this place and will come back for our next trip.

De eerste keer Airbnb voor mij en mijn vriend. We hadden een warm welkom met uitleg over de buurt en wat we allemaal konden zien, erg fijn! Zijn op een pleintje vlak in de buurt wat gaan drinken, waar eigenlijk geen toeristen zijn, goed geadviseerd door Yuri! We mochten de fietsen lenen wat super handig is in Antwerpen. Alles was zeer naar wens, een erg aan te raden adres. De kamer is ruim en je hebt alles wat je nodig hebt. Een tip: neem in de zomer anti-muggen spul mee!

Het is een mooi appartement met een aparte slaapkamer die erg mooi en luxueus is ingericht. Yuri en zijn vrouw zijn erg hartelijk en behulpzaam. Zij nemen de tijd je weg te wijzen in Antwerpen en proberen je het zo comfortabel mogelijk te maken. De locatie van het appartement is net buiten het centrum waardoor je in een rustige wijk met leuke locale tentjes zit. Je kunt makkelijk lopend of
met de tram naar het centrum in enkele minuten!

Yuri and his family kindly let me stay in their place despite the fact they were on vacation. The place is just perfect, and I enjoyed my stay to the fullest. Location is great, the hosts are wonderful people, and you'll have plenty of space in the lounge room. I would come back any time. This place felt like home the moment I walked in.

Highly recommend this place to stay. I’m glad I was there. Actually, it not simply spacious room, but rather separate apartment, only with the shared shower and kitchen on a next floor.
This room has a separate entrance from the street(!), a toilet, a sink, a kettle, a backyard, a large TV with a sound system, big bed. Clean and accurately, always quiet, Wi-Fi is working. Feel privately, as at home.
The room can easily accommodate two person, and even more if you don't mind sleeping on the couch or on the floor)
Yuri and Ania really happy family with smart little boy Mateo and white-ginger cat. Always glad to help: treat food, wash clothes, print your ticket.
The apartment is well located, near the central station, from where you can easily get to other neighboring cities by train or bus. Like I did.
Advantages of Antwerp: historic center, beautiful train station, good transport links, comfortable city bike rental system, existence of restaurants, bars and clubs. A week did not have time to get bored, also visiting Ghent, Bruges, Brussels and The Hague(by bus).
Thanks to Yuri and Ania for their hospitality!

Erg fijn verblijf gehad in deze ruime en mooie kamer gelegen in een rustige wijk van Antwerpen. Dichtbij het station en ook te voet ben je zo in het centrum.
Erg hartelijk ontvangen door Yuri, die ons ook voorzien heeft van leuke en bruikbare tips en een luxe ontbijt. Aanrader!

Yuri en zijn gezin bieden met hun kamer/appartement een fijne en rustige uitvalsbasis om Antwerpen te ontdekken. We werden heel vriendelijk ontvangen en kregen goede tips (op vrijdag eenvoudig gegeten in het Eco-Café, zaterdagmiddag lekkere hapjes gesnaaid op het Theaterplein en ook op het gezellige plein in de buurt (Dageraadplaats) was het heerlijk vertoeven. Bij Yuri thuis heb je echt je eigen domeintje, waar je je heerlijk even kunt terugtrekken uit de drukte van de stad als je daar behoefte aan hebt. Kortom: we hadden een heerlijk weekend!
Yuri and Anna were amazing hosts! Jim and I felt very welcome. I was especially charmed that Anna made us breakfast every day.  We felt like we were houseguests and that was a very nice experience.

Yuri and Anna have been perfect hosts, we felt really at home!
The room is a large Indipendent living room at the ground floor with direct access to the private garden, the bed is a sofa-bed but very confortable. Yuri and Anna have served us breakfast every morning and given us a lot of useful advices.
The house is 15 minutes walking from both principal train station and 20 minutes walking from the city center, we never need public transports.
Really an experience to repeat!!!

Een schitterend huis op een perfecte locatie. Omdat Isabelle er niet was, ontvingen haar ouders ons. Een warm welkom met een aantal goede tips over t Stad. Ook nog een avond gebruik kunnen maken van de goed uitgeruste keuken. Een plek om terug te komen!
Prima huis..... een goede keus voor een citytrip naar Antwerpen. De ligging is goed en centraal.
The reservation was canceled 11 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

I was in my old hometown of Antwerp on a weekend trip with friends from Paris and booked Isabelle's house because of its location close to the city center and because it seemed to have lot fo character. Communication with Isabelle was smooth: questions were answered swiftly and she went out of her way to receive us at the house ahead of the standard check-in time. We found the house as described in the ad and spent a very good weekend there.

We had a lovely stay in this apartment - our 68th Airbnb in Europe. Isabelle was there to great us. And her father was very helpful as well and even took Michael out of town to the FedEx complex to retrieve some important papers.
Staying in this apartment is a unique experience. The location is excellent - in the heart of the fashion district so lots of shopping. But you are literally the only residence opening onto a busy pedestrian shopping street, so be prepared for people looking in your windows and wondering what you sell! It is an easy walk to the center of town and the Cathedral and all other points of interest - the metro is also very close for day trips and the Zoo (very enjoyable). There is a good Poxy supermarket just across the way so you can cook meals in the well equipped kitchen if you like. If you are not a "stairs" person this house, as wonderful as it is, might not be for you. There are 66 winding stairs from the main floor to the top floor bedrooms - the bathroom is on the first level, but still upstairs. The fun part is this is the narrowest house in Antwerp (just 8' feet across) so, of course everything but the kitchen and dining room is UP. We managed to have a good time even with small grandchildren - so if you are fit and want to really live in the heart of the city - this is the place for you. We highly recommend it.
Beautiful place, my family was so pleased and loved their stay.
Isabelle met us at the house.  She made us feel very welcome.  The neighborhood was wonderful, right in the middle of everything, convenient to everything.
Ons artistiek team heeft een fijn verblijf gehad in het huis van Isabelle en staat bij ons bedrijf als één van de mogelijke verblijven om opnieuw te boeken in de toekomst. Dus een echte aanrader!

Prima contact met de verhuurder, vader Michel verwelkomde ons hartelijk. Heel charmant huis op een geweldige plek in Antwerpen, centraler kan nauwelijks. Parkeergarages in overvloed om de hoek en laat de auto daar maar (euro 16,90 per 24 uur), want vanaf huis door de stad en langs de Schelde slenteren is prachtig.

Vertskapet gav oss den informasjonen vi trengte før oppholdet. I tillegg var de behjelpelig med informasjon underveis.

Louise Marie den romantiske leiligheten var helt fantastisk, og var akkurat like skjønn som den var beskrevet. Stedet ligger sentralt, og det er både butikker og spisesteder rett utenfor døren. Veldig koselig nabolag med spisesteder rett utenfor døren. Skal jeg reise til Antwerpen igjen, er dette definitivt stedet jeg vil bo.

Een heerlijk weekend gehad in kerstsfeer in Antwerpen. De ontvangst was hartelijk en we werden rondgeleid in de woning door Isabelle. Omhooggeleid is misschien beter uitgedrukt want het huis is inderdaad heel smal. Per verdieping zijn twee kamers en de trap kronkelt naar boven. Maar wat een sfeervol huis! Er was zelfs aan een kerstboom gedacht! De bedden waren prima, de douche zou wel wat verbeterd kunnen worden. Het ligt vrijwel in het centrum van Antwerpen, dus alles kunnen belopen. Een aanrader voor iedereen die niet tegen traplopen opziet (maar die kan altijd op de 2de etage zijn bed reserveren)
Een heel charmant oud huisje in de binnenstad van Antwerpen. We hebben het er opnieuw erg naar ons zin gehad!

Before arrival Isabelle let me know that she would wait for us at the appartment. At the end she could not make it, but her parents were there to welcome us. They were very friendly and kind and showed us the beautiful house. They told us about the city and the nice things we could do.
The host canceled this reservation 29 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

We all had a great stay in a charming house in a fabulous location! Michel met us on arrival and was very welcoming, helpful and had some great recommendations for us.
We will certainly be going back and wouldn't hesitate to recommend.

We had a great stay in antwerpen! Louise Marie is such a lovely town house! The location is really close to the old town of antwerpen! Michel was very helpful and welcoming. I can recomand a stay in this cozy town house!

Zeer sympathiek huisje in hartje van Antwerpen. Sfeervol en mooi ingericht. Prima bedden, fijne keuken en badkamer. Op loopafstand van de kathedraal. We werden warm welkom geheten door Michel bij aankomst. Heel de familie, zeker ook de kinderen, hebben genoten. We komen zeker terug!

A very warm and informative welcome from Michel and Isabelle.
The house is beautifully decorated and adorned, and very well equipped.
Superb, very central location; a winning feature.
Be aware there is only 1 toilet, no fixed shower and the accommodation is arranged on 4 floors accessed by steep, narrow stairs.

This home is in the center of everything which gets you the full Antwerp experience, including fantastic shopping, great little cafes but also noise at night when sleeping.
Key pickup was simple and almost everything was available at the house. There were however no closets or dressers, lots of stairs (like lots and lots, be ready for some cardio) and no shower.

Michel welcomed us upon the arrival in the house and was very helpful with his personalized recommendations as to what to see in Antwerp.

The house itself is really beautiful and located just off a nice pedestrian street, very close to bars and most of the fashion stores. Stairs in the house are quite steep (it's a historic building) and since altogether there are 4 levels this place may not be ideal for older or those with disabilities. It's not a disadvantage, just a feature.

One thing from the house that stood out the most is the kitchen area on the ground floor which together with the dining table opens up towards the pedestrian street. It's an amazing spot to enjoy home cooked breakfasts and dinners watching all the pedestrians strolling by.

We loved our stay at Michel's place and can definitely recommend his beautiful house!
Maison charmante, personnalisé et chaleureuse ( loin de l'univers Ikéa dominant), hôte disponible et attentionné. Je recommande très vivement.

Genoten van Antwerpen vanuit deze toplocatie. Centraler kan je eigenlijk niet liggen. Huis is zeer compleet en heeft een erg leuke uitstraling. De gastheer is zeer behulpzaam en kan je voorzien van tips betreffende restaurants, cultuur en de betere Belgische cafés. Voor ons zeker een aanrader en een accommodatie waar we zeker nog eens zullen terugkeren.
Very nice and central accommodation I would recommend for a large group

It was a very nice place. Very tidy and clean.
Very short walk to the center and the premetro system.
The beds are very good and it's fairly quiet at night.
The rooms are upstairs and the stairs are quite steep, but that's okay.
The house is very cute and would do nice for a romantic getaway.

This charming apt. has lovely period detail in the flooring, wallpaper and furnishings while the beds and bedding are updated nicely. Loation is the end of a trendy shopping street however quiet. What is not clear from the listing is that the apt. Is a very skinny stack of 4 stories of rooms as follows: the main floor with the flavour of a storefront is kitchen and eating area, up 1 flight of stairs is sitting room and bathroom. Up a 2nd flight is bedroom 1 and 2,up a 3 rd flight is bedroom 3 and 4. You have to know that the 3 staircases are somehat spiral with very shallow stairs requiring slow and cautious climbing, especially coming down. They were difficult to navigate for the able-bodied but tough family for kids, arthritis sufferers or older people.
The rooms were quiet and we heard no noise from neighbors.
Location, access to everything including the train station were perfect.
We had a very nice time at the Louise Marie house. We were welcomed by Michel himself, the house had a wonderful atmosphere and the neighbourhood was really nice.
Bijzondere woonruimte met het centrum van Antwerpen om de hoek.

We voelden ons ontzettend welkom! Michel was behulpzaam en vriendelijk. De locatie is perfect, binnen enkele meters in de winkelstraat en op loopafstand van bezienswaardigheden en parkeerzieningen. We hebben genoten!

Het huis Louise Marie ligt op een toplocatie: in een (rustige) winkelstraat in de modewijk, dichtbij het historisch centrum, de Schelde en musea die de moeite waard zijn. Het huis is sfeervol en stijlvol ingericht, de huiskamer op de eerste verdieping vonden wij een heerlijke plek om bij te komen. We hebben ons prima gered in de keuken en we waren blij met de goedwerkend oven. Ook werden we blij verrast door het bad in de badkamer. We hebben de auto geparkeerd op de Sint-Michielskaai, 10 minuten lopen van het huis, daar kun je gratis parkeren en daar is ruimte genoeg. We komen graag terug.

Top huisje op een fantastische locatie. Echt een aanrader.
let op, steile trappen
Goede ligging, knus en gezellig.
Een pracht appartement op een mooie lokatie. Het aanbevelen waard met Michel als goede gastheer
Cosy house in the center of Antwerp. A nice spot in the center of Antwerp.
Zeer centrale locatie in een schattig oud huisje. We hebben genoten en het was erg fijn dat alles op loopafstand was. Aanrader voor een weekendje Antwerpen!
Excellent location, very central in Antwerp.

Schattig huisje, zeer centraal gelegen, fijne keuken en eetkamer waar we gezellig hebben ontbeten en geborreld.
Zodra je de deur uitliep stond je midden in het bruisende antwerpen.
Het huisje was schoon en heel leuk ingericht. Geweldige details.
Communicatie verliep ook heel prettig.
Voor herhaling vatbaar

Charming little house extremely well located.
We stayed comfortably with 6 (4 adults, 2 children).
You just need to be fit when you have to climb to the 4th floor! But all in all, a very recommendable place!

We had an amazing stay in the lovely Marie Louise house! It was the perfect place to stay while travelling with my mother and sisters, we loved the XIX mood, and each of us had our own room. The location is surprisingly great. I did not met Michel, but he was really kind allowing us to let our luggages in th the house some extra hours. Michel's daughter Isabelle welcomed us in the house and everything was perfect. Thank you Michel!

Yes, the staircase is narrow and steep. Yes, some of the walls need to be refreshed. Yes, there is only one bathroom. But! The price is really good. Michel is really responsive and accommodating (thanks again for that bottle Michel!). The house is perfectly located. The house is very charming with an "old" feel but with all the modern commodities. So I have no problem recommending it. Just keep in mind that, because of the staircase and the absence of a bedroom on the ground floor, this is not for persons with limited mobility.

Michel's place is in a great location and an easy walking distance to the main area of Antwerp.  It was clean and tidy, well furnished, and has a lot of character.   It may not be best for those who are unable or find it difficult to walk up a couple of  flights of stairs since it is spread across three floors.  Michel's communication was great and it helped make sure we had everything we needed for our trip and during our stay.  Thanks Michel!

Michel's place is fun and fantastically located. The period furnishings make the experience special, but the period stairs (three flights of narrow, winding, steep stairs) are not for those who are balanced challenged. The food across the street (Juliette's) is wonderful and the clothes shopping in nearby streets will tire even the most ardent fashionista. Overall a great base for seeing Antwerp.
Michel accueille très bien ses hôtes et fait preuve d'un très grande amabilité. Le logement est conforme à la description et très bien situé en plein centre.  Je recommande vivement.
We hebben genoten van het leuke en romantische Huisje. Origineel en charmant tot in de puntjes. Rustig maar wel midden in de gezelligste buurt van Antwerpen. We komen zeker terug.
Super locatie. Heel sfeervolle plek dichtbij alle bezienswaardigheden.

Gezelig verblijf om met een familie of vriendengroep van zes te verblijven. Ik heb nog een nederlands souvenirtje (Website hidden by Airbnb) kaasschaaf.
Verder is alles aanwezig in de keuken en kan je prima vertoeven in dit optrekje in het centrum van Antwerpen.

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour dans cette petite maison de poupées atypique. Elle est idéalement située dans le centre !

La maison était très propre. Nous avons simplement été légèrement déçus par les matelas qui ne sont pas des plus confortables. L’acces aux 3 différents étages n’est pas toujours aisé, attention aux personnes âgées ou aux enfants ... mais c’est aussi ce qui fait tout le charme de cette maison.

Michel a toujours été de bon conseil et très réactif !
Großartig. War wirklich sehr schön in dem Haus. Alles perfekt. Danke.

This is truly a secret gem in Antwerpen. It's so perfectly located. Dead center but still quiet because of the closing shops every night. And the house is a unique experience through it's ambiance and really sophisticated interior. Like living in the 18-th century for  few days. When in Antwerpen, go at Michels place, you will not regret this.
Michel is an example host. Our stay was magical there!

This house is a time capsule! It is an amazing feet of design as it is so narrow but is still able to sleep 6 people. The stairs are steep but my 83 year old mother-in-law managed to negotiate them: you just need to take your time! It was very pleasant to spend time in the kitchen and the living room as they are both so cosy and the fires were welcome from the cold weather. Michel responded to my queries very quickly and speaks perfect English, as do most of the Belgian population (I wish I knew some Flemish!) The house is situated right in the middle of the city and so is ideal to visit all the sites. Thanks Michel!
房子非常棒！地理位置绝对是中心，购物等非常方便！房东人也非常好
Geweldige locatie en super cute huisje.

This beautiful house is in a perfect location to explore and enjoy all the delights of Antwerp. The beds are very comfortable and the decoration is beautiful in the flesh.
One thing to note is that the stairs are, although typical for Antwerp, quite narrow.
Excellent location, stylish house, Great host!
I second all previous comments,  great plac
Great place, will come back.
We (six people) had a wonderful time at Michels house- it had an amazing atmosphere, everything is walkable from there and Michel was wonderful host. Thank you again!

Het is een stijlvol en gezellig ingericht appartement in een erg leuke buurt. Bij warm weer wordt het wel benauwd in het appartement dus de ramen moeten open en dat is dan weer vervelend omdat er naast het appartement een woning is met jongeren die tot laat luidruchtig zijn.
Great place in perfect location.
Very nice accommodation! Worth the money
Ein Erlebnis in diesen historischen, schmalen Haus mit vielen Treppen zu wohnen. Die Lage ist zentral. Michel sehr nett und unkompliziert.

Really special apartment in quiet street. Loved our 4 nights stay here. It was quiet, unique and memorable. It was one of the highlights of our stay in Antwerp. Appreciated meeting the host and getting introduced to the apartment on checkin. We had one quick question after checkin and Michel was readily available and responsive.

Be ready for narrow spiral stairs! We travelled light and our 3 and 5 year old managed the stairs fine.
Heel tof huisje op een hele goeie locatie.
Je recommande. Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour hors du temps dans un cadre de charme et surtout en plein centre ville.
房子真的非常棒。房东真的很棒。给出了很多游玩意见。地理位置也很好。离中心商业街都很近。房间很美。仿佛穿越回中世纪。装修考究
Really nice, beautiful, central place to stay in Antwerp. You feel like living in a museum;) Uncomplicated, fast and flexible communication with Michel! As a group of six persons we recommend it.
A very nice place with very good location
Très bon séjour et très bon accueil !!
Cosy house at a perfect location in the city center.
Very charming space in a super great location.  Excellent support from Michel.  The stairs have already been mentioned in other reviews and if you can handle them I couldn't imagine a nicer place.

De omschrijving van een 'romantisch huisje' is volkomen gerechtvaardigd. Het is een waanzinnig schattig huisje midden in het centrum van Antwerpen. De gastheer is zeer vriendelijk en het huisje voldeed aan alle verwachtingen. Een absolute aanrader.
We very much enjoyed the stay in the house. It is ideally situated in Antwerp for excursions around the city.

La maison est vraiment authentique et très bien située. Michel est sympa et disponible.
Je recommande vivement !
A funky place in a great location.
Wenn du eine große charmante Unterkunft in einem super viertel suchst, bist du bei Michel richtig. Viele Treppen dürfen dir nichts ausmachen.
Great location. Fun space and charming old home.
Tres bon week-end. Logement central et parfaitement conforme à sa description

Een kleine gezellige stadswoning in de vorm van een pijpenla die als mooie uitvalsbasis dient voor het ontdekken van de binnenstad van Antwerpen. Alles is op geringe loopafstand. Goede wifi verbinding en gelukkig geen televisie
super plek

Great place with a perfect location. It was quiet at night and quite comfortable. The living room is also wonderful. Not a bad place to hang out and have a drink in the evening.

Michel gave us a nice introduction and was easily reachable.

It is true that the stairs are not for people with any sort of mobility problems. They are narrow and there are lots of them. The building is narrow and deep - charmingly so, in my opinion.

The antique furniture gave the place a unique feel. Certainly one of the most unique appartments I have stayed in.

Some basics in the kitchen weren't available. The only knife for cutting was dull and I do not think there were any simple bowls. Hence, maybe not the best place to stay if you plan on cooking your meals.

Een karakteristieke oorsponkelijke smalle woning met stevige trappen. Heerijk gelegen in het centrum van Antwerpen. In avond en nacht verrassend rustig.
Zeker een aanrader voor mensen met een gevoel voor sfeer en nostalgie.
Really enjoyed our stay at Michel's lovely house right in the center of Antwerp.  Michel was a great host who gave us great recommendations for things to do in Antwerp.

Beautiful, traditional house in fabulous location in Antwerp. Really enjoyed our stay and would recommend, although be aware that there are a lot of steep stairs. Welcoming hosts. We had a brilliant time! Thanks again!
Prima uitvalsbasis om Antwerpen te verkennen.
Tres bien.

Would love to come back another time. It was such a lovely house with great atmosphere and perfect location; safe, quiet and with restaurants and nice shops just around the corner. Lots of stairs in the house, so visitors should be able to walk stairs :-)

Super schattig en stijlvol huisje midden in een gezellige buurt.  Wij hebben met 6 vrienden in het huis geslapen en waren alle 6 zeer enthousiast over de sfeer en de aankleding van het huisje. We hadden een beetje het idee in een klassiek poppenhuisje te zijn beland. De ligging is ook perfect. 5 minuten lopen maar de Grote Markt, de Schelde en midden tussen de leuke winkeltjes. De perfecte plek voor een weekendje Antwerpen.
We had some wonderful days in this beautiful historic house! Super location in a very nice area in Antwerp with a lot of cafes, restaurants and bars all in walking distance.
房间位置非常棒，城中心，厨房设备一应俱全，房东人很好

Super elegant, historic townhouse in the centre of Antwerp. And Michel is such an amiable host! Do note that there are a lot of steep stairs in the house – as with any traditional building in Antwerp.

A well-located historic house in the heart of Antwerp.  This was the perfect landing spot for our family of five to explore the city, and it's a quick tram ride (or ˜20 min walk) to the train station.  Check-in was super easy, and Michel was accommodating to our request for  late check-out as there were no guests after us.  While we enjoyed our stay, it's worth noting that this is a mid-19th century home that is maintained to feel like one.  Some (like us and our children) will find this charming, but it may not suit tastes of those looking for more modern accommodations.  Also definitely not suitable for those who have issues with stairs, as there are four levels with somewhat precarious stairs.

Tweede keer dat we geweest zijn met vriendinnen en het is een super fijne, charmante en romantische woning, midden in het centrum. Michel is goed bereikbaar en in- en uitchecken  is heel makkelijk middels een sleutelkastje. Een aanrader!

Excellent séjour chez Michel. La maison est très bien située dans la vieille ville d’Anvers. Son originalité - étroite sur plusieurs étages - lui donne beaucoup de charme. D’une grande propreté. Pas de bruits de rue. Nous avons rarement aussi bien dormi! Je recommande avec enthousiasme.
Michel’s location is excellent, the home is beautiful and the decor is fantastic. We loved our stay and would highly recommend this location, especially for adults or families with older children.

Brilliant location, comfy beds, super stylish and ultra characterful. Plenty of room.
Lots of steep stairs with narrow treads. Be aware!
Leuke, charmante woning. Uitstekende locatie. Wel veel trappen en jammer genoeg niet heel erg proper. Wel goede, snelle en vlotte communicatie met verhuurder.
Super host, with fast reply on any question

Heerlijk weekend met 6 vriendinnen gehad. Perfecte locatie en alles in huis om een gezellige avond binnenshuis te houden. Het huis zelf was alsof je in een cupcake was beland. Zeer romantisch met authentieke elementen. Gelukkig geen televisie, maar wel een fijne stereo om muziek mee af te spelen.
Super leuke plek in centrum Antwerpen. Heel sfeervol. Goed verzorgd en fijne bedden!

Michel has an charming historic house in the very center of Antwerp. It's four very narrow storeys with antique furniture and an original romantic atmosphere. The staircase is very steep and narrow, so not for people with challenges walking, but for everyone else it's highly recommended.

Wij, 6 vriendinnen, hebben in het weekend van 15-17 nov in het prachtige en knusse huis van Michel doorgebracht. Het huis staat op een toplocatie in het Modekwartier. Je loopt overal zo naar toe. 's Ochtends naar de bakker voor heerlijk vers brood  bijvoorbeeld. Het huis van 4 verdiepingen is knus, het omarmt je. In de woonkeuken op de begane grond is het gezellig rond de tafel bij de gaskachel zitten. Er is genoeg (brocante) servies en kookgerei aanwezig. Voor koude dagen en avonden kun je bij de 2  mooie gaskachels  (de 2de staat in de zitkamer op de 1ste verdieping) heerlijk genieten van de warmte.  Er is een mini-mini bibliotheek in de zitkamer. De slaapkamers zijn gezellig ingericht, de matrassen liggen goed en de dekbedden zijn heerlijk warm. De badkamer is ruim en ook knus. Het is een huis waar je graag bent in de mooie stad Antwerpen.
Great host, quick repose. Awesome location.
Prachtige lokatie! Leuk huisje.. en een gastvrij ontvangst. Geen lokatie voor mensen die slecht ter been zijn.

Uitstekende lokatie, karakteristiek oud pandje. Je moet niet bang zijn voor steile trappen!
Basic ingericht, uitstekend voor een kort verblijf!
Fijne communicatie en snelle reacties op vragen.

Een superschattig klein huisje op toplocatie! Wij waren een weekend weg met een groep huisgenoten en hebben echt genoten. Alles zag er netjes uit en de sleutel konden we zo krijgen, dus we hebben Michel zelf niet gezien. Het was erg flexibel met de tijden van in- en uitchecken. We misten wat kleine voorzieningen in de keuken om voor 6 man te koken, maar we hebben ons prima gered! Een gezellig onderkomen om ook gewoon een avond thuis te zitten. Zou hier zeker terugkomen!
Michels Haus ist wirklich was besonderes. Die Lage ein Traum. Die Treppe sicher nur für fitte Menschen zu bewältigen. Ideal für eine Städtereise. Wir kommen wieder.

This is a beautiful, atmospheric house which was perfect for our group of four. It is in an excellent central location. Despite cold winter weather we were warm and cosy. Be warned the stairs are  (as highlighted) very steep!

Wir waren nun schon zum 2. mal in Michels Unterkunft. Die Lage ist unschlagbar. Parken direkt gegenüber im Parkhaus. Wichtig ist immer zu betonen, dass die Treppenbeleuchtung Haus sehr steil sind und schwierig zu begehen. Sonst ist alles prima.

Unfortunately the conditions were worse than it was stated in the offer. If I was there by myself - I could stand it but it was a business booking and my sub-contractors didn't stay there a while. The house needs to be redecorated or photos updated.

une charmante maison, typique et bien décorée.
A noter que les escaliers sont très raides, et cette maison ne convient pas parfaitement pour de jeunes enfants (nous en avions et tout s'est néanmoins es bien passé

Absolutely GREAT location, everything is on walking distance like all major historic attractions, restaurants, bars, musea and public transport if needed. Save and cheap parking garage "Cammerpoorte" on literally 2 minutes distance of the house. The house is small but very cute and with a romantic vibe. The stairs are steep and small, not a problem for us, but would not recommend for disabled people or small children. It has 3 floors: on the 3rd & 2nd floor: 2 bedrooms per floor, each with a single person bedroom with sink, and a double person bedroom. The beds and pillows are good and the linen smell fresh. On the 1st floor is the only bathroom (shower is in the bathtub) and the only toilet. Hot shower but small to stand/move in the bathtub and not possible at all if you're above 185cm! Across from the bathroom is a cozy living room but with great bars and terrace in front of the door sitting there is very unlikely ;-) On the ground floor is the entrance and kitchen. The kitchen, bathroom and toilet could really do with an upgrade as things are very dated. But overall the house was clean and bug/mosquito free! A gem in the fashion district of Antwerp. Contact with Michel was clear and quick, as was the check in via a 4 digit coded key box. We would stay here again!
Sehr authentische Unterkunft, super gut gelegen. Zum Wohlfühlen, aber Achtung die schmalen Treppen sind nur für Leute geeignet, die kein Handicap haben. Sonst aber alles wunderbar! Danke Michel!
Le logement de Michel est d'excellent rapport qualité prix. J'ai réservé pour plusieurs de mes salariés, qui ont été très satisfaits par leur séjour dans ce logement. Il est fonctionnel.
Enjoyed our stay. Great ambience, good beds, convenient location.
Perfecte locatie en goede communicatie!
The place was great - clean, a lot of space and the location couldn't be better.

The location and aesthetics of this beautiful place were amazing. Because the house is quite old, there were some small disturbances, but nothing that bothered us too much. We really enjoyed our stay!
Un excellent sejour dans cette maison en plein coeur de cette belle ville.

GE WEL DIG!!!

Op een prachtige locatie in Antwerpen. Vlakbij een supermarkt, het mode museum, de Kloosterstraat en restaurantjes. Een romantisch huisje met alle voorzieningen. Het is even geklauter naar de bovenste verdieping, dat wel, maar we hadden met onze familie een heel fijn weekend.

La maison est décorée de façon charmante, très accueillante, très bien située.

Very nice and comfortable appratment! I was the first visitor and Sam did his very best to feel me home. He contacted me several times with small sms to ask if everything was ok (without really disturbing me)

Thanks Sam!

Would definitely recommend this apartment for your stay in Antwerp.

Sam is a great host who will go out of his way to make your stay both comfortable and enjoyable. Thanks for your help, I will be staying here again in the future

Nice and quiet apartment, really in center of town. Apart from the shower (you have to hold the showerhead (probably soon fixed) and the pipes seemed to be a little clogged) it is a cosy place and the Nadereh Atta was very friendly.

Fantastisch appartement in een goede buurt! Alles was heel makkelijk te bereiken met het openbaar vervoer of te voet. Veel leuke lunch- en eettentjes in de buurt. Een absolute aanrader als je een weekend naar Antwerpen gaat!

We hebben een ontzettend fijn verblijf gehad bij Nadereh. Het is een leuk schoon appartement in het centrum van Nadereh. Het centrum is vanaf het appartement goed te belopen. Ik zou het zeker aanbevelen.

Super appartement!!
Goed verzorgt, veel ruimte, het bed was heerlijk en richting het centrum was heel makkelijk aan te lopen.

Super leuk weekend gehad in het appartement van Nadereh. Bij aankomst goed ontvangen. In het centrum kwamen we Nadereh nog tegen en heeft ons goed geholpen met advies voor restaurants en bars. Onze vertrektijd was zeer flexibel, de dag van vertrek konden wij lang blijven. Zeker een aanrader!

Great location, great host, great apartment! Everything is within walking distance - 20 min to the main attractions of Antwerp. Nadi was a fantastic host, making it comfortable and fun for both me and my dog. I'll definitely be staying here again when I get back to Antwerp!
Nadi is a real nice lady who wants you to feel at home. She had a nice house on a good location.
Prima verblijf gehad!

Nous avons passé un agréable séjour dans l'appartement de Nadi. Il est très confortable. Même si nous n'avons pas pu rencontrer Nadi car elle travaillait, notre arrivée et notre départ se sont bien passés. Je conseille cet appartement pour visiter Anvers.
Heel fijn appartement!
Very Nice place.  Good situation and very quiet. Easy going owner. Just as Nice as the pictures.

A nice apartment close to the city center. We had a wonderful stay in a stylish room that had everything we needed. Nadi is a friendly, open person who makes you feel welcome from the start. Contact was quick, clear and positive.
Thanks to Nadi, the service was great and we had a good time in this appartment.

Ich würde die Unterkunft für diejenigen empfehlen, die sich die Stadt erkunden möchten. Ruime nette studio op gunstige ligging. Goede incheck en snelle communicatie. Top!
Nadi est une hôtesse très réactive et attentionnée, et son appartement est parfait pour quelques jours en centre ville. Je recommande !
Super locatie en heel gastvrij. Zelfs toen ik de sleutel vergeten was, kwam Nadi savonds ons nogmaals helpen. Reageert ook super snel.
Heel fijn appartement, fijn ontvangst en in het centrum!

We hadden een nacht geboekt bij Liselotte begin februari.

Bedankt Liselotte! We komen zeer zeker weer terug!

Leuk ingericht appartement. Midden in de stad! Alle winkels in de buurt. Vriendelijk ontvangst. Een aanrader!

Liselotte is a lovely host, making us feel totally welcome when we arrived. The apartment is beautiful, clean and in a super location. We were in walking distance from all the sites and the old square. Perfect for a city break.

We would definitely reccomend staying in this lovely apartment.

Liselotte's apartment is stunning and immaculate. Alles is uitstekend. Ik heb er volop van genoten. De theaterbuurt is heel erg mooi en Cafe Bourla ligt vlakbij. Even flaneren en een borrel drinken s'middags !

Great apartment in a great location. Would definitely stay here again if I travel to Antwerp.

this apartment are so lovely, it is the best apt for your trip, it is like we living in the decoration magazine. every detail are so testy, stylish. we really love esp. the kitchen is fully equip....color are so lovely Green, White...and wood things.....WE LOVE THIs apt. and the area are super cool!!!!

thank you :)
Lies was a great host. She gave us fabulous advice about bars and restaurants. The apartment is very cool and in the best part of the city. Would recommend this to anyone

Das Haus hat eine super zentrale Lage direkt gegenüber vom Modemuseum. Eine liebevolle Einrichtung, helle luftige Zimmer, sehr schöne Bäder und eine niedliche Küche. Wir haben uns zu viert dort nach Ostern sehr wohl gefühlt und können es nur empfehlen. Lies hat sich immer sehr schnell gemeldet und gut gekümmert, der kostenlose Parkplatz ist schnell erreicht, Einkaufen direkt um die Ecke, ein echter Tipp für Antwerpen.
Very nice house and host in a wonderful location to discover the city

We hebben een heerlijk weekend gehad in het super mooie appartement van Lies. De locatie was perfect, op een paar minuten lopen van het centrum van Antwerpen. We werden goed ontvangen en hebben veel gehad aan de tips die ons werden gegeven. Het appartement was erg netjes en super sfeervol. Echt een aanrader :).

The photos are accurate, this stylish house looks straight out of Wallpaper* magazine. Lies was a charming and responsive host, greeting us with a bottle of bubbly and a box of chocs. She gave us a notebook with loads of ideas for places to eat and visit, and there's a shelf of guide books. When we asked for a couple of household items she provided quality solutions within 24 hours. The house is absolutely central, on the No 4 tram route and close to Groenmarkt. It's a busy road, but by keeping the windows shut we slept fine. (Note, Antwerp has fierce summertime mosquitos, so come prepared for that.) It's a characteristic tall townhouse, with many levels linked by a long winding staircase. The cute kitchen adjoins a large dining room, and the equally large sitting room has comfy floor level sofas. Wi-fi is good plus many power points for appliance charging. The top double bedroom occupies the entire attic and has an ensuite, the smaller double bedroom has its own loo and shower on lower landings. Beds are big and comfy and bathrooms look new, with lots of towels and fragrant toiletries. Furnishings are minimalistic and chic, eg clothes rail / wall hooks rather than wardrobes. Indeed, there are many design ideas here, we particularly liked all the different shades of green on the doors. All in all a fascinating insight into life in a beautiful old Antwerp townhouse, and one that's perfectly suited to the art / fashion / design area it is situated in.

Alles was perfekt: het huis ligt heel centraal en in de buurt van de metro. Het was er heel proper, de bedden goed, het was ook heel rustig. Dank U voor des roosjes in de slaapkamers en in de eetkamer.
Het interieur was helemaal naar onze smaak. In de keuken hadden we alles, wat we nodig hadden om 's morgens gezellig samen te ontbijten. We hadden ook geen moeilijkheden om Lies te bereiken en met haar alles te regelen. We komen zeker graag terug! Marielle en Niko + 2 vrienden (ouder koppel, maar noch fit genoeg om een paar trappen in het huis te beklimmen)
Lies met us and took time to show us around the house and talked about some great places to eat. It's a beautiful home and we had a lovely stay.

We had a lovely time at Lies' place. The location is perfect, the apartment is lovely and extremely comfortable. Lies has a marvellous sense of aesthetics, from the decor and furnishings, to the amazing and eclectic collection of design books and magazines to the curated scents in every room of the house. If you appreciate the finer things in life and have a laid back style, you will love this place and every detail of the apartment!

Lies was heel snel met reageren; de communicatie ging heel erg goed. Het huis was ontzettend fijn, met als verassing een en suite badkamer met ligbad in de slaapkamer boven. Heerlijk genieten!! Qua ligging is het ook in wat voor mij de fijnste buurt in Antwerpen is, parkeer garages in de buurt, dichtbij winkels, trams, leuke koffietentjes, de markt, theaterbuurt, Groenplaats, Kathedraal, etc. Je hebt ook alles in huis wat je nodig hebt; ook als je graag zelf wilt koken. Ik heb er mijn 30e verjaardag gevierd met een etentje zondag middag, en de positieve energie van het huis, heeft zeker ook bijgedragen aan de gezellige sfeer, en mooie herinnering aan de dag. Wij komen zeker terug!
Lies was amazing and the apartment was WAY better than the description.  On top of that there were fresh flowers, and two guides to Antwerp. This was indeed my best airbnb experience!

What a totally cool place to stay!! Our favorite place in Europe was this apartment. The space was amazing and we did not mind the stairs as it was so quaint and perfectly located. We were visiting a grandchild doing a semester in Antwerp and when he and his friends stopped in they were equally amazed. Lies is quite the decorator and stores and restaurants were within easy walking distance. We were met upon arrival, given lots of maps and info ( like a book of 500 hidden gems of Antwerp). It felt like home ( no make that better than home because I do not iron my sheets).
The kitchen was great and only drawback was no microwave but we mastered the stove quickly. I just wish we could go back tomorrow.

The apartment was very cosy and beautiful. Perfect for a rainy and cold April! Flowers and a book as a gift made us feel very welcome. Everything was very clean and the kitchen very useable. Would love to stay again.

The apartment was absolutely fabulous, communications went well, and everything was just perfect. We would definitely stay there another time. There are a lot of stairs however, so not good for people that are not good on her feet. It is basically your own townhouse. We even got an Antwerp book for us to keep ;)

The description of the apartment is absolutely correct - our expectations were even exceeded. It is a nice and clean apartment, with lots of charm. Sadly we had to work a lot, so we did not really get to enjoy it as much as we would have loved to.

Lies was always very helpful and got back in touch with us very quickly. She provided lots of helpful information. Her boyfriend let us in. He not only guided us through the apartment, he also provided us some more useful information to find our way through the neighborhood.

The neighborhood is awesome. There are lots of nice and unusual shops around and the gorgeous city center of Antwerp is just a 5-min-walk away. Close to the apartment is the "Groenplaats" where you will have got connections to the public transportation.

It was the perfect place to be for us and I still am in love with this wonderful apartment! Would definitely come back!

What a fantastic apartment and host.  The other reviews are spot on.  It is even more beautiful than the pictures and is spotless.  There were fresh flowers and thoughtful provisions provided to make our stay comfortable.  The apartment location cannot be beat.  In addition, Lies could not have been more helpful throughout and suggested a great place for dinner and kindly made reservations for us.  This is a real Airbnb gem!

Booked 3 nights last minute for a wedding and Lies was more than accommodating and responded promptly. Her home is very artistically designed and we enjoyed enjoyed the reading materials. Chic & clean space, amazing location in Antwerp!

Lies made us feel very welcome before, during and after our stay. She sent a list of nice places to visit and was in good contact at all times. We really enjoyed our stay and would recommend it to other travelers.

Très bon accueil de la part de Lies (fleurs, renseignements, livre cadeau utile pour visiter Anvers). C'est vraiment un bel appartement, très agréable à vivre.

We had a wonderful experience staying at Lies' lovely house. Just like Antwerp, this house has an effortlessly cool vibe. We loved the clean simple decor with some thoughtful details here and there. The stairs? We had no complains! Great for toning your legs:)) and, may I add, great for taking pictures. Lies is a charming host and as a PR professional provided us with loads of info about cool places to have coffee or lunch. Location is superb! Thank you Lies, we shall be definitely coming back. xx

This apartment was perfect for a 2 week stay in Antwerp for our family of four. It is well located for the old city centre and the fashion district. The apartment is delightful - light and airy and beautifully presented. There are a lot of steps, which was great exercise for us but could be an issue for some. Lies was very responsive and provided some great tips on where to eat and visit.

My friends and I had a wonderful experience staying at Lies' Hamsa House in the heart of Antwerp. I can highly recommend choosing Lies' place and hospitality to anyone visiting Antwerp!

A beautiful, huge apartment that looks even better than in the photos. Communication was great and arrival super easy. Having not known anything about Antwerp before we arrived we soon realised the location is perfect, close to everything we needed. Highly recommended.

We spent a lovely couple of days in Lies' flat. Its beautiful, and wonderfully devorated, a very relaxing place. The location is great - right between all the interesting areas. Lies her place is great! Clean, beautiful interior and a perfect location. We had a very good time.

Great location and very spacious place. As per pictures. Lies was very welcoming and offered lots of good advice on where to go and where to eat. Would recommend Antwerp, vibrant city with lots of character and things to do.

Lies apartment is situated right in the centre of Antwerp and is equipped with everything you need. Museums and shops are within easy walking distance. A very nice place to stay in the hart of Antwerp. Lies is very communicative, gave good instructions how to reach the apartment and the house is wonderful! Thank you for a wonderful stay Lies. Hope to come back one day!

Lies has a beautiful, stylish and sunny apartment right in the center of the city. Just a step outside the front door are shops, restaurants and activities. Het appartement van Lies ligt middenin het centrum van Antwerpen; je loopt zo de deur uit en staat dan in de Nationale Straat in het modekwartier. Het is slechts 2 minuten lopen naar de Groenplaats. Beautiful apartment, great location for a first trip to Antwerp!

Lies's house is quite charming- it is tastefully decorated with painted wood floors, simple furnishings and lots of original character.  The location is absolutely perfect for everything we wanted to do in Antwerp- close to great restaurants, shopping, museums and subway.

This property and host are extremely special.  As soon as we booked Lies reached out with great tips and ideas for how we could spend our time in Antwerp. We had the pleasure to stay four weeks in this charming three-story-apartment in the heart of the mini-metropolis Antwerp. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié le triplex de Lies et reviendrons sans aucun doute! L'endroit est très central, bien emménagé, calme, très propre et joliment décoré.
This is a great apartment in an awesome location. It's really spacious, stylish, loads of natural light, very quiet... perfect. You also get a great view from the top floor!

We had an outstanding experience. In addition to a wonderful house and location, Lies shared with us information, magnificent destination locations for food and shopping. We would return again and again if given the chance. A real winner!

El apartamento tiene una ubicación excepcional, es correcto y relativamente limpio.

Lise's apartment is lovely and very well located in a fashionable part of Antwerp. It's very close to shopping, restaurants, and the metro. There are lots of steps to climb to the living spaces but this is typical for apartments in Antwerp. Thank you for hosting our stay.

The 5th floor bedroom was nice and quiet since it had a room as a buffer to the street. The top floor bedroom was quite loud on the weekends. It is a trade off between quiet sleeping with 3 floors to a toilet or louder sleeping with the toilet in the same room.
Excellent from start to finish. Great advice before we arrived and everything was so easy.
Lovely central apartment, very clean and stylish. The ideal spot to enjoy Antwerp. Lies was great and amazingly quick at responding!
Charming space in a beautiful neighborhood full of great shops and cafes. We had a wonderful stay, thanks Lies!

The location was perfect, many nice bars and restaurant and loved the area with all of the vintage, antiques and furniture stores. Lies was very helpful and quick in her communication. Would definitely recommend this place.

Gorgeous home in the center of town, Lies place is walk- or tram-able to everything you’ll want to see in Antwerp. Prepare to climb lots of stairs in this four-story walk-up... to paradise. The assortment of guide books and maps were also a nice surprise.

Lies is an excellent host and the place is perfectly comfortable for 3-4 people and we loved all the stylish touches.  Perfect area to stay in near so many places.  Lies stayed in contact to make sure everything was good and gave excellent recommendations for things to do.  We would absolutely stay again.

Our stay at Lies‘ house was perfect! The location couldn’t be better. You are in the heart of Antwerp. The accommodation is exactly the same as in the photos. A great place to stay in the centre of Antwerp. Lies was so helpful with local advice. Definitely a place to come back to.

this house is so special, it became our home for a couple of weeks. Every detail is simple, beautiful and of very good quality. The Location is absolutely perfect. There are many stairs but we good used to it! The owners are super- friendly and helped us wherever they could.

Stayed here over 3 months while working in Antwerp. We had an fantastic time with excellent communication from Lies. The apartment was in fantastic condition with all the amenities you could want.

Me, my wife and our ~1 y.o. baby stayed in the house for nearly 3 months and couldn't be happier with our stay. Nous avons particulièrement apprécié la situation centrale de l'appartement, sa propreté et sa décoration.Nous le recommandons donc pour passer un agréable séjour à Anvers.

The apartment is very big and has everything you need including 2 complete bathrooms. Do definitely recommend it for groups of 4 that also want some privacy.

The apartment was absolutely gorgeous and clean, located in a lovely quite area and near all the amenities.
There was a little issue with the Wi-Fi but A'mie was extremely nice and help us sorting it out right away. Lovely stay, I'd definitely go there again next time I'm in Antwerp. / Vee /
The Apartment was truly amazing!! I would defiantly stay again. A'mie was lovely and even left some food and drinks for us which we really appreciated.
The perfect host. Warm and caring and helpful and inspiring.

Wir hatten eine super schöne Zeit bei A'Mie!!! Die Unterkunft ansich ist eine Reise wert und die Gastgeberin ist sehr freundlich, hilfsbereit und bemüht einem den Aufenthalt so schön wie möglich zu gestalten!! :) Sie hat uns viele hilfreiche Tipps über Antwerpen gegeben und einen Stadtplan und Reiseführer zur Verfügung gestellt.
Ich kann diese Unterkunft für einen Aufenthalt in Antwerpen nur empfehlen.

A'Mie & David made my Antwerp stay the best! Due to an unfortunate dubbelbooking they let me stay by myself in the Sunny Joy house which was amazing & highly recommended! Be aware though -  you might not see much of Antwerp since you won't want to leave the roof terrace overlooking the peaceful garden! :) Quirky area with nice architecture & nearby bars. A'Mie was easy to communicate with & super helpful. Let me stay longer than the check out time and stored my luggage on departure day. I would definitely recommend to stay in any of their places!

Het appartement ligt op een ideale plek dicht bij het centrum en het centraal station. Ik raad hem zeker aan als je een keer op een bijzondere manier wil logeren met je partner en vrienden. We vinden het niet erg dat de ruimten open waren. Dit gaf juist het appartement een leuke sfeer.

Wij hebben ons enorm thuis gevoeld in het appartement van A'mie! Bij aankomst kregen we een warm welkom van Annemie. Ze liet ons het mooie appartement zien en gaf ons tal van tips voor leuke plekken om te bezichtigen. Die tips stonden ook allemaal netjes aangegeven op een kaart die we meekregen, dus dat was een goede binnenkomer!

Appartement zag er verder top uit. De boel was schoon, van alle gemakken voorzien en er stond bij aankomst een leuk welkomspakketje klaar. Daarnaast zat de supermarkt om de hoek mocht je iets tekort komen. Verder hebben wij het weekend alles te voet gelopen vanaf het appartement naar de leuke plekken van de stad. Was goed te doen.

Het fijne was daarnaast dat we met uitchecken ook niet hoefde te haasten. We konden zelf even kijken hoe laat we weer wilde vertrekken. Die flexibiliteit was erg fijn.

Al met al een topweekend gehad in dit fijne appartement!
We had a good time in Antwerpen and the apartment is very nice!
Une superbe expérience! Je recommande vivement cet appartement pour découvrir Anvers. L'accueil de notre hôte était chaleureux et sympathique  !

We had a great stay here. The place is very much as presented on line; no surprises there. It is easy to reach and very central and the welcome package is a really nice gesture.
