We stayed for two nights in Ian, Jande & Marie's home. It is amazingly beautiful and very, very large. We were four people and everyone had their own space. There are three bedrooms, one on the main floor (2nd floor of the house) and two downstairs - much more room than we needed but we enjoyed it! Each floor has it's own bathroom which is very nice and there are two sitting rooms and a dining room that I wish we had been able to enjoy but we were not in the home much. The beds are amazingly comfortable and our check-in process was very easy with Marie meeting us and walking us through everything. Internet worked for me but not my cousin - I never have high hopes for wifi so generally just got with the flow. One note is that there is no handrail or railing of any kind up the first flight of stairs when you enter the house and, more importantly, no railing of any kind going down to the lower two bedrooms. You have to use the wall to balance and if you have any trouble climbing stairs, that will be a problem. It's also difficult to get luggage down the stairs while also trying to use the wall to balance. The downstairs is lovely though, once you are there. The location seems to be a bit outside the downtown Antwerp scene but it was definitely walkable during the day and seemed to have a few more restaurants and bars popping up. All in all, the home was beautiful - the kind of place we'll be thinking of as we design our dream homes - and we would definitely stay there again!

We stayed in the two houses with a group of 15 swimmers for a competition in Antwerp. The houses are very spacy and comfortable, although not all rooms are seperated by walls (curtains between rooms).

Really enjoyed staying here!

Maurice

We hebben een super fijn weekend gehad in het appartement van Ian, Jande en Marie. Alles was voor elkaar, fijne bedden, genoeg ruimte voor 9 personen. De keuken was volledig uitgerust en een grote tafel om met z'n allen aan te eten. Ik zou dit appartement iedereen (met een grote groep mensen) aanraden!

Afgelopen weekend met 8 meiden gelogeerd in dit super mooie appartement. Het appartement is super ruim, maar wel erg gehorig. In de persoonlijke communicatie werd aangegeven dat de verhuurster op een half uur rijden afstand woont. Hier was zij in de communicatie erg duidelijk over en we moesten precies aangeven hoe laat we zouden aankomen, er was anders niemand om ons in te checken. Toen we uiteindelijk 10 min later aankwamen in verband met het verkeer kregen we daar een opmerking over. Het gekke hieraan is dat later bleek dat de verhuurster die avond zelf ook in het appartementen gebouw sliep en om de haverklap bij ons voor de deur stond als we volgens haar mening te veel lawaai maakten. Terwijl ze eerder die avond had ze aangegeven dat de overige bewoners en huurders pas later die avond in het gebouw zouden zijn. Uiteraard zijn 8 meiden in 1 ruimte niet de meest stille groep, maar het gedrag van de verhuurster was erg overdreven en heeft veel invloed gehad op onze avond. De verhuurder stond zelfs om 1 uur nog voor de deur, wij waren ons al aan het klaarmaken om naar bed te gaan, met de dreiging dat als we niet per direct zachter zouden doen wij de volgende avond geen slaapplek zouden hebben.

We delen dit verhaal omdat we hier andere groepen graag voor willen behoeden. Het huis is mooi (hier en daar wat verouderd en niet super schoon), maar zo gehorig dat je dus niet aan tafel kan zitten kletsen en lachen met een wijntje zonder de verhuurster aan de deur te hebben. Na deze, wat ongelukkige, avond hebben we niks meer van de verhuurster vernomen, ook niet toen we haar probeerde te bereiken omdat er voorzieningen in het huis mistte waar we wel op gerekend hadden. Denk goed na wat je uit je weekend wil halen voor je hier reserveert!

Het appartement is prachtig, en zoveel ruimte. Wij zijn er met veel plezier verbleven met 8 vriendinnen. Ik kan me ook voorstellen dat het fijn is om hier te verblijven voor werk. Lekkere bonen koffie is ook aanwezig. Rust en luxe op loopafstand (kwartiertje) van het station. In de handleiding staan goede tips. Zo zijn wij een drankje gaan doen bij Cafe Mombasa, heel gezellig. En er zijn meerdere care fours en zelf een albert heijn zijn op loopafstand.

This is a stunning apartment that was incredibly spacious for our group of four friends. Marie met us at the apartment and showed us everything we needed to know about the place and gave us local tips. We particularly enjoyed the amazing coffee from the machine and the very  comfy beds. It's a bit of a walk into the old part of town but seconds from the tram stop. A lovely stay.
Mooi appartement
Perfektes Airbnb!
We loved the place, it was nice, spacious an comfortable!

Beautiful, light, airy, apartment, which was lovely and warm. A super welcome and thorough introduction to how the whole apartment worked. Only a short walk from the Central Station. I would highly recommend this AirBnB.

L'appartement est asbolument génial, superbe et magnifiquement décoré. Nous étions neuf dedans et, nous étions tous surpris de la qualité de l'appartement, la machine a café, le calme, la déco et l'accueil des hôtes qui étaient super !

We loved the apartment. It really suited our needWe all loves and the location worked well for us. Very tasteful decorating with very comfortable beds. It was a 15 minute walk to central station but tram stops are close by as an option not far from the front door.
Having a coffee machine was heaven for all of us Aussie coffe lovers. Our only criticism was the stairs leading down to the 2 lower bedrooms felt very unsafe with no railing on 1 side and were also extremely noisy to climb. Also it would be handy to have laundry facilities as well but wee managed. Thankyou Marie.

La maison est magnifique, raffinée. Tout le confort est à la hauteur de ce que montrent les photos : l'appareillage ménager, les quelques réserves de base dans la cuisine (sel, poivre, huile etc...) mais aussi le savon et le shampoing offerts dans les salles de bain. C'est une adresse unique ... et encore pour un séjour plus en hiver car on est content de rentrer et d'y passer du temps! Idéal pour une famille avec de grands enfants car chacun a son intimité et un magnifique lieu pour se retrouver...

Erg mooie authentieke woning op een toplocatie. Het is 10 min lopen naar het centrum. De woning was van alle gemakken voorzien en erg schoon. Bedenk wel dat een aantal bedden in open verbinding staan met de loft waardoor deze kamers wat gehorig zijn. Buiten dAt hebben we enorm genoten van ons verblijf en zou ik het iedereen aanraden

Ein wunderschönes Loftappartement. Marie war zuvorkommend und sehr freundlich. Alles hat bestens geklappt. Ich kann das Appartement gut weiter empfehlen. Wie war als 7 köpfige Familie da. Platz war genug ..
Beautiful and stylish house, central location - very helpful and attentive to us during our stay.

Prachtig appartement op loopafstand van het centraal station en het mooie centrum van Antwerpen. De ruimte was heerlijk ruim en schoon en het contact met Ian en Jande verliep zeer gemakkelijk. Zeker een aanrader voor mensen die met een grotere groep willen verblijven in Antwerpen.
8 vriendinnen hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad in het mooie appartement. Een gevoel van luxe!

Oh my goodness. Ian and Jande’s place is the utter epitome of luxury.

The apartment is enormous. I’ve never stayed in an Airbnb apartment with a part of the residence that I didn’t have to use.

The space is amazing. We were a party of five and we were all slightly embarrassed by the rooms that we had.

A tiny criticism is that the apartment is slightly out of town. But we really liked BoHo and the tram network is such that getting in to the city was really easy.

Wonderful. If you’re considering booking it then do it. I’m pretty experienced with Airbnb and this is as good as I could imagine it gets. Thanks Ian and Jande!

Wir hatten ein tolles Wochenende in einer sehr schönen Wohnung!
Die Küche ist super ausgestattet. Alles war sehr sauber und hübsch eingerichtet.
Nous avons passé un superbe week-end chez Ian, l’appartement est magnifique spacieux et très bien décoré. On s’y sent très bien.

This apartment is something. From the street you have no idea what is behind the door. We were 5 and stayed comfortably with room to have some privacy. The kitchen is well stocked with implements if one wants to prepare a meal. The neighborhood has some great restaurants and cafes within walking distance and the apt is close to Antwerp Central. Marie is very accommodating and responsive. I recommend this Airbnb.

We loved this flat. It was great for our girls trip. Lots of space, well equipped, clean and tidy and very stylish. Very central. The two downstairs bedrooms open onto a street that does get busy early in a morning, which is to be expected in the city. It isn’t a problem with the window closed.

Dear Marie,
Thank you so much for your hospitality.
The apartment was fantastic, the view from terrace was very nice and all was perfect! Hope to visit you soon again.
Beautiful apartment!  Great communication with owners. Neighborhood was fine but not a destination type neighborhood. Bakery a few doors down and a grocery store a block away.
quiet neighborhood on the outskirts in a quiet building. flat is located close to downtown, public transit and restaurants
Appartamento  fantastico comodo e ospitale, perfetto per un soggiorno turistico.
very nice and comfortable apartment. Spacious, bright, elegant, well equipped and clean. Really enjoyed our stay in Antwerp. Thank you Marie for your kindness.
Great apartment with a perfect host.

An amazing apartment, so much more than we expected. Loads of space, beautiful interiors and well equipped. Short walk to the station and busier parts of antwerp!
Great hosts, would definitely recommend!

Een prachtig en qua leefruimte ontzettend ruim stijlvol appartement! Alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig. De straat aan de voorzijde van het appartement is levendig en kan wat geluidsoverlast veroorzaken. De ligging van de locatie is ideaal, het is mogelijk om naar het centrum te lopen.
Super lejlighed. Beliggenheden er perfekt.

This apartment is perfect for a trip to Antwerp. We arrived by train and walked the whole time we were there, the apartment is so central. It is spotlessly clean,  gorgeous old building but that is renovated to modern kitchen and bathroom furnishings. Nice host, even with our late delayed flight she managed to meet us and showed us around without a problem! Everything about this airbnb was very easy and relaxing from arrival to departure!!
Geweldig huis!

Het is een mooi huis en zeker de moeite waard voor een weekendje Antwerpen. Handdoeken en lakens zijn inbegrepen. Ook is het huis voorzien van servies en een vaatwasser, erg fijn! We hebben een leuk weekend gehad met vriendinnen.

Let wel goed op met parkeren. Ik zou adviseren in de privat parking te gaan staan. Wij zijn daarover niet helemaal goed geïnformeerd. We hebben in een zij straat gestaan en hebben dit gechecked met Marie. Vanwege festiviteiten in de stad konden we niet in de straat zelf staan. Vanuit de gemeente is er ook een brief gestuurd waar de afgesloten straten op stonden. Echter kunnen er na de uitgave van zo een brief nog andere straten dan aangegeven afgesloten worden. Verder is de kans groot dat vandalen de verkeersborden verplaatsen. Dit kregen wij te horen op het politiebureau. Als je fout geparkeerd staat, wordt je auto weggesleept. Dit kost veel meer dan de kosten van de privat parking.

Goed bereikbaar, alleen wat moeilijkheden met parkeren gehad maar daar is ook alles mee gezegd. Heel mooi appartement waar wij met 8 man meer dan genoeg ruimte hadden. Bedden waren goed, alle voorzieningen waren goed. Al met al top weekend gehad.

Very open and welcoming space! About a ten minute walk from Antwerp Central Station, and steps from the bus stop. We really enjoyed all of the little touches Marie had such as a coffee machine/beans, fully stocked kitchen supplies and information about local restaurants and attractions. Would definitely stay here if we ever get the chance to visit Antwerp again!
Appartement spacieux et très confortable ! Il est très bien situé, parfait pour un groupe de 8 amis en weekend. L'accueil de l'hôte est au top !
Sehr schöne Unterkunft :).

A truly remarkable home! Stayed with my family and there was more than enough space to accommodate a large party. The home is spacious and well appointed. All the amenities and appliances to make you feel at home. The home was also close to shops and the train station which made it easy to get around. Would highly recommend!

Our group enjoyed our stay. Marie was a very helpful and hospitable host. The space was ideal for our family group and as the organizer I was complimented for my choice!

Pros:
- Very helpful host who is available in the same building
- Close to tram stop (tram goes directly to Old Town and central station)
- Beautiful high ceilings, very spacious and nice atmosphere for socializing with your group
- Great heating and full kitchen

Cons:
- The WiFi is slow (ok for email but not for video etc)
- The bathrooms are quite dark
- One bedroom has only curtains to separate it from the living area

Our host kindly let us store luggage until we left in the evening, and there were flowers in the apartment which was a very nice touch! We hope to stay again one day!

Het appartement is prachtig. Erg ruimtelijk en stijlvol ingericht. Alle voorzieningen aanwezig, goede koffie en ruim plek voor 9 personen. Parkeren in een zijstraat van de hoofdweg (waar 't appartement aan ligt) is prima betaalbaar en er zijn voldoende plekken aldaar. Wij hebben genoten met onze vriendengroep. Top weekend gehad!
Fantastic flat, outstanding hospitality and great amenities. Everything in the flat is good quality, the matresses, the linen, the coffee beans and the technical equipment.

Très beau loft situé à 10 minutes à pied de la gare et du zoo. La déco est superbe, le logement est très agréable. La maison dispose de 3 chambres et deux salles de bain. L'accueil est impeccable. Nous avons passé un bon séjour. A noter toutefois le niveau de bruit élevé depuis les 2 chambres coté rue (trafic important). La troisième chambre coté jardin est en revanche complètement au calme et dispose d'une vue sympa sur l'hôtel de ville du quartier.

Wir waren eine Gruppe von 7 Leuten und haben vier Nächte über Silvester in Antwerpen verbracht. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Es gibt zwei Wohnzimmer, die über eine Küche und einen Essbereich in der Mitte miteinander verbunden sind. Wir wurden drum gebeten abends das eine Wohnzimmer zu benutzen, da sich unter dem anderen Schlafzimmer befinden, das war allerdings kein Problem für uns, da überall genug Platz war. Ein Schlafraum mit einem Doppelbett ist nur durch einen Vorhang vom Wohnzimmer getrennt, hat aber ein eigenes Badezimmer und ist zur Rückseite gelegen, dadurch ist es das ruhigste Zimmer nachts. Die anderen beiden Schlafzimmer befinden sich im Geschoss darunter und sind zur Hauptstraße gelegen, wodurch man nachts viele Geräusche der Straße hört (zwei mal die Stunde fährt die Tram vorbei). Von der Ausstattung war alles da, was man zum Kochen benötigt. Marie ist sehr gastfreundlich. Wir würden dieses Loft immer wieder mieten.

We had a fantastic time at the house! It was gorgeous, and my (personal) favorite was the Christmas tree! The location was perfect, it was the perfect size for our group (of 8) and the views off the back patio were gorgeous. Highly recommend!
Super appartement! Alles is erg schoon en ziet er tip top verzorgd uit.
Great old converted townhouse with style and character. Good hosts & everything in order.
Amazing place! It looked great in pictures but even better in person. House was very clean, hosts were very nice and explained everything we could have wanted to know.
Bijzonder mooi appartement!
all is ok
We had an amazing stay at this apartment! It's bigger than it looks on the pictures! Very clean, well equipped and only 10 minutes by foot from main station
Mooi ingericht ruim appartement met goede bedden, twee badkamers.
Very nice and spacious apartment

In een woord"geweldig"! Wij hebben een super verblijf gehad met 8 (Website hidden by Airbnb) loft zag er op de foto's al mooi uit,maar in het
echt nog mooier en heel sfeervol!Gastvrijheid was super! Ook
ideaal dat de tram voor de deur (Website hidden by Airbnb) kan de auto het hele verblijf laten staan.Aanrader!
Schitterend pand. Een aanrader! Stijlvol ingericht, heel ruim, kraaknet  en een centrale ligging. Heel veel betaalbare restaurantjes in de straat, winkels vlakbij. En een heel goed onthaal.

Very nice big apartment.  Jande was very helpful.  Good location, about 15 min. walk from central station.  You do have to do 2 flights of stairs to get up and down from there with luggage, which was no big deal.
Tolle Wohnung und sehr netter Gastgeber. Man ist sehr zentral und hat alles in der Umgebung was man braucht.

Samen met mijn 8 vriendinnen hebben we een fantastisch en gezellig weekend gehad. Dit mede door dit prachtige appartement. Gezellig ingericht, van alle gemakken voorzien en erg schoon. Zeker een aanrader!!  Dank je, Ian, Jande en Marie

The apartment was situated on one main street about 1 km from railwaystation. The area was restless and inhabitants mostly immigrants. There was no Air Condition at the apartement and dishwasher was partly broken.
Very kind hosts! The Loft is amazing!

This place was AMAZING. Truly one of the most AMAZING airbnb apartments I have ever rented.

The apartment and style is great, place is spacious and clean.

Jande and her mom was sweet and communicative to ease the process of getting to the place and when we asked for local advices

Great and spacious place :)
Very pretty!

Thank you for this very big and stylish apartment, it was perfect for our party of five!!
Everything was as described, you can easily reach a supermarket or bakery within minutes, for the centre of Antwerpen you need a little longer by foot, but you can use the tram. The communication was friendly and uncomplicated. If you need a bigger place for a few people or your family, it's perfect, we enjoyed it very much!

A huge and beutiful appartment just like the picthers
It have 2 living rooms and kitchen between them
It's ancient and modern decorated clean and has all things u need
The host is very nice and helpfull
Its located in crowded immigrant aria but it feels safe
Thanks for great
Weekend

Es war viel besser als erwartet!
Das Loft ist riesig groß mit sehr hohen stuckverzierten Decken.
Alles war blitzsauber.
Die Küche war mit allen erdenklichen Dingen ausgestattet.
Die Espresso-Maschine funktionierte einwandfrei.
Wir haben uns mit 7 Personen sehr wohl gefühlt, da
es extrem geräumig ist.
Der Balkon nach hinten heraus bietet Ruhe und einen wundervollen Blick
ins Grüne und auf ein historisches Gebäude.
Diese Wohnung können wir nur wärmstens empfehlen.
Mooi en ruim appartement
Een prachtig appartement met veel ruimte. Onwijs genoten van ons vriendinnenweekend. Goed te lopen naar het centrum (evt. tram) en parkeergelegenheid in de buurt.

Met een groep van 9 meiden hebben we afgelopen weekend verbleven in dit prachtige huis! Vriendelijk ontvangen. Genoeg ruimte voor 9 personen en ook genoeg servies en glazen. Het huis heeft 3 prachtige slaapkamers en 1 slaapbank in de woonkamer. Het is wel gehorig, zowel in het appartement want de vloer en trap kraakt (hout, dus logisch) maar ook de bovenburen hebben we wel thuis horen komen. Verder was de locatie perfect, op een steenworp afstand van het station. We hebben alles gedaan met huur fietsen of Birds (elektrische stepjes)! Top weekend.

Very spacious, nice and comfy place. The rooms towards the Turnhoutsebaan little noisy. The room to the back very silent. First night little cold due to heating system, which was still in summer mode. Marie fixed it next day, then it was warm and cosy. Perfect place to stay!

Het appartement is uitermate geschikt voor een grote groep. Zeer stijlvol ingericht, enorme fijne ruime ruimte waar iedereen zijn eigen ‘space’ nog heeft. Heerlijke grote keuken, gezellige banken. De straat is druk en divers, maar als je binnen bent zit je in een fijne oase. Uitstekend voor een groep tot 7 personen. En de behulpzaamheid van de hostess is top! Dank jullie wel voor een heel fijn verblijf!
Een geweldig ruim en gastvrij verblijf. Wat een prachtige woning. Zeer veel ruimte om met een groep vrienden te verblijven!
Great place to stay with friends in Antwerp!
Perfect place. This was the second time I stayed here and it was again amazing. The apartment is just beautiful.

Very great loft apartment and ideal for a city trip. We were there over NYE with 7 people and enjoyed it very much. The kitchen is ok equipped. The oven is a small microwave with extra baking functions so not ideal for bigger groups! We very much enjoyed the architecture of the flat and the openness! In heneral the flat is very poorly soundproofed so if you are a bigger group it can be hard :-) otherwise perfect stay in a very central neighborhood- 15 min walk to the central station and 25-30 min walk theough the Jewish quarter  to the Grote Markt! We loved it!
Spectacular apartment with a beautiful view and walking distance from central station.  Great for families, beautifully decorated and an amazing way to spend time in Antwerp.
Great big house, clean and lots of room.
Prachtig appartement, veel ruimte en goed gestyled. Heerlijke bedden en daarmee ideaal voor groepen. We hebben het er fijn gehad! Openbaar vervoer voor de deur.

Our stay with Marie was outstanding. The apartment was absolutely stunning and had all the amenities we could ask for. Marie was a fantastic host, great communication, greeted us upon arrival and gave us a thorough tour of the apartment.  Would definitely stay at her place again.
Een prachtig appartement, groot, gezellig en mooi en van alle gemakken voorzien.
Un magnifique appartement idéalement situé pour profiter d'Anvers
Was a perfect owner, and the house is very very beautiful

We were three collegues and shared the place for 6 weeks, which is quite long, and we enjoyed pretty much every moment of it. This large living room - kitchen - living room area made our life there spacious and airy. The balcony has the best view possible, in some sweet gardens and that wonderful church, whatever it is called. The neighborhood is edgy, which makes you feel like part of the city, not some tourist passer-by. All in all, I would rent it again.
Leuke, premium airBnB!

Sehr schickes, schön ausgestattetes Stadt-Appartement, gut gelegen und angebunden. Für eine Städte-Trip genau der richtige Ort. Der Gastgeber ist auch zu empfehlen. Wir freuen uns auf den nächsten Besuch.

Very chic, nicely furnished city apartment, well located and connected. Just the right place for a city trip. The host is also to be recommended. We are looking forward to the next visit.
Séjour très agréable dans ce bel appartement, très bien situé. L'endroit est calme, apaisant avec un très bon rapport qualité prix quand on voyage à plusieurs.
In één woord super. Prachtig loft, super locatie en hele vriendelijke hosts

Mooi en zeer ruim appartement en van alle gemakken voorzien. Leuk balkon met grote openslaande deuren. Vooral met mooi weer kan je daar heerlijk zitten en heb je tot laat zon. Fijn dat dingen zoals zeep, koffiebonen, etc al verzorgd zijn. Dat zijn vaak dingen waar je zelf niet aan denkt, maar waar je je nu niet druk over hoeft te maken. Als ik de volgende keer weer naar Antwerpen zou ik dit appartement weer kiezen.

Wij vonden het appartement heel mooi en op een goede locatie liggen. De gastvrijheid vonden we niet goed. Het is erg duidelijk dat er vaak sprake is geweest van geluidsoverlast. Het welkom stond daar in het teken van. Opmerkingen over dat we op sokken moesten lopen, ze hoopt dat we 2 avonden de stad in gaan en dat Nederlanders altijd luidruchtig zijn. We voelden ons niet welkom.
Ein wirklich aussergewöhnliches und tolles Appartment.
Perfect !

We hebben genoten van het prachtigen appartement van Ian, Jande en Marie. We werden aangenaam ontvangen en door het appartement geleid door Marie. Zeer ruim en hele nette woning op korte afstand van het stadscentrum van Antwerpen. Openbaar vervoer dichtbij, A Velo fietsen om de hoek, goedkoop parkeren en zeer leuke restaurants op 10 minuten lopen aan het Dageraadsplein (echt een tip om bij May’s te gaan eten).

everything went fine.
beautiful appartement.
Thanks for the fantastic stay in your amazing appartment! We will definitely come back.
Heel mooi ruim huis met prachtige hoge plafonds, fijne keuken en goeie bedden. De buurt is niet de beste maar je loopt in een kwartier naar het centrum
Prettige ontvangst, met duidelijke en vriendelijke communicatie. Zeer net appartement, erg ruim en centraal!

Zeer sfeervol appartement op 10 minuten loopafstand van het centraal station en zo'n 30 minuten lopen naar de Grote Markt in de wijk Borgerhout. Het appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien en heeft heerlijke bedden. Supermarkt en bakkerij in de directe nabijheid. Wij komen zeker nog eens terug!

Tout s'est très bien passé chez Tania, elle a été particulièrement souple pour notre arrivée plus tardive que prévue.
Maison tout confort, conforme à la description.

Tania made us feel very welcome, she is friendly, generous and very helpful. Her home was a delight to stay in, a real home from home. Very relaxing. Her cat is a rescue cat, very nervous and needs to be treated with respect, I missed her (Pitou) when I returned home.
We came to Belgium to visit seriously ill friends & it was great to have somewhere nice to be able to relax quietly with them & get them out of their own house for a while.
There are major supermarkets locally and a useful Spar convenience store at the end of her road, with a friendly owner that speaks excellent English. There are good tram, bus & rail links nearby, which makes it ideal for going into Antwerp sightseeing, without the risk of a noisy disturbed night. Much nicer than staying in an hotel.
The only suggestion I would make to visitors is to bring some slippers with you, my husband found the floors cold just wearing socks, but I was snuggly in my slippers.
Nothing to fault, all good, as described.
Thank you very much Tania, for sharing your lovely home with us.

Het was een super fijn huis! We waren er in het paasweekend en er lagen wat chocolade eitjes voor ons klaar. Alles is aanwezig, goede douche, lekkere bedden en een keuken waarin je een heerlijk maaltje kan koken. De grote tuin lijkt me heerlijk om in te zitten als de zon schijnt (helaas was het bij ons iets te koud) en de kat is een lief beest. Met de tram ben je zo in het centrum van de stad. De auto kan je makkelijk op de oprit kwijt. Top verblijf!

Nous avons été accueillis très chaleureusement par Tania. La maison est très lumineuse, très confortable et bien équipée. Elle est située dans une rue très calme de la banlieue d'Anvers à 5 minutes d'une station de tramway. C'est un "bon plan" que nous recommandons sans réserve.

Nuestra estancia en la casa fue muy agradable, a pesar de que llegamos muy tarde a la casa Tania nos esperó. La casa es bastante grande, con una cocina y un salón muy amplios. El barrio es residencial y muy tranquilo, pero bastante lejos del centro de la ciudad. En general nuestra estancia fue muy cómoda :)

nous voulons vous dire merci beaucoup, Tanya! Elle a fait tout ce que notre séjour était confortable! la maison est très confortable. Très calme, sauf pour le chant des oiseaux! Nous vous recommandons!

Mijn dochter en haar vriendinnen hebben een heerlijk weekje gehad in het appartement van Tania. Omdat het zulk prachtig weer was hebben ze optimaal kunnen genieten van de tuin bij het huis. De ontvangst was aller hartelijkst door Tania.

Lovely house, nice host although due to traffic we arrived later than arranged so handover was very rushed.  Neighbourhood was very multicultural but tania's house was tucked away from main drag and we travelled by team into centre a no one gave us a second glance.
La maison de Tania est très agréable à vivre avec un jardin, deux chambres et un grand salon

Superbe logement. On était très à l'aise. Tania a tout fait pour nous faciliter le séjour.
Grand plus de ce logement: le jardin.
Het was heel aangenaam vertoeven in dit gezellige huisje met mooie lichtinval! Rustige buurt, aangename tuin, vriendelijke buurvrouw, lieve poes...

My husband and I were in Belgium for a family wedding in nearby Liers and we wanted an Airbnb near to other family members, (also staying Airbnb just 3 streets away), who were giving us a lift with their car. We travelled via Brussels airport to Antwerp by train and then took the number 2 tram (metro) from the Diamant stop (below the beautiful station) to a overland tram stop a very short way from Tania's house. Tania had very kindly allowed us to check in early at 10.30am and was there to welcome us and introduce us to her sweet cat Pitou. Tania was very nice and helpful and the house is lovely and in a very attractive street. We found the location very good - an interesting tram ride back to the station (most of the tram's journey is above ground along the pretty streets) and then an enjoyable walk into the historic centre. We also visited the MAS museum at the docks area which was fascinating and had an excellent view of the whole city from every floor and from the roof. We spent little time in Tania's house as we ate out every evening and then attended the wedding but it was a comfortable and very quiet place. We did not use the kitchen (except for tea) but it was very attractive and there was a very pretty garden - the lounge area was very spacious and the large windows gave lots of light and a view of the quiet road with plenty of greenery. I would recommend this house for anyone visiting Antwerp. Tania was exceptionally hopeful and responded to us very quickly. A very successful visit. Thanks Tania!
Merci à Tania pour son accueil et pour le café
Hôte très sympatique maison très agréable dans un quartier tranquille on y est comme chez nous

Un weed-end à Anvers très réussi dans cette spacieuse maison au calme, mais très bien connectée avec les transports publics pour rejoindre le centre-ville et avec tous les commerces à proximité.
Un grand merci à Tania pour son accueil sans faille malgré notre arrivée tardive, et la mise à disposition de vélos qui ont largement contribué à la réussite de ce séjour, nous reviendrons avec plaisir...
Prachtige tuin, goede ligging, supermarkt en bakker om de hoek. Kat is kindvriendelijk.
nice!

Een letterlijk en figuurlijk warm welkom bij Tania. Het is een fijn huis om in te verblijven, alles wat je wensen kan is aanwezig. Het centrum is niet op loopafstand maar met het openbaar vervoer prima te doen. Wij hadden onze fietsen meegenomen, dat is nog iets makkelijker, in 20 minuten zit je midden in de stad. Poes Pitou is makkelijk en komt gezellig bij je zitten als je even rustig op de bank zit. Tijdens ons verblijf was Tania per app goed te bereiken voor onze vragen over leuke restaurantjes en musea. Een aanrader is restaurant Flaneur in de Leopold de Waastraat !
Tania is a great, warm host, very flexible and accommodating. We really enjoyed our stay. Pitou the cat is adorable . Highly recommend!

Tania heeft een geweldig ruime airbnb waar u niets tekort komt. Het is ruim, erg netjes en tania is zeer vriendelijk en erg goed te bereiken. We waren er nu maar 1 nachtje maar deze ruimte is zeer geschikt voor een langer verblijf. Met openbaar vervoer is het centrum prima bereikbaar. We zijn geweldig ontvangen en geholpen door Tania!

La casa está situada en una calle tranquila, cerca de una estación de tranvía y es conforme a las fotos y la descripción. Tania es una persona muy simpática y nos recibió y nos mostró toda la casa. Y su gata Pitou es adorable. Solo pasamos una noche, si hubiéramos tenido más tiempo nos hubiéramos quedado más días sin ningún problemas. Ideal pasa una estadía en familia.

If you're in Antwerp there's no place like home than at Tania's beautiful home. The large open concept kitchen, the accessibility to Antwerp and it's attractions and it's close to several grocery stores within walking distance. To top it off Pitou the cat keeps you company the whole time! The house was presented in an excellent manner, clean, efficient, excellent shower and with fresh flowers and linens makes Tania's place a great place to call home.
à conseiller vraiment

We had a very nice stay at Tania's place.
The ground floor is very spacious, cosy and very convenient.
Garden looks inviting…but winter made us stay inside ^_^
Pitou, the cat, is cute and calm.
Communication with Tania was lovely and helpful.

Accueil très chaleureux de la part de Tania, maison spacieuse, impeccablement propre et conviviale avec des détails apprécié tels bouteille de vin, fleurs coupées ... Quartier calme et agréable.

Tania was very welcoming, the house is spotless, light and spacious, well situated in a quiet suburb. The little details like fresh flowers and wine were much appreciated. A big thank you and all the best to Tania.

Tania is a great host. We had contact bevor we arrived and could plan the check-in time. The house is really nice and cosy. Since we were traveling with small children the house was perfect and they just loved the cat Pitou.

My wife and our two small children made a long weekend visit to Antwerp and stayed at Tania's house. Its a very warm and cosy house. Tania is also a great host (great recommendations and tips for things to do and see in the city) as is her old but charming cat Pitou. Overall we had a good stay!

Tania is een heel vriendelijke dame. We kregen heel wat info. Het huis biedt alles wat je nodig hebt. Een aanrader is om tijdens je verblijf eens gaan eten bij de zoon van Tania in de flâneur in Antwerpen.
Fijne woning, echte aanrader. Grote stadstuin, moet fantastisch zijn met mooi weer
Tania is a fantastic host. She was available when we needed her. Cat is adorable as well. Its quiet away from center.  We loved our stay here. We will be back.
We enjoyed the relaxed ambiance in the house. We traveled with two little children. We felt very comfortable.

Het huis van Tania is een prima plek om te verblijven. Wel rekening houden dat de deuren geen slot hebben (toilet). De badkamer kan niet dicht. Verder een grote tuin, wat bij mooi weer heerlijk is. Een prima locatie om een paar dagen te slapen. Bedankt Tania!
Tania's house is full of light and an ideal place to discover antwerp. pitou is a lovely cat and tania a friendly host

Agréable séjour avec un très bon accueil de Tania par ces petites attentions. Maison propre, agréable et au calme. Pitou, le chat, est très attachant et très sociable, comme sa maîtresse. Je recommande cette location.

Wonderful host and home! My friends and I were greeted with a very warm welcome. Tania gave us a very thorough tour of the house. She makes a great ambassador to Antwerp with all the restaurant recommendations, guide books you can borrow, and information for public transportation. Tania offered full use of the kitchen including ingredients for cooking. It felt like going home for the holidays. She even had some tram tickets we could use and left her some extra money for it. Convenient parking right at the front door and a short walk to the tram stop. The little things like leaving a bottle of wine and some snacks made it one of the top Airbnb choices!

Tania a été une tres bonnne hôtesse. À notre arrivée elle nous a tout très bien expliqué et donné plein d'infos sur les choses à faire à Anvers, en mettant des cartes à notre disposition. Elle est très flexible concernant les horaires d'arrivée et de départ, et elle a une adorable chatte qui s'appelle Pitou!
Tania Haus ist sehr gemütlich, geschmackvoll  eingerichtet  und man fühlt sich gleich wohl. Die Katze ist ein angenehmer Mitbewohner. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Heerlijk huis. Prima bedden en een lieve gastvrouw. Perfect verblijf. Oh en de Pitou de poes is super lief!

Maison idéalement située, proche de Anvers et des transports dans un quartier calme. La maison est très bien équipée avec un agréable jardin.
Tania est toujours disponible pour vous donner de bon conseils.
Nous avons passé un très bon séjour, Merci Tania.

Tania's house is close to Anvers in a quite area. Public transports are also near from the house.
The house is spacious and confortable.
Tania is always available for providing some good advices.
Thank you Tania, we spent a nice stay.

I stayed at Tania's place for a total of 5 weeks. Throughout the entire duration of my stay, Tania was always contactable and very responsive and really made my stay in Antwerp so much more enjoyable. The house felt like home by the end of my stay with the kitchen and garden terrace being the best features. The neighbours were also very accommodating and friendly and I think they enjoy meeting new people who come to stay in Tania's house. The area in which the house is located is well catered for in terms of supermarkets and bakers, with a tram station 2-3 minutes walk. As is the norm in Belgium, there are cycle paths aplenty and from the house you only have to cycle for 5 minutes to link up to the main city waterfront cycle path. Tania offers the supply of two roadworthy bicycles and their is also a VELO cycle station at the bottom of the road, where you can hire any number of bikes.
huisje was top!

Prima plek, een aanrader.
Van hieruit snel m tram 4 naar de stad.
Ruime woning in Rustige buurt waar je de auto kunt parkeren.
Gastvrouw Tania heeft veel tips.

Een heerlijk huis, met grote tuin vlakbij het centrum van Antwerpen. Voor ons gezin (met jongens van 6 & 7) een heerlijke plek en een prima uitvalsbasis om de verschillende delen van Antwerpen te verkennen.

Tania ontving ons zeer hartelijk en gaf ons diverse tips over de omgeving.
Het verzorgen van de kat, Pitou, vonden de jongens leuk om te doen.
Allez-y c'est un appartement charmant avec une maîtresse de maison adorable

Таня очень  гостеприимная хозяйка.  В ее доме найдется все для комфортного проживания. Мы останавливались семьей с ребенком 3х лет. У нас не возникло никаких проблем за время проживания. Кот Питу скрасил наш отдых в этом доме. Таня всегда готова помочь,  посоветовать что стоит посмотреть и посетить в Антверпене, Бельгии.
Dit is een prima plek als je Antwerpen wilt bezoeken.
Tania offer her own house to their guess. She helps in all their guess needs. Fantastic.

Das Haus ist sehr gemütlich und dekorativ eingerichtet. Wir fühlten uns sehr wohl und die Katze war eine sehr angenehme Mitbewohnerin.
Die Tramhaltestelle ist nah, so kann man perfekt Antwerpen ohne Auto gut besichtigen.
Tania ist eine tolle Gastgeberin und gab uns wertvolle Tipps zur Stadt.
un havre de bonheur dans une maison qui ne manque de rien le chat Patou est adorable meme si il sait vous reveiller gentillement...
Tania is a great host and has a lovely home! Everything was clean and neat, transportation to the city center of Antwerp nearby and the area was quiet. Will definitely book again!

Une très bonne adresse sur Anvers, proche des trams, magasins ... Nous avons beaucoup appréciez le calme de cette maison ! Tout y est pour le confort, très propre, un super jardin en ville !
Merci encore pour l'accueil chaleureux, les informations et toutes les petites attentions !
Nous reviendrons !

Pascale & Michel
nous revenons pour la seconde fois et l'acceil est toujours au top merci à tania pour sa disponibilité je recommande sans soucis

Un accueil chaleureux, un logement agréable et confortable.
A une proximité d’environ 20 minutes en voiture du centre ville d’Anvers et du palais des sports (idéal pour la rampage ).
Et une communication facilitée par le français de Tania.
Everything was great! Thanks

Tania welcomed us into her beautiful, spacious home. She guided us around, made suggestions where we should visit and was easily contactable throughout our stay. Her house is very close to the tram stop with a 15 minute trip into central Antwerp. The garden was also a real plus as was Pitou the cat! Thank you so much for making us so welcome Tania, hopefully one day we will get the chance to return!
Maison agréable avec une propriétaire et son chat très à l’écoute merci pour tout
Tania is a great host. Has tons of information on the area. Her house is very tranquil.
loved my stay here. tania was a fantastic host, greeted with fresh lemon water and a blow up pool because of the hot weather. so thoughtful, felt like I was right at home!
Great host! Really nice place!
Transport into town is easy and quick. The property is exactly as advertised, just beware that the driveway is quite narrow. Tania is very quick to respond to any issues that come up.

Wir hatten in Tanias Haus einen wundervollen Aufenthalt. Das Haus ist sehr gut ausgestattet, der Garten wunderbar. Mit der Straßenbahn ist man in maximal 30 Minuten in der Innenstadt von Antwerpen. Empfehlenswert ist Tanias Haus vor allem für Familien. Wir werden auf jeden Fall wiederkommen.
Well worth the stay with some very good advice. Will return.
Tania is very accommodating and courteous!

Tania's huis is een beetje thuiskomen, ze is een zeer attente gastvrouw, goed bereikbaar en met goede tips. Het huis voldoet aan alle verwachtingen, alles is aanwezig om zelf een potje de koken, ook goede bereikbaarheid met openvaar vervoer, kortom een aanrader
Gezellig huisje met mooie tuin met al het nodige. Goede ligging met veel opties van openbare vervoer.  Zeer aangename verblijf bij een heel vriendelijke dame.
Great place and good communication with host Tania. The location is perfect for visits to Antwerp but also Brussels, Bruges etc. Definitely recommended!

It was a great experience staying at this place. It was well organised, clean and tidy. Host was very friendly and guided us with all the necessary details for the tour. Home was spectacular with all the amenities. Worth for money. I definitely this place for others.
Tania was a great host and took the time to make us feel very welcome. The house was very comfortable and had everything we needed. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would use the house again.
Perfect
Great host. We felt at home.

Tania ist eine sehr nette, freundliche und sorgsame Gastgeberin. Das Haus wird normalerweise von ihr bewohnt. Die Bahnverbindung ist in der Nähe.  Es eignet sich gut zum relaxen. Es ist alles im Haus was man braucht und kann benutzt werden. Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt.
Tania war eine hervorragende Gastgeberin. Viele gute Tipps für den Aufenthalt erhalten. Besonders gut Bistro Steiger3 in der Nähe an der schelde.
Heerlijk huis op fijne locatie. Zeer vriendelijke en prettige ontvangst.

Tania ist - selbst wenn sie nicht in der Stadt ist - die perfekte Gastgeberin. Sie hat immer sehr schnell auf Fragen geantwortet und tolle Tipps gegeben. Das Haus ist groß und hat einen super schönen Garten der bei bestem Wetter zum verweilen einlud. Die Straßenbahnanbindung in die Stadt ist 5 Minuten vom Haus entfernt. Auch um weitere Städte in Belgien zu erkunden ist Tanias Haus als Standort nur zu empfehlen.
Wir kommen gerne wieder! Thanks for a lovely stay.

Tania is such an amazing host who is very responsive and caring throughout your stay. It is like staying in a hotel in the comfort of house like staying with family and friends. Thanks so much for great accommodation and being so kind. This is my second time staying here and would highly recommend! Thanks

Vous serez très bien accueillis par Tania qui est très prévenante et attentionnée. Il y a beaucoup d'ustensiles de cuisine et la maison dispose aussi d'un lave-linge. Par contre, il y a peu de place dans le frigo qui est occupé par les affaires de Tania qui habite sur place mais quitte le logement au moment de la location.

Tania's home is situated in a quiet residential area about 30 minutes by tram from Central Station. Her home is very clean, comfortable and has everything you need for your stay. She also has a very pleasant garden and outdoor furniture so you can sit out and enjoy the peace.
Unfortunately due to the present work on the tram line you have to walk further to the next stop and this may be difficult for anyone with mobility issues.
There are two shops nearby and it is easy to obtain fresh food.
Overall, there isn't much to do or see in the immediate area but local transport is very good.

Tania ist eine sehr freundliche und hilfsbereite Frau. Die Nachbarin ist auch sehr nett. Das Haus befindet sich in Hoboken, einem nicht sehr absprechenden Vorort von Antwerpen. Die Straßenbahn hält in der Nähe, fährt aber leider sehr unregelmäßig.  Geschäfte für Lebensmittel sind gut zu erreichen. Das Haus von Tania ist sauber,  nur der Behälter für die Essensreste ist nicht schön. Die Betten sind für Menschen mit Rückenproblemen nicht geeignet. Alles in Allem eine nette Unterkunft für ein paar Tage Urlaub.

We enjoyed our stay in Tania’s place a lot. The house is lovely, very spacious and cozy. Location worked out for us as we were driving everywhere. Tania is a great host and made us feel welcome. I misplaced the key and had to courier it to Tania after our stay and she was very nice about it which I am grateful for. I do recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a comfortable and cozy place to stay in Antwerp.

Tania’s place is very spacious , we rented a car so location is not a problem for us. We stayed for 4 nights, there have 2 nights no hot water for the shower , and we need to go down to the cave and reset the machine . Anyway we still love this place .
Дом и хозяйка выше всех похвал.
A perfect base for a trip to Antwerp! Very nice and clean place! Outstanding hospitality from Tania!

Che dire, una casa a dir poco accogliente e confortevole, ogni spazio è curato, ogni stanza ha la sua comodità. Siamo rimasti molto colpiti dallo stile e dalla posizione della casa in un quartiere molto tranquillo. Tania è una superhost simpatica, molto disponibile ed attenta a tutto. Un’ottima scelta e grazie ancora!
Great location and stay for an Antwerp visit in a place off the beaten track, give it a try.
Another great stay.

Tania is a great host!  The house was decorated for Christmas when we arrived, a detail that was much apreciated! The Kitchen has everything you need for cooking. The house is located in a very quiet area.  Tania  answered any question we might have and gave us detailed instructions regarding the house. We would highly recommended this appartmens for other travelers!
A pleasant stay in a good location. My place to stay when in Antwerp.
Fantastic stay.
Another great stay.
Thank you so much for our stay! Tania was very kind and welcoming! Great spot next to the tram!
Goede locatie om hiervandaan Antwerpen te verkennen.Tania kan je hiervoor allerlei tips geven.
Fantastic. Perfect location, flat was very clean and the amenities great. If you want to stay in the heart of Antwerp then this is the perfect place.

The apartment couldn't be in a better location in antwerp, close to great restaurants, transportation and the charming historic center of antwerp which is wonderful place to just walk around and soak up the atmosphere.

The place is spotless with a very comfortable bed and our hosts were extremely friendly and helpful.

We will happily stay here again next time we are back.

The best stay in Antwerp you could wish for. The location is ideal, located in the middle of the city centre without to much noise. Appartement is very cozy, clean and has very relaxed feel to it. Winny made us feel very welcome and was a great host.  Don't look any further if you wish to stay in Antwerp!

Op een toplocatie in het centrum van Antwerpen hebben we genoten van deze schitterende studio. Het ontbrak werkelijk aan niets. Zelfs voor het parkeren op 100 meter van de studio was er gezorgd. We werden persoonlijk ontvangen door de eigenaar. De studio bevindt zich naast een Tapas restaurant, waar we genoten hebben van een royaal verrassingsmenu. Het restaurant bleek ook van de eigenaar te zijn. En ondanks dat het hartje centrum was, hebben we geen straatrumoer gehoord. We komen zeker terug!

Super appart ! Bel accueil.
Un peu bruyant (locataire du haut)mais j'y retournerai avec grand plaisir!
C.
Wij vonden het een heerlijke studio op een toplocatie in Antwerpen! Zeker een aanrader!!!
Heel fijn appartement op een fijne, centrale locatie. Vriendelijk ontvangen en fijn dat we onze spullen nog even achter mochten laten toen we de stad wilden zien smiddags. Heerlijk bed!

A wonderful apartment which has been lovingly restored.
Our host met us within minutes of making contact, we would have liked more clarity on how we collected the keys but this was quickly resolved by the business next door.
Everything was perfect, spotlessly clean comfortable and good facilities.
The locations suited our plans although it is a bit of a walk from Antwerp train station, suited us for the shops, Sunday Market, The Cathedral and restaurants. Be aware of Cathedral bells, it didn't bother us but if you're a light sleeper it could be a problem.
We would definitely book this accommodation again.

The apartment was easy to find from Groenplaats metro station and is located right in the heart of the old part of Antwerp in the shadow of the Cathedral and only a few steps from the local bars and restaurants. Comfortable, clean, quiet and modern, it is an ideal place to stay if you want to a well priced apartment in the heart of the city. I would stay again without any second thoughts.
Justin
Singapore

The apartment in Antwerp could only be described as a perfect AirBnB experience. Arrival & Check-In was a snap & after a quick climb up the narrow spiral staircase we were in a bright, immaculately clean and incredibly well appointed studio above the narrow & cafe lined side street of Pelgrimstraat. Our host Winny was always available for our questions and the apartment was the perfect home-base for our time in Antwerp. My only regret is that we didn't book a longer stay to enjoy this great rental and the beautiful town of Antwerp, Belgium. 10/10 would rent again.

We hebben twee nachten in het keurig verzorgde appartement van Mara en Winny geslapen. De ligging is ideaal: midden in de stad, vlakbij de kathedraal en het openbaar vervoer op de Groenplaats.
We werden gastvrij ontvangen: de eigenaar waarschuwde ons voor mogelijk lawaai van de verdieping boven ons. Dat bleek terecht: op beide nachten werden we vaak wakker van geloop, geschuif en gezang. Dat was het enige minpunt van dit appartement (maar wel een flink minpunt).

Ontzettend fijn en volledig voorzien appartement op een toplocatie midden in Antwerpen. In de buurt van vele restaurants en café's, en op loopafstand van de Meir (5 min.) Fijn ontvangen door de eigenaar, een zeer attente man. Het heeft ook ons ook zeer geholpen dat hij ons een persoonlijke routebeschrijving stuurde vooraf aan ons verblijf. Ik zou dit verblijf zeker aanraden.

Winny was a good host and explained everything to us. This apartment is exceptionally good. The design is great, everything has been thought of.   The photographs give a true impression of the apartment.  It is in the old part of the city, cobbled and narrow streets. The area is so close to the main square, but away from the tackiness. Recommend highly.
This is a fantastic apartment in the heart of Antwerp. It is exactly as decribed and more! Winnie was a great host and could not be more welcoming or helpful.
Winny was most kind, waiting for us and allowing us to make use of his parking spot in a garage nearby. The appartment was absolutely spotless. A true pearl within the heart of Antwerp.
Loved staying at acha's apartment.  It's perfectly clean and in a great location.  I found the hosts to be really friendly and helpful,  and they gave us lots of suggestions as well.

This was our first stay at an Air BnB location and it exceeded our expectations.  Mara and Winny were very welcoming.  The location was perfect, right in the center of the old town on a quiet side street.  And the apartment itself was beautiful - very spacious and clean.

Our Host Winny made us feel very welcome, he is very accommodating and keen to give you quality. The apartment was immaculate and so well set up with good quality crockery, cutlery, utensils, serving bowls, we could have happily cooked at home each day. There is also a washing machine which helped us out when we got soaked on the one day of bad weather we had during our stay.
We were extremely comfortable, TV worked on UK channels with very good reception, Broadband the same.
We love the location, it suits us although it is noisy with the bells from the Cathedral and bars nearby, however it really does not affect your enjoyment or comfort in the accommodation. We've stayed before and look forward to staying again. It is really central with a fab cake shop nearby. We can't wait to return.

My wife and I stayed here for a week while I was visiting Antwerp for business. I wanted somewhere that she would feel safe and comfortable during the day while I was at my company's office, plus easy to walk to nearby restaurants, shopping, and tourist sites. This place fit the bill for us exactly being right in the town center - only 2 blocks from the Grote Markt, Groenplaats, & Cathedral and 4 blocks from the Meir shopping area.
The inside was very well laid out - more than enough space for 2 people - and had everything we needed including very fast internet, extended cable TV, comfortable bed & seating area, and fully equipped kitchen. Although with literally hundreds of restaurants and bars within walking distance, we actually never used the kitchen!
The parking space available (for a reasonable add-on) in a nearby garage works out great if you need it, as otherwise the parking would be very challenging. But if you don't plan to have a car, the place if very easy to get to by public transport from the Antwerpen main train station.
The host was always very clear in directions, procedure for getting access, checking out, and available by text or phone during the week for some occasional questions and recommendations.

Antwerp is a wonderful city and this is a highly recommended place to stay for any visitor!
Heerlijk appartement vlak bij de Grote Markt, kathedraal en Groenplaats. Zeer proper en volledig ingericht. Super Tapas in Spaanse Tapasbar onder het appartement.

Myself and my partner had a wonderful time staying at Mara and Winnys apartment this summer. They took such good care of us, helping us with directions, tourist sites and being so kind about the late hour that we managed to get into Antwerp.

The apartment is situated at the heart of Antwerp and on a beautiful little street. It is the perfect size and has everything you could possibly need for long term stay despite being a short let. It is walking distance from anywhere you might want to go and I wish we had stayed a little longer to enjoy the apartment itself.

Winny and Mara are lovely. We hope to be back here again soon.

A perfect Airbnb experience. Smooth booking and communication. Excellent accommodation (exactly as pictured and described). Hosts very warm, welcoming and helpful. Great location. Very good value for money.

Part of the charm is the lively locale amongst cafes and restaurants near the Grote Markt; the result is there is some 'noise' from all the chatting and laughing so if you need absolute quiet to get to sleep before 11.30pm, bring some ear plugs.

My boyfriend and I stayed together here and it couldn't have been a more perfect location. You step out, walk 20 feet and are in the hustle and bustle right by the beautiful tower and all of the restaurants. The hosts were superb and extremely nice. Unfortunately, my boyfriend and I were too tired after previous travel to stay out late, and were staying over the weekend. As a result of the apartment sitting above a restaurant, it was extremely noisy through midnight. As a result, I personally had a hard time sleeping. Although not ideal, I understood it can be expected being close to the city centre. Otherwise, everything was TOP NOTCH. Thank you!
... a perfect place to discover Antwerp!

Winnie met us at the apartment right on time to let us in and show us around.  He was very helpful in providing recommendations for our weekend in Antwerp.  The apartment is just as pictured, a perfect studio/1br.  It's light and impeccably clean with a fully-furnished kitchen.  Located right in the heart of the old city, the place is on a wonderful alleyway full of restaurants and around the corner from the cathedral.  Grocery is just a couple of blocks away as well.  We couldn't have asked for a better place or experience.

A lovely large apartment in the Perfect Location! We were warmly welcomed and shown around by Winny who was very helpful providing us with local information. Super cosy bed :) The only downside is the slightly noisy floors and stairs. Ear plugs recommended. Otherwise highly recommended.

Wij hebben enorm genoten van het appartement, het was erg schoon, luxe, centraal gelegen maar bovenal prachtig om te zien. Winny ontving ons hartelijk en communiceerde erg prettig. We komen graag eens terug!
Een mooi, schoon en schattig appartementen in hartje Antwerpen. Heel prettig om te verblijven, erg goed bevallen.

Super dagen gehad in Antwerpen. Prima ontvangst en we mochten ruim een uur eerder dan afgesproken in het appartement.
Deze ligt op loopafstand van CS en zeer gunstig tov heerlijke kroegen en restaurants. Het appartement zelf is absoluut een aanrader. Schoon en van alle gemakken voorzien. Één grote, gezellige ruimte.
We komen zeker nog eens terug en zullen iedereen die een mooi weekend in Antwerpen wil beleven dit appartement aanbevelen.

We stayed in the apartment for weekends. We were very happy to live in the very center very close to main citysights. The apartment is perfectly furnitured and is located in very quite street. We liked spending time in the city as well as we enjoyed the apartment

We loved this apartment - it was very bright and incredibly clean. Very well thought out and provided everything we needed. Better than a hotel and great value.
The bed was extremely comfortable - loved the cosy duvet and sheets.
The temperature throughout the apartment kept us warm but was easy to control.
Winny was very hospitable and responded quickly.
We really liked the street too, full of interesting restaurants and gave us a good feel for the city.

The flat is in the best location, in the historical center of Antwerp, in walking distance to great restaurants, jazz bars and historical spots. Winny was friendly and gave us tips for places to go. Would definitely stay here again!

Mara et Winny ont répondu à nos appels en cours de route pour nous guider, et nous attendaient pour nous montrer où nous garer et nous ont aidé à nous installer dans l'appartement. L'appartement est au coeur de la veille ville, proche de la cathédrale. Rénové très récemment, bien aménagé et décoré, il est très confortable, bien équipé (cuisine, Wifi, TV...), bien meublé et décoré. Les photos sont très représentatives du confort de l'endroit. La rue et le quartier sont très animés, avec un grand nombre de bars, de restaurants et de boutiques de designers. Un seul bémol, un peu de bruits vis vis du restaurant, de la rue, et de l'escalier, mais après minuit plus de problèmes.

Perfect place to stay in Antwerp! We enjoyed our time in the middle of the city center and definitely recommend AchA's studio. If you like tapas, please try the restaurant/bar from the airbnb owner, it was delicious. Till next year ;)

Down a quiet vehicle-free cobblestone lane, this first floor studio is smack center in Antwerp’s Old Town, just steps from the magnificent cathedral, and lovely Groenplaats and Grote Markt. The listing description and photos provide an accurate account of the apartment’s crisp style, functional layout, and modern amenities. It is a large studio, with the bedroom separated by a wall from the living area, almost a junior one-bedroom, in fact.

With so many restaurants around, it’s unlikely that you’d be doing much cooking, but the kitchen is well-equipped if you choose to have a night in. The Wi-Fi was reliable and password-secured. The washing machine is a real plus for road warriors. The flat-screen TV carries no English language channels. Although it just a few dozen meters from several busy pedestrian zones, the apartment was quiet, allowing for restful sleep in the comfortable queen bed.

Winny is a cordial and responsive host. He answered my emails promptly and was conscientious in orienting me to the apartment and the neighborhood. Check-in and check-out were fast and easy. I enjoyed myself thoroughly during my four night stay and do recommend Winny’s apartment highly for its prime location, amenities, and value versus a hotel.

Bijzonder aangenaam appartement op een zeer centraal gelegen locatie. Comfortabele woonkamer, keuken en badkamer en alles was zeer schoon.
We werden zeer warm ontvangen door Winnie met wie het makkelijk communiceren is.
Leuke studio gelegen in centrum Antwerpen. Alle voorzieningen aanwezig voor een langer verblijf: leuk samennetje en kitchenette. Goede Wifi. Voor herhaling vatbaar wanneer we in Antwerpen zijn.

Centraal, Knus en Vriendelijk!

De verhuurders Winny en Mara zijn zeer vriendelijk en hebben een prachtige studio in het hartje van Antwerpen.

Van 11 tot 13 december hebben wij mogen genieten van de stad Antwerpen in kerstsferen. Het verblijf in de studio van AchA, was als een schot in de roos. De studio is netjes ingericht, is voorzien van alle benodigde faciliteiten en kent een centrale ligging. Als je de studio verlaat word je direct omringd door leuke winkeltjes, gezellige cafeetjes en heerlijke restaurants. De grote markt, de mooie oude straatjes en de grote winkelstraat liggen op steenworp afstand. Kortom een ideale locatie in hartje Antwerpen.

Had a great stay in Antwerp and Winny was a very helpful host. The apartment is right in the centre of the historic area of the city, but still very quiet. It sits in the shadow of the Cathedral which is quite a sight in the day and also at night when it is lit up. It is just a short walk to the Centraal Station, Zoo, Aquarium and shopping mall. The Christmas markets were just a stone's throw away, and after a long day of shopping we were able to just pop downstairs to his Tapas restaurant (Tapabar) which is a must visit for anyone staying here! Food, wine, service and atmosphere are all 5*!
Safe and secure parking was just round the corner and reasonably priced.
We would definitely look to stay here again should we return to Antwerp in the future.

What a beautiful apartment in the heart of Antwerp! My husband and I had a wonderful stay over five days. We could walk everywhere we needed to go. The kitchen was fully equipped so we could cook and the living room was very comfortable. Thank you Winny for helping to make our holiday special.

Es war ein toller Aufenthalt in dieser schönen Stadt und vor allem traumhaften Wohnung! Wir wurden freundlich empfangen und es hat einfach alles gestimmt. Die Stadt mit dem Rad zu erkunden war eine gute Idee!

Lovely apartment dead in the centre of Antwerp. Beautifully decorated and looks just as shown in the photos – everything is brand new. We had a fantastic stay, everything in walking distance and the host was very kind in meeting us, communicative and flexible about the check-out time, which we appreciated. Great value, definitely would recommend and stay again!

We had a fantastic stay in Winny's apartment. It was our first holiday as a family with our new baby and while we were apprehensive, this was the perfect experience! The apartment is so central, you are right in the middle of everything and literally have great bars and restaurants in your doorstep. Everything in the apartment was new and modern and it was a pleasure to stay there. Winny was an exceptional host and nothing was too much trouble for him, from providing us with a cot from our baby to emailing us a list of recommended restaurants. If we come to Antwerp again we would stay here no question!

Lovely studio, very bright, spacious and clean; nice sitting area with leather sofa's and separate sleeping area with soft and cosy bed; the host is 100% available and very helpful. The studio is situated more than ideally, at one, two minutes walk of the Cathedral, nice restaurants and bars, and yet it is not noisy at all.

I loved this apartment. It was very comfortable and beautifully and simply decorated. It came with ample amenities to live there for a few days or a few weeks — hair dryer, cookware, plenty of dishes, clothes washer, etc. And the wifi is good. It's the perfect location — close to tourist activities, but on a side street that is frequented by locals. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this apartment.

On meeting with Winny at the apartment he let us know that we would in fact be staying in there larger apartment. This was a nice surprise and had no negative impact on the stay.

The apartment is up a beautiful set of stairs and when you enter you are met with a clean and bright apartment that looks exactly like the pictures! Winny was very accommodating and took the time to show us around and talk the history of the building.

We were located a stones throw away from the cathedral of our lady and plenty of shops, bars, restaurants. You should try a restaurant called De Pelgrem where you get eat like you are in the medieval times with rustic food and beer!

All in all we had amazing time and we would definitely book with AchA again, Winny and Mara were great!
Very clean and well appointed studio. Private setting, but right in the middle of everything Antwerp has to offer.

Un appartement en plein cœur d'Anvers à deux pas de la cathédrale et de son animation de fin d'année.
Lieu de vie très confortable.
Really nice place right in the middle of town! Perfect location and perfect host. We had a great weekend!!!!

This lovely apartment located off the Meir  in an historical building offered home amenities in style in an excellent location near so many museums, churches, cathedrals, the central train station, and much more. Laila was a gracious host who provided support as needed while allowing one to have space and freedom to enjoy the apartment.

The flat is well located in central Antwerp above a nice tapas restaurant.  It's identical to the photos and well presented.  Check-in/out were very smooth and straightforward.  It's in a beautiful old building, so noise may be an issue for light sleepers

We had a great time at Winny and Ruth's apartment!
The location is amazing, with the beautiful cathedral as well as lots of restaurants and bars right around the corner. This also means that you can sometimes hear the people outside in the evening, but we did not mind that at all. Also you can hear the cathedrals chimes from inside the apartment, which is very nice :-)
The studio is lovely, comfortable and clean, the communication with our host was flawless as well.
We definitely recommend staying here and would definitely come again!

Das Apartment was sehr schick, es ist sehr stilvoll eingerichtet. Es ist wirklich sehr gut gelegen, man hat alles in unmittelbarer Nähe, inkl. die besten Restaurants und Bierkneipen. Da es sich um ein historisches Gebäude handelt, hört man ggfs. ein wenig die Nachbarn über dem Apartment, aber wir haben das nicht als problematisch empfunden. Ebenfalls großer Pluspunkt: Die Sauberkeit war wirklich sehr gut. Insgesamt können wir das Apartment wirklich jedem empfehlen.

Prachtig appartement in het historische centrum van Antwerpen. Alles is op loopafstand, zoals leuke barretjes en de winkelstraat. De verhuurders zijn zeer gastvrij en gemakkelijk te bereiken. Zeker een aanrader als je een paar weekendje Antwerpen op de planning hebt!

Prachtig appartement, centraler kan bijna niet, extreem vriendelijke en attente eigenaar, alles voorzien wat je nodig zou kunnen hebben. eerlijk gezegd waarschijnlijk zelfs onder de marktprijs. absolute aanrader. ik kom zeker terug!

Yet another wonderful stay on Pilgramstraat at Winny’s flat in old town Antwerp. There are not enough good things to say about this space... one of the best AirBnBs I’ve ever stayed in! Can’t wait until next time!!!

Great location!  Less than 5 minutes walk to subway.  More than 50 restaurants within a 10 minute walk!  Apartment was very clean and newly remodeled, everything needed to stay for a few days or a week if you wanted.  Older building with one set of steep stairs, so if mobility is an issue might not choose but most people will not have an issue.  Larger than I expected, plenty for a couple to stay for an extended period of time.
Fijn appartement op een perfecte locatie. Alles was goed geregeld. Ik zou het zeker weer doen.
Absolutely gorgeous space within sight of the cathedral and in a great walking area. Clean well furnished and comfortable. Had an amazing stay.
super locatie en een fijne ruimte.
Top appartement!
Lovely little apartment right in the centre.

I can't say enough about this place – it's clean, beautiful, comfortable, well-appointed, ideally located, has friendly, thoughtful and thorough hosts, check-in and check-out were a breeze… And it really does look as amazing as the photos! (Except there's a washing machine in the bathroom where the photo shows a little table, which is actually a plus.)

We were very lucky finding such an amazing place for our stay in Antwerp and we would definitely stay there again.

Wij hebben heel erg genoten van het appartement. Het ligt in het centrum van Antwerpen, maar net een beetje verscholen, zodat je niet midden in de toeristische drukte zit. Leuke straat met gezellige restaurants en barretjes. De ruimte zelf is top. Het appartement is voorzien van alle faciliteiten. Het contact met de eigenaren was ook heel erg fijn. Erg gastvrij!
Zeker een aanrader!!
Great location in the middle of the vibrant city center of Antwerp. Apartment is even better than it looks on the pictures
The apartment is two streets away from Groenplaats and Grote Markt, so close to anything you want. There are plenty of restaurants around and lots of things to do.
Superleuk appartementje dat heel centraal gelegen is. Vlotte gastheer..

Our stay was fantastic. It is the perfect place to stay. The location couldn't be better! Everything inside is clean and in great condition. Winny is always available for any questions as well. Antwerp is such a beautiful city and this place is a great one to stay in as it is centrally located to everything.

We hebben een heerlijke tijd gehad. Het appartement is keurig schoon en de locatie is echt geweldig! Je stapt de deur uit en bevind je zo tussen de cafe's en gezellige winkel straatjes.
Zeker een aanrader!
Alles super! Sehr freundlicher Gastgeber!

We had a very comfortable stay in Winny & Ruth’s Abnb. It is an outstanding and charming place in all aspects. The location could not be better. If we return to Antwerp again, this will be the place we stay.
Toplocatie! Fijne ruimte.

The apartment is very well located in the heart of Old Town Antwerpen. It is easily accessible to public transport and is situated in the vicinity of the main public squares. The apartment is very clean and well equipped with everything you will need for a comfortable stay. The bed is comfortable and big. The WiFi is good. The upstairs neighbours are a bit noisy, but the noise did not ruin our trip. We will definitely be back.
Great location and lovely clean apartment. Would definitely recommend it for a city break in Antwerp

Uitstekend gelegen appartementje/studio om de stad te verkennen. Gezellig maar ook practisch gemeubileerd. Zeer netjes ook. Vriendelijke eigenaar die steeds bereikbaar is indien nodig. Wij kunnen enkel positivieve dingen zeggen over ons verblijf in die woonst en hopen dan ook er bij ons volgend bezoek aan Antwerpen weer te kunnen verblijven.

This is a really lovely apartment perfectly situated close to Antwerp’s centre.  It is very well equipped and was spotlessly clean.  Surrounded by nice places to eat or just have a drink (we were spoiled for choice), and with very easy access to the cathedral, main squares and the river.  AchA was a lovely host, proactive and accommodating.  We had a lovely stay and would definitely recommend this accommodation.

Un logement situé en plein centre, très agréable, très propre, avec une déco soignée.
Je le conseille vivement sans aucune restriction.

This apartment is in a truly wonderful location for discovering Antwerp.
It was a small inconvenience on arrival that the apartment had not been cleaned. However it was 100% clear that this was a communication misunderstanding between owners and cleaner. They were clearly horrified and I did not make a deal of it. It was simple human error and the cleaner arrived 1 hour later.
There’s a wonderful range of restaurants and bars in very short walking distance.
Overall I have no negatives about the place. It can be a little noisy at night due to location of some of the bars. I was normally in the bars so not a problem !!

In summary.......I can’t wait to go back.
This apartment was perfect for my partner and I’s weekend in Antwerp. Great hosts. Amazing location. Lovely apartment. Highly recommend.

This place was fantastic! Everything you want and need were literally a short walk away. Very easy to get to from the train station. Communication was quick, and getting the keys were easy.

The space was comfortable and clean. The washing machine is in the apartment, which was great after traveling for a week.

If I come back to Antwerp, I have no need to stay anywhere else.

Very nice place and a great location. The washing machine was bonus. There is a narrow staircase to the unit. As the location is great, there is noise from the street into the wee hours of the morning. Communication was very good.

We had a wonderful stay at Winny’s place in Antwerp. It was situated in a perfect location, central to everything in the city as well as close to transportation hubs. Winny was very thorough in sharing information about the apartment and check in procedures as well as providing information on places about town.  Winny was also very responsive when we had any questions (Website hidden by Airbnb) The apartment was very clean and comfortable (not to mention beautiful!) and we enjoyed having access to a clothes washer as well. I would definitely recommend this place to any couple looking for a place to stay in Antwerp!

Winny and Ruth's apartment is perfectly located in the Meir - with literally hundreds of charming cafes and restaurants at your doorstep (our favorite was right below -  Tapas Bar - serving the most delicious Spanish tapas with a very delightful staff:) The apt itself was also perfect - spacious, with a washer/dryer, fully equipped kitchen and strong wifi. The apt overlooks our charming medieval street and we were able to walk everywhere in minutes - the Central Station,  MAS Museum (a must visit), Chinatown for dim sum and the Nationalestraat for excellent shopping. Our favorite Airbnb ever, we'll be back! Thank you Winny!

This is a great apartment for 1 or 2 people wanting to stay in the heart of Antwerp.   It's comfortable and well appointed, and has a great location.  The only downside of staying somewhere that's so central, is that there is quite a lot of street noise, so pack ear plugs if you're not used to noise at night.
This apartment couldn't be in a better location, and it is big and very comfortably appointed. Winny made check in and check out a very easy process. Thank you!
Wonderful location and homey, cozy,  wonderful space to spend a few days or even longer. I can’t recommend it enough. Really great place to explore the city from!
We had a great time in Antwerp. In this flat is definitely a great point in our journey!  Winny is so nice. If we visit Antwerp again we will back to Winny and Ruth . :-) hopefully it will be soon.
Super Wohnung in toller Lage! Alles perfekt!
Super locatie en een geweldige studio! De host was enorm behulpzaam en de communicatie verliep soepel! Echt een super airbnb!

Perfect flat in central Antwerp. Everything in walking distance. Clean, with all amenities.

Highly recommend

Een prachtig verblijf. Modern gerenoveerd. Fijn beddengoed en handdoeken. Luxe keuken met mooi servies en ruim aanwezig. Locatie is absoluut geweldig. Ook het parkeren. Vriendelijk contact. Zeker een aanrader.

We had a great stay at this apartment. Winny and Ruth were great hosts and were very hospitable and understanding. The location was amazing and it made our short stay in Antwerp very easy. Would definitely return and recommend to others!

I can’t say enough good things about this place. It’s just absolutely stunning, and the location couldn’t be better. Ruth and Winny were extremely hospitable each step of the way, and if I ever make it back to Antwerp, we’ll stay here. I feel lucky to have been able to stay at their place. Thanks a lot for a lovely weekend!

Voor de tweede keer dit appartement geboekt en niet voor niets. Vooral de locatie is geweldig. Dit weekend, tussen kerst en oud en nieuw, wel zeer druk in de stad waardoor alle horecagelegenheden en pleinen overvol waren.
Het huis is heerlijk. Deze keer ook huurders in het appartement boven ons. Dat was goed hoorbaar maar logisch voor een huis in de stad.
Perfect location. Very modern, clean and cosy apartment. Would totally recommend!
Great location (less than a minute walk to the cathedral and maybe 2 min to metro), clean, comfortable and very nice hosts. A good base from which to explore Antwerp.
Very nice and very clean apartment in the center of Antwerp. Winny&Ruth. are very hospitable and discreet at the same time. There is no better place to stay for a few days in Antwerp.

The apartment was easy to access from the central station via metro and with only short walking distance from the metro stop. It's located right in the cozy part of Antwerp with everything just outside the front door. The apartment has all the basic amminities and kept very neat and homely :-)

This is m second time at AchA's place. I just love this place!! It has everything one needs, it is beautiful, clean and in such a great location! I am telling everyone about this place, such a gem!! Winny is an amazing host, communication is always very simple and Winny is doing everything he can to help. This is  my best Airbnb experience . MERCI!!!!

Winny & Ruth are excellent hosts. Always at service for their guests and taking the AirBnB experience to another level. I've been travelling from place to place for the past few months and this was by far the top stay. The comfort of the appartement (furnishing/amenities/location) in combination with their hospitality makes for a very successful stay in the heart of Antwerp. Even through tougher times, I felt safe and truly cared for. Thanks for this experience.
good appartment in Antwerp !

This is a great place to stay in Antwerp. It's right in the old town and surrounded by cafes and restaurants. The apartment is very well appointed and well furnished, great shower (always a plus for me!). Can't fault anything.
The host, Winny, is extremely helpful and accommodating. Nothing too much trouble.
Paid parking is in a multi storey car park about 100 metres away, and Winny can provide you with a pre-payment card which is very convenient.
