I would recommend this place to anyone. I was working, but it would make a great base for a city holiday. It will be my No.1 go-to place should I have to repeat this trip
John Webb

Perfekte Lage in Mitten im Zentrum Antwerpens. Alle Sehenswürdigkeiten sind mit einem kurzen Fußweg zu erreichen. Sehr viele und sehr gute Bars und Restaurants in der Nähe. Einziger Nachteil wäre wenn man etwas früher schlafen möchte, dass dennoch etwas Lärm auf der Straße herrscht aber dass ist bei solch einer Lage natürlich normal.
Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen.
Excellent location and Great place
Lovely apartment in the centre of Old Town. Extremely clean and tidy, with all the towels, bedding and kitchenware you’ll ever need.

Very nice apartment, sparkling clean and centrally located in the old town. We pretty much enjoyed the fully staffed kitchen and the comfortable couch area.
Close to the main attractions and to public transportation (metro/bus station). WiFi was great, and as well the communication with the owner. Perfect for a longer stay in Antwerpen.

Winny & Ruth’s apartment is ideally situated in the historic center of Antwerpen, close to everything happening. The restaurant below was closed the first two nights of our stay. It was open on the 3rd/last night of our stay and the noise level changed drastically, but was not obnoxious and all was quiet just after midnight. To be fair, this may not have been any different in any of the apartments in this area….I suppose its a trade off to being in such a perfect location.

The linens were pleasant and the bed very comfortable.

We were not disappointed with our decision to stay at AchA.

Thank you, Winny & Ruth.
Very nice apartment right in the centre of Antwerpen, what's not to like?

This is a brilliant flat right in the middle of Antwerp's historic centre. Everything you could ever need is within a couple of minutes and you're also really close to the Metro system if you need to go further afield. The flat itself is amazing and makes you feel like a real resident in the city. It was well-stocked with everything you need as well as lots of interesting books on local artists. I hope to be back one day!

Hosts were very kind and helpful. They managed to get us a parking space near the flat.
The place is confortable and tidy, very well equipped. Noisy as expected since it is in the city center.
Excellent Location to reach tourist places, pubs and restaurants. I recommend this place to enjoy Antwerp.

Je ne peux que conseiller cet appartement idéalement situé en plein cœur d'Anvers. Cet appartement est particulièrement agréable et très bien équipé. Par ailleurs, la qualité de l'accueil et la disponibilité des hôtes sont remarquables. Merci pour cet excellent séjour.
Beautiful and clean apartment in a perfect location! Host is great to deal with
The reservation was canceled 9 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Sehr schöne Wohnung, sehr nette Gastgeber, sehr schnelle Schüsselübergabe, liegt mitten im Zentrum, .... Kann nur weiter empfehlen!

Het was geweldig om hier te verblijven! Het appartement is net zo mooi als het er op de foto's uit ziet. Prachtig opgeknapt en voorzien van alle gemakken. Het ligt op 1 minuut lopen van de restaurants in het centrum (Groenplaats) en 5 minuten lopen van de winkels. De communicatie met Mara en Winny van AchA verliep goed. Ze waren heel flexibel en erg behulpzaam.

We spent 2 nights in this nice apartment in a very old and charming building on the top floor. Winny gave us a warm welcome and showed us everything in this newly renovated flat. It is situated perfectly for every traveller, as it is in the center of the old town of Antwerp and everything is right around the corner. We enjoyed our stay and were happy to have a place to stay at the very center of Antwerp - Thank you!
Prachtig appartement, goede lokatie in hartje Antwerpen. Hartelijke ontvangst.

Simply superb!
Lovely appartment situated in the heart of the Antwerpen city center. A perfect location to discover Antwerp's lovely center.

Perfectly restored to the highest standards whilst keeping the original vintage atmosphere alive. Excellent beds, fully equipped kitchen, spacious seating and dining area.

Winnie the landlord was very friendly, helpful and flexible.
Unfortunately we could only stay for one night but we will certainly be back for a longer stay!

Erg fijn appartement midden in de stad! Perfect om een paar nachten met vriendinnen door te brengen. Het is ruim, ziet er mooi uit en bevindt zich op een leuke locatie. De gastheer was vriendelijk en behulpzaam, en ook van tevoren was het contact goed. Zeker aan te raden!
Really nice remodel in a classic building with great views. Definitely would stay again.

Winny was absolutely wonderful to my family and I when we stayed here. There was complimentary coffee and wine upon arrival and he gave us recommendations for the best places to eat and drink. He was there to meet us and made sure that if we needed anything we had his phone number. The apartment is located in the historic centre of the city with a view of the cathedral. Everything was clean and more than comfortable! Needless to say I will try to have all my visitors stay here when they come and visit! Would recommend this place to everyone! I sing my praises about AchA!

Winnie was a great host. Very welcoming and was glad to work around our arrangements. The apartment is simply incredible. The pictures don't do it justice. The apartment is very close walking distance a lot of stores and bars/restaurant. I'll be staying here again.

Het appartement is prachtig! Mooie authentieke vloeren en goede mix tussen authentiek en nieuw interieur.
De locatie is perfect. Super centraal, bij de Groenplaats en bijvoorbeeld het Mode Museum.
De ontvangst en communicatie met Winny was erg prettig.
Jammer dat we er maar een nacht verbleven. Echt een aanrader!

Prettige ontvangst door zeer vriendelijke eigenaar . De beschrijving van het appartement klopt helemaal met de site, prachtig opgeknapt met behoud van karakteristieke details en kraakhelder . Midden in het centrum maar toch een oase van rust met uitzicht op de kathedraal , kortom een aanrader !

A wonderful experience from the start to the end. Had very good communication with Mara and Winny in preparation for the stay and during we were there. Winny was very helpful and kind.
The apartment was absolutely beautiful and clean. The views of the city from the top floor bedroom were stunning.
Great way to enjoy and feel Antwerp style!

It was wonderful to stay in this beautiful, very tasteful and lovely renovated apartment located right in the centre with views to the cathedral for instance, over some Antwerp roofs and the alley on the other side. We felt very much at home and would love to come back! Thank you very much.
Greetings, Caroline.

Perfecte locatie, midden in het oude centrum van Antwerpen. De markt is 100m lopen en veel restaurantjes en leuke cafés om de hoek. Heel mooi en netjes appartement. Vriendelijke en behulpzame verhuurder. Echt een aanrader voor een bezoekje aan Antwerpen!! Wij komen graag nog een keer terug!

A truly stunning apartment in a fantastic location!
We had a wonderful stay in the beautiful city of Antwerp and this apartment was the cherry on top. Everything you need is provided, the place is immaculate and extremely comfortable it's also very quiet given its central location.
A few steps from the Cathedral of Our Lady, the Grote Markt and a plethora of restaurants and bars the location couldn't be better!
Winny welcomed us, showed us around the apartment and gave us a couple of restaurant suggestions, he and Mara also live nearby so are easily reached if needed.
Thank you Winny and Mara, we hope to see you again!

Ontzettend gastvrije mensen en super net authentiek appartement! De badkamer en keuken waren volgens mij net nieuw. Heel gaaf uitzicht op de kathedraal, kon echt niet beter. Tevens zijn we zeer tevreden over de locatie, midden in het centrum en allemaal heerlijke restaurants. Als je de straat van het appartement inloopt komt de heerlijke tapasgeur je tegemoet.. We hebben heel erg genoten.

We had a great stay. The hosts were very welcoming and attentive. A beautiful apartment, clean, comfortable and light. Brilliant location, right in the centre of town, lively in the evening and peaceful in the morning, the sound of the carrilon adding to the charm and the sense of place. The architectural style, the interior design, the view and vicinity of the cathedral really make you feel you're in Flanders. A very authentic experience!
And, like the apartment, the city of Antwerp very successfully mixes the historic and the contemporary, with plenty of opportunity to opt for non-touristy alternatives: independent shops, characterful eating places, thought-provoking art displays, etc.

In één woord: super!
Zowel qua ontvangst, locatie, comfort, hygiëne, appartement....eigenlijk alles! Michel

We were 4 women travelling together (leaving behind our husbands and children for a few days) meeting our good friend who now lives in Brussels. The appt was wonderful and we all agreed that it made our weekend. Although we were 5 there was plenty of room and it is obvious that Mara and Winny have put an awful lot of love and attention into every detail and were extremely welcoming. The exposed beams, original winding staircase, fully equipped kitchen, lovely bathroom, views of the cathedral - I could go on.
This is the first time I have used Airbnb and I can only hope that all my experiences are as fantastic as this. Many thanks

We were delayed 6 hrs by Eurostar and only pitched up past midnight in Antwerp - Winnie waited up to let us in and met us with a smile. He was so helpful and considerate - he deserves a medal! The flat was perfect, central but not noisy, bright and comfortable and with some nice views, a relaxing haven at the end of a busy day's sightseeing. We enjoyed Antwerp very much - please go the The Red Star Line Museum and eat at Le Zoute Zoen. On our last morning Winnie drove us to the station, typical of his kindly thoughtfulness.
Overall a great experience. So much more than a hotel!
Good host, lovely appartement.

This was my first stay using Air BnB and boy did the owners and the property set the bar high!  The owners are so gracious and accommodating.  The location for Antwerp is definitely in the middle of the action but is on a quiet street that provides peace in the middle of the city.  The house inside is STUNNING and the views are amazing.  We were on a two week vacation and traveling with only a carry on suitcase so the washer/dryer combo came in so handy.  We like the property so much that when we return to Antwerp we will schedule our vacation around availability for this specific house.

I am incredibly grateful to y hosts for making my week-long stay in Antwerp a wonderful experience! The apartment is wonderfully situated in the heart of old Antwerp and has everything one could need. It is beautifully decorated and very comfortable. The hosts were very attentive and helpful throughout my stay. I would certainly recommend staying in this apartment!

This is a lovely apartment in the centre of Antwerp, on a fairly quiet side street but within hearing of the cathedral bells and chimes -- our daytimes indoors were punctuated by this lovely sound! The apartment is excellent: plenty of space and spotlessly clean, and very well equipped. It has been really well renovated, so it's modern but it has lots of very old features too -- really charming. There's lots of places to eat nearby, and many sights are within a 10-15 minute walk or less. My sister and I were more than happy with our stay, and the very friendly hosts, and I'd warmly recommend the apartment.

We have been a long weekend in Antwerp early August 2015 staying at Winny's appartment. The house has been restored beautifully and has everything you might need. Large enough for 4 people while the location could not be better. Everything is on walking distance and Pelgrimsstraat is a cosy street indeed. Winny is easy accessible though we only met him when arriving and leaving: no need since all was fine. Would definately use Winny's place again and can't recommend it enough.

Beautifully restored and perfectly equipped Appartement in the Heart of the City.

Very nice host, but if you are travelling by car, its cheaper not to accept his offer to reserve a parking place. He sent us to a public parking garage 2 minutes from the appartement and at the end, we payd him more than the regular rate would have been.

Winny was very kind and friendly that he helped us a lot with our big luggage. His house is very very clean, beautiful and spacious for 4-6 people! It is lovely and the location couldn't be any better. It is walking distance to the attractions and many great restaurants and shops. The kitchen is very well-equipped that you have everything you need to prepare a meal. I am sorry that I broke a soup bowl and Winny was very kind to tell me not tow worry about it when I offered to pay him back. As a side note, the wifi works great.

We have never been to an apartment in Europe (we travel to Europe every year) that wonderful and clean. I have very expectation with lodging and Winny's place exceeds my high standard. We enjoyed our staying and felt like home :) I would highly recommend his apartment and would definitely come again to when we come to Antwerp the next time. Thank you Winny!
Prachtig appartement in een hele leuke buurt. Het was perfect schoon.

What an amazing experience we had in Antwerp! We were greeted outside by our wonderful host, who showed us up and gave us a tour of the apartment, and how to use everything in it. He also pointed out many of the original/historical elements of the home, which we loved. Much appreciated hospitality! Easy check in / check out, great communication. As for the apartment itself, we feel so lucky to have gotten the chance to stay there. It was beautiful inside and outside – we were steps from an abundance of places to go - museums, restaurants, bars, shops, and of course the gorgeous cathedral. My favorite part of the apartment was the breathtaking view of the cathedral from the skylight. Convenient to have laundry in the apartment, and loved the luxurious bath. Overall awesome time, really hope we get to stay here again in the future. Thanks so much!

STUNNING house - absolutely beautiful. Very thoughtful touches and wonderfully presented. The house was perfect for the 3 of us, very spacious with privacy. The location is perfect and within walking distance to many sights. Winny is incredibly kind and generous with local recommendations and history. We could've stayed much much longer. Highly recommended.

A beautiful apartment! Completely renovated and loads of old details. Clean, spacious, has everything you need and the location couldn't be better. The owner was very friendly and it was easy to communicate with him. We would like to stay here again!

As the photos suggest, entering this apartment--more a townhouse--will have you happily gasping at its architectural perfection (the host is an architect, among other pursuits), preserved antiquity, and modern comforts. You'll wish you could host dinners at the big wooden dining room table or put up friends in the extra beds in addition to your generous upstairs master bed. Meals you prepare on the kitchen's beautiful stone counters can also be eaten at a matching table, as you enjoy the light from three huge double windows looking out on 17th-century buildings along this notable street. The bath is brightened by a skylight, which brings out the texture of the lovely tile walls. Downstairs, there's an extra room with a desk and convertible couch. Lovely views out the back windows.
The great squares begin a block away; grocery shopping at a Carrefour is about three blocks distance.
Perhaps best of all is the grace and geniality of the host (and his wife), a soft-spoken man of culture and passion for his city and country. Living next door, he appears in minutes when you need him, and seems always willing to offer tips and opinions on local offerings when asked.

beautiful appartment in the city center, very clean, well-equipped, friendly host, perfect for our weekend in Antwerp!! might be quite warm in summer and a bit of noise from the lively street at weekend nights.

Winny's place is wonderful. By far the most visually appealing Airbnb I've ever stayed at. Everything is beautifully renovated and in perfect working condition. Or host was very welcoming and accommodating and quick to respond to all communication. The location is ideal--just steps from the center of Antwerp's Old Town with great restaurants and sight-seeing.

Vi var en langhelg i Antwerpen i oktober og ble godt tatt i mot av verten. Aller første gang vi har brukt AirBnB og alt gikk etter planen. Flott leilighet, rent og trivelig, og oppe i master bedroom var det stille selv om leiligheten ligger midt i byen. Mange gode restauranter og hyggelige kafeer rett rundt hjørnet.

This apartment is amazing.  The location is great. The place is beautiful and clean, with all the amenities you could want- washer/dryer, coffee maker etc. The host is very nice too and provided us with a list of good restaurants in the area.  It was overall an excellent experience.
Mooi appartement midden in Antwerpen. Super lokatie. Zeer schoon. Keuken met alles erop en eraan. Schitterend 16e eeuws pand maar met alle moderne gemakken.

My colleague and I were traveling for work and we were looking for something beyond the same old hotel rooms.  The apartment was even better than the pictures and Old Town was a great place to be!  We were positioned right near the beautiful cathedral, close to restaurants and shops.  Winny was there when we arrived to help us park and gave us great recommendations to nearby restaurants.  It was a great experience! I highly recommend it.

Wat hebben we genoten van ons verblijf in het appartement. Schoon, mooie locatie in het geweldige centrum van Antwerpen, genoeg ruimte voor 4 personen en het appartement is helemaal af!
Winny is ook zeer behulpzaam en vriendelijk. We hopen snel weer eens terug te komen.

Can't be more central. Close to the cathedral, near nice restaurants and bars. Beautiful flat, calm and neat. Our host was adorable and helpful, he kept our luggages in his home on sunday time for us to have a last afternoon in the city. If you go to Anvers don't hesitate that's THE place.

This apartment is attractive, spotlessly clean and ideally located for all tourist attractions within the city of Antwerp.

Winny and Mara are ideal hosts and met us outside the apartment on the day of arrival to show us around, pointing out how everything works and how to get in touch with them should we have any further questions.

The apartment itself has all the usual mod cons you come to expect such as high-speed WiFi, worldwide cable TV, microwave, conventional oven, washer/dryer, refrigerator etc. The bedrooms are comfortable and all windows have the added luxury of blackout blinds for those sunny mornings where you'd like to lie in!

The decor is to a very high standard with some antique furniture to give the modern whitewashed walls a more authentic look.

Location-wise, it couldn't be more suitable. You are 30 seconds from the cathedral but down a quiet side street so away from any tourist noise...we pretty much walked everywhere while we were there and nothing seemed too far.

I would recommend this apartment to any couple or small family looking for a short break in a great city. I would not recommend this apartment to anyone with mobility problems as the stairs up to and within the apartment are quite steep and narrow and there is no lift available.

I would definitely return to this apartment if returning to Antwerp and would also certainly recommend to my friends and family.
Excellent location, very clean and unique apartment. No complaints whatsoever!
winny is an elegant host and the appt is fabulous.

Mara and Winny were excellent throughout and gave us a brilliant introduction to the flat/local surroundings. They both make brilliant guests and the appartment was amazing - brilliantly decorated and very homely. Location was very central situated in the heart of the city close to historical architecture and bars/restaurants.

Het appartement is super, schoon en comfortabel. De locatie is top.
Winny en zijn dochter hebben ons goed ontvangen.

I had a fantastic stay at Winny´s absolutely beautiful apartment.
The apartment is perfect situated at the beautiful old city center and it´s absolutely quiet.
The flat is even a bit more beautiful that at the pictures and it was very clean. I stood there for 3 nights and really enjoyed it.
The communication with Winny was really easy and he´s an adorable host.
If you like spanish food you have to visit is tapas restaurant next door!
I can absolutely recommend this apartment and hope to come to this beautiful place again.

We had some fantastic days in this wonderful apartment right in the middle of old city of Antwerp. Our host was very nice and helpful, both to share tips on restaurants and to accommodate our requests. The apartment is very fresh and even nicer than shown on the pictures. It has got everything you need, even charm. Warmly recommended.
Prima plek, prima welkom, prachtig appartement, brand schoon!!!

Prachtig gerestaureerd appartement op een fantastisch plekje midden in het centrum van Antwerpen, het straalt volkomen de sfeer van de stad uit, een mix van mooi oud en praktisch nieuw. Het is ruim, zeer compleet uitgerust en super schoon. De ontvangst door Winny was bijzonder hartelijk. We willen hier nog zeker terugkomen en kunnen het ten zeerste aanbevelen.
We had a very pleasant stay in a marvelous 5plus!-star apartment. Absolutely neat. Every household equipment available. Nice view on the cathedral. Obliging host. Lovely city. Everything perfect.
Een prachtig appartement voorzien van alle gemakken, midden in het gezellige centrum van Antwerpen. We hebben met z'n vieren een heerlijk weekend gehad!
I stayed here for a week while I was working in Antwerp. The flat was lovely, clean, warm and well located. Check in, check out and communication was excellent, as was the host.

Everything was great! We were met on time by our host and instructed about parking and then shown the apartment. Great central location within walking distance of many major sites. The pictures give a very accurate image of the apartment which is beautiful. The beds were very comfortable and all appliances worked. We did accidentally blow a fuse which was fixed within 30 minutes by the host. Our host had at restaurant recommendations as well. The only negative of our stay was a shorted out ceiling light in one bedroom due to a slight leak from recent heavy rains which the host was planning to fix as soon as we left. Overall highly commended!

We had a great time at Winny's apartment. The apartment is very well done and just as you see in the pictures. The kitchen was fully equipped for making food at the apartment but the location is also great if you want to eat out. There are restaurants literally on the doorstep (including a great Tapas place we tried) and there are many other places within walking distance. It is also a good location for getting to museums and other attractions. Being on the top floor the apartment is quiet despite being in the centre of things. Winny was a very friendly host, meeting us at the apartment and recommended places to go etc. Would definitely recommend it as a place to stay.

Es war eine hervorragende Unterkunft mit tollen Vermietern.
Zentral gelegen im historischen Zentrum von Antwerpen.
Parkmöglichkeit durch den Vermieter im nahen Parkhaus.
Die Unterkunft ist absolut zu empfehlen.

It is an excellent apartement with very friendly host.
Location in the central old city of Antwerp.
Offered parking place in a parking house by the host is very closed to the apartement .
For a stay in Antwerp we would recommend it.
Makkelijk telefonisch te bereiken, stond klaar met sleutels en zeer uitgebreide uitleg.

This apartment is perfectly located in the old centre of Antwerp. It was immaculately clean and had all the facilities you could need for your stay. The host was very welcoming and was on hand to deal with any queries. I would recommend this apartment for a short stay in Antwerp.
Had a fantastic stay with Winny and Mara.  The apartment is beautiful and well equipped with everything you could possibly need.  The location is superb and extremely convenient.
Really beautiful flat in the center of antwerp ! Winny and Mara are great hosts!

Квартира очень понравилась. Чистая, с хорошим дизайном. Лестницы в доме и квартире шокировали, но это с непривычки.
Самый центр. Иногда казалось, что просыпаешься на Красной площади.

Het appartement is prachtig; net zoals op de foto's. Perfect gelegen midden in het centrum. Allemaal fijne restaurantjes in de straat. De bedden zijn ook heel goed. De bovenverdieping is sowieso geweldig. Vanuit bad kijk je zo op de kathedraal.
Parkeren kan om de hoek. Misschien kun je beter gewoon zelf betalen dan het kaartje van de verhuurders gebruiken; dat eerste is weliswaar 1 of 2 euro duurder per dag maar scheelt wel wat gedoe. Dan hoef je niet eerst het kaartje op te halen om in te rijden en weer terug te brengen na uitrijden.
Het enige minpuntje (en dat is in veel verhuurappartementen zo): er mag wel iets meer sfeerlicht zijn in de woonkamer.
Maar we zouden hier zeker terugkomen en iedereen dit huis aanraden. Het is echt heel comfortabel en perfectere locatie kan niet.

This was possibly the nicest Airbnb place I've ever stayed in -- especially at the price. An incredible mix of original architectural features, modern appointments, well-stocked cabinets, and interesting views from every window. Plus, the location is great for exploring many parts of Antwerp; you're right around the corner from the cathedral and close to everything else -- including a great, local genever bar just down the alley. Plus, Winny was a great host. He gave us a tour of the apartment and sent us loads of information on the neighborhood and which restaurants to check out (and which to avoid).

Tolle, offene und helle Wohnung mitten im Zentrum. Voll augestattete Küche und großes helles Bad mit extra WC. Alles ist sehr gut zu Fuß zu erreichen. Direkt um die Ecke befinden sich Cafés,  Restaurants, etc. Der Parkplatz, den man zusätzlich buchen kann, ist auch um die Ecke. Die Wohnung ist sehr zu empfehlen!

Such a lovely apartment! Old building, charmingly restored but with modern appointments. Clean and tidy. Very spacious with lots of room. All beds were very comfortable with nice linen. Great having two toilets. Very central, close to train station, restaurants and shops however still quiet. Heating efficient. Antwerp is a lovely city and I encourage everyone to visit. We had an easy day trip to Ghent, Brugge and were able to get the bus easily to Brussels airport (45 mins). We felt the owners took great pride in their apartment and were very house proud. Highly recommend.

The apartment was great. Everything was in great shape and the furnishings and decor all felt high quality. The apartment also felt very central in Antwerp. There were a ton of great restaurants and sites within a short walk (sometimes just right out the door).

Winny was great too. He walked us through the whole apartment and gave us his recommended list of local restaurants, which were all great. If I'm ever back in Antwerp, I'd definitely stay again!

Het was ons tweede verblijf in dit schitterende appartement.
En dit zal zeker niet de laatste keer zijn!
Dank je Winny en Mara voor een perfecte weekend!

Mara's and Winny's apartment is simply gorgeous! It was such a pleasure to stay in this outstanding place. Mara and Winny were wonderful and caring hosts, they provided us with restaurant recommendations and helped us with a parking space.

We will come back for sure! Thank you so much for everything!
Winny and Mara were reliable and friendly hosts. The flat is fantastic, it is very clean, comfortable and the ideal location. We enjoyed our stay so much that we will be coming back to stay!

The apartment was really beautiful; I felt like I was in a medieval castle, the kind of place you pay 15 EUR entrance fee to look round! The floor and ceilings were beautiful wood, clearly lovingly restored by the owners.

The furnishings had also been carefully chosen to fit in with this – the dining table with its chairs made me think of a group of knights having dinner together!

All the modern conveniences were there too. The brand new bathroom is tastefully designed with a huge roof window, so nice and bright. The modern kitchen had everything we might have needed to cook, but unfortunately our short stay (2 nights) did not really merit shopping and cooking other than for breakfast. It would be a perfect place for a longer stay too.

The location was unbeatable, bang in the middle of the old town. There were plenty of bars and restaurants of all varieties just a few steps away. We really liked sitting outside the bar next door, with delicious local beer. The tapas bar on the ground floor in the same building as the apartment was a good place for dinner (very busy, so worth booking in advance).

We used the parking which Winny recommended, and that was ideal too.

Winny and his wife were charming and helpful, and answered all our questions. We will definitely stay here again if we come back to Antwerp, and also absolutely recommend this apartment.

Many thanks for a great weekend!

Clean, calm, comfortable, well-equipped and spacious apartment in an old house restored with great care and perfectly situated in the historic centre of Antwerp. We were warmly welcomed by Winny, who waited for us on the street and even carried one of our suitcases upstairs (and downstairs again when we left). Highly recommended.
The listing was accurately described and the host was on hand if we needed anything.

Position,position,position!In the very heart of this great city of Antwerp we found this stunning second floor (Website hidden by Airbnb) decorated with a mix of antique  and modern furniture . Luxurious  bed linen an unexpected bonus.We were met at the door to the apartment by our host Winnie,who very kindly carried our suitcases up the two sets of rather steep (Website hidden by Airbnb) above a Tapas Bar we had expected a fair bit of noise,but our fears were unfounded.

This apartment's location is ideal for visitors to Antwerp, in the middle of the historical Cathedral and Grand Place neighborhood. Some really good restaurants are just steps away. The apartment is quite spacious and the kitchen very modern.
If you have a car you do want to make arrangements with the host for a parking spot in a parking garage which is located nearby.
Un bon accueil dans ce superbe appartement en plein centre. Décoré avec goût, propreté irréprochable, un magnifique appartement duquel visiter toute la ville.

We have stayed at the studio apartments here on a couple of occasions and always return because it is so comfortable, spotless and well equipped, on this occasion it was not available so we chose to stay at the larger apartment above. We were delighted with it, this is exceptionally beautiful, spacious, well equipped and comfortable for 2 to 5 people. We had a fantastic 4 days, the location of the apartment is brilliant to get around the city, the facilities superb. We will return here again and again. The host does not cut corners this apartment is a superb high standard home from home, worth every penny. Thank you for everything.
un accueil agréable et très courtois dans ce magnifique appartement restauré avec goût au coeur du centre historique.

Winny and Maras apartment was beautiful, the decor and finishings were so lovely that we were sad we hardly spent any time there. The location is great (on top of amazing restaurants), and within easy walking distance to everything you'd want to see and do. I am already planning my next trip back!

This was a really terrific place to stay.  We were very centrally located in the most lovely historic quarter of Antwerp.  We could walk everywhere.  The place itself was spotless and very beautiful.  Winny spent time with us checking we had all we needed and also providing insight into the history of the city.

Die Wohnung ist der perfekte Ort um Antwerpen zu entdecken. Mittendrin und alles ist fußläufig zu erreichen.
Um die Ecke ist ein Parkhaus, wo wir bequem parken konnten. Dort hat uns unser Host auch in Empfang genommen.
Ich würde die Wohnung immer wieder buchen. Selten so eine saubere Airbnb- Wohnunh gehabt. Toll!

O apartamento é lindo, amplo, limpo, confortável, silencioso e super bem localizado! Fica a uma quadra do metrô, ônibus e do Supermercado Carrefour. Noitredame e Groet Market ficam na rua de trás do apartamento, além de muitos bares e restaurantes! O ponto turístico mais afastado (Museu MAS) fica a 1 km. A distância até a estação central é 1.6 km. A esposa do Anfitrião, Ruth, foi sempre muito simpática e prestativa. Certamente recomendo este apartamento e anfritrião a todos os usuários do AirBnb.

Een prachtig en comfortabel appartement dat met liefde en smaak is ingericht. De hoogte, de authentieke balken, goede bedden, volledig uitgeruste keuken, ruime luxueuze badkamer en mooie houten vloeren maken dit appartement bijzonder. Een plek waar je je direct thuis voelt. De locatie is fantastisch, middenin het centrum en in een straatje vol leuke cafeetjes, restaurantjes en winkeltjes. Wij komen zeker terug!
L'appartement était très bien placé et très agréable. La literie parfaite et l'ensemble hyper propre. Winny, très disponible. Rien a redire sur notre sejour!
Winnie was a very kind host. His house is very well decorated and cozy. Perfect for a romantic get-away or a week-end with friends!

Der Gastgeber hat uns sehr freundlich empfangen und uns auch angeboten ein Stadtrundgang zu organisieren.

sehr zuvorkommend!
We Recommend this place for anyone! We had such a nice time over Christmas staying in this lovely apartment and we'd definitely do it again.

The apartment is situated in the most beautiful place in the old town of Antwerp. It looks exactly like the pictures. Everything is super clean, the interior is Individual, cosy and modern. In Mara and Winny's Apartment you'll feel like Home!

Het was werkelijk TOP!
Met dank aan Winy en zijn team.
Amazing house, and perfect host. The location is simply perfect for exploring beautiful Antwerp and everything at hand. We strongly recommend this house, we will repeat for sure.
Top locatie, prachtig appartement met alles er op en er aan!

Prachtige locatie en appartement. Appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien. Ruim opgezet, schone en grote badkamer en complete keuken. De bedden lagen heerlijk!
1 verbeterpunt; de douche kan niet op sta-hoogte worden opgehangen. Verder zouden wij hier zeker terugkomen!

We had a wonderful stay in this beautifully decorated and comfortable apartment. It was a perfect spot for our family, an excellent location, and had all the amenities we needed. It truly is a perfect spot in the center of Antwerp, we would highly recommend it and would certainly return to stay here again.
Top.
This is the perfect place to stay if you want a home away from home on your trip to Antwerp. Central to the sites and very walkable to shops, restaurants, and public transit. Beautiful home!

We had a wonderful stay in Antwerp. I don't think you could find a better location to stay. There are some great restaurants in the same street. Parking is very close by. The apartment has great views and was very quiet. I can definitely recommend it and if I was going to stay in Antwerp again, this is where it would be.
Geweldig appartement op toplocatie. Voor herhaling vatbaar.

We had a great time at this amazing flat. It was perfect for our family city break with our one year old.

The flat is in a great central location, close to all the major sights (although you're never too far from anything in a small city like Antwerp). It is in immaculate condition, bright and airy. Despite the central location, any street noise didn't carry into the flat.

The flat had a well stocked kitchen in terms of dishes and cooking utensils, which was great for us as we cooked in meals.

They also had a cot for the baby, which is not advertised, but worked a treat for us.

Communication with Winny was responsive, and contact when we arrived was great. He's super friendly and gave some good tips.

I would not hesitate to recommend this flat. We loved it!

Leuk appartement, ruime woon- en (Website hidden by Airbnb) boven een tapasbar (die ook echt aan te raden is), maar daar heb je geen last van. Recht in het hart van Antwerpen, met de winkelstraten en alle toeristische trekpleisters binnen wandelafstand. Vriendelijke eigenaars heten je welkom en geven je een duidelijke uitleg. Voor herhaling vatbaar!!

Dit was de 2e keer dat we bij Winny en Mara zijn geweest. Super locatie, alles is te belopen. Erg fijn dat er nu een 2e tweepersoonsbed was beneden. Alles in de keuken aanwezig zodat je ook zelf een avond kan koken. Wederom een erg fijn verblijf gehad!
Our host was extremely helpful, and made us feel very welcomed. It is a lovely apartment in a fantastic location. We will be returning again.

AchA is a beautifully restored apartment In a convenient neighborhood of Antwerp. Our host, Winny, responded quickly to emailed questions and was most helpful in carrying out bags up and down the typically steep steps of the apartment. The apartment was well equipped and very clean, conveniently located for walking to see the sights, and close to many restaurants. Great experience for first-time visitors to Antwerp!
Gretchen
Great location, lots of nice cafes, bars and restaurants right on the doorstep. Cool interior with lots of original features.

Winny, the host, is a very kind and engaging gentleman who met us at the door when we arrived, walked us through the whole apartment, showed us all the amenities, and provided great local food suggestions. He was very easily reached and responsive the rest of our stay for a great, hassle-free experience. The apartment is truly stunning and it in and of itself seemed worth the trip to Antwerp, let alone its central location in a beautiful city, right down the street from the cathedral, with a fantastic tapas restaurant right next store and everything within walking distance. Highly recommend!

This was a great place to stay for our few days in Antwerp. Communication with Winny and Mara was good thoughout, and they were waiting for us when we arrived to let us in and show us around.  The apartment is beautiful with lovely furniture. Highly recommended
We really enjoyed our stay. The location was fantastic, the apartment was beautiful and the owner was very accommodating.  Would definitely stay again.

Eine charaktervolle Wohnung mit hochwertigem Mobiliar, einer sehr gut ausgestatteten Küche und modernem Bad. Sie befindet sich in der Altstadt, zentral, wenige Schritte von der Kathedrale entfernt. Der Vermieter war stets erreichbar und kommunikativ, An- und Abreise unproblematisch.
Die engen und steilen Treppen des Altbaus stellten für uns kein Problem dar, könnten aber für Menschen mit Gehbehinderung schwierig zu bewältigen sein. Auch von schwerem oder sperrigem Gepäck ist abzuraten.
Das enge Gässchen ist voll von Gastronomie, was natürlich zu einem gewissen Geräuschpegel führt. Wir fühlten uns aber nicht im mindesten gestört, denn die Fenster schließen dicht und ab Mitternacht herrschte Ruhe auf den Strassen.
A propos Gastronomie: das Vietnamesische Restaurant schräg gegenüber hat uns besonders gefallen!

Exactly like the pictures (you basically feel like you're staying in a museum because it's so antique and beautiful).  Very clean too...walked around barefoot and my feet were totally clean.  RIGHT in the center of town too! We arrived to get the key to check in, and he met us within five minutes.  He then showed us how everything worked in the apartment in a nice and quick manner.  This apartment is on the second floor (American third floor) and is up some typical Belgian stairs (a beautiful plus for me, but for some w bad knees, maybe not?). Anyways, PERFECT experience:)!!
Very beautiful apartment and worth to stay. My parents really loved this antique apartment. Hope i can visit this place again.

Wij hebben een heerlijk weekend in Antwerpen gehad in dit prachtige appartement. De ontvangst was zeer vriendelijk. We hebben genoten van een erg mooi en compleet ingericht huis (volledig ingerichte keuken met nespresso-apparaat, veel serviesgoed en glaswerk, vaatwastabletten, afwasmiddel, mooi opgemaakte bedden, fijne badlakens). Alles is super schoon en met zorg onderhouden. Wij komen graag terug.

Its a great place to stay at. It is beautiful, very comfortable and with a nice neighbourhood. Town centre just 5 minutes away and cafes right down the apartment. The host is very kind and is always available for any help.

Our stay was very pleasant and would love to book it again on our next visit to Antwerp.
Die zentrale Lage und die komfortable Ausstattung der Wohnung hat uns besonders gut gefallen.
Great apartment in a perfect central location within an easy walkable distance to surrounding sights! We really enjoyed our stay. Thank you for having us :-)

Stop searching! This place is perfect.
Perfect for location too.

A really great place to stay. The flat was elegant, comfortable, well equipped and beautifully kept. The location is great for the old town and convenient for other areas of the city. Host helpful, friendly and informative. Recommended.
Great location, easy to communicate with host, very accommodating, well appointed and convenient, beautiful place.

Wiinny and Mara were fantastic hosts and their apartment is central, quiet, comfortable and beautiful. When we needed an iron or had problems with anything Winny sent someone or helped us immediately.

This place is a gem! Historic with incredible, modern upgrades (the bathroom is gorgeous). Location was amazing...you can walk anywhere (shopping districts, cathedral, train station). You can't turn around without running into a cute bistro or restaurant or cafe! Open up the large balcony windows and let the beautiful, bustling outside world inside the apartment! The bed is heavenly. I slept 9 hours each night! This place is not only a safe bet, it's a sure thing! You will not be disappointed!!
What an amazing unit in the middle of an amazing city!!! Winny & Ruth were ultra communicative and flexible!

This is the most beautiful apartment I've ever stayed in. The owners have done a lovely job of restoring and decorating it. It's close to many bars, restaurants, and attractions, but was surprisingly quiet. The only problem during our stay was that I slipped and fell on the painted timber stairs in the apartment - be careful!

Erg goed gelegen. Goede ontvangst.
Mogelijkheid tot dichtbij parkeren.
Ruim appartement.

What an incredible find! Best location in the city, beautifully decorated and so comfortable that we wished we had more time just to stay in and enjoy the apartment.  The owner, Winnie,  was beyond helpful and kind to us. Highly recommend and would definitely stay here again .

This apartment is everything and more than the description provided. It is truly charming, well appointed and comfortable. The checkin was a breeze and easy to communicate with Winny. Upon arrival we found the apartment meticulously clear. There is a nice washer/dryer combo and one that actually dries the clothes completely.  The kitchen is also well stocked. One thing to note is that the apartment is two flights up on steep Belgian stairs and then another floor up to the main bedroom once you're in the apartment.  For us it was no problem but important to know for those with difficulties climbing.  That said, Iwill gladly stay here again on my next visit to Antwerp.

Een fijn appartement in Antwerpen! Vooral de ligging is geweldig, centraler kan het niet. We hadden zondagnacht wel last van iemand die verderop in de stad een luidruchtig feestje vierde maar de kinderen sliepen er gelukkig goed doorheen. Op doordeweekse dag is het appartement rustig. Goede bedden en ruim. Het ontvangst was ook prima. Heerlijke restaurants in de buurt maar je kan ook prima koken in het appartement. Kortom: het is leuk adres voor wie een keer Antwerpen wil verkennen.
The host canceled this reservation 23 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Very lovely appartment in the heart of the city.

What is there NOT to love about this apartment? It's gorgeous and in a fantastic location. We loved everything about it. It's just like the pictures if not better. The bathroom is amazing and I miss that tub. The owners are fantastic people. They held on to our bags when we had a later train which really made our experience that much better. It was wonderful to have several more hours to explore Antwerp without having to deal with luggage. Would highly recommend this place and would most certainly stay there again!

Wunderschönes Appartment mitten im Herzen von Antwerpen und mit Blick auf die Kathedrale. Man könnte keinen besseren Ausgangspunkt haben, um die Stadt (zu Fuß oder per Segway (Mietstation um die Ecke) oder per Rad (ebenfalls zu mieten an jeder Ecke) zu erkunden. Restaurants, Boutiquen, Cocktailbars, Szeneviertel - alles in unmittelbarer Nähe. Das Appartment ist tipptopp gepflegt, Bäder und Küche neu und schön und bestens ausgestattet, alles extrem gepflegt, bis hin zu duftenden Handtüchern. Ein interessanter Mix aus alten und modernen Möbeln, wirklich eine tolle, ganz besondere Unterkunft. Zudem sehr angenehme Vermieter - Empfehlung auf ganzer Linie!

AchA was an amazing host, had great communication through out the trip, and provided great knowledge of the area. The flat was comfortable and elegant as well as was located in a great part of town.
This will be a first location we will seek out when visiting Antwerpen again.

Een prachtig ruim, schoon, licht en mooi gedecoreerd appartement in een leuke wijk van Antwerpen! Op loopafstand vind je tal van leuke boutiques, cafeetjes en restaurantjes. Absolute aanrader voor 'n weekendje Antwerpen!

We really enjoyed our stay in the apartment, the location was ideal for exploring the Christmas markets, as they were only a 2 minute walk away. The apartment was very clean and tidy and well equiped with everything that we needed. The parking that is offered is very handy and only a couple of minutes walk away. There are plenty of good restaurants in easy walking distance making this a great place to stay.

Stylish apartment, perfectly located near the cathedral. Well maintained with everything you need to either relax and cook-in or head out to restaurants, shopping districts and beautiful sights. A warm and friendly host. Thanks Winnie.

The apartment is in an amazing position, close to the cathedral, square and fabulous restaurants.  Winny and Ruth have a beautiful apartment, spotlessly clean with everything that we needed.  Winny was a great host and we would highly recommend that you stay here, you will not be disappointed.  Thank you for making our break memorable.
Prachtig appartement, geweldige locatie, vriendelijke eigenaar, super schoon. Geweldig verblijf gehad!

I wish I could rate this Airbnb higher than 5/5. This two storey apartment dating from the 16 century is elegantly decorated and well located. Winny and Ruth were exceptional hosts and went out of their way to make our trip extra special. They were quick to respond to messages and were able to accommodate our late arrival. If you are in Antwerp to celebrate a special occasion let the hosts know as they also own a delicious tapas bar in the same building (we tried it and it was delicious). I would recommend staying here to anyone and look forward to returning to Antwerp  :) thank you Winny and Ruth for the amazing experience!

This apartment is really beautiful and in the most perfect location. It is comfortable and stylish and had everything we needed. Walking out and straight into the lovely streets was amazing. We would definitely recommend this place and stay here again!

Wonderful apartment in a fantastic and easy location. The stairs are a little steep, but well worth the little effort. The apartment is clean and nicely decorated, with some nice old pieces of furniture, Tyler are lovely beams and the restoration of the apartment is very nice. The kitchen is well equipped and also clean. The plus is a washer dryer in a downstairs toilet room which was great for us. The views of the church clock tower from the bath are quite special! The hosts have been very helpful and given a quick response.
We had no issues and really enjoyed our time.
Thank you
Perfect location...clean, huge, quiet, amazing apartment with a wonderful host!

Everything about this apartment is wonderful! Winny and Ruth have thought of everything to make for a perfect visit to Antwerp, and couldn’t be more welcoming and helpful. As mentioned, the beds are very comfortable (our family of 4 adults had plenty of space), and the entire apartment has such a warm and cozy feel. It’s one of those places you hate to leave and can’t wait to come back to!
Prachtig gelegen, schitterend historisch pand en voldoet aan alle verwachtingen
Luxury!  You won’t want to leave.

Loved staying at this apartment. Location is superb. We drove in from the airport. Winny provided a parking card to Parking Brabo, which is very close, for a discounted daily rate. Winny is fabulous, charming, very helpful and quick in all required comms.  The apartment is chic and views are lovely. The upstairs bed was super comfortable, kitchen and living room are well equipped and relaxing. As others may have noted, the stairwell to the apt is a bit steep, 2 flights. We still managed to bring up a 27kg bike box. Also, there is flight up to the master bedroom. I would advise to walk barefoot or in shoes on the stairs, we slipped in our socks. But I’m rather clumsy so… Even still we would book this apartment again in a heartbeat. Highly recommend. Other notes, on Pelgrimstraat, we ate at TapaBar, excellent, had great cocktails at Jones, and lovely luncheon at ‘t Hofke located in an alley from 1591. Thank you W for a truly wonderful stay.
Beautifully restored, large, well appointed apartment in an ideal location. Good appliances, near shopping as well as monuments and historic sites. Owner is very helpful and responsive.

This apartment is perfect in every way.  The pictures are exactly what we experienced in addition there was another bedroom off the living room that would have been perfect for additional guests to sleep.  The host was very friendly and lives close by should he be needed.  The apartment was recently redone as all the facilities are new. The washer/dryer combination is very useful and allowed us to pack less for the trip.  The location to old town and the metro are perfect for commuting and sightseeing.  I can’t recommend this apartment enough and if returning I would definitely stay here again.  There are beds for 5 people and they would all be comfortable in the available space.

This is a great apartment right in the middle of the old town which is beautiful. Trams are very close, everything is walkable. There are cafes around every corner. It is a spacious lovely old apartment with a great whole top floor bed and bathroom. It is very quiet. Winny came personally to check us in which was very good. It is up 2 flights of steep windy steps which is pretty standard for old European buildings. Great place to stay.
Top locatie op loofafstand van de grote markt en de bezienswaardigheden. Zeer nette accommodatie met hele prettige communicatie met de verhuurders. Zeker een aanrader.

Prachtig appartement midden in het hartje van de oude stad. Het is prima gelegen, perfekt uitgerust met alles erop en deraan en alles in pico bello staat. En bovendien ook erg mooi, Vooral als je zoals ik van antiek houd (maar de keuken is heel modern wat dan nog eens een extra "cachet" geeft. Goede en vriendelijke ontvangts. We hebben een fantastich weekend gehad !

Want a perfect location for exploring the Antwerp, its night life, museums and more!  This is it! Beautifully decorated!  Authentically Belgium. Lovely amenities.  Hopping night life nearby.  Food options galore.  Sights within walking distance.  Can’t go wrong!  Check in/out is easy and Winnie was a great help with communication and suggestions!
A better location in Antwerp is hard to get. Top located and very well and charming equiped.

Wonderful stay close to attractions, shops, and restaurants. Beautiful old world charm with modern touches everywhere. Our perfect host Winny was very responsive and accommodating. With we could have stayed longer!

Great location. And Winny the owner was really great. The place is large by Europe standards. The only thing you should take into consideration is that the stairs are really steep by US standards and small like and a little ladderish, but I think you will find this in all the places in Antwerp. It was on the 2nd floor but that is 3rd floor US.

It was near all of the amazing restaurants and beauty of the old city. It’s a beautiful apartment, but you won’t want to spend time in it due to the beauty of Antwerp. The stairs are a bit tricky with luggage, but the host kindly helped me with my bag.

The apartment is beautiful, clean, and located in the heart of the old city. It is a 20 minute walk from the train station. I attended a conference near the train station and the apartment was a perfect choice. The neighborhood is very lively. The tapas restaurant directly below the apartment was wonderful. Winny the owner also recommended a local restaurant that serves Belgian food that was outstanding and very reasonably priced called De Bomma. The noise outside the apartment is a joyful noise of people having a wonderful time talking. The bedrooms are on the back side of the apartment and were quiet. It was a great place, I can't imagine you can stay in a better location in Antwerp than this location.
This is a lovely apartment in an amazing location in the center of old Antwerp. The accommodations and attention to detail are excellent and the host most accommodating and not intrusive.
This was an amazing apartment and an excellent location!  Winny was very helpful and only a couple minutes away when we needed him.  I would absolutely stay here again.

Beste, U heeft een geweldig appartement op een bijzondere locatie. Een appartement ingericht met alle voorzieningen. Dit alles in het hart van Antwerpen. De toeristische trekpleisters zijn vanaf hier bijna allemaal op loopafstand.
Brilliant location and a beautiful apartment.

What a gorgeous place to stay in a wonderful city. The apartment is spacious and as beautiful as the photos suggest. Winny is a gracious host and his restaurant recommendations were spot on.  You can’t go wrong staying here.

AchA's flat is absolutely beautiful and in the best possible location in Antwerp. The flat feels like an oasis of calm in a lively, vibrant pedestrian street where you can relax and listen to the chatter and cathedral bells from the gorgeously furnished apartment. The host could not have been more helpful and informative. Thank you!!

This apartment is in the perfect location for exploring Antwerp. We found it to be extremely comfortable and stylish. It was easy to check-in/check-out and we would highly recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a great place to stay in Antwerp. You can hear the cathedral bells and feel the charm of the city. You can even see the cathedral lit up through the skylights on the second floor. It's truly a remarkable location. Thank you for a wonderful stay!

This apartment is stylish, very comfortable, extremely clean and in an excellent location. A very good choice for a stay in the lovely city of Antwerp. Winny was on hand if we needed anything which was great.

My review can’t do justice to Acha’s beautiful apartment in charming historic Antwerp! It is perfectly stocked, tastefully decorated and convenient to all Antwerp has to offer. Perfect for families, small groups or just a couple looking for a relaxing weekend. He was even nice enough to get us parking at his garage @ €15/day. Love his place and we would definitely stay if our trip takes us back to Belgium in the future. Thank you!!

We loved this place so much, we could envision ourselves living here. Winny was pleasant, helpful, and efficient. The location is unbelievable. It is just a couple blocks from the cathedral, museums, and countless restaurants and shops. In fact, two of our dinners were just across the street at Mistral and An Nam. The apartment was large, beautiful, and thoughtfully appointed. Winny got us a parking pass at a garage just a block away, making this a convenient base to explore other cities in Belgium and the Netherlands. We loved Antwerp and hope to return some day, and when we do, this is where we want to stay.
Great apartment  in the middle of the city. Nice host! Would do it again.
Wonderful apartment with interesting design and features. Great hosts.
Beautiful apartment in a great location.
公寓位于老城中心！门口便可以看到大教堂！古朴的公寓已经有400多年！但是房东新装修的房间 保留了原有的木结构！看上去还是很有味道！楼下的酒吧就是当地人休闲的地方 房东是位很好的老先生！美好的回忆！
Amazing location in old town. Walking/biking distance to everything. Clean space and friendly host! Incredible bath tub. Would stay here again!

This is by far the best AirBnB I have stayed in. The space is stunning and impeccably clean. The location cannot be beat and we enjoyed being a short walk from many of Antwerp's treasures. Ruth and Winny were very kind hosts and communicated with us prior to our trip to ensure we knew the best ways to travel and check in.

This may be one of our favorite Airbnb spots.  Comfortably renovated historic apartment with exposed wood beams and a great location.  The apartment is up two flights of very steep stairs, so probably not the best choice for those with restricted mobility, but well worth the climb when you get to the top.  The proprietor, Winny, is responsive and helpful.  The apartment gets a little street noise in the front on weekends, but not enough to detract from all the advantages.  We hope to stay there again.

A real gem in an incredible location with warm host! The historic apartment is on a quiet street in old Antwerp. Beautifully designed and perfectly equipped for four adults. Easy walk to shopping, cathedral, train station, Christmas market, cafes, and restaurants. Highly recommend.

Très bel appartement décoré avec goût, extrêmement propre et soigné. Tout est mis en œuvre pour le confort des hôtes, à noter une literie particulièrement bonne.
Parfaitement bien situé au cœur d’Anvers, après quelques difficultés pour arriver en voiture à cause des rues piétonnes autour du logement, nous avons passé un très agréable séjour.
Merci à Winny pour son accueil et sa disponibilité.

This is a glorious apartment, in a charming street right by the cathedral. The photos do not exaggerate its delights. We felt we were living in an Old Master painting - but one with a sparkling bathroom and kitchen equipped with all you could need. We had a cold and wet stay but the apartment was warm and cosy and Winny was an excellent host. Antwerp is a fascinating city and you are right in the heart of it here.

Super séjour
Très bien placé
Merci pour l’accueil
Appartement très propre

Great apartment to stay in during Antwerp trip. Host was lovely and easy to reach. Apartment is perfectly located in the middle of everything. Beds are comfortable and clean. One downside was the shower head. The shower is set up bath tube style with an adjustable shower head however there is no stay to position it on to shower under. Otherwise, great place!

Superbe appartement ancien très bien rénové, très propre. L'emplacement est exceptionnel, dans une rue piétonne en plein centre. Winny a été disponible et très flexible, nous sommes arrivés tard le 1er soir et le jour de notre départ, il nous a permis de repartir en milieu d'après-midi. Je recommande sans hésiter.
Excellent location, the house is incredibly clean and has everything you need plus there are many good restaurants close by.

A most amazing place centrally located in the heart of Antwerp.  Close to food, shopping and the museums.  Host walked us thru the place, explained how everything worked and made himself available to answer any questions.  The Host and the place are the gems that make AirBNB.

Our family (two adults and three kids) loved our time in this wonderful house. It is in a fantastic location, has beautiful views of the Cathedral and the town, and has been kept in great condition. The hosts were easy to work with too. Definitely recommend.

This was the perfect location in Antwerp for us. It is near so many of our favorite restaurants and of course there is the Cathedral and the Groote Markt. It is close to the market and all the shops on the Meir. Transportation is easy with the trams from the Groenplaats. In other words, you have everything!

A gem of a place. Sparkling clean, wonderful amenities, tons of space, right on the heart of a bustling pedestrian area that comes alive with a ton of food options. The beds were also extremely comfortable. Would stay again if we return to Antwerp.

The location is excellent, the apartment is very clean and lovely. Winnie is very quick to respond to any questions or for suggestions. The only negative are the stairs...two flights up and another flight of stairs to the upstairs bedroom and full bathroom. They are the real narrow European curved stairs. There is everything you need in the kitchen for dishes and cooking, towels in the bathroom, the beds were very comfortable with really nice sheets. A very adorable apartment!

More than worth every step it takes to get up to the apartment! Incredible attention to detail and care in every piece of the space. Supplied extra amenities / thoughtful touches throughout. Location was ideal for exploring the city on foot. Would never look to stay anywhere else in Antwerp.

A really interesting apartment in the heart of the old city. Remodeled but kept its old world look and feel. Extremely clean, full array of amenities, extremely responsive host.
Close to every key site and many restaurants. We loved it!

Stairs are winding and narrow and steep yet quite beautiful. Didn’t bother us—good exercise—but could be a challenge for some persons who are not as mobile.

We spend 3 wonderful days here for our first visit to Antwerp,Belgium.Stay in Winny‘s amazing house made our trip unique. We all love here very much.
1-Winny is soper gentle and nice,always answer our requires soon from the moment I reached out for booking.
2-Location is superb,you can even see the Cathedral throughout roofwindow,and yes 3 mins walk to metro,so it very convenient for us since we also visit Brussel and Brugge during our stay.
3-stylish&cozy,this is a dream house,as pretty as the airbnb page,and well prepared for guest,we have good sleep every night.
4-bonus,downstairs is a very good restaurant,taba table and songria are“must try”.
Wish we have chance to back to here again.
Mengmeng&Lynn
Great location, very central and nicely equipped

Appartement très bien équipé et hyper bien situé.
Vous ne pouvez pas trouver mieux!
Listing is as described. Centrally located, incredibly roomy by European standards. Would definitely book again if ever in Antwerp.

Great location near to the Cathedral. Lots of excellent restaurants nearby, although in the hot weather open windows are necessary at night with the noise of late night revellers evident. Great facilities. Need to know your co-sharer as both bedrooms are 'open'.
C'est un grand appartement. Acha est une bonne personne. Anvers est une ville très merveilleuse.

The beauty of this apartment exceeds the pictures and it is kept meticulously clean. The location is ideal, with everything worth seeing and doing in easy walking distance. Our host was welcoming and helpful, and made checking in and out very easy. The only negative for some might be the steps - you have to go up 2 flights to get to the apartment and there’s one more inside to get to the bathroom and one of the bedrooms - but we didn’t mind them at all. Can’t recommend highly enough!

This apartment is a wonderful starting point in the old town of Antwerp. It has been renovated with great attention to detail and the tension between old-traditional and modern is very fine.
The kitchen is very well equipped and invites you to cook.
Winny is a great host, he has helped us with many requests quickly and very friendly.
Thank you very much for that.
My husband, me and our two teenagers enjoyed the time very much, we recommend the apartment very gladly.

Really nice apartment right in the very center of Antwerp. Close to the underpass tunnel, to transit stops under the Groenplaats, and to grocery shopping.  Our family of 4 were very comfortable there. While the streets are lively at night, we were not bothered by any noise. The apartment has everything you might need to cook, two toilets, and a washing machine.
A lovely apartment right in the heart of Antwerp!
Superb location, quiet, yet central. Very friendly host. Wonderful apartment.
Beautiful place, super clean, great location. Highly recommend!

Met z'n vijven verbleven wij in dit geweldige appartement. Het is niet alleen mooi maar zit vooral op een top locatie vlakbij allemaal eettentjes en een gezellig gedeelte van de stad. Mooie inrichting en van veel voorzien (koffiezet apparaat, wasmachine en droger, ruime kamers, optie tot parkeergarage).  De verhuurders waren in de buurt en dachten met ons mee met betrekking tot in- en uitchecken! Zeker een aanrader!

This location is amazing! Very central to everything. All the windows provide great views, light, and fresh air throughout the whole place. The stairs getting up to the unit are quite narrow and steep, so heads up if you have a lot of luggage. But getting to the top is worth it! Very clean, lots of modern updates and touches. You can’t beat the space and value. A must if you’re staying in Antwerp for a few days!

This flat is lovely- it is as beautiful as shown in the photos and you can enjoy the historic rooftops from all the windows. We have lived in Antwerp and found the central location just perfect for seeing all our favorite sites and going to restaurants, cafe's in the Grote Markt. The owners have thought of everything- we did not need anything that wasn't provided or available in the flat. We would highly recommend it to all travelers coming to Antwerp.

The pictures look impressive enough but staying there was even better than we expected. Winny & Ruth are great at communicating with the queries we raised and take great pride in the presentation of their home. It’s spacious, well specked out and has lovely views of the city. We are definitely going back there!

Wat een geweldige appartement!  Super verzorgt en stijlvol appartement midden in de centrum van Antwerpen.  Alles was tot in de punt verzorgt.  Echt een aanrader en als wij weer naar Antwerpen komen staat dit appartement op nummer 1.

My partner and I stayed in their other property last year (wonderful) and wanted to check this one out this trip and we were not disappointed. This place is fantastic and we absolutely loved it. It looks as good in real life as it does in the photos. It's very clean, spacious, well-equipped, located in the most beautiful part of Antwerp and close to the best restaurants. You won't be disappointed.

Very nice flat, and very similar to how it is described. Some steep stairs for those who are not physically capable, but no problem for those who are. The amenities in the flat were great with plenty of guide books and tips. We found it hard to navigate through Antwerp at night with various road closures but once we found the flat we were extremely impressed.
Very good location for the cathedral and main city square with loads of bars and restaurants close by
Wonderful apartment in a very convenient location! We had everything we needed for a comfortable stay!

This flat is a gem. Photos on airbnb are accurate, what you see is what you get. We wish that we stayed longer to take in the space more as well as the neighborhood. It is very centrally located. Make sure not to miss the Vlaykensgang, a lovely old alley. We appreciated the detailed tour that the owner gave us in the apt. which is a landmark. Also they were gracious to accommodate us late at night with an extra set of bed linens. It was a treat after a long trip to arrive there which was sparkling clean and spacious.
Small improvement could be to add a stool to the tub for people who need to take showers which negligible for a short stay. We would definitely stay here again and recommend to the airbnb community as well as friends and family. Thank you Winnie.
Geweldig appartement met alle denkbare voorzieningen op een waanzinnige locatie. Behoort tot mijn beste AirBnB ervaringen

What a find in the heart of the action of Antwerp. Winny (the host) lives nearby and he gave us a tour of the lovely apartment, which he -- an architect by trade -- remodeled himself and retained many original details. You really feel like you're at home in Antwerp.

The location was perfect as first timers in Antwerp. Just by wandering the streets you'll find great shopping and food options, both boutique stores and large retailers.

One thing to note is that the area does get lively at night since the apartment sits along an alley full of restaurants and is just steps away from Groenplaats. The bedroom, however, faces inward toward other homes which helps manage the city sounds nicely.

Thanks for a great stay Winny! We hope to stay with you again should we visit Antwerp in the future.

Beautifully restored apartment right in the old historic centre of Antwerp. As with all old terrace houses a couple of steep sets of stairs to get to the apartment- not a problem if you have no mobility issues. We’d definitely stay here again.
We all appreciated the stay, very nice appartment well located and clean. Thank you

One of the best AirBNB apartments I have stayed in. The location is fantastic, right in one of the most historic streets in the old centre of the city, near shops, restaurants, metro etc, but minimal noise in the apartment. The space is beautiful, decorated stylishly to a high standard. Everything worked perfectly, and the apartment is very well-equipped. It was a very nice place to spend time between going out and sight seeing. Check-in and check-out were straightforward. Winny was immediately available, and accommodated our schedule completely. I'd definitely come back here on a future trip to Antwerp.

I am not sure where to begin the praises! This place is just wonderful, it is beautiful, so very well equipped and in the most perfect location to visit Anvers. The beds are so very comfortable that w e had trouble to get up in the morning.  Everything in the house is well thought and of the best possible taste. This is maybe the best place we stayed in with Airbnb. Mille mercis!!
Very nice apartment. Location was outstanding. Proffesional rent out apartment.

Prachtig appartement in hartje Antwerpen: authentieke elementen, maar met alle moderne comfort die je kan wensen en super comfortabele bedden. Perfect als ontspannen uitvalsbasis voor na je uitstapjes in't stad!

Very beautiful apartment! Super clean, spacious and has everything you need.
Also a perfect location. The host was very friendly and easy to communicate with. Thank you Winnie and Ruth!
Perfect place, very comfortable and spacious. Nice very old furniture, with of course, new bathrooms. You can hear music till 23.hrs from Spanish restaurant, and weekends longer, but not very loud.
Very calm and convenient appartement in downtown Antwerpen.
Very clean, spacious appartment.

Nous avons passé deux nuits très agréables et cette petite escapade nous a fait un bien fou en cette période.
L’hôte était agréable, l’appartement d’une propreté impeccable, très bien équipé et situé. Literie au top du top ! Nous y reviendrons avec grand plaisir.
Merci !

Would stay there again in a heartbeat! Perfect location, perfect quiet side street with quaint cafes, Winny was so communicative and hospitable. Would not stay anywhere else in Antwerp. Thanks so much Winny!
Perfect stay - fantastic host! Thanks!
Underneath the bells of the Antwerp Cathedral you are engulfed by the sounds, smells and tastes of all the goodness Antwerpen has to offer, in classic style.
Great home base for exploring Antwerp. Authentic space. Very kind and friendly hosts.

We came for a weekend away in Antwerp and couldn‘t have chosen a more perfect spot! The apartment is at the top floor of a stunning refurbished building, beautifully renovated and perfect for a trip with friends or family. Had we stayed longer we definitely would have made use of the kitchen which is stocked with just about anything you could need for cooking, including a hob/oven combination and a dishwasher. Located in the centre of the Old Town all major sights, lots of shopping opportunities as well as countless bars and restaurants are within walking distance. (Jones’ next door do great coktails!) We would definitely recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a great spot to discover Antwerp by foot!

The hosts are welcoming and helpful, the appartment is really well placed, and decorated tastefully. Winny and Ruth thought of everything to make the guests welcome- the appartment is clean and comfortable to an extremely high standard. I miss it already!
Great hosts, very nice and friendly. The apartment is beautiful in a historic building.
Fijn appartement in het midden van de stad. Van alle gemakken voorzien. contact met de verhuurders liep goed. Auto kan je nabij parkeren in de parkeergarage.
Excellent apartment  ! Great location, absolutely clean,  kitchen with all you need, very spacious and comfortable, and great reception by the host !

Even the most critical of person could not find fault with this apartment or the location.

Absolutely perfect in every way, with special shout out to value, location and comfort.

I cannot wait to come back

Een prachtig oud pand helemaal gerenoveerd tot moderne woning De locatie is top, midden in het centrum Alles oogt nieuw in huis, heel schoon en fris Veel servies in de keuken en fijne bedden. Zeker een aanrader!
Heel net, fijn en sfeervol appartement midden in het centrum van Antwerpen. De host is erg vriendelijk en goed bereikbaar. Een echte aanrader.

This place is FANTASTIC! It was a shame we didn’t plan for a longer visit. The location is all you can ask for, in the city center with lots of shops and restaurants in the same street. Antwerp’s Central Station is a short 15 min walk away. The place has everything you need and more, and the hosts go the extra mile to make your stay one you will remember. Don’t doubt it, this is what you are looking for!
Great and authentic appartment, very stylish and convenient. Excellent location. We had a great stay here, thanks Winny and Ruth!
Een heerlijke plek midden in het centrum van Antwerpen! Een echte aanrader

Netjes en centraal gelegen appartement. Snelle en fijne communicatie en uiterst behulpzame host.
We waren met twee kleine kinderen en de kamers kunnen niet afgesloten worden (1 grote ruimte en een kamer met een gordijn) dus wel gehorig.
Very nice place, quiet street. Great location.
Excellent place, location and host. Highly recommended

Very nice home. Noisy area more slightly due to construction on the cathedral that begins early mornings. Great locale for late nights and walking around to eat and drink! Parking they offer is super! Dogma: excellent cocktails! The Pomphuis excellent…5 minute drive away! Lovely shops! Busy city with lots to see and loads of new construction projects on the go! Antwerp much more accommodating than Brussels or elsewhere with Covid issues! Arrive with PCR  test results!

Laura & Jasper Design loft was a home away from home in Antwerp. There was so much: location, breakfast, unique decor, high quality sheets and towels, lighting options, and two lovely cats!
Whether this is a first or your fiftieth visit to Antwerp, Laura & Jasper will truly make you feel at home.

Mijn man nam mij als verrassing mee naar deze loft. Dat op zich was al leuk maar toen ik het gezien had was ik helemaal blij. Wat een mooie combi tussen oud en nieuw design! Een super lichte kamer met vide met een nespresso koffiezetapparaat ( hulde!) de leukste waterkoker die er is en fijne spullen van Rituals ! De ontvangst was zeer gastvrij - de tips voor fijne eetadresjes werden op post-its geschreven en het ontbijt werd op de kamer gebracht! Met..een handgeschreven kaartje er bij ! Serieus - ik word er blij van. Manlief mag me nog een keer verrassen ;p

Super luxe loft! Grote schone kamer met veel licht. Heerlijk bed en mooie badkamer. Goede locatie, rustig maar wel op loopafstand van de winkelstraten en het havengebied. En ook een heerlijk luxe ontbijt!
Jasper & Miriam zijn zeer aardig en gastvrij.
Wij hebben een super weekend gehad en ik kan deze loft aan iedereen aanraden.

Wat een heerlijk appartement! Heel fijn en smaakvol ingericht, van alle gemakken voorzien, waar overal zelfs een extra luxe randje aan is toegevoegd. We werden heel hartelijk ontvangen en kregen leuke tips aangetekend op een kaart van de stad, handig! Locatie is perfect, 5min lopen vanaf centraal. Ontbijt wordt geserveerd op je eigen gewenste tijd. Een super begin van de dag, met alles er op en er aan, van champagne tot fruit. Wij raden iedereen dit verblijf aan!

Wir hatten ein unvergesslich schönes Wochenende in Antwerpen – ermöglicht durch Laura & Jasper und ihre wundervolle Gastfreundschaft.
Sowohl die Gastgeber als auch die Unterkunft haben jede Erwartung bei weitem übertroffen. Laura & Jasper waren bereits im Vorfeld extrem hilfsbereit bei der Planung unseres Aufenthalts. Das Apartment ist sehr beeindruckend: Sowohl Design als auch Ausstattung sind bis ins letzte Detail durchdacht und elegant. Dieses ausgesprochen beeindruckende Gespür fürs Detail machte sich auch im Frühstück bemerkbar, welches uns jedem morgen frisch gebracht wurde und welches durch besondere Aufmerksamkeiten und die liebevolle Zubereitung ganz einfach zauberhaft war. Wir hatten den Eindruck, dass es Laura & Jasper persönlich sehr am Herzen liegt, dass wir uns bei ihnen wohlfühlen – was selbstverständlich im allerhöchsten Maß der Fall war. Einziger Wermutstropfen blieb, dass wir leider nicht länger bleiben konnten. Ein Wochenende, an das wir uns ganz sicher noch lange erinnern werden!

I stayed in this wonderful Loft during a conference in Antwerp and I was stunned!
This turned out better than any Hotel I every stayed in and the hospitality was beyond words!
The Interieur was stylish and some of the electronic Gadgets (i could Programm all the blinds so I would be waken up by the light at a certain time) were phenomenal!
I will definately come back!

We had a great time in Antwerp largely thanks to the great accommodation Laura & Jasper provided. From the moment we arrived to the moment we left, we received great advices on the best places to visit in the city, restaurants and bars included.
