They also gave us great directions and suggestions of things to do in Antwerp as well as some history about the city. The room was nice and quiet on the top floor of their home. Just be aware that the bathroom is two flights down stairs. I definitely recommend staying here and would love to again next time I visit Antwerp. :)

Bij het binnenkomen waren we al bijna sprakeloos over hoe mooi het huis was. De weg was makkelijk te vinden met de routebeschrijving die we hadden gekregen, we liepen in een keer goed. We werden hartelijk ontvangen en met de uitleg die ze gaf leek het alsof we een nachtje onderdeel van hun gezin waren. Hoe leuk is dat! De kamer was super, er lag vanalles klaar om te gebruiken en bovenal sliep het bed heerlijk.
Ze gaven ons tips voor Antwerpen, waar we bijvoorbeeld naar toe konden gaan. Altijd fijn als je niet helemaal in de stad thuis ben!

We have a great experienced in Belgium not only because of its nice views but also with the host family that we stayed. They are hospitable, helpful and kind. The house itslef makes you feel comfortable when you stay on Anne's place and it is clean of course. I will really recommend Anne's place to my friends if they happen to visit Antwerpen, Belgium.
Anne en Manu hebben ons perfect ontvangen. Hun huis is prachtig, mooi ingericht en ruim. Super!

Très bon accueil, indications claires pour trouver le logement, Anne a pris le temps de nous présenter la maison et les endroits atypiques de la ville. De plus, son mari nous a parfaitement expliqué quels étaient les places et musées à visiter, le tout dans un français quasiment parfait ! Nous nous sommes vite senties comme chez nous. De plus, la maison est vraiment magnifique, une décoration raffinée dans un style ancien, c'est absolument incroyable.

Je vous recommande vivement d'aller chez Anne lors de votre voyage à Anvers !
Een goede advertentie en vooraf goed contact zodat er vanaf het begin het vertrouwen was dat het een goede keuze was om voor dit airbnb adres te kiezen

Wij voelden ons meer dan welkom. Kregen uitgebreide uitgaan en musea-tips, mochten de fietsen lenen, de paraplu, wandelschoenen..
Het verblijf in de riante en sfeervolle woonkeuken was een extra pluspunt evenals het terrasje in de fraaie tuin en het dakterras, waar we van ons ontbijt konden genieten.
Het was heerlijk slapen onder de klamboe. De eigen wastafel was fijn en handig.

名符其實充滿歷史痕跡的lovers' house
房東夫婦因為藝術而暫時不住在這裡，整棟公寓充滿了藝術文化的小玩意，非常有趣。房間內有舒服的床，獨立的水槽，可以吃早餐的後花園，開放式的廚房，以及很大的餐桌，當然也有舒服的客廳，此外浴室提供非常多種的盥洗用品跟保養品。

還有接待我們的Martha人非常好，Deniel(dog)超級可愛，她推薦了我們一些當地的餐廳，event，以及後面一定要去的城市，讓我們行程變得更隨機更豐富。

We consider ourselves lucky to have been able to stay at Anne's place. It was our first booking with airbnb, and a great experience. We did not meet Anne, but her daughter made us feel at home and gave us lots of helpful information where to go, off the beaten tracks. She was very welcoming and charming, even speaking Castellano with us.

The house is exactly as described in the listing, full of books and visual surprises. The spacious room and the shared bathroom were very clean. The bed is comfortable and breakfeast in the backyard made you forget you are in a busy town. We highly recommend this place to anybody who is looking for something really special.

Thank you Anne and Marta - ¡hasta la vista!

Het verblijf in de book lovers room was fantastisch! Mooie kamer, fijn huis op een perfecte locatie in Antwerpen. Maar bovenal was de ontvangst door Anne en Manu heel erg fijn. Airbnb zoals airbnb bedoeld is! Zeer aanbevolen!

Wonderful room, house and family! Room and amenities were precisely as described and depicted by the photographs. Anne and her family were very friendly and welcoming, giving us great tips on what to see and where to go. Highly recommended!

Als opgenomen in het gezin van Anne, voelden we ons direct welkom. Deel van het huishouden. Ontspannen en met interssante gesprekken. Leuke buurt achter het station. Huur een fiets in Antwerpen, dat is gemakkelijk en heel leuk om te doen (maar verwacht geen Nederlandse fietspaden ;-))

Vi havde tre dejlige dage hos Anne og hendes mand. Vi oplevede en stor gæstfrihed, hjertevarme og hjælpsomhed. De åbnede ikke blot deres spændende og smukke hjem for os, men gav os også et personligt indblik i kultur og hverdag i Flandern.
Vi oplevede, at det kunne være vanskeligt at finde parkeringsplads, når vi ankom senere end kl.19, hvorimod der i dagtiden var flere ledige pladser til en absolut rimelige pris.

Absolute the most amazing airbnb experience ever! Anne and her families are very adorable, helpful, kind, the gave me all the travel tips I need and tried their best to give us suggestions... Me and my parents have spent two wonderful days in Antwerp thanks to them! Also, Anne's house is fabulous, every corner is art... Really a wonderful place with wonderful people, I will come back here for sure! Highly recommend!

Si vas a visitar Amberes no hay opción mejor que la casa de Anne. La casa es preciosa. Su estilo y decoración te encantará. Además tiene un precioso Jardín que parece sacado de un cuento de hadas. Muy cerca de la Estación Central (5 min) y del fabuloso ZOO de la ciudad. Recomendado 100%.

The best choice!

Anne's house is very beautifully decorated and quite comfortable. The family was there to welcome us and explain everything. Location's great, close to central station, public transport and bike rental. Anne is also a great help to plan the itinerary in Antwerp. I'd love to come back here.
Staying in Anne 's beautiful yet stylish house was a really great experience. Highly recommended if you would like to explore more on the cultural and historical side of Antwerpen.

Anne and her family are the most wonderful people one can encounter in probably whole Antwerp! They were so uncomplicated and warm-hearted and made my stay very special and unforgettable. I felt home from the very first moment and was happy and thankful to live in this wonderful house and room for a couple of days. I wish I could have stayed longer but whenever I'll be back in town, I know where to go. :) Thanks so much again!
Incredible, huge, atmospheric house and very warm welcome! We had a great weekend and highly recommend Anne's place for a stay in Antwerp

Anne and her family are great hosts!
They gave us a very warm welcome showed us the amazing house and our wonderful room. They equipped us with a lot of maps and informations of the city and we got a detailed overview about the city with nice places, cafes, architecture, restaurants and other places of interest.
Anne and Manu are very inspiring people with interest in other people.
De verhuurder is heel gastvrij en geeft veel informatie over Antwerpen. Heerlijk plek om aan te komen. Je voelt je direct thuis en welkom. Ook een leuke plek om met een kind logeren.

Excellente halte à Anvers. Anne est si agréable que c'est un plaisir de loger chez elle plutôt que dans un logement entier. Nous avons garé notre voiture à 50m pour 3€8 par jour et avons découvert Anvers à Pied. C'est à 10' de la gare et 20' du plein centre.

Anne, Manue and their lovely daughter Marta are very warm-heart and sincere family, gave us all surport and help as much as possible, so appreciated and impressive to Anne's host and caring when we get into a new place, and we had very pleasant staying together for two familes

Een erg fijne plek, vlakbij het station met een meer dan prima kamer! Anne, en haar gezin, zijn zeer vriendelijk en welkomend. We hebben dan ook een prachtige tijd (zij het kort) gehad in deze 'boekenkamer' in Antwerpen. Bedankt Anne!

Bedankt voor alles Anne! Huis en kamer waren (Website hidden by Airbnb) als uw gastvrijheid. Ideaal voor mijn verjaardag in Antwerp. We hopen dat jullie ons kaartje hebben gekregen :-)

Thomas & Charlotte

P.-S. : To all the others reading this comment, don't hesitate to book, just do it!

We hebben een fijne nacht gehad bij Anne thuis! Zeer vriendelijk en open ontvangen, Anne en Manu zijn heel behulpzaam en geven leuke tips voor wat te doen in Antwerpen. Het huis en de kamer zijn heel mooi en heel erg schoon. Heerlijk geslapen in het fijne bed (waar zelfs een chocolaatje op het kussen lag!).
Ik heb een heel fijn verblijf gehad bij Anne en haar familie. Prachtig huis, rustige buurt, heel gastvrije, open en interessante mensen.
the b&b was great, great people, the rooms where big and confortable, you can use kitchen, no breakfast is served, but you can make it yourself.

Het contact vooraf was zeer klant vriendelijk en behulpzaam, tot het vinden van een betaalbare parkeerplaats aan toe. Verder veel advies voor onze planning van ons uitstapje. We mochten zelfs de fietsen lenen om naar de stad te gaan. Ook het ontvangst was zeer gastvrij en huiselijk, we voelden ons meteen thuis.

Het welkom van Martha en Cornelius (de kinderen van Anne, die er bij onze komst even niet was) was hartverwarmend, we voelden ons meteen op ons gemak en het huis met alle doorleefde heerlijkheid en boeken was helemaal naar ons zin. Een huis waar de tijd even stil lijkt te staan, met om de hoek het trammetje (nr. 11, halte Ploeg, met zicht op de giraffen van de Antwerpse Zoo) dat je overal heen brengt: aan de ene kant Berchem met de schitterende Cogels Osiley en aan de andere kant Centraal Station en de rest van de stad.

This was hands-down the best airbnb experience I've ever had. Anne was not at home, but her son and daughter were home and super friendly and helpful. Antwerp is a smallish city with a lovely artistic tendency, and staying in Anne's home was actually the highlight of my trip... It's a beautiful, interesting old home that oozes character and personality. I would visit Antwerp again just to stay here! :8)

Thanks again, Anne, Marta, and Cornelius!

I had a beautiful stay in Antwerp with Anne and family at Book Lovers Room. The location was convenient to the train station and for exploring the city. Hosts greeted me with detailed information about the city and answered questions during my stay. They really made me feel at home, and the room was so comfortable that I looked forward to hanging out there at the end of the day. It was fun to be in a residential neighborhood and to have suggestions about where to go, where to eat that were off the regular tourist circuit. I felt more like a friend of the family than a paying guest, and would be happy to stay there again if the chance arises.

Met dank aan een ontzettend gedetailleerde routebeschrijving was het huis niet moeilijk te vinden. Daar aangekomen werden we in ontvangst genomen door Anne, die ons daarna het hele huis heeft laten zien en tot slot de kamer waar wij een nachtje in zouden verblijven. De kamer is prachtig, en goed voorzien van een waterkoker en een wasbak. De badkamer is gedeeld en wij hebben hier niet echt gebruik van gemaakt, maar deze was ook mooi en schoon.

De locatie is erg vlakbij het station en ook de rest van de stad is prima lopend te bereiken. Anne kon ons een aantal locaties en buurten aanraden, die wij later met plezier hebben bezocht.

Als je naar Antwerpen gaat, kijk dan even of deze kamer nog beschikbaar is!

De kamer bij Anne heeft de charme van Dickens. Veel boeken, veel leuke dingen, sfeervol, prima bed, ruim. Anne en haar man zijn gastvrij en weten enorm veel over Antwerpen. Het ruime oude herenhuis ligt vlakbij het station en de joodsewijk. Parkeren kan voor €3, 80 in een nabije straat. Ontbijt is er niet en dat is wel jammer, maar de bakker is vlakbij. Koffie, thee of karnemelk is er wel. Een aanrader als je trappen lopen niet erg vindt.

Malgré notre venue le soir de Noel nous avons été très bien reçu
Lieu très calme et agréable
Situation proche de la gare très pratique

Séjour très agréable dans cette maison au coeur d'un quartier gentrifié d'Anvers. La déco est originale et dégage une atmosphère qui nous fait sentir comme à la maison... Et l'acceuil des hôtes est à la hauteur de leur chambre! Parlant couramment Français et Anglais, Anne et Manu connaissent tous les coins et recoins d'Anvers et nous ont donné de nombreux tips pour découvrir la face "authentique" de la ville. Tous deux écrivains, ils sont de très agréable compagnie et ne tarissent pas de conversations intéressantes.
A proximité de la gare, des parkings à 3,8 euros par journée sont accessibles facilement. Je reviendrai!

Anne and her family were very friendly and warm. They gave us a lot of good tips about cultural events and attractions in Antwerp. The house has plenty of charm and our room was very cozy and warm. Also it was located close to the city (on foot easy to reach) was very beneficial. All in all, we felt very comfortable.
Anne gave us great information about what to see in the area. We had a fantastic weekend

Bedankt we hebben ons zeer welkom gevoeld. En mede dankzij alle tips van U Anne is ons verblijf in Antwerpen tot een succes geworden.
We hebben ook erg genoten van het mooie sfeervolle huis.

We hadden vooraf regelmatig contact, bij aankomst werden we hartelijk verwelkomd door Martha, de dochter van Anne. Ze bood ons iets te drinken aan, gaf een rondleiding door het huis en had - en passant - nog enkele leuke local-tips.
We voelden ons erg welkom in dit 'huis van mooie verhalen'.
Realiseer je wel dat je - behalve de slaapkamer - geen privé-faciliteiten hebt. Maar dat had wat ons betreft ook zijn charme. Het huis is gelegen in een rustige zijstraat, achter het Centraal Station. Openbaar vervoer is dus vlakbij, maar wij hebben alles te voet gedaan. Ook voldoende ontbijtmogelijkheden in de buurt.
We gaan zeker nog eens logeren bij Anne en haar gezin.

Anne was zeer goede host! Ondanks ons drukke schema nam ze samen met haar familie de tijd om ons welkom te heetten en wegwijs te maken. De restaurant tips in de buurt, weg van het centrum, waren ook zeer welkom.

Haar huis is in alle opzichten uniek en bijzonder.

Zeer aan te raden.

Het voelt koninklijk om hier te verblijven. Het is een prachtig huis. Het ademt gastvrijheid. Anne en Manu hebben ons van harte welkom geheten en ons talloze tips (en een plattegrond) gegeven. Niet twijfelen, gewoon boeken.
Very welcoming and helpful hosts, charming room, good location. Everything like in the photos and description.

We zijn zeer vriendelijk en gastvrij ontvangen en we hebben een leuke, enthousiaste toelichting gekregen op alles wat er te zien is in Antwerpen.
Onze fietsen mochten achter in de tuin.

Anne was heel communicatief: ze reageerde steeds snel en efficient op mijn vragen.
Haar zoon was onze gastheer en liet ons ook steeds weten hoe wij contact konden houden en sjouwde onze bagage naar boven toen wij de stad in waren. Beide personen (ook de dochter) kwamen op mij heel gastvrij en open, betrouwbaar over. Ze hadden tijd om informatie te geven, maar gaven mij en mijn dochter ook voldoende prive-ruimte. Het prachtige huis is zo ingericht, dat je je snel thuis voelt omdat de regels duidelijk zijn en het zo ingericht is, dat je elkaar niet voor de voeten loopt.
Er zijn inderdaad heel veel prachtige, leuke boeken, ook op de kamer die wij huurden. Een heel leuk en fijn extraatje !!
Het feit dat de eigenaars van dit pand schrijvers zijn voegt voor mij een dimensie toe. Ik zou ze graag eens ontmoeten.

Absolutely beautiful room in a stunning house – would definitely recommend staying to anyone desiring to spend time in Antwerp. Fantastic location with bakeries and convenience stores on the doorstep and only a couple of minutes away from central station. We were greeted on arrival by Anne’s youngest son who was incredibly polite and welcoming. Despite only meeting Anne on the day we were leaving she was warm and friendly. Her list of recommended bars, restaurants, galleries and museums was more than enough to see us through our trip, though! Also: they have an adorable dog if that swings things for those thinking of staying

Anne en haar familie zijn geweldig. Zo hartelijk en warm, we voelden ons direct thuis. Anne kent ook veel bezienswaardigheden in de stad. De kamer is gezellig en knus, en het prachtige huis staat vol curiosa. We konden het heel gemakkelijk vinden vanaf het centrale station van Antwerpen. En vanaf het huis konden we ook theater Da Roma lopend heel gemakkelijk bereiken. Kortom een echte aanrader, en al helemaal als je naar een concert in Da Roma gaat.

Anne heeft ons verschillende tips gegeven om ons verblijf waardevol te maken. Er lagen kaarten op de kamer en een overzicht van de openingstijden van alle musea in Antwerpen. Daarbij heeft ze ons ook nog tips gegeven wanneer wij elkaar zagen. Erg leuk!
We voelden ons heel welkom en kregen alle ruimte om ons te laten inspireren in de rustige en reine ambiance van het huis.

De snelle reacties van de host, de ontvangst, de ligging van het huis en de prachtige kamer maakten ons weekendje Antwerpen tot een groot succes! Merci!

Wir haben uns wirklich sehr wohl gefühlt in diesem sehr atmosphärischen traumhaften alten Haus. Das Zimmer ist liebevoll eingerichtet und mit vielen kleinen Details versehen. Anne und ihr Mann waren sehr freundlich hilfsbereit und zuvorkommend. Wir haben von ihnen viele Tipps bekommen für die Besichtigung von Antwerpen, die wir leider, weil wir nur einen Tag da waren, nicht alle umsetzen konnten. Auf jeden Fall nur zu empfehlen, diese Unterkunft!

Een hele mooie kamer. Dichtbij het centrum en net verwijderd van de drukte. Anne en haar familie zijn zeer gastvrij en geïnteresseerd in je plannen in de stad, waardoor ze je ook kunnen verwijzen naar goeie restaurantjes en mooie dingen om te zien.

We hebben het heel erg leuk gehad. Antwerpen is een prachtige stad en we gaan graag nog een keer.

Beautiful house, very central location, we had a wonderful stay. Anne and her family were very helpful in welcoming us into their home and giving us advice on places to visit and make the most of our weekend. Parking is a bit complicated however.

The house is a wonderful place, a one in a kind refuge in the heart of Antwerp. Anne's grown-up kids were extremely supportive during my stay and gave me a few crucial tips that my stay all the more memorable.

Liebe Anne, vielen Dank für einen sehr schönen Aufenthalt bei euch in eurer wunderschönen Wohnung. Die Kommunikation lief sehr unkompliziert und Anne hat mir gute Tipps für Antwerpen gegeben. Ich habe mich sehr wohlgefühlt und komme gerne wieder.

We had a great stay at this beautiful, unique place! Conveniently located, near the station. Lovely, friendly host (one of the daughters) who gave us some great tips. The house is full of great & quirky ornaments and pretty paintings to enjoy on the way up to your room.
Excellent.  I had a  very pleasant stay in a characteristic Antwerp townhouse located in a quiet and convenient street

Wir hatten einen perfekten Aufenthalt bei Anne in Antwerpen. Annes Haus ist ideal gelegen, sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet und gut ausgestattet. Das Zimmer ist groß genug auch für 3 Personen.

Wir haben von Anne und Ihrer Familie auch sehr gute Insider-Informationen erhalten für unsere Tour durch diese faszinierende Stadt.

Ich freue mich schon darauf irgendwann einmal wieder kommen zu können.
We werden zeer hartelijk ontvangen, in ons geval door de zoons des huizes, die ons goede tips gaven. Zeer ontspannen en gastvrij onthaal in een prachtig en sfeervol huis !

Our experience at Anne's and her family place was absolutely marvellous. The house is beautiful - better than the pictures!
The room is at the top floor of their period house, which has a unique character and a delightful eccentric touch. Anne and Manu are warm hosts, enthusiasts about the city were they leave, with plenty of useful tips and interesting point of views. Their three grown-up children are as warm and polite as their parents.
Fascinating and inspiring, will definitely go back.
Thank you, Irene&Simon
PS: Denis, the family's terrier dog, is such a charmer that you will want to take her home!

Wonderful place and great hosts - thanks Anne for all your caring support to find a doctor and medical support. You really took care of us. Hope to be able to stay with you again

Marion & Myke

Anne! Thank you for letting us stay! Your suggestions and knowledge of the City was wonderful and really useful for us, as we only had a couple of days in Antwerp.

Also, we loved how close your home is to the Central Station/central area! It makes a huge difference when you have a limited time in the City.

Thanks again and hope to see you soon.

We were welcomed into this home like long lost friends - such a delight! I can highly recommend staying here with Anne and her family. We arrived with only half a day to explore Antwerp and Anne enthusiastically pointed out the best highlights to suit our limited time - they were perfect! Anne also told us about a great pizza restaurant and the MAS (a multi-level museum which you can climb for free for a superb 360 degree view of the city). The room is just as lovely as the photos and it was such a treat to experience an authentic home of the local area. We wished we could have stayed longer to see more of the city and spend more time getting to know Anne and her family. Another really positive Airbnb experience!
We had a pleasant stay! The location is perfect,  very close to the central station in a cozy house. Thanks for hosting!
Warm family and a lovely host. It was a pleasant stay and felt like home. If I am in Antwerp again I would book it again without a second thought.

Courteous, friendly and very helpful hostess. They gave a session on Antwerp 101 which was very helpful.
They provided us with coffee.
The bedroom was up on 3rd floor; spacious
The stairs leading up to the bedroom are narrow; hence do not recommend taking up a big luggage.
The bathroom, on "chan loi" is clean. If an elderly guest, would suggest to take the bedroom on 2nd floor so that easier to get to the toilet at night.
Great and beautiful house, Anne and her lovely family were so kind to give us lots suggestion to esay discover how Antwerp beautiful is, and I love their super adorable dog Daniel. ^^

Everything is fine. It is very convenient to visit Antwerp. Anne and her family is very warm to make me feel like we are in the family also. We shared the kitchen with her and have a good conversation in the morning. They have us a good help and so many useful information about visiting Antwerp.  I will be there if I could visit in Antwerp again.

Anne nous a fait nous sentir chez nous tout de suite avec son accueil chaleureux. Nous avons eu droit à d'excellentes adresses non touristiques. Le logement correspond  aux photos, la maison est vraiment très propre et a une atmosphère presque magique. Nous avons super bien dormi dans le lit et dans le silence. Le jardin est une merveille dans lequel il fait bon prendre un café le matin. Je recommande à 100%.

Anne and Manu are perfect hosts, ever so kind and hospitable and helpful.
I would definitely recommend their beautiful 18th century house/ room to everyone! We loved staying there and felt really at home!

The house is very closed to the center.
The home is very clean and original, extraordinary. And the daughter is very kind and she speaks German :-)
Super sauber, sehr nah zum Zentrum, sehr freundlich.....

Très belle maison-musée. La cuisine est grande et conviviale avec un joli petit jardin devant. Idéal pour se reposer ! Martha a été une hôtesse sympathique et nous a guidés pour les bars et restaurants. Merci Anne !

agréable appartement bien situé à anvers.
Anne absente ; ses enfants ont été présent et je les remercie pour leur accueil et leurs conseils sur la ville..
prêt de vélo en plus , que demander de plus !
je vous invite à réserver..

Although it was just for one night, it was a wonderfull stay. Anne was very helpfull during the planning as we booked under 24h before arrival and arranged one of her children to open the door for us.
It's a very roomy and calm place in the middle of Antwerp.

We werden ontvangen door Basil, en voelden ons zeer snel thuis in dit schitterende herenhuis. Deze locatie is centraal maar rustig gelegen en uniek ingericht, een ideale uitvalsbasis om Antwerpen te ontdekken.
Helemaal super! Goed geholpen, snelle reacties en leuk weekend gehad.

Es war ein sehr entspannter Aufenthalt in einem wunderschönen Haus mit Garten in einer tollen Gegend. Alle Kommunikation lief reibungslos und haben viele tolle Tipps zur Stadterkundung bekommen, die wir auch gerne umgesetzt haben. Begeisterung pur –  gerne kommen wir wieder!

Very very beautiful house with a lot if books and hospitalized hostess who sent me lot of suggestions week before I went to Antwerp. And it's a cozy house which is very close to the central station, 5 mins by walk. I'll definitely introduce this Anna's b&b.

Zeer aangenaam verblijf gehad. Van tevoren al heel veel informatie gehad. Mooie, rustige, kamer gekregen met een zeer goed bed, ook voor lange mensen.
Je zit midden in Antwerpen waardoor alles zeer goed bereikbaar is (400 meter van het station).
Voor ons voor herhaling vatbaar.
We hebben een heerlijk weekend gehad! Anne is erg warm en gastvrij. Ze heeft ons veel leuke tips gegeven over Antwerpen. Een aanrader!

We felt most welcome and had a lovely time in the book lover's room. Our hosts were very helpful and knowledgeble of the area. It's a beautiful house in a good location that we would highly recommend to anyone visiting Antwerp.

Een mooi oud huis midden in Antwerpen. Het lijkt van binnen op een klein museum.
Anne en Manu hebben ons heel hartelijk ontvangen en tips gegeven over Antwerpen. Ze zijn heel flexibel met de aankomst en vertrektijd.
Ze geven zelfs gratis boeken weg voor de mensen in de buurt.

Stunning house and very nice, hospitable owners. Location is central and very easy to walk to main attractions/sites. The hosts have a wealth of knowledge about Antwerp. Highly recommend staying here.

We went to explore Antwerp for the weekend and found this fair priced and old fashioned apartment. All the trinkets in the house made it even more interesting because of all the stuff you could explore. The hosts were extremely helpful, we certainly took their suggestions and enjoyed all of them. Highly recommend.
The House has a great atmosphere and Anne was the perfect host. We felt welcome and would come back any time!

The house is lovely as the hosts are. A comfortable and quite place just 5 min walking from the station, clean and perfumed of grandmather's soap. Beautiful windows with decorated glass, which make a warm and relaxing light.

Ik heb hier een top verblijf gehad! Hele lieve mensen waar je je al snel thuisvoelt. Het is een erg mooi herenhuis en mijn kamer was mooi en ruim. Ze denken mee en geven leuke tips tav dingen bekijken in Antwerpen. Nogmaals, het was top!
We hebben een heel fijn verblijf gehad bij Anne in haar prachtige huis. Ze was heel erg betrokken en gaf ons veel tips. Ik raad iedereen aan om hier te logeren.

I was made to feel very welcome by Anne and her family, the book lover's room along with the rest of their home is warm, comfortable and full of character. Manu and Anne were very helpful and enthusiastic, giving much appreciated information about the highlights Antwerp had to offer along with maps and directions. The location was close to public transport and walkable for the centre of the city. A great neighbourhood and I would love to stay again sometime.

Het zet direct de goede sfeer en vervolgens kom je in een prachtig, sfeervol huis waar je ontvangen wordt door Cornelius (haar zoon), met ijskoud water, een gulle lach en heel veel vriendelijkheid. De kamer is geweldig, het hondje heel lief en we kunnen het iedereen aanraden!

Anne était en vacances durant mon séjour et c’est son fils qui m’a gentiment accueilli. Ils se dont débrouillés pour me prêter un garage pour la voiture. J’ai passé un agréable moment dans cette belle maison.

Wat een prachtig huis, met heel veel licht en planten en een heerlijke sfeer, we hadden nog veel langer willen blijven! We hebben een hoop goede tips gehad van te voren en zijn heel erg gastvrij ontvangen door Anne's zoon. Onze kamer was heel fijn en we hebben 's ochtends heerlijk koffie gedronken in de mooie tuin. Nogmaals dank voor het fijne weekend!

It's a great place to stay in Belgium. Anne and her sons are very friendly. The house is very cozy, the interior is very beautiful and exclusive. Anne and her children helped us a lot and gave us helpful advices. We felt like at home. I would love to come back again!:)

We had a great time at Anne's place. Anne was not there, but her sons hosted us splendidly. Anne's place is like a museum. It has the most beautiful terraces and garden and is spread out over 6 stories, about 2 rooms per story. Lots to explore. You receive lots of tips and info in advance and the hosts are very open and very nice. If you have any question - i am sure they will be answered. The house principle works on co-habitation which you can feel right when you enter - very nice! The location is perfect to start exploring Antwerp!
Don’t miss your chance to stay in this beautiful home! Anne is also a warm, knowledge expert host. You won’t regret it.

Staying at Anne's place was delightful, she and her son Basil were very kind and the house is just amazing!
She told us about all the places we need to visit in Antwerp and made sure we fully enjoyed our trip.
Anne en haar gezin zijn zeer gastvrij, gemakkelijk in de omgang en bieden een uitstekende basis om het mooie Antwerpen te genieten. Voorzieningen waren prima. Zeker een aanrader!

This is easily on of the best Airbnb’s I’ve ever stayed in! The room is beautifully furnished, bright and spacious, and we were very comfortable there. Anne was the perfect host and gave us great local tips about what to see and do in Antwerp. The house itself is a endlessly fascinating, with an eclectic design and a gorgeous garden. It’s also a short walk from the train station. I would happily stay here again!

Alles wat je van een groot statig huis mag verwachten en dan aangevuld met warme kleden, lange gordijnen en heeeeel veel om te bekijken. Het lopen over de groene krakende trap geeft je een rijk gevoel.

My five night stay greatly exceeded expectations.

First, there was the large quiet room, filled with both books and light.

Then there was the kitchen, focal point of the house, where I prepared and enjoyed meals.

Lastly, there was the friendly atmosphere and generous hospitality, which really made for a special visit.

Thanks, Anne!
Fantastic place to stay!
Anne's family was really kind to us and gave us a very warm welcome. Everything was perfect and so we had a great weekend. It was a pleasure to stay at Anne's place. Thank you very much!

Antwerp is beautiful city with no doubt. When You arrive by train the first that hits you is it's amazing central station that not only inside but also outside astonishes with architectural gems. And it gets better after. The same You can say when You arrive here. It's beautiful and full of wonders. Books, sculptures, green staircase and little ornamental features of every room will make You fell like in wonderland (at least that's how I felt). When You get to your spacious room you will admire stained glass windows filtering the light inside like you could just imagine looking at the pictures. You're tired after travels, so there is a coffee pot, chair and more books. Did I mentioned  back garden oasis that transfers you into nature sanctuary in the middle of city at any time. I definitely didn't mention heart and soul of the house - because, yes, I leave the best for the last. Anne and Manu. All in all this place and people there are worth a book. So if you ever wander what to do in Antwerp and Plantin-Moretus is on your list - that's good. MAS museum? - for sure. Anne and Manu's place - definitely!  Thank You!

Highly recommend!! What a wonderful house they have.
It was really nice stay. After booking, Anne gave me lot of information for direction easier get to house, some popular places of Antwerp, her recommendations and so on. It was helpful to make a plan in Antwerp. I could visit some places. I wouldn’t have visit if she did not.
About House. It is amazing. Details, furnitures, about everything is really cool. I even see wallpapers when I climb (Website hidden by Airbnb) Any things and anywhere inside the house are like a museum. Garden as well.
So when I pick up the key I was going to leave quick but house is really cool I couldn’t do it.haha
There are coffee and tea in the room.
Family members are warm welcoming.
All of things is great!!
I personality think stay at the house is the reason to come to Antwerp.
I would book for it if I come again Antwerp.
Thank you so much.

Anne and Manu's house is a museum of curiosities. There are little objects everywhere. The room is very spacious and comfortable and there is a lovely garden in the house. Anne was very helpful with insider tips and local knowledge right from the moment we booked the place. Staying at their place was a unique experience, one that we will always cherish.
Very nice hosts. The rooms are clean and the place in general has a lot of charm.  Great location.
What a beautiful place. So close to the tram stop too. I would recommend staying here.

Anne was incredibly thorough and communicative. Her daughter Martha was the host, who was kind, friendly, and very welcoming! She lives in the back with her sweet little dog. The place is  an incredible mansion, in a quiet beautiful neighborhood, great location, clean, comfortable, everything you want in an air bnb.
It was really wonderful. Everything was as good as expected. Thanks!
It's an amazing house. I hope I get to stay next time

Kom ook overnachten in dit karaktervolle herenhuis, district Borgerhout! We werden hartelijk ontvangen door Anne en hebben er heerlijk geslapen in de Lovers Room. Een huis om verliefd op te worden met haar krakende vloeren, prachtige trappen, vele planten spiegels en talloze boeken. Tip (aan alle Nederlanders): je hoeft echt geen fiets te huren. Wandel naar de Dageraadsplaats, de Draakplaats, het Museum Plantin-Moretus, MAS of ontdek het Begijnhof. Een weekend om niet te vergeten!

It is a very cozy and clean house and in my opinion it is beautifully decorated. The hosts are very friendly and hospitable. Also, the location is really nice: close to the central station and not too far from the centre of Antwerp. (Next to the house there is a spot where you can rent a bike for a very low price, which is great if you want to see every corner of the city.) We have had a wonderful stay.
Very nice, special fairytale house with lovely hosts.
Second stay. Friendly people, beautiful house and great location (near train station).
Prima lokatie, schoon, prettige ontvangst. Je moet niet slecht ter been zijn: smalle trappen en badkamer/ wc redelijk ver van de slaapkamer.
The house is beautiful and hosts are very friendly, open and helpful people. We were happy to stay with tchem. The location is also fantastic. Thank you Anne

The Booklovers' house is really charming - and most of all the hosts! I really enjoyed the stay in a terrace house with loads of character - including the furnishings, a plenitude of interior plants and atrium. It was so much nicer to be 'en famille' than to be in an anonymous hotel room.

Anne, the host, provided lots of useful information on Antwerp some weeks before I arrived and was always ready to help with more questions. The house is in a great location close to the central station and about 20 minutes' walk to the city centre - so perfect for anyone wishing to visit Antwerp for a few days.

The stay was very relaxed and the hosts friendly while remaining discreet at the same time. Perfect!

Anne's place was great. Her house is a wonderful old town house decorated with interesting antiques and personal touches. My room was so cozy and full of character. Anne made me feel at home immediately and was always responsive to my questions. She offered excellent advice about sight seeing and the city. Her description on AirBnB is very accurate. There are a lot of stairs, which are very easy to climb. Her cute dog Dennis was good company when I was practicing my viola in her sitting room! A definite plus. I'd definitely recommend her place and would stay there again if I find myself in Antwerp sometime in the future!
Amazing place like fairytale! Kind host family will help ur journey much more abundabtly joyful!

Een mooi e kamer in een prachtig en smaakvol ingericht huis.  De foto's liegen niet.  Ook nog eens vlakbij centraal station.  Je kan van hieruit makkelijk naar alle hoeken van Antwerpen.  Anne is gastvrij en behulpzaam.  Een uitstekende plek om te ontspannen en te genieten.  Dankjewel.

The stay at Annes house was great! We got lots of those precious insider tips, that make a trip so great. Would easily reccomend this to anyone who wants to have an authentic experience of Antwerp. Super hosting also by the daughter Martha, who gave us a lot of tips.
Geweldige ervaring. Het is een prachtig huis vol prachtige antieke decoratie en prachtige planten. Wij hebben intens genoten van het huis, de gastvrijheid en de leuke en vele tips.
Great AirBnB experience in a superb location.  Highly recommended!
Anne’s apartment is beautiful and lovely. I wish that I would have chance back in summer. Anne, Thank you so much for all of kind arrangement.
Een gastvrij ontvangst met ampele informatie over interessante plekken in de stad.
Prachtig huis op een mooie locatie. Wel gehorig, maar dat hoort ook wel bij de charme van een oud pand.
Een prachtig interieur, verzorgt tot in de puntjes. Wat een feest om hier te mogen verblijven!

Ons verblijf in de book lovers room was erg fijn. Het is een prachtig oud huis, dicht bij het station. Het huis is wel wat gehorig, maar Anne d'r tips en hulp maken dat helemaal goed. Ze is erg milieubewust, en inspireert gasten om dat ook te zijn.

We had a great stay at Anne's! After a very warm welcome and a tour around the house she shared her knowledge about the city, where to find the good places, and supplied us with a lot of additional information. The house is absolutely beautiful, with many of the old details still visible and plants, books and art in every part! They rent out the room based on the idea of co-habitation and open up their house for you, so make sure to read the instructions you get carefully. It may seem like a lot, but it all comes down to living with respect for the environment. Good location: behind Central Station but not in the busy part. Highly recommend the place!
Anne is centrally located a few minutes from train station. She will help and inform you what you need to know. Her hospitality is wonderful, I recommend her highly! Thank you Anne!
This apartment is so beautiful, and the hosts are very kind too! It's clean there, you'll have your privacy of you want to... I really have no reason to claim. Thumbs up!

Great place to stay - close to everything in a quiet area - it seems to be pushed back for 2 centuries.
Thanks Anne and Manu for your uncomplicated hospitality.
Ursula&Nina
Anne's place is incredible and unique. Perfect place to discover Antwerpen.

Anne’s hospitality is flawless and the house is an incredible wonderland of exquisite furniture with all the comfort you could need.

Anne and her daughter Martha communicated with me at all times and their recommendations were terrific.

The bed is super comfortable and all amenities are thought of for you.

The location is perfect for a visit to Antwerp, within walking distance of most places and public transport very close by.
Prachtig huis, zeer sfeervol, lieve host. Al met al een erg fijn verblijf op een prachtige locatie.

I’m really happy to have chosen and stayed at this place! The house is absolutely beautiful - styled in a bohemian / vintage style with lots of plants and antiques all around. My room (I had the one for book lovers) was very spacious and had everything I needed (including a personal sink, which came in very handy as I was sharing the bathroom). Initially, I was a bit hesitant about booking a room that’s not en-suite, but the cleanliness of the shared bathroom (which is bigger than my bedroom back at home) was totally on point! The only things I didn’t like were the pillow (I should’ve probably asked for another one!) and the fact that you can hear when the person next door comes up the stairs and in their room, but that’s usual for old houses, so can’t complain at all! In terms of location, the property is 10 min away from Antwerp Centraal, so everything is within walking distance. Finally, Anne was a great host, always helpful and informative, who made sure I had a good stay - thank you Anne! When I come back to Antwerp, I’d make sure to book this Airbnb again.

Anne and her family are amazing hosts full of stories about Antwerpen. Both being writers, their house is a homage to the intellectual spirit. We replenished within days where we usually need weeks. The house is restored with care and attention to the detail. A genuinely rare get away!

The best place in Antwerpen is that appartament! Didn't want to go elsewhere! Very inspired by that amazing place. Saw sweetest dreams under a beautiful laced blanket and made a lot of photos with amazing vintage interior  pure love!!!

Ik was als fotograaf opzoek naar een mooie klasieke locatie. Nou die hadden we bij Anne gevonden! :) Mooie stijlvolle kamers, met prachtig licht en veel verschillende soorten hoekjes. De bedden waren helemaal prima!
Anne´s place was an amazing house with lot´s of history and interesting details.

I wholeheartedly recommend Anne's place. The house is a wonderful example of Flemish architecture and perfectly situated between the more touristy center and the lovely squares in the south east that seem preferred by locals. Anne and her husband and experienced hosts who'll make you comfortable quickly.
Hartelijk ontvangst, nette en mooie kamers, fijne plek om je op vakantie te voelen.

It‘s a lovely old house with a lot of plants and antique things. Sometimes you feel like you‘re in a museum (in a good way). The hospitality was really great. We felt more than comfortable and would totally recommend it.
We enjoyed our stay very much, Anne is a very caring host. We can recommend at all!

Anne was a wonderful host, ready with great suggestions for things to see and do in Brussels. Her unique home is a destination in itself. We appreciated her concern about our comfort during an unprecedented heat wave. Thanks, Anne!  Highly recommended.

Staying at this house will definitely add another story to your trip :) It is a deep diving into completely different surrounding with lots of stylish old interior details. I took many photos yet there are more to see - sculptures, pictures, plants, big furniture, tiny furniture...

We had a double room with a bit yellow window glass, which make the room look sunny during any weather. It is a big nice room, though I also like a pink room with a double bed. Would recommend a couple to stay there. Thanks to Anne for all the details about the city. She is prepared to give you any information about museum or places to visit or bars. Plus she has maps and guidebooks :)
Nogmaals bedankt voor de gastvrijheid en goede zorgen! Groetjes Ralph en Vasanthi
Stijlvolle kamer, prima voorzieningen en gastvrije ontvangst!

Encore merci à Anne pour son accueil et ses temps d’échange...
toujours un plaisir de revenir !

We enjoyed Anne's and her family's hospitality and the pleasant atmosphere a lot. The whole house has a unique touch - Any book lover is sure to instantly fall for it. Due to its proximity to the train station, it turns out the perfect starting point for a exploration of the town! Warmest recommendation!!
Thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Anne’s place. Lovely room and house in general. Very accommodating.

Ideally located, Anne's place is beautiful and full of charm. Room is great, very comfy. Anne is a very welcoming hostess and she gave loads of very useful tips for my stay. Definitely recommend staying at her's.

a beautiful, historic home, full of tasteful and interesting treasures.
the entire family went out of their way to offer comfort and good advice.
the many stairs mentioned (41 !) were a great workout ! (and we accepted their immediate offer to help us with our bags)

It was lovely to stay in Anne and Manu's home. They are welcoming and friendly and always ready with tips and interesting conversation. I learned a lot too! Highly recommend to anyone who wants to stay in a home with other people. Anne and Manu made it very wonderful. And the house is drop-dead gorgeous!
Conveniently located very close to train station, very clean, nice place in general

The private room is wonderful! The neighborhood is centrally located and all of the must-see spots are reachable by foot. As a solo female traveler, I felt extremely safe in their house and in the neighborhood! The room is beautiful and has every amenity that you would need - hair dryer, WiFi, water heater, extra blankets, etc. Anne and Manu were very helpful in providing recommendations of restaurants, shops, and museums. I would highly recommend!

The door of the historical house of Manu and Anna is open. Expect warm hospitality and cherish this.
Its a special oppertunity to be a guest. Anna is willing to share so much information and enthousiasm about Antwerp. Co-housing at the best. Thank you both!
Super mooi huis, lieve mensen, fijne en heel rustige kamer. Weg van toeristendrukte maar dicht genoeg Bij alle interessante plekken

Deze kamer in het huis van Anne is een heel fijne en ruime plek. Met fijne voorzieningen zoals koffie, thee, een eigen wastafel, een extra bed en groot bureau om aan te werken. De persoonlijke tips en adviezen van Anne zijn heel erg gewaardeerd en maakte de ervaring compleet en volledig 5 sterren waard, dank voor alles en alle gastvrijheid!
Nice place with awesome atmosphere. Close to the city(walking distance)

Fantastische slaapruimte dat mij snel een thuisgevoel gaf.Veel houtwerk,krakende trappen,,houten ramen,hoge blafonds,grote keuken met vloertegels en omgeven met tal van planten.En natuurlijk ook een sfeervolle badkamer met ligbad en doucheKortom voor ieder een aanrader op wandelafstand van centrum Antwerpen!!!!
Prachtige plek, fijne mensen, heerlijk kamer/huis. Aanrader.
I had a very pleasant stay. The house and room are clean and tidy, and accurately depicted. The hosts are friendly, responsive, and knowledgeable.

Our stay at Anne‘s was really great! The house was gorgeous and like a little museum. We have slept very well and were ready to explore the city at the next day. Anne gave us a lot of helpful recommendations, what to do and were to eat and drink. Anne and her family were very caring, open-minded and friendly! We have enjoyed our stay a lot!
Goede lokatie. Geweldige sfeer met al die mooie oude meubels!
Beautiful room in the heart of Antwerp and great family to stay with!

Wonderful stay at Anne's! Lovely house, people and dog :) Anne and her family were very kind and welcoming. It felt like home.
Would definetely suggest and come back.

Anne is a great host! Her house is situated in a lovely area very close to public transportation. Our room was beautiful and clean. We enjoyed our coffee in her lovely yard and we met her wonderful family that helped us explore nice places in the city! We really felt like home! For sure it is an experience to stay there!
They are lovely people with a lovely home and will help you where they can.

I had a great time staying with Anne and her family. They were very welcoming and answered all my questions. The room ist very cozy and has lots of interesting details. I especially liked how eco-friendly this household is :)

Bart was amazing! We felt instantly welcomed and "at home". He's courteous and a great host, offered us everything we needed, told us where to go and gave us useful tips.

The apartement is clean and cosy, the architecture is interesting and spacious. The room is nice and tidy. The place is close to the city center, so we walked everywhere, a big supermarket is just around the corner.


We didn't miss a thing and highly recommend to stay at Barts place! I'm sure we do when we revisit Antwerp.
Prettig ontvangst. We hebben de verhuurder maar kort gesproken omdat we wat haast hadden. Alles was netjes in de woning. Geen minpunten. Prima geslapen. Verhuurder erg aardig.

We had à Greet time in Bart's house. It was very tidy and spacious (Website hidden by Airbnb) is very friendly if anyone want to enjoy their time in Antwerp, I suggest this place for him or her.  This house is 10-15  walk to the down town.

Bart is a friendly person who has a nice room to offer. It is very clean and spacy. I can only recommend this for anyone who is going to Antwerp. You can also walk from the centralstation to his house.
This is what Airbnb is all about. bart was really on the giving side all the time and gave us good tips on what to do and we really felt at home. Beautiful place and beautiful person.

This was our first Airbnb experience and we really liked it! Thanks Bart for making it such a positive experience. We loved staying at your place and having the flexibility to come and go as our schedule allowed it. Your room was as advertised, simple and clean. Bart was great, generous (thanks for the breakfast :)), friendly and helpful (we got great tips for visiting the city).
The apartment is not located in a very nice neighbourhood, yet close enough to one of the many city bike stations (bikes are great for exploring Antwerp!) .

It was a really nice trip to Belgium for me and staying in Bart's house was one of the reasons that made the trip so wonderful. The room was exactly like what we saw in the photos, and Bart was really welcoming.   Bart gave us really accurate information about the location of the place so it was really easy to find. Very close to the central train station. His apartment was really great, very clean, comfortable and spacious. He gave us lots of advice about where to go for good food! We arrived pretty late in the evening after an unexpected exhausting trip from England to Belgium, and found an amazing Moroccan place open 24/7  around the corner in the middle of night. And the food was GOOD. My friend and I went to Antwerp for a conference at Uni of Antwerp. We walked to the university everyday because we enjoyed walking through the city. It took us about 25mins. There were buses around, we also saw bike rentals around. There's also metro/underground stations within 5mins walking distance, which is really convenient for us to get to the Cathedral side and the other tourist places. Bart was so nice to lend us his metro pass and so we didn't have to pay extra for buying the pass(so just paying for the ticket fee, which is like 1.4 euro per person). I really enjoyed my staying and would recommend Bart's place to my friends!

My friend and I stayed with Bart for 2 weeks while we studied at Antwerp University for a summer school course. Bart was away when we arrived but we had arranged the check in well in advance, and when we got in we had our beds and towels ready for us... And we absolutely loved the apartment - it's spacious and tidy and just half an hour's walk into the centre. Bart replied to our emails right away when we had any questions. He was away some of the time but when he was there, he gave us recommendations of restaurants and places to go. A very nice friendly man! I would stay there again if I go back to Antwerp :)

Bart's house is so nice big and clean, just the same as the photo. And he was so nice to let us use two beds to sleep well. And if you are traveling with car, his house is the best choice because he has a garage. Thanks again for his warm hosting.

Nous n'avons pas rencontré Bart mais il avait tout préparé pour faciliter notre venue, nous laissant même des guides et des plans pour découvrir Anvers. L'appartement était très confortable, très beau et très propre. Tout s'est parfaitement passé. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.

Afgelopen weekend ben ik van vrijdag tot zondag met mijn vriend in barts appartement verbleven. Hij was niet thuis maar had van te voren al heel duidelijk via de mail omschreven hoe we binnen konden komen en waar de auto geparkeerd kon worden. Het appartement was prachtig en van alle gemakken voorzien. We waren echt heel erg enthousiast. Ook was het prima te lopen naar het centrum, het station enz. (15/20 minuten lopen). Op zondag had ik gevraagd aan Bart of we savonds uit mochten checken, ook dat was geen probleem. Bart was een hele fijne host en door hem en zijn appartement hebben we een geweldig weekend gehad.

Bart wasn't in when we visited his house but his instructions were really clear! He was very responsibe and helpful so we had no trouble locating his house. His house is way, way more beautiful than we had expected!! Defiitely recommend if you are looking for accomodation in Antwerp

Bart was erg snel in het reageren wat het prettig maakte in de aanloop naar het verblijf toe. Ook zagen we elkaar heel kort in het appartement waarbij hij meteen aangaf dat alles te gebruiken was. Erg fijn!
Er lagen ook handdoeken en een welkomstbriefje klaar in onze kamer.
Met de stadskaarten die we erbij kregen kon het weekend niet meer stuk!
De buurt is wel onprettig. Dat moet er wel bij vermeld worden. Het is afgelegen en door donkere straatjes.

Rundum Perfekt! Mehr ist dem kaum hinzuzufügen.
Bart ist ein toller Gastgeber und das Appartement ist wirklich der Hammer!
Sehr sauber, gepflegt und modern eingerichtet.
Bart gab uns genügend Tipps und zeigte uns in Ruhe alles.
Zum Parken hat er uns seine Garage zur Verfügung gestellt.
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und würden jederzeit wiederkommen.

Our stay with Bart was outstanding. Way before our arrival we received a detailed document giving us basic information about the accommodation etc.  When we arrived Bart wasn't home, but we could let ourselves in. Later that day when we met him, we found him to be a very friendly and generous host who did his best to make us feel at home and enhance our stay in Antwerpen. The house and room were clean, spacious and comfortable. What we particularly also liked was how quiet it was inside. Although the location might not be in the very heart of the centre, the neighborhood feels very city-like and the centre can easily be reached by rental bikes, or by foot if you don't mind a walk. In sum, we certainly recommend this place (provided that you enjoy culturally diverse neighborhoods).

Ik ben erg tevreden met mijn verblijf bij Bart's huis. Het huis is erg mooi, ruim en heeft een warme sfeer waardoor je je thuis voelt. Locatie was perfect en je had ook een hele mooie uitzicht vanuit de slaapkamer. Ik vind het zeker een aanrader!
Ons bezoek bij deze verhuurder was ideaal. Het appartement is qua locatie ideaal, de woning is zelf zeer ruim en comfortabel. De privacy was zeer gewenst. Hartelijk bedankt!

Obwohl ich mich zu spät bei Bart gemeldet hatte, war er sehr vorsorglich und hatte schon mir per Email geschrieben, wie ich vorzugehen habe, wenn wir ankommen. Seine Wohnung ist sehr sauber und gemütlich. Eine bessere Bleibe hätte ich nicht aussuchen können. Wir hatten die ganze große Wohnung nur für uns das ganze Wochenende lang.

Siamo stati accolti in modo famigliare e messi a proprio agio.
Bart è un ospite organizzatissimo e presente per ogni necessità pur lasciandoti completamente libero.
Il quartiere è silenzioso e multietnico, ogni confort è a due passi da casa. il palazzo è un piccolo gioiello di architettura contemporanea. L'appartamento con ogni confort è luminoso ed accogliente. ci si sente a casa mentre ammiriamo il cielo d' Anversa dalle panoramiche finestre.

Our stay with Bart was great! The instructions given on beforehand were clear and made it easy to get inside even though Bart arrived later in the evening. The apartment is fantastic, really spacious and well decorated. The room which is rented is great as well. Nice clean and slightly bigger than normal bed, clean towels en stuff you can do in Antwerp. Had a small drink as well with Bart, he is a really cool guy! A big recommendation!

We hebben een erg prettig verblijf gehad. Het is een fijn, netjes en ruim appartement en alles wat je nodig bent is er. Locatie is ook prima, we vonden het niet erg om 20 min naar het centrum te wandelen. Het contact met Bart verliep snel en goed. Dit is zeker een aanrader!

Very nice and clean and spacious apartment with a beautiful view!! It is conveniently located near the central station. Bart wasn't there when we arrived, but left the keys for us. Communication was uncomplicated and Bart responded very fast to messages. Would definitely recommend staying there! We had a wonderful time in Antwerp!

We had a wonderful stay in Antwerp. The flat is very spacious and modern. Situated in quiet area with easy access to the city centre and attractions.
Even though Bart was not there that weekend he gave us very detailed instructions how to access his apartment and the garage. We communicated via email and Bart was very good at replying straight away and giving us all necessary advice.
We couldn't be happier with everything and would definitely stay again.

Bart made me feel very welcome, and provided clear instructions on how to find the apartment even though he was away during my stay. Communication was great, and he was quick to respond to all of my messages. Bed was comfortable and the room was spacious. Thanks for the great stay!

Just like the other reviews I read before booking, I found Bart to be a really nice, genuine person and I had a really nice time staying at his place.
