The bedrooms are large and comfortable, the kitchen is equipped with everything you might wish for.  The house is even more impressive than the fotos could tell. We can absolutely recommend the place and Tom as a host. Even though he wasn't there to welcome us personally his neighbour Justin made sure to show us the house and explain everything we needed to know.

Zeer warm welkom door de buurman van de verhuurder, hij hielp ons zelfs met het uitladen van de auto's!
de buurt op zich was niet zo heel bijzonder, wel fijn dat we zo dicht bij de stad zaten.
Het huis was net zo gaaf als op de foto's, heerlijk ruim en schoon en zeer compleet, lekkere zachte en ruim voldoende handdoeken, zeep en wcpapier. Superfijn dat we dat niet zelf mee hoefden te nemen.

Met 9 vriendinnen hebben wij een heerlijk verblijf gehad in dit geweldige huis! Het is nog veel mooier in het echt dan op de foto's! Ideaal huis om met een groep een weekend of langer weg te gaan in deze gezellige stad. Wij komen zeker nog een keer terug. Aanrader!

Our stay at Tom's Belle Epoque townhouse was beyond wonderful. Our family (8 people and a child) was able to stay comfortably in this beautifully renovated home during a rather sad time in our lives at which we all needed to feel close. Not only were all rooms super clean and cozy, the furnishings, well stocked kitchen, attention to detail ( fresh flowers, large beautiful houseplants) made us really feel so welcome. The proximity of old town, major shopping streets, central station and Central Park made it also very convenient. We only needed a car to get out of town. Thank you, Tom and family

Wat een fantastisch huis, met schitterende kamers, een geweldig fijne keuken en meer dan voldoende ruimte voor 5 stellen. De foto's laten bij lange na niet zien hoe mooi dit huis is. Tom heeft ons erg goed geholpen. De locatie is top, erg centraal. Tom bedankt!

Our group of 8 had high expectations of Tom & Anna Sofia's house, and they were more than met! Their very kind and hospitable neighbor Justin was very flexible in accommodating our odd requests of meeting times, was there at the ready when a heavy rainstorm brought in a little water. The house is big and held us all well, and the well equipped and supplied kitchen and dining area let us all congregate and share each others' company. The bathrooms were modern and well put together, there was space in the basement alcove for our 6 bicycles (5 were folding), and we never felt cramped or alone.

Within a short walk was a small grocery, bakery, kebab shop, and tram stops. We were there for work and didn't have much time to explore the immediate area.

Heerlijk verblijf gehad!
Alles was zelfs nog beter dan op de foto's
Locatie was perfect om hapje te gaan eten, te shoppen.
Gewoon TOP, aanrader!

We had a lovely few days in this beautiful family house. We were 4 adults and 2 children but there was plenty of space for an extra family with 2 children and more. We came back thinking we would just love to live in such a house on a daily basis! Decorated with tasted, large yet homely, fabulous kitchen, and felt more like a hotel than a let out house. We could happily spent the whole day in the house. Completely suitable for children - just be ready for the stairs as in any typical belgian house. Tom and Justin were very helpful - we really had a lovely time.

Het Belle Epoque Townhouse is een erg groot, mooi, sfeervol huis op loopafstand van het centrum van Antwerpen.
Bij aankomst zijn we zeer vriendelijk ontvangen door Justin die ons alles kon vertellen over het huis en de omgeving.
Het huis is zeer compleet ingericht; handdoeken, zeep, keukengerei, kruiden, thee, etc. Alles was aanwezig!
Wij hebben het er met 8 vriendinnen erg gezellig gehad!
Echt een aanrader!

Wir hatten ein wunderschönes Wochenende in diesem unglaublich schönen Haus. Das alte Stadtzentrum ist sehr schnel erreichbar und wir hatten eine tolle Zeit mit der Familie. Das Haus ist noch viel schöner als die Fotos das zeigen könmen. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen.

We had a short stay in Tom's lovely house as a part of a business/educational trip for me and my team. The pictures don't really do the house justice--it's so much more beautiful and grand!

There was an incredible amount of space for all of us to spread out and relax--very rare when we all travel together--and a lovely table where we could all eat together after the long day's work. Tom (and his neighbour, Justin, who kindly let us in and showed us around as Tom was unavailable when we arrived) were both lovely and super-responsive when messaged. Thank you so much for letting us stay in your beautiful home, and for making us feel so welcome!

Wij hebben een heerlijk weekend in het mooie, ruime (!!) huis van Tom gehad! Met in totaal tien vrouwen hebben wij ons super goed vermaakt in- en rondom het huis en hebben wij genoten van de heerlijke tuin en de grote keuken en kamers. Tom heeft ons van tevoren enorm geholpen bij de voorbereidingen van dit weekend weg. Bedankt Tom, we hebben genoten!
Dana + 9 anderen, uit Amsterdam
Amazing place, great location, great host, everything perfect. The house looks a lot lot better in real life than on the pictures :) Will be back again!

A great place to stay. Very spacious and charming house even better than the pictures. Justin was very nice on the arrival and everything was well organized and easy. Thanks Tom, we look forward to coming back.

Exeeding expectations. We stayed with a group of 8. The house is great and very well equipped. Cozy atmosphere and luxury feeling on a central spot in Antwerp. Communication with Tom is easy and to the point. Easy checkin and checkout. Recommended!
Amazing house, and great hospitality! I wish we could have stayed longer!

Tom's house was even more beautiful, spacious and comfortable than it already looked in the photos. It is an extraordinary place located very near all main Antwerp cultural attractions, shops and bars/restaurants. Justin was a perfect host, kind and helpful, and he gave us all the information and Antwerp tips we needed to have a perfect stay. We found the perfect house for a memorable family holiday.

The house is lovely – grand, with high ceilings, and also comfortable. Ann-Sophie, who showed us round, was very thorough and helpful. The location is good, near the centre and with excellent tram links.

We had arranged to arrive at 2pm, but there was no one at the house and we could not get through to Tom by phone or email. Eventually he rang us at 6:30, saying he had been on a plane and lost his phone. He was very apologetic, arranged for Ann-Sophie to let us in at 8pm, and offered to refund us one night’s rent, which we accepted. We were very glad that in the end we were able to stay in the house.

Antwerp is very attractive, especially around the Grote Markt, and we enjoyed going up the MAS tower, round the Rockoxhuis, and playing scrabble in the oldest pub in Antwerp.

Beste Tom,

Ons weekend Antwerpen van 2 tm 4/9 was geweldig.Antwerpen is een fascinerende stad.Ons verblijf in Belle Epoque (niet te verwarren met de Zoo) gaf een bijzondere dimensie aan dit vriendenweekend.Het huis is prachtig en heeft alles om je comfortabel te voelen.Als we geweten hadden dat Justin wel voor ons had willen koken hadden we dit zeker overwogen.Dit huis vraagt erom om er veel rustmomenten in door te (Website hidden by Airbnb) directe omgeving met veel orthodoxe Joden is intrigerend.
Tramlijn 4 stopt voor de deur en brengt je linea recta naar het centrum, maar ook lopend is veel bereikbaar. Het CS is prachtig, het Pomphuis een aanrader en brouwerij de Koninck niet te missen. Een stadswandeling met Carolyn maakt het nog completer.We kunnen iedereen aanbevelen dit huis te huren.Hartelijk dank voor de gastvrijheid en de ontvangst door Justin. Gr. Henk, Marius,Karel, Lex, Luurt-Jan en Coen

What a wonderful house and such a great location! We can highly recommend this beautiful place.
Very spacious, clean and well maintained.
Just in a few minutes walk you’re in the center. The kitchen is really comfortable and with great amenities.
Tom and Justin (who received us) are very kind and helpful persons.

We enjoyed our stay very much, thank you so much.

Wonderful townhouse. Very spacious, all ameneties. Close to old town. Very easy access to tram (only 50 m walk). Great for couples (with children) and in our case for 5 colleagues during a multiday congres. Plenty of privacy but still together. Great teambuilding.

Our guest totally loved everything about the house!
The had an amazing time!

Sehr schönes und ruhiges Ambiente in Antwerpen zum Erholen und Ausruhen, perfekte Unterkunft für eine Gruppe.
Sehr geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Ein ort zum Erholen.

Marvelous address!
Pro's:
Bed/kitchen linen inclusive, also high quality towels etc
No extra charges, so clear pricing
Perfect location
Super flexible check-in and -out
Highly equipped house
Good communication

No con's
This address is highly recommended for e.g. family reunion.

Thank you Tom and co, we had a perfect stay.
Prachtig huis in leuke stad! Dikke aanrader!

it was GREAT!!!!
thanks to Tom and Justin.
perfect house....
An amazing house and a great stay. The photos don't do justice to this beautiful townhouse. I thoroughly recommend.

The house is amazing, greatly located and super spacious. I is so big that my little nephews were even scared the first night and though it was a castle! Everything was clean and in great shape. Perfect for a big family or a few couple who want to explore the city.

Das Haus liegt gut zur Innenstadt um alle wichtigen Punkte zu erreichen.
Die Einrichtung ist super. Die Zimmer sind großzügig und nett eingerichtet.
Die große Küche lässt keine Wünsche offen.

Prachtig huis met alle comfort die je kan wensen. Uitgebreide keuken om te koken en een perfecte tafel om met zijn allen aan te eten en na te praten. Ideaal zijn de meerdere badkamers en toiletten zodat je met een grote groep op tijd aan het ontbijt kan beginnen.

Dit huis is heel speciaal door het oude, historische pand dat mooi is verbouwd en van moderne gemakken is voorzien. De ligging van het huis is uitstekend. Echt een aanrader!

I can only echo the glorious reviews so far. The layout of this beautiful villa is perfect for intimate gatherings for medium groups, whilst being big enough to allow people downtime alone.
The kitchen is fantastic - a dream! And perfectly set up for dinner parties, or a buffet breakfast.
I definitely plan to return next time I am in Antwerp!

Myself and a few friends stayed at Toms for a long weekend in Antwerp. Tom was very accommodating and communicated promptly. Faith in human kind is somewhat restored! Although we didn't get the chance to meet him, it all went very smoothly, we met his neighbour who was incredibly helpful with showing us around the house (the grand tour took about 45 minutes because it's so big! And was great at giving us tips to the city). The apartment itself blew our minds somewhat. It's so much more beautiful in real life. I've never stayed in anything quite like it! The neighbour hood is nice as well, there was enough going on in the local area to keep us entertained for a long weekend. I'd definitely recommend it and I'd love to come back in the summer with a bigger group of people.

Toms Haus ist genau so wie beschrieben. Wir waren mit 8 Leuten dort, jeder hatte Rückzugsmöglichkeiten, es war aber auch ausreichend Platz um alle zusammen zu sitzen. Die super ausgestattete Küche verleitete zu gemütlichen Kochabenden. Die Betten waren super bequem, rundherum ein gelungener Aufenthalt!
Uitstekende locatie voor groepen die hun eigen stadspaleis willen hebben voor het weekend; echt bijzonder mooi, zeer aan te bevelen!
Fantastico

We were celebrating a family birthday and this house was perfect. Plenty of space for all 9 of us and a real treat to spend it somewhere so grand, yet comfortable. The kitchen was really well equipped and we had some great evenings in the house. Would highly recommend, the house was lovely, easy to book and it was great to have Justin next door.  Thanks Tom and thanks Justin.

With a large number of people we had a great stay at this beautiful big house. Everything we needed was provided for. It is an old mansionhouse with very tall ceilings. A large kitchen suitable for cooking for large groups. Our short stay was very comfortable. Thank you Tom for your hospitality.

Wij, 10 oud hockeyvrouwen van rond de 70, hebben genoten van dit mooie, oude, in stijl gemoderniseerde, luxe huis met alles er op en er aan om je thuis te voelen. Het ligt op een prima plek voor mensen die een stukje lopen naar het oude centrum geen probleem vinden. Er gaat trouwens wel een tram. Wij hadden voor alle dagen fietsen gehuurd en dan sta je na 10 minuten ook in het centrum. Beheerder Justin was zeer behulpzaam en vriendelijk en eigenaar Tom goed bereikbaar via telefoon en mail. We kregen goede tips over supermarkt, de bakker en leuke restaurantjes in de buurt.
Echt een aanrader voor een groep vrienden of een gezin met kinderen (ook alles voor aanwezig), die wat luxe en veel ruimte om te logeren zoeken. Als je 's avonds TV wilt kijken is dit wat teleurstellend (oude TV met weinig kanalen, wel in de chique bibliotheek), maar wij hadden daar eigenlijk weinig belangstelling voor.
Tom en Justin, dank van ons allemaal voor de fijne dagen die we hadden.
This was our second time at Tom's place and everything was great again. Tom is a great host and all communications are easy and quick. I would definitely recommend it

Prachtig huis, stijlvol met mooie details.
Super keuken. Centrum op loopafstand. Tram 4 voor de deur.

We had a great stay at the Belle Epoque Townhouse and were sad that we couldn't stay longer. I'd definitely book again.

The house is decorated with charming taste, combining simplicity with eye to detail and the history of the building. Rooms were clean and comfortable, as were the bathrooms (three). The kitchen is very well equipped, not in the least with a great stove we used for cooking breakfast. There is a beautiful library / television room that we haven't explored enough. The garden is pretty and provided us with a welcome cool place to sit.

It was easy to park our cars down the street and for the rest of the stay just walk into the city centre.

Tom was prompt and kind in his responding and Robert was so kind to let us in and show us the house.

Tom was great - good communication and very easy to work with to book our stay. His neighbor actually met us and showed us around, answered every possible question we could have thought of, and offered to make himself available as needed throughout our stay. They were incredibly gracious, and the house itself is gorgeous. Lots of beautiful touches and charm.

One thing (which I can't fault them for, as it was advertised totally accurately) I would mention is that if you are traveling in the summer, it can get quite warm, and there are no fans in any of the rooms except the one all the way at the top, and the windows are also unscreened, so not something you can really leave open to try to get a breeze.

Overall, we would definitely go back, but because some of our group has a hard time with the heat, would plan for a cooler season.
Prachtig zeer ruime accommodatie. Ideaal voor grote groepen.

Tom is a very good host. His house is really beautiful. Everyone was impressed at first sight. He chose and decorated the house uniquely. He deliberately chose and share this truly wonderful place. The communication was excellent. In the house there is a fullly equiped kitchen. The backyard make you feel relax. I hope anyone who has stayed at this house, please takes care of this beautiful house well. I have stayed in this house for only 5 days, but I feel loved in the house. Moreover I can feel that Tom is really good person. I feel so guilty that some of our group make his home a mess. I am very pleased to pay compensation for him to replace that part. And hope to help him repair his house
Great place! Spacious and great location!

It's a wonderful weekends for us. Perfect castle like big house, big kitchen, full sets of table wares. Not to mention the outdoor BBQ pit. It's perfect for family or friends to spend a weekends there. Washroom in every level. If you are close enough, two of you can share one bed, it could take 13 ppls. Chinatown is nearby and we love Chinese foods! Highly recommend!

Wir hatten ein super schönes Wochenende in Toms Haus. Das Haus ist einfach riesig, das wird auf den Bildern überhaupt nicht richtig sichtbar. Es war alles vorhanden was man so braucht. Die Küche ist super ausgestattet und Tom (sowie sein Nachbar) kamen uns mit allen unseren Wünschen entgegen, was wirklich super war.

Absolute Reiseempfehlung, auch für größere Gruppen.

The house is amazing. High ceilings, great interior, comfortable beds. We visited the house with the maximum number of guests for a weekend and there was more than enough space for everybody. Tom thought of everything, even a tablet with the most important apps to go around the city was available. It is close to the city center and a bus stop is just 50m next to the entrance. There are multiple places to eat and shop groceries in the neighborhood. Highly recommended !
Sehr stilvolle, wunderbare Unterkunft; Straßenbahnanschluss um die Ecke. Sehr zu empfehlen.

Fantastisch mooi huis, fantastische stad. Super weekend gehad met 10 vriendinnen. Veel te doen, veel te zien. In een mum van tijd in het centrum met openbaar vervoer of stadsfietsen. Zeer vlotte communicatie met eigenaaar en een super ontvangst door Justin. Aanrader!
Excellent house!

Het huis van Tom is werkelijkwaar super gaaf en ontzettend mooi! De leefruimte en de open keuken maakt het knus en gezellig. Er zijn voldoende slaapkamers en op elke verdieping is een badkamer en toilet aanwezig wat wel handig is. Alles klopt aan dit huis! Wij hebben er onwijs van genoten!

Dit huis heeft onze verwachtingen méér dan overtroffen. Wat een prachtige en luxe ruimtes, en heel fijn dat de heerlijke bedden al zijn opgemaakt. Met de tramhalte voor de deur ben je zo in het centrum, maar te voet ook zeker te doen (en minstens zo leuk).
Ongelofelijk prachtig huis. Een absolute aanrader
Absolutely lovely home in an interesting area. Great reception from Justin. If you bring a car you should register it at the tourist info office. On street parking was fine. I would love to return.
We had a great time. It's a very nice house with enough space for everybody and close to the city center.
Really lovely the stay. Very homey,  Great kitchen facilities and a beautiful house !!
Great place to stay for a weekend and explore the city. House is beautiful, comfortable and clean. Great location, walking distance to city center.
Grand house, great kitchen with all you would ever need and beautiful library.

When we walked into Tom's townhouse it was nothing short of amazing! from the gourmet kitchen, spacious dining area, multiple living areas and not to mention some of the most comfortable beds I have ever slept in. This townhouse is definitely one for the record books! Well done Tom, we will be back!

Your house was so nice is we had a hard time leaving it to visit Antwerp, which is a really good sign of how good we felt in there I think :)
We booked this place for a friends reunion, and it was just the perfect place for that ! Plenty of space, amazing kitchen that we used to make a great dinner all together.
A really great place, and we even started talking about getting back here next year, so who knows :)
I can tell you that your house was really appreciated by everyone. Thanks !

Supergroot huis (in het echt groter dan op de foto's/in omschrijving). Alles is aanwezig.  Het huis is erg mooi en schoon. Tuin is ook fijn.  Ideaal met kids. Wij waren met 6 volwassenen en 5 kinderen en dat pastte makkelijk in De vele ruime slaapkamers en drie badkamers. De wijk is rustig (veel Joodse gezinnen) en dichtbij het park. Parkeren ging ook makkelijk.
Très belle maison de charme, très bien située et équipée. Anvers est une ville magnifique.
Prachtig groot oud huis, van alle gemakken voorzien. Zelf een tuin! Goede locatie, alles in huis netjes en verzorgd.

We hadden alle lovende recensies natuurlijk wel gelezen, maar het huis was in werkelijkheid nog mooier en groter dan we gedacht hadden. Met ons achten hadden we heel veel ruimte en het huis was van alle gemakken voorzien. De joodse buurt is interessant, we waanden ons echt in een andere wereld. We hebben Tom zelf niet ontmoet, maar buurman Justin stond stanby om al onze wensen in te willigen, thank you so much!

Tom's place is terrific.  Justin (neighbor) met us and showed us all around the place and very patiently and politely answered all our questions.  Is located very close to Centraal Train station.  Great supermarket just down the block and 3 min walk to super bakery.  A 10-15 min walk to the Meir (City central pedestrian plaza - a must visit!) with plenty of pubs and eateries on the way.   The townhouse itself is huge!  Was like nowhere I’ve ever stayed.  My family and I felt like royalty.  Huge fully stocked kitchen.  Plenty of bedrooms and bathrooms.  Great patio out back…very quiet and green.  Main floor has kitchen, large dining area, a living room and another sitting room in the front of the townhouse.  We all mostly hung out on this floor.  Very comfortable and roomy.  I would definitely stay here again and would recommend it to all.  Thanks Tom and Justin for a wonderful stay!!

Amazing, beautiful period house, perfect for groups of friends or, like us, a large family with a few kids. Very good location and infrastructure. Impeccable service/ check-in/ cleanliness. Tom and his neighbour Justin were very helpful and professional. Great value for money. Would (will) definitely recommend it to anyone.

The house is very beautiful and really spacious. We stayed there with 6 adults and 5 children, and there was so much room for us all! Tom is a very friendly, obliging host - we enjoyed our stay very much!
Amazing house, amazing stay!
Heel gaaf huis! Vier verdiepingen, grote ruimtes en perfect voor een grote groep. Het huis was (nog) beter dan op de foto’s. Alles was aanwezig. Het huis ligt 30min lopen naar het centrum. Aanrader!

This is a really beautiful, spacious house in a central location. It is 10 minutes walk from the city centre, which is full of interesting things to do, or just enjoy wandering around the pretty old streets. Justin, who greeted us, was extremely helpful, and gave us information about places to visit and local shops and restaurants.
Ik had hoge verwachtingen gezien de reacties van eerdere gasten, maar deze werden zelfs overtroffen. Wat een fantastisch pand!

Very nice Townhouse in Antwerp.
Everything as described.
Tom was a great host. Easy and fast communication.
I can highly recommend that place.
20 min walk to the heart of Old Antwerp.

We had a wonderful stay at Tom’s house with all my family. Grand-parents, adults and kids really enjoyed this beautiful, spacious and confortable place !
Thank you Tom !
great place to stay with plenty of rooms for many guests and a well equipped kitchen. Great host as well.

Prachtig huis, we waren hier met een vriendinnengroep van 9 vrouwen! We waren onder de indruk van het huis. Alles wat nodig is, is aanwezig. Toen we aankwamen hebben we veel tips gekregen over een leuk verblijf in Antwerpen. Kortom we hebben volop genoten!
great property in central Antwerp. Highly recommended for larger groups.
Tom’s house is really amazing and well worth visiting. The welcome provided by Justin was also very warm and friendly. Highly recommend!
Prachtig groot huis, met alles erop en eraan! Ontzettend fijn weekend gehad met 10 andere dames.
Top aanrader!
This is an amazing house.  We loved staying there.  It is huge and well cared for and is an excellent base for a visit to the city either as a group of friends (as we were) or for a family.

Wat een prachtig huis is dit. Het is echt heel veel groter dan je van tevoren kan inschatten op de foto's. Perfect voor grote groepen. Er is alles wat je maar nodig kunt hebben. Alles is ook ingericht in de stijl die bij zo'n huis hoort.  De bedden zijn goed, de badkamers prima, de keuken perfect en de leefruimtes super! Qua locatie zit je ook erg goed en je bent lopend, met de tram of met een electrische step (Bird, kan je huren) zo in het centrum! Winkels en eet gelegenheden om de hoek. De gastvrijheid van de eigenaar/buurman is ook super. Je krijgt een duidelijke uitleg/rondleiding en tips over Antwerpen als je die wilt hebben. Ik raad iedereen aan om hier te verblijven!

Superbe maison ! Idéale pour un grand groupe. Cuisine, table à manger et terrasse parfaites pour grand brunch entre amis ou en famille. Centre ville accessible à pieds. Nous avons passé un très bon moment ! Je recommande :)

Amazing space, luxurious beautiful home enough room for family of 11 in whole house.  Great tips about the local area and host Tom responded very quickly to any queries I had before we arrived. Definitely worth a stay to explore Antwerp - with the local team stopping outside!

The house was amazing! It was much bigger than we expected! It is fully equipped with everything. Kitchen has basics, tea, coffee etc.. Shops in very short distance to buy basics, even shop open until 2am! Comfy beds, lots of towels provided and also shampoo and shower gel.  The location is quite central, walking distance to the station and the centre. We arrived around 10.30pm at night on the train and walked, safe area. The house has a ground floor then 3 more floors where the bedrooms are. There is also a garden out the back. This would be nice to sit out when the weather is good. We didn't spend much time in the house as we were out and about. Definitely recommend Chocolate Nation to anyone who likes chocolate! Tom answered all our questions promptly and organised his colleague to meet us at the house. There was no problems with this. I definitely recommend Tom's place for large groups of people. We were 7 and it was perfect!

Een prachtig huis op een perfecte locatie. We hebben een geweldig weekend gehad met 10 vriendinnen. Alle nodige voorzieningen zijn aanwezig en het huis is nog veel mooier dan verwacht. Absoluut aan te raden.

Super Super House. Super stylish, super comfortable beds - with a great kitchen and bathrooms.

It was a 15 min walk into town with great local eateries for breakfast, an amazing chocolate shop for gifts and a large supermarket for essentials. We really enjoyed Antwerp and would highly recommend staying here.

Een fantastisch huis! Iedere kamer is een nieuw beleving. De buurt is leuk en op loopafstand van het centrum. De communicatie met Tom verliep erg soepel. Justin ontving ons ontzettend gastvrij en stond het hele weekend voor ons klaar. Echt een aanrader!
Prachtig huis. Veel groter dan verwacht. Van alle gemakken voorzien. Communicatie verliep perfect
Amazing building, excellent location and great equipment! Would always come back for my next trip!
A really spacious and good location.
We stayed at this amazing place and had a great time. The building is beautiful, very well decorated with small details. Everything was very clean. All in all 10/10!
Niet twijfelen gewoon boeken, echt een prachtig huis!!
This is a beautiful house that is beautifully decorated and has lots of space. Perfect for a visit with a group of friends. Tom is very quick in his responses and very helpful.

This house is a real jewel. The location in grand. Grocery very near by. Trolley very near. And a very walkable distance to central Antwerp.

The house is amazing!! We were travelling with small children so did find we moved some of the lovely fragile pieces into a “no-go” zone for their protection. And of course restored them to their actual place apron checking out.

I can truly say I have never stayed in this interesting and intriguing home.

Thank you Tom!

Het huis was in het echt nog mooier en groter dan op de foto’s! Ook fijn dat er dingen zoals kruiden, olie, shampoo etc. aanwezig waren. De check-in met Justin verliep ook erg goed, hij heeft alles in het huis uitgebreid laten zien en veel leuke tips gegeven voor activiteiten en restaurants. De ligging van het huis is ook goed, kwartiertje lopen naar het centrum.
Tom really was a superhost! Thank you for everything, I hope we will be back soon.

We had high expectations about this stay and it even exceeded them. We’re a young family with small kids had the most wonderful stay at the townhouse. The only danger is not wanting to leave! Very centrally located, right by public transport, easy to get around by bike or by foot as well. Clear and friendly communication with the owner, very accommodating.

5*
Clean house , easy check in , nice area ,for sure we will be back !

Fantastisch huis, van alle gemakken voorzien. Zeer goed geoutilleerde keuken. Heerlijk terras met ruime zitgelegenheid.

Goede audiospeler en beamer.

Parkeren kan in de bij het huis behorende garage.

Heldere communicatie, gastvrij onthaal

Een absolute aanrader
Veel mooier en ruimer dan op de foto's. Geweldig genoten en zeker dikke aanrader

Wij verbleven tijdens ons vrienden weekend met 10 personen in deze fantastische AirBnb.

Het enorm grote huis overtrof al onze verwachtingen. Je hebt als je de foto’s bekijkt geen idee hoe groot het huis is.

Wij raden deze AirBnb zeker aan!
Uitgebreide ontvangst, Chique Villa met voldoende badkamers om je 's ochtends in klaar te maken. Was voor ons een geslaagd weekend.
Prachtig huis!
Fantastisch verblijf! Gigantisch mooi herenhuis centraal gelegen in Antwerpen. Alles is op loopafstand goed te doen. Een echte aanrader voor groter gezelschap.
Prachtig huis en genoten! Fijne locatie en snel in het centrum. Heel erg goed geholpen bij ontvangst.
Great house! Everything went perfect, excellent communication! We had a wonderfull time!

Fantastisch ruim huis. Het is nog ruimer dan op foto's. Mooie complete keuken en ruime verbinding met woonkamer. Het geheel heeft goede sfeer. Dat begint al bij binnenkomst, grote hoge stalen deur en direct daarachter ruime hal met trap omhoog.  Ruime benedenverdieping en daarboven 3 verdiepingen met slaapkamers en op elke verdieping een badkamer. This is very wonderful staying with Martha’s family. Martha was in her camping, so I met her short time, but she is very nice and kind person. Most of time, I stayed with her mother Anne, her husband Manu. They are very nice and kind and helpful people. We had many talking time and talk about travel and culture. They told me good places to visit in Antwerp. All the area is very nice and beautiful. They are very kind and nice people, so I’m happy to meet them. During my staying, I felt in my home. The room is very clean, spacious and cozy. I could use kitchen, wifi, towels and washing machine etc. A bathroom is very spacious and clean too. Location is very close to central station about 10mins by walking. Also, son, Cornelius is very nice and kind. It was very pleasant meeting them and staying the house. I highly recommend to someone want to visit Belgium.

Martha and her family provided a warm welcome for me. The room as well as the hole house are super beautiful and almost a bit like a museum. The family gave a lot of recommendations, what to do in Antwerp. Even though I was out of the house most of the time, we had nice and informative chats when I came back. Everything was clean and the pictures matches reality. I would totally recommend this accommodation - especially when you are on a short trip alone.

Martha was enorm gastvrij en vanaf het moment dat we binnen kwamen, voelde we ons thuis. Als er iets was, konden we haar altijd bereiken. Het huis is prachtig! Bijna een museum waar je in mag leven. De locatie is perfect gelegen en alles wat je nodig hebt is goed bereikbaar. Zeker aan te raden voor een stedentrip!

Martha was a wonderful and helpful host. The house and room were very comfortable and beautiful. And the location was great! I highly recommend staying here if you are visiting Antwerp. Thanks, Martha!
Mooie kamer in een prachtig huis op loopafstand van al het moois wat Antwerpen te bieden heeft

I felt amazing. Lovely old house, exactly as in the pictures, situated right next to the central train station, 10 min walking distance to the shopping area and 15-20 to city center. Quiet and safe neighborhood. They made me feel like home.
I went for something related to work so they made sure it was quiet for me, I was able to rest very well in all my stay anyway.
Also they gave me maps and touristic indications.
You can have great coffee!!
One morning I had time to stay and have breakfast with them, we had an entertaining conversation and I am not one for 'family eating time', but this one was good, a nice part of my holiday.
The dog is so cute and friendly!!
To sum it up I totally recommend the place! :)

Manu greeted me upon my arrival and Anne arrived not long after. Manu showed me a map of the city and suggested many great places and sites to visit, and then Anne showed me around the house. IT. IS. BEAUTIFUL! Seriously, this is my dream home, filled with antiques and books and charm. Their office reminded me of the library from Beauty and the Beast! I threatened to move in permanently after being inside for less than an hour. ;)
The house itself is in a great location, close to the train/bus station and within walking distance to pretty much everything you'll want to see.
Manu and Anne were kind and lovely, as were their kids (young adults, in case you were worried about little ones running around), who I met only briefly. I would not hesitate to stay there again. If I go back to Antwerp, I'll go back to their home.
P.S. Dennis (the dog) was a fun addition, too!

Wat een warm welkom. Zeer gast vrij. Prachtig huis op een uitstekende loop afstand vanaf centraal station. Route beschrijving is ook top. Uitstekend faciliteiten aanwezig. Niets dan lof over de bewoners. ik kom hier graag nog eens logeren.
Dank je wel!
Jeroen

Lovley room, very easy and friendly family. Great location.
Very recommended!!

The location of the house is perfect, very close to the central station of Antwerp. It took me not more than 7-10 minuts to get there with my luggage on foot as well as the way from the place to the Market square took not more than 20-25 minutes walking. Martha and her family were very friendly and helpful. The house is beyond expectations, it's comfortable, spacious and cosy. The room is ideal for a solo traveller, not too small and you can find there all you might use, the furniching is also very nice. I highly recommend this destination and the hosts. I will definitely stay there during my next time in Antwerp.

Too bad it's winter so the ivy out front is all brown. However, the inside looks exactly like the photos if not better! I didn't get a chance to meet Martha but her parents are super helpful. Manu helped me with my luggage all the way to my room which is on the 4th floor (thanks again, Manu!) so I would recommend everyone to pack light. :)

Make sure to go check out Cogels-Osylei. Amazing neighborhood! Big thanks to Anne for the recommendation.

What an appartement and what an host ! Martha and their parents are amazing. She kept communication open with us all through out our arrival and checkout process. The house is amazing and the house if perfect for a quiet nightstay. I highly recommend the hosts and the lovely apartment in antwerpen

Martha's room is beautiful, light and comfortable. It is the perfect stay, sleep and work room in a quiet and cosy house.
Martha and her family are most hospitable, friendly and easy-going. They offer their home for you to enjoy and are very helpful.
The house is gorgeous, interesting and very clean. It was the perfect place for a visit to my home-town!
I like Martha and her family and would love to visit again.
amazing house, beautifull room, and very nice hosts. very well equipped room too! thank you for the hospitality and for making things easy! thanks for lending me an umbrella.

Goede, hartelijke ontvangst met kopje thee en alle uitleg.
Fijne kamer, prima badkamer en keuken. informatie over Antwerpen.

Het was fijn!

The whole family was really friendly and flexible and I felt welcome in their beautiful house. Martha's room was nicely decorated, very clean, calm and the bed was comfortable. Great location: the central station is near, as well as the tram lines and grocery stores. Would recommend!

Martha en haar familie hebben me een warm welkom gegeven in hun heerlijke huis. Hartje Antwerpen, met fluitende vogels in de tuin. Het was alsof ik even in Antwerpen woonde. De kamer van Martha is ruim, licht en gezellig. Bovendien had ze een lijst met goede tips, ook een aantal 'geheime plekjes' die toeristen doorgaans niet kennen. Ik kom graag nog eens terug!

Anne, Martha en de rest van de familie hebben mij zeer hartelijk ontvangen. Op het moment dat ik aankwam, waren zij aan het bbq'en met de buren, maar dit leek totaal geen probleem te zijn. Anne nam de tijd om mij het huis en de kamer te laten zien.

Het gehele huis is super sfeervol en de ligging is ideaal: rustig, maar toch zo vlakbij het station. Ik heb uiteindelijk in een van de tweepersoonskamers geslapen en alles was perfect. Fijn vond ik dat er in de slaapkamer een wastafel en een waterkoker met thee/koffie aanwezig was.

Ik kan een verblijf hier van harte aanbevelen. Leuke mensen, leuk huis en een leuke stad; ik heb genoten!

I had a great stay with Martha and her family. They were all extremely welcoming and friendly, and made my stay comfortable. The house is amazing, and I had a restful night of sleep. I enjoyed Antwerp and would definitely stay here again if I return!

Martha was super kind and helpful - she even drove to the station to see if I needed help. Even though the house is close to the train station, I had a super quiet night and slept wonderfully in the comfy bed (with mosquito netting - I heard the mosquotes buzzing but they could not get in to bite me!). Martha was accommodating - for example, when I left something in the room after my departure. Thank you, Martha! For some people who are not used to stairs - realize you need to walk downstairs for the (super cool and practical) bathroom. This was exactly the place and the comfort I needed to get a long night of sleep after some intensely exhausting traveling. If I had had the time, I would have gone to the under-the-radar places Martha’s Mother recommended - I am saving them for next time.

My stay in the house of Martha was fantastic. I found their house exactly What is explained in the profile. Tram station is just very close to the house. Central station is on a walking distance but the tram also goes directly there. The house is absolutely majestic, like in a fairytale. Beautiful house and the garden. The hosts are especially very hospitable people. I was given complete details of the house and quite enough details of the city of Antwerp by Basil.

As a whole I would recommend it to everyone, if I come to Antwerp again I would certainly stay here.
Lovely people, excellent accommodation, very good communication! Thank you!
She was very welcoming and charming, and her house was very stylish and comfortable.

Bij Martha en haar familie was het heerlijk vertoeven. Zeer sfeervol huis en fijne ruime kamer waar je ook lekker zelf kopje thee of koffie kunt maken. Goed bed! Rustige buurt.
Lekker dicht bij het station en fietsverhuur in de buurt.
Zeker een aanrader!!

The location really cannot be beat- I loved exploring Zurenborg and the surrounding area, and it's nice to be someplace so un-touristy yet so close to the train station and all the main sites. The house is really amazing- really unique- and the room was comfortable and quiet.

I really loved staying at Martha's place! It is a very beautiful house, and the family took really good care of me. Casa bellissima, una famiglia di intellettuali. I figli dei proprietari sempre molto gentili. La casa è molto comoda per chi viene in treno perché è dietro la stazione

This place is walkable distance to Central station. Homely stay and it was pleasure meeting the family who are very friendly and provided suggestion to visit sight seeing. Also, it was pleasure to meet the little family member Denise(Dog) who was very adorable and friendly.

The home is antique and brings back medieval period home recalling history

Accueil très chaleureux et famille très sympathique. La maison est pleine de charme. Le logement est conforme à la description donnée et nombreux conseils utiles ont été donnés pour la visite de la ville.

A warm welcome. A beautiful house. A perfect visit. It was my first Airbnb experience and I liked the friendliness and the chance to glimpse local life being lived behind doors, but also the trust and independence granted me.

This was absolutely perfect. When I arrived, Anne gave me a friendly and efficient tour of the (beautiful) house, and the room is even nicer than it looks in the photos. There were lovely and unexpected special touches as well. I was very happy with my stay and would certainly book again if I need to stay in Antwerp.

I highly recommend this room. I received an immediate response accepting my request and the house is very close to the station. I could also walk to all the places of touristic interest. I felt very welcome at all times, the family is super friendly. The room (and the rest of the house) is as cozy as it looks in the picture.

Wonderful people and the most beautiful authentic house you can wish for! really close to Antwerpen Centraal trainstation! I would love to go back there myself so I obviously recommend a stay with this family.
Anne is a very nice host, she provided many efficient advices about the museums, the places she likes. And her house is very beautiful, clean. I wish I can go there again.

Loved the place, it's one of the best airbnb experiences I've ever had. Anne was super helpful and friendly, starting from pre-communication to her warm welcome to her house. I really enjoyed my stay there, the decor is quite interesting, it's right in the middle of a residential area, which is something nice to experience, it's quiet, and only 10 minutes away from central station, although I mostly walked around the city or rented a bike. Anne, her husband and son were nice enough to just welcome me to their breakfast in the morning where we had super interesting discussions as they're very interesting people. I am definitely hoping I visit Belgium again, if I do, I will surely stay with them again :)
Séjour agréable. Hôte accueillant et de bon conseil pour la visite de la ville. Maison confortable. Que demander de mieux pour visiter Anvers ?
Very nice and fun family.  Everything was excellent.  Nice
A wonderful stay in a beautiful cosy home :) I was given great suggestions to make the most of my time in Antwerp!

A very beautiful, friendly and pleasant house and familly that I can definitely recommend, full of history and sensitivity! Matha is doing a very good job making it a home for everybody who happens to stay with them!
Loved it.
Very friendly and welcoming family. Nice neighbourhood and a clean and nice house.

I had a great stay here. The house is very comfortable, and the family very welcoming. I was just there for a quick over-night visit, but was welcomed in to share their house like an old friend. Had I stayed longer, I'm sure I would have gotten to know the whole family.

I'm not sure what Martha does professionally, but she should consider being a tour guide. She was very helpful, pointed me towards several attractions I wouldn't have found by myself, and helped me plan my day's travels. (Not to mention giving advice on taking the train in Belgium, providing the secret shortcut to her place, and filling me in on Antwerp history!)

My room was spacious and clean, as was the whole house. The place is tucked away on a side street just a few minutes' walk from the train station - easy to get to, but quiet at night.

I had a lovely stay and would recommend Martha's to anyone visiting the area.

I had a great stay in Anne's beautiful home, which is itself like a cabinet of curiosities. The room was comfortable and quiet, and great to return to after a day's exploring. Anne was very welcoming, and sent me loads of tips before I arrived. She also took the time to explain how to get around once I was there, which was really helpful. I walked into town everyday, but the tram stop into the centre is only a 10 minute walk away, next to the central station. There's also a supermarket close by. I would definitely recommend staying here and hope to return myself someday. Thank you, Anne.
Hun huis is een juweeltje in de stad, vol met authentieke kenmerken. Je word zeer vriendelijk ontvangen en ze geven je veel tips over Antwerpen. Zeker een aanrader!
Excellent quiet room at great central location. Wonderful host, recommended!

I had a quick visit to the city and stayed at Anne's house for one night. She was very helpful with recommendations on what to visit and see. The room itself had very interesting decor as well as the rest of the house. The neighbourhood is quiet and the public transport is nearby.

I had a great a stay in Martha's room. I didn't get to meet Martha but her mother was very welcoming and made sure I had everything I needed. The house is at a great location (quiet but near to the centre) and has a great atmosphere. If I go back to Antwerp I will definitely check if Martha's place is available.
Beautiful house, very close to central station as well as trams and city hire bikes. Great hosts, very communicative and helpful.
Really quite, really friendly hosts.

I think that it was perfectly prefect !! Precision, communication, welcome, it was all perfect ! Anne help me a lot before I come in Belgium and give me advice for the country and the city. She was very kind and it fell in love about the house and Anne and his family... eveeeenn the dog waaas so cute !! If I come back, the first thing I will do is to go see her again !!

This is a beautiful old house, centrally located which is great. It is clean and neat and has everything you could need. The hosts go out of their way to make sure that the guests are comfortable and settled in.
I would definitely come again and recommend it to my best friend.

This accommodation was excellent very eccentric and a bit of a curiosity I loved the house and Basil was very friendly when I met him, I would highly recommend staying her if you are looking for something a little different.

This is a very beautiful home located very near the Antwerp Centraal train station. Basil was a great host with wonderful recommendations.

Communication before-hand was great - all my questions were answered and directions from the train station were clear and quick. The room was cosy, clean and comfortable. I was made to feel very welcome and would recommend this to any travellers! Cute little dog at the house too :)
Great stay! Thank you.

One of the best rooms I lived in bnb. The room is perfect. Only few mins walking to central station. The house is classic with modern equipment. The communication is so good, and everything is organized well. Highly recommended.

During my stay I met Cornelius and Basil who welcomed me nicely, and also sweet little dog Dennis. There are a lot of neat things to discover. The room is on the second floor, steep stairs to climb, and it is easy to feel like home. The bathroom is shared by everyone but with the sink in the room it is easy to manage without blocking the bathroom. I appreciated the way of communication before and also all of Cornelius' suggestions of where to go upon my arrival. The house is very conveniently located, the neighborhood very quite, grocery shops and tram and train stations close by. I've had a wonderful time in Antwerp thanks to the whole family, and I absolutely recommend to stay with them.

Aanrader! Alles is aanwezig wat je nodig hebt. Je hebt voldoende privacy en Basil en Cornelius zijn heel attent en vriendelijk. Ze geven tips over de stad en welke plekjes je zeker moet bezoeken. Het is een leuke kamer en in elk hoekje van de kamer valt wel wat te bezien. Gezellige houten vloer en woonkamer is erg cosy. Je mag alles gebruiken, tv, keuken en badkamer. Une très jolie maison, originale et bohème ; un jardin comme on en rêve tous ...un accueil des plus sympathiques ; Basil est charmant et c'est intéressant de bavarder avec lui

The house is very beautiful. It has big living roon, kitchen and garden. I got the chance to meet Basil and Cornelius, who were my hosts. Both were so cool and we had good chats. They even let me leave my luggage before check in time. I strongly recommend this place.

Excelente habitación, muy espaciosa e iluminada. Tiene un lavabo que es muy útil para lavarse los dientes y manos al regreso de los paseos.

Basil fue muy buen anfitrión. Me sugirió muchos lugares para visitar en la ciudad, además me dejó guardar unas pequeñas botellas en el refrigerador y siempre estuvo dispuesto a ayudar.

Definitivamente recomiendo este lugar.

Un excellent souvenir de cette maison chargée de souvenirs où les objets les plus divers et poétiques nous charment et font rêver.Basil et Cornelius ont une très grande qualité relationnelle, sont très disponibles. Grâce à eux les diverses facettes d' Anvers ne m' ont pas échappé ! Encore merci !

I had such a lovely stay at Martha's place! The home is absolutely gorgeous, and conveniently located near the central train station. Would definitely stay here again!
If you wish for comfortable home feeling place right in a middle of the city with great connections to central station , and great people, this is exactly what you are looking for!
A lovely room in a beautiful house-a special place. Hosts are very friendly.

Excellente adresse à Anvers, à proximité de la gare centrale (mais non loin du centre historique: 20 Minutes de marche). Accueil chaleureux d'Anne dans sa très belle maison. Perfect AIRBNB in the centre of Antwerp.
I can highly recommend this to anyone visiting this beautiful city.
For sure i'm coming back again. Jeroen

This place is just awesome! Can not say more.. you definitey need to stay at Anne's house, its most probably the best accomondation in antwerp. Great place

Het is een prachtig en fijn ingerichte plaats waar je je snel thuis voelt. De tips van Anne maken dat je je helemaal een ‘local’ voelt.

A wonderful stay in a typical Antwerp house, full of character... I was warmly greeted and felt instantly at ease and comfortable. Such a nice stay!

I was in Antwerpen for a night / little over 24 hours. I would highly recommend you to explore the city by foot and take the city flair in.
The room in Anne's house was as described; the house is gorgeous.
Anne was extremely friendly and gave me great tips for the city!

Anne ’s family members are very very friendly and This is a beautiful and artistic house .The room is comfortable,especially in the morning sunshine.And the location is so convenient that you don’t have to travel by car,you can walk to where you want to go.

Excellent accueil, des très bons conseils de visite. Une famille très sympathique dans une magnifique maison. Accès très facile depuis la gare.

This is so nice place that I'd been envying to the owners. The house with a little garden, descrided by the host as a common one in Antwerpen, it is near the central station, conveniently located. Martha is very enthusiastic. Communication between us is great! And her family is very happy, her husband and her daughter and her son gave me a lot of help, I like them. And l like her small garden， for which I stayed quietly for a few hours. I am enjoying this accommodation.
Beautiful home. Super friendly hosts everything was great!

Martha - or I called her Anne - was an extraordinary host. I had a moment to enjoy her beautiful garden and the rest of the house was so pretty that I was already thinking about wanting to come back. The room was very clean, pretty and cozy and the bathroom/shower was very spacious. I had to go to a wedding within walking distance from her house and on my way back past 1am, the neighborhood seemed quite safe. I would absolutely recommend her place to other travelers.

Really enjoyable stay in Anywerp, wonderful house and great location ! I would happily come back to stay again :-)

Dit gezellige familiehuis heeft wel wat weg van een museum. Ik voelde me er meteen thuis. Anne had me over de app al een berg nuttige tips voor de stad gegeven. Haar zoon Cornelius vulde deze bij ontvangst verder aan. Het was een prima uitvalsbasis om de stad te verkennen. Prima bed ook.

I love Martha's house and everyone who's living there including super cute Dennis!! Basil, my host, was friendly and gave me suggestions what else I could possibly see for the second part of my stay in Antwerp.  Both Basil and his brother Cornelius are very knowledgeable about the history of their hometown and just awesome people! Thank you guys for being an amazing hosts and for a great conversations! We made a last minute reservation and thanks to Laila's quick response we were able to make our trip to Antwerpen happen. The apartment itself was great; clean, plenty of space but intimate. On top of that it is located in a quiet street, but close to everywhere you would want to go on a trip to Antwerp! Would highly recommend!

Staying in Laila's cosy apartment in the centre of Antwerp was a great experience. the apartment was every clean, and the street is quite.

Beside the apartment itself, Laila is a great host as well. She prepared everything till the details, and the communication went smoothly, there was even drinks and snack at our arrival.

We will definitely recommend this apartment, especially for couple and if there will be a next time we will chose this apartment again for sure.

We've stayed at quite a few airbnb apartments in Antwerp this year, but Laila's was so far the best. It was so amazing that we decided to only stay there whenever we're in Antwerp. No kidding!!

Laila herself was super nice & helpful and even allowed for very flexible check-in/check-out times, which only made our stay even better.

Tip: you definitely need more than a few days to really appreciate and enjoy the apartment and its location, though. It's a perfect place to stay if you want to be central and explore the city. Coming home from shopping at the main shopping street(s) only takes 5-10 minutes and it's a very nice walk, with quite a few great restaurants and decent cafes and coffee shops on the way.

We can't recommend Laila and her apartment enough. :)

Prachtig sfeervol schoon appartement! Mooi centraal gelegen en een koele oase om naar te ontsnappen in de hitte. Bij binnenkomst stond er een flesje bubbels voor ons klaar. We hebben een heerlijk ontspannen weekendje gehad, bedankt Laila!

Laila was so sweet! She thought of everything, the apartment had toothbrushes, nespresso capsules and all the small things we might possibly need.

Communication was very efficient, Laila was a few doors down if we ever needed anything and could hop across to help.

The apartment itself looks very cool with exposed hardwood. The bed and the sofa were both very comfortable. The location is excellent, a minute away from the old city and the shopping street, easy to reach from the train station as well.

I completely enjoyed my stay in Antwerp!

Прекрасная квартира в оптимальном месте! Идеальная чистота! Все новое и даже техника миэль, хозяйка встретила и проводила, общение было приятным, если была нужна помощь - оперативно помогала. Шампанское в подарок, и прекрасный отдых!

Precies zoals de beschrijving een gezellig, knus appartementje. Het is schoon en heeft alles wat je nodig hebt. Een paar stappen buiten de deur sta je al in de winkelstraat. Ideaal als je een weekendje Antwerpen wil verkennen.

Binnen is aan alles gedacht. Er stond een welkomstdrankje in de koelkast en er waren zelfs tandenborstels voor het geval we die zelf vergeten waren. Het appartement heeft ook een hele fijne douche.

Laila was super flexibel wat betreft incheck en uitcheck tijden. Heel fijn! Wij wisten van tevoren onze aankomsttijd nog niet maar het afspreken voor de sleutel verliep heel soepel. Laila reageerde snel op berichten. Op de dag van uitchecken konden we gerust wat later op de dag vertrekken.
The place and the location were perfect. I really enjoyed being there. I personally think Laila is the best hosts I've had. Place is absolutely lovely and beautiful.

Laila's apartment is super nice and in a great downtown location. Walking distance to everything - including public transportation. Even though we could not meet her, she made sure that we were met by someone who could give us some insider info about Antwerp.

Although Laila was not there to hand me the key when I first arrived, we were greeted by her friend Diego who was very helpful to me. I also managed to meet Laila later on, and she takes extra care to make sure that the people who stay in the apartment is well taken care of. She is also very accommodating and always easy to reach. The place itself is clean, beautiful, and is the ideal place for a getaway in Antwerp. It's also very close to all the historic must-sees of Antwerp, which is another big plus!

We hebben een geweldige tijd gehad in Laila's appartement. Het is gezellig, schoon, ligt op een prachtige locatie en bevat alles wat je nodig hebt. Laila en haar broer waren ontzettend gastvrij en aardig. Zeker een aanrader!

Lovely apartment in the middle of Antwerp. Very kind hostess and everything was taken care of. We were surprised by the completeness of the inventory, luxe bathroom, kind welcome-note and king size bed. We would definitely recommend this to others, Airbnb in its best form :)

We hebben erg genoten van het mooie appartement van Laila. De locatie is uitermate gunstig (midden in het winkelgebied) en het appartement was erg schoon en smaakvol ingericht. Compleet uitgevoerd met Nespresso koffiezetapparaat (incl. Cups), magnetron, waterkoker, mooie televisie en Bluetooth speaker om muziek te luisteren (waar wij overigens geen gebruik van hebben gemaakt). De badkamer was compleet uitgerust met benodigdheden waaronder tandpasta, deodorant, wattenschijfjes, oorstaafjes, fohn, etc.
Het beddengoed en de handdoeken waren netjes en fris gewassen.
De slaapkamer bevindt zich op een soort van vide met aangrenzend de badkamer. De vide/bovenverdieping is makkelijk te bereiken via een vaste/goede trap die midden in de woonkamer staat.

De WiFi verbinding is stabiel en snel.

Ik kan dit appartement zeker aanbevelen.
This is a great apartment ideally located and Laila is a great host. Great communication and a lovely person . I cannot recommend this place highly enough .

This is a very cuty, well designed, feel good accomodation in a perfect spot nearby anything in Antwerp.

It was spotless !
It was quiet and privat.

Laila is very nice and making appointments with her (check in and check out) went very smooth.

Will recommend this place to anyone travelling to Antwerp.

L'appartement est très bien situé, pratique pour un week-end, propre et confortable.
Laila nous a bien accueillis et s'est montrée très disponible.

Laila's apartment turned out to be more lovely than I could even imagine. This charming 2-level flat in the heart of Antwerpen was the greatest place to stay during my whole trip. Everything in the apartment was neat, clean and well organized.
Laila herself was very helpful and responsive. Answered all our questions almost immediately and did her best to make us feel comfortable. She even provided some additional bonuses for us, which was very surprising and touching.
It was a wonderful stay and I'll surely try to stay at Laila's place again if I return to Antwerpen.

Laila's place is a real gem in the centre of Antwerp. A very nice city. Just a couple of meters away from the main shopping street.

Liala is quick in her response and very flexible in arrival and depature time. Would book her place again next time we are in Antwerp.

Ik heb mijn ouders verast met een overnachting, zelf moest ik helaas doorrijden en kon ik niet blijven. Het is een prachtig ontworpen appartement dat ruimer is dan wat de foto's doet vermoeden. Uitgebreide keuken en uitstekend bed. Mijn ouders kregen een warm onthaal en werden verast met wat lekkers. Ze waren vol lof over hun ervaring hier en willen heel graag nog eens terug komen om er langer te blijven.

Lyala heeft een prachtige Loft achtige woning in het hartje van Antwerpen. Bij aankomst was alles netjes, ze had zelfs een flesje prosceco voor ons koud gelegd. We hebben een fantastische tijd gehad in Antwerpen, mede dankzij Lyala

Laila, enorm bedankt voor de gastvrijheid. We hebben een heerlijk weekend gehad! Mede door het knusse appartement en de locatie! Fijn appartement met een heerlijk bed, allemaal heel schoon. Ook heel leuk met dat verdiepingkje ertussen. Daarnaast is dit appartment precies achter de winkelstraat, wat de toegang tot de stad enorm makkelijk maakte. Kortom, zeker een aanrader!

We hebben een heerlijk weekendje gehad in Antwerpen in the cozy appartement van Laila. De ruimte was heel ruim, schoon en lag op een toplocatie. Alles was op loop afstand. Laila was heel vriendelijk en gastvrij. We zouden dit appartementje zeker aanraden en zeker nog een keer terugkomen.
I really enjoyed having Laila as a guest! Great communicator and overall wonderful guest. Left the house clean and tidy. I would love to host Laila again!

Ein originell und liebevoll hergerichtetes Apartment. Die ganze Ausstattung lässt keine Wünsche offen. Ideal auch die Lage im Zentrum in einer ruhigen Nebenstraße. Und Laila war eine freundliche und flexible Gastgeberin. Also ein ideales Quartier für einen Antwerpen-Trip.
This is a great apartment perfectly located great host 2nd visit here hopefully won't be the last.

L'appartement est magnifique, très bien situé, près des magasins. C'était très agréable. Un magnifique weekend.
Merci pour l'accueil.
Perfecte plek midden in het centrum. En alles is goed gereged

Great flat just a few blocks from transit. Super stylish, clean, and perfect for traveling. My boyfriend and I cooked a nice meal in the kitchen, which was really great after weeks of traveling and dining out. Wonderful experience.

We stayed in Laila's place for 9 days, it was my first air-bnb experience. Everything was wonderful - very clean and modern apartment, perfect location, privacy comparing to the hotel. Thanks to Laila for answering all my questions, she's a wonderful host. Definitely recommended!

Een leuk appartment op een toplocatie! Layla was erg behulpzaam in het geven van tips! Ook heel fijn om een lekkere koffie te kunnen zetten en ontvangen te worden met een flesje prosecco..voor herhaling vatbaar!
This apartment is great and Laila was an excellent host! The apartment is large with a big, comfy bed and is a quick walk away from all the tourist activity. Thank you Laila!

Die Wohnung liegt Mitten in Antwerpen und ist absolut gemütlich. Wir fühlten uns sofort wie zu Hause auch dank Lailas kleinen Aufmerksamkeiten die überall in der Wohnung zu finden sind. We hebben genoten van het prachtige appartement dat 1 straat verwijderd ligt van de grote winkelstraat. Hierdoor heb je geen geluidsoverlast, heerlijk rustig. Op het laatste moment besloten om naar Antwerpen te gaan en binnen een uur contact met Leila en alles prima geregeld. Goede service en een fijn appartement. Dank!

A lovely, clean appartment on a great location. All major attractions are really closeby. Communication with Laila went smoothly and it is always nice to be welcomed by a bottle of prosecco :). Very warm welcome by Laila. The apartment was very  clean but most of all very cozy. 30 seconds away from the city center where all restaurants and shops are. The street is surprisingly quit. We had a wonderful stay! Highly recommend if you want a pleasant stay in Antwerp!

Very nice apartment in the center op Antwerp. We found it a bit warm and somewhat noisy, but nevertheless this place is worth it.

Laila responds very quick and polite. She is an example for every other host or hostess.

Had a great stay - Laila was a fantastic host and even came by with toothpaste as I had run out of my own! Location is perfect, just off the main shopping area but even better a short walk to most of the best spots in the city. Highly recommend staying here if you visit Antwerp.

The place was clean and and bright. Great location! In the center of the city but yet on a very quiet street.

Laila responded quickly every time we had a question or a request.

We would for sure stay here again!

Laila was very sweet and responsive as we were getting into the city. The apartment is very cozy and right near the shopping area. It's got a nice big bed, big shower and big couch. What a great spot in Antwerp. Very nice living space and had everything I needed. It is in the heart of the city near the shopping district and a short walk to the water and the train station. I will certainly go back.
Het appartement en de locatie waren helemaal top. Fijn ontvangen door Laila (met een flesje bubbels). Kortom: Een aanrader!
Couldn't fault the host Laila and her property in anyway. The apartment was in a great location and was exactly as described. Communication with Laila was always friendly and timely.

As always, communication with Laila is very easy. A friendly & flexible host. Laila has other apartments on offer in the same street that are just a little bit more spacious compared to this one. Nevertheless, this is a recommended place to stay and explore the city!
super plek voor dagje Antwerpen! Laila was snel en goed te bereiken en super vriendelijk. Parkeergelegenheid aan de overkant was perfect.

Pittoresk huisje, lekker bed en een prima douche! Fijn is dat de parkeergarage letterlijk 5 meter lopen is. Kortom top voor een citytrip met de (Website hidden by Airbnb) zoals het verblijf waren wij ook zeer content met het contact en service.
Super lokatie! Prima schoon ruim huisje.

Laila was a very nice host. I stayed one month at her apartment and I enjoyed it a lot. She made sure that the apartment was clean and comfortable every week. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour à Anvers, l'appartement est idéalement placé. Non loin d'une grande rue très commerçante et du métro. Parking sous-terrain juste en face à 20 euros la journée. L'hôte est très agréable.

We loved this flat! I wish we had spent more than a day here, but it was a perfect landing spot in Antwerp. Very close to all of the shopping and cute downtown restaurants and pubs. Quiet street. Fijn appartement op een ideale locatie in antwerpen. Ook als je met de auto komt is de garage aan de overkant een uitkomst. Makkelijk om met Laila afspraken te maken over de aankomst en vetrektijden. Wij hebben een heerlijk weekend gehad.

We hebben een geweldige overnachting gehad in één van de accomodaties die Laila aanbied. Het appartement was heel schoon, prachtig ingericht en van alle gemakken voorzien. Een heerlijke ervaring en zeker voor herhaling vatbaar! Laila ving ons vriendelijk op en gaf ons een welkom gevoel!
Perfect appartement op een uitstekende locatie

What a wonderful apartment in the heart of Antwerpen! Check-in went super smoothly; Laila was waiting for us at the door as we walked down the street. Thanks, Laila!
Great location and cozy apartment, perfect for a city trip

Het appartement is erg knus en leuk voor een weekendje Antwerpen. Perfecte locatie (zijstraat van de Meir) en alles is dus goed op loop afstand. Nette slaap- en badkamer. Wel wat geluidsoverlast van de bovenburen door alle tussendeuren.
The apartment is really nice, wish we stayed longer. It's right in the center of the city and you can park the car literally 10 sec. away!
Laila Has been super friendly and helpful to Us , the apartement it self its realy nice and cozy , near to the shopping area Meir,i would recommend this place to everyone
Great experience. Excellent place and location for a short weekend break. Laila was very kind and helpful!

Great place for short stays while exploring the city of Antwerp or shopping. There was some construction going on in the street and that made the place a bit noisy. The TV only has some Flemish, French and Dutch stations to view, it would have been nice to get a broader selection for English and German visitors. Everything else worked out fine.
Ik heb een heerlijk weekend gehad! Perfecte locatie en n mooie kamer. Laila reageerde snel op berichtjes en was super vriendelijk

L'appartement de Leila est idéalement situé, tous les sites touristiques peuvent se faire à pied; la gare centrale également
L'appartement est mignon et impeccablement tenu

A recommander vivement

Het appartement is 10-15 min lopen vanaf Antwerpen CS, bevind zich heel centraal en op loopafstand van winkels en musea. Het appartement ziet er prachtig uit, is ruim genoeg voor 2 personen, ligt rustig en is uitgerust met alles wat je nodig hebt voor een compleet verblijf.
Super lekker weekend gehad!
Отличные апартаменты в  прекрасном месте! Квартира полностью соответствует описанию и фото,  очень чистая и красиво оформленная. Лайла дружелюбный и отзывчивый хозяин. Рекомендуем для проживания!
Super Location. Nice and clean apartment. Walking distance to shops, restaurants etc..

Laila was a perfect hostess. Met me on arrival at the apartment and provided all the information I needed.

All in all Laila's place was the perfect perfect location from which to explore Antwerp and I couldn't have asked for anything more. Highly highly recommended.
Thanks for making my stay a memorable one!

The apartment is lovely!! It is in a great location, it's close to main shopping streets and all the tourist sites are nearby, but still on a quiet street just off the main area. We would love to stay again if we ever return to Antwerp, I would recommend the place to anyone travelling there!
Heerlijk groot en schoon appartement op een top locatie in de stad. Enorm genoten van ons verblijf in het appartement en in Antwerpen.
Very clean, comfortable spacious apartment. Laila looked after us well. Great stay in a lovely City. Thanks
Great appartment, centrally located. Totally recommend!
Super hip appartement midden in het centrum. Super dicht bij de winkelstraat en eettentjes en op loopafstand van het station. Een heel fijn verblijf gehad in dit appartement  Zeker een aanrader

Dit super mooie appartement (zoals ook op de foto's te zien) was precies wat we ervan verwacht hebben. Het appartement is erg netjes, de ligging is geweldig, centraler gelegen dan dit gaat het niet worden. De gastvrouw is erg behulpzaam en vriendelijk.

Thanks so much again for the wonderful stay! Beautiful apartment!
The apartment is in a great location, and Laila is very kind and a good communicator. The apartment was very comfortable.

Layla welcomed me into her home with a warm smile, kind words and plenty of recommendations for my stag in Antwerp. I have been living in her house quite two months and I couldn't have found better. Perfect locations for 2 persons, next to everyting you might need.

Ideal gelegen, mitten im zentrum und trozdem ruhig, man bekommt kaum mit dass das apartment keine hundert meter vom zentrum entfernt ist... sauberkeit wie man es sich wünscht, und nicht unwesentlich, ein bequemes riesiges bett in dem man sich vom städtebummeln erhohlen kann! Jederzeit wieder!

Quel plaisir de passer le weekend dans cet appartement boisé à proximité de la rue commerçante!

Un véritable coup de cœur, nous y relogerons à notre prochain weekend à Anvers!

Prachtige locatie! In het drukke centrum bij de Meir op slechts 15 min. lopen van het centraal station. En doordat het in een zijstraat zit toch lekker rustig. A black off the main shopping street, this flat is the perfect place to stay in Antwerp. All of the main sites and attractions are close by. Laila is full of great tips, especially if you need to help finding the right shops for your style.
Tout est parfait chez Laila. L’appartement est le plus propre que nous avons eu. Je recommande cette adresse.
Mooi en net appartement op een geweldige afstand van de hoofdstraat

Mooi, schoon appartement! Heel gastvrij. Ligging is perfect. Centrum op minuutafstand lopen. Aanrader!
Laila is a great host and her apartment is just as great and clean as in the pictures- she truly contributed to our having a perfect weekend in Antwerp!

I was brilliantly surprised by the look of the apartment, better than the pictures. The location of the apartment is ideal for those who want to discover the city on foot.
I will definitely be returning to this apartment multiple times.
Absolutely amazing host, super flexible and I felt welcomed.
The place was excellent and very centrally located. Laila was a warm host and responsive. Thank you !
Amazing!!!! Highly recommend. Great location & super easy check in

Perfect location for walking the city. We loved the loft style apartment and finishes. Bed was big and comfortable, and the apartment was great. Laila was easy to communicate with and made our stay seamless!
Top appartement op een top locatie!

I will recommend this place to anyone who whishes to visit Antwerp!

Laila's apartment is fantastic in a perfect location of Antwerp.  Laila is very friendly and I would highly recommend staying here!
This place is great! Awesome location. Laila is a wonderful host.

Genoten van het appartement in het centrum van Antwerpen. Laila reageert snel, appartement was erg netjes en sfeervol. De twee flesjes cava in de koelkast om het oude jaar mee af te sluiten maakten het compleet. Kortom: een aanrader!

Top appartement, perfecte locatie, goed aangekleed appartement: koffie, thee shampoo van alles aanwezig.
lovely place in a great location.

Laila’s Airbnb is zoals aangegeven: gezellig, schoon en op een toplocatie! Contact verliep vlekkeloos. De Airbnb heeft zeker bijgedragen aan een leuk weekend in Antwerpen!

Laila is super responsive and the place can’t get any better, location is really strategic and even though is almost in the Meir (really busy area) you don’t get any noise!

Laila was a great and helpful host and I would definitely recommend this place if you ever visiting Antwerp :)

Laila was very quick with communication and was adaptable to my arrival time for check-in. She greeted me at the door and offered to answer any questions. The appartment was lovely and met every expectation. Location is fantastic right in between the central train station and historic Antwerp.
Cozy apartment in a wonderful location, right in the centre of Antwerpen. We only stayed for one day during Christmas but it would be fine for a longer period.

Immaculate & unique space in a perfect central location. Laila was kind & communicative and very accommodating for check-in. 10/10 recommend
Really nice and cozy appartment to stay after long day in Antwerpen. Best part that it is close to main street and train station and you cannot hear noises from cars and people. 10/10
We were made very welcome in this flat which was as described - fully equipped and comfortable. Excellent location. A nice touch to leave us plenty of good coffee with the coffee machine.

Pluspunten: Mooi licht appartement, leuk uitzicht aan voor- en achterkant. Prettige buurt. Astrid is een vriendelijke verhuurster die snel reageert op mailtjes. Last minute reserveren was geen enkel probleem.
