Geen mogelijkheid om douchekop op te hangen.
Very nice flat, in a very nice area. Astrid has been very helpful and careful for us. It's been 4 good weeks. :) I'll come back for sure!!

Mooie buurt en locatie. Ik heb Astrid zelf niet gezien dus weet ook niet hoe ze in het echt is, maar de mailtjes waren altijd open en vriendelijk. Over de locatie zelf. Als ik aankwam moest ik zelf nog mijn lakens drogen...  Het appartement is niet echt modern. Veel dingen zijn aan een opknapbeurt toe. Er hangt een hinderlijke geur zowel in de oude traphal naar boven als in het appartement zelf. Spinnewebben in de plafondhoeken en ongelapte ramen. Zwart geschimmelde voegen in de badkamer... Zoals een andere bezoeker ook al aangaf is het dus niet proper en toch betaal ik 30 euro voor schoonmaak? Ook hoor je de bovenbuur luid en duidelijk rondwandelen en zelfs telefoneren. Als ik eerlijk moet zijn: ik kom hier niet meer terug en vind het ver beneden de standaart die je verwacht van een slaapplaats waar je 65 euro per nacht voor betaald.

Voor mij was de ligging van de studio perfect gelegen omdat ik 3dgn in het
Friendship building om de hoek moest zijn. Van Astrid kreeg ik heel snel antw op al mijn vragen, zij is erg behulpzaam. Ook de info vooraf is super uitgebreid. De studio deed zich gezellig en ruim aan. Ik vond het redelijk netjes. Lijkt me ook een prima onderkomen voor een wkndje Antwerpen.

De communicatie met Astrid was snel, helder en duidelijk.
Het appartement ligt inderdaad in een leuke buurt met veel restaurants etc, en je loopt zo de stad in. Het is wel een oud huis, en zeer gehorig (je hoort de buren lopen boven en op de gang).
Het huis is nogal 'versleten', en de 'slaapbank' niet echt een succes (oud, versleten, doorgezakt en morsig). Gordijnen zouden opnieuw moeten worden opgehangen. Er lag een lelijke oude matras op de kast in de slaapkamer, zag er niet fris uit.
Het sanitair is ook aan vervanging toe (wc-pot staat los, schimmel in hoeken en op douchegordijn, geen douchestang).
Kortom: het huis ligt goed, maar zou absoluut gerenoveerd moeten worden.

It was a nice stay at Astrid's place. Great value for money.

The apartment is nice, clean and on a very good location. It's in the new yacht harbor (with many restaurants around) and easy to walk to the Schelde river and into the city. The terrace is nice (currently only reachable via sleeping room window, soon to be more easily accessed via a real door as indicated by Astrid). Thanks!

Topappartement op een topplek! Goed geregelde binnenkomst en overdracht en we troffen het schoon en netjes aan. We hadden het geluk dat er net een gloednieuwe bank en bed was geplaatst, we hadden de primeur!
Het contact met Astrid was helemaal prima, en in Antwerpen contact met Gloria was ook helemaal top.
Alles bij elkaar hebben we een geweldig gezellige vakantie gehad. We'll be back!
Tip: Huur een Velo-fiets voor de tijd dat je in Antwerpen bent.

I didn’t meet Astrid, who was out of the country when I was in her apartment, but we communicated via AirBnB many times and she was always pleasant and helpful. Her friend Gloria, who filled in for her, was very accommodating.
The location of the apartment is great! It’s about one mile from the center of the old town, near the new museums, close to lots of restaurants, near buses #17 to central station and #34 to the center of the old town is about 3 blocks away; a bank/ATM about 6 blocks away, small grocery store around the corner.
The apartment is clean and has nice kitchen well supplied with equipment; clothes washer, dish washer; small European type refrigerator. New sleeper sofa/sectional in living room and new mattress in bedroom. Lots of storage; plenty of linen and towels. Bathroom is tiny but has a large bathtub.
Heat is controlled by a programmed thermostat and is generous. No air conditioning but a fan is supplied. TV with more than 20 channels in several languages; wi-fi is fast and always on.
The stairs leading to this apartment are numerous and old. The apartment is on the America third floor and there are lots of stairs to climb.
Astrid describes this as a “modern studio.” I would call this a traditional three-room apartment. It is two rooms plus a large kitchen.
Tips for future renters: the little restaurant called “Den Hut” around the corner toward MAS (across from the food store) is very good and very friendly. The Red Sail Line Museum should not be missed, and it’s just a block or two away. MAS is also interesting.

Het appartement van Astrid was perfect voor ons weekendje in Antwerpen. Het was netjes en gezellig en er lagen enkele boekjes met info over Antwerpen. Het appartement is ook goed gelegen, vlak aan het MAS. Alles wat we nodig hadden, was aanwezig dus ik zou dit appartement aan iedereen aanraden!
3 months in Antwerp for work: the apartment was in line with my expectations, with the plus to be in a very nice and trendy area of the city.
Top locatie en appartement. Uitzicht op het MAS museum en vrijwel alles op loopafstand. De buurt is een absolute aanrader als je in Antwerpen bent!
Een heerlijk appartement op het eilandje. De leukste buurt van Antwerpen, vanuit de slaapkamer zicht op het MAS. Fijn en goed contact met de verhuurster! 100% aanrader.

Een heel fijn appartementje in Antwerpen vlakbij het centrum en op loopafstand van het MAS. Contact met verhuurster ging soepel en ook met schoonmaakster Gloria. Erg handig was alle informatie (100% Antwerpen boekje!) die aanwezig was in het huisje. Tip: huur een Velo-fiets om lekker door de stad te vervoeren. Top verblijf, dus zeker een aanrader!
Top location, took us 10 minutes per feet to get to the city center. Everything was nice and clean, communication was uncomplicated. Would stay at Astrid's place again!

Astrid rief eine Woche vorher an und klärte, wann wir uns wo und wie treffen. Super! Es klappte alles Reibungslos.
Die Wohnung ist angenehm groß, es gibt leere Schränke für die Klamotten, ausreichende Anzahl Handtücher, Bettlaken für das Klappbett und das richtige Bett war schon fertig bezogen. Die Küche war gut nutzbar eingerichtet. Die bereitgestellten Infos waren gut verständlich und hatten einen großen Nutzen.

Einzig der gefährliche Auf- und Abstieg über die sehr schmalen Treppenstufen zur Wohnung war gewöhnungsbedürftig und die Aussicht vom Balkon etwas trist (dafür kann Astrid ja nichts).

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour chez Astrid!
L'appartement est très agréable, propre, confortable, fonctionnel et très lumineux, facile d'accès en transport en commun de la gare centrale, et bien situé. Le quartier d'Eilandje est très sympa! Les autres quartiers d'Anvers sont facilement accessibles à pied. Une bonne expérience, à refaire!
Uitstekend appartement

El piso es cómodo, bonito y muy buen comunicado. Quizá no sea centro centro pero se puede caminar hasta la zona más céntrica o coger el tram que hay en la calle de al lado y en muy poco tiempo estar en el centro.

Perfect for the 3 months I worked in Antwerp location is good lots of nice bars and restaurants nearby and about 10 minutes walk into historical Antwerp, there is a tram round the corner that takes you directly to the centre, Grear host good communication.

Het was een fijn verblijf in dit appartement met vele prettige voorzieningen en een mooie parketvloer. Ik heb elke nacht prima geslapen en genoten van het rustige balkon aan de achterzijde. Dit was mijn eerste verblijf in een Airbnb, veel aangenamer dan in een hotel.

Petit appartement simple mais fonctionnel. Très lumineux. L’accueil lors de notre arrivée était très bien, malgré une arrivée avant l'heure prévue.

I stayed at Astrid's for two and a half months. The apartment is very well located in the Northern part of the city, around the harbour of Antwerp not far away from the Museum Aan De Stroom. Supermarkets are nearby and separate parking is very convenient. Public transport (tram) and Antwerp's rental bikes are right in front of the apartment. Thanks to the big windows the apartment is pleasingly bright. The kitchen is well equipped with nearly everything you could ask for and a cleaning woman takes care of the place once a week. Communication with Astrid and the cleaning lady was no problem at all.
Overall I can just recommend Astrid's place!

Heel fijne locatie,  het oude centrum en de kaaien op loopafstand om de hoek en ‘t Eilandje heeft ook leuke verrassingen, zoals Bocadero. Het appartement zelf is prima en van alle gemakken voorzien, communicatie met Astrid en in- en uitchecken etc. verliep uitstekend. De bijbehorende parkeerplaats is fijn. Séjour très agréable, bel appartement propre et lumineux.

No volvería ni por la mitad de precio, no recomendable si se viaja con equipaje pesado, porque no tiene ascensor y las escaleras son muy pequeñas, muy inclinadas y peligrosas.

Lovely apartment in a quiet neighborhood, with the river, museums, cafes and anything you might need nearby. The city center is also a short walk away. Communication with Astrid was easy and quick! Definitely would stay there again!

Astrid is super and the flat is perfect for a city trip!
It is located close to museums, a tram station, restaurants, bars and also food shopping is not far.
It was clean and the bed is super comfortable! We were allowed to make us coffee to start into the day.
Would definitely come back :-)
Perfect stay. Perfect for me as a professional. Everything available for a longer stay. Feels at home right from the first week. Contacting Astrid went smoothly when you needed something.

Astrid réserve un accueil très chaleureux à ses hôtes, et apporte toujours la meilleure solution et donne les meilleurs conseils.
L’appartement est agréable, lumineux et fonctionnel et est équipé d’une cuisine nouvellement installée.
Le parking couvert avec l’appartement situé à 8 minutes à pied est très utile quand on voyage en voiture à Anvers.

Heel fijn om na een dag te relaxen. Kortom, ik had een heel fijn verblijf! Een aanrader. Een goede prijs/kwaliteit!

Perfekte, wunderbare, grossartige Gastgeber - unkompliziert, hilfsbereit, locker und freundlich. Wunderschönes Haus, toller Hinterhofgarten, sehr schönes Zimmer. It is very pleasant meeting them and staying the house. I highly recommend to someone want to visit Belgium.

Heel warm onthaal, super vriendelijk!

I stayed three nights at Anne’s place and had a wonderful time. Anne and her husband Manu are very outgoing, helpful and friendly people.  Anne‘s house  is a beautiful and charming old building, something very special. It also has a garden. The house is in a nice neighbourhood close to the train station, so it‘s easy to get around. I can only recommend staying there!
I found Anne to be a thoughtful, caring host. I had a thoroughly lovely experience at her home and would be happy to return there again. I was made to feel very comfortable and at ease.

Had a fantastic stay at Anne's place. Even though she wasn't home she sent through heaps of tips and ideas for exploring Antwerp. It is less than 10mins walking to central station and a comfortable walk of about 30mins into the centre. There are plenty of trams etc as well. I loved my stay here and would definitely stay again.

Het was zeer aangenaam vertoeven bij Anne. Ik heb er 2 nachtjes geslapen en het huis en haar bewoners getuigen van warme, open en creatieve sfeer.
Zeker een aanrader als je zoekt naar eigenheid en ontmoeting .
Niet twijfelen... beter kan je niet vinden.

If i go antwerp again, i will go Anne's house! not even stay!
And house is good and beautiful. I touched by many antique things and her office room is very very beautiful. Its perfect place in antwerpen, I think :)

We felt like members of an extended family. Anne is very passionate of her love for her city and was very generous in sharing that information with us. We learned so much.
Her home is warm and welcoming.
Anne was very open with explaining the rules of her home, which I very much appreciated because as a guest in someone's home respect for that home is so important.

Anne Provoost's family was very warm and friendly. The house is a pleasant antique style well designed one. The room was very pleasant, with a nice balcony, and the bed was very comfortable. Even their female dog was very cute and friendly. They took care of our luggage until we left Antwerp in the afternoon which helped us a lot.
We have new friends in Antwerp, and when we come back again we will surely wish to stay in Anne's place.

We hebben met ontzettend veel plezier bij Anne en haar familie overnacht. Ze wonen in een ontzettend sfeervol huis en doen er alles aan om je verblijf zo prettig mogelijk te maken. Wij raden iedereen aan bij Anne en haar familie te boeken en zien uit naar ons volgende bezoek.

I met Anne's family when I arrived , they are very friendly and welcome me in the evening ! The house is so big and charming , I gave 100 like ! I felt like travel back in time ! Thanks for arrange such a nice room for guest, wish I will go back in summer next time !

We werden ontvangen door de zoon van Anne, super vriendelijk en gastvrij. Kamer/appartement was precies wat we er van verwachtten. Locatie in de stad is OK. Enige nadeel was het rare geluid van de van de wasbak in de kamer wat werd veroorzaakt als iemand aan het douchen was, hier werden we helaas 's ochtends wakker van, dit is het enige verbeterpuntje. Al met al een positieve ervaring!!
Anne and her family is amazing. I enjoy the house and room soooooo much, its really make u feel like in home. If I visit Antwerp again, I definitely will pick Anne's house again!!

Wij hebben een enorm genoten van onze tijd bij Anne. Al bij het openen van de deur waan je je in het België van een eeuw geleden. Een echte unieke ervaring voor degenen die op het interieur van het verleden zijn gesteld. Zelfs menig brocantewinkel en het Elfde gebod kunnen aan de inrichting van dit huis een puntje zuigen. Wij voelden ons direct thuis en we zullen het "kingsize" bed wel het meest missen! Een aanrader!

Anne gives you a warmly welcome and show you her beautiful house where she lives with her family. She is  very open, kind and always in for a chat :) the house is again very beautiful and from there you can walk to the center of Antwerp. She and her husband knows all the ins and out of Antwerp and are happy to help you around. Thanks Anne we had a good time at your place!

In het prachtige Antwerpen werden wij in een pracht pand ontvangen door Anne. Erg vriendelijk werden wij rondgeleid en alles was erg duidelijk. Ons werden all to do's in de stad verteld, heel erg handig! Verder was alles erg schoon en de kamer was perfect. Jammer dat het geen zomer was om op mooie terras te verblijven bij de kamer. Kortom, aanrader om hier te verblijven!
Mooie nostalgische woning met een  aangename gastvrouw en heer, zeker een aanrader om te verblijven:)
Everything is great! I only recommend to stay there.

I felt at  home the minute I arrived at this delightful and civilized family house packed with curiosities and mild eccentricities that reflect the wide-ranging interests of the owners. The bed is very comfortable, the room quiet and the balcony charming. The stairs are steep and may not be too easy for anyone with a mobility problem. The bathroom is shared but there's plenty of hot water and a little flexibility goes a long way. The family is welcoming and easy-going, can offer excellent suggestions on where to go, what to see and how to get there, and the lovely old Flemish house with its pretty garden is 10/15 minutes walk from Centraal Station, the Diamond and Jewish districts. Denis the terrier/datchund cross is adorable and very nearly carried away in my suitcase.

Anne und ihre Familie sind unheimlich freundlich, herzlich, hilfsbereit und offen. Das Haus ist wunderschön, das Zimmer urgemütlich. Es liegt zentral. Wir bekamen tolle Insider-Tipps. Alles in allem haben wir uns sehr integriert und wohl gefühlt.

Anne was away when we stayed at hers. Her daughter welcomed us and everything was great. She recommended us places for dinner, coffee, brunch etc. All was amazing.
House and the room has lots of characteristic. We fall in love with her writing room. It was amazing to see that her novel was even translated into Turkish.
If I go to Antwerp again I would definitely stay there.

Chambre agréable dans maison du XIXème. Il faut aimer la décoration un peu surchargée, mais on y est bien reçu par la fille d'Anne, Martha, et.... leur chien ! Pas très loin d'un chouette endroit pour manger& boire des verres en compagnie de Belges. Par contre, il faut s'armer de patience pour trouver où se garer... Pas mal dans l'ensemble.

We had a really pleasant stay at Anne's and her daughter was a very nice host. The house is beautiful, situated in a peaceful area with a nice private terrace, but still a short connection to the city centre.

Thank you so much Anne! We had a completely wonderful stay.  The house is amazing, the feeling is very open and welcoming and Anne was incredibly sweet and helpful. She had wonderful Tipps on where to go and how to get around in the city and even had a city map for us. We only stayed for one night so we sadly didn't have much time to hang around at the house, the wonderful garden and further get to know our hosts but during the time we were there we felt really welcome. I'd absolutely recommend staying here if you come to Antwerpen. We had a wonderful Time.
Excellent.  I had a  very pleasant stay in a characteristic Antwerp townhouse located in a quiet and convenient street

The house is beautiful, in a practical location, room and everything is super confortable and clean, we have been welcomed very friendly by Anne's daughter so we had a perfect stay, thank you so much !
Door dochter en zoons goed ontvangen. Ze waren heel vriendelijk en behulpzaam. Goede slaap- en badkamer en vooral het dakterras bij de tuin is heel fijn als de zon schijnt, uitstekende ontbijtplek.

Ons verblijf bij Anne en haar gezin was kort maar krachtig. We kregen een warm ontvangst met koffie en gelijk wat praktische uitleg. De foto's van het huis spreken al tot de verbeelding en om er dan daadwerkelijk in rond te lopen is heerlijk. Het kind in mij genoot! Voor wie ook enorm kan genieten van schoonheid en vriendelijkheid; dikke aanrader dit!
Super gemakkelijk dicht bij het station en daarmee dus heel handig gelokaliseerd; we hadden zelf onze fietsen meegenomen en het was heerlijk rondfietsen van noord naar zuid Antwerpen en weer terug.
Goede tips gekregen van de kinderen des huizes mbt leuke plekken om te bezoeken in Antwerpen. Ja, echt een mega goede ervaring. Zou het zo weer doen!

Anne's home is stunning! We were warmly welcomed by her sons who shared their knowledge of the city.
Prior to our arrival, Anne provided us with excellent detailed directions from the train station to her house, and information and links to many sights, cafes and highlights of Antwerp.
The room, and the entire house, is charming, comfortable and unparalleled to any other.
With only one night, we spent little time at Anne's home, but took a break to enjoy a breath of fresh air on the lovely bedroom balcony.
Staying at Anne's was a pinnacle in our journey. A most exceptional experience!

Een geweldige kamer in een prachtig en sfeervol huis! De eigenaren geven je een welkom en thuis gevoel en geven leuke tips en info om de stad te ontdekken. Het inchecken was zeer flexibel mogelijk en het contact hierover verliep top. Je voelt je vrij en thuis in het huis van Anne. De bereikbaarheid is zeer goed, vanaf het station is het 5 minuutjes lopen. Toch is de buurt rustig en kom je na een drukke dag heerlijk tot rust in deze fijne kamer.
Nous avons énormément apprécié l'accueil remarquable de Manu et avons été sensible au temps qu'il a passé à nous parler d'Anvers. La maison est très agréable et bien décorée.

Lors de notre arrivée, Basile, le fils de la propriétaire nous a reçu dans sa magnifique maison. Il nous a fait visiter la maison, puis, il nous a donné un plan de la ville où il nous a indiqué les différents quartiers à visiter ainsi que les musées à voir dans la ville. Le logement correspondait parfaitement à nos attentes et nous nous sommes sentis comme chez-nous ici. Merci donc pour ce séjour enchanteur dans une ville qui l'est tout autant. Il faut dire que nous avons eu un temps magnifique avec des températures estivales!! Je recommande ce logement à quiconque souhaite un séjour d'exception.

L'hôte idéale, tout simplement.
Exhaustive, réactive, et un logement génial, avec une terrasse. 1000 mercis!!!

Anne and her family are friendly, welcoming kind host. They gives us a lot of information about tourism of Antwerpen, which helps us. The house is situated near Antwerpen Central station, so we can go there easily by walk. That is the point I recommend you. Just, mattress of bed was too soft for us who prefer more hard to sleep.
Een warme ontvangst in de betoverende woning van een heel attente gastvrouw: alleen maar positieve woorden over het verblijf bij Anne!
Perfect! We just wish we could have had a bit more time in Anvers.

Anne was absolutely nice and helpfull with everything. We had an amazing stay about two nights and felt welcome and happy. Everything was as described and it was very quiet yet central (10 minutes from Centraal).
We would recommend her place for friends, couples or singles.
We shared bathroom and kitchen but at no time we had to wait to use the facilities.
It is all clean and very beautiful. There is so much to see in her house.....
We gladly would love to come back.
Super ! En plus d'un très belle endroit pour loger, Anne est très agréable et arrangeante :)   Je recommande fortement cette adresse !!!

Fantastisch huis, heel leuke buurt, lieve mensen en handenvol tips om bijzondere plekjes in Antwerpen te vinden (zelfs voor mensen die al regelmatig in Antwerpen komen:) ). Bijzonder fijne tijd gehad!
非常好，就在火车站附近，家里也很干净，厕所非常的大，房东很热情，来安特卫普住这个房子绝对不会错的~
Top! We're definitely coming back!
Leuk huis op een prima plek! Heerlijk geslapen

If someone finds a better place in that part of Antwerp, let me know.
Cool house, great people.
I'll be coming back here!
La casa de Anne es lo MEJOR que se puede tener. La amabilidad y hospitalidad me hicieron sentir como en casa. Totalmente recomendable!!
Anne est très aimable. Logement propre et dans une rue calme
Was een zeer hartelijk ontvangst, leuke wijk, veel goede tips. Sfeervol huis!
Fijne en warme ontvangst en een mooie grote kamer! Ligging is ook zeer gunstig.
Some people come to see Antwerp... Well, I met some guests who came only to spend few days in this house. Highly recommend.
Très joli appartement, Anne n'était pas présente mais elle a su nous donner des bonnes adresses à Anvers

Wij vonden het een prachtig, groot en sfeervol huis om te verblijven. We werden ook goed ontvangen door Cornelius, die ons wegwijs maakte en tips gaf. Alles was prima verzorgd en schoon. Een aanrader dus.
Gezellig & sfeervol huis! Vriendelijke host, veel tips en staan klaar voor een praatje. Aanrader!

We had a lovely stay in Antwerp.. great city and made all the more special by staying at Anne's beautiful and eclectic house.. loved it.. easy to get to, good transport v near, easy to get into the hub of the city . Restaurants and bars near by ..
Anne and her sons very friendly and helpful

We had a pefect stay at Anne's house. Basil, Anne's son, took good care of us. He gave us a short introduction to the history of Antwerp and showed us all the interesting sights on the map. Anne had also provided us with lots of links to the sights and restaurants.
We loved staying at Anne's because of the extraordinary decoration (lots of antiques and beautiful paintings). The arquitecture of the house is also special.
The house is easy to find (Navigation System)! A problem is the parking. However, Basil offered us the garage, which was not used at the moment. We can highly recommend to stay with Anne's family!!!
Super super super. Gewoon doen!

Een zeer warm welkom van Anne en haar gezin/familieleden. We kregen ontzettend goede tips over de stad Antwerpen met daarbij een duidelijke kaart van Antwerpen. We konden onze bagage al eerder brengen dan inchecktijd en mochten onze bagage laten staan na uitchecktijd en deze ophalen wanneer het ons uitkwam. We hebben ons zeer welkom gevoeld in het huis en zijn zeer tevreden over de kwaliteit/hygiëne/comfort van de kamer. Dit is het voorbeeld zoals AirBnb naar mijn mening is bedoeld; je komt bij iemand thuis en hebt niet het gevoel van een onpersoonlijk hotel. Wij komen graag een keer terug bij Anne. Deze ervaring was leuker dan een geheel appartement/woning te huren via AirBnb.

Ich habe für vier Wochen bei Anne & Manu gewohnt und ich wurde sehr herzlich und liebevoll aufgenommen. Es gab hier alles was man braucht und für Fragen und Tipps rund um Antwerpen standen sie jederzeit zur Verfügung.
Wenn man wollte, konnte man am Familienleben teilhaben, aber wenn man etwas Zeit für sich brauchte, konnte man sich auch problemlos zurückziehen. Das Haus ist wunderschön verträumt mit alten Möbeln eingerichtet und mein Zimmer mit Balkon habe ich sehr genossen. Das Haus liegt direkt hinter dem Bahnhof und mit dem Fahrrad ist man innerhalb von 10 Minuten fast überall.

Ich würde jederzeit wieder zurückkommen und kann jedem, der einen authentischen Eindruck vom Leben in Antwerpen gewinnen möchte und auch etwas länger bleibt, dieses Haus nur empfehlen.

A home away from home!!
Anne and her husband are just amazing, eager to help, there for you at any time and so so so kind! Unfortunately we didn't spend much time in the house but we really felt at home. It was super convenient because the house is only 5 min away from the train station and at 15 min walk from very nice areas in Antwerp! We definitely recommend the place!
来自中国的朋友们，也建议你们来这边住。离火车特别近，走路5分钟！而且Anne和她的老公特别友好，真像家人一样！

It was a pleasure to stay at Anne's house. It is so cozy and nicely decorated that we immediately felt like being at home.
Thank you so much for the warm welcome and all the explanations and ideas. We loved the Plantin Moretus Museum! warm regards, Henria and Laszlo
séjour agréable au sein d'une famille chaleureuse et attentive dans une belle maison décorée avec goût et originalité, tout prés de la gare et des transports.
Outstanding house. close to the station and to the center of Antwerp but in a quiet area. Definitely recommend it! we had a lovely time :)

Het was aangenaam om hier te logeren. Het huis is groot genoeg om iedereen zijn eigen privacy zou hebben en toch is het verre weg van de steriele hotelkamers. Ik heb veel uitstekend tips gekregen die mijn bezoek van Antwerpen echt onvergetelijk hebben gemaakt.
房間乾淨，問題回覆快速
Great place to stay! Lovely family!! Highly recommended.

Des petites attentions très mignonnes partout, des efforts pour nous faire une visite des lieux en français et d'excellentes indications pour pouvoir découvrir la ville au mieux. Je recommande fortement.

Dichtbij het station en de zoo en toch rustig gelegen. Het is vergelijkbaar met oud amsterdam havenpand dat er zeer goed verzorgd uit ziet, en overal leuke details. Van te voren een hele leuke route beschrijving ontvangen, hiermee liep ik er zo naar toe, via een achterstraatje. Omdat ik al een plan had voor de volgende dag, anders had ze mij graag diverse tips willen geven waar ik de dag kon doorbrengen. En ook nog goed geslapen.

Anne and Manu are great hosts! I had a wonderful time in their lovely home. The balcony outside the red room is a nice little nook. Location wise, it is very well situated - within walking distance to the main central station and various attractions. Thanks again!

Una casa preciosa, muy pintoresca y realmente encantadora. Muy cerca de la estación, hay que andar un poco para ir al centro pero hay muchos factores que compensan este hecho. Los anfitriones además de super serviciales son personas cultivadas  y con conversaciones realmente interesantes, ha sido una experiencia super enriquecedora, y un autentico placer conocerles.
Lovely people, lovely home. All very easy going.
Amazing stay, I recommend it wholeheartedly!!
Liebevoll eingerichtet Vintage-Haus in super zentraler, ruhiger Lage. Anne und Manu sind unglaublich hilfsbereit und offen - wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen!
Belle maison de maître à proximité immédiate de la gare, idéal pour un week end en amoureux!

Geweldig huis!
Geweldige kamer!
Veel gastvrijheid en veel vertrouwen.
A very nice house on an interesting location.
Geweldige ontvangst in een inspirerend huis, de eerste airbnb ervaring is ons zeer goed bevallen.

Anne's home is absolutely magical, with is beautiful vintage style it feels a little bit like time has stopped. The attention to detail is just amazing. The bed in my room was very big and comfortable. The room even has its own little rooftop terrace. There were towels, slippers, coffee, tea and anything else one might need. Anne and her family were super lovely and welcoming. And the little dog is just a darling. Anne also gave me very good tips on where to eat and visit, so I really felt like I made the MOST out of my short time in Antwerp. I do hope to visit her again someday soon. :)

Wat een parel van een huis! De kans om in een dergelijk herenhuis te kunnen verblijven kom je niet vaak tegen - en dat voor een zeer scherpe prijs. Tel hierbij op de razendsnelle communicatie, geen moeite teveel (zelfs een kinderbedje werd geleend voor ons van de buren) en hartelijke ontvangst inclusief tips voor de stad maakt het meer dan terecht dat Anne (en haar familie) een SuperHost is! Wij komen hier zeker nog eens terug.

The room is wonderful and actually very inspiring. Actually I was happy to stay in the room and even wished to stay longer. Ann is very helpful and understanding and professional. I wish I will be back again and stay here one day. The atmosphere is great! I highly recommend to everyone.

Prachtig Herenhuis op voor ons loop afstand van het Centrum van Antwerpen.
Zeer gastvrij en centraal gelegen aan de achterzijde van de Zoo.
De kamers zijn netjes en schoon de badkamer is ruim.
Vanaf het balkon kijk je vanaf het dak terras de mooie binnentuin in.
Het is een oud herenhuis met moderne isolatie waarbij de prachtige interieurs
en plafonds, trappenhuis en gehele authenticiteit behouden gebleven.
Kortom een overnachting in Antwerpen die het gevoel van de oude stad compleet maakt.
Midden in de stad nabij goedkoop parkeren en toch erg stil in de nacht. Een huis met stijl, als je van antiek houdt

Une maison chaleureuse, décorée avec beaucoup de sensibilité et d'attention, des hôtes qui connaissent parfaitement leur ville et qui savent vous en parler. L'emplacement est pratique et très calme. La présentation est tout à fait conforme au lieu. Excellente communication avant le voyage

Difficult to visit the city when you are staying in such a beautiful house soaked in culture and art. Luckyly the whole family is in love with Antwerp and they will give you the right tips for a great experience in the city, fantastic place and people!

Absolute aanrader, deze plek. Een parel verstopt in een rustige buurt, toch vlak bij het centrum. Anne reageert snel, is super gastvrij en relaxed en natuurlijk is het huis - en ook de kamers- echt waanzinnig mooi. Autentieke details, mooie decoratie, heel veel sfeer. Zoiets vind je niet vaak!
Chambre très bien située, à moins de 10 minutes à pied d'Antwerpen Centraal. Notre hôte a été de très bons conseils tout au long de notre séjour. Nous avons été enchantés !
Heerlijk verblijf in een authentiek stukje van de stad.

Mooi sfeervol verblijf. Locatie is prima centraal.
Fantastisch bed!

The house is very clean and maintained well. However I did not have a smooth stay because the heater did not work at night. She controls the heating through computer so u can't put the heater on. Heater in the toilet only after 8 am and on Saturday as the family gets up late it was not available at 8 am even. There is no dryer as written in the listing. Anne have never used public transport so could not explain it. The place is close only from backside of the station which is difficult to find. From frontside it's 1 km from station. She even raised her voice when I was not able to understand her complicated explanation of roads. Bathroom and toilet are same and u share it with  4 other members of family. They host guests in other rooms as well so if the rooms are full you share it with many more people. The host does not have the sensibilities of welcoming a guest from another country.

Anne haar huis is een prachtig paleisje in het centrum van Antwerpen. Enorm gastvrij ontvangen door haar zoon Basil. Ik zou zo weer een avondje boeken als ik in de stad was. Een echte Belgische parel.

The house is near the centraal, easy to find. The room is clean and tidy and so is the rest of the house. Anne will make sure you will find everything you need! The decoration and features really makes you feel at home and gave my stay a relaxing vibe. The whole family is extremely friendly and very intelligent, I enjoyed the conversations a lot! Would recommend, 10/10!

Een heerlijk huis, met een fijne kamer en een fantastische gastvrouw. We voelden ons zeer welkom. Lekker dichtbij het station, winkels, restaurants en bioscoop. En vooraf voorzag Anne ons van alle informatie om ons verblijf onvergetelijk te maken.

The room and the house is as beautifull as shown on the pictures. Everything was tidy and clean and arranged with good taste.
We could breakfast in the lovely kitchen. We meet Anne just shortly when we arrived. She is a very friendly and sympatic host and gave us full of information in advance, so we didn't have any problem to find all the interesting sites in Antwerpen and the way to her house.
We felt very well at home and we can warmly recommend this very central and very quite neighboorhood.

Die Unterkunft liegt schön zentral, aber sehr ruhig fußläufig zum Bahnhof. Wir haben Anne und ihren Mann kennengelernt, beide sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit mit jede Menge Tips zu Kultur, Shoppen und Ausgehen. Das Haus ist hat eine ganz besondere Atmosphäre mit einem ganz eigenen Stil aus Kunst und jedemenge Literatur. Unser Zimmer war geräumig und gemütlich. Bei schönem Wetter ist die Terasse zum Garten ein Traum. Man lebt gemeinsam mit der Familie, teilt sich also auch das Bad. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt.
Wonderful host and house !!!!! Recommend 100%
Anne’s house is so beautiful and has a amazing view from the balcony outside.big kitchen ,big bathroom 。we had a perfect experience in Anne’s house

Great location and beautiful room like a museum! Lots of local information was provided before and on arrival, which was quite useful. I would love to stay here again next time I visit Antwerp!
ﾁｪｯｸｲﾝ時の日本語での案内も嬉しく､心温まりました。
Parfait pour se mettre dans l atmosphère de cette belle ville.

Anne's place is a beautiful and homely house decorated in impeccable and comfy taste. One feels welcomed as soon as the door is opened. Everything was in perfect shape and very clean. The room I stayed in was very spacious and comfortable with a great view and balcony as well. I highly recommend staying at Anne's, especially if you plan to get to know Antwerp in detail: you'll get the best local tips.
a really nice place to stay in
Great hospitality and friendly hosts! Cozy and original interiors. The best..

Anne and her family were great hosts.

The house is beautiful and ideally located, very close to the train station and within walking distance of many Antwerp landmarks and attractions.

The room is just as described, very clean and bright with lots of antique pieces. There is even a coffee machine and kettle in the room : this is a nice touch!
Would recommend 100%
Wonderful people and wonderful house! I will come again!

Anne is the best host you could find. She and her family are very friendly and they make you feel not only welcome but at home.
The house ist really close to all interesting points and Anne provides you with enough wonderful tips for many weeks in Antwerp.
I had some perfect days there and I'd come back any time.
Anne and her family are exceptional people. They are a pleasure to stay with and they enhance the experience.

I stayed at Anne's beautiful place for the second time, and it felt like coming home. The room is fantastic, with it's own roof top terrace and so many lovely details. The house is simply magical and perfectly located to explore the city. And as always I got the most amazing tips for places to visit. THANK YOU, Anne & family! <3  <3 <3
Tip als je van een huiselijke sfeer houdt!!!
This was my first Airbnb experience. The bar has been set very high.
Anne en familie zijn heel gastvrij en hulpvaardig. Het is een leuke woning, het bed is aangenaam en je kan er ontbijten op het balkon met zicht op een groene tuin.

Stijlvol huis met evenzo stijlvolle slaapkamer. Zeker een aanrader als je in een echt Belgische stadwoning wilt verblijven. Prima te bereiken vanaf het
Centraal station

Anne’s place is great! 7 minutes walking from the train station in a quiet and calm neighborhood that makes you forget you are so close to the center. Arriving to the house I was greeted with a warm and friendly welcome and got tips and recommendation on what to do and all of them turned out to be great. I really felt “at home away from home” and I feel sad I only got to spend 1 night there. Highly recommended!!!
Ohh and there is the cutest dog there!

Anne is an exceptional host. Her whole family was wonderfully welcoming. They are very interesting people! I was traveling alone, visiting Antwerp for the first time. They made me feel right at home. Anne gave me excellent tips for touring. Take her advice. She really knows what she’s talking about. She also stored my luggage until late so that I had a very full last day before leaving the city. Do note that you share a bathroom with the family,  but have your own sink in the room. It’s a bit like being one more family member. The house is stylishly fun with its garden and the room’s balcony giving you an expansive sense of being both inside and outside. But bring your insect repellent for the occasional mosquitoes. The location is fantastic for seeing the many sides of Antwerp. I loved it.

I loved my stay at Anne's house. It is gorgeous, very clean and Anne and her family are all extremely friendly and welcoming. It's located in a very convenient location for the train station and the diamond district and Anne told me of some wonderful places to visit. I hope to visit again and stay longer next time. Thank you Anne.

Anne and her smile are great hosts. Super warm, friendly and knowledgable about Antwerp. Location is so close to the main train station. Room was very pleasant and private deck was lovely in the morning.

You can go there without any qualms Anne and her family are very welcoming. They have everything that one could need. May it be basic toiletries or things like an umbrella Anne has them for you to use. The great thing you can use the kitchen, her fridge etc. You will feel at home in her house.
Ik voel me bij Anne en haar familie thuis
superlocatie in een fantastisch deel van Antwerpen.
Verten var svært hjelpsom og gjestfri! Huset var enestående, med en god atmosfære. Vi skulle gjerne blitt flere netter! Anbefales på det varmeste!

Geweldig mooi, schoon en gezellig appartement in een rustige buurt vlakbij het centraal station Antwerpen. Al in de mail kregen we allerlei tips over de stad en de activiteiten in de zomer en de ontmoeting in het appartement was ook gastvrij. We voelden ons gelijk helemaal thuis hier! Heerlijk terrasje om te ontbijten in de zon en alle spullen waren aanwezig in de keuken en badkamer. Zeker een plek om terug te komen!

We are very pleased to have stayed at Richart appt. Really appreciated it's design and tasteful décor. Speaking practically, the appt has most of the utensils. Ironing board was a nice bonus. If you come by car - a free parking area is a 15 min walk from the docks (north of Londenstraat). The area itself is calm, Carrefour express nearby. A 10-15 min - and you are in the center. Thanks to Christel and Karel for a smooth check-in/out and for being helpful all the way through.

Die Wohnung von Christel ist recht großräumig und sehr schön eingerichtet. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Kommunikation mit Christel verlief gut. Persönlich haben wir sie aber nicht kennengelernt. Der Wohnungsschlüssel liegt in einer lockbox bereit, so dass man jederzeit in die Wohnung kann. Die Wohnung liegt sehr nah am Zentrum, sodass man es auch zu Fuß erreichen kann. Die Nachbarschaft ist allerdings nur tagsüber einladend.

Wij hebben een geweldig weekend in het appartement van Christel gehad. Bij aankomst heeft ze ons gastvrij ontvangen en het appartement is ruim, schoon en goed onderhouden. Ook was het erg leuk dat we voor vertrek al vele to do tips toegezonden kregen. Een echte aanrader dus! Wij hopen hier nog eens terug te komen.

Christel little Belgian flat is great to explore Antwerp - rental bikes station are only few minutes away in Rotterdamstraat and Centraal station is really close. The place was great value for money and Christel was very helpful. Thank you for having us!

L'appartement de Christel est magnifique. Décoré avec goût, très propre, lumineux et pratique, nous avons apprécié notre nuit à Anvers.
Merci, et bonne continuation :-)

We loved our stay at Christel's home. It was exactly what was described and more! It is very spacious and very close to all neighborhoods in Antwerp. We also loved Antwerp and Cristel's guide was very helpful! Her restaurant recommendations were great. We would definitely stay here again and recommend to anyone. Thanks Cristel!

Christel made us very welcome . The flat is very nice , the only things for elderly people ,which are not good on foot it's very hard. The stairs are a killer.
But it's easy to get to the main town by tram. Even if you get lost the friendly Belgium people bring you home.
Kind regards Ruth

Authentic Belgian apartment was really authentic. We like it very much. Everything was okey and Christel is nice person who helped us with many things which we needed. Location of apartment is also good. Its close to the main train station and to the city center as well. So my evaluation  is only positive :)).
Een heerlijk appartement in een leuke wijk. Christel heeft er alles aan gedaan om ons thuis te laten voelen.

Christel is a lovely, friendly host. She was very flexible about our arrival and departure time. Christel met us at the apartment, and showed us around.

The apartment has a cool layout, and is beautifully decorated with modern furniture. There were lots of leaflets and folders about the city, and a folder made by Christel with lots of tips about places to see. You can tell she spent time on this, and it was done with care, as is the apartment. Lots of attention to detail!
On foot, you reach the city center within 20 minutes. We parked our car next to the Sportpaleis (for free!), from where you can take a tram to the apartment.

We had an amazing stay and really enjoyed the apartment.

Appartement très sympa, bien situé.
Je recommande pour un weekend en amoureux!
Thank you for a wonderful time, we loved your apartment, in what was such a great neighbourhood. The tips and the information books you provided were a great help :)

I rented appartment for my nephew with his girlfriend. According to them they were really happy with the appartment and the neighbourhood. I've also dropped in for a few minutes and found it just amazing. Clean, fully self sustained and cozy. 15 minutes walk to the citycenter. Certainly worth it's money. Christel was absolutely friendly and provided every support. Would recommend this appartment with no doubts.

Christel (and her son) has done an amazing job of making this apartment a unique and welcoming place to stay. The rooms are light, spacious, clean and beautifully furnished. The location is great - a nice quiet neighborhood, yet only ten minutes or less to walk to the main train station, and an easy 15-20 minute walk to the central town area (including many of the main Antwerp sights). I had a lovely stay and would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Antwerp.

Christel was a great host! Her place in Antwerp was fantastic! It was so nice and spacious I could have lived there!

The neighborhood is great, very interesting mix of culture and activities and easy to get to the central train station and also the different markets and parts of the city.

Christel made sure I had everything I needed and I liked how her son had some of his very cool art and books in the apartment.

I would definitely recommend staying with Christel to visitors of Antwerp!

Simply put, this apartment is awesome. It looks gorgeous, and is actually larger than what we expected based on the photos (very rare to come across that). It's located about 10 minutes from the central station on foot, in a fairly safe neighborhood. Checking in and out was perfect. We loved our short here and would definitely return!
Apartment is close to the center station. Tram 12 is passing on the street that apartment is located. Place is clean and well furnished. Christel was helpful.

We had wonderful days in Christels home, the apartment is great, everything very clean and well maintained. the apartment is well furnished and everything is there that you need. a lot is within walking distance, we had bicycles with which was also good. Antwerp is worth the trip and certainly again in this apartment. Thank you

Christels flat was very nice and clean, it has everything you need. It's situated in a very colorful, multicultural neighborhood and it's just 15 minutes walk from the city center. It's also well connected with the public transport (tram). We had a nice stay.
Christel's apartment is really good. It is very clean and spacious. Christel's son is very helpful and warm heart. He made our checkin smoothly and used his car send us to city center.
Christels apartment was was really great! It was clean and like the discription. Christel answered fast, when we had questions. It was an cool trip to Antwerpen and to stay in Christels apartment.

The apartment is gorgeous. The check-in process was efficient and seamless. Christel answered every message very quickly. The wifi was fast and reliable (hooray!). I would absolutely stay again and recommend it to others.
This is a great flat; big, clean and charming, in a good location; a quit area not far from the City center, with a nice host. I would recommend this place.

We had a fantastic time in Christel’s apartment. The place is super elegant, with high ceilings, light open plan rooms, and stylish contemporary decoration. With everything at hand for a comfortable stay, we immediately felt at home here. The apartment is conveniently located in the east of town, just a few minutes’ walk from shops and bustling Antwerp city life.

Very central. Lovely apartment. It was very clean when we arrived. The neighborhood is really nice and the local shopkeepers were very helpful when we got lost. Christel left us lots of useful information for our stay.
Everything was fine! Christel was quite fast to answer all the questions I made!
We hebben in een mooi, compleet en ruim appartement verbleven!
Everything fine. Easy communication and the apartment as described. Recommended!
la casa é molto carino, tutto il necesario é presente. ubicazione perfetta, facile da raggiungere dalla stazione. I propieterai sono molto disponibili e cordiali.

Een fijn appartement in een prima buurt, centraal en goed bereikbaar met tram, metro of te voet!
Het appartement is leuk ingericht en schoon en van alle gemakken voorzien. Ik heb hier een heerlijke tijd gehad en zeker voor herhaling vatbaar.

Samen met mijn zoon 1 nacht verbleven in het appartement. De ontvangst was zeer hartelijk. Mooi ruim appartement. Prima om hier ook langer te verblijven. Zeer centraal, met de metro of lopend naar het centrum.

L'appartement était très agréable, propre et très bien aménagé, j'ai passé un très bon moment. Non loin du centre ville, c'était super pour des escapades...
Merci Christel
Camille

Wat een prachtig appartementje! Het was schoon, goed onderhouden, ruim en heel erg leuk ingericht. De dochter van Christel heeft ons hartelijk ontvangen en er lag een leuk boekje met tips om Antwerpen te kunnen verkennen. We voelden ons erg welkom! Bovendien lag het appartement op slechts 5-10 min lopen vanaf Centraal Station, dus je bent overal zo. Kortom: zeker een aanrader en voor ons absoluut voor herhaling vatbaar.

Christel's place was amazing! Great decorations, lots of space and we enjoyed the outdoor patio which was a great bonus. It felt very comfortable and close to the train station and a grocery store right down the street. She answered all questions we had very quickly and she is a very kind host. If you're visiting Antwerp we would suggest that you stay here. We loved it and thanks for allowing us to stay!

My friends had a rellay good time at Christel's flat. They sais it had a nice vibe and it was really close to everything, also it's very clea  and the landlords are kind and patient with their guests.

The apartment was lovely and we really enjoyed our stay there. Christel had provided so much information about the local area which was all really helpful. It was a good location and easy distance to walk to the city centre. In the apartment there was lots of nice homely touches which made you feel really at home and comfortable there. Definitely recommend staying there!

Everything was perfect! It's a cosy and very comfortable apartment in the center of Antwerpen. You can park your car near on the underground parking. Carrefour (food shop) is located near. The location is excellent - you can reach the center in 15 minutes by foot. Christel was very friendly and she told about interesting places in the city.

Indulged in the splendor of the beautiful and comfortable apartment. Had a very pleasant stay, rested well to explore Antwerpen. Thank you Christel for providing us with everything necessary. Enjoyed reading the stories left by fellow travelers in your storybook.

Christel's apartment was great and exactly as described. It was a very cool area, with lots of local cafe and food options. The apartment was large and well furnished. I would definitely stay here again.
Lovely and more spacious than we expected. We had an excellent time exploring the city and the apartment was a great base.

This is the perfect place to stay. The apartment is spacious and very comfortable. The neighbourhood is vibrant - a real melting pot of different cultures. It was close to town for us to visit during the day and had a lovely living room to relax in

Ik had nood aan rust en even tijd voor mijzelf. Ik heb deze rust helemaal gevonden in het appartement van Christel. De ruimte was net zoals op de foto's. Zeer gezellig, een thuis-gevoel.
Binnen is het zeer rustig maar eenmaal je de straat uitloopt kom je terecht in een zeer levendige buurt. Dit zorgt voor een echte meerwaarde. Slapen in het appartement van Christel is dus een echte aanrader.

Very nice place! walking distance to the central station and several nice places to visit in Antwerp. The apartment is well taken care of and everything was nice and clean when we arrived. Thank you very much for everything! You've helped us to make the best out of our stay in Antwerp.

My stay at Christel's place was really nice. I stayed here for 2 nights with my girlfriend and we enjoyed Antwerpen a lot. The place is every bit as pretty as on the pictures and for 2 people it's very spacious. Getting in touch with Christel was very easy and we could also contact her son if we needed anything. Would recommend this place to anyone!

The apartment and neighborhood was amazing. There was plenty of room for two persons and getting and leaving the apartment had been made easy. Christel had left plenty of tips for Antwerpen and we felt very welcome throughout the stay. Only minus got from difficult lock on the door. The apartment door was pretty hard to open and close.
The apartment was 100% as it was described. Everything worked and was clean. The street was quiet, but only 10-15 min walking distance from the center. I can recommend to anyone.

Christel communicated all the relevant information perfectly to us. Although we never met her in person, she made sure had everything we needed. She suggested a couple of useful websites to inquire about transportation, sights and events. The neighbourhood is very pleasant, with tram line 12 stopping around the corner. Overall it's a very nice and conveniently located apartment.

Het was jammer dat ik Christel niet ontmoet heb, maar alles was heel erg goed geregeld en duidelijk zonder haar aanwezigheid. De sleutels waren makkelijk te vinden en alles spraak duidelijk voor zich. Het appartement was mooi schoon en het boekje wat er lag legde alles goed uit wat belangrijk was voor ons verblijf. De buurt was erg aangenaam. Er waren genoeg plekjes om te eten en om boodschappen te doen. Het was erg dichtbij het station en een fijne loopafstand van het historische centrum. Er was veel openbaar vervoer dichtbij, alleen heb ik daar geen gebruik van gemaakt.

An amazing place to stay in Antwerp - close to the central station and all the interesting places on foot. Very cosy flat - you may feel at home. If ever again in Antwerp - would love to come back to Christel's place.
Het appartement was precies zoals de foto's! Dichtbij het centraal station, makkelijk lopend naar het centrum. We hebben het erg fijn gehad!

My boyfriend and I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb - it had everything we needed packaged into a colourful, vibrant and quirky apartment! The book of suggested activities was a great idea - we particularly enjoyed Zeppelin bar and only wished we had remembered to leave a story in the house book before we left...unfortunately the 8% Belgian beers at Zeppelin on the last night of our stay clouded our memory a little (thank goodness for a fairly late check out time) haha.
We'd highly recommend this apartment - private, spacious and in a great location. Thanks so much!!

We first thought not to write anything but it wouldnt be fair towards the many good people in Antwerpen which hosted us so far which were reliable and when everything was without problems. This was not such an experience at all.
Most importantly, the hosts have not respected an agreement made before booking. We have asked if it were possible to stay longer on the last day of our stay which due to circumstances was rather important. This was no problem until the booking was made but was canceled the day after without any attempt to provide alternative solution.
Other than that: the apartment was not clean (We are not spoiled but nail-clippings on the living room carpet were too much).

Minor items: the lock was broken so the apartment couldnt be locked. This was fixed on our second day. And the neigubourhood is also not so nice and cosy. There were people shouting and making noise but the owner cant do anything about it I suppose.
Christel is a very nice host!

Very nice and comfortable apartment! We enjoyed our stay very much - much better than in a hotel! Everything was easy and well organised. Christel and Karel are very kind and helpful. I reccommand totally to book this apartment.

The apartment was 100% as it was described. Everything worked for us and it was clean. You can do everything by foot. Short distance to the center station, shopping street and port. . I can recommend it to anyone. Really enjoyed it.

Our time in Antwerp was amazing. The apartment is as described. Well furnished and great location, easy to find and very close to city center. Christel helped us with many informations. I would recommend it to everyone!

Thank you Christel

Christel is a very nice and helpful host! Planning and communication beforehand was fast, easy and great. Christel helped us a great deal with some issues. We were lucky and happy, that we could stay in the Authentic Belgian Apartment.

The accommodation itself was awesome. The apartment is nice and tidy and with the tasteful interior it was very enjoyable to stay at.

If I happen to come back to Antwerp, I know where I will look for a bed. :-)

We had a lovely stay at Christel's house. It was nice and clean! The apartment was a close walk to the city centre.
Thank you so much for an awesome stay :-)

Christels apartment is even more beautiful than expected. We arrived there and we immediately felt comfortable. Everything was well organized and the apartment was very clean. It is just about 5 Minutes walk to the Central Station of Antwerp. And there is a Metro Station not far away.
We would have loved to stay longer! We were very happy with everything, thanks a lot!

Great weekend in Christel's RichArt apartment! Spacious living room with high ceilings, comfortable bed... We especially enjoyed the Antwerp guides, maps, and the lovely art on the walls. The apartment definitely echoes the artsy vibe of Antwerp! Easy walk/bike/tram to pretty much anywhere in Antwerp, 10 minute walk to the central train station.
We hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad in het appartement. Het is exact zoals op de foto's, het balkonnetje is fijn om even bij te komen na een dag de stad in en bed slaapt goed. Absolute aanrader!

I had a really lovely stay at Christel's place. The apartment is really spacious, with an incredible living area, and beautifully done up. The street is quiet and pretty, and there's a Carrefour supermarket just around the corner. Easy walking from Centraal station, and you're less than fifteen minutes walk away from the University and some of the bigger, busier 'touristy' streets and squares as well, but have your own quiet space to come back to when you're ready. Highly recommended!
Nous avons passé un moment très agréable chez Christel. Le logement correspond parfaitement au descriptif. C'est une excellente adresse que nous donnerons à nos amis qui souhaitent visiter Anvers.
De overnachting in het appartement van Christel was heel fijn! Een mooi en leuk appartement in een fijne buurt dicht bij het centrum, alles was prima te bereiken te voet. Zeker een aanrader!

Christel's apartment is in an interesting and diverse neighborhood with many shops and within easy walking distance to everything I wanted to see in Antwerp.  It's a lovely apartment,  comfortable,  and (except for the shower) quite roomy. The weather was warm (not hot) while I was in Antwerp,  and it would have been nice to have a fan to circulate the air,  as it was uncomfortable for sleeping in the apartment. I never got to meet or talk to Christel; we only communicated via messaging within Airbnb.
Everything was ok, it's bigger than on photos, nice district, 10 min walk to central station, 10 min walk to LIDL, it has even a terrace

Nous sommes arrivés tard dans la nuit et nous n avions aucune idée de la merveilleuse ville que nous allions visiter mais avant tout direction chez Christel .
Après avoir sinué les petites rues d Anvers nous ont trouvé cette jolie bâtisse , notre arrivée était parfaitement préparée grâce à un petit keybox !
Et là l enchantement commence dès l ouverture de la porte d entrée on y était déjà bien
Un endroit cosy épuré comme on aime et très reposant et tres bien situé .
Anvers est une magnifique ville partout où l on pose les yeux nous sommes charmés
La possibilité de se servir des cartes à disposition dans l appartement nous à permis de vite situer les monuments et la gentillesse des personnes rencontrées nous ont fait découvrir des endroits insolites !
Je n ai qu une hâte c est de revenir et prendre le temps car nous n avions que 2 jours de prévu !

Een erg fijn verblijf gehad in het appartement van Christel. Het is een mooie ruimte met een fijne zithoek, prettige keuken & badkamer. De locatie is ideaal! Christel was erg behulpzaam en gaf ons nog wat tips over wat te doen en zien in Antwerpen. Oh en de wereldkaart op de muur is ook een erg leuk detail van het appartement natuurlijk :)

Gut gelegene Unterkunft von der aus die Innenstadt in kürze zu Fuss erreichbar ist. Die Wohnung ist ruhig und voll ausgestattet inkl. gut nutzbarer Küche. Nur Parkplätze in direkter Nähe sind eine Ausnahme. Aber auf jeden Fall zu empfehlen für einen Antwerpen Besuch.
The apartment is great! Lots of space and a lovely terrace. Location is perfect, it made our time in Antwerp even better!
Heerlijk fijn plekje in Antwerpen! Netjes onderhouden en alles in orde. Op loopafstand van de Zoo, het centrum van Antwerpen en het Sportpaleis.
Really felt like I was home. The space is cosy, very comfortable and ample.
We had a lovely stay at this appartment. Clean, beautiful and nearby central station! We recommend everyone to stay here!!

We hebben dit appartement gekozen omdat het qua ligging handig was voor het concert in het Sportpaleis waar we heen wilden. Lijn 12 stopte om de hoek, perfect dus. Het appartement van Christel is precies zoals het op de foto's weergegeven wordt. Het is schoon, prettig ingericht en je voelt meteen de fijne sfeer. Het is licht met grote ramen. Een nadeel is dat daar alleen doorzichtige rolgordijntjes voor hangen en je dus compleet zichtbaar bent in alle kamers voor buurtbewoners. Maar het heeft het verblijf daardoor niet onprettig gemaakt, het is zeker voor herhaling vatbaar.

The apartment was very spacious,filled with light and tastefully (Website hidden by Airbnb) is our very favourite Air B and B property so far.
It was an easy walk from both the station and old town and very quiet.
There are plenty of shops and bakeries around the corner and a Turkish restaurant with tasty food so reasonably priced that we had takeaway or ate there each night.

Christel was very friendly and helpful. The appartement was as decribed. Very cute and nice appartement, nice balcony to have the morning coffee. It´s not far to the central station and not far from the old town (walking distance). If you wanna cook you find a well equiped kitchen - just bring your herbs and spices :). We had a lovely time and would come back to her place if we would travel to Antwerpen again.

Gezellig appartement met hoge plafonds en veel ramen. Heerlijke grote bank in de sfeervolle woonkamer. Er staat een lekkere grote kast voor je kleding en tassen een goed bed, waar we goed in hebben geslapen. Prima douche in het knusse badkamertje. Met de rode velo op het plein zijn we overal naartoe gefietst, ideaal!
We had a really lovely time at Christel's apartment: so close to everything. Also, Antwerp is a fabulous place with lots of hidden gems. Thank you!

Same as the pictures! The apartment looked a bit shabby before going in but it was clean and spacious (the complete opposite!) The bed was comfy, clean bathroom, spacious living room. We loved everything about this airbnb apartment.
Spent 2 nights in Antwerp with my sister in Christel's amazing apartment. Great space to relax and a good base to see the city.

Séjour de rêve à anvers dans un appartement magnifique et facile d'accès.
Christel et son mari nous ont donné de précieux conseils pour visiter la ville
Génial ! A faire absolument !
Appartement très joli et spacieux, tout le confort est là. Centre ville à pied en 20 min, en 10 min au zoo. Parfait pour un séjour de quelques jours.

The flat is really great, big, bright and stylish, we found it very relaxing. It is in a very vibrant neighborhood and close to many of the city attractions and the station. The location was perfect.

A couple of things to note would be that the neighbors can be noisy at night and a tram line goes right in front of the flat, we got used to it very quickly though. Lastly, there are no dark blinds or shutters so bring a night mask if you are bothered.
The christel the studio is very comfortable and spacious . Near the central train station. It is located in an interesting neighborhood to know a little of the daily lives of immigrants

This place was a gem.  The hosts were super accommodating and everything was perfect for us.  The apartment was in a great location and it really made our first visit to Antwerp less stressful and really enjoyable.

Loved staying at Christel's apartment! Very spacious layout and loved the patio. I enjoyed the neighborhood as well- very comfortable to me, not touristy.  Very culturally diverse. The apartment was well equipped to meet our needs and also very affordable for the size of the apartment!
The host canceled this reservation the day before arrival. This is an automated posting.

J'ai séjourné 2 semaines à Anvers pour des raisons professionnelles.
Je me suis vraiment senti comme chez moi dans l'appartement de Christel : il bénéficie de tout le confort et est décoré avec goût. Christel est quant à elle une hôte vraiment adorable!
Je recommande vivement cet appartement pour sa proximité avec le centre ville : tout peut se faire à pieds, bien que le quartier soit bien desservi en transports en commun. À ce sujet le bus 34 vous conduira directement dans le quartier Het Zuid qui est rempli de bars, cafés et restaurants, mais aussi de boutiques plus trendy que les chaînes classiques présentes sur le Meir.
En conclusion cet appartement ne peut que rendre votre séjour à Anvers - qui est une ville géniale - encore plus chouette !
Didn't get the opportunity to meet but key was easily handed off. It was wonderful to be so close to the center of Antwerp. It was an easy walk.
Mooi appartement, zeer netjes en schoon! dichtbij station en centrum

Huge, gorgeous apartment. It was nice to have it all to myself. The neighborhood got kind of rough at night and I had a scary experience, but I was also a woman traveling alone, and you have to be careful.

Christel's appartment was very nice and comfortable. We liked the guests' storybook.
Easy to walk to from the Central Station.

There is a fire alarm next to the front door which is rather easy to accidentally set off if you get confused and think the button is to open the door. Christel was fine though when we contacted her and told us how to reset it.

We would be happy to stay again.

The place is walking distance from the centraal station and hence was very convenient to reach.

It was warm cosy apartment and the 2 of us enjoyed our stay here.

I thought the apartment a perfect place if you want to be near enough to the station if you don't mind a 5 minute walk. The area is quiet. The no. 12 tram slides by the window now and again but you can only see the pantograph. Strangely it adds charm to the stay. Plenty of space in the living area and everything provided. Was very happy with my choice. I became Antwerpian for a week, living as they do. And that made it very special.
Great location,,2 tram stops from Central Station,,easy to get to all main sites...Christel responded right away to my questions..very clean and comfy flat...super value

Christel was very nice. She was for question available and the flat is really closed to the city and by the way to the sportpalais where we had a great red hot chillli peppers concert.

The flat was clean and the bed and living room very beautiful!

I recommend the flat for a good trip to antwerpen.

Thanks Christel!
We had a lovely stay at Christel's flat. Clean, comfy and well located. Perfect for a city break!
Beautiful apartment really closed to the central station! Perfect for couples! :)

Aangenaam en comfortabel appartement met toegankelijke in- en uitchecktijd.
In de keuken zijn voldoende potten, pannen, scherpe messen...
Dit maakte het verblijf extra comfortabel!

Het appartement bevindt zich in een rustige straat. Er rijden meer trams dan auto's (het geluid van de tram bezorgt geen overlast in het appartement). Een beetje verder is het levendiger. De slager verkoopt trouwens heerlijk pitta vlees! Een aanrader!
Goede locatie en een prachtig huis!
Nous recommandons cet appartement très agréable, joliment décoré. Bonne localisation pour découvrir la ville.

Ik ben samen met mijn vriend 3 dagen (2 nachten) in Antwerpen verbleven. We hebben hier ontzettend van genoten, grotendeels dankzij het prachtige appartement waar we heerlijk konden uitrusten na een lange dag wandelen. Het is een prachtig appartement, en ruimer dan we in eerste instantie hadden verwacht! De communicatie met Christel verliep erg goed en heel snel.  En echte aanrader!

The Appartement is clean, cosy and in a Nice neighboorhood, you can reach anything by foot Or with the nearby Public Transport.
We enjoyed our stay and can highly recommend the Appartement!
Quiet and convenient

Very nice and cozy apartment in an old house with high ceiling. We did not meet Christel but the communication was good. The neighbourhood is maybe not the best and its a 20 min walk to the old city centre but its totally alright and did not bother us at all.

really good accommodation in excellent location (on the quiet street but not far from the city center); spacious, clean and pretty comfortable appartment, can provide a very satisfactory stay. Special thanks to Christel for responsiveness.
very clean, nice facility and less then 5 minutes away from nearly everything. totaly well our stay, we realy enjoyed it.

Een uitstekende prijs/kwaliteit verhouding!

Verrast door het ruime appartement. Christel is een goede gastvrouw en behulpzaam!

Appartement ligt gunstig voor de tram, metro en parkeergarages.

Wij zijn niet snel angstig en geen negatieve ervaring, maar als vrouw zijnde kun je het wellicht als angstig ervaren in de nachtelijke uren. De taxichauffeur omschreef het treffend als 'klein Afrika'.

Verder echt een perfect weekend gehad.. aanrader!!

Very handy to the central train station. It's hard to get truly great coffee in Europe compared to down under so I was pleasantly surprised to find a great coffee bar just around the corner from here. Viggo's. Very comfy bed too!
Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist total schön und gut ausgestattet. Der Check ist total unkompliziert. Und Christel ist super nett und hilfsbereit.

We had a lovely stay in this beautiful apartment! It's big, bright and really nicely furnished. It's situated in an up-and-coming area near the train station,
which was residential and seemed very safe to walk around at night. You can get a tram or bus easily to the main areas of Antwerp, or walk anywhere in 30 minutes. We didn't get to meet Christel but communication was excellent and we would highly recommend staying here!

Very nice and roomy apartment with well equipped kitchen. Within walking distance of most of the city. Check-in made super easy! Very good value.

Bright spacious apartment close to the main station and a great base to explore the wonderful city of Antwerp.

Thanks you Christel :)

Appartement sympa que nous étions heureux de retrouver après des heures de marche dans la magnifique ville d'Anvers. Et en plus à 10 minutes à pied de la gare centrale.

Thank you, Christel!

Check in and check out at Christel's could not possibly have been any easier! Overall, my girlfriend and I had a nice stay for an affordable price in a lovely city!

Such a beautifully bright lit apartment in a good location. Spent most of my nights in the amazing lounge room with Netflix! Such a nice place to relax after a long day. Didn't want to leave. Highly recommended.
Fijn en mooi appartement op een top locatie!

Great apartment! Lots of space and all the amenities we needed for a lovely couple of days in Antwerp. Уютные апартаменты с особенной атмосферой и своей историей.  Хорошее расположение, недалеко от вокзала, близко к Grote Markt . Хороший Wi-fi. Отлично обустроенная кухня, чисто. Легко получить и оставить ключи.

Апартаменты чистые и светлые. Находятся в небольшом отдалении от центра города. Рядом есть магазин, где можно купить все необходимое на первое время. С заселением проблем не возникло. Een mooi, hoog appartement met een zeer ruime woonkamer. Het appartement ligt zo'n 20 minuten lopen van Antwerpen centrum, wat toch wat te ver is als je er al een hele dag struinen door de stad op hebt zitten.

Metrostation om de hoek, dat is erg handig. Enige nadeel van Antwerpen is, dat de laatste metro om 00:30 gaat, houd daar rekening mee.

Christel hebben we helaas niet ontmoet, maar via de sleutelbox was het erg handig ophalen en achterlaten van de sleutel. Zorg er ook voor dat je eventuele vragen ruim van tevoren stelt, want tijdens het verblijf konden wij haar niet bereiken via AirBnB. Dat was verder niet erg voor ons.

Nice appartment, about 15/20 min walk from city centre. However there are shops around the corner for your groceries and public transport quite readily available. Christel is a good host and everything was well arranged! Would come back here for another visit.

Ruim, lichtrijk & stijlvol appartement gelegen in een rustige buurt met alle voorzieningen die je nodig hebt. Er is een supermarkt dicht in de buurt. Tramhalte + station Antwerpen-Centraal ook op wandelafstand te bereiken. Super verblijf gehad!

Great base to explore antwerp from. 15mins from the main area of the city. Perfect for a long weekend
Prima verblijf!

This is a good apartment for people who are ok with narrow steep stairs.  The main living room is spacious and comfortable.
Merci beaucoup pour ce séjour ! L’appartement était très propre, bien chauffé et joliment décoré. Il est situé dans un quartier calme et proche de tout ! Nous recommandons vraiment l’endroit :-)

Absolute aanrader. Alles op loopafstand, schoon, ruim. We hebben een top weekend gehad!

Very stylish flat in quiet neighbourhood near the station. Plenty of space for 2 people. About a 20 minute walk into the centre.

Le quartier peut ne pas plaire à tout le monde, mais nous avons beaucoup aimé. Surtout la place De Coninckplein et les rues aux alentours, où il est possible de manger 10 cuisines différentes, de boire un bon café ou de rejoindre les endroits plus touristiques en quelques minutes.

This is a partially renovated building in an ideal location. Once you are in the apartment you are in a renovated space nicely decorated and complete with everything on the list. It is a comfortable space for long and short stays.

We had a lovely stay in the Apartment. We didn’t meet Christel but everything was easy and we could message her if we needed anything. The apartment ist near to the city (with bike rent stations all around) and in a very lively neigbourhood. On the inside especially the living room has a nice and cosy style.

Een echte aanrader om in te verblijven tijdens een bezoek aan Antwerpen. Centrum op loop afstand (20+ minuten), maar ook de buurt heeft gezellige supermarkten en een heerlijk Indiaas restaurant. Un grand appartement lumineux et bien décoré. Excellent Wifi. Tout le nécessaire dans la cuisine. Salle de bain avec douche puissante. Quartier populaire à distance à pied de 20 mn du centre. Bruit du tram la journée qui n est pas gênant.
Grand appartement situé très près de la gare, dans un quartier cosmopolite, à une vingtaine de minutes de marche des principaux sites à visiter. Très bien.

Super Unterkunft. Apartment hat uns außerordentlich gut gefallen. Das Zentrum ist ca. 1 km entfernt, daher auch super zu Fuß zu erreichen. Die Parkplatzsuche gestaltete sich allerdings etwas schwierig.
The stylish apartment near city centre. 10 out of 10.

Christel's flat was perfect for a week's stay, light and airy with tall ceilings. The Antwerp guide book on the bookshelf was really useful, and we discovered more about Antwerp. For those of you that are used to curtains, there are only blinds that let a lot of light in, however we discovered the bedroom has an outside shutter that made the room darker. (We don't have these in England!)

This apartment is furnished with a love to detail and feels very homey. It is situated in a vibrant neighbourhood and we very much enjoyed the diversity all around. You can easily walk everywhere in the center of the city, therefore it is a lovely place to explore Antwerp from. We would recommend it to everyone that has a love for high ceilings, glass doors and a soft spot for the narrow houses of Antwerp.

It was one of the best apartments i have ever seen. It is really stylish and spacious. It is near the city center and train station (10-12 mins by walk). Also there is a food supermarket carrefour on the next street. I recommend this apartments.

Крайне рекомендую! Одни из лучших апартаментов. Стильная, чистая, светлая квартира с большой комнатой, спальней. Отдельное спасибо за кофемашину

Licht, ruim en gezellig appartement met authentieke details. Christel was vriendelijk en snel met reageren, maar we hebben haar niet ontmoet omdat de sleuteloverdracht met lockbox gaat. Nice flat not far from station. Good grocery shops nearby. Bit of a walk to town. Area didn’t feel super safe but once inside the flat it’s lovely, especially the living room.
Christel's appartement is a charming place close to Antwerp's center. It was a super clean, tidy and welcoming area and I highly recommend it!

Christel's place is clean, spacious, charming, and has good heating if you're coming during the cold months.

Nice flat, great check-in (even late hours possible).

Christels place was wonderful. It felt very homely and there was lots of space. The kitchen was fully equipped with everything you need. It was walkable to everywhere needed we didn’t use the public transport once :)

Great place in Antwerp! Christel has a lovely home and it is decorated sooo nicely. The check in was super easy with the lock box key. Great location to a super market and to town, we walked everywhere and it was great. Apt very clean and comfortable. Highly recommend!
Все очень понравилось!
Great appartment, great facilities, great advice and great organization! Thanks!
Great apartment in a convenient location. Christel was a very friendly host and very accommodating.

We had a nice stay at Christel's place. Apatment has lots of space, we liked the design of interior. All amenities were there except a hairdryer.
Apartment is in a quiet street 10 min walk from Central train station, however the streets nearby do not seem nice/safe for walking in the evening.

Spacious flat, everything corresponds to the photos and description.
Very hospitable and friendly owner. Thank you!

Christel’s apartment is lovely decorated and very comfy. My boyfriend and I came to spend a weekend in Antwerp and this apartment is great value for money. Although location is not the best in Antwerp it’s not far from the old town and other attractions and it is possible to walk almost everywhere! Die Unterkunft ist sauber, gemütlich und komfortabel eingerichtet. Zum Zentrum und zum Bahnhof sind es nur wenige Gehminuten. Uns hat die Wohnung sehr gut gefallen und wir würden sie jederzeit wieder buchen.

Excellent location close to everything, Lovely flat, clean with confy bed, everything that you can wish for.
