Alexander is a great host and his flower shop, right in the building is beautiful.
Mooie sfeervolle ruimte. Hartelijke ontvangst en flexibele aankomst-en vertrektijd.
The room is even better then shown in the Picture! Its a warm and cosy place. Alexander is a perfect host.

Alexander's apartment is above his gorgeous florist shop in a beautiful part of town close to many tourist spots, cafes and restaurants. The apartment itself is beautifully decorated and roomy enough for 2 with a fully equipped kitchen. There's a supermarket a very short walk away too, so this was super handy!
Alexander was great to communicate with and being that his business is on the ground floor, was there to greet us when we arrived. We can't thank Alexander enough for a pleasant stay - one of our favourite Airbnb experiences to date!

Een fijn appartement, op een ideale locatie.
Alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig, gastheer is vriendelijk en behulpzaam.
Een aanrader dus.
Alexander ist sehr höflich, sympathisch und flexibel in den Ab- und Anreisemöglichkeiten.
Mooie stijlvolle ruimte in hartje stad en een prachtig boeket bloemen op tafel bij aankomst. We hebben mede dankzij de goede tips van Alexander genoten van een heerlijke weekend!
Nice apartment in the center, Alexander a very nice person and lovely flower shop on the ground floor!
Een prachtige uitvalbasis om Antwerpen te bezoeken.
Alexander's place is very cute and cosy. The bed is extremely comfortable and the whole place smells of beautiful flowers. Great location and great host ! Would highly recommend.

Alexander is goed bereikbaar en uitermate vriendelijk. De verse bloemen in de kamer getuigen van gastvrijheid. De studio is schoon, behaaglijk (het was -7 buiten), heeft een heerlijk bed en is zeer centraal gelegen met veel bezienswaardigheden op loopafstand. Een aanrader.

Alexander is nice person who has beautiful flower shop. The house is calm and clean and a lot of charm(flower are everywhere). 5min by walk from historical place. We had a great weekend. Thank you so much.

Alexanders Zimmer ist für eine Städtereise genau das Richtige! Nach den endlosen Rundgängen zu Fuß in der Stadt, freuten wir uns in das gemütliche Zimmer heim zu kommen und in ein gutes Bett auszuruhen! Sehr zu empfehlen!

Traveling and want to feel home in the center of Anwerp? It is the place :)
Highly recommended.

We had a great time living at Alexander's place. The room is above his beautiful flower shop and in the middle of the city. The room itself is cozy, well decorated and gives a nice view in the garden. There were many little shops and bars up and down the street. Alexander was really polite and friendly. We had a great stay in Antwerp.

We had a fantastic stay at Alexander's lovely apartment! The location is great, easy to explore all the main sights by foot. The apartment is very cozy, charmingly furnished and Alexander provided wonderful flowers for us. Communication and check-in was easy. I can highly recommend this place and we would love to come back soon!

This was a great place in Antwerp!  Check-in was quick and it is a nice studio apartment on the second floor.  The room was very nice, comfy bed, nice bathroom and shower, nice kitchenette and a cool little outside garden.  I highly recommend it for solo or couples!   The location is great also!
Een fijne, rustige plek om te verblijven in Antwerpen. Centraal gelegen. Goede prijs-kwaliteit verhouding.
Lovely place near the center.
L’apartament és fantàstic i molt ben ubicat. S’entra per la floristeria i a l’apartament hi trobes flors fresques i tots els detalls. L’amfitrió és encantador. Molt recomenable.

Another fantastic stay in this great little flat above a flower shop in the centre of Antwerp. Great location, clean, has everything you need and of course beautiful flowers and a friendly host too. Would recommend!
Not often you get to stay in a charming city, above owners quaint flower shop with high ceilings and view of splendid garden

Everything about Alexanders place is perfect. It is a short walk from Antwerpen Centraal (about 1.5 km). The place is located within a 5 minute walk from the main city center with restaurants, stores and monuments really close by. Unfortunately, we were in Antwerpen for less than a day and so, could not really do much. The place itself is really quaint, located above the flower shop run by Alexander. The little patio overlooks a lovely flower garden and we saw a couple of cool birds in the morning. It has some cool touches to it, the usual amenities. A big plus, clean and ironed sheets and a clean bathroom!! We enjoyed our short stay and hope to visit back again someday!

This studio is the perfect place to stay and located in the middle of the historic town of Antwerp. There are a lot of bars, restaurants and the most important historic sights just around the corner. Free and (in our case) safe parking is possible at the waalsekai, 20 minutes walking distance.
We enjoyed our stay a lot and can totally recommend it! :-)
L'appartement est conforme aux photos, propre, calme et fleuri. Alexander est très sympathique, je recommande.

Alexander’s place was great! Located above a flower shop so it smelled nice, and had a beautiful garden backyard area. Alexander was extremely helpful and responsive, and the bed was super comfortable! We will definitely stay in with him again next time we are in Antwerp!
Perfect, dank je wel!

Mooie en nette studio in een rustig stukje van de stad, op vijf minuten lopen van het centrum; de Groenplaats en de Grote Markt. Voor ons de perfecte uitvalsbasis voor een bezoek aan Antwerpen! We werden vriendelijk ontvangen door Alexander en voelden ons zeker welkom. Communicatie verliep vlot en soepel. We komen graag nog eens terug.

The studio was the perfect, adorable, base for my weekend trip to Belgium. Walking distance to a ton of great spots and the train station! Check in/out was very easy and Alexander responded quickly to all my messages. Thanks for a great stay!
Good central location, big bed, nice updated bathroom, and a great little view/terrace overlooking the garden below. Easy and flexible check-in with Alexander in the flower shop below all day.

Nous avons beaucoup apprécié notre séjour chez Alexander. Il s'est montré sympathique, réactif. Communiquer avec lui a été très aisé. L'appartement est ravissant. Impeccable, bien décoré, fonctionnel, calme, c'est un pied-à-terre idéal pour découvrir Anvers et rayonnner dans le centre. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié la vue sur le jardin et reviendrons avec plaisir!
Alexandre et Charlie

This is a charming space in a great location. The kitchen is well equipped, and the apartment is even more beautiful than the pictures suggest. Alexander was quick to respond to communications and very helpful. When we arrived, there was a huge bouquet of beautiful flowers from his shop on the table. Everything is clean and well taken care of. We hope to return someday!

Alexander´s place is perfect for exploring Antwerp. Very centric and easy to find. The house has everything you might need for a short stay and is very clean and cosy. Alexander was very helpful regarding check-in, allowing a certain flexibility to drop our stuff off and getting the keys earlier as he was already there.
Antwerp is Europe's best kept secret and Alex's place is a superpower spot to experience it from. We’re former residents of the city so we know what we’re talking about. Great value as well!

Небольшая, но очень уютная студия с хорошим расположением, все достопримечательности в пешей доступности. Есть небольшой балкон, выходящий в красивый зелёный сад, на столе стоят живые цветы. Рядом супермаркет и остановка трамвая. Чисто, удобная кровать. Нам все понравилось, рекомендуем.

Sehr schönes zimmer, nichts zu beanstanden. Alexander ist sehr nett und aufgestellt. Da man durch den Blumenladen in die Zimmer läuft, ist es einmalig...jedes mal die frischen Blumen zu riechen, einfach toll. Auch auf dem Zimmer hatten wir frische Blumen und es war sehr liebevoll dekoriert.

We stayed at the apartment for just one night but would definitely go back . The apartment was clean and very well kept . It’s located at a walking distance from the main square and other places to see . Very well connected by public transport as well . Alexander was very helpful.
book it! it's a beautiful amazing room, alexander is very sweet and the flowers smell wonderful. 5/5 the best BnB experience

Our stay was so peaceful. We arrived to a sparkly clean room with fresh flowers. He was kind enough to hold our bags while we grabbed breakfast after check out. The laundry mat was about 3 doors down so it was convenient to get that taken care of before leaving to our train. Central location and he was a great host! Wish we could have stayed longer.

This is a well appointed studio! Hearing the church bells on Sunday morning, smelling the lovely fresh flowers, and looking out on the back garden area--atmospeheric and relaxing. Walkable to historic Antwerp and to transit to other areas.

Nice place , good location and very good communication from Alexander.
Thank you.
Leuk appartement goede ligging in historisch centrum van Antwerpen. En een hele leuke gastheer.
Mooie, rustige en propere kamer! Het was een zeer aangenaam verblijf. De wifi werkte niet zo goed, maar de verse bloemen maakten alles goed!
Wonderful Host! Great experience! Everytime again! Dankjewell!

Alexander’s place was very nice, walkable to many places of interest, bars and restaurants.
Long walk from central station. Find tram route to make it easy.

Perfect place for a short stay in Anvers: nice room, clean, quiet, window view on courtward and small balcony.
If you want tovisit Anvers for a week end don't hesitate to book this airbnb!
Très beau studio fleuri proposé par Alexander en plein centre d'Anvers qu'il est donc très facile de visiter et d'apprécier. Le parking (gratuit, c'est important) n'est qu'à 15 minutes à pied.
Studio bem localizado, limpo, muito bem decorado e o Alexander é um excelente anfitrião. A cama é muito confortável e chuveiro delicioso. Lugar tranquilo e aconchegante.
Un alojamiento muy bien localizado, limpo e ideal para descansar. Alexander es un anfitrión de primera.

Unser Aufenthalt war super beim Alexander, die Kommunikation war super und schnell!
Die Wohnung war echt sehr schön und sauber! Hat unsere Erwartungen übertroffen!
Die Wohnung lag sehr zentral, wenige Gehminuten ins Zentrum!
Wir würden wieder kommen!

Einzige Manko, der kleine Kühlschrank im Zimmer war nachts sehr laut! Wir konnten ihn aber ausschalten.

Great place that exceeded our expectations and the description! Alexander is a great host who welcomed us when we arrived and was great to communicate with. The best part is that the house smells great because it is directly above a lovely flower shop!

Alexader’s place was so much more than we expected. Very spacious and beautifully decorated with everything we needed. It’s also perfectly situated for the historical Centre. Added to that all the conveniences are close by - supermarket, laundrette, trams, restaurants, etc.
We can definitely recommend a stay there. Thank you Alexander!
Heel net en super aangenaam appartement. Heel flexibele check-in. Zeker een aanrader!

Alexander is een top host die je gastvrij ontvangt, de omgeving kent dus je goede tips kan geven over plekken waar je zeker een bezoekje moet brengen en zeker met je mee denkt.
De kamer is aan de westzijde, hierdoor komt er nooit directe zonlicht binnen, wat prettig is omdat de kamer dan waarschijnlijk heel heet zou worden. Omdat de kamer aan de achterzijde van het gebouw is, hoor je alleen het geluid van de vogeltjes, en af en toe de klokkentoren. Maar als je de schuifdeur dicht doet valt dat geluid ook wel weer mee ;) Het appartement is mooi en schoon en centraal gelegen zodat alle bezienswaardigheden, en ook het centraal station, maximaal 30 minuten lopen zijn. Ik ben niks te kort gekomen tijdens mijn verblijf. Ik zou zeker nog een keer komen.

Een goeduitziende studio.
Ideale locatie, netjes en schoon.

Prima verblijf gehad! Mooie bloemen op tafel, alles keurig schoon en een prima bed. Centraal gelegen in hartje Antwerpen. Onze auto geparkeerd in de Grote Markt en genoten van een prachtig en zonnig Antwerpen.

Dit was een heel fijn appartement om te verblijven. Alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig en het is netjes. Een lichte ruimte met een comfortabele douche. Je kijkt uit op een mooie tuin en het is er stil waardoor wij goed geslapen hebben. Goede service van Alexander door flexibel te zijn met de in- en uitchecktijden!

We had an amazing time at Alexander's. Beautiful flat in a great location, and the easiest check in experience I've ever had. Best of all, he owns a flower shop that you go through to get to your room!
Gezellige kamer! Leuke uitvalsbasis!
Your own little oasis of peace & quiet, bang in the middle of town.  I would definitely recommend.
Super locatie, leuke studio, vriendelijke gastheer, aanrader!
Très sympa et propre. Confortable. Belle douche, coin  cuisine et repas pour petit déjeuner, supérette Dehaize pas loin. Alexander est très sympa et serviable. Je le recommande

Alexander's place is amazing, it's in a cute historic building, beautifully decorated, and we were greeted with gorgeous fresh flowers. Their flower shop below is beautiful and it's in a great location. We walked everywhere we wanted to go (Plantin Museum, Rembrandt's house, MAS museum, the Cathedral and Grot Market) and felt safe and confident exploring. The dreamiest jazz bar is a block down (le Muze) with live music every night and there's great bars and restaurants all around. There's also a laundromat a few doors down so that was really helpful to us since we'd been traveling a while. They also made check-in and check-out very simple and quick. We'd love to stay here again!
Everything you can expect for...

Alexander’s place is a wonderful little escape just a few minutes walk from the Grote Markt, Steen Castle, Cathedral of Our Lady, Rubenshuis, and Vleeshuis (a quaint musical instrument museum). There is a laundromat about 5 doors down, and a supermarket about a block away. (However, it’s about a 25 min walk from the train station so definitely look into riding the tram.) The flat itself has lovely wood floors, a high ceiling with exposed wood beams, and a beautiful garden in the back. The flat was furnished with everything we might need, including extras like coffee/tea and fresh flowers. Alexander was very warm and friendly and flexible on check-in/check-out which we really appreciated. Communication was great from start to finish. Highly recommend!

I highly recommend Alexander's place: it's clean, pretty and functional. We had everything we needed: towels, hair dryer, comfortable bed and even a bouquet of fresh flowers in our room. The view of the backyard full of plants is very pleasant. His place also has a kitchen, which we really didn't use, since the location of his place is perfectly close to all the cafes.
The bike rental station and the store are almost next to his place too.
Great experience that made our stay in beautiful Antwerp very pleasant.
Will stay there again.

Beautiful and cozy place, was very clean, quiet, very good location, a lot of restaurant around. Alexander was an excellent host. I definitely recommend to stay in their place. I hope to come back next year.
电车下来步行3百米左右，房东在一楼花店接待，行李可以寄存。房间如图，鲜花布置，望得到楼下花园。楼下有超市洗衣店，离大教堂景点很近，所以周边很多很多吃的地方。房东会帮助拿行李，人很耐斯。性价比很高的选择。就是网络不行。

Le studio d'Alexander est trés bien situé, et le fait que celui-ci soit disponible dans sa boutique juste en-dessous est vraiment pratique. Pour le reste tout correspond à la description, notamment un trés bon wifi et un lieu calme.
This is a great place to stay for 2

I don't need to make big words: toptoptop! Alexander is very friendly and flexible, the room is perfect, you can't wish more. I will be very glad to stay there again when I come to Antwerpen next time!

This is one of the best places I have stayed in. It is beautifully decorated with adorable details like a massive bouquet of fresh flowers from the host's flower shop. There is a small kitchen that is functional with everything you would need to cook a meal- we loved being able to cook for ourselves. The place is gorgeous, clean, and I would recommend anyone to stay there. I hope I get the chance to go back!
Alexander was a really nice host. The Location ist perfect. We will come again! Thx
Perfect location for discover the City! Nice apartement and Alexander was really hospitable.

Lovely space in the heart of Antwerp.  Alexander was a very gracious host. Had no problems finding it or checking in and out and he was very kind to hold my bags for a few hours while I waited to check into my next Airbnb and explore the city. Very cozy.

Eine feine stilvolle Unterkunft, wie sie schöner hätte nicht sein können mit einem wundervollen Blumenstrauß und Blick ins Grüne, ...ein wahres kleines Paradies- sehr empfehlenswert. Alexander ist sehr gastfreundlich. Dankeschön!

유럽 여행 일정 중 가장 훌륭한 숙소, 그리고 호스트였습니다.
일단 대성당과 시청 근처라 위치가 좋고
바로 앞에 큰 마트도 있습니다.
무엇보다 훌륭했던 건 인테리어.
제가 꿈꾸던 유럽에서의 하루밤을 그대로 옮겨놓은 것 같은 아담하면서도 섬세함, 예쁜 방이었어요.(주인분이 꽃집 사장님이라 그런지 방안 곳곳에 꽃이!)
하나 단점은 계단이 좁아 케리어를 옮기기 조금 위험할 수도 있습니다. 하지만 정말 강추하는 숙소예요!!
Super verblijf gehad. Netjes ontvangen, bloemetjes op de kamer en de locatie is perfect. Wij komen terug!
Alexander's place was lovely-great space, great location, great host!

Je voelt je welkom om te genieten van een goed verzorgde studio met alles erop en eraan en zelfs nog meer. Aandacht voor stijl en comfort, rustige kamer in het oude centrum, dus alles is goed te belopen. Een echte aanrader!
Lovely place, great location in the old town.

Loved the garden view and the fresh flowers from Alexander’s flower shop downstairs. Staying in such a unique location was really fun.

Only a half block from the oldest house in Anvers, not to mention plenty of good places to eat and lots of interesting things to see.
Peaceful place with a very nice host, worth visiting again!
Mooie, rustige en nette studio. Gastvrije host en alles is op loopafstand! Zeker een aanrader.
Mooie goed verzorgde studio met een goed bed, fijne douche en een mooi uitzicht op de tuin. Op de kamer staan verse bloemen en de gastheer is erg vriendelijk. Zeker een aanrader!

it’s located very near good restos, bars, convenience stores, and sights. previous guests were not kidding about an awesome jazz club 3mins away. the space was roomy for 2 people and nice touches like the flowers and plants in a little nook at the back just added even more good vibes❤️
alexander was also very accommodating to give tips about where to eat, and he even gave my bestfriend great insight on what plants and flowers to grow in her terrace in paris. all in all, a perfect 10

Квартира находиться действительно в самом центре Антверпена.
Удачное месторасположение, отличный хозяин.
Рекомендую!

We loved this place! It is so central, well thought out and Alexander is a fantastic host!!! We stayed 2 nights in Brugge before, and 2 nights in Amsterdam after. There’s a part of my mind that thinks it would have been worth doing daytrips to those places, and stay at Alexander’s the whole time. Antwerp has so much to offer, whilst not walking in a «queue» with other tourists/travellers. The studio itself is light and airy. Large; - has a well equipped kitchen area, dining table, sofa, wardrobe, balconette., and it’s spotlessly clean. There are supermarkets nearby, as well as laundrette, cafe’s, restaurants, take away’s, sights - and public transport. The only negative - mosquitoes!!! But we had close encounters with those in Brugge and Amsterdam, too (suppose canals and mozzies just go together). Would love to go back - great place, great location, great host.
Very good place, clean and comfortable, the location is good too, definitely recommended!
Alexander’s flower store is excellent! The room is clean and nice! My favorite!

Alexander's place was sweet, comfy, and everything we needed. It was a pleasure to have gardens to view through the glass doorway at the back of the unit, and flowers to enjoy on the table.
His small kitchen is perfect for a few nights, we appreciated the refrigerator for keeping our wine and cheese chilled!
Thank you, Alexander!
Mooie locatie en erg vriendelijke ontvangst!

The apartment is as described and seen in the pictures. Everything is sparkling clean with a little cottage charm. Right in the heart of the city. Alexander is communicative and simply lovely. All in all, it’s a cosy home in Antwerp!

Sehr nette Unterkunft, sehr zentral, aber trotzdem ruhig. Alexander ist ein sympathischer Gastgeber, mit dem alles reibungslos geklappt hat.  Wir hatten sogar frische Blumen aus seinem Blumenladen auf dem Esstisch!

Unterkunft unbedingt weiterzuempfehlen. Wir waren total zufrieden. Gemütlich, liebevoll und sehr warm eingerichtet. Die Wohnung war top sauber und sehr zentral. Alexander ist ein sehr freundlicher Gastgeber.

Alexander’s place was beautiful! We loved the plants and fresh flowers in the room, and the space itself was really cozy and inviting. Alexander was very communicative and gave us easy directions for reaching the apartment and tips about the area. We wished we had booked another night here!

We had a fantastic stay here. Alexander was very responsive and accommodating. The place is gorgeous, we loved the flowers that were waiting for us when we came in, and most importantly, the location is superb, just blocks away from the Grote Markt, Cathedral, St. Paul's Church and lots of other great bars and restaurants. Totally recommend.

This is a very stylish, cozy spot for anyone looking to explore the most popular areas of Antwerp. Alexander was also a very friendly/accommodating host and check-in was simple. If you’re looking for a convenient yet quiet location I definitely would recommend staying here!
Perfect location and lovely space in the heart of Antwerp.

This is such a great place to stay in the heart of Antwerp. The apartment is spacious and really nice. You have a view of a beautiful garden out the back door. The place is centrally located to the trolley, subway, and plenty of restaurants and bars. Christian is an excellent host who takes great care of you.

Calm and centrally located
Beautiful appartment with wonderfull fresh flowers!
Alexanders place was spacious. The balkony and court made it look green. I loved the wooden ceiling. Close to city centre. We had a nice stay.

Alexander’s place was very clean and comfortable. Check in was very flexible and easy as his floral shop is located under the loft. The loft is conveniently located to many shops, cafes and the Grote Markt. Would highly recommend staying at Alexander’s!

Classic and modern decoration in a lovely apartment prepared for you to have a lovely time. You enter the apartment via the flower store below, lovely by the way. The host was super nice.

I will definitely comeback.
Great location, clean, comfortable, good size, great host.

Helemaal perfect! Ik zou deze locatie iedereen aanraden. De studio is heel schoon & er staat een prachtige bos bloemen als je aan komt. Het is 2 minuten vanaf het centrum dus ideaal als je overal heen wil wandelen.
A spacious studio with garden view in a really central location.
Very nice place
Highly recommended, excellent location, perfect host.
Nice accommodation in the heart of Antwerp!
Heerlijk mooi,, stil, net apartement midden in de stad.
Fijne stille ruimte, goed bed, goed dekbed, simpele keuken met gerei. Heerlijk dicht bij het centrum.

Geweldige plek, midden in de stad.
Prachtig huis, aanrader.
Goede locatie, studio is zeer netjes. Ik vond de kamer zeker sfeervoller dan op de foto's. Uitstekende prijs/kwaliteit.

This place was a wonderful find! It is above a florist in a hip part of Antwerp, 5 mins walk to the centre of town.

The street and surrounds are gorgeous- cobblestoned and full of bookstores, vintage shops and cute cafes. A fabulous area to just wander in! There is also an excellent supermarket 2 minutes walk from the apartment.

The apartment itself was excellent. Clean and cheerful and very warm on cold winter nights! The kitchen is well equipped for whipping up quick meals.

We loved our time here and only wish we had stayed for longer!

Excellent place to stay for short or longer trips. Alexander is friendly and helpful. The studio has a picture perfect view on his flower shop's enclosed garden area and is very quiet and peaceful. Highly recommended and we will  return for a future trip and stay.

Alexander's place is in a short walk to town, the sights and places for food. Lovely short stay. Perfect for a couple nights, though the amenities can be limited if you wanted to cook your own food.
Alexander is a friendly local, owning the flowershop below for 24 years, and gave good tips for the area and booked our taxi back to the station on our day of departure. Good communication.

Good location. City center close, with lot of shops and restaurants. Place was cozy and clean. And the host, Alexander, such a nice person! Flowers behind the door in the morning was a sweet surprise.
Just fine

Prima locatie om een aantal nachten door te brengen.
De ligging is ideaal, alles is lopend prima te doen.
Alexander is een vriendelijke man. In en uitchecken kan in overleg.
Great location and beautifully decorated room. Loved our stay!

I would definitely recommend you stay at Alexander's place.
It is stylish, clean, comfortable and in a great location.
will definitely return when back in Antwerp.
Thanks Alexander!!

Locatie is vooral het voordeel van dit verblijf. (Hoewel Alexander erg vriendelijk is en goed communiceert.) Loop afstand van het gezellige oude centrum, kleine plekjes in dezelfde straat om even iets te drinken of te eten en een supermarkt een paar deuren verder. Daarnaast ligt de kamer aan de rustige achterkant. Het heeft alles voor een kort verblijf, de basis in de keuken, ruime douche en een mega zacht en comfortabel bed. Zoek niet verder.

Heel fijne kamer met prachtige verse bloemen en een heerlijk breed bed. Prima badkamer en keukentje in de kamer. Alexander reageert heel snel en de ruime inchecktijden en mogelijkheid om je koffertje achter te laten zijn erg fijn. Leuke buurt ook! We komen terug.
Lovely apartment, well located in the centre of Antwerp.  Alexander is very nice, and we have had the chance to actually meet him. We enjoyed our weekend.

Aanrader! Alexander is een erg vriendelijke man die erg meedacht om ons verblijf optimaal te maken. We hadden bijvoorbeeld onze baby mee in de kinderwagen. Aangezien de studio op 1 hoog is bood Alexander aan om de kinderwagen in zijn bloemenwinkel te zetten die eronder zit. Dit was erg prettig. Doordat Alexander eronder zijn winkel heeft is hij erg flexibel met inchecken en uitchecken wat erg prettig was. De studio zit in het historische centrum, alles zit heerlijk dichtbij. Zelfs een supermarkt op 200mtr die 7 dagen open is. De studio is zelfs wat ruimer dan verwacht. Ons babybedje paste er makkelijk bij en dan was er nog genoeg bewegingsruimte over. Daarnaast was alles schoon en waren de basisvoorzieningen zoals handdoeken, zeep, toiletpapier en koffie/thee aanwezig.
Heel fijn verblijf gehad in een mooie studio op een hele goede locatie!

Het is een hele gezellige studio waar alles heel goed geregeld en verzorgd is. Het ligt echt heel in het centrum met een supermarktje om de hoek. Alexander is enorm gastvrij en heel behulpzaam, hij heeft ons tips gegeven en was flexibel met in- en uitchecken. Als we nog eens naar Antwerpen gaan dan weet ik zeker dat we hier terugkomen, het was echt genieten.
Great location and the studio just has everything you need for a visit to Antwerp! Also very easy check-in and flexible with check-out. I really recommend it!
Very central, very quiet location and nice equipment. It is also very clean and functional.
Great place to stay. It's very central located, the room is great and the flowers are beautiful. Would definitely stay here again.

A lovely apartment right near the centre of Antwerp, comfortable and very handy. Powerful hot shower and good coffee machine, as well as a very large and comfortable bed. Very clean and nicely styled, an excellent apartment.
Heel fijn appartement dicht bij het centrum van de stad. Prettig contact met de verhuurder en fijne sfeer in het appartement, verse bloemen uit de bloemenwinkel op tafel!
great place, great location!

Gemütliches Zimmer in guter Lage und sehr freundlichem und jederzeit erreichbarem Gastgeber. Es waren sogar frische Blumen aus dem Blumenladen im Erdgeschoss aufgestellt. Einziges Manko war das schwierige WLAN, aber Alexander war jederzeit erreichbar und hilfsbereit.

Gezellige en knusse accommodatie, voorzien van werkelijk alle gemakken en op loopafstand van het oude stads- en uitgaanscentrum. Alexander  is bijzonder gastvrij en behulpzaam. Kortom, een heerlijke plek om te verblijven en Antwerpen te bezoeken.

Great place with excellent design touches. Lovely place to stay.

Hôte réactifs aux messages et très chaleureux. Appartement propre et très bien situé.

Perfect location, beautiful little studio and wonderful guest

Excellent host with a beautiful flower shop and very nice interior design!

Thank you

The host canceled this reservation 24 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.

Le logement est SUBLIME tel que sur les photos et la description. Le logement est situé juste à côté de toutes les commodités. Très grande terrasse plein soleil, avec de quoi se coucher et se relaxer. Je recommande vivement . Merci Karine
De locatie is top, met leuke cafes en winkels in de buurt. Mooi en ruim appartement, nog beter dan op de foto’s.
Karine is very helpfull and so quick responsive. Perfect stay!
I always enjoy staying at Karine's apartment. It's a wonderful space in a great location. Karine is quick to respond and check-in and check-out is effortless. Highly recommend.

We had amazing days in Karines loft, which is extremely well equipped and we had plenty of space. Communication with Karines was always very prompt, easy, helpful and kind. All in all it was a perfect stay. Highly recommended.
Friendly Host. Plenty of space. Stylish Loft. Near to likeable bars and cafes. Unfortunately this summer (2018) many signs and monuments of the city were under construction or closed.
Strak ingericht. Lekkere ruimte, lang uit op de bank, prima keuken, badkamer en op een mooie plek gelegen in Antwerpen.

Great place ! I enjoyed a lot the loft of Karine, very design, clean, quiet, in a great area ! Perfect for 1 or 2 persons. The place is even more beautiful in real than on pictures. I definitely want to go back at Karine’s place when I go back to Antwerpen.

Karine was a great communicator. She was easy to reach via the app, which we always appreciate. She met us in person to help us get checked in. The apartment was in a great location with easy access to public transit and many walkable locations.

Karine's place is stylish, modern, and unique - and also situated in the perfect location in Antwerp, close to delicious restaurants lively bars, but also not exposed to noise. Karine herself was an excellent and super responsive host. Great experience!

It was so nice to spent one day/night in the loft. We really appreciated the extraordinary design of the loft. And it's really in the center of the town. You can walk easily to all interesting places. The neighbourhood itself is really nice too. We tried to book very spontaneously and Karine was very flexible. We would like to come back!

Het is een heerlijk, ruim appartement met een gunstige ligging. Wij houden van de wijk Antwerpen zuid met volop restaurants, terrasjes etc om de hoek.
Appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien. Ook super attent dat er gin tonic was als welkomstdrankje :-)
Prachtige ruimte, perfecte locatie!
Beautifully decorated, central and quiet location.
Super ruim en mooi appartement in een een leuke wijk in Antwerpen. Goede uitvalsbasis voor een stedenstrip!

Zeer gastvrije dame. Prachtige locatie.
Alles was er perfect.
Karine’s place is one of the best Airbnb I have stay in. The pictures don’t do it’s justice. The real thing is much more spacious. Beautifully designed. We had a good time staying there.
Her home was amazing. Everything was clean and organized.

Na aankomst via een kleine patio leidt een smalle trap u naar een modern, mooi gerenoveerd appartement zoals u dat ook in woonbladen ziet. Het biedt alle comfort en wij zijn hartelijk ontvangen. Communicatie verloopt snel en soepel, en ook stelt Karine zich flexibel en dienstbaar op. Het appartement is een goede uitvalsbasis voor het verkennen van de binnenstad en u te laten verassen door omliggende boetiekjes.
Absoluut een aanrader!

Prachtig appartement, zeer ruim, strakke inrichting, van alle gemakken voorzien. Volop restaurants en bars in de omgeving, op loopafstand van het centrum. Perfecte uitvalsbasis voor een stedentrip. Karine is een superhost; reageert snel, is zeer gastvrij en correct.
Very beautiful and well designed flat! The location is incredible, everything you need.
Top place

Het appartement is strak maar stijlvol en sfeervol ingericht en voorzien van alle gemakken. De toegang is via een wat smalle trap (te grote koffers zouden niet handig zijn!!!) maar dan kom je in een zeer ruim appartement gelegen in een zeer trendy deel van Antwerpen met heerlijke restaurantjes in de buurt en op loop afstand van het Centrum etc. De gratis parkeerruimte op ca 300 meter van het appartement is zonder meer een pre
Top loft op een top plek!
Vrij rustig en goed gelegen app/loft. Vriendelijk onthaal en goede communicatie! Een aanrader!
Een oase van rust middenin Het Zuid en een van de beste bakkers van Antwerpen naast je voordeur. Heerlijk geslapen & het dakterras is volgens mij in de zomer fabuleus. We komen graag terug!
Stylish and well-located apartment. Karine is a wonderful host that will help you in discovering Antwerp. Definitely recommend.

Very nice place and pictures reflect well the reality. Easy contact with Karine and appreciated the flexible approach re check in/out.  Perfect location (bars, resto, museum etc) with free parking 2 min walking away, easy access to city rental-bikes, public transport etc.  Just one remark, previous guests smoked cigarettes at the windows and the appartment was smelly but am sure Karine will make sure this no longer happens.  Thanks Karine !
A great and beautifull loft with a roof terrace. In the centre of Antwerp South. A district full of good shops, pubs and restaurants!
This is the best place to stay when visiting Antwerp!
Location is really great, many attractions at a short walking distance

Karine helaas niet persoonlijk ontmoet, maar de communicatie verliep erg prettig en vlot. Het is een ruim, schoon en mooi appartement op 5 minuten loopafstand van het centrum af. Het enigste wat een beetje minder was, was het parkeren. Het was wel gratis voor de deur (na 15:00) maar enorm druk. Ik heb mijzelf goed vermaakt en raad zeker dit appartement aan!

Super loft op een toplocatie!
Zeer rustig gelegen. Grote dressing. Goed bed en een
heel comfortabele douche!
Wij komen graag nog een keertje terug.
Karine is bereikbaar en reageert snel.

Karine nous a accueillis très chaleureusement et a répondu à toutes nos questions concernant le quartier.
De plus l'appartement est spacieux et très agréable. Avec en plus la terrasse super sympa.
Je recommande vivement !
Really nice place!!! Highly recommend it.
Enorm genoten. Prachtige plek op een top locatie. Zeker een aanrader.
Dit was ons 4e verblijf bij Karine en zeker niet de laatste. Een aanrader!

Een heel fijn en ruim loft, centraal gelegen. Karine kon ons niet ontvangen, maar had alles goed uitgelegd en was snel met communiceren. Er was koffie, thee en zelfs gin/tonic. Maar we hadden zelf een wijntje meegenomen.
Dit loft is een échte aanrader.
Monique

Karine’s home is a very stylish, very large minimalist apartment right in the middle of the arts/ design district! At the same time it’s close enough to walk to other popular tourist destinations in Antwerp! It is also super quiet so a good nights sleep is never a problem! I mustn’t forget to mention the relaxing sun room on the roof. Perfect to kick back and do some reading, dozing or getting over jet lag! My husband and I loved our stay at Karine’s and wouldn’t hesitate to stay there again should we return to beautiful Antwerp! Thanks Karine!
Nice and spaceous, good location, comfortable bed. Karine has been super kind and helpful.
Beautiful minimalist apartment in a nice part of the city to walk around and get coffee or explore.
Cool, cozy and stylish space in Antwerp. Definitely would like to stay again.
All was just perfect. Great location close to everything and very stylish appartment.

Prachtige luxe ruimte waar je je lekker thuis voelt door alle handige voorzieningen. Echt een designruimte en ideaal gelegen ; vlakbij restaurantjes en cocktail lounges :)! Enige minpunt is weinig belichting in het appartement. Kijk er erg naar uit nog een keer hier te kunnen verblijven.
This place is a hidden gem in the city with great space design and it’s super close to everything. Recommend for anyone who wants to book it.

I had a perfect stay in Antwerpen. The place is just perfectly located and very nice to stay.
Very clean and unique. I can absolutely recommend the great loft.
For someone who studies interior architecture this space was really inspiring! Very comfortable and  we made good use of the available utilities.

To say I was impressed when seeing this beautiful flat is an understatement.
It was just perfect!
Even thought this modern bright flat is located in one of the trendiest neighbourhoods of Antwerp it is sill a very quiet place if you simply wish to relax.
It’s gigantic by the way!
The communication with Karine (the host) was very smooth all the way which is always a big plus.
From the warm welcome, to the many tips she provided about the neighbourhood or other, the hassle-free check in & out, etc.. she even made sure we had fresh drinks in the fridge including some special Belgium beer :) and other little details like if the tv channels we were looking for were available before we arrived etc...
We spent a lovely weekend in Antwerp and staying at Karine’s flat certainly contributed to what was an enjoyable experience.
Recommended? Yes!!
Will we come back ? Definitely!!!

The place is just perfect!!!
I had an amazing time
An amazing apartment in a brilliant location and Karine is the perfect host.

die loft ist echt cool eingerichtet und in einem sehr schönen viertel in der innenstadt. Das Bett ist 140 cm und könnte für zwei personen etwas breiter sein. Wir kamen aber ganz gut zurecht.
Leider wußten wir nicht, das ausländische autos ohne anmeldung nicht in die umweltzone fahren dürfen! So wurden wir beim reinfahren fotografiert und sollten 180 € strafe zahlen. Karine’s apartment is wonderful. The apartment itself has a stylish, minimalist interior and is larger than it looks on the photos.
It’s in a fantastic area, right in the heart of Antwerp’s best restaurants (2 min walk from Marnixplaats) and bars and a 10 minute walk from the shopping area (or 2 tram stops!).
Antwerp itself is a great city...we’ll be back (hopefully to stay at Karine’s again!!).

Sublime maison, hôte très réactif et attentionné.
Merci :)
Had a great stay at Karine’s place. The loft is a lot bigger than the photographs which was a surprise. Amazing location and very stylish.

Heerlijk heldere grote ruimte, alles fris wit, het dakterras mét goede beanbags was echt top!! (Zeker tijdens dagen met 36graden) De locatie is super, leuke rustige en gezellige buurt in Zuid met fijne eetplekjes. Karine is een superhost, flexibel en erg fijn contact. Wij komen nogmaals terug!
Beautiful and very spacy loft To be recommended.
A steep winding staircase leads to a spacious (cavernous) second floor flat. Very quiet and comfortable.

This apartment is really a stylish and cozy place! The very heart of the city is within 15 mins walk and there is a free parking space just 5 mins walk away. Very convenient and safe location. We would definitely come back next time!

PS. If you’re driving a rental car from other countries, please have a check in advance whether your car is registered to the LEZ system. I heard that penalty might cost a lot for not register.
Dit stijlvolle, centraal gelegen, van alle gemakken voorziene, ruime loft zal je niet tegenvallen!
Great location - amazing apartment with loads of space to relax.

We had a great time in a beautiful loft apartment in the best area of Antwerp. The place is stylisch and unique. The check in was easy and the communication quick and uncomplicated. There are many good restaurants and bars just around the corner. Don’t hesitate to book this wonderful accommodation!
Huge apartment, very chic, in a great location. Karine was very responsive and helpful.
Mooie strakke en zéér ruime loft met alle voorzieningen.
Es war wunderschön und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt! Die Lage ist perfekt und alles ist fussläufig zu erreichen. Wir kommen auf jeden Fall wieder.

Amazing loft! Big and airy. You have so much space you don’t want to leave the apartment and stay in watch tv and Netflix. Do go out, because you are in the best location with great restaurants and shops all walking distance. Highly recommended. Book it now!
Prachtige loft!!! Alles is op loopafstand en heerlijke restaurants en biertjes
Absolutely beautiful space situated perfectly in the centre of antwerp, karine was an amazing host offering every bit of local information we needed. Definitely recommend staying here, 10/10.
Place to go !
Excellent endroit je recommande !

quick and easy check in, nice location, interesting place!

thanks Karine!

Precies op de afgesproken tijd werden we hartelijk welkom geheten door Hanne. Met prima tips over de bakker, de supermarkt en restaurants op loopafstand kon ons weekend beginnen.
Het appartement is precies zoals verwacht of eigenlijk beter. Twee prima slaapkamers, een volledig ingerichte keuken en een gezellige woonkamer.
Na een wandeling van circa 25 minuten sta je in het historisch centrum. De wandeling op zich is al leuk.
Wij komen zeker terug!
Zeer sympathieke ontvangst van de zus van de eigenares. Schitterend appartement met een prachtige woonkamer en zicht over de stad. Op wandelafstand van allerlei leuke dingen.
The appartment is very spacious, excellent location, clean and comfortable. Better than the pictures :) We will remember this place.

We had an amazing stay! The apartment is more than we expected, large and bright.  As soon you walk in you fell really welcome and you feel like home. The apartment is very spacious and it is fully furnished. We loved the large living room with the amazing bow window on the 5th floor. I have to admit, I spent a lot time looking at the view. We didn’t have the chance to meet Suszy, but she was really helpful by text. However, we met her sister Sylvie. She is a brilliant and funny. She gave us  good tips on things to do  and on traditional things to buy (like the  typical cookies). I highly recommend this place.

Very nice location, 2km to the shopping street, super market very nearby , 2 bedrooms and 2 bathroom,
I love Suzy's apartment very much , it's nicer than the pictures, and bigger than I thought
A fantastic apartment, perfectly situated in the city center. Much space and well equipped. Suzy is a lovely host and very helpful.
Mooi en praktisch appartement op een heel handige locatie. Ideaal om van daaruit de stad te gaan verkennen.
Een schitterend, zeer compleet ingericht appartement met een mooi uitzicht over de stad.  Communicatie met eigenaars is perfect.  Eigenlijk zou je er zo willen blijven en nooit meer weggaan...
Very welcoming and hospitable host. We definitely like the apartment and the position. There are very nice restaurants, cafes and bars nearby. The old town is in a walking distance (15 min).

El apartamento de Suzy es cómodo,  bonito,  limpio,  muy amplio, con todo lo necesario. El apartamento está a unos 15 minutos del centro en un barrio tranquilo y con muchos restaurantes a menos de 5 minutos. Ella es flexible,  detallista,  atenta y contesta rápido a cualquier duda. Totalmente recomendable.

Suzy's place was exactly as pictured/described. She was very accomadating and easy to reach via text when necessary. Very spacious and clean apartment. Our only complaint was the lack of air conditioning as it was very hot in Antwerp during our stay, but that was stated in the listing so it was our fault for not noticing that. I would stay here again if I visit Antwerp again

Suzy is a great host, always getting back to me promptly when I had a question. The house was superb and the wee personal touches (beer in fridge!) made it all so much better! A fantastic location and a great stay in Antwerp, highly recommended! Thank you so much!!!

Vriendelijk en comfortabel ingericht appartement op een fijne locatie, dicht bij restaurants, cafés, en een heerlijke bakker. Rustige omgeving. In het appartement alles wat je nodig zou kunnen hebben. Suzy is een relaxte behulpzame host, flexibel met in/uitchecken, alles was tiptop in orde. Aanrader!

Beautiful, spacious apartment in a great location, close to museums, galleries and restaurants. The two playgrounds on the doorstep were perfect for our five year old. The quiet neighborhood is perfect for families.

Suzy’s sister, who met us when we arrived, was warm and welcoming.

I would recommend this lovely apartment.
Très bon accueil. Appartement très agréable et proche du centre.

Het verblijf in de loft van Ibrahim was erg aangenaam. Naast het prachtige uitzicht over de stad, was de loft schoon en mooi ingericht.
Ibrahim was zelf niet in staat ons te verwelkomen maar de Portugese buurvrouw heeft ons rondgeleid en alles uitgelegd, dit was allemaal goed geregeld en van te voren afgesproken.
We konden, als we vragen hadden, deze altijd stellen aan de buurvrouw of Ibrahim zelf, wat een goed gevoel gaf.
De buurt van de loft is erg goed gelegen en vlakbij het centraal station van Antwerpen. Je kan alle kanten op vanuit deze locatie!

Samenvattend, een verblijf in deze loft is een aanrader voor iedereen die een leuk weekend Antwerpen wil!

Our stay in the loft of Ibrahim was very comfortable. Besides the beautiful view form the loft, it was clean and nicely decorated. Ibrahim sells and buys vintage, which was shown in the loft, beautiful.
Ibrahim was not able to welcome us himself, so his Portugese neighbour welcomed us. She gave us a tour around the loft and explained a few important things about the furniture. Overall we had a excellent stay in the loft, and we would highly recommend this stay! We would love to come back.

We hebben het super fijn gehad in de loft van Ibrahim! De manier waarop hij alles regelt is erg oprecht, verzorgend en met veel respect. Zo had hij bloemen voor ons gekocht, lagen er handdoeken met zeepjes voor ons klaar, lag er een guestbook met lekkere Belgische bonbons ernaast en was de loft erg schoon en lekker warm. Het is echt heel mooi ruim en heeft een prachtige inrichting. Veel antiek en vintage spullen, waar Ibrahim ook nog iets over verteld heeft. Het uitzicht is heel mooi, je kan Antwerpen-Centraal zien liggen. Het is lekker dichtbij het centrum, alles was op loopafstand. Ibrahim zelf is erg gastvrij, vrolijk en de communicatie verliep uitstekend. Perfect als Airbnb!

Beautiful spacious loft with a great view and well styled. Really close to the station and only a 15 minutes walk to the old city centre. Ibrahim is a friendly and flexible host. We can recommend a stay at his place!

Ibrahim was very attentive and quick to respond, hard working and manages his busy schedule very well. On the last moment reservation I made, he managed to put things together making our arrival look so well prepared. The home is clean and has a unique style of its own. Beautiful views from the windows.
The bed was clean and comfortable with nice selection of bed linen ( Egyptian cotton I'm guessing ).
He and his friend made good recommendations on things to do in Antwerp.
We felt well looked after and I highly recommend his home on your stay in Antwerp.

Die Wohnung von Ibrahim ist fantastisch. Durch die zentrale Lage, bereist man schnell alle Ecken von Antwerpen! Die Aussicht ist wunderschön und trotz der Lage schläft man im 7.Stock in völliger Stille. Die Einrichtung der Wohnung ist sehr stilvoll und gemütlich, man fühlt sich direkt wohl. Ibrahim ist ein cooler, witziger und offener Typ. Als Welcome gab es Pralinen und Wasser. Zahnpasta, Handtücher ,Duschgel und Taschentücher lagen auch schon bereit. Wir kommen gerne wieder!!

Ibrahim was op en top gastheer. Hij heeft er letterlijk alles aan gedaan om het ons zo prettig mogelijk te maken. Alles was piekfijn in orde, alles spic en span en het huis was een plaatje. We voelden ons meteen op ons gemak.
Het uitzicht is geweldig en de ligging ten opzichte van het CS en de Meir is uitstekend.
Als er een titel is voor Mister Airbnb dan is Ibrahim de aangewezen persoon. Wij geven hem 10 uit 10. Chapeau.
Ibrahim is a five star host. Communiation was easy and reliable, the loft as described and superclean, location top. Full recommendation.

Ibrahim is an exceptional host. He is very friendly and thoughtful, which showed in both his communication and his welcome. His apartment is particularly cool and he has great taste. Would definitely recommend staying here especially as it is real close to the train station.
Super apartment very nice furniture very friendly host, everything is looked after, towels, soap, showergel, fruit and candy are available on arrival. Attention to detail. Well worth your stay

Wat 'n beauty van een plek, wauw! Gelegen om de hoek van Antwerpen Centraal en mogelijk... met 't allermooiste uitzicht. De vintage inrichting is authentiek en cosy; we houden ervan. Ibrahim heeft zeer zijn best gedaan om onze komst voor te bereiden, ook al was het kort dag. Merci!

Very nice flat with a perfect welcome of a very friendy host.
Pretty close from the train stration and 15 walking or so from the South district.
Highly recommanded!

Ibrahim is such a kind and thoughtful host! The area was perfect condition me as it was a few minutes from the main station and also fabulous shopping and sightseeing, but also quiet. The apartment is also stylish as Ibrahim has an interest in vintage stuff.  I would recommend to anyone.
Ibrahim heeft ons zeer welkom ontvangen in zijn Loft.  Prachtige plek om vanuit Antwerpen te ontdekken. Zeer leuk gestylde woning op een goede locatie bij een  zeer vriendelijke verhuurder!

We had a lovely stay in Ibrahim's apartment. Great communication throughout and warm welcome on arrival. The location is fantastic and the flat itself cosy, spacious and with great view over the city. On all front we were met with kindness, warmth and flexibility. Thank you for making our stay such a great one. I can highly recommend to anybody looking for accommodation in Antwerpen, beats any hotel!

Ibrahim's loft was my first Airbnb ecxperience; both his willingness to assist and his stylish place has made me a huge advocate for airbnb.

Perfect location and the loft made the stay even more special!

Als cadeautje voor mijn vriendin zijn we een weekendje naar Antwerpen geweest en hebben we geslapen in het toffe appartement van Ibrahim. Heel gaaf appartement met uitzicht over het centraal station en alles is goed bereikbaar. Het is een heerlijke ruimte met alle gemakken, kortom we hebben genoten!

Ibrahim responded directly to all my questions. He's a great guy and very flexible. Everything is vert clean and we felt immediately at home! Thanks for a great weekend, I would come again to his place next time!
Ibrahim's place has amazing views, an amazing vintage flare and a great bead. Ibrahim is also a very nice and understanding host.

Ibrahim is a wonderful person &host! his hospitality was incredible & he did everything to provide me a comfortable stay
The apartment is spacious, nicer than in the pictures
all was neat, & check in flexible!
Thanks a lot! hope to come back soon
big recommendation!

Ibrahim was erg gastvrij,het appartement was helemaal geweldig we voelden ons er erg thuis.
De locatie was goed,openbaar vervoer in de buurt.
Vlak bij het station en de winkelstraat op loopafstand.

The apartment was everything we expected and more, very spacious and clean with a nice view over the city. Ibrahim was a great host, the contact we had with him was easy going. We definitely would love to come back here!

Super appartement situé a 5 minutes de la gare d'Anvers ! Pour joindre le centre ville, très simple et aux alentours de 20 minutes a pied ! Le mieux étant bien sur de louer les vélos de la ville a la gare (attention la borne est tout au fond de la gare) et de se balader et explorer la ville dans tous ses recoins ! L'appartement est exactement comme sur les photos ! Magnifique, original ! Ibrahim a su décorer son logement avec goût et extravagance parfois ! Je recommande bien sur de venir a Anvers chez lui! Très simple de le joindre ! Et si vous êtes intéressés comme nous l'étions, il vous fera des petits topos sur ces différents objets qui meublent/ décorent son appartement !
The appartment is very nice.

A very joyful guy who loves to help. The apartment is very neat and has a lovely vintage design. The apartment is located in the city center. All of the sightseeing of Antwerp is nearby. No need to take a taxi.

Thanks for the wonderful stay. We will be back!

Ibrahim was very easy going and really easy to talk to. It was sort of like talking to an old friend! If you are having any doubts about staying at his apartment, then don't! As long as you can make it up the stairs, the apartment is well worth it! It's close to the Antwerp station and you get a great view of the Ferris Wheel and the surrounding buildings at night!

Très joli appartement, spacieux et décoré avec goût. IL se trouve à quelques minutes à pieds de la gare centrale. pour rejoindre le centre ville, une petite vingtaine de minutes sont nécessaires à pieds. A vélo, le trajet se fait en 5-7 minutes !
L'appartement est comme indiqué dans la description : charmant, accueillant, lumineux et dispose d'une belle vue sur la ville.

L'accueil était parfait. Ibrahim est extrêmement gentil et a été à notre entière disposition. A notre arrivée, une bouteille de vin nous attendait ainsi que différentes choses pour le petit-déjeuner.

Si je dois retourner à Anvers, je n'hésiterai pas une seule seconde pour retourner chez Ibrahim. Je recommande vivement !

Heerlijk ruime loft! De foto's geven een mooi beeld van wat je te wachten staat. Een flesje wijn en chips stonden ons al op te wachten. Omdat Ibrahim zelf op vakantie was heeft een vriend van hem ons binnen gelaten. Enorm behulpzaam en we voelden ons dan ook direct thuis in deze prachtige ruimte die met beleid is ingericht :) Voor de korte duur was het een heerlijke plek om te mogen verblijven en in de toekomst zou ik hier ook zeker terug komen.
Very nice host - took even care of breakfast

"Alsof je in het huis slaapt van de eigenaar van een Vintage Galerie", zo heb ik het verblijf bij Ibo ervaren. Dit huis met al zijn persoonlijkheid en met het prachtige uitzicht over de stad heeft mij verliefd gemaakt. Op Antwerpen.
Très bel accueil, avec tout mis à disposition pour passer un agréable séjour. Merci aussi pour l'apéro et les petits déjeuners.

Thanks Ibrahim for your hospitality during our stay in your wonderful apartment. It was in a perfect location for exploring the city by foot and was lovely and cosy to come home to in the evenings. Throughly recommend for anyone visiting Antwerp.

Ibrahim heeft ervoor gezorgd dat onze eerste ervaring met Airbnb een fantastische was. Last minute alles tot in de puntjes verzorgd en bij het uitchecken kwam hij zelfs met een ontbijtje aanzetten, dat we tijdens een goed gesprek in de prachtige loft hebben kunnen opeten. Bedankt voor alles.

Nice stay, good location, very good communication and really nice host!
Recommending it! Listing is beautiful

What a fantastic place to stay! From comfort to views and then the vintage everything! Ibrahim's attention to detail surpasses any effort in a boutique store! Truly magnificent!
