At the time we checked in, we had trouble finding the entrance to the loft due a huge party being thrown at Cafe Delux (the bar that the bar is located above) that partly blocked the entrance. The music was so loud we couldn’t think and called Petra, and got a hold of her within about 10 minutes. The party shut down at 10, but it was unexpected by all and made for a difficult check in.

The loft itself is very nice, and we were expecting the bottle of cava promised upon arrival but wasn’t there, so another let down.

The beds downstairs were nice, but the bunk beds were incredibly squeaky so we actually ended up moving one of the mattresses onto the floor. The level of noise was high and constant unfortunately, which understand is not in the host’s control and comes with being in such a good location.

The location was wonderful, the patio looks directly at the cathedral which is gorgeous especially at night. Very central and you can walk everywhere and to the tram/train stops if needed.

Overall, this was a lovely loft with a great location but if you are looking for some peace and quiet, and especially if you are a light sleeper like myself, this may not be the best place.

Petra’s loft is super clean and way larger than you would think for the area. It is stylishly decorated and very comfortable. There was coffee and champagne available to enjoy as well. The elevator is super convenient because if you have luggage there is no way you can take it up the beautiful original stairs to the third floor. The loft is located right in the middle of many restaurants, including some that are just down stairs. But do not worry the noise stops early because you are in a historical district and it never bothered my family once. Many amazing historical places are located just minutes from your door. In fact, it sits right at eye level with Our Lady Cathedral and is an unbelievable sight to see at night when it is all lit up 15 feet from your window. The beds are also super comfortable and I could’ve honestly slept all day. With my family of four, we easily had enough space to spread out and not be on top of each other. Which you rarely find when booking in the city. The TV had Netflix which was amazing because we don’t speak Dutch. It was nice after a day of exploring to come back late and watch a movie. Petra also provided card games, which we didn’t get a chance to play but was a nice touch, nonetheless. Finally, the desk in the loft has so much information and guides to help you get to know the city better and it was super helpful. Overall, we greatly enjoyed our stay and would 100% come back!
Een mooi en stijlvol gezellig loft in het hart van centrum Antwerpen.

We enjoyed 2nights in Antwerp and Petra’s palace was perfect.  Centrally located to the best bars and restaurants surrounded by beautiful buildings. The place is as exactly as shown in the pictures.  I would recommend to anyone.

Great apartment in the heart of Antwerp. Gorgeous views. Close to everything & there are little e years like a shopping trolley. If you want peace & quiet this is a lovely location which we lived as you could easily close the windows. Would definitely stay again
Super gelegen, zeer stijlvol appartement.

Most amazing view - pictures do not do it justice. You a really staring at the cathedral from your balcony.
Can get loud till about 2am with the bars and night life, but super cool loft and amazing location!
Great airbnb location, easy check in, great communication with Petra, modern, very nice and clean loft in the heart of Antwerp!

Petra’s place was even more beautiful than we expected and right in the middle of a great part of town. We were able to walk to everything we wanted to do.

Petra responded to all of our questions right away. We couldn’t have felt more taken care of. If we come back to Antwerp, we’ll definitely stay here again.
Mooie loft, prachtige lokatie. Bedden niet fijn en schoonmaak kan beter.
Prachtige ruimte, midden in hartje Antwerpen met een fantastisch uitzicht!
Great loft in a great location, can be a bit noisy outside, as you are surrounded by bars. But we viewed that as a big plus! :)
Best view in the city from every! window!!! Magical, cozy, practical and right in the middle of the center of beautiful Antwerp!

This apartment is amazing: it has beautiful decoration, the location couldn't be better and the views are fantastic.
It's 100% recommendable!

Super fijn appartement op een top locatie. Voor ons de 2e keer dat we er een lang weekend verbleven (1 x loft 1 en 1 x loft 2) en beide appartementen zijn fantastisch voor een groep zoals ons (6 personen)
Das Loft liegt super zentral in Antwerpen und man kann alles fußläufig gut erreichen. Petra ist sehr nett und hilfsbereit. Das Loft ist schick eingerichtet und die Küche komplett ausgestattet.
Beautiful appartement. All the things you need though well through. Excellent and beautiful location.
Perfecte locatie, erg mooi appartement, alles wat je nodig hebt!

Superbe emplacement dans le coeur d'Anvers et avec une vue splendide sur la cathédrale. Nous remercions Petra pour la qualité de nos échanges et sa grande réactivité. L'ensemble de notre famille est ravi d'avoir séjourné dans ce très bel appartement.

De loft is fantastisch en precies zoals de foto’s. Het voldeed absoluut aan onze verwachting. Het contact met Petra was prima, altijd een snel antwoord!
Het is redelijk rumoerig rondom de loft, logisch want midden in het uitgaansgebied. Om die reden zijn oordopjes geen overbodig, maar het mocht de pret zeker niet drukken.

Nice loft with excellent location. Very easy to get to several places to eat good food and try different belgium beer. Bunk bed does make some noise if you tend to move a lot in your sleep, and massage shower panel is broken, but overall decent value for money if you are 4-6 people.

Petra, reageert erg snel en duidelijk. Het appartement was erg schoon, mooi ingericht en erg ruim. Met name de ruime keuken met aangrenzende tafel was erg fijn! Locatie was zelfs nog fijner. Midden in het centrum met alles op steenworp afstand. Zeker een aanrader!
Een perfecte locatie voor een bezoek aan Antwerpen. De loft is ruim en stijlvol, van alle gemakken voor zien. Bij het inchecken werden wij zelfs verrast met een fles bubbels!

Really great loft with a super friendly host.
We really enjoyed our stay and can recommend this loft to everyone who wants to travel to Antwerp.
Mooie loft met een top locatie.
Zeer mooie en nette loft

The hostress is very very nice and respond very quickly to problems. We met accidently a big incident during the night and the hostress offered us compensation and  another also well-designed accommodation.

Such an amazing apartment to stay in! Central location, a lot of great restaurants are in the neighborhood. Apartment is very comfortable and super cosy, everything you might need is there! Petra is a wonderful host,  very hospitable, thoughtful and charming! One of the best Airbnb experience! Will definitely come back!
The Loft is really beautiful but the best is the outstanding location right in the center of the oldtown with a clear view on the Cathedral. Perfect!!

De loft ligt heel centraal gelegen, wat een groot pluspunt is. De voorafgaande informatie is heel duidelijk en klopt ook. Eens binnen in de loft is alles netjes en zoals het eruit ziet op foto. Een heel aangenaam weekend achter de rug doordat alles omtrent de verblijfplaats vlekkeloos verliep.
We had a great weekend! The loft is superb and the location could not be better! Thank you very much for your responsiveness to our requests. I highly recommend!

Hugely recommend this apartment/loft, me and 4 friends had a great stay whilst in Antwerp for the weekend! The location is truly superb and the views from the balcony are awesome! The apartment itself is cool, quirky, and a lovely place to spend time. There cant be many better places to stay in Antwerp, especially for larger groups of 4 to 5 people

Perfect location in the center of the city center, amazing view on the cathedral from the living room... we spent a great week-end in Petra place! Furthermore, Petra is a very responsive and flexible. Thanks a lot!
Great apartment in Antwerpen! We loved it! We would definitely go back and stay again at Petra's place!
We hebben weer een fijn weekend gehad

Sehr schöne Wohnung im Herzen von Antwerpen. Super Lage!!
Kann man nur empfehlen!!

Our family had an excellent stay at the loft. The location in Old Town is extremely convenient and in walking distance to all the major sites. We especially enjoyed relaxing on the balcony with the gorgeous view of the cathedral and sunset. The loft is just as pictured and Petra was able to supply a portable crib for our baby. We look forward to coming back again.
Amazing loft in the perfect la action to check out the city.

De loft is op een unieke locatie midden in de stad met een mooi uitzicht op de kathedraal. Vanuit hier kun je alle kanten op in Antwerpen. Petra is erg hulpvaardig voor tips en bezienswaardigheden in Antwerpen. Kortom; een aanrader!

This place was in a perfect location. Close to all the major sites. Older part of the city with an amazing view of the Church. Great bars and cafes close by (just watch out - it can be loud in the morning when they are slamming kegs around and restocking the bars). All in all - a great place just as described.
Perfect

Das Apartment hat eine perfekte Lage im Herzen Antwerpen. Dementsprechend muss man im Sommer aber damit rechnen bis in die Nacht herein die Geräuschkulisse der nahe gelegenen Restaurants mitzukriegen, was bei geschlossenen Fenstern aber kein Problem ist. Das Apartment lädt ansonsten wirklich total ein zum Wohlfühlen! Petra ist sehr nett und bemüht!
Très bel appartement avec vue magnifique. Mais franchement en mauvais état de maintenance et absolument pas propre.

Superb location. Petra was fantastic and very helpful. The accommodation was modern and very clean. The shower was great! Highly recommended. PS the view from the balcony is stunning,especially at night.
beautiful apartment in a beautiful location, absolutely amazing
Stayed for the 2nd time in this stylish loft, right in the center of Antwerp. Perfect place for a weekend break of citytrip.
The location and ease of this loft were amazing. Petra was a very responsive host. While there were a few details that could have been better, all in all it was a great stay.

The place is rather average overall, the decoration is nice and the location is absolutely awesome.

Missing points for me, it was extremely cold. We ended up using the bathroom heater and barely have any time upstairs :/

Also, two single beds don't make a double bed :(

The bathtub and showers were great too, just be careful with the hot water being extremely hot!

I would say, it's a great if your plan on being cosy and staying under the blanket, or if you're mostly outside!

We hebben een mooie tijd in een prachtig appartement gehad, super locatie. Alles was goed geregeld, het appartement was van alle gemakken voorzien. Petra is  erg vriendelijke en behulpzaam. Dit appartement is zeker een aanrader.
Wij hebben met 6 vriendinnen een geweldig weekend gehad, de loft voldeed precies aan onze verwachtingen. De loft was erg schoon en netjes. Perfect centraal gelegen in hartje Antwerpen.

Apparemment très bien situé au cour de la vieille ville. Bien aménagé et équipé! Petra est très disponible et agréable.
Petit bémol de nombreuses prises ne fonctionnaient pas, beaucoup d’ampoules étaient claquées dans la pièce principale (au point qu’il y faisait sombre) et le wifi ne marchait pas bien.
Propreté passable.
Top locatie, alles is op loopafstand en de loft is perfect voor groepjes van 5 tot 6 gasten ! Verhuurder reageert heel snel en alles was netjes. Echt een aanrader !

Prima locatie. Midden in de stad. Alles binnen bereik dus. Houd rekening met kroegen aan alle kanten, dus vroeg slapen gaan kun je maar beter niet doen. Verder kan het appartement wel een opknapbeurt gebruiken.
amazing loft! definitely will be coming more often

Appartement très bien placé, Intérieur stylé et de bon goût.
S'attendre à des nuisances sonores. (pas de double vitrage et ensemble de l'immeuble consacré à la location, d'ou des nuisances possibles).
Les couchages ne sont pas très qualitatifs, surtout les lits d'appoint.
Il y a par ailleurs un vrai souci de propreté.

Prima midweek gehad in dit appartement met 5 vrienden. Heel mooi uitzicht op de kathedraal en over de terrasjes van Antwerpen. Verhuurder is goed bereikbaar en communiceert duidelijk. Appartement zag er netjes uit met de nodige voorzieningen aanwezig.
Top service! Voor herhaling vatbaar!
Really nice!
Great location. Spacious loft.  Enjoyed our stay! Would recommend and stay again.
Très bien à part le canapé lit
Genoten!

Super locatie!
Heel nette loft en heel sfeervol!
Great loft on a nice location. Very central and near the places Antwerp has to offer!
Heerlijke plek in het centrum echt waar voor je geld
Goede aardige vrouw vrolijkke uitstraling
Mooie locatie in het centrum van Antwerpen.
Gemakkelijke communicatie met snelle reacties. Ik kon al heel vroeg de loft in op de dag van aankomst, dat was erg prettig. Verder was het erg netjes en schoon.
Zeer mooie loft op een mooie locatie. Alles was netjes geregeld en de communicatie was perfect. Echte aanrader!
We had a great Stay in Petra's appartement. The location was perfect for us. Petra is a very nice and helpfull host.  We would highly recommend this appartement for a weekend in Antwerpen.
Tolle Wohnung mit super zentraler Anlage. Ideal für einen Wochenendtrip. Man muss sich natürlich auf einen gewissen Lärmpegel abends am Wochenende einstellen.Die Sauberkeit war verbesserungswürdig.

Fijne en mooie loft. De loft zit op een top locatie als je houd van leuke barretjes. Er was veel te doen en te beleven, maar ook waren wij met vijf meiden veel in het loft, omdat het alles heeft wat je nodig hebt.
Great stay!
Supergezellig en mooi appartement! Het uitzicht op de kathedraal is ook nog eens prachtig! Wij verbleven hier met vijf vrienden. Prima uitvalsbasis om deze geweldige stad te verkennen.
Mooie loft op een toplocatie

We had a lovely experience staying in Tinne's appartement, the location is outstanding, in the middle of one of Antwerp's cosiest neighbourhood. There are lots of bars and restaurants nearby where you can eat all kinds of food. The historical and fashion centers are within walking distance. Tinne is a great host, she welcomed us very kind and gave us lots of tips about the city. The appartment itself is very luxurious and big, it has everything you need and more! A true reccomendation if you want to visit Antwerp in style!

Tinne and Eric were both great hosts. Tinne gave us the direction to her apartment. Location is great. Tram stop is right in front of the apartment. We enjoyed our stay in Tica Home and would love to be back some day. Apartment is beautiful with complete amenities. Everything is within reach. Thank you Tinne and Eric! We highly recommend this apartment to air bnb user / traveller.

Heel mooi en schoon appartement op een geweldige locatie. Het Mechelseplein ligt erg centraal. Er zijn leuke cafe's en restaurants om de hoek. Op het plein is eenpatisserie waar je terecht kunt voor een heerlijk ontbijtje. Het appartement is goed verzorgd en Tinne en haar zoon zijn hele vriendelijke hosts. Ik wil hier zeker eens terugkomen.

L'appartement est très très jolie et confortable, j'ai vécu un week-end très agréable et il n'y a rien à dire. Tout était très propre et bien rangée. Je recommande cet appartement.
Le seul inconvénient est le parking, il n'est pas facile de se garer dans le quartier mais ce n'est qu'un détail.
Merci Tinne :) à très bientôt.
Tinne is a very kind host. We had a great time and comfortable stay. Everything is newly arranged and the apartment offers a great chance to visit Antwerp. Suitable for family with small kids.

The host was a fabulous communicator, very friendly in person and generous with her time. The flat is even nicer than it looks in the photos ... Lovely linens, high end toiletries & a beautiful shower! We also likes the tasteful decor, charming tall ceilings and Windows and the nice touches at every turn.

Tinne was the perfect host!
The flat is amazing: modern, clean, cosey and everything is available.
The location is just perfect. In an artsy area with cool bars.

For me this was the best Airbnb experience!!

Gert

My father and I just had a wonderful weekend in Tinne’s apartment in central Antwerp. It’s hard to describe how lovely the apartment is other than to say it’s even better than in the photos and it looks pretty awesome in them. Lovely high ceilings, bright modern decor, quiet and well-sound proofed, luxurious toiletries, stylish fully-functional kitchen and the best shower I’ve ever had! And then there’s the beds which were so comfortable we slept like logs which for dad is almost unheard of!

The location is excellent too. About 9 minutes walk to the Shopping/ Museum/Old Town part of the city and 7 mins to Kloosterstraat (should be renamed Koolerstraat!). Antwerp is a very easy city to walk around but if you don’t fancy walking, there are bikes for hire and a tram stop right outside the front door. After a hard day’s exploring there are two lovely bars opposite the apartment and a great restaurant called Life is Art for a very reasonable, delicious Belgian/French meal. Breakfast also close by at cafe Lindt or fresh croissants from Goosens!

And to top it all off Tinne is absolutely lovely. She kindly provided us with links for antique markets by email prior to our arrival and made us feel right at home when we got to the apartment. You could not want for a better host!


SERIOUSLY Don’t book anywhere else - Stay here. We’re already planning our next stay!

Thanks again Tinne!

Het appartement was heel gezellig, huiselijk en comfortabel. We hebben genoten van de heerlijke zeep, douchespullen en de ultiem zachte handdoeken. Puur verwennerij! En de locatie was ook perfect. Alles binnen loopafstand aanwezig. Echt een aanrader!
Nice place, tanks
Séjour parfait avec de très belles prestations, Tinne est à l'écoute, et très attentive aux moindres détails. Nous recommandons vivement !

Tinne's appartment is as great as the fantastic sunny weather we enjoyed when staying there. Light, modern, clean, all the extras you could wish for (guides on Antwerp, adventures of Tintin to read and good coffee & internet etc), comfortable and quiet sleeping, and enough space to house a family of four. A great appartment at a great location: several bars right across the street, another one (K. Zeppos) around the corner, all lively with a good vibe but not intrusive when you want to sleep. Antwerpen's centre can be easily covered by foot and Tinne's appartment is perfectly located to do so. Just park the car and start exploring. Communication with Tinne was quick and friendly and relaxed, and she felt us feel welcome (we forgot to drink the prosecco in the fridge). All in all a very good experience: host & appartment & location. When Antwerpen calls again we will certainly come back.

Tinne was a wonderful host with an equally wonderful apartment in a fantastic location. The apartment was clean, modern, and within walking distance of most attractions in Antwerp. Tinne met us at the apartment, welcomed us, and was more than accommodating with our last minute trip changes.

Wir wohnten für vier Tage in Tinnes Apartment, ein geräumiger, sehr komfortabler, heller und in Sachen Küche, Bad, WLAN etc. fantastisch ausgestatteter Rückzugsort mitten in Antwerpen - in einem unaufdringlich renovierten Altbau, ausgesprochen ruhig und dabei zugleich in einer lebendigen Umgebung voller sympathischer und entspannter Bars und Restaurants. Fast alle interessanten Orte des Stadtzentrums wie Museen, Kirchen, Theater und Mode-Geschäfte sind zu Fuß zu erreichen. Vor der Haustür halten auch zwei wichtige Straßenbahnlinien. Tinne begrüßte uns sehr gastfreundlich, versorgte uns mit allen nötigen Informationen und sogar ausreichend Kaffee, Tee und Milch für unser Frühstück. Ein Ort, an dem man gut für eine ganze Weile verbleiben kann und jedes Mal, wenn man von ausgiebigen Touren durch die Stadt zurückkommt, wirklich ein kleines temporäres Zuhause findet.
Tinnes apartment is in a great location, it's it's spotless and big enough for 4 people, even though we just put one guest there. He was very pleased with everything. Any time again.

We had a fantastic time in Antwerp and Tinne's apartment. The apartment was just a short 5-10 minute walk from the historic centre and close to some bars that offered a very good selection of Belgian beers! There was also an excellent restaurant close by offering fancy cuisine at a good price.

The apartment was very tidy with everything that you'd want for a short stay. It is the perfect size for a small group of 4 so there was ample room for the two of us. The open plan living space was great for socialising and there was plenty of light in the apartment, which helped to lift spirits despite the rain.

Tine's hosting was superb. We were greeted by her son and made to feel very welcome. On one of the days where we were rained in, Tinne pro-actively messaged us with things that we could do so that we made the most of our time. That doesn't always happen with hosts.

We would happily return back to Antwerp and Tinne's apartment. It is very reasonably priced for what you get.

Tinnes Wohnung ist modern, hell, geräumig und geschmackvoll dekoriert. Der Standort ist recht zentral und in der Nachbarschafts gibt es viele Bars und einige Restaurants. Die Schlafzimmer befinden sich nicht auf der Strassenseite, sodass wir keine Geräusche der Strasse hören konnten. Die Betten waren bequem.

Als wir ankamen hat Tinne uns mit belgischem Bier begrüsst und uns die Wohnung gezeigt. Sie scheint eine nette, freundliche, flexible und verständnisvolle Gastgeberin zu sein. Sie hatte auch Reiseführer und Visitenkarten von Restaurants und Bars ausgelegt.
Heel verzorgd en degelijk, modern en licht onlangs gerenoveerd appartement op centrale locatie.

Tinne 's apartment has been our best AirBnB experience so far! It was even better than on the photos: spotlessly clean, spacious, bright and tastefully decorated. The location is superb: a 5-min walk to the historic centre, close to public transport and one of the best bakeries in town! Communication with Tinne was excellent. We recommend this place wholeheartedly!

The flat is really great: comfortable, well located and well furnished. We had no problem to get the Keys even if we arrived à little bit late. Anvers is an interresting city, especially Red star line muséum. Thank you Tinne

Very nice and friendly host and welcome. The appartement is very well maintained, clean und tastefully equipped. Full kitchen with dishwasher and everything you need. Luxurious bathroom and separate toilet. The two bedrooms (one a bit small without a cabinet, obviously for kids), the other one bigger. Both with very good mattrasses. The only problem is the very noisy neighborhood. Just across the street there are two bars which are busy the whole night till 4 am in the morning (at least during summertimes). With the modern isolating windows closed it's bearable. On the other hand you are in the center of the old Antwerp with plenty of restaurants and shops. Positive impressions in gerneral. But if someone is looking for a quiet place I wouldn't recommend it.

L'appartamento di Tinne si trova in una posizione ideale per visitare la città, è molto spazioso, pulito, confortevole e fornito di tutto ciò di cui si possa aver bisogno! Tinne è veramente molto accogliente e gentile, ci ha fornito una mappa e delle guide della città e si è resa disponibile per qualsiasi necessità! Consiglio assolutamente di soggiornare in questo bellissimo appartamento!
We had a good time in Antwerp. The place was just as advertised. The location was great!
Great location + apartment. Just like the photos.

Met spijt verlieten we Antwerpen na een prima verblijf in Tinne’s appartement.
Goede ligging in een leuke buurt met cafeetjes en eettentjes, de tram en de ‘witte fietsen’ van Antwerpen voor de deur, en op 10-15 minuten lopen van het modemuseum.
Een voortreffelijke warme bakker en patissier en een supermarkt om de hoek, ideaal.
En het appartement is comfortabel, heeft een goede sfeer en is uitstekend geoutilleerd, een aanrader.
En om mee te eindigen: bij binnenkomst kregen we een hartelijk welkom van de gastvrouw en stond er voor elk van ons een lekker drankje klaar.

Tinnes Sohn empfing uns kompetent bei der Ankunft. Insgesamt verlief die Kommunikation schnell, unkompliziert und reibungslos. Im Vorfeld unserer Ankunft sorgte Tinne, wie vereinbart, dafür, dass ein Babybett und ein Kinderstuhl in der Wohnung waren.
Die Lage der Wohnung und die Wohnung an sich sind sehr gut. Lediglich die Parksituation ist schwierig.
Insgesamt sehr empfehlenswert!
Tinne was a great as was the flat. Easy to contact and always available if you needed anything. The place is in a great spot and we will definitely stay again next time we're in Antwerp

We really enjoyed staying in this apartment. Everything was as described in the listing, it was clean and looked as nice as in the pictures. The neighborhood had some nice restaurants and cafes and was lively in the evenings, but we could not hear the street noise in the bedrooms. We walked everywhere from the apartment. Tinne made us feel welcome and had several guides and advice for us as we'd never been to Antwerp. She also made sure that check-in and check-out times were convenient for us. So we would definitely recommend staying with her.

Very relaxed and helpful.
apart at an amazing location & super clean & accessible.
Had a fantastic stay here. The place is very nice and the location is great for getting around the city. Tinne was very flexible with the booking and check in process. Highly recommended!

Het is gewoon een aangenaam appartment, van alle gemakken voorzien en lekker centraal gelegen. Alles was erg schoon en er werden voor de periode dat wij er verbleven ook meer dan voldoende handdoeken voorzien wat erg fijn was. Extra info over Antwerpen beschikbaar (resto, musea,...) maar ook boeken en DVD's. Zeer compleet uitgerust.

Mijn moeder en ik zijn drie nachten in Tinne haar appartement verbleven. Ons verblijf was, kort samengevat, helemaal top! Het appartement ligt super centraal en vanuit het appartement kun je in 5 a 10 minuten lopend overal in het centrum komen. De buurt was heel aangenaam en gezellig. Het appartement ziet er precies uit zoals op de foto's en het contact met Tinne en de sleuteloverdracht verliepen beide heel snel en soepel. In het appartement stond een welkoms drankje voor ons klaar en er was ook heerlijke douchegel aanwezig. We komen met heel veel plezier nog een keer terug!
Een heel fijn appartement, schoon en fris. Locatie is heel goed!

Tinne war sehr flexibel in Zusammenhang mit unserer Ankunftszeit. Wir wurden herzlich begrüßt und mit wichtigen Informationen für unseren Aufenthalt versorgt. In der Wohnung fanden wir interessante Bücher über Kunst und Architektur in Antwerpen, die gute Hinweise für unsere Planung gaben. Die Wohnung ist gemütlich, gut ausgestattet, zentral und sehr sauber. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Schlafräume sind sehr ruhig. Geschäfte für den täglichen Bedarf und ein Markt liegen in unmittelbarer Nähe. Die Innenstadt lässt sich gut zu Fuß  erreichen.

We chose Tinnes apartment for our weekend trip to Antwerpen and were very pleased from the beginning on. As we were arriving late on a Friday night, Tinne could not welcome us personally, but we could pick up the keys in a bar just next door to the apartment. The neighborhood is very friendly with many bars an d cafés around, and it is only a 10 minutes' walk to the city centre. The apartment is spacious and beautifully furnished, and Tinne provides everything you need. Thank you very much- we really enjoyed our stay!
Gorgeous apartment in a lovely area close to cafe bars & shopping district. Tinne was a great host, will definitely stay here again next time I'm in Antwerp.
Top appartement in een hippe wijk met heerlijke restaurantjes.  Centrum op loopafstand. Verhuurder is enorm gastvrij. Kortom, echt een aanrader!
Alles was tip top in orde.

This was a wonderful and comfortable place to stay. Tinne is a great host, responded quickly to all communication and was very flexible in making arrangements on arrival/departure. The flat is roomy and well equipped, the living area is full of light and with a lovely view on the square. Much appreciated the toiletries and the fluffy blankets. The area is very nice, interesting, buzzing, close to the center (can get a bit noisy on weekends evenings but the bedrooms are on the 'quieter side' of the flat) . Because of the central location, we went almost everywhere by foot. Definitely recommended!
Casa molto accogliente, luminosa, funzionale. Situata in un bel quartiere vivace e centrale. Tinne è stata perfetta host. Esperienza da ripetere.

Tinne is a great host. She helped us and made any possible adjustment to make us feel at home. Also, her apt is greatly located, super clean and comfortable. It is well furnished and it has cosy beds.
Highly recommended!!!

I rented the apartment for someone else, but he told me it was the most wonderful apartment. I did get to meet Tinne and she was a great host, the communication was also always fast and correct. I would really recommend this place!
Beautiful spacious appartement, great location. Tinne is a great host!

A lovely apartment in a quiet part of the city. On a tram line and within walking distance to the city center. The apartment was clean and very nice. The kitchen had everything we needed and a Nespresso machine with capsules provided! Bonus! I would absolutely stay again.

Fantastische plek; echt een 'thuis'. Lekkere bedden, douche (met lekkere producten) en goed uitgeruste keuken. Locatie is super; of je nou wil shoppen, cultuur snuiven of restaurants en café's bezoeken. Alles is te lopen. Parking 'Nationale Bank' is enigszins betaalbaar en niet ver van de locatie.

A super clean and modern apartment great for families with kids or couple. The kitchen is very well equipped with nice appliances. The building is very quiet with street parking. Trams and bikes available right in front. I rented this apartment for my family coming into town and I live a few doors down. Everyone agreed that it was a great place and I will continue to book for friends and family visiting...

Tinne's appartment is really nice, spacious, and warm, lovely bedding and towels and we'll equipped bathroom and kitchen. It is very near the tram stops and easy for the city. I very much recommend it. Also Tinne is very helpful and always in good communication

Mijn collega en ik hebben een fijn verblijf genoten in het appartement van Tinne. Het is van alle gemakken voorzien en in beide slaapkamers troffen we een comfortabel bed. Het niveau van voorzieningen is prima (vaatwasser, nespresso, goed wifi, fijne douche, etc.) en in de schone keuken is alles aanwezig om zelf te koken. Ook de communicatie verliep goed; Tinne heeft ons persoonlijk ontvangen en was tijdens ons verblijf, ook al bleek het onnodig, goed bereikbaar.

Tine's apartment felt spacious and light, the bed was very comfortable and she had left light provisions which was helpful. She was also happy to facilitate an early arrival and met us promptly as planned. Probably most importantly, the apartment's location is very handy for the centre of town: within ten minutes walk, we were in the middle of shops, bars and restaurants but there are also bars around Tinne's apartment. Altogether a very convenient and enjoyable stay.

I would certainly recommend Tinne's place. The apartment is beautiful and very well located in a quiet and cultural district of the city center of Antwerp. Tinne did everything to make the guest feel comfortable.

Tinne's apartment offers a lot for both business travel and vacation. It is clean, centrally located one a lively location but with quiet bedrooms. All facilities for a comfortable stay are available: a well equipped kitchen (incl. nespresso machine), comfortable bathroom with shower and a nice living room with dining table and a couch. I'll definitely stay here again.

I rented Tinne's appartement when me and a friend participated in We ride Flanders, wich meant that we brought our bicycles. This went very well and Tinne had prepared nice welcome treats for us. We really enjoyed staying in her clean and stylish apartment in the very center of Antwerp.

The property is situated in a convenient location close to all local amenities. The apartment is modern, clean with all the facilities. The living room is very nice with sofa and dining table. The bedrooms behind quiet and relaxing. The area around very cozy with hip bars and restaurants actually you are two steps from the city center. Tinne is very helpful always at your disposal. She is really a great host. We have as a family a great stay and we can absolutely recommend the apartment.

What a great place to stay... I have been coming to Antwerp for more than 10 years , but never stayed this side of the town  before... A very hip neighbourhood with lots of small cafes, bars and art galleries. The flat is very nicely decorated ... Never had a chance to meet Tinne and but her gentleman son kindly met me to hand over the keys...The communication was excellent through out... Thanks Tinne, will come back again when our conference comes back to Antwerp in 2019.
Very nice apartment and great location.  Tinne was very helpful and gave us good tips for restaurants.

Fijn appartement in het centrum van Antwerpen. Gelegen aan een gezellig plein, maar 's nachts wel lekker rustig. Het appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien. Goede communicatie met Tinne, ze is een erg aardige en betrokken gastvrouw.

The guest for whom I booked Tinne's place was very enthusiastic. He found the apartment fantastic, and was impressed by the hospitality when Tinne welcomed him. I myself enjoyed - again - the clear communication with Tinne, and her helpful and trustworthy attitude.

What a great apartment! The style of the interior was really nice, modern and cozy.

We enjoyed our stay there very much. It was located in sort of a party zone and just leaving the house ment to be in the middle of life. Perfect atmosphere.

Tinne was a great host, managed everything and we had a good communication.
Great location, very nice appartment, we had a wonderful stay.

Het appartement van Tinne is DE plek om heerlijk te genieten van Antwerpen. Prive reis als zaken reis dit is een heerijk appartement! Tinne is een vlotte bereikbare gastvrouw welke een warm appartement aan weet te bieden. Het centrum daar zit je midden in wanneer je de voordeur uitgaat. De barretjes aan de overkant van de straat zijn aan te raden.

Op naar een volgend verblijf bij Tinne!
Gewoon top!

L'appartement est top. IL est situé dans un quartier animé, mais les chambres étant sur l'arrière de l'appartement , il n'y a pas de souci pour dormir, les nuits sont calmes.
Très bien situé pour se balader.
Merci à Tinne pour son accueil chaleureux.

The location of the apartment is great and Tinne is a friendly host. She welcomed us warmly and the communication was clear. Everything was arranged smoothly and the apartment has nice extra features.

Tinne's place was perfectly located. A short walk to sights in the city, with a tram right outside. We loved how spacious, clean, and modern the place is. There are bars right outside, but the bedrooms are located in the back so the noise doesn't travel. Tinne is also very easy to communicate with. If you are visiting Antwerp, I would definitely recommend staying at Tinne's place!

Wij zijn met drie personen, moeder, dochter en kleindochter, te gast geweest bij Tinne via airbnb in een appartement op het Mechelseplein te Antwerpen. Er is maar één toepasselijke omschrijving voor ons verblijf en dat is: "grandioos" Wat ontzettend schoon en er is werkelijk aan alles gedacht. Wij hebben getracht een "tekortkoming" te ontdekken maar dat is ons niet gelukt! Wij waren van alle gemakken voorzien en hebben zeer genoten. Ook de ligging van het appartement was geweldig! Kortom: chapeau en wij komen graag nog eens terug!

Tinne was a great host. Her communication was excellent and she was happy to give good recommendations for local restaurants and bars, as well as helping with transport around Antwerp.

The apartment was very clean, spacious and perfect for the 4 of us. Location was great, with shops within walking distance and lots of restaurants and bars nearby.

Would definitely recommend this place for anyone who would like to explore Antwerp.
The appartment is very cozy and Tinne is super Nice. I recomend to anyone
Apartment perfect ,everything very clean ,the Tica very nice left in the super will super indicated this apartment for those who like bars the street is great to enjoy

This first floor apartment is in a great location within walking distance of the historic sites of Antwerp and everything you need such as supermarket, restaurants and a lovely coffee shop directly opposite. We walked from the main train station to the apartment (a pleasant 20 minute walk), but the tram stops outside the apartment which is a great alternative.  It was quiet and very comfortable for us as a couple. Tinne was a great host who helped us with everything we needed and she also left some treats for us! We would be happy to recommend this apartment and would certainly return here if we visit Antwerp again.
Was een perfecte plek om Antwerpen te verkennen. De communicatie met Tinne was erg goed en helder. Zeer behulpzaam en we komen volgend jaar graag terug
Alles wat is geschreven is helemaal waar
Great beautiful spacious and great location!! Like a luxury hotel but better!! Comfy beds. Book here you won't regret!!

Wir hatten eine super gute Zeit in Tinnes Wohnung. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und liebevoll eingerichtet. Die Kommunikation mit Tinne vorab und während unseres Aufenthalts war immer sehr schnell und unkompliziert. Zum Check In war ihre Tochter da um uns rumzuführen. Wir wurden außerdem mit einer kleinen Überraschung im Kühlschrank willkommen geheißen. Sehr aufmerksam. Wir würden diese Unterkunft (übrigens Top-Lage) jederzeit weiterempfehlen.

The appartment was very clean and nice. It looked like in the pictures. Towels, coffee and more was provided for. The flat is perfectly located and we can recommend it. It is a very lively place during the night with bars around, but in the bedrooms we did not here it.
Tinne seemed to be a nice person, but unfortunatley we did not meet her, instead her daughter showed the appartment, which was fine for us as well.
A very good place to stay while you are in Antwerp.

Regelmatig boek ik Tinne's verblijf voor gastprofessoren van mijn instituut aan de Universiteit Antwerpen, en dit steeds - ook nu weer - tot grote tevredenheid van de gasten. De communicatie met Tinne verloopt altijd uitstekend, en de ontvangst is steeds hartelijk. Een aanrader voor wie op zoek is naar een mooi, ruim en rustig gelegen appartement in het centrum van Antwerpen.
fijne plek om thuis te komen en er op uit te gaan!
I recommend!

This is a real gem in a great part of Antwerp.
The apartment is well appointed, stylish and light. It's only 20mins walk from the station and has a choice of good quality restaurants close by as well as a delicious bakery.
The main sights are only 10minutes walk away but there is a tram stop opposite should you need public transport.
I stayed with my Dad on a recent trip and it worked well for us both.
Tinne is a lovely host and very welcoming.

This place is excellent! The apartment is well-equipped, clean, and ideally situated for shopping, drinking and dinners. Tinne is also a great and very friendly and helpful host. This one is highly highly recommended if you’re looking for a wonderful stay in Antwerp.
Really nice appartment in the center of Antwerp

Tinnes appartement zit op een geweldige plek, met het historische centrum en enkele gezellige winkelstraten op loopafstand. De communicatie verliep vlot, het appartement was brandschoon en het bed sliep heerlijk. Geen echt ‘bewoond’ appartement, maar een fijn tijdelijk thuis in Antwerpen.

L’appartement de Tinne est très agréable a vivre. Il est même mieux décoré que sur les photos!
Le quartier est très sympathique et parfaitement bien placé dans la ville. On peut aller à peu près partout à pieds.
C’est vraiment une bonne adresse pour visiter Anvers.

Tinne was a great host - place is lovely in an excellent location, and good value for money. Walkable to main shopping district, old city, tourist area and night life. Safe and good neighborhood, on the tram route and bicycle hire facilities close by. We were 2 people staying in apartment for 10 days, and will definitely be back!
Perfect apptm for a city visit

De gastsprekers die we vanuit onze onderzoeksgroep aan de Universiteit Antwerpen een verblijf in het appartement van Tinne aanbieden, zijn zonder uitzondering enthousiast over de aangename ruimte, de mooie ligging en de goede voorzieningen. We blijven het appartement van Tinne dan ook graag aanbevelen!
geweldig appartement op ideale locatie in de luwte van al het moois wat antwerpen te bieden heeft!!

Super séjour passé dans l'appartement de Tinne qui est très agréable et lumineux, à deux pas des commerces, tram et métro !
Merci beaucoup pour les petites attentions !

Tinne and her son were very accommodating for our checkin and throughout our stay. We came for work but had some downtime, having a nice clean, centrally located condo was a plus. Belgian beers in the fridge for us when we arrived as Tinne knew we are brewers. A lovely spot by wonderful people. I’ll be back for sure! Ps,... comfortable beds and all amenities!

Top location in Antwerp
Full of tips / books over the city
Very friendly , check in was perfect
Thanks Tinne !
Staying in Tinne’s apartment was a great way to explore the city! And after a long day of adventures, it was always so nice to come back to a homey clean place. Tinne is a great host :)
I would recommend Tinne’s place to everyone who wants to stay in Antwerp

Antwerp is a very noisy city. If you stay anywhere near the Center, consideration needs to be made about the proximity to the street level. With this said, Tinne's place is outstanding for having great noise control when you need to sleep.

The flat is located in an very active and vibrant area of Antwerp. I have been visiting Antwerp since 2008, so I know what I'm talking about. Coffee, food, a church, hardware store and grocery store are all within five minute's walk from the flat. The living room looks down upon a number of cafes across the street. The nice thing is that the noise from those locations can't be heard at night when you shut the bedroom door. People tend to get VERY loud after they leave bars in Antwerp, but I never heard any screaming and yelling as I was trying to sleep. This is the first time this happened for me. What a relief! Even my good friend's private flat never had this level of noise control in the bedroom.

The flat also has a lot of light, but equally great curtains for when you don't want so much illumination. The kitchen is well-equipped and there is a coffee maker.

The back bedroom is perfect if you have a child traveling with you. They have some stuffed animals and even children's books available too. As usual, the bedding in each bedroom was very high quality. I love that European hosts don't spare any expense when it comes to sheet and duvets.

You will need to carry your luggage up one flight of stares, so keep that in mind. I am a veteran of traveling to old buildings so I know how to get a 50 lb suitcase up a winding staircase. This is something to keep in mind anywhere you travel to where the construction might be older than your country of origin.

I can't recommend Tinne's place high enough! I am already planning my return visit.
Perfect host, excellent location. Communication was fast, personal and very friendly, and Tinne’s apartment has all you need for a wonderful stay in Amsterdam. See you next time!

Geweldig appartement wat betreft ligging, of je nu lopend Antwerpen gaat verkennen of de tram pakt. Brandschoon, sfeervol ingericht, uitstekende bedden. Verwennerij met heerlijke zeep, shampoo en bodylotions, verschillende smaken nespresso en  voor ons stonden flesjes prosecco klaar. Heel attent en gastvrij. Communicatie prima. Door files kwamen we uren later dan afgesproken aan, met de sleutel regelde Tinne het zo, dat we niet in de stress zaten. Veel dank Tinne voor een geslaagd verblijf, we komen graag terug!
Great apartment - great location.
Tinne's place is clean, nicely decorated. A fantastic location and she is was very responsive and helpful. Highly recommended.

Splendid apartment in a fabulous location- a 20 minute walk from central station and just a 10 minute walk from the main sights in a hip, lively neighbourhood with lots of cool bars within a 60 second walk! Tinne met us and was a lovely host who was very communicative. The apartment is very spacious with great high ceilings and cool minimal design. Family friendly too for our 1 year old boy with a high chair and travel cot provided. A Nespresso machine and bottles of prosecco from Tinne were the icing on the cake! One warning is that keep the bedroom window closed in the warm months as lots of mosquitoes bit us badly but we’ve experienced the same in Brussels. We will be back, it is perfect and Tinne can be proud of the brilliant accommodation she provides.

Excellent place and location! Just some minutes away from the city centre, and in a lively area.

Everything in the apartment was perfect: Clean, well equipped and with all we needed during our stay.

Recommended 100%

Asunto oli todella kaunis ja puhdas. Sisutus oli huolella suunniteltu, jokaista yksityiskohtaa myöten. Wifi toimi erinomaisesti. Tämä oli luxus asunto. Tervetuliaisjuomat ja huippu luokan kosmetiikka käytössä mm. Shampoo, hoitoaine ja body lotion. Sijainti keskeisellä paikalla, lähellä kaikkea. Erinomaisia etnisiä ravintoloita lähistöllä. Lintin kahvio lähellä, josta saa aamupalan jo varhain aamulla. Pyörien vuokraus edullista ja suositeltavaa.
Tinne supermajoittaja. Vastasi todella välittömästi kysymyksiin. Kiitos Tinne! Tulemme uudelleen!

Ik heb met 2 vriendinnen een heerlijk weekend in het appartement van Tinne gehad. Ruim, schoon, goed gelegen, de bekende witte fietsen voor de deur, betaalbare parking op 5 min lopen. Tinne is zeer attent en gastvrij. De in- en uitcheck verliep soepel en de communicatie vooraf plezierig. Kortom, een aanrader!

Tinnes Empfang war sehr herzlich und wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Wohnung ist sehr gut gelegen; alles ist fussläufig erreichbar. Auch die hellen Räume, die moderne und stilvolle Ausstattung sowie die Ausstattung für unseren Sohn (<2 Jahre alt) haben dazu beigetragen, dass wir uns sehr wohl gefühlt haben. Vielen Dank Tinne! Wir können Tinnes Apartment absolut empfehlen.

I would highly recommend this very comfortable apartment. Cross the road and you can hop on a tram, restaurants in abundance, close to the station, very central and a lovely 14th century pub on the corner. Facilities fantastic, bed super comfy and lots of special touches.

We hebben genoten van ons verblijf. Het appartement is ideaal gelegen, midden in de stad, op wandelafstand van alle bezienswaardigheden en vlakbij vele restaurants en cafés. Het is gezellig ingericht waardoor je je meteen thuis voelt. Alle faciliteiten zijn aanwezig en er staat zelfs een flesje cava klaar in de ijskast. De ontvangst door Tinne is warm en hartelijk. Alles was piekfijn in orde en proper. Ook de communicatie, zowel op voorhand als achteraf, verliep vlot en vriendelijk. Dit appartement is zeker een aanrader! We komen nog terug.
A great place to stay! I have no complaints.  Tinne was very helpful and communicative.  The apartment is stylish and spacious.  Thanks again! Highly recommended.

We spent a long weekend in Antwerp with our 1 year old daughter. Tinne's place was perfect for our needs. It was simple to walk to major attractions like the zoo in around 20mins and the port in 30mins. There is also a tram stop directly outside the apartment, although we didn't use it.
Tinne was a fantastic host. She communicated really well with us before our trip and met us in person to let us into the apartment and show us around. She even left us some drinks in the fridge which was a lovely touch.
The apartment is on the first floor and the steps are a little steep so this might be a problem for some less mobile people but for us it was fine-even with a pushchair. We just left it in the hallway which was private and seemed secure.
The apartment was really stylish and much bigger than I expected. It was so helpful to have a cot and highchair for our daughter too. There are cafes and shops very close by, again making this a really convenient place to stay. We would definitely recommend Tinne's place to anyone and I'd say it's particularly good for families.
It is a nice place. It is clean and the location is perfect for a weekend-trip with bars close by.  Tinne is very nice and helpful! I definitely recommend her place.

Great size and great location in the city. Photos do not do the accommodation justice. The area was a little bit lively for me but we came on a bank holiday. If you can get out and like bars/restaurants it’s a great location! Amazing if you’re VEGAN there’s a great spot over the road and 2 other vegan/vegetarian restaurants 5-10 mins walk away.

Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in Tinnes Wohnung. Wir wurden von ihrem Bruder pünktlich empfangen. Trotz Tinnes Urlaub war die Kommunikation schnell und einfach. Die Wohnung selbst war wie beschrieben: sauber, modern und ruhige Schlafzimmer. Gerne wieder!
Tinne was an outstanding host, nothing was missing. Everything was absolutely perfect!

Outstanding stay, and one of our top AirBnB experiences.

Tinne greeted us personally with Prosecco and answered the few questions we had. The flat is beautifully renovated, modern, bright, airy and spacious. The kitchen provided all the amenities needed for a long stay. The bedding was top quality and extremely comfortable and we were pleasantly surprised by the high-end bath products. Location couldn't have been better: the tram and the convenient city bike rental was right our our front door, there were plenty of bars and cafes in the area and the grocery store was just 3 blocks away. A quick 10 minute walk got us to the heart of the old town. Would not hesitate to recommend Tinne's flat OR stay there again the next time we are in Antwerp!

The place was lovely. It was really nice and clean. The location is perfect, very close to city center but not too close that it becomes too noisy. We were not able to meet Tinne but she communicates really quick and clearly. Would definitely consider staying at her place again!

Wij hebben een heerlijke tijd in Tinne haar appartement gehad!

Het appartement heeft een mooi centrale ligging en was nog groter dan verwacht! Het appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien en leuke extras, zoals heerlijke zeepjes overal! Of de geweldige regendouche!

Bij aankomst stond Tinne ons op te wachten met een glas Cava, wat een heerlijk welkom!

De communicatie verliep goed! Toen wij op een ochtend even geen warmwater hadden werd dit direct opgelost!

Al met al was het een zeer aangenaam verblijf in een mooie stad!

Tinne dankjewel!
Lovely flat, beautifully furnished. Great location and Tinne a super host. Highly recommended.

We had a fantastic time at Tinne's apartment. It is spacious, well-appointed, fully equipped, and located just perfectly to explore Antwerp's center by foot.
The living room faces two lively bars where people may be out and about at night in good weather. We enjoyed the atmosphere but we also glad that both bedroom windows face another direction and are quiet.
Beautiful bathroom, lovely coffee table books and a few useful Antwerp guidebooks round off this excellent space. Thanks, Tinne and Rogue

Excellent base for visiting Antwerp. Walking distance to the Grote Markt district, which is central to many attractions. Tram stop just outside for longer journeys. Very clean and modern. Highly recommended.

Notre séjour chez Tinne fut très agréable. L'appartement est spacieux, lumineux , très bien aménagé et décoré.
L'emplacement est idéal dans un quartier calme et branché. A proximité de bars et restaurants de quartier à découvrir.
Une adresse que je recommande.
Merci Tinne pour votre accueil.

Ideal for Shopping weekend !
Really enjoyed staying at Tinne's apartment. Three ladies managed OK and drew straws as to who should have the main bedroom. However all the beds were very comfortable. Spacious living and kitchen area and everything you need. Good shower with plenty of hot water. The area is very near to everything. Lots of nice bars and coffee places . The stairs up are very narrow and steep so don't take a large suitcase .The apartment is opposite two busy bars. Luckily the bedrooms are at the back so this was not a problem. Tinne was there to greet us. Great place to stay and we would stay again

Thank you Tinne for the lovely welcome and great hospitality. We really enjoyed staying and explore Antwerp. The proximity to restaurants, bars and sIghts make this place a great place tool stay. Definitely recommend!
Tinne is an amazing host, always helpful and in contact. Highly recommend her, her place and the location is great, as is the flat. Top recommendation.
We stayed here for the second time: wonderful apartment (with great shower), perfect location close to the city center. Very kind welcome with a glass of prosecco :) we’ll definitely stay here again!

This was my second time at Tinne's. Read my first review for a detailed description.

Everything was as expected for my visit this time. I can't say enough about the combination of location, ambience, and peacefulness of this flat. Many places in Antwerp are very noisy at night. Tinne's is not. You can get a restful sleep in the quiet bedrooms. This is very important when traveling internationally.

Another great aspect to her location is that there is a grocery store within a 5 minute walk. That's just one if many fabulous businesses very close by!
A very stylish apartment! Very quiet bedrooms and is in a great location.  Many restaurants to choose from. Transit nearby too.

Voor de tweede terug bij Tinne. Niet voor niets: weer een zeer prettig verblijf in een goedgelegen, ruim en schoon appartement dat van alle gemakken is voorzien. Communicatie met Tinne was weer vriendelijk en vlekkeloos en flexibel met aankomst en vetrek. Een echte aanrader voor een ontspannen verblijf in Antwerpen.
Great host, excellent location and lovely flat, tastefully decorated and meets all needs. Highly recommended
I can highly recommend Tinne's apartment. It's spacious, clean, and has all amenities. Communication with Tinne is easy, friendly and fast.
Great flat, great location and a pleasure to work with Tinne. Recommended.
Spot on

Als je graag dichtbij het centrum wil verblijven, dan is dit echt een aanrader! Tinne is erg behulpzaam en geeft je een veilig en warm gevoel. Je hoort wel de mensen ‘s avonds/‘s nachts die buiten staan bij de kroeg maar denk als je slaapkamerdeur dicht doet dat het meevalt (ik slaap altijd met deur open naar de gang....)
Tinne had ook een klein flesje prosecco klaar staan, erg attent!
En de douche was heerlijk.
Niet twijfelen gewoon doen.
My regular stop. Always good!
Prima plek om ANtwerpen vanuit te gaan ontdekken. Huurfietsen midden voor de deur. Heerlijke badkamer. Alles prima voor elkaar.
Great Air B&B close to lots of stuff and a short walk to the city sights.
GREAT PLACE, GREAT LOCATION, GREAT HOST

This apartment is in a great central location with updated amenities (hello, rainfall shower head!). As mentioned in other reviews, the bedrooms are quiet which really helps. Tinne was very nice and communicative. Erinomaisella paikalla oleva viehättävä ja siisti huoneisto. Asunto todella kaunis ja vastikään remontoitu. Nähtävyydet kävelymatkan päässä.
Great location and great apartment. Everything was settled atm I checked in. Would love to stay there again. Tinne is a very polite host and responded quickly! Thanks Tinne :)
Good location, great host. Would return.
Un appartement très fonctionnel et propre et super bien situé.

Tinne's place is really beautiful and in a prime location, especially for the money. It is very close to the historic city centre, museums and popular fashions stores. In front of the appartement there are three hip bars that are always fun to hangout at. For us this was great. But, maybe for some people this may be a minor minus point. Because you can hear it a bit at night, not that much though. Furthermore, Tinne was very helpful and went out of her way to open the door for us even when we were a bit late. She also has a great selection of local guide books that might help inspire some fun trips in the city. My mom and girlfriend liked it too, greatly recommend
Een fijne, mooie ruimte op een goede locatie. Prettig contact met de verhuurder. Aanrader!
Convenient place to stay in Antwerp.  Close to many things including a number of popular cafes.
Good place, convenient, neat, great location and excellent communication.

Place is OK. We got mislead bigtime by the photos. The house is terribly small for 4, and for the price we were charged, we felt like we were robbed. We 4 adults checked in, and quickly had to book a separate airbnb for 1 adult. The second room is so small that with 2 beds, nothing can be kept there, not even move around properly - I don't know where the host expected us to keep our luggage - there are no cupboards in 2nd room. This house is for 2 adults and 1 child - even the beds and living rooms are that way. Only 2 can sit on a sofa, I don't know where they host expected other to sit!
Overall, it was a terrible experience. Didn't expect this from a so called 'developed' country!
Was really nice! We had a great time!
Loved our stay!

We hebben opnieuw genoten van dit mooie appartement. De ligging is perfect, het is de ideale uitvalsbasis om de stad te ontdekken. Alles is tot in de puntjes verzorgd en smaakvol ingericht. Een echte aanrader!
Nice and clean apartment on a perfect location to explore Antwerp.

First, the host: responsive, flexible and friendly. We arranged everything swiftly and without any problems. Highly recommended!
Second, the house: spacious, recently renovated, well equipped (kitchen, bathroom), and overall nice to live in. It consists of a loft-like ground floor where the kitchen, living room, second bath (toilet only) and a tiny courtyard are located. The large bathroom with washer and dryer is located on the second floor, whilst the two rooms (which are rented out) are located on the third floor. The only real setback can be the steep townhouse staircase, which I handled without any problems, but could prove challenging for children and seniors, whilst it is impossible to climb for people with any major physical disabilities. Overall, highly recommended!
Third, the room: spacious, rustic looking and with a large and very comfy bed. It however lacks a desk and chair and a view. Since it is located in the attic (3rd floor) it can also get really hot but I only experienced a few days of real heat. Opening the window did help instantly, but also let the noise from the street in (only children playing, no cars since its a dead-end). Apart from those days, I enjoyed it. The ground floor always remains cool, its still Belgium not Spain. Overall, recommended.
Fourth, the neighbourhood: low-income residental and in itself not very inviting (little green areas, as it is the case with Antwerpen overall, no bars or cafes, but enough shops to do groceries) but not to be considered unpleseant or even dangerous in whatever way and in any time of the day. It is just a reality check in regard to the upscale South- and Northwest of the city. Its southern part is however very vibrant but getting more and more gentrified, pushing prior residents out (also with the help of the lovely platform we all love to hate). Overall, would recommend if in Antwerp for a longer stay. If only on a short touristic visit, pay extra and opt for South- and Northwest.
Fifth, the location: a 20 min walk from the University or city centre, 12 min walk from the central station, with several city bike stops close-by. If you bike or use public transport, its very practical. If walking, you might consider moving more to the West. Overall, recommended if you don't mind biking and/or using public transport.
Overall: would book again if returning to Antwerp for a longer stay, especially in the colder months. I stayed at the place for 5 weeks, whilst conducting research at the University of Antwerp, and had a very nice time.

Mooi appartement, mooie stad en zeer goede communicatie met de eigenaar. Het centrum is prima aan te lopen. Zeker een aanrader.

This was smooth! Vito scored really great on all points: communication, friendly, dependable. The appartement was really, really, really great. I'm saying this because what I like about staying at an airbnb is that it's not a hotel, and many times the experience is just that; like staying at a hotel. We felt like we were staying at a friend's house, the friend being away, and having gone out of his way to make our stay at their appartement as pleasant as it could be. We were made to feel welcome, Vito shared tips to make our stay great, the appartement felt like somebodies home. The home feeling is important, because if that's lacking, one could just as well choose to stay at a hotel. This place (and Vito) nail the 'airbnb-experience' as it should be: better than a hotel because it a personal experience, not merely a commercial transaction.
Location, size of appartement, comfort: all boxes checked.
I highly recommend Vito's place if you ever wanted to stay in Antwerp.
A great place to stay.

Vito is very nice, and easy to communicate with. Astrid and Olivier, the onsite people who manage the property, are outstanding. I would recommend Vito because he and his friends understand hospitality, and are kind, gracious host.

We had a wonderful stay at Vitos beautiful apartment! Vito organised everything very well and Astrid and Oliver made us feel really comfortable!  And the view of the apartment is amazing! Thanks a lot!! :)
Perfect place to stay in Antwerp! The apartment was clean, spacious yet cosy and quiet, excellent amenities for cooking, very comfortable bed, great location... We'll be back for sure! Thanks Vito!

Das Apartment war total klasse. Die Lage war prima. Fussläufig zu allen wichtigen Spots. Wir musste nie auf öffentliche Verkehrsmittel zurückgreifen. Für vier Personen absolut ausreichend. Excelente departamento, muy luminoso y muy bien ubicado.

This was our first time using airbnb,what a great one it was. Vito was easy to get in touch with. The place was clean and inviting. Truly European living. Close to everything but not so.close that it's noisy.  Just a wonder home in a beautiful town.
Ideale plek nabij het centrum. Ruim appartement met een prachtig uitzicht over de stad.
Geweldig appartement op goede locatie!
Appartement grand et lumineux dans un quartier du vieux Anvers, entre le MAS et la cathédrale, très calme. Commerces à proximité.

We thoroughly enjoyed the apartment, particularly the balcony view and location close to the action but still relatively quiet. We were a little concerned about the old-timey elevator when we first arrived, but though it was charming and convenient by the time we left.
Beautiful spacious apartment. The best I ever been to. Clean, good location and Vito was the perfect host altough we didn't meet him. We would love to come back!

The apartment is excellent value and a perfect place to stay and enjoy the old part of Antwerp. An easy stroll to any number of fun shops, cafes and restaurants.

Communication was excellent and check in was easy. We absolutely loved it!
Sehr gut gelegene, charmante Wohnung. Schöner Blick vom kleinen Balkon. Ein großes Abenteuer ist die Fahrstuhlfahrt - der ist von 1929!

Vito and his neighbor were clear, communicative, and made visiting a foreign place so easy! The apartment, oh my gosh, had beautiful views and everything you could ask for. I would love to stay here again when I come back! (P.s. Don't be afraid of the elevator )
Fantastic! Stay there as Vito is a great host and communication was simply and easy!!!!

The apartment was very nice. We immediately felt very comfortable. The location is very ideal. A big thank you dear Vito, to the late check-out time and the fast and uncomplicated communication. We would always come back and will remember the apartment for future Antwerp trips.

Vito's apartment was clean, bright and a beautiful base for our stay in Antwerp. Perfect location with walking distance to all the destinations you want as a tourist. Would highly recommend and we will be back soon for sure!

Vito's place was a real pleasure to stay in. It's perfectly located in a beautiful, interesting part of the city with great bars and restaurants. The apartment itself is extremely comfortable and well-appointed, and the view is gorgeous. Highly recommended!
Great appartment in Center!

Cool apartment, great space, great location. Vito (from NY) and Astrid (local) were great to deal with. Elevator was cool. This Airbnb is highly recommended! Perfect position, walking distance to the center of Antwerp. The apartment was homely and clean, fully equipped. Lovely views and a gorgeous building.

One of the best we’ve ever stayed in! Thank you Vito.
A great little place 10 minutes walk from Antwerps old centre and the up amd coming Docklands area. A great base from which to explore Antwerp.

Super séjour chez Vito ! L'appartement est superbe, linge de maison fourni, propreté, très spacieux de bon goût et surtout l'ascenseur vaut le détour !

Fijn appartement met prima voorzieningen en een prachtig uitzicht op een perfecte locatie in het centrum van Antwerpen. Alles op loopafstand. Great experience, nice place and a super good location. Vito is a really nice guy who helps whenever he is in the possibility. The apartment was nice and clean and there is a good vibe! An absolute recommendation for all other Airbnb users :-)

Top appartement, dicht bij centrum en een heerlijke koffiezaak aan de overkant!
Thanks Vito for an excellent stay in your beautiful apartment! Would highly recommend - great space & very central.

The appartment is beautifully decorated, very light and cozy as well. Soggiorno buono l alloggio si trova a 10 minuti dal centro della città

Thank you Vito, will definitely be back!

Great apartment, great located, very clean, airbnb dream

Een verbeterpunt zijn de gordijnen, doordat het raam maar voor de helft bedekt is, wordt het snel licht in de slaapkamer.

This apartment was tucked away on a fairly quiet street but is walking distance to shops, restaurants, bars, clubs. We walked everywhere and it’s only a 20 minute walk from the station. Ich war mit meiner Familie zu Besuch in Antwerpen und wir hatten eine tolle Zeit. Das Apartment ist wunderschön, sehr gemütlich eingerichtet und hat alles was man braucht. Tolle Lage, wir haben zuerst 2 Tage Tickets gekauft. Tätsachlich brauchen wir gar nicht.. zu historische Stadtteil und Hafen kann man einfach zu Fuss reichenden.
Die Wohnung ist sehr schön, wie Film Ausstellung.
Aber ein bisschen schade ist, dass die Gebäude zu alt ist, d.h. Schallschutz ist nicht so gut. Wir hören überhaupt, was die Nachbarn reden. Aber nach 22 Uhr sehr ruhig. Keine Sorgen.
Ich erwarte mich nächste Mal noch in Antwerpen und diese Wohnung zu besuchen.

The house was lovely. Nice small balcony with a view over the roof tops. Easy to get around from here.
Super fast communication with Vito and his neighbour who greeted us.
Definitely recommend :)

Nice large one bedroom apartment in a great location. The old world elevators added an additional touch. The balcony was great to seat two people to have cocktails and watch the sunset. Also, Vito was very responsive whenever I had a question and messaged him.

Supermooi, schoon en ruim appartement in het centrum van Antwerpen. Inclusief balkonnetje met uitzicht om 's ochtends te ontbijten en 's avonds een speciaalbiertje te drinken. Zeker aan te raden!!

Wir werden auf jeden Fall wieder kommen. Deine Wohnung liegt perfekt um die Stadt zu Fuß zu erkunden. Da das Wetter so unglaublich gut war, waren wir nur drauße unterwegs und haben deine süße, großzügige Wohnung beim schlafen gehen und aufwachen bewundert.
Vielen Dank für deine tollen Tipps und viele Grüße an deine super netten Nachbarn.
Bis bald.
Anke und Oli
Spacious and stylish apartment with excellent location and amenities. We stayed with a 10 month old and we had plenty of room and loved the location. Would definitely recommend.

tout était parfait -

Meteen bij thuiskomst gekeken wanneer we weer naar Vito’s appartement kunnen gaan. Dat zegt alles. Het huis is prachtig, schoon en heeft een fijne sfeer. En is heel erg ruim.

Dichtbij de Schelde, dichtbij het centrum én in een leuke buurt. Tegenover het appartement kun je heerlijk koffie drinken bij Koffieklap.

Great location for exploring the city, and the balcony was perfect in the nice weather. Having a crib available for my daughter was a huge plus!

Vito’s place is lovely and makes you feel right at home. Close to the tram and train, but also walking distance to the centre of town. The apartment is clean and homey, just what you want for a getaway. Lovely view over Antwerp from the balcony!

Appartement agréable, spacieux et lumineux. Idéalement situé, nous avons pu tout faire à pieds.

Exactly as described. Easy to have access to the keys and good location near by the Grotmarkt. Thanks Vito.

Wunderschönes Appartement, geniale Lage, interessante Stadt.

Danke!

We hebben een fantastisch weekend in Antwerpen gehad en het appartement van Vito heeft daar zeker aan bijgedragen. Een fijne, lichte plek en groter dan verwacht. De locatie is perfect en het appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien. Zeker een aanrader!

Great apartment with a terrific view. Close to grocery stores and restaurants.

Vito and his neighbor Astrid were very accommodating and great hosts. The place was very well equipped with everything we needed and the location was very quiet and peaceful. Would recommend Vito's place to my friends and family.

Très bel appartement, spacieux .

Appartement spacieux, bien équipé.

Fabulous apartment in a fantastic location within walking distance of the best parts of Antwerp.  We loved it and would definitely recommend it.

We stayed in Vito’s spacious 6th floor (in Canadian terms!) one bedroom apartment in Antwerp for 4 nights. Having an elevator available was wonderful. It was centrally located in the old town, on the edge of the red light district. We were able to walk everywhere using the apartment as our base. We enjoyed the French doors onto the small balcony, though due to rainy, cool weather we were not able to use the balcony as much as anticipated. The kitchen was stocked with plenty of dishes, cutlery, salad spinner, bowls, 2 sharp enough knives, tea and tea pots, coffee, coffee filters, many spices, laundry and dishwasher detergent, etc. The gas stove worked like a charm but we didn’t use the oven. The fridge had plenty of room. I was disappointed in the absence of a toaster. The couch and living room chairs were comfortable. Vito had a great selection of books, and we particularly enjoyed the local ones! The dining room table was large and comfortable to sit at. Overall most rooms were too dim for us in the evening, especially to read. The washer and dryer was a welcome bonus. The bathroom had good counter space for toiletries and there was plenty of hot water. The bathtub was very comfortable. Vito was immediately available by email to resolve an issue that arose. However, there was some noise, both from upstairs and from being on the street in the centre of town. In summary, it was a very enjoyable apartment.
