We had a problem with the front door lock, but I’m sure that will be sorted this week and it wasn’t too big of a deal. Raissa was really acccomodating on the sunday when we were late coming back from a museum. We checked out after that and she met us there again. Highly recommended place!
Très chouette accueil et super appart cosy pour un citytrip à Anvers !

We spent four nights in Antwerp and in Raïssa's apartment we felt like home.
The house is located at Grote Markt, right in the centre of historic Antwerp. Therefore it is the perfect starting point to explore the city by feet or by metro/ tram (station Groenplaats is quite close)! The flat has beautiful furniture and a big comfy sofa. Cushions, candles and plants give the living room a really cosy touch. Reality does not differ from the photos. The big windows let a lot of natural light inside. The kitchen (with induction cooker) is very well equipped and offered several spices. Living room and kitchen were our highlights. The communication with Raïssa was excellent. We could not meet her in person but she always wrote back very quickly, was very helpful and gave us some recommendations. In addition, Raïssa was very flexible about our check-in and check-out which was very practical. The only drop of bitterness is that the windows of the sleeping room are above a bar with loud music and people chatting outside from evening until late in the night (also during the week). But I think that's the disadvantage you have to accept if you stay in the centre. Definitely bring earplugs!! The bed is comfortable. We had problems with the electricity; the fuse had gone three times. But I believe that we were just unfortunate and I'm sure Raïssa will take care of this problem very soon.
All in all, we had a great stay in Raïssa's apartment and I would definitely recommend it! Thanks a lot!! :-)

Place was stylish, in a great location. Paul is super responsive, kind, and helpful. Would go back in a heartbeat!

Genoten van ons weekend in het prachtig appartement! Appartement was heel schoon en alle voorzieningen die je nodig hebt zijn aanwezig! Ook dat er de mogelijkheid is om bij het appartement te parkeren scheelt veel geld en is gemakkelijk. Supermarkt is vlakbij, maar voor wat wij zochten in Antwerpen moesten we wel een stukje lopen (winkelstraat, kroeg half uurtje lopen). Wel een ontzettend mooie en aparte wijk om eens geweest te zijn. Communicatie met Paul liep voortreffelijk. Erg prettig!

Wir waren jetzt zum zweiten Mal hier weil es uns so gut gefallen hat. Paul ist ein toller Gastgeber, der Check in war schnell und er hat immer sehr schnell auf alle unsere Fragen geantwortet. Die Wohnung ist eher noch schöner als auf den Bildern zu sehen, hell, großzügig und absolut sauber. Wir haben schon unseren nächsten Aufenthalt hier gebucht.
Es war, wie immer, ein perfekter Aufenthalt. Wir werden wiederkommen!

Paul’s apartment is beautiful- modern, nicely designed, extremely clean and comfortable. It is located right next to a group of cafes and restaurants which was really nice. He was very responsive and helpful. Overall our stay was excellent.
Great modern and light apartment in very nice, quiet (ie, no cars etc) but lively surroundings. Less than 5 min walk to The Jane.
Een geweldig weekend gehad ik dit prachtige appartement. Ziet er nog mooier uit in het echt dan op de foto’s.

Paul’s place is amazing! Very clean, spacious, incredibly well designed, and the lovely hosts provide thoughtful touches for anyone lucky enough to stay here! The location is central (by famed restaurant the Jane-book in advance!), but sheltered with greenery all around. Everything you would require is provided (the kitchen is faultless), and, should we be back in Antwerp, we would definitely stay again! Thanks for having us :)
Great location!

Wij boekten het appartement omdat het zeer gunstig gesitueerd was voor ons bezoek aan the Jane. Dat bleek nog dichterbij te zijn dan gedacht. Letterlijk op 2 minuten lopen in een zeer moderne en rustige wijk van Antwerpen. Het appartement voldeed aan alle wensen en de heerlijke koude fles Koninck in de koelkast was een attente binnenkomer. Absoluut een perfecte plek voor ons uitstapje!
Wir waren inzwischen zum 4. Mal in Paul Wohnung, es war wie immer perfekt. Tolle, moderne Austattung, ruhige Lage und supersauber.

Are you having diner at The Jane? This is the place you need to stay. But take a tram and you’re in the city centre within 20 minutes as well. The place is even better as advertised. It has a great kitchen, a nice large balcony, a great seating area and it’s squeaky clean. The underground parking is also very nice if you come by car.  One of the best value for money Airbnb’s we’ve stayed in. Highly recommended.
Mooi appartement, zeer de moeite waard

Could not fault our stay at Antwerp. The place is well located and spacious, particularly if you want to be away from the city crowds (which we prefer). Paul is a great host; fast communication and even walked us to the apartment to make sure we were settled. The added welcome beer was a lovely touch. Thanks again. A+

Amazing apartment in a wonderful and safe community, the photos don’t do it justice. The apartment is stylish and is fitted out with small things you may not even notice. Paul is great, and was so helpful our entire stay. We loved the quiet location but it is a good 20 minute walk to the city center. However it’s well connected by Rent a Bike and tram. If you are eating at The Jane, don’t think twice, just book!

A great stay! Clean, bright, well appointed, and peaceful view into the common green spaces. Paul was very hospitable and went above and beyond to make us feel welcome. Parking garage was so convenient and exceptionally clean. Would highly recommend to others!
Great place to stay and Paul responded quickly to my questions.

We had a great time staying in this apartment, we were sad we had were only staying for one night! The apartment is even better than it looks in the photos. Paul and his wife were very hospitable and friendly, really good communication and gave us good local tips and beers. They were very accommodating of all our needs during our short stay. I would definitely recommend staying here and I hope I get the opportunity to do so again. The apartment is spotless and well located too.
Es war wie immer perfekt. Eine tolle Wohnung, supersauber und sehr gut ausgestattet. Wir kommen wieder!
Heel fijn appartement met prachtig uitzicht. Vriendelijk ontvangst en van alle gemakken voorzien. En Belgische biertjes als verrassing!

100% recommended, the area in which the flat is in is incredible. There are shops moments away and a brilliant little bakery nearby. It's a 10 min walk to the main train station and 25 to the city centre. The flat is ridiculously perfect. we found ourselves staying in late just to enjoy it more. IF you're considering it, stop it and just book this place.

Heerlijk ruim, net, schoon appartement, van alle gemakken voorzien en zelfs heerlijke biertjes bij aankomst van de locale brouwerij. Parkeerruimte is onder het appartement. Wij hadden een fietspas voor een paar dagen aangeschaft zodat wij super snel in het centrum waren. De fietspunten vind je op vele plekken in Antwerpen en altijd een fiets beschikbaar. Ideaal!

We loved the apartment and the hospitality! 100% recommended. Paul received us with some snacks and local beers, recommendations of activities and even discount cards. The apartment has everything you need, from a great kitchen with all the appliances you need to cook, to a very cosy space where you can watch TV and feel like in a mini cinema. Walking to the city took us around 20 minutes, but it's much faster with an electrical step! (also a recommendation of Paul). Definitely, you should stay here!!
Fijn en stijlvol appartement

The apartment is much bigger than I’d realised when booking it, with several cleverly designed distinct spaces so you can either be watching - the huge - TV, lounging on the sofas or hanging out in the kitchen.

It’s part of a modern complex on the site of the old military hospital so it’s all pedestrianised in the immediate vicinity, but then it’s only a few minutes walk to the tram for central Antwerp, or perhaps the Koninck brewery, also well worth a visit. Nearby is a bar with around 70 beers as well as a pizza restaurant and another serving salads and healthy burgers. So - all very convenient as well.

We really enjoyed our stay here and would highly recommend.

Highly recommend this apartment. All fittings are of a very high standard. Quite easy to access the City and local supermarkets are nearby.

Thank you.
Great, spacy and modern apartment. With everything you need.

Wir waren jetzt schon zum fünften Mal bei Paul, das sagt wohl alles. Die Wohnung ist supersauber, toll eingerichtet, es gibt bequeme Betten und Paul ist ein supernetter Gastgeber. Wir werden wiederkommen.
Flat is outstanding with all the new touches. Will def stay there again.

Eine sehr moderne, große, gut ausgestattete Wohnung in sehr ruhiger Wohngegend erwartet euch. Über einen Fahrstuhl in der Tiefgarage erreicht man die Wohnung außerordentlich bequem. Der fussläufig erreichbare Supermarkt ( ca. 500m) bietet alles, was man zum Leben braucht. Schön wäre es gewesen zu erfahren, wie der Müll zu entsorgen ist und welche Gepflogenheiten man beim Passieren der Tiefgarage zu beachten hat.
Wir können die Wohnung auf alle Fälle empfehlen.

Paul and his wife are really nice and helpful hosts. The apartment is located in Antwerp's Green Neighbourhood (Groen Kwartier) which is a car free zone. But no worries there's an underground parking space beneath the apartment block. We met up with Paul's wife who guided us to the parking lot. The apartment itself is really spacious, clean and well equipped. And it's the perfect place if you like to visit the Michelin starred restaurant The Jane. The Jane is a 2 minute walk from the apartment.
Great spacious place in a lovely neighborhood. Very hospitable owners.

Great location
Clean and great apartment
Bed is super comfy

A lovely stay. The photos don’t do the apartment justice - it is more stylish and spacious!

We had everything we needed and were impressed with the layout, design and lovely balcony! It was also ideal for our little boy who likes space to crawl around!

This was our first visit to Antwerp and we loved the city - the apartment is ideally situated in a quiet, nice area with lovely bars/restaurants. It is also very easy to navigate public transport to go into the centre. Exactly what we wanted.

Thanks and we hope to stay again someday!
Schitterend appartement op goede locatie

This is a fantastic apartment. I’ve stayed in Airbnb on 3 continents and this is the best apartment I’ve stayed in yet.

Great space, amazing amenities and a good location, nothing not to recommend here!
Pauls Apartment ist wunderbar. Wir waren schon zum achten Mal hier, ich glaube das sagt alles. Ideal um bei The Jane Essen zu gehen!
Perfect apartment, especially if you want to explore Zurenborg/Berchem area.

Fantastic apartment, it’s huge! The pictures don’t do it justice. The area is lovely and the gardens around it are kept nice. Paul was very helpful meeting us when we got there and showing us to the parking space. We had everything we needed for a great stay!

We hebben een geweldig weekend in dit appartement gehad. Wat een ruimte en uitzicht. Alles is aanwezig en van alle gemakken voorzien. Als je bij the Jane gaat eten, ben je er met de lift naar beneden en het hoekje om lopen binnen no time. Daarnaast zit je met tramlijn 4 binnen 10 minuten op de Groenplaats. We gaan hier zeker terugkomen!
It was great!! For our next trip to Antwerpen we will definitely book this Appartement!

The apartment is very nice, clean, well equipped and includes a parking, which was a huge plus for us.
Communication with Paul was very easy. Thank you again!

It seems this house was the best in my entire travel history.  Beautiful bathroom, kitchen, bedroom and of course a magnificent living room.  Very clean!  The hosts met and gladly answered all the questions and were always in touch.  Thank you very much! I wish you good guests always.
Wie immer war es ein toller Aufenthalt

Super verblijf gehad in het appartement van Lieven! De foto's liegen zeker niet, zeer mooie inrichting! We voelden ons direct thuis. S avonds is het er ook heel erg gezellig. Bij het slapengaan en opstaan heb je een prachtig zicht. De ligging kon ook niet beter, je zit direct in het centrum. Lieven is ook een zeer aangename man, wij waren zijn eerste gasten en hij heeft ons heelgoed ontvangen en tips gegeven waar we naartoe konden.
Zéker een aanrader!!

Lieven is a great person and his apartment is really amazing, very clean, luxurious, just around the corner of Meir (main shopping boulevard of Antwerp), The apartment is very big, great and secured building, quite and very safe area. I ABSOLUTELY WANT TO COME BACK AT HIS PLACE!

Een dag voor aankomst belde Lieven dat hij onverwacht niet aanwezig kon zijn. Hij had echter een uitstekende vervanger aangewezen om ons te ontvangen en wegwijs te maken. Het appartement is precies als op de foto's: ruim, netjes, fris en prettig om in te verblijven. De drukte van de straat dringt slechts door als achtergrondgeruis en zowel centrum, station als stadspark zijn op loopafstand.

Het appartement is erg netjes. Lieven is erg vriendelijk en contact was prettig. Zeker een aanrader!
The appartement was nice and clean. Lieven was very friendly and the contact with him was great. I would recommend this place!

Lieven was an ideal host! He was very welcoming, and amazingly helpful. He met us at the train station, showed us everything we could possibly need to know about the apartment. The unit is excellent: very comfortable and well stocked (it even had the phone charger we forgot to bring). Thanks Lieven!

중앙역과 도심에서 약 5~10분거리에 위치하고 있어 지리적으로는 매우 좋은 아파트였습니다.
그리고 호스트도 친절히 여러 가지 잘 설명을 해주었고요.
아파트내에 여러 주방 기구들이 있어 직접 조리도 가능할것 같아요.
잠시 여행을 떠나는 분이라면 추천을 해주고 싶네요.
단, 주차장은 없어요~

Super mooie en centrale plek! Lieven heeft een mooi ruim en schoon appartement. Op loopafstand van alle leuke wijken en station. Fietsen kun je huren op ongeveer 100 m afstand. Je auto parkeer je voor 7.50 euro per dag bij de Nationale Bank. Aanrader!
Lieven is a great host, meeting him and takingn over keys was super easy! Flat is very central, super cozy, nice decorated and calm. City center is within 5min walk! Would definately come back!
Lieven was a great host. The flat was amazing: so much light and space. It was perfect for us. Would definitely stay again! Thanks so much!

Lieven was a very friendly host! Super flexible about in- and outcheck time! The appartment was really in the center of Antwerp! Very close to the shopping main street; bars and walking distance from the port. The appartment was very beautiful and clean! Really had a plesant stay!!

we hebben een heel fijn verblijf gehad in het appartement van Lieven!
het is een mmoi, ruim appartement met veel lichtinval en een mooi zicht op de stad! het is centraal gelegen, ideale uitvalsbasis om Antwerpen te verkennen, te voet of met de fiets!

Lieven was on holiday and his brother came to fetch us from the station. The train station is walking distance from the apartment. Apartment was very clean, and exactly like in the photos. We really felt like home! Only downer was the weather, probably some of the hottest days. There was no a/c or fan, and the apartment got quite hot in the mornings.

My girlfriend and I stayed at Lieven his place and were heartily welcomed. The apartment is located near Antwerp central and is easily walkable. The apartment is very spacious, light and even better then the pictures. A balcony on the front and back on the building makes sure you'll have sun 90% of the time. we've used his place to discover the centrum of Antwerp and is easy walkable. With great restaurants and points of interest all arround the apartment I would recommend Lieven his place to anyone who wants to explore Antwerp
Great place to stay! It is a very spacious apartment close to the city center, it has a lot of natural light and is also quiet so one can have a perfect sleep. Highly recommended.
Le séjour chez Lieven s'est très bien passé. L'appartement est bien placé et très agréable.

We had a lovey stay at Lieven's apartment. It is a spacious and clean place with an amazing view on the city. Lieven was a friendly host and very flexible in both the arriving and departing time as well.
Everything is nearby: train station, shops and city center are all at walking distance. Recommended!

Appartement très spacieux et lumineux, en plus d'être bien placé à proximité du marché et des beaux cafés et restaurants d'Anvers. Lieven a été très disponible et souple pour les horaires d'arrivée et de départ.
Lieven was a great host.  Easy to communicate with and his place was just as described. Great location and nice and clean. I'd be happy to stay again.

Lieven was a very kind and accomodating host, communication was excellent especially when our delayed train made it so we would miss our check in time however Lieven made sure he could stick around in order to let us in and show us the place. thank you

The best option if you are thinking visit Antwerp. Really close to the central station and in the middle of the comercial area. The historic center is less than 5 minutes walking. Lieven is very nice and the apartment is like the pictures.
Zeer vlotte check-in. Alles wat nodig was ter plaatse was voorzien. Heel leuke avond gehad en zeker voor herhaling vatbaar.

Het appartement van Lieven is zeer centraal gelegen, en voorzien van alle benodigdheden voor een overnachting. Ook is het uitzicht vanaf 6 hoog over de stad erg fraai. Lieven was zelf niet aanwezig, maar de communicatie met zijn broers verliep erg soepel. We hebben het naar ons zin gehad in Antwerpen!
Mooi, licht en net appartement midden in het centrum. Veel bezienswaardigheden en leuke horeca spots dichtbij, ideaal! Zeker een aanrader!

Een top appartement in het hartje van Antwerpen. Enige minpunt was dat de tv op de foto's er niet bleek te zijn. Alsnog een super locatie! Lieven is heel vriendelijk en gastvrij. Zeker voor herhaling vatbaar.

Lieven was a great host who was very accommodating of our travel plans at short notice and did everything he could to ensure a smooth arrival and departure. The apartment is a beautiful light-filled, clean space - perfect for a quick sightseeing stop in Antwerp.

Lieven's flat was a perfect accommodation for our short visit to Antwerp. It is very near to the train station, downtown, and all of the sights and nightlife. The flat was clean and well-furnished, with a comfortable couch and wonderful electronic window shades. Lieven was a gracious host, very concise and quick to reply to our questions. I would very much recommend this place to anyone.
Great place and good location. modern finish, all very minimalist

Situé centre, facil d'accès au centre.

Appartement est assez grand, bell vue, calme.

Je ne vois pas lu even, mais il as expliqué tous ce que je besoin par avance.

Communication facil, parfait!

Je veux conseille cette appartement!!

Lieven is an amazing and very accomodating host! He's super flexible, regarding our last-minute booking and always available for any questions.  The apartment is located very central in one of the best areas in town! It's spacious, clean and everything is available for a perfect stay. Highly recommended and we'll be back for sure.

Het appartement ligt super centraal, is mooi groot en schoon en van alle gemakken voorzien. Lieven is een super gastheer en de communicatie verliep uitstekend. Zeker een aanrader voor iedereen die Antwerpen wil bezoeken!

Lieven's apartment is very stylish and comfortable, it is also very close to the city centre, making it perfect for a weekend exploring Antwerp. As a host he was very accommodating with our check-in and our requests and was excellent at communicating before our stay. I would 100% recommend this apartment to anyone, and if we visit Antwerp again would love to stay again ourselves. Thank you Lieven!

Lieven's apartment has a great location. It was very central and a close walk to the main train station. The apartment was clean & large and was fine for what we needed however it lacked in basic amenities. There was only two towels for the four days we were there and we had to purchase things like toilet paper and hand soap for the washroom. The apartment also had no TV as seen in the picture. Overall Lieven's apartment did the job and he was easy to communicate with. Thank you for our stay.

Great communication between me and the Host. He helped me out whenever I had questions and even gave me some recommendations of some excellent places to visit while i stayed at the apartment. Highly recommend!
Lieven is a kind and great host. The apartment was spacious and cosy. Moreover, the location is great. Definitely a recommend!

Het appartement ligt vlak bij het Centraal Station en het winkelgebied. De slaapkamer heeft prachtig uitzicht en het appartement is ruim en licht. Lieven was goed bereikbaar en erg vriendelijk. We hebben een erg prettig verblijf gehad.
Heel mooi appartement met een waanzinig uitzicht zowel op de Antwerpse Leien als op de skyline van Antwerpen!
Really nice location, very spatious flat and charming host
Prettig en ruim appartement, van alle gemakken voorzien. Zeker voor herhaling vatbaar.
Alles super.
Het appartement is schoon is ligt erg centraal. De verhuurder is zeer behulpzaam en reageert snel op berichten.
Cosy en heel comfortabel app met prachtig uitzicht en centraal gelegen. Vriendelijk en hulpvaardig ontvangst door eigenaar. Aanrader !
La ubicación es muy buena y el anfitrión te da buenos consejos para visitar la ciudad, el departamento es muy muy bueno también
Great place to stay for a week end in Antwerp. Lieven has been really accommodating.
Prima appartement, maar het ziet er nogal onbewoond uit. Er staat basis mobilair, maar verder weinig sfeervol. Prachtig uitzicht.
Erg net appartement zeer centraal gelegen. Parkeergelegenheden (betaald) in de buurt en winkels op loopafstand.
Geweldige locatie en goed voor een kort verblijf. Appartement was vrij leeg maar voor ons geen probleem aangezien we hier alleen sliepen en verder in de stad waren.

Lievens Wohnung ist super gut gelegen und befindet sich nur wenige Gehminuten von Hauptbahnhof und Innenstadt entfernt. Sie ist sehr geräumig und stylisch, aber auch ein wenig kahl. Check-In und -Out waren problemlos und Lieven super flexibel.

Prima locatie voor bezoek aan Antwerpen. Ruimte is schoon en groot!
Inderdaad bijna te leeg te noemen, maar alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig.
Inchecken en uitchecken is relaxed, dus geen stress!

I booked the apartment for a month-long stay for my parents and took care of the communication and logistics. The apartment is well-located and spacious (although the room in Pictures 13 and 14 is not accessible). Lieven is, overall, friendly and responsive. During the stay, the washer broke down, a new dryer needed to be installed, and there was a serious mosquito problem, but Lieven was attentive and took care of all the issues.
Lieven was very quick to respond and very helpful. It's a lovely flat with a beautiful view on the city at the back. I recommend this space.
Buena estancia. Apartamento muy céntrico.
Mooi, stijlvol appartement. Ideale ligging dicht bij het centrum

My friend and I spent one night in the Lieven's appartement and it was very good !
Localisation is perfect, very usefull and clean, and Lieven is a very great host, nice and accomodating.
We had a bit delay but he waited for us without any problem.
What else ? Unbeatable value for money !
I would recommand this place to everyone who want to visit Antwerp.
Many thanks again Lieven.

This place was amazing: a lot of light and space. The apartment is near either to Antwerpen Centraal Railway neither to the historical sites. My sister and I arrived there and felt comfortable. Mr Lieven was very open to help us and give advice to where to go, eat, etc. There are some cool cafe, bars and supermarkets nearby. I would recommend this apartment to anyone who goes to Antwerpen.
L'appartement est sale est semble en travaux. Les finitions ne sont pas finis. Il ne vaux pas le prix payé. Heureusement que nous avons passé ne journées à visiter la Belgique.
Fijn verblijf gehad hier. Alles was goed geregeld en de advertentie klopte met de werkelijkheid: goede locatie, heel ruim appartement, schoon en goede communicatie met de eigenaar.
Our stay was great and we didn’t have any difficulties! :)
A beautiful and big appartment in the centre of Antwerp near the central station

A lovely location away from the noise around Centraal Station but close enough for walking. Lieven was outstanding in communication when we had an issue with a previous flat and needed a new one asap. Would definitely recommend.
Located walking distance to the antwerp central station and all the eating and shopping places. Nice play to stay.
Mooi, ruim appartement. Goede locatie in het centrum, nabij het station en de winkelstraat.

Warre was a very kind host at a very special place.
We just stayed one night and unfortunately there was no concert or else at this night.
Warre took us to an exhibition in the city centre which was nice to see.
I think he has always a good suggestion for the nightlife.

Warre is an easy going guy, who showed us the entire property when we arrived. The property is used for many artistic purposes (and is way bigger than you'd think!), however we didn't hear much going on in the building from our room. The room was basic, but just what you need when you're staying for the night after going to a concert. 5-10 minute walk to the Sportpaleis and Lotto Arena. Warre is a home-handyman, which makes the house really unique and personal!
Quite unique house, full of character!

What a hidden gem!

It is tucked away in Antwerpt but easily accessible by tram from Central Station. Warre quickly replied to all of our questions and gave us quick and easy access. The tour of the house was expansive and incredibly big, and inspiring to boot. Very accommodating and a lot of cool spots and greenery.

Authentic place to stay, unique house with creative layout. We were 45 minutes late for check in due to unexpected public transit issues and the host was obviously extremely annoyed. It was understandable that being late would irritate him, but felt like a very uncomfortable arrival and unwarm welcome. Room was fine, location was good, but no breakfast as promised.
Very friendly hospitable host, the house is clean and has wide spaces. Quiet neighbourhood. Recommended.

Nous avons passé un super weekend.
Warre est très accueillant, généreux et réactif.
On a eu de belles et chouettes discussions.
L'endroit est génial pour qui aime les ambiances d'ateliers d'artistes.
J'y retournerai avec grand plaisir <3

Nous n'avons passé qu'une nuit chez Warre, mais on a adoré ! Le lit était confortable, l'ambiance cool et détendue, les espaces de la maison uniques et la communication avec Warre simple et agréable.
Il faut toutefois préciser que la chambre se trouve hors du centre, pas possible d'y aller à pied, mais il y a un arret de tram très près de la maison pour aller directement dans le centre ou à la gare. Par contre, le Sportpaleis se trouve juste à coté et c'est donc idéal pour ceux qui (comme nous) cherchent un endroit sympa où dormir après un concert ou un événement en soirée.
Merci Warre !! <3
Lugar tranquilo perfecto para descansar

Probably the best Airbnb experience I've had. The house is truly unique and inspiring. Warre is outstandingly generous and friendly and so were the other people we met that are staying in the place working / living as artists and craftsmen. We are definitely coming back!
Amazing place with a great host. Really admire the house.
Very beautiful place, really artistic and inspirational!

The owner is a creative person and very attentive soulful person! Gave me a lot of useful tips and even gave a blanket so that I could sleep in the car if I can not find affordable housing in Amsterdam!

Very creative and inspiring place in Antwerp. Also very well located (3min from tram station and then cca 15min by tram to the Centraal Station (Diamant). Warre and his friends were more than happy to help and answer our questions.

Definitely recommend this place and really a must-go if you are an artist.
Great host, quick response, great opportunity to get to know people outside the box

Very convenient if you have an event in the sportpaleis as it’s 5 to 10 minutes walk only

I had a warmly welcome tour when I arrived and the place is amazing

I definitely recommend this place
This place is awesome. The host is way nice and flexible. The environment is open and fun. Way bigger than I was expecting. Loved it.

Warre is a great host: open, friendly and always open for a nice chat.
The audio plant is a big building with a lot to offer! If you are open-minded and into music this is your stay. Value for money for sure.
nice people. helpful. good tipps for you. interesting house :)
Really cool place which give inspiration!
Good host

Prima plek als je een nachtje wilt verblijven in Antwerpen, voornamelijk als je naar de Lotto Arena gaat of het Sportpaleis. Relaxte sfeer in huis, bijzondere ervaring, deze AirBnb! De locatie was vlak bij een tramstation, maar lag zelf helaas niet in een gezellige wijk.
's Ochtends helaas ijskoud water in de badkamer, dat was jammer.

Warre is een goede gastheer. Gemaakte afspraken keurig nagekomen en zeer gastvrij ontvangen. Locatie is ideaal voor een avondje sportpaleis/lotto arena
Recomended for low budget.. Its close enough to Central, the room was quite clean. He was fast responses and helpfull..

Warre and the family were amazing, the house is a dream. They have everything you need and more. The tram is right outside and the centre is close.
Lovely people, great atmosphere! I will definitely come back again!
What an amazing quirky place! I would recommend it 100% to anyone visiting Antwerp. Warre is very welcoming, I’d visit again in a heartbeat!

Nice appartement!

Wir hatten einen wunderbaren Aufenthalt in Antwerpen. Davids Wohnung war chick, sauber , gut gelegen. Wir haben uns da sehr wohl gefühlt. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

If you are looking for a nice and big room with your own bathroom in lovely Antwerp Zuid, this is the place to be!
The bed is comfortable, shower and toilet modern. Location is nice: you can park in the neighborhood for just 3,80 per day and it is just a little walk to the centre!

The apartment is nice and was perfectly clean. Location is good and the sorrounding are is full of restaurants and convenientoy located.

Lovely stay at David's place. Great location and super clean.

David’s place offers a great location (only a short walk to the centre of Old Town and lots of nice restaurants nearby), the room was super clean, the bed was very comfortable, and we enjoyed many nights and mornings on the outside roof terrace. David was very helpful and gave great tips on exploring the city as well as Belgium as a whole. Couldn’t recommend this place more!

As a solo traveller I found the room spacious and with good facilities. If the weather is sunny and you want to have a coffee whilst you do a bit of reading or writing then the rooftop sun terrace is ready and waiting. Despite being a well-located spot I did not find it noisy at all and slept well.

If you visit David's flat you will be well-served by local bars and cafes, e.g. Mirlo's in particular. There are several museums within a relatively short walking distance including FOMU (photography gallery) which I feel bettered an equivalent gallery in Soho (London). I was able to walk into the city-centre but also made use of the nearby Antwerpen Kasteelplein tram stop (routes 8 and 10) to speed up the journey when necessary.

David was an attentive host and available if I needed help. I would happily stay again when visiting Antwerp.

David was quick and clear in communication. There was lemonwater and coffee at arrival, the beds were comfortable, the place is quiet and in a perfect neighborhood with nice restaurants at the square and good bars within five minutes walking distance. There is also a nightshop around the corner and you can enjoy your drinks or breakfast on the specious rooftop terrace. Perfect choice.

David is a welcoming and very attentive host and whenever a question came up we were able to easily contact him and he answered directly. The flat in one of the typical narrow steep houses is really charming and exactly as shown in the pictures. It is ideal for couples but with the second bedroom and separate toilet it also works out fine for friends. The flat location is ideal - easily reachable by public transport, only a 15 minutes walk to the town center and in a charming quiet quarter but with nice restaurants and cafes nearby. Thank you David, we had a great time.
We had a very comfortable and relaxed  stay at David's stylish place. The location was great and our needs were well looked after for our week stay. It truly felt like a home from home!

Daumen Hoch! Die Wohnung von David liegt 3-5 Minuten vom belebterem Zentrum entfernt. Sie befindet sich in einem schönen Altbauhaus unterm Dach. Sie war zudem sehr sauber und verfügt über eine schöne kleine Dachterasse.
Die stilvoll eingerichtete Wohnung entspricht zu hundert Prozent der Beschreibung auf der Webseite und den Fotos. Das Bett war bequem, das WLAN schnell und die Dusche sehr angenehm.

Die Kommunikation verlief ebenso problemlos.
Für einen kurzen Aufenthalt sehr zu empfehlen. Gerne Wieder und besten Dank :-)
highly recommended,

It was very easy to find the apartment, walking from the train station was not that far. The apartment itself is in a wonderful neighborhood, you can find everything you need close by. There is a small corner store for groceries just downstairs and great restaurants, bars just 4 min. away.
The apartment is beautiful and comfortable. The small roof top is perfect for coffee in the morning with sunshine.
David was the most kindest and helpful host. He replied quickly to all our questions and offered his help for the entire stay. Thank you so much David. We will choose your apartment anytime we come back.
Julia & Angela
Emplacement idéal pour visiter. Chambre spacieuse, très propre et lieu agréable et calme ! On recommande ce logement !
Stylish, superclean, perfectly situated appartment close to so many nice bars, restaurants and cultural venues. David is a superfriendly host, quick in his responses. Fully recommended!
Really nice place, David is the best

Dit appartement was fantastisch voor ons meiden weekend in Antwerpen! De locatie is top, het centrum is op 10 min lopen en er zijn genoeg restaurants in de buurt. Het appartement zag er precies zo uit als op de foto’s en het was mooi verzorgd en schoon!

We loved staying at David's place. It is very clean, stylish and located in a nice neighborhood from where you can easily walk towards the historical city centre. David made sure we had everything we needed and gave us some great recommendations for museum and places to eat.
Very nice apartment, great position, impecably clean, great host, super kind and helpful!:)
David's space is absolutely brilliant - comfortable, clean and a great location near cafes, bars and about a 10 minute walk into the center. Would highly recommend David as a host!
Erg fijne, schone ruimte, goede douche en top locatie. Lekker dat de ook koffie en thee op de kamer gemaakt kon worden.

We had a great stay in Antwerp! The flat is in a really cool neighborhood, with a great terrace where we could enjoy the sunset with a fresh Belgian beer! David was really helpful all along our stay and it was easy to communicate.
My mother and I had a wonderful time in the city thanks to the kindness of David and the great adresses he gave us. His home is warm, cosy and calm. Recommended !
It is an amazing location.
Very nice room on top floor. Nice attention during stay.  Very good situation.

de foto's kloppen volledig met de realiteit.
David is een vriendelijke man. Zijn verblijf is heel netjes en proper. De ligging is perfect !
Een aanrader !

David is a really friendly and welcoming host. He has good tips about the sights in Antwerp.

Very friendly welcome, perfect location, cosy but spacious apartment! Great stay!

Very clean and cute appartement - we had a wonderful stay in Antwerp. Also David was very kind and helpful! Would recommend :)
David is a great and kind host! The rooms are clean, the sun terrace is very nice and the location is within walking distance of pretty much everything. Would recommend!

David was the perfect host, with a lot of great tips for visiting the city, and really arranging. We had a great time in this private level. The rooftop terrace is a very must to enjoy a peaceful breakfast!
een fijne gezellige plaats waar alles voor handen is wat je nodig hebt voor een goed verblijf ,douche ,bedden ,aankleding kamer ,koffie en dak terras

If you would like to find a tidy room to spend your holiday, I would definitely recommend you this accomodation in Antwerp.
Very clean appartement. Great location, close to the metro and nice bars and restaurants. Very kind host.

Our stay with David was great, everything was newly renovated and clean. The location was perfect as we were visiting Antwerp to attend Grafixx festival, which was only a 5 minute walk from the house. David was very helpful and easy to communicate with. Thank you so much David!

Roos is  very nice and welcoming, we had a wonderful time in Antwerp, her apartment is also very confortable with make the stay  even nicer. I recommend her strongly. It's also well located because you have the metro close by.

3 stappen van supermarkt en metro, zodat centrum makkelijk bereikbaar is met openbaar vervoer. Straat is breed en licht, met mooie gebouwen en makkelijk een parkeerplaats te vinden. Appartement is van alle gemakken voorzien een echt thuiskomen. Dankjewel Roos.

Een weekendje Antwerpen in het appartement van Roos. Het was echt super.

Super toffe gastvrouw, met mooi proper ingericht appartement.  Zeker een aanrader voor iedereen die wilt relaxen.
Een mooi gezellig appartement. Tip top in orde. Vriendelijk ontvangst met de nodige uitleg. Een aanrader.

Roos was als gast vrouw zeer vriendelijk. Later inchecken was geen probleem. Verder is het appartement heel proper en leuk ingericht!

Roos reageert super snel op alle vragen en had voor alles gezorgd. Ook een extra haardroger was geen probleem. Roos was ook super flexibel met aankomst en vertrek. Perfect weekend! Host very friendly, helpful, polite!

The stairs leading up to the apartment on the third floor is very narrow though and there is no lift, so it is difficult if you are carrying with you a relatively big luggage. Also, the tram/metro in front of the apartment is under construction so you would need to use the bus or change from bus to tram/metro to get around. And the wait for the bus can be quite long. I have waited 20 to 30mins on average for bus and 50mins at the longest.

Roos is a great, flexible and accommodating host and communications with her was easy as well.
Mega vlotte vriendelijke communicatie. Alles perfect in orde. We zijn mega tevreden! En komen ooit nog terug. Tot binnenkort?

Het appartement is mooi en netjes, je voelt je er snel thuis :) Roos is erg vriendelijk en toegankelijk, je kan bij haar terecht voor tips... Super weekend gehad!
Een ruim, licht appartement, op korte tram afstand van het centrum van Antwerpen. Roos ontving ons zelf en heeft ons kort rondgeleid en uitgelegd. Erg gastvrije ontvangst. Prima verblijf gehad.

Mooie sfeervolle locatie  op 3 hoog, prettige communicatie met de gastvrouw.

地点非常好。浴室非常让人享受
Amazing apartment and location. Laila was easy to contact and quick to respond. All facilities were clean and comfortable with  a knowledgeable and friendly host. We will be back! Thankyou

Zeer goed contact!! Alles perfect in orde!! Waarschijnlijk de mooiste locatie die je kan huren te Antwerpen!!

Prima vertrek. Oud gebouw maar goed schoon.

I lived in this apartment for one month in March 2019.  The main reason to stay here is to enjoy the dining room, with its high ceiling, glass chandelier, embossed leather wall coverings, wooden paneling, and its blue delft tile painting of Antwerp over the massive marble fireplace.  There is also an entry room with a good tv and a sofa, a bedroom, a kitchen, a shower room over the bedroom and a toilet room with washer and dryer off of the dining room.  There is an enclosed patio, but I did not use it.  The bed is large and comfortable, the shower room is modern.  There is sufficient storage space for clothing.  The kitchen is well-equipped.  It's a short walk to the old city, the university and the major shopping areas.  There is a Carrefour supermarket in the Grand Bazar shopping mall.  There is some noise during the day from the construction site across the street, but that is a small price to pay for absolute quiet during the night.  (The building is at the dead end of an isolated side street.)  The only downside was that during rainy weather there were some funky smells in the bathroom and the kitchen (and in all of Antwerp for that matter).  Laila came every week to change the linens and towels and to clean.  She was very reliable.

Great location, amazing apartment.

We enjoyed staying in this historic space- it is very large, cool being in this older building, but I would not say it is cozy.  The noise from construction at 7:00 am was not the best, but you can't beat the location- it was clean, great location- comfy bed......we needed to get up anyway- great hostess as well.
Best Airbnb I have ever stayed in. Also Laila has the best recommendations for restaurants! Thank you very much for an amazing stay

Een hele fijne plek op een perfecte locatie. Een stille straat midden in het centrum. De dag na ons was niet geboekt, dus mochten we van de gastvrouw later uitchecken. Echt heel erg gastvrij! Een aanrader!

Enorme ruimte, heerlijke slaapkamer en douche. Incl douchegel en handdoeken. Keuken is helemaal prima en veel zaken waren al aanwezig als zout/peper/olie.
Heerlijk, maar zacht, bed en lekkere 4 kussens. Binnenplaats is echt een plaatsje (geen uitzicht), maar je zit zo centraal dat je die helemaal niet nodig hebt. Veel parkeergarages direct in de buurt: zoek de juiste uit (Horta op het Hopland, 7 min lopen) en je parkeert voor 10 euro per dag (top!). In de straat ook een garage voor 23 euro per dag. Heerlijk ontbijt/lunchtentje om de hoek met de grote winkelstraat (Meir). Alles op loopafafstand (bv wijk Eiland en wijk Zuid), maar OV ook prima. Fotos kloppen en positieve recensies ook! Aanrader!
This apartment is in the centre of Antwerp, only a short walk from a huge choice of restaurants, bars and cafes. Good value, lovely space and the paid parking is secure and close.

Laila met us promptly upon arrival in Antwerp and provided us with all the information needed.  She even got in touch with us during our visit to make sure we had everything we needed.  I highly recommend this apartment and would stay here again if we make it back to Antwerp.

We felt like royalty! Laila’s place is big and beautiful, with a comfortable bed and an incredible shower. We also got the chance to do laundry, which was a godsend. Laila was very helpful with suggestions. We would definitely stay again!
This place is beautiful and everything was perfect!

Lailas apartment was absolutely beautiful. The renaissance architecture along with modern features was stunning. It was close to various restaurants and located perfectly where we wanted to be. Laila was a great host and communicating with her was very easy. The shower was amazing! And I loved the chandeliers in each room. Will stay here again when in Antwerp.

This is a great apartment from which to enjoy Antwerp life. It is located in the heart of the city and central to everything. The facilities are first class, being expansive, comfortable and of a very high standard, including a luxurious designer bathroom that occupies the entire mezzanine floor. The character wood surrounds and very high ceilings add to the ambience. It is particularly good apartment in which to base a stay in Antwerp.
Ontzettend vriendelijk en benaderbaar, prachtig appartement op toplocatie. We communiceerde via (Hidden by Airbnb) , super handig. Aanrader!

Nice, comfortable apartment bang in the centre of town, yet on a quiet street a couple of minutes walk from all the amenities of central Antwerp. Just what we needed for a two night stay on our first trip to the city.

One of a number of Air b&b properties managed by Laila - so check in & communication was dead easy.

Quirky in character, big comfortable bed, great shower, TV room in the hall & helpful little kitchen.

Thx Laila.
De foto’s komen zeer goed overeen met de werkelijkheid. Locatie is ook top. Laila is goed bereikbaar en communicatie verliep top.

This place is exactly as the listing describes. Almost felt like I was staying in a modern victorian vampire den (but in a good way). It is super centrally located which makes it easy to get anywhere. I would definitely stay again.

Great location, and beautiful and warm apartment. Due to circumstances we had to check-in later than expected and this was no problem! Laila was also left cava in the fridge for us to celebrate my birthday. All in all, a great stay.
Sehr coole Wohnung im centrum von Antwerpen... superbere Host...

Probably the best Airbnb I’ve stayed in! Location is perfect, right in the heart of everything but so quiet. Amazing place, unlike anywhere I’ve stayed before. Super friendly & responsive host. Absolutely recommend!
Geweldige locatie, prachtige plek. We komen graag weer terug!
Perfect located and a great and stylish Airbnb. You feel like sleeping in a museum. A very clean and beautiful decorated place. Would stay again  in a heartbeat
Really unique and luxury stay! Perfect location and not noisy. We enjoyed our stay!
Top, mooi

Wonderful space in a perfect location. A block away from the hustle of the Meir but so quiet you wouldn’t think you were in a major city. Laila puts the “super” in “superhost” and was the most considerate and helpful person imaginable. Highly recommended.
We had a great time at Laila’s place. Like the advert says: this is a real hidden treasure!

Een prachtige Airbnb, om de hoek van de Meir (winkelstraat). Contact met Laila was erg snel en vriendelijk. De airbnb zelf is ontzettend indrukwekkend en erg ruim. Met name de regendouche is een fantastische voorziening. Als je op zoek bent naar een romantische accommodatie, centraal gelegen en veel waarde voor je geld, boek dan deze airbnb.
would totally stay again
Groot, luxe appartement midden in de stad. Goed matras, heerlijke regendouche, alles was schoon (lekker ruikend wasmiddel of -verzachter). Zeker een aanrader!!!
Laila is een top host, vlotte communicatie, alles was aanwezig en de locatie zelf wel mooi en zeer proper. Zeker een aanrader!
Beautiful , thanks

Fabulous and unique apartment which is very well located for all the sights in Antwerp without being noisy. Very spacious also. Laila was very communicative and friendly. On the whole the experience could not have been better. Highly recommended.
Laila’s place is stylish and cool. On top of the cool factor, it’s also in a great location. If we’re ever back in Antwerp, we’ll be checking to see if Laila’s place is available!
Awesome place right down town in the city center. Just a few minutes walk from the main train station. Loved the very high ceilings.

This is an amazing apartment, quite unlike any Airbnb I have stayed in before. From a practical perspective, it is cosy and comfortable and well located for the railway station and the main sights. Laila was an exemplary hostess and was there for us when our late running train delayed our planned arrival time.
Perfect

Die Lage der Wohnung ist super, man kann von dort aus die Stadt sehr gut zu Fuß erkunden, drumherum gibt es tolle Restaurants und die Bilder geben die Wohnung perfekt wieder.  Die Kommunikation mit Laila hat wunderbar funktioniert.

Werkelijk fantastisch appartement in prachtige Rubens stijl. Erg veel voorzieningen, heerlijk bed, unieke badkamer en super schoon. Zeker aan te bevelen! We waren er enkele dagen met 30 graden buiten, maar binnen bleef Het fantastisch koel. Een oase net achter de drukke Meir. Trouwens de tram/metro halte ligt ook heel praktisch om de hoek.
Tot slot niet te vergeten onze vriendelijke, punctuele en perfect communicerende gastvrouw, Laila. Bedankt. Erg attent van fles heerlijk koud water bij aankomst trouwens. We komen graag terug.

De airbnb is ruim en van alles voorzien. Ruime, moderne badkamer; ruime slaapkamer en heel ruime 'eetkamer' met prachtige schouw en houten muurbekleding. Ondanks de onmiddellijke nabijheid van de Meir heel rustig gelegen. De keuken is degelijk uitgerust en je kunt zelfs buiten tussen de gebouwen je maaltijd nuttigen (indien mooi weer)..

Kortom, een aanrader voor een verblijf in deze stad.
Top locatie, dichtbij vertier en fijne host!

Wir hatten ein sehr schönes Wochenende in diesem traumhaften Apartment. Die Kommunikation mit Leila war total unkompliziert, alles lief super. Die Lage ist für einen Städtetrip perfekt! Das Apartment selber sehr außergewöhnlich, gut ausgestattet und blitzsauber. Wir würden jederzeit wieder herkommen!

This location is very beautiful in its own style. It is in a quiet dead end street, still very close to Antwerp’s main shopping district. Easily accessible by public transportation. The place is really clean and amenities are clearly more than should be expected from and AirBnB rental. The host is very nice and communicates clearly and quickly. There were some measures in place against COVID-19 as well. As noted in the general description, there is indeed construction work being down across the street, but it did not bother us.
Een super fijne/mooie plek om tot rust te komen in het leuke Antwerpen!
Tres bel endroit. Au calme et pourtant tres proche du Meir. Literie confortable. Équipement conforme à la description et aux photos
A charming house and a lovely host !

We stayed at Lailas for a weekend and it's one of the best Airbnbs I've been at. Everything looks according to pictures and the location is hard to beat in Antwerpen. We'll be staying here next time we come back to the city!
Me and my partner stayed in these beautiful surroundings for a week... it was hard to leave!
Great place and incredible location!
A great apartment right in the centre of the city!
Overwhelmingly charming place in the perfect location to discover the city as well as enjoy some peace and quiet. Layla is a very helpful and kind host.
We had a great stay at Laila’s place. The apartment has a lot of character and Laila is a charming and helpful host. The neighborhood is perfect for visiting the city.
We waren onder de indruk vanaf het binnenkomen, beeldschone ruimte, proper, voorzieningen. Laila is altijd bereikbaar, top gastvrouw.

Ongelooflijk verblijf in het hartje van Antwerpen! Het appartement is prachtig en een unieke verblijfplaats! Vanaf het binnenwandelen waren wij onder de indruk. Laila legt alles goed uit en staat steeds paraat voor vragen. In het algemeen een fantastisch verblijf!
Zalige locatie, dicht bij alles. Leuke badkamer en interieur!
Prachtige en centrale locatie van dit enorm grote appartement. Fijn dat het zo schoon was en ook een erg fijn bed. Zeer comfortabel verblijf gehad. Aanrader!

Een zeer sympathieke en vriendelijke ontvangst door Leila. echt top !
Wij vonden het toch een beetje een bevreemde airbnb, toch iets minder charmant en romantisch dan we het ons hadden voorgesteld...
Een hele bijzondere plek in het centrum van Antwerpen. Prettige communicatie en een mooi verzorgde plek. Aanrader!
A hidden gem, bang in the city center without realizing it.
Amazing place! Great host, smooth communication, we had everything we needed! Perfect location as well. Definitely recommended!
Locatie perfect, parkeergarage om de hoek, heel veel ruimte.
Fijn contact, prima service!

Das Apartment ist ideal gelegen, um Antwerpen zu erkunden. Die Räume sind sehr schick und atmen den altehrwürdigen Charme Antwerpens. Trotz der großen Fenster bleibt es aber den ganzen Tag über eher dunkel in der Wohnung, weil die Sonne nicht direkt hinein scheint (Hinterhof, schmale Gasse). Wirkt mystisch, aber eben auch etwas düster.
Geweldige locatie, lekker bed en een prachtig verblijf. Zou het iedereen aanraden.
A unique and very special space, and a location near everything and yet very quiet.  Host is great, very responsive & helpful.

Perfecte centrale locatie, 10 min lopen van station, midden tussen winkel en horeca, en prachtig pand op een hele rustige locatie.

Aanrader!
Beautiful place in a great location- close to the Main Street but still quiet. Comfortable bed and great bathroom.

The apartment is located very centrally and is quite spatious and has a beautiful living room. The shower is located in an open gallery above the bed.
The space however tends to be a bit dark, as it is on ground level in a smaller street. Some of the furniture and decoration do not match the architecture and feel a bit misplaced.
When we arrived, the apartment smelled like a heavy perfume, which we disliked.
Communication with Laila was very nice.
Great place! Totally recommend it!
Great spot close to everything in the city. Very cool interior.
Great host, quick communication. Friendly and helpful.
Fantastisch ruim en bijzonder appartement op een fijne centrale lokatie. Ideaal voor een weekendje weg!
Ein fantastischer und ungewöhnlicher Ort voller Charakter. Lage, Ausstattung - alles ideal für ein langes Wochenende in Antwerpen.
I really enjoyed the character and features of the historic property, but especially the location.  And Laila is a gracious host.  Highly recommend.

Wat een statig en prachtig appartement! En dit in het hart van Antwerpen.
Echt genoten van ons verblijf.
Host was zeer gastvrij en behulpzaam!
Very well located comfortable apartment in the historic old stock exchange building. Laila offered great support and we had a lovely time in Antwerp.
Fijne host
Super
We had a great time at this AirBnB in Antwerp. Check-in was smooth, and the place was well-equipped. Laila was very responsive too!

The flat is exactly as the photos show.  From the great storage solutions to the smallest vignettes, every design element is so well thought out.  Having the spacious outdoor areas was super and just adds to the beauty of the space.  The location is close to the train station as well as easy walking distance to the main sights of Antwerpen.  Daan is a great host and we would definitely stay here again.

The apartment is spacious, bright, very clean and exactly as you see in the pictures but more impressive when you are in it.  Dana is the perfect host and met us earlier to accommodate us which was very much appreciated by us.  The location is ideal as it's so central.  It's also very quiet area at night so you get a great nights sleep in the fabulous comfortable big bed.  I certainly recommend this apartment and would return again if I was ever in Antwerp.  Thank you Daan.

Penthouse seemed larger than photos depicted. The flat was spotlessly clean, and Daan was a great host - meeting us at check-in and following up with us during our stay. Flat is about a 5-8 min walk to Antwerp Centraal station with easy connections to Ghent, Bruges, Brussels, and Amsterdam.

The space was perfect! It was so much larger than it looks in the pictures. Everything was sparkling clean and Daan could not have been a better host. He was so quick to respond when we had questions and he knew where everything was. The space is centrally located for everything. We would definitely stay here again if we came back to Belgium!

Highly Recommended.  I have stayed at several Airbnb's in the Central Station area of Antwerp and this was by far the best.  The location is great with a view overlooking Stadspark and the rooftop terrace was a beautiful spot to spend a few hours in the sun.  Daan was a great host and very accommodating.  There were even a few local Belgian beers waiting in the fridge when I arrived.  I would recommend this spot to anyone visiting Antwerp.
Daan's apartment was everything I expected and more. I really enjoyed the time I spent there and I would be happy to stay again.

Ik werd goed ontvangen door Luk, de partner van Daan. Daan kon niet aanwezig zijn. Ik kreeg eerst een rondleiding doorheen het appartement. Op het balkon legde hij mij de skyline uit van Antwerpen. Tot slot toonde hij mij een stadsplan en gaf mij advies wat ik allemaal kon bezoeken.
Alhoewel het gebouw aan een drukke straat stond had ik er geen last van omdat rond 18.30 het verkeer stilviel. Een groot pluspunt was ook dat er op nog geen minuut wandelen de Velo huurfietsen stonden waarvan ik gretig gebruik van heb gemaakt.
De appartement zelf zag er heel goed onderhouden uit. Wat mij direct opviel nadat ik binnenkwam was de mooie karakteristieke houten vloer. Alles was ook zeer licht en ruim. Er was ook zeker voldoende opbergruimte. En de keuken is volledig uitgerust om je eigen potje te kunnen koken. Kortom ik heb genoten van mijn verblijf in de penthouse.
Maar ik had wel enkele minpunten en dat is dat het 's morgens veel te licht was in de slaapkamer waardoor ik veel te vroeg wakker werd. Er was een probleem met de gordijnen.
Wanneer je in de woonkamer zit hoor je de buren en de lift. Zo had ik een avond wat geluidsoverlast van de buren. Waarschijnlijk hadden ze bezoek want ik hoorde gelach en gepraat. Gelukkig is het maar bij een avond gebleven.

Es war ein sehr angenehmer Aufenthalt. Sehr zentral gelegen, so das wir alle Sehenswürdigkeiten zu Fuß erreichen konnten. Alles war sehr sauber und man hat auf beiden Seiten einen tollen Blick über Antwerpen. Vielen Dank!

I have been in Antwerp for a couple of days with some friends and we stayed in this beautiful loft. It is quiet, spacious and well furnished. Leen and her husband were very kind and helpful with us and they gave us some tips on what to visit in Antwerp. I really loved listening to relaxing music on their vinyl record player after a long day.

L'atelier de Leen et Roel est juste parfait pour découvrir Anvers et nous avons particulièrement apprécié leur accueil chaleureux. Nos hôtes nous ont guidé en nous laissant un plan avec les endroits à visiter, qui correspondaient à nos centres d'intérêts.  L'appartement donne directement sur un jardin/cour très calme et charmant...le quartier est également très sympa. Nous recommandons vivement cette adresse! Merci pour tout, nous reviendrons sûrement! :)

Leen a répondu à toutes nos questions sur le logement, son ami nous a très bien accueillies lorsque nous sommes arrivées à Anvers. Nous avons passé un agréable séjour dans leur loft tout équipé ! Le quartier est très sympa, très populaire, avec un arrêt de tram à proximité (le centre ville n'est pas très éloigné, même à pieds). C'est un petit havre de paix au cœur de la ville.

Das erste mal Aibnb und es war Top. Wir wurden sehr nett begrüßt und da Leen und Roel nah bei wohnen war es auch kein Problem das wir etwas später angekommen sind. Eine sehr saubere Unterkunf, Zentral gelegen aber schön ruhig. Wir haben tolle Tipps für Restaurants bekommen. Wir kommen gerne noch mal wieder. Grüße aus Deutschland Susanne, Elisabeth & Ina

Hele fijne ruimte, lekker hoog en schoon. En op een goede plek: een halte met de metro naar het centraal station of 10 minuten lopen. Het is een atelier dat aan een klein tuintje/plaatsje ligt en daardoor erg stil.
Everything was perfect - the atelier was exactly as described or even better! We really enjoyed our stay and would love to make another trip to Antwerp.

Great night at Leen's place. Her husband gave us all the information needed for visiting the city, buses, places to eat and some tips as well.

The place was great, big, clean, with all the facilities. We highly recommended this place for future visitors.

Een SUPER verblijf! We werden goed onthaald en kregen de nodige informatie om Antwerpen te bezoeken. Een tof en net atelier gelegen in een rustige buurt. Gemakkelijk te bereiken met de tram of te voet. Zeker een aanrader!!!
Marijke, Leen en Sanne

L'atelier est vraiment super beau et on s'y plait beaucoup ! Les hôtes sont accueillants, sympathique et arrangeant.
Tout y est réuni pour passer un bon séjour.
Je recommande pour un passage à Anvers

We werden vriendelijk ontvangen door Leen's man. Hij heeft ons uitgebreid uitgelegd hoe we onze weg konden vinden in Antwerpen. De studio was geheel volgens foto's. Licht, ruim en bijzonder. Er staat een platenspeler en een stapel lp's. De wijk is heel levendig en mooi contract met de rustige binnenplaats waar de studio aan ligt.
Alles naar wens. Goede communicatie. Aardige mensen. Schoon en compleet appartement. Aanbeveling!

Een hele leuke plek, een verrassing achter de grote houten poort. Leuke frisse ruimte, alles wat we nodig hadden was aanwezig. Rustig, fijne atmosfeer en een goed bed! We werden erg vriendelijk ontvangen en wegwijs gemaakt. Al met al een zeer fijne uitvalsbasis om Antwerpen te verkennen. Ik zou anderen dit adres aanraden.
Leen was super flexibel, heel leuke ontvangst! Huisje is vlak bij het centrum en openbaar vervoer. Alle voorzieningen, ook leuk binnentuintje en vlakbij gezellige barretjes en koffiezaakjes.

Notre court séjour dans l'appartement a été très agréable : l'espace est lumineux et bien aménagé, et l'accueil par son compagnon chaleureux. Nous avons pu profiter du tourne disque situé dans l'atelier pour passer des soirées fort sympathiques et les quelques prospectus proposés nous ont orienté dans notre découverte de la ville. Bien qu'il faille (bien) marcher pour rejoindre le centre de la ville, la ballade est agréable, et sinon il y a un arrêt de tramway tout proche !
Nous reviendrons avec plaisir !
Prima verblijf, vlakbij centrum in een drukke buurt waar alles te vinden is. Maar de ligging is op een binnen terrein dus heerlijk rustig!
Gemütliches Wohnatelier in einem ruhigen Innenhof, perfekt für ein Wochenende. Vielen Dank für die Gastfreundschaft!

We had a beautiful and relaxing time staying in Leens atelier. The atelier itself is spacious and unique. Since it is located inside a backyard with a garden you can leave all the noises and lights of the city outside by stepping through the gate. We were travelling with our daughter (8) and she also enjoyed the stay. The sofa is a very comfortable bed, the kitchen is fully equiped. The tram is very near and the centraal station is only three stops away. Roel and Leen were very helpfull. If we ever come back to Antwerpen we hopefully can come to this place again.
Très bon accueil de Leen et Roel, qui nous ont facilité l'arrivée et le depart. Roel nous a donné les indications pour nous déplacer. Logement conforme à la description, tres spacieux.

Thank you so much Leen! We had a great time in your atelier. The place is just perfect, we sit outside in the night, watching the stars, walked around in the pretty nice neighborhood, had a lot of very good food around the house. If you want to get to know the city and the people Leens atelier is the best point to start with. It has a big kitchen, a really nice bathroom, the sleeping couch was one of the most comfortable we had. There is also a second floor with another bed. And listen to the vinyls, there is also the one Leens husband did with his band, good music from the heart.

Again, thanks a lot to Leen and her family, they made us feel home!

The studio of Leen & Roel is really nice, equipped with everything you need for a pleasant  stay. It is as described in their post, plus it also has access to a nice outdoor area. It's about 20min walking distance from the centre of Antwerp. I would definitely stay here again in the future.
perfect place for creative people in a nice neighbourhood. A warm welcome and very helpful hosts! recommended if you look for a cosy stay in Antwerp

L'appartement est tel que décrit dans l'annonce, les photos réalistes. On a même eu un peu de soleil avec :)
L'emplacement nous convenait, on venait pour un festival à 10 min de là. Le centre-ville est par contre un peu éloigné, mais les transports en commun ou vélos sont pratiques.
Le petit lit de la mezzanine est ok, mais ne convient pas vraiment pour des longs séjours je pense. Mais cela a été parfait pour nous, un grand merci !

We werden hartelijk ontvangen door Roel, Leen´s man. Het is een ruim appartement in een levendige wijk met veel kleine winkeltjes. Door de binnentuin is het wel lekker rustig in het appartement. Met de tram of ben je binnen 10 min in het centrum.

Roel (de vriend van Leen) wachten ons op en gaf ons veel tips en uitleg over de buurt en de stad! Erg vriendelijk en het verblijf zag er precies zo uit zoals op de foto's. We hebben een erg leuke tijd gehad!

Leen and her husband were perfect hosts! The loft is very well-situated, you can walk from the Antwerp train station (20 minutes) or take the Tram (10, 24 one ride is 1,40€) and get there very easy. The studio's kitchen is so well equipped, we did a real cooking-session there and had lovely cosy breakfasts. Everything is just fine - it was like staying at a friend's place you've been knowing since ever. Thank you, we enjoyed this weekend and the city is just super pretty!
Goede afspraken met Leen kunnen maken. Fijne ontvangst en welkom door Roel. We voelden ons direct thuis en hadden een heerlijk verblijf.
De ruimte was lekker ruim en privé. De man van Leen was heel vriendelijk en goed bereikbaar via telefoon.

We had a great time during our stay in Leen's and Roel's place. The studio is actually even bigger than on the photos. The space is just enormous! Very quiet surroundings as the property is located in the backyard.
Few minutes from central station by tram.

Everything went fine with Leen and Roel. They are nice and welcoming people!

Before our trip, we spoke with Leen easily to plan our arrival.
When we arrived, Roel gave us good advices about Antwerp.

We were here to go to a music event so their home was just perfect for music lovers (there is a nice Zappa poster and some vinyls!).

PS : for beer lovers, we advice you the "beer lovers bar" ! ;)

Leen and Roel are very kind and friendly people and perfect hosts. We enjoyed our stay in their atelier which is located in Borgerhout, a very interesting neighbourhood.  A perfect place to start exploring Antwerp even by foot. Thank you very much. Greetings from Hamburg, Claudia, Carlotta & Frank

We three had a really good time.
Thanks a lot for the flexible check in/out. This helped so much!

Wir waren für ein Wochenende in Antwerpen. Alles lief ganz unkompliziert. Das Atelier ist super gemütlich, Tram direkt um die Ecke, sehr nette Gastgeber die auch auf verspätete Gäste warten  Was will man mehr. Wir können die Unterkunft in jedem Fall weiter empfehlen.

This was a really cool place to stay. Leen and Raul were very helpful and friendly and gave us excellent tips of where to go and what to do in Antwerp. The apartment is really nice, very clean, great decor and comfortable bed. It was nice to have access to the private courtyard. Will definitely come back again!

Bon accueil de Leen et son compagnon. Le logement est agréable, spacieux, lumineux et les chaises de jardin sont agréables aux beaux jours. Un endroit bien sympathique à recommander. La ligne de tramway desservant le centre d'Anvers est proche du logement. Pour les amateurs de marche à pied, compter 3 kms pour rejoindre le centre-ville.
We had a great weekend at Leens apartment!

Great place to stay at, especially in summer ! Very bright and quiet place, we could enjoy the private garden too which is just magic for breakfast or diner outside.
Leen and her husband were really nice and helpful with good advice to discover the city.

We hebben een heerlijk verblijf bij Leen gehad. De studio is een oase van rust in een levendige wijk. We hebben, al lopende, heel veel kunnen zien van Antwerpen en dan was het fijn om weer 'thuis' te komen in de ruime en sfeervolle studio.
A great studio, ideal for exploring the multicultural environment of Antwerp in a bright, comfy and arty appartment!

Nous avons passé un séjour très agréable dans ce chouette studio qui donne sur une cour-jardin partagée avec d'autres ateliers d'artistes. C'est très lumineux, propre et confortable, avec beaucoup de charme, proche des transports et du centre d'Anvers, et Leen & Roel nous avaient laissé toutes les informations, cartes et plans utiles pour nous repérer dans la belle ville d'Anvers. Nous reviendrons avec plaisir !
Gute Lage, ruhig und trotzdem mit der Tram in ein paar Minuten in der Stadt. Die Wohnung bietet alles was man braucht und die Gastgeber waren super freundlich. Kann man nur empfehlen:)

We hebben vooral erg genoten van de rust op deze locatie in de luwte van de binnenstad. Je kunt in deze ruimtelijke artistieke woning echt ontspannen na een intensief dagje Antwerpen Centraal. Vooral ook de mogelijkheid gebruik te maken van de groene (tuin) binnenplaats was een aangename bijkomstigheid.
A 10 minutes du TRIX, appart parfait, très lumineux !

Excellent séjour chez Leen & logement très agréable !!
On garde l'adresse pour notre prochain séjour.
Merci Leen !

Wir verbrachten ein paar wunderschöne Tage bei Leen und Ihrem Mann.
Sie waren sehr nette Gastgeber.
Das Apartment liegt ruhig in einem Hinterhof, man ist aber trotzdem schnell in der Innenstadt.
Wir hatte alles was wir benötigten.
Alles war super sauber und top in Ordnung.
Gerne wieder! :)

Wat een heerlijke ruimte is dit! En wat een sympathieke mensen zijn Leen en Roel. Na een warm welkom en goede tips voor de omgeving van Roel kon ons feestje beginnen. We hebben ons een paar dagen heel erg thuis gevoeld in de kamer en ook in het dorpse Borgerhout en omgeving. Het stadscentrum van Antwerpen hebben we overgeslagen, we hebben vooral onbekend terrein verkend. De buurt is gezellig en levendig en alle voorzieningen liggen om de hoek. De loft zelf is van alle gemakken voorzien, heeft een goed geoutilleerde keuken en vooral ook een echt goede slaapbank (zelfs voor iemand met ernstige rugklachten comfortabel). Alles was brandschoon. Van harte aanbevolen!

It was a very nice stay in a creative authentic apartment. Me and my boyfriend enjoyed a lot to spend time there, especially in the morning, when open the big windows letting a lot of light coming in while listening wonderful music played on real old style vinyl player. Flat was very clean, warm and equipped with everything what is required. Flexible check in an check out. Good communication. We even hat a small guide through sound studio :) We wish all the best and hope to come back again very soon. Yulia & JC

Wir haben unseren Aufenthalt sehr genossen. Der Hinterhof hat eine tolle Atmosphäre und ist sehr ruhig. Das Atelier ist geräumig, hat große Fenster ist mit allem Nötigen ausgestattet und macht einfach gute Laune. Uns hat auch das nicht touristische Stadtviertel Borgerhout sehr gut gefallen. Um die Ecke gibt es viele kleine Lebensmittelläden und auch Tram und Bus sind gut zu erreichen. Es sind nur ein paar Stopps bis zur Innenstadt. Leen und Roel geben gute Tipps und die Kommunikation lief reibungslos. Danke für die schönen Tage bei euch. Wir kommen gerne wieder.
Leen's place was great.
Sehr nette Gastgeberin, gute, ruhige Lage ca. 2-3 km vom Zentrum entfernt und tolle Tips von Leen.

The loft is very stylish and roomy. The location was absolutely phenomenal: secluded and sheltered away from the street, it is extremely peaceful compared to the hustle and bustle of the city. Very close to public transport and just about everything else, we couldn't really ask for much of anything more!
房东非常热情，天气太热还专门买了新风扇。房子很干净，离景点很近。

It was great! They were really hospitable, and gave us a lot of informations to enjoy the city. There   were also interesting vinyl records to listen in the free time. The place is beautiful, with a small private garden. It is also near to the center (20min by feet) and well linked with public transports.

Leen was super nice and flexible. The Apartment is nearly perfect, i loved the style! There's everything you need: wifi, tea, coffee, towels, soap etc.
I would absolutely recommend this Apartment!!
The place is beautiful and calm. Leen and her family were very welcoming. We had a great stay in Antwerp.
Top !
Clean, big, confortable. 10/10

Everything was perfect, the place was exactly like we expected it to be. Leen's husband gave us a great introduction and many tips where we could go in Antwerp. The location of the Studio was also great, we could get everywhere easily. Check-In and Check-Out was really flexible which was perfect for our quite spontaneous trip. Me and my friends would 100% recommend!

Agréable logement, atypique, clair et bien situé à Anvers.
Cadre sympathique.
A recommander

Leen's place is clean and quiet studio with lots of space, air and light. It was perfect for us and had everything we needed.

Really awesome space with excellent kitchen. Cool part of town, but a fair way away from the centre. Easy to get to with public transport though. The record player is a nice touch. Would stay here again.
Sfeervol en comfortabel appartement op uitstekende locatie, zeer vriendelijk ontvangen - een aanrader!
We had a great stay!
Amazing outdoor space. It’s quiet and peaceful even thought it’s placed close to a busy street. The kitchen it’s well equipped.
Very unique place, great location with Tram and Metro very close. Leen is a great host and is very engaged to offer a great time in Antwerp.
Spacious place for 3 in an artsy backyard. We enjoyed it a lot.

Super goede ervaring gehad! We werden vriendelijk ontvangen door de moeder van Dries. We voelden ons meteen thuis. We kregen zowel het nummer van Dries als zijn moeder en toen we de Wifi niet snapte werden we meteen geholpen.
Het appartement was precies zoals op de foto's: ruim, netjes en mooi. Op 1 minuut loop afstand van de tramhalte en als je zin hebt in een wandeling binnen 15/20 minuutjes op de oude markt. Ook in de buurt zitten leuke lunch en eettentjes!
Een echte aanrader voor een leuke en fijne tijd in Antwerpen!
Fraai appartement op prima locatie. Ontvangst door Dries zeer hartelijk. Ideaal voor verblijf voor aantal dagen in deze aangename stad !

Nous avons été parfaitement bien reçu et Dries s'est rendu disponible dès notre arrivée pourtant retardée par les embouteillages.
Le quartier est idéalement situé et l'appartement très spacieux et confortable .
Je conseille cet appartement afin de découvrir la jolie ville d'Anvers.
Très bonne continuation à Dries
Great spacious cleanly place with nice location but no washer even tho it's listed. Everything else was amazing
