The apartment is even more comfortable and modern than the the pictures, well-arranged and spacious. Above all, the location is perfect and everything to do in Antwerp is walking-distance. Thanks again Dries, looking forward to come again !

Dries's apartment is amazing. Recently renovated with great open spaces. Located not to far from Antwerp central station and in a very quiet and safe neighbourhood.

The apartment is very clean and warm. I would definitely recommend this place to my friends.

Dries is friendly and prompt with his communication. The perfect host!

Thanks alot.

Nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Anvers.
L'appartement de Dries est très confortable, calme et lumineux.

Stayed at the apartment with two friends while checking out the city of Antwerp and it was absolutely perfect! Lovely apartment, reasonable pricing and great location. Would definitely recommend this to anyone who plans on going to Antwerp for a few days :)
Eine sehr schöne, helle und super gelegene Wohnung.

Het was een fijne en vlotte aankomst. Het appartement is fraai ingericht zoals op de foto's te zien is. Mooie ruime badkamer en slaapkamer.
Ligging aan een rustige zijstraat van een grotere levendige straat met trams richting het centrum. Nabij een fijn Stadspark met recreatiemogelijkheden.
Mooi appartement op zo'n 10 minuten lopen van het centrum
Ik en mijn vriendinnen hebben een heerlijke 5 dagen in Antwerpen gehad, mede door het appartement van Dries! Schoon, ruim en we voelden ons gelijk op ons gemak!! Zeker een aanrader.
Heerlijk appartement op een fijne plek in Antwerpen. Gastvrije en flexibele gastheer. Superbedankt, Dries!
Leuk appartement dicht bij het centrum van Antwerpen. Heerlijk weekend gehad in het appartement van Dries!

Goede ontvangst, mooi appartement, compleet met volledige keuken en ruime badkamer. Bedden waren netjes opgemaakt.
Al met al zeer positieve ervaring!

We spent a week-end in Antwerp at Dries' place and it went super well. Dries' place is warm, cosy and comfortable. It's actually even nicer than on the pics.
We were three and the extra bed was comfortable. We had everything we needed for a weekend and even more. It is not in the center but Antwerp can be explored almost entirely by foot. Otherwise there's a tram very close to the flat to get to the center. I highly recommend this flat and would be happy to go back.
Fijn plekje om een paar dagen te zijn in Antwerpen!

Very comfortable apartment, instant at-home feel, in a great location for all kinds of visits to Antwerp. On a quiet street easily accessible to and from various parts of the city (everything walking distance for those who don't mind walking 10-20 minutes to things), around the corner from public transportation and neighborhood amenities. The neighborhood itself is scenic and pleasant. Walking distance from the Central Station (depending on your luggage situation of course). I would recommend it whether you are a couple on a getaway to Antwerp, or traveling with kids - mine didn't want to leave! - or any situation in between.

We had a fantastic time in Antwerp. The apartment is situated within an easy walk of the city centre, bars and restaurants. At the same time the street is very quiet. Dries made us feel welcome from the moment we walked in and the apartment was cozy and comfortable. We would be very happy to stay here again and would definitely recommend the place.

Dries appartment is very well located and beautifully decorated. We felt at home there. Dries has been very kind and helpful. He also got us a cradle for our baby! Thank you so much for everything. We look forward to come back soon

Great apartment, served three of us really well. Was very central we walked everywhere but there were trams running close by as well. It was a nice neighbourhood everyone was very friendly. Antwerp is a really lovely city we had a great time.
We had a great time at Dries's flat. The flat is practical and well equipped and the host is friendly

Schoon, ruim appartement. Communicatie met Dries verliep vlekkeloos. Centrum op loopafstand en de tram stopt voor de deur. Als ik een minpuntje zou moeten noemen is het de gehorigheid van het huis (als er iemand op de trap loopt is dat vrij goed hoorbaar), gelukkig zijn het rustige buren in een rustige buurt.
Tout était parfait. L'appartement correspond à la description. Dries s'est montré discret tout en étant disponible  Une adresse que nous recommandons .
Very lovely place to stay, host is friendly as well
Cosy apartment in a beautiful city. We stayed 4 nights and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Communication with Dries was easy and fast.
Great apartment! Very bright and airy and in a great location. Dries and his mother were great hosts, who helpfully let us check in early. We would definitely recommend this place.

Stayed here for 2 nights with mates, the apartment was lovely, very clean & tidy. Had everything you need, walking distance from train station, easy enough to get the trams & taxis. Dries was easy to contact & helpful, would 100% recommend this if you're looking for a good apartment!
Mooi, leuk, schoon appartement op een top locatie in het centrum van Antwerpen! Aardige en vriendelijke gastheer!

Nice, tidy and quiet place in a good area of the city.
Great apartment and nice people.
Dries is very reliable and nice. His appartment is very comfortable (spacious, luminous, silent...) and it is well situated in Antwerp. Thanks again Dries ;-)
Cool space in quiet Jewish quarter. Can walk or bus to places easily. Host was very accommodating as well.

Eine schöne , gemütliche und helle Wohnung. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Küche war optimal ausgestattet, so daß wir gut kochen und gemütlich Essen konnten. Badezimmer sehr schön und groß. Die Wohnung war in einer ruhigen Wohngegend und in nächster Umgebung gab es gute Einkaufsmöglichkeiten für Lebensmittel. Gastgeber Dries war freundlich und sympathisch. Alles lief reibungslos und unkompliziert. Wir können die Wohnung absolut weiterempfehlen :)

Een héél mooie locatie, alles (winkelstraat, leuke kroegjes en bezienswaardigheden) op loopafstand. Dankzij Dries leuke kroegjes gevonden en hij is goed te bereiken wanneer nodig! Wij hebben een heerlijk weekend gehad.
Dries is a great host and the apartment was great. Easy and smooth checkin and checkout. The location is great and close to everything. Be happy to recommend Dries as a host

It is a great place. Photos are very accurate. Super clean, well decorated. Well located. Nearby train station (15 min walking distance) and city center (20-25 min walking distance from the cathedral). Nice bars and restaurants nearby. (I.e Barchel- perfect for breakfast and good coffee; Beni Falafel - best falafel in town; Goosens chocolate- among best chocolate shops; Lambik to eat with locals...). I would highly recommend it.
Great place! Lots of room and a beautiful one bedroom apartment. Right around the corner from the tram stop and only a 20 minute walk to the central train station. We loved it!
The flat was clean, spacious and in a quiet neighborhood. Dries was also very nice and helpful. Would gladly recommend this place !

Great stay in cosy & clean appartment,  walking distance from shops,  bars, resto's,  all major attractions bref anything you want! Nice & fast communication with owner Dries as well, I'd definitely book again!
Relaxed, fijne communicatie en heel behulpzaam. Aanrader

It's a beautiful apartment close to both the Centrum and Central station in a nice neighborhood and Dries was an excellent host, all of which made for an excellent stay at Antwerp.

Die Wohnung war so wie sie vorher beschrieben wurde und schön eingerichtet. Für drei Personen hatten wir viel Platz. Fried ist sehr kooperativ die Kommunikation mit ihm lief problemlos. Ich würde hier immer zurückkommen wollen.
Patrick
Great spot

Die Wohnung ist für zwei Erwachsene und einem Kleinkind gut, allerdings muss man, um zur Toilette zu gehen, immer durch das Schlafzimmer gehen und der Balkon ist eher ein kleiner Austritt hinter dem Badezimmer.
Top verblijf voor een weekendje Antwerpen.

Although I didn't meet Dries he was an excellent host, very good communication. His apartment is beautiful and spacious, and feels very homey. 15 minute walk from central station and tram stops just around the corner

We so loved our stay here. Stepping inside this beautiful apartment, we felt like we'd hit the jack pot and was a perfect escape. Just the right distance from the station and the city - one evening we decided to walk home instead of the bus/tram. Our favourite part was discovering Barchel - a cafe just up on the main street. Awesome breakfast and coffee - they even do a flat white. Next time im in Antwerp, I know where I want to stay. Thanks Dries! :D

Great apartment! Located very near from the train station (around 15minutes walking distance) and near supermarkets. The place was spacious and had everything we needed for three people. Dries responded to every question we had. Thank you!

Local agradável para passar alguns dias.

Super Wohnung...großzügig & gemütlich, alles da was man braucht :)
Wenn ich nochmal nach Antwerpen komme, dann sicher nochmal in dieser Wohnung.
Sehr zu empfehlen!

Great apartment, 15 mins walk from central station

safe and quiet.  washer and dryer very convenient.

Thank you Dries!!

The place was larger and better than I had expected. Quiet location close to where the fun areas of Antwerp are. Would stay again

Thanks for the visit Dries and I really loved your comfy bed and lounge!!
This is a beautiful large apartment in a central area of Antwerp. We enjoyed the local restaurant Lambik and walking to several other areas of Antwerp.

Easy getting in and easy getting out.

Staying at Dries’ apartment was a joy! The place is clean, in a quiet area, and really close to anything you would like to see. There is a book in the apartment with 500 unique places to see in Antwerpt, which you must read. It took us to some great places we wouldn’t have seen otherwise. Thanks Dries for a fantastic stay!
Très bel appartement. Dries est un hôte réactif et attentionné.

Dries heeft een mooi, net en ruim appartement dichtbij het centrum. Het is van alle gemakken voorzien en een uitstekende uitvalsbasis voor een leuk weekend Antwerpen.
Dries was a great host! Very reliable and happy to help. The place was clean and we had a great stay!
Nice location, really close to city centre. The room is really clean and cozy. We went with our 3-years-old daughter, Dries prepared a baby cot for us, really thoughtful.

Thanks for this beautiful and light apartment. The cleanliness and facilities is exceptional and we were thankful for the swift communication.

We'll happily hit Dries up should we ever return to Antwerp!

We found however that as we were on a middle floor in the building and there is no soundproofing, there was a lot of noise in the late evenings from neighbours.  Conversations, children crying and heavy footsteps could keep us awake until well after midnight.  During our second week we got earplugs, and were then able to settle down when we wanted.  Apart from this, which was outside our landlord's control, we found the flat and our host to be excellent.
We had a great stay at Dries's  apartment. The space is modern and contemporary and in a quiet part of Antwerp, only 20 minutes walk to the central part of town. Would certainly stay again.
Dries is best to reach via sms or phone...make sure you got the right code for the key.

很不错的房间，安静的社区。不过需要提行李走两层楼的楼梯，离公交车站有点距离，需要步行至少七八分钟才能到最近的公交站。
因为卫生间在卧室里面，所以比较适合情侣或者夫妻入住。

Great apartment. Good location. Close to public transport, apartment has all the things you need.

Tolles Apartment, mit Stil und Geschmack eingerichtet und viel Altbau-Flair.

Dries was an excellent host who communicated quickly with us and was responsive to our concerns.

We would definitely stay there again if we were to return to Antwerp.
Prima , ruim en rustig apartement. Gunstig gelegen. Fijne  plek voor een weekendje Antwerpen.
Clean, cos and nice appartment with a small-minded balcony and quiete  neighbourhood. I can totally recommend it.
The best apartment ever if staying in Antwerp. The apartment is massive, clean and spacious. The location of the apartment is very peaceful. Will definitely stay here again when i am next in Antwerp.

We liked to stay in a  styled and good locatated app. with a very friendly owner !!!
Lovey spacious flat, we had a great time after booking it at very short notice. The place was sparkling clean, check in was very easy. The area was very nice and quiet. Would recommend

Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt in Antwerpen. Wir haben verschiedene Städte in Belgien angeschaut und Antwerpen war unser Ausgangspunkt. Die Lage des Appartements ist zentral, nur zwei Stationen bis ins Zentrum. Die Unterkunft ist prima. Es ist alles vorhanden, was man braucht. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Läden, Restaurants... alles per Fuß schnell zu erreichen. Parken kein Problem. Man kann in der Straße oder Nebenstraßen sicher parken. Netter Kontakt mit Dries und seiner Mama. Schnelle Antworten per Mail.
Very good apartment and very friendly host!

Appartement grand, clair, calme et très agréable. Très bien situé, le centre et tous les quartiers intéressants sont accessibles à pied, marché et magasins alimentaires à proximité.
Nous étions très contents de notre séjour chez Dries et nous recommandons cet appartement.

The apartment was really clean and very spacious. Great location from where you can explore the city on foot.
Driess is a Great host and provides everything that you need in the apartment. Very easy self check-in. I would definitely recommend Driess’ apartment to explore the city of Antwerp.
Heel fijn appartement op een fijne lokatie. Prima om Antwerpen te verkennen!

Prettige en ruime B&B op loopafstand van het centrum. Communicatie met Dries verliep soepel en snel. Wij waren erg blij dat Dries ons wilde ontvangen, want we hebben kortdag gereserveerd.  Een pluspunt is dat de keuken met goede pannen en voldoende servies is ingericht (dat is in onze ervaring lang niet altijd het geval bij B&B's). Daardoor konden we, ondanks de vele leuke eetgelegenheden in Antwerpen, ook prima thuis een maaltje klaarmaken. Als ik dan toch een verbeterpunt moet noemen: de badkamer was netjes, maar in het toilet en de gootstenen zat een soort aanslag. Niet vies, maar het was prettiger geweest als dit er spik-en-span had uitgezien.
Good location, lovely and spacious flat. Make sure you go to Beni Falafel down the road!
Mooi appartement op een mooi, centraal gelegen plek. Al twee keer met veel plezier verbleven.
Nice spatious appartment. Quiet neighborhood, not to far from center of the city.
We would definitely stay here again! Highly recommend!

Heel mooi appartement, op zo’n 20 minuten lopen van het centrum. Genoten van ons weekend weg! Alle voorzieningen aanwezig, en het is een hele fijne plek om even bij te komen. Gelegen in een rustige straat, je hebt amper door dat je in de stad zit. Het enige gekke is de voordeur, die je achter je op slot moet draaien (dit wisten we de eerste avond nog niet)

Great trip to Antwerp. The apartment was so spacious and has all the amenities you could want. Very quiet  and walking distance to the railway station and old town. Heaps to do in Antwerp.  Definitely recommend.
Lovely flat and great location! Highly recommended! Dries is very reliable and always give us quick response. We would love to stay his flat again if we come back to Antwerp!
Nice apartment in a quiet neighborhood, owned by a very kind and available host. Thanks again!

Quiet neighbourhood but walking distance to restaurants and city park. Spacious apartment - plenty of room if you're staying in Antwerp for longer than a few days. Dries is on site and always available if you need anything.
L appartamento è ben posizionato, spazioso e funzionale! Dries è stato preciso, ci ha dato indicazioni e ci ha permesso di godere al meglio del viaggio!
leuk appartement in mooie stad

It was a really pleasant time I’ve spent in Dries’ house. The apartment is bigger than what it looks like in the photos and it is very well located. Just to consider, you must be quiet to avoid neighbors’ complains. But I had no issue at all as I was on business trip. I’ll come back surely.
Un lloc tranquil i agradable,un apartament molt maco,amb un llit de matrimoni molt comode,un bany enorme i a 5-10min a peu de l’estacio central.

The apartment is clean and spacious and is ideally located between the central station and the old town. It’s incredibly easy to check in and out and Dries is a very responsive host. Great value for money!

I stayed in this apartment for one month and I didn't really want to leave. I felt great there. Dries is very nice host, always helpful. Location is also very good in quit neighbourhood, aprox. 15min in walking distance from a city centre. Thank you, Dries!
Byli jsme velmi spokojeni. S Dries byla výborná komunikace i na nestandardních záležitostech. Ubytování čisté, moderní, vzdušné  doporučujeme

The apartment was lovely and spacious. There were nice cafes in the vicinity.

Dries was also responsive to our questions during our stay.
Zeer net en ruim appartement op een mooie locatie. Communicatie met de verhuurder en het inchecken verliepen heel soepel.
The communication with Dries was very uncomplicated and we had a very pleasant stay at his place. The appartement looks cool and cozy. Definitely a recommendation!
Mooie ruimte, nette woning . Centrum op loopafstand ongeveer 10 minuten lopen.
Nice apartment in central Antwerpen, everythin in walking range. We had a nice weekend without any problems! I can only recommend this place to anyone.
Bien ubicado
Fijne uitvalsbasis voor het verkennen van Antwerpen. Genoten van het stadspark om de hoek. Wel gehorige etages, echter de ruimte, voorzieningen en gastheerschap maken dat meer dan goed.
We had a great stay at Drie’s place! It was super clean and had everything we needed for our stay. The layout was also great and spacious!

The Owner was very friendly and helpful.
He helped us to find some good Restaurants to eat and nice places to Dance and Party.
I would take this flat again. It was great. :)
Wir hatten einen schönen Aufenthalt in Antwerpen
Good for a short stay but some bits of description were inaccurate. Also the washroom had no locking mechanism/latch in the door. So it can be a problem if multiple people stay.
Great appartment. Easy to reach with public transport.
Nice, quiet area to stay only 20 minutes walk from city centre. Clean, tidy and spacious with good communication and helpful tips from Dries.
Top Location and nice Apartment!
The apartment is perfectly located to discover Antwerp. It is very quiet and well equipped. Dries is a caring host.

Good base for exploring all parts of Antwerp. Best for two people as the sofabed is not the most comfortable but okay for a few nights. Must be able to handle the stairs. Cool spacious interiors and everything you could want for amenities, including cooking facilities. Dries is a brilliant host and quick to respond to requests.
Appartment entsprach unseren Erwartungen, gut gelegen, ruhig und trotzdem zentral, gute Austattung. Wir werden wieder kommen
A nice and cosy flat in a quiet place, 15 minutes far from the town center. A place to remember

Vous avez trouvé l'offre de Dries pour visiter la ville et d'autres destinations proches, alors allez-y les yeux fermés. Un garçon très sympa ponctuel. Il met à disposition un appartement très agréable, douillet et fin prêt pour vous recevoir.
Merci Dries, nous avons encore pas mal de choses à voir en Belgique et reviendrons vers toi pour nous poser. Richard Nath et Juliette (qui a aussi adoré la déco)

Dries,

Dries’ s apartment is really nice and pleasant.
The location was good and we were able to visit the city on foot.

I recommend!
We had a lovely stay! Great spacious apartment has everything you need and is on walking distance from city centre.

This was an absolutely terrible experience.
First of all, when I arrived the host hadn’t even cleaned the place from the previous guests. The whole place was messy and smelled awful. Acoid it like the plague not worth it

Localisation idéale : quartier calme et relativement proche du centre-ville à pied.
Appartement bien équipé et agréable.

Quiet apartment with good tram access.
prima appartement, goede locatie, niet ver van het centrum, rustige straat
Sparklingly clean, fabulous flat in central Antwerp. Dries was an amazing host and communication was extremely easy with him. One of the best Airbnb I've been to

L’appartement de Dries est conforme à son descriptif. Il est spacieux et très bien équipé.

Il est dans un quartier idéalement placé avec des trames à quelques minutes de son appartement.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour en famille et nous gardons cette adresse pour y retourner prochainement.

Excelente, recomiendo este alojamiento es increíble, cómodo tiene cerca supermercado cerca, el tram te deja casi en la puerta, el centro está a minutos tanto sea caminando que con medios. Volvería seguro.

Ein schönes, modernes und mit allem Equipment eingerichtetes Apartment, mit bequemen Betten. Die Lage in einem ruhigen, aber zentru (Hidden by Airbnb) ahen Viertel ist klasse. Ein geniales Frühstückscafé mit Bäckerei (ab 7 bzw. 8 Uhr geöffnet) liegt 5min entfernt. Die Anreise mit dem Auto und bezahlbares Parken in der Umgebung war problemlos. Zu Fuß oder mit der Straßenbahn ist die Innenstadt, aber auch z.B. die Koninck-Brauerei schnell zu erreichen. Dries ist ein toller Gastgeber, die Kommunikation war direkt und zielführend. Wir kommen gerne wieder!

A beautiful place to stay, a great location not far from the centre (a simple 20 minute walk) with lots of amenities near by. Dries is a wonderful host with great communication speed and understanding.
Die Wohnung ist gut ausgestattet mit einem großen Bad. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Innenstadt ist sehr gut fußläufig erreichbar (15-20 min zum Hauptbahnhof).

Doporučuji ten skvělý a stylový byt. Obrovský, světlý prostor.
Pohodlná komunikace s Dries.
Měli jsme hezké Vánoce.

Děkuji, Dries.

Eine sehr schöne Wohnung, ein sehr gutes Bett und Badezimmer, viel Platz in den Schränken und Schubladen. Auch im Wohnraum war alles sehr bequem und funktioniert gut. Die Geschirr-/Kochaustattung ist etwas spartanisch, aber Dries kann "aushelfen", wenn etwas zusätzliches gebraucht wird (z.B. Toaster). TV ist nicht digital, daher nur einheimische Sender, keine Radioprogramme.
Die Gegend ist ruhig und doch zentral. Kurze Wege zu Supermarkt und Straßenbahn. Auch zu Fuß ist man schnell in der historischen Altstadt.
Dries ist ein toller Gastgeber :)
Definitely I recommend Apartment of Dries, for the good and friendly help and very good services.

Les points forts selon nous: la communication avec Dries, la localisation très proche du centre, le bon rapport qualité prix pour Anvers. Avec deux ados, on a passé quatre jours pleins avec des visites au MAS, musée Red Star line, Plantin Moretus, ballades, le Zoo, les diamantaires...
We enjoyed to stay in family at this appartement very  well equiped, quiet and well located.

Wir hatten eine tolle Zeit in der Wohnung. Sie ist sehr schick eingerichtet und man hat sich sehr wohl gefühlt. Der Check in war super unkompliziert, auch der Check out. Dries war sehr schnell erreichbar und hat viele Tipps gegeben. Alles in allem sehr zufrieden. Die Bahnhaltestelle ist 100m von der Wohnung entfernt.
Great place to stay. Clean and comfortable
Perfect hospitality. Lovely apartment owner and helps with anything and at any time. Excellent apartment cleanliness and location.
Dries is an amazing host and the apartment is cozy and well located. Everything was great!
Nice apartment as advertised.  Good location close to the park and Antwerp Centraal.  Dries was very easy to deal with.  Would recommend this apartment.

Wonderful apartment in a good neighbourhood with all the necessary shops in the area. The check-in was easy enough via a self service lock system. The apartment is spacious and clean and has everything you need for a quick stop in Antwerpen.
Nice apartment and good host!
He is enough helpfull and kind person.
Well equipped studio, very ideal location close to everything!
The Flat is well located and very beautiful. We had everything we needed!
Very nice, cozy and spacious apartment to stay in Antwerpen. Nice neighborhood. About 20 minutes walking to the city centre. I loved it!
Nice and easy stay, thank you!

Had great time at Leen's place.
Close to the center, nice place, helped when needed.
Recommended.
Fijne host, goed contact en een top accomodatie. Locatie was ook prima, ongeveer 20 minuutjes lopen van het centrum en centraal station. Helemaal perfect voor een weekendje weg :)

Great apartment! Very large, beautifully equipped and very clean! Dear Vera, thank you very much! We will come back.
Great place, great host, great location. Definitely a recommendation.

Spacious and very clean apartment with artistic and quirky decor. Yet it was very homey. The shower's hot water was a bit wonky but she is very attentive and is looking to fix it. Also very flexible with the check in time as we were not able to confirm our exact arrival time yet she waited for us.  Really appreciate it her hospitality!
Ein wirklich tolles Apartment! Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt, alles war super sauber und für uns vorbereitet. Der Kontakt zu Vera war auch klasse! Viele Grüße und hoffentlich bis im nächsten Jahr!
Nice apartment, close to tram which goes straight into Antwerp. Easy check in and check out. Vera responded quickly to one small issue. Recommend it as good place to stay if visiting Antwerp.
VP was lovely to deal with, house was very quirky

Nous avons passé trois nuits dans ce bel appartement très joliment décoré, bien équipé, et bien insonorisé, propreté parfaite.
Les escaliers sont un peu raides, et c'est un deuxième étage. Nous les déconseillerions à des personnes âgées.
Sinon tout est parfait.
El apartamento es muy agradable y comfortable, volveria
Nice a beautiful place to live...

The room is truly astonishing and far beyond our expectations. It's way bigger than we originally thought it would be. The house is a beautiful historical building located in a good area. Bjorn and Silke are nice and kind hosts. They were very flexible with the time of our arrival (which was quite late).
Nice, central and well located to access public transports.

For us was the stay at Bjorn and Silke very nice typical stylish belgian living. You live with them, but at your own Floor with your own bathroom.  You can feel the inland belgian atmosphere in the house and enjoy it. The hosts are very friendly and helpful. The Position of the house is 2 stops from the City centre in a peaceful jewish quarter.

Bjorn & Silke are both excellent hosts with a lovely pied-a-terre in a peaceful and central part of town. The studio itself has plenty of privacy, thoughtful touches and a lot of comfort. To add to it, the public spaces in the house are very interesting architecturally and of high spec, meaning you can cook and/or eat in style! Furthermore, Bjorn & Silke are both very friendly, interesting and respectful hosts, who made my stay extremely easy.
Ideal for anyone travelling alone or in a couple, short, medium or long stay.
Thanks both and helpfully see you again soon!

Great Hosts and a very good room in a nice house. The location is perfect because its easy to get there by public transportation and has a parking spot so you can travel by car too. Honestly I have nothing bad to tell about it.

Wij hebben genoten van het verblijf bij Björn en Silke. De kamer en het huis waren erg mooi en in antieke style. Het was flexibel met in en uitchecken. Bedankt, Bjorn en Silke voor jullie gastvrijheid, gezellige gesprekken en toffe tips, want hier hebben wij veel aan gehad. We raden deze mooie ruimte aan en zouden er zo weer verblijven!

Bjorn and Silke’s house is absolutely gorgeous! The room was way bigger than we thought from the pictures and was really nice and clean. The tram stop was literally around the corner. Also Silke was so nice to help us around with some tips for nice museums.

We had an amazing time here, the location is just perfect, for us everything was within walking distance. The room is great, we had nice weather so we were lucky to enjoy the rooftop terrace. The only thing that was different then we expected was the bathroom. It is a shower and toilet in the same area. Therefore everything will be wet when you shower and you have to leave your dry towel and clothes in the communal hallway. Not a problem for us but maybe something to know when you book. I would be happy to book again when staying in Antwerp.

Very nice, clean and cosy place with some stylish equipment. We had the whole upper floor for us which gave us enough privacy. There was also some tea and water in our room, which was very nice. The communication was easy and the owners are also very nice people and we even received some tips where to go and what to do. The only complain would be about the bathroom which is very small and once you shower everything is wet. Otherwise it was perfect.

I highly recommend everyone to visit Antwerp and stay in Bjorn and Silke's home! It is a house with stylish Belgian atmosphere. Big kitchen with wooden furniture and all the necessary to cook, spacious and bright room and the bed under the roof!!! Also, the roof is available to spent nice evenings there! Hosts are sociable and nice persons, they did all to make our stay great!

Bedankt voor de goede zorgen en het fijne verblijf! Wij gaan dit zeker onthouden en komen graag nog eens terug bij jullie. Een goude locatie en een aanrader voor iedereen!

Liefs Bart en Didi
Ideaal gelegen locatie voor bezoek aan The Jane en de stad Antwerpen. Rustige buurt met alles op loopafstand. Goede voorzieningen in de kamer.
Super verblijf in het centrum van antwerpen, super lekker bed, en knusse inrichting. Het kleine dakterras is een leuke extra.
Nice Housing and neighbourhood. 15 min walk to the city. Very friendly. Would stay there again
ﾄﾗﾑの駅からもさほど遠くなく静かな住宅街。ﾎｽﾄのｾﾝｽの良さがわかる素敵なｲﾝﾃﾘｱ。ﾄｲﾚとｼｬﾜｰは専用で使わせていただけたし冷蔵庫も貸していただけ快適に過ごすことが出来ました。またｱﾝﾄﾜｰﾌﾟへ行ったら是非泊まりたいお宅です。
The room was fine and spacious. The bathroom was as small as indicated. The kitchen was really dirty. The location of the room was perfect.
Genoten van de reis!

Merci Bjorn et Silke pour votre accueil !
Très bon logement pour un séjour rapide sur Anvers.
Nice and clean place, everything was perfect! Bjorn is kind and helpful, and his house is in a good location for visit Antwerp and for reach easily the railway station.

What we really liked, was the privacy of the room. You have the floor to yourself. It is neat, cozy and clean. Very friendly homeowner. Beautiful house.
Keep in mind that the old centre is 30 minutes away by foot. Consider the velo bikes! We were happy to have stayed here!

Bjorn, Thanks a lot!! The place is very beautiful and with privacy. It’s like a beautiful loft in the house, super cozy, clean and the location is good, about 15 minutes walking from the Central Station.
I would definitely recommend this b&b.

Top kamer, mooi interieur en comfortabel verblijf. Björn is erg vriendelijk en antwoordt snel. Bovendien is er een handige tramverbinding naar het centrum om de hoek. Al met al zeker een aanrader voor wanneer je een paar daagjes Antwerpen wilt verkennen.
Cosy flat near city center! Clean and stylish! very nice host.

De ruimte is heerlijk groot: beneden een zitje en meer dan genoeg ruimte voor je spullen, waterkokertje, bekers en koffie en thee staan klaar. De badkamer is inderdaad wat klein, maar je kunt prima douchen en het is niet moeilijk om het vloertje daarna even droog te trekken. De vide, waar het bed staat, is heel ruim. Je kunt fijn buiten zitten, heel vrij op het dakterrasje. We hebben veel gebruik gemaakt van de stadsfietsen die je een straatje verder voor 4 euro per dag uit de stalling kunt halen. Al met al: zeer aan te raden!
Very nice and cosy place, the chairs on the roof are a nice touch. A great Home and a lovely host, overall a great experience!

Bjorn was a super responsive host. Very easy to communicate with. His cat, Brutus, is super gentle, slightly shy and won't disturb you.

Location: Great! Located 2 stops from the central train station. It was about a 2-3 minute walk to the tram stop.

Room: Was the place value for money? Sure. Our room was clean as was the bathroom. Do note that the bathroom is located just outside / next to the bedroom. The bedroom itself is akin to a loft-style unit. Do note that it's also three flights of stairs up to the room (not including the stairs in the room itself).
Very nice stay, Bjorn is welcoming and the room was perfectly clean.

La casa es realmente muy bonita. TIenes mucho espacio privado, Bjorn te permite usar la cocina que también es muy bonita y es muy relajado. Tiene un gato muy bonito que no molesta para nada. Es verdad que el baño es pequeño pero funcional, el agua viene bien caliente. Lo recomiendo totalmente.
This beautiful quirky house is comfortable and conveniently located. The stairs are a little challenging but the climb is well worth it; the bedroom at the top is stunning.

If you are not afraid of an original setting, this is an excellent challenge.
Good public transportation, close to town center, coffee&tea available on the room,
good comfortable bed with a view. You can use the common kitchen & fridge, if you want to. Tiny bathroom and shower in one. The host is nice and discrete.

Prima, schoon appartement, goede ligging t.o.v. centrum en station. Bjorn was erg snel en helder in zijn communicatie en heeft ons voorzien van waardevolle tips. Raad hem als verhuurder en zijn ruimte van harte aan. De badkamer is zoals anderen aangeven klein, maar prima voor een kort verblijf. De rest is ruim en knus door de stijlvolle inrichting. Bedankt Bjorn!
Prima ruimte , simpel maar doeltreffend . Björn heel relaxed.
Тихое и спокойное место для сна, в 20 минутах прогулки от центра. Очень большие 2-этажные аппартаменты. личная небольшая ванная комната. Оборудованна общая кухня и очень приятное гостеприимство!

Bjorn’s place was great. The loft was pretty neat, and we liked the outdoor space - beautiful view! We never actually met Bjorn as our schedules were off, but his friend greeted us when we arrived and she was very friendly and acquainted us with the space. The tiny bathroom takes a bit of getting used to but does the job. Thanks for letting us stay!

Mooi, knus en fijn appartement om een paar daagjes in Antwerpen te vertoeven. Het verblijf was beter dan verwacht en de communicatie verliep vlot. We komen hier zeker terug! (p.s. de kat Brutus is ontzettend lief en knuffelig)

We had a great time, Bjorn is a super nice and friendly host and the place is also amazing. It's practically like having your own private flat. The center is about a 30min walk away, but you can also take public transportation which is very close (we just chose to walk instead). We would definitely stay there again if we're ever back in Antwerp.
Super Airbnb! Fijne locatie, mooie kamer met fijn bed en Bjorn is erg gastvrij. We voelden ons op ons gemak en hebben genoten van Antwerpen. Aanrader!

Bjorn is a great host, who (despite being busy in his work) makes time for his guests. His house is very unique and beautiful. Shared places were unfortunately not always entirely tidy. The house is slightly on the fringes of Central Antwerp, but well connected with public transport. It was quite hard to find a parking space during the week.
Ruim, stijlvol en net appartement. Bjorn is gastvrij, flexibel en communiceert goed. Prijs kwaliteit verhouding is uitstekend, een aanrader.

Een geweldige kamer, knus, en door de slaapkamer boven een ideale plek om ook even te zitten. Goede prijs/kwaliteit verhouding. Verder is de stad ideaal bereikbaar met de fiets. De gastvrijheid van Björn is geweldig. Kortom geweldig!
We had a great stay in a great place, Bjorn is a really nice host. 10/10 would recommend!

Bjorn is a very friendly and hospitable host. The room was exactly as described and even almost like a whole flat with its two floors and the own bathroom. After we checked out, Bjorn let us leave the luggage in his apartment till our departure, so we could spend the day without it, which was very nice. His cat Brutus was very cute and we were happy every time it paid us a visit.

Great place to stay in antwerp, very close to everything so you can walk everywhere.
Bjorn was there as we arrived and as we left - super easy and friendly!

Die Wohnung ist korrekt beschrieben und hat einen besonderen Stil, der uns gut Gefiel. Wir hatten ein paar nette Tage in einer besonderen Gegend von Antwerpen. Bjorn könnte uns fürs Wochenende eine parkgelegenheit besorgen. Ich denke, das kann in der Woche schwieriger werden. Daher nutzt die hervorragende Anbindung mit den Trams oder mehr ein Rad. Eine tolle Unterkunft.
rapport qualité prix correct accès facile et à  proximité du centre ville par tram et bus

Mooie ruime kamer met een zeer fijne locatie dichtbij het centrum. Bjorn is zeer gastvrij en helpt je graag. Het is een prachtig huis en alles is netjes en schoon. Zeker een aanrader voor wie Antwerpen wilt ontdekken!

Bjorn's place is amazing! You have basically an apartment for yourself as the bedroom is a gallery with a living room area. Bjorn left some chocolates for us in the room, that was an amazing thing as we arrived really hungry (plus Belgian chocolate is always a good thing). The house is great and the view from bedroom is really good, there is a small balcony for when the weather is good. About the bathroom it is exactly as you see in the pictures: practical, small but works. If you are little as me the toilet might be a bit tall.

Great place with very comfortable bed. I really like the design of the room as the loft made the place feel very big. It was close to the main tram and city bike rental stations. Overall, it was great!

Bjorn is really a great host, very friendly and communicative. The apartment is very beautiful with high ceilings and the room is very cosy. It’s close to the center and supermarkets in walking distance. Very quiet street so it was very nice to sleep.  Definitely recommended and I will book it again next time. Thanks Bjorn and greetings!
Bjorn is the perfect host all around and his place is very cozy and spacious. The location is as good as it gets in a quiet neighborhood. Will be back soon!
Fijn verblijf bij Björn in huis. Communicatie verliep soepel.
Mooie locatie in de Joodse wijk op maar 8 minuten steppen van het Centrum. Goed ontvangen door gastheer Bjorn.

We ad a very good experience at Bjorn's. We had some travel issues and turned up very late, so the option of being able to check-in ourselves was quite a relief.
The home is very calm and cosy and Bjorn is very welcoming and helpful. I love the cat Brutus who also lives there, he's very welcoming too :)

If you are looking for a unique, authentic and beautiful location to enjoy Antwerp from, look no further. This incredible studio style space was outstanding and the atmosphere it presented was worth everything.
Beautiful space to relax in. Easy check in with the use of a lock box. Very cute cat as well!
Mooie ruimte , ruim , met een klein dakterrasje waar je uitkijkt op de groene binnentuinen van antwerpen. Fijne rustige ligging , makkelijk tram naar centrum om de hoek , goed contact met verhuurder.
This is a very pleasant studio and a great location.

Bjorn’s place is amazing! My boyfriend and I stayed for a few days and loved it!
The house is sooo cool and the private space you have is like a little apartment. It’s super clean and really spacious. He is sooo accommodating and very nice. He responds immediately and provides all info well in advance of arrival which makes checking in perfect! It’s really close to the train station and perfectly located for exploring the city. If this place is available you don’t need to look any further, just book before it’s taken!

We had a great time in Bjorns room and some good conversations with ihm, too. He is a kind host. We also liked his cat Brutus. Thanks again for the delicious dessert you have made for us Bjorn:-) The metro is a 3 minutes Walk away, so you can drive easy to the center.

Wirklich eine sehr tolle Wohnung im jüdischen Viertel von Antwerpen. Wir sind zu Fuß in die Altstadt gelaufen, die Straßenbahn ist aber auch direkt um die Ecke.
Die Wohnung war sehr sauber und durch die Zweistöckigkeit und das eigene Bad wie ein kleines Apartment in Bjorns Haus. Sogar eine mini Dachterrasse ist direkt angeschlossen. Das Bad ist sehr klein, aber für einen kurzen Aufenthalt ausreichend. Die Küche im 1.OG konnte mitbenutzt werden.
Björn war ein sehr netter Gastgeber und stand mit guten Tipps jederzeit zur Verfügung. Wir würden bei unserem nächsten Antwerpenbesuch wieder diese Wohnung wählen.
We liked the ambience, especially the balkony and the bedroom.
Snelle communicatie, gemakkelijke toegang via sleutelkastje, ruime nette kamer. Leuk verblijf!
Great place. Lots of privacy. Very modern & clean. Absolutely loved that the bedroom opens up onto an open balcony area which overlooks a quaint city-living scene. Beautiful light!
A very nice flat and the room was great. We enjoyed every minute we spent there.

Honestly I can't say anything but a huge thank you for Bjorn. Probably the best Airbnb experience we've ever had. The two rooms are actually a bit bigger than on the pictures, the bed was really comfortable, the small balcony has a nice view, and in the end of the day even the small bathroom - as mentioned in the description - just did the job too; don't expect too much space there and please mind keeping your clothes/towels out whilst showering, but again, this wasn't a surprise at all to us.

Too bad we didn't meet Bjorn in person but the whole flat itself looked really cool and Brutus the cat is really friendly too.

10/10, highly recommended.
Fijne ruimte in een mooi pand!
Mooie ruimte in een stijlvol pand, niet te ver van het centrum en station. Pas op voor de stijle trap!

prima locatie. op paar min lopen is een metro die naar diamant. opera en groenplaat gaan. 3 plaatsen in t centrum. lopen naar centrum is 30 minuten. hygiëne is ok. bed slaapt echt prima! gastvrije gastheer. al met al prima overnachtingen gehad

Tolles Doppelgeschoss unterm Dach, wo es an nichts fehlt. Die ganze Wohnung von Bjorn ist sehr schön eingerichtet und sein Kater Brutus ist superflauschig und freut sich über jeden der ihn krault.
Die Kommunikation mit Bjorn ist reibungslos und sehr freundlich und er hilft auch gern mit Empfehlungen und Tip's weiter.
Uneingeschränkte Empfehlung und gerne wieder!

Bjorn’s house is atypical & really lovely, located in the genuine Diamant area of Antwerp (15/20min walk from the center).
The split level is big, super quiet and the bed is reaaaally comfortable.
The bathroom consists in a cabin integrating the shower + toilets, so it’s tiny but really clean so that wasn’t a problem for us.
Bjorn was really reactive, great communication.
We would recommend!
Mooie ruime kamer, alles was schoon en netjes. Bjorn heeft ons goed ontvangen en was erg behulpzaam. De communicatie van tevoren verliep super, waarbij we ook erg handige tips hebben gekregen.
Top service, mooie kamer, duidelijke en snelle communicatie, en we kregen onze privacy

We had a great stay in Bjorn's apartment and highly recommend for anyone visiting Antwerp. The room is very stylish and unusual with lots of character. It is approx 30mins walk to the centre of Antwerp and we walked there and back each day. In the evening we ate in a local square which Bjorn recommended, which was ideal as it's only 15mins away and quieter than the centre.

The room was very spacious. There are 2 floors: One to sit and relax, the other one with a nice big bed and a small rooftop terrace. I loved that a lot of light comes in, that there is a kitchen available and it's close to the 2 stations in Antwerp: Central station and Berchem station. The bathroom is rather small but definitely ok for just me.
Wunderschöne, außergewöhnliche Wohnung in toller Lage. Bjorn und sein Kater Brutus sind sehr nette Gastgeber. Wir würden definitiv wiederkommen!

Bjorn's place was more interesting and better equipped than we could have hoped for. The house itself is a true gem - great location, private garden, beautiful two-story room with a lovely view. I can confidently recommend his stay for future travellers. Garden and spacious rooms make it a pleasant stay even if the outside experiences are somewhat restricted due to the current coronavirus situation.

The place is precisely described. It is cozy and functional. We had a good time there. The only thing is that during your stay in the winter the room can be a bit cool. Bjorn is a really cool and helpful host.

Vlotte en snelle communicatie met handige tips voor een leuk verblijf! Een mooie, ruime kamer die heel netje was. Een rustige buurt op wandelafstand van het centrum en het Centraal Station en vlakbij het toffe Zurenborg.

De Airbnb is gevestigd in een heel tof pand! Bjorn was zeer open en gastvrij. De plaats van de Airbnb is super, tussen alle leuke buurtjes in. Alles wat je nodig hebt voor een leuk weekend in Antwerpen!
Was super plekje op leuke locatie!
Perfect, correct, leuke plek
Es war eine super schöne Zeit in Belgien. Wir werden sicherlich wiederkommen!

Sfeervolle, nette accommodatie in Antwerpen. Host was erg gastvrij en had een aantal goede tips. Huren van een fiets is handig, anders is het centrum ook goed bereikbaar met het ov. Voor de prijs is dit appartement zeker een aanrader!
Bjorn heeft een zeer fijne accommodatie het zag er zeer netjes en verzorgd uit. Ook is het een top locatie/verblijf en al helemaal voor de prijs!

Die Unterkunft von Bjorn ist etwas ganz besonderes und das Zimmer war schön eingerichtet, sauber und es war genügend Platz. Das Bad ist - wie angegeben - nicht groß und auch eher etwas speziell, aber für wenige Tage völlig ausreichend. Bjorn hat uns freundlich empfangen und war insgesamt sehr zuvorkommend, unkompliziert und hilfsbereit
Die innenstadt erreicht man zu Fuß innerhalb einer halben Stunde, es fahren aber auch Metros eine Straße weiter.

Great value for money place. The building is beautiful, the room and the small living room that is part of it are very spacious. The place is not far from the centre, the walk to the main sights is about 20 mins so if you like walking like I do that is the perfect place for you. Also super calm neighbourhood. Bjorn was a delight to communicate with. All super smooth and very caring.
Prettig huis en fijne host.
Charming place that is pretty well located. Bjorn is really easy to reach and communicated a lot. Very enjoyable stay
We hadden een erg fijn verblijf in de airbnb van Bjorn. De kamer was schoon en sfeervol ingericht. Locatie op loopafstand van centraal station en openbaar vervoer om de hoek. Zeker aan te raden!
Mooie kamer in een prachtig huis, precies zoals beschreven. Bjorn is gastvrij en communiceert duidelijk. Locatie in een rustige buurt op loopafstand van het centrum.

Staying at Bjorn's place was great!
Good location, clear communication, handy tips and a friendly and helpful guy.
The room was spacious, clean and cosy.

At arrival the host was present and greeted us in a friendly manner. We were able to check in without his help and he told us that if we needed anything we could always ask him.

When we got to the room there were a few cups, a bottle of water, two chocolates and towels. The bed was clean and the room looked clean as well. We did notice that the pictures of the room were a little better than the actual room. The lighting isn't very warm and there are some ventilation tubes on the wall. The bathroom is very small with a shower and a toilet, but good enough.

When we got into the hallway downstairs, we smelled some cigarette smoke, though the advertisement said that it was smoke free. This smell is present in the entire house, including the available bathroom. In the room itself the smell is not so present.

The pictures on the advertisement showed a pretty bookcase and a garden. If you want to use this though, you will be in the immediate house of the host, which didn't feel very comfortable to us (maybe to others it does).

The mezzanine was really nice with the beds and the lighting is also good over there. It is the nicest place of the room.

One bad thing that we experienced on our second night, was a very strong marihuana smell that got up to our room and also entered our room. It came right past the door. We had to open up windows on both sides to make the smell better.
Top airbnb op perfecte locatie. Het huis is prachtig en de kamer erg sfeervol. Bjorn is onwijs vriendelijk en behulpzaam. Locatie ook top. Oftewel; een aanrader!!!

Bjorn's place is great, very close to a very nice area with some bars and restaurants, close to the central station, and to the public transport so you can reach the city center very quickly. The communication with Bjorn was also fast and clear, he will help you in finding nice places and bars and will give you more suggestions if you ask him. He was also very kind for letting us leave the backpacks at his place until we got the train in the evening. Will definitely come back there the next time in , thanks Bjorn!

Goed verblijf, heerlijk geslapen en kamer is zeker leuk! Stad is even lopen maar zeker de moeite waard. Keuken is wel gedeeld als Bjorn thuis is, daar hadden wij ons misschien niet goed over ingelezen dus was voor ons een verrassing. Nogmaals kamer is goed en communiceren met Bjorn is zeker makkelijk!
Really nice and cosy! Good location. There is a lot of light which is pleasant.
The greatest flat I have been in Antwerpen. The living room and the two terraces are amazing with a very nice view. in calm Berchem.

Our stay in Marieke's place was very nice! The communication was good for our arrival and departure. Marieke is very pleasing and gave us some good address to eat and visit nearby.
The appartement looks like the pictures, no surprises.
We will come again without hesitation!
Great location and beautiful balconies with lots of sunlight! Very spacious too! I would love to come again!

La casa di Marieke è a letteralmente 5 minuti dalla. Stazione di Berchem. Comodissima e in una zona silenziosa e molto carina, il quartiere arabo. La casa è al quarto piano con ascensore ed è spaziosissima e molto luminosa. La proprietaria è disponibile ma non abbiamo avuto bisogno di nulla! Se dovessi tornare ad Anversa tornerei sicuramente!
ruim retro appartement met alles erop en eraan ....prettig verblijf in huiselijke sfeer...marieke is een sympathieke gastvrouw
We had a great time in Mariekes apartment. Much space, two nice terraces - and thanks to Marieke's top recommendations we discovered a lot of wonderful places and great restaurants in the city :-)

The location is great as it is close to the station. Sadly enough, The day i arrived she let me know there was a problem with cockroaches.. i slept in the sofa every day because there are no curtains in the bedroom what i find pretty weird. And i got a skin infection after a couple of days so i left earlier because of all the discomfort. Marieke came by a lot to check up on the cockroaches, what I appreciated. Hope she can get the curtain fast, would make a huge different for anyone who wants to stay in the apartment in the future.

Mariekes Airbnb is such a nice place. Its on the 4th floor but you got an elevator. The two balcony’s are the perfect place to just relax or have dinner while watching the sunset. Its spacious so you can enjoy your time with a group of people and also take time for yourself. Nearby are nice restaurants and a place with bars, just 15 mins by foot. To reach the city you can easily rent a Velo bike and enjoy the beautiful streets on the way. A tram station is around just 9 min by foot. Marieke is a very friendly host and the check in and out was very easy, even that we arrived earlier was no problem at all.
The listing was accurate and the apartment was very spacious. It was in a lovely area that was easy to walk (within 20 minutes) to everywhere we wanted to go.
Zeer gastvrij ontvangen! Het was ook een zeer schoon en mooi appartement. Lekker dicht bij het stadspark, de binnenstad is heel even lopen.

Very nice place with a superb location. Just a 15 minute walk from Antwerpen Centraal. Lot's of cafes and two supermarkets nearby. Annabel was not there to receive us but her friend was very kind to let us in and show us the apartment. Would definitely stay here again!
We werden netjes opgewacht bij de entree en vervolgens rondgeleid in de woning. Alles zag er proper uit en de woning voldeed aan de verwachtingen. Al met al een aangenaam verblijf in Antwerpen!

Mooi ruim en schoon appartement op een hele goede locatie. Ziet er uit zoals op de foto's, voorzieningen waren aanwezig. Wel aantal dingen die niet helemaal lekker liepen. Bij aankomst was er niemand, de wifi werkte niet en bij vertrek geen reactie van verhuurder op sms/telefoon. Ook werd ons meermaals benadrukt dat het echt een heel rustig appartementen complex is, en dat je dus echt heel erg stil moet zijn (wij werden bijna fluisterend onthaald). Wij waren met 5 meiden en we voelde ons daardoor een beetje bezwaard, voor een zakentrip oid wel aan te raden.

Annabel was not present but a friend of her introduced us in the apartment. The apartment is large enough for 7, very clear and clean.
It is only 20 minutes walk from Grote markt, great!

Dirty bath and a lot of dust in the bed equipments. Not a real two bedrooms: the second bedroom is with a very unconfortable convertible sofa with a big hole in the middle.
Good location, lot of space.
Bonjour  pour les futurs  voyages  je vous recommande  le logement  il est grand et sympa et calme  super loge

Het appartement is goed gelegen en we werden vriendelijk ontvangen maar toch zijn we niet zo tevreden. We waren een meisjesgroep van 7 en we werden er al meteen op gewezen dat we niet te luid mochten zijn vanwege de buren.
De eerste dag wilden we gezellig aperitieven, maar er bleken maar 6 stoelen aanwezig te zijn om rond de tafel te plaatsen.
Toen we 's avonds de bedden wilden opmaken, kwamen we tot de conclusie dat het zetelbed in de living stuk is. Hierdoor moesten 2 personen op de grond slapen, op een dun matrasje, dat normaal voorzien was om op die zetel te leggen.
Verder was er geen toegang mogelijk tot het terras en maar 1 potje en 2 pannen aanwezig in de keuken, koken zat er dus ook niet echt in.
Al deze elementen wijzen er op dat dit appartement niet echt voor 7 geschikt is (voorlopig).
Het appartement van Annabel is ruim, netjes en uitstekend geschikt voor zakenreizigers of toeristen. Annabel was uiterst hulpvaardig en flexibel. Een heel fijne ervaring.
Appartement confortable, calme, proche gare et toute commodités. Hôte sympathique, appartement sécurisé pour les enfants, je le conseil fortement

everything was great. clean city center app, quiet place and safe neighbourhood..
tv and internet was good too..
i feel like home here!
thank you so much Annabel, hope to see you again..
Recommend!!

Prima locatie, zeker als je in Antwerpen moet zijn. Parkeren is wat lastig en Antwerpen in komen is erg moeilijk, maar verder is het een prima plek om te verblijven. Annabel is goed bereikbaar en probeert steeds snel te helpen om eventuele problemen op te lossen.
Prima locatie, fijn appartement. Antwerpen in komen is wat moeilijk 's middags, dus zeker als je in Antwerpen moet/wilt zijn is het een hele fijne locatie.
Annabel was amazing to work with.  She was immediately responsive, flexible, and her flat was perfectly located/set up for my needs!
Everything great.

This is a fine flat in convenient location. It is on the fifth floor (with lift) of a modern building in a residential area about half-way between the station and the old town. It is a respectable and pleasant neighbourhood, near supermarkets and a tram stop. The flat is clean and well-equipped.

We booked at the last minute, and found Annabel very friendly and responsive to deal with.

In my view this flat is good value, and I recommend it.
nice app, close to the city center, easy to reach, perfect for work related stays
Perfect place , safe area , perfect location , Anabel is very nice host , Very helpful , very comprehsible  ! I recomend to everyone her apartment !

This apartment was the best apartment , you have everything you need inside , very confortable beds you can sleep like a baby ! The internet was very fast , the apartment very quite and safe area ! The neighbors was very lovely people they can help you with everything you ask !
The host was very comunication very friendly Anabel knows how to treat their guest , she is a perfect women and host !
I sugesst to everyone her apartment !
Thank you Anabel !
Everything was ok
Great location and communication, good value for money.

The place is super clean, spacious and nice. The bedrooms are on the quiet side of the apartment and the bed is comfy. Annabel is a great host, answering quickly to my messages and being helpful in arranging to get the key. Also, the location of the place is very good, being at a walking distance from De Keyserlei and the old centre. Recommended!
Everything was perfect
Annabel è stata sempre gentile e disponibile. Ottima esperienza.
Nicely furnished apartment, sparkling clean, great location. The owner is caring and welcoming, would recommend this place to stay.
Adorei, apartamento espaçoso e localização ótima
A large, clean apartment in a quiet, secure part of town. Close to shops and all forms of public transport. An ideal home away from home. Annabel is the best host you could hope for.
Thank you Annabel for the hospitality and for finding your impeccable apartment .. we were very comfortable the apartment is large it is very well located and quiet .. I loved the hospitality !!
A good place to stay.
An excellent place to stay, a great host and very helpful.
Sterke communicatie, centrale ligging, rustige slaapkamer, netheid. Een heuse aanrader!

Нам очень понравилась квартира, жили с ребенком - все удобно, много места, у ребенка была своя комната, он давно мечтал, вот получил возможность потестировать :) Аннабель любезно предоставила нам игрушки своих детей, сын был в полном восторге, я тоже, т.к. он был занят пока я удаленно работала, ну и счастливый ребенок = счастливая мама. В квартире очень тепло, мы лишь иногда включали отопление пока не разобралась как включать сушку в стиральной машине, либо в паре холодных ветреных ночей, в остальном очень теплая квартира, ребенок в шортах играл на полу и не мерз. Все есть: посуда, белье, полотенца; продуктовые магазины рядом, доставка из ресторанов, хозяйка дала чудесные рекомендации. Мы чувствовали себя как дома, довольны, непременно приедем еще
Спасибо!
Supernice and open. We had a great stay and would recommend to others.
Calle tranquila, bien comunicado con el centro. La amfitriona es atenta.
Appartement très bien situé au centre d'Anvers. Séjour très plaisant et très bon accueil.

Location is very practical: close to Central Station and walking distance into the center of Antwerp, but luckily not a noisy location at all. We didn’t meet Natalia, only communicated through text and a few short phone calls. But the communication was quick and clear enough to get to the flat and find our way in without any problems. The flat itself seems brand new (as in the pictures), everything is clean and everything you need for an independent stay is there.
I don’t think anyone lives there (yet). A few little additions in the kitchen would be nice to make it more usable - but it has all the amenities you need.
Maybe not the best place if you’re looking for a homely place with a cordial host to provide lots of recommendations. But a very good place if you’re an independent traveler, looking for a base for a few days to explore Antwerp.

It was a wonderful stay. Natalie was waiting for us to arrive with the key. Due to an issue with the apartment we've got an upgrade to the apartment above. Really nice!

The apartment is in the middle of the centre. Directly across the street is a parking garage you can use. (due to road construction works we could not reach it at first)

Overall a top apartment.

Modern, clean flat in Antwerp that is just a 5 minute walk from the central train station.
Ideal for a weekend trip to visit the city. Walking distance to trendy shopping and historical city centre.
Eli was very helpful and it was very easy to communicate with him. The location is great, in the middle of town, and the apartment is beautiful.
Great spot, nice apartment.
Communication with Eli was very fast. Arrival was smooth, apartment is just as on the pictures. We really enjoyed our short stay and can definitely recommend Eli's place to anyone!

Super leuk appartement, 5 minuten lopen vanaf het station en dicht bij de winkelstraat. Supermarkt en eetgelegenheden om de hoek. Ontvangst was goed, zelfs een drankje aangeboden gekregen. Handige tips gehad over de omgeving. Wij hebben een super verblijf gehad!
Eli's apartament is great as a whole and its one of the most comfortable places i 've ever been.
Es war ein toller Aufenthalt in Antwerpen. Auch danke einer sehr schönen Wohnung. Es war sehr sauber. Die moderne Einrichtung der Wohnung gefiel uns gut.

Snelle communicatie via mail. Zeer goed gelegen, dicht bij station en binnen 5 minuten in de binnenstad. Parkeerplaats recht tegenover het appartementen complex, per 24 uur rond de 18 Euro goede prijs voor binnenstad. Leuke en goede lunchtent onder het appartement.
Een mooi, schoon en compleet appartement op loopafstand van het centrum en bezienswaardigheden. Goede ontvangst en snelle communicatie.
We loved Eli's apartment. Very central located, spacious, modern. It had everything you need. Commucation was quick and easy!

The appartment is verry central located and got everything you need for a couples of days or a longer stay. Communication with Eli was simple and smooth. Will defenitly go back to this place when going to antwerp again! Thanks Eli!

We had a pleasant stay at Eli's apartment. It's a very comfortable and central apartment. Eli is a good, flexible and helpful host. The only thing we missed a little bit was some more kitchen equipment. But overall staying at Eli's apartment was very nice! Would definitely recommend this place when you're visiting Antwerp.
Very practical for a city break

Great place to stay for two in the centre of Antwerp. Eli did respond quick to online questions. He runs his own bagel shop downstairs, so if you need anything he's nearby. It's close to the main attractions and public transport, but in a pretty quiet street. And if you arrive by car you can park across the street. We really liked staying there and we'll be definitely be back.

And if you are with three persons, there is a perfect extra bed.

Appartement très bien situé. A 5 mn de la magnifique gare centrale d'Anvers (l'une des plus belles d'Europe) et pas loin du centre historique.
Eli est un hôte à l'écoute et qui fait tout pour le séjour se déroule très bien.
L'appartement peut convenir à une famille avec un seul enfant.
Super Nice place. In the Centre. Nicely furnished and perfect for seeing Antwerpen at it best!

We had a lovely stay at the appartment. It was fresh, clean and recently renovated. It is in the middle of the city centre, so you have a lot of opportunities to go out. Eli was very flexibel and you can reach him at any time. We recommend it!
Mooi en net appartement. Zeer centraal gelegen. Alles voor een goed weekend Antwerpen.

Allereerst, de communicatie met Eli was erg fijn; snelle reactie en duidelijk.
Het huis was op de foto's erg mooi, dus ik had hoge verwachtingen van het huis en daar voldeed het ook aan; mooi modern ingericht, en erg fijn voor 2/3 personen. Conclusie; zeker voor herhaling vatbaar! Thanks Eli!
Perfect location. Very good communication. Comfortable bed. Clean. Definitely recommended.
A very confortable appartment that is well equiped, everything you need to feel at home during the stay. Familiar ambiance with Eli, he is very committed to give a helping hand if needed.

Good location, near the main station.
Only two or three step to get the lift.
The living room is spacious. But only two chairs for the bar table. A little bit inconvenient if you are three.

Very tastefully and well furnished apt in a very central location. Neighborhood is quite within walking distance to many attractions of Antwerp.
Eli was a great host and comminication was excellent. Onyl the second bedroom is fairly small so do not expect a true 2 bedroom space.
Will be happy to stay here again.
Thank you Eli.
Very comfortable, central location. We used the city bike scheme to get around everywhere and the bike location was just round the corner from the flat.

I spent a great weekend at Eli's place in Antwerp. The apartment was clean, spacious and comfortable and in a great location. close to all the bars, restaurants and shops. Eli was a brilliant host. Looking forward to staying there again !!

The flat is nice and very central. Eli is a very nice man.
There is a restaurant under the flat with a noisy ventilation working till very late...
Great location, only 3 minutes from the central station. Comfortable bed and clean/tidy bathroom. Overall quite  a pleasant stay.

Great apartment located centrally to public transport, shops, restaurants and nightlife. Apartment is located above Eli's bagel and wine bar . Building includes a lift and is very quiet at night. Looking forward to returning!
Great place! Spacious and well equipped. I will stay here again next time.

Dit appartement is super! De ligging is fantastisch - dichtbij Antwerpen Centraal en op loopafstand van het centrum en de grote winkelstraat. Daarnaast ziet het appartement er fantastisch uit, precies zoals op de foto's, en was het er heel schoon en netjes. Ook de communicatie met Eli ging erg gemakkelijk, hij reageerde elke keer heel snel en was erg gastvrij. Ik zou hier zeker nog een keer naartoe gaan!

Easy access from the train station (5min walking), the flat is in a really calm area, but just next to the restaurants, bars and shops. It was very clean and we had everything we needed in this spacious flat. Eli was very welcoming and! caring. I would highly recommend it!

Eli's apartment is fantastic. very clean and well equipped. It is within walking distance of the all the sights and very close to the central station.

Eli is a great host, very accommodating and helpful!
Awesome location so close to Antwerp train station. Eli even got some basic groceries for the place for us! Thank you Eli!
Very nice apartment. Close by the main station and centre of Antwerpen. Very good communication! Top!
It's been a pleasure to stay in Eli's apartment. Nice place, nice host and amazing city!
Eli was a perfect host, i was able to check in much earlier and I only messaged him last minute to check in early. He sorted it quickly. The flat is amazing and very centrally located. Amazing find
Great apartment in a very good central location. It was very modern and clean.  Eli was very Helpful. I would 100percent recomdend his apartment for a stay in Antwerp.
Le séjour c'est super bien passé

Eli's place is around the corner from Antwerp Centraal Station (and the Zoo), which makes it easy to commute to when travelling in from abroad or other cities. It is walking distance to the Meir, the main pedestrian shopping street, Rubenshouse, and Theatre Plein, a charming plaza with restaurants and theatre. It is a bit further to Grotemarkt and the Cathedral but the proximity to train station means there are many buses and trams one can take to these other locations in town. The master bedroom has a king size bed and the living room is also large and confortable. There is an extra room with small cot that is an added bonus when travelling with 3rd person. The cot is a pull out kind of cot, so it is fine for a couple of nights but might not be too confortable as a long stay. Note that many buildings in Antwerp do not have elevators and even the ones that do, still might require one to go up a flight of stairs from street to elevator. I was travelling with my elderly parents and they had to be extra careful with stoop steps. Anyhow, it was really confortable and convenient staying at Eli, I highly recommend it.
Great Place to stay in antwerp, very recommendable!
Amazing apartment in a great location!

Die Wohnung verfügt über eine zentrale Lage und die Kommunikation mit dem Gastgeber verlief reibungslos. Die Nachbarschaft ist ruhig und im Haus haben wir niemanden gesehen. In wenigen Fussminuten ist alles erreichbar.

Über die Sauberkeit lässt sich streiten – aber die Böden waren nicht sehr sauber. Die Matratzen etwas durchgelegen. Als es stark geregnet hat, ist Wasser durch das Dach getropft. Es sind nicht viele Küchenutensilien vorhanden – je nach Belieben müssen Kaffeekapseln nachgekauft werden.

Mooie centrale Locatie, Redelijk tot goed appartement, met wat kleine opwaardering van kleine details een 5 sterren, daarom geef ik 4 sterren. verder een heel vriendelijke man en goede communicatie, Ga zo door Eli... Bedankt
Check-in was easy, and the location close to the station is very convenient.

Die Lage von Elis Wohnung ist optimal. Die Schlüsselbox ist zu hoch montiert, da es ein silbernes Drehrad mit silber geprägten Zahlen ist, konnte man kaum erkennen was man einstellt, habe sicher 5 Minuten gebraucht. Der Eingang ist nicht behindertengerecht bis zum Lift muss man etliche Stufen bewältigen. Die Wohnung besteht in der unteren Etage aus Wohnzimmer, Küche, WC und Terrasse. Die Einrichtung ist schön, aber nur für junge Leute geeignet, das Sofa ist viel zu tief, ich konnte nicht mehr aufstehen, wenn ich mal sass ( Knieverletzung) Es gibt nur einen Hochtisch mit Barhockern, keine normalen Stühle mit Lehne. Küche haben wir nicht gebraucht, aber war wohl alles da. Die Terrasse ist toll, ruhig im Innenhof. Es führt eine sehr steile Treppe in den oberen Stock, etwas gefährlich für Kinder. Das Geländer war mit braunem Paketklebeband geflickt und wackelte bedenklich. Im oberen Stock gibt es ein schönes Badezimmer mit Dusche, leider keine Ablagefläche in der Dusche. Das Doppelbett im ersten Zimmer ist sehr bequem, am Rand etwas durch gelegen. Im zweiten Zimmer steht ein Etagenbett, völlig ungeeignet für Erwachsene, viel zu klein und die untere Matratze hatte die Dicke einer Liegestuhlauflage, die obere Matratze ist etwas besser. Oben fehlt auch wieder ein Stuhl, wo man sitzen könnte, aber das wird wohl ein Problem , da die Zimmer recht klein sind. Allgemein ist die Wohnung kleiner, als sie auf den Fotos erscheint. Eine Waschmaschine haben wir trotz Angabe nicht gefunden. Ich würde das Apartment für jüngere Gäste empfehlen, für alle anderen ist sie unpraktisch.

-We found that the flat we stayed in smelled very strongly of cigarette smoke most of the time, likely from other smokers in the building. If you are a non-smoker like us, I would be aware of this if you are sensitive to these smells.
-The flat can be noisy at night since it is in the area of Groenplaats square. If you are going with the intention of getting a restful sleep, I would suggest bringing ear plugs, especially for the weekend evenings.
