We stayed in Sean's flat for a long weekend. The communication with Sean was easy, he made sure that someone was there to let us in when we arrived and was flexible with the check-out. The flat is very spacious (especially the living room/ kitchen) and bright and the location great - about 5 min to the city centre, maybe 25 to the harbour with museums and restaurants. The only tiny downside was the delivery truck for the supermarket downstairs that woke my friends up in the morning (I slept right through it though, so can't have been too loud). Would definitely stay there again!
Hat uns alles super gut gefallen, alles besser als erwartet. Immer wieder gerne. Auf jeden fall empfehlenswert!

Appartement très agréable, très lumineux et très bien situé dans le centre d'Antwerpen. Rapidité de réaction de Sean lors de nos questions.
À recommander +++
Heerlijk verblijf gehad, zeer centraal in Antwerpen en de parkeerplaats in de kelder is erg handig. Een supermarkt naast het appartement is ook zeer handig. We komen zeker een keer terug!
Superlokatie en prachtig apartement. Echt aan alles is gedacht.
Superbe appartement. Bien placé. Identique au photos. Sean est un très bon hôte et très ouvert. Merci pour tout.

Super schoon, ruim en prachtig appartement in het centrum van de stad. Met gratis parkeergelegenheid. Sean is een plezierige host, die snel reageert. Het appartement ligt tegenover een café en boven een supermarkt. Dat zorgde tijdens ons verblijf wel voor geluidsoverlast. Op vrijdagavond/nacht door het café en de volgende ochtend vroeg door bevoorrading van de supermarkt. De nabijheid van de supermarkt is anderzijds ook heel plezierig. En als je in de stad zit moet je rekening houden met geluiden. Al met al hebben wij een plezierig verblijf gehad.

The apartment is great,  spacious, light, airy with everything you need, even the smell of pastries being baked wafting up from the supermarket below. The location is great close to the centre & within easy access to the docks. Would happily stay there again!

Seans Wohnung ist sehr modern und super schön. Unten Schlaf- und Badbereich und oben Wohnküchenbereich. Die Fotos sind absolut authentisch und es ist alles da, was man sich wünschen kann. Die Lage inmitten der Altstadt ist perfekt und aufgrund des Tiefgaragenplatzes ist Parken kein Problem. Sean ist ein toller und unkomplizierter Gastgeber. Wenn wir wieder einmal nach Antwerpen kommen, dann auf jeden Fall wieder gern zu Sean.

Sean is a great host. He gave us nice tipps for restaurants, cafes, clubs etc and he answers really quick.
We really liked the apartment, it was clean and very chic.
Would love to come again :)

We had an excellent stay at Sean's place and was definitely better than expected. The apartment is large and very modern, and we were extremely pleased with the cleanliness of it. The location is great; only a few minutes from the centre and conveniently situated next to a local grocery store, bars, and cafes. The only thing I was displeased with was the noise level when the delivery trucks came for the grocery store early morning. Otherwise, very impressed overall. Sean was always so quick to respond and a very caring host. Would definitely recommend staying here if you are planning a trip to Antwerp!
Place was amazing! Much bigger then anticipated. Pictures don’t do it justice. He was super responsive and checked in to make sure we had everything we needed. Would definitely recommend !
We really enjoyed our stay at Sean’s apartment. It is modern, spacious and clean and is well located for exploring Antwerp on foot or by bicycle.

Magnifique appartement, très sobre et très confortable. Le garage en sous sol est très appréciable. Sean n’était plus disponible à notre heure d’arrivée mais a tout organisé pour la remise des clefs. Je recommande sans réserve!
Very comfortable ❤️
Het verblijf was heel mooi en modern ingericht . Alle nutsvoorzieningen zijn aanwezig en super proper . De ligging is ideaal : dichtbij centrum en winkels . Ons 3 daags verblijf was een topper !!
Nous étions quatre et avons tous été très satisfaits de l'appartement. Très propre, excellent emplacement.
Great location and good respond and facilities fully equipped.

Ladies and gents do not look any further this is the real deal. Sean is the man period. The condo is more than you can imagine, the location is perfect and has multiple restaurants and jobs around it. Sean is quick and kind, easily needs to be promoted to a super host.

Organizing the trip with Sean was really quick and easy and he was quick to respond to any questions we had. The house is in a really nice neighborhood, filled with bars and cafes and a quick walk from the city center. The place was spotless when we arrived and was a great cozy home base for our weekend. Thanks a bunch Sean!
Super appartement op super locatie!
Great location, comfy beds, and super spacious.
非常乾淨又附有停車場的房子，樓下就是超市，而且鬧中取靜，雖然住宿中間有點小問題，不過Sean的立即回覆和處理讓人感覺很窩心，房間的設計如同照片一樣，空間大得很適合家庭，非常喜歡這晚的住宿。
Incredible place, spacious, clean and modern! Steps away from shops and restaurants. Parking garage is a wonderful bonus. You won’t be disappointed!
Het was erg fijn om hier te verblijven!

L’appartement de Sean est vraiment merveilleux, fonctionnel et très propre. De plus il est très bien situé dans le centre. Malheureusement nous avons eu du bruit et de la musique au bar en dessous jusqu’à 4h du (Website hidden by Airbnb) souhaite que nous n’ayons pas eu  de chance et que ce n’est pas très fréquent.
Loved our stay here!

Dit is een top locatie als je de stad wilt ontdekken! Het appartement is mooi en je hebt er lekker veel ruimte. Je kunt je auto onder het gebouw kwijt in de garage en alle bezienswaardigheden zo wel te voet af. Een aanrader dus!
This is an amazingly stylish and spacious apartment on two levels close to the centre of town.  Fantastic place to stay.
Brilliant host, great apartment, excellent location, thank you, Sean!
The flat is amazing and well located, Sean was very friendly and helpful although we didn't meet in person.

Die Wohnung ist ganz hervorragend gelegen, und entspricht in allen Punkten der Beschreibung. Die Kommunikation  mit Sean war schnell und unkompliziert, auf Wunsch bekamen wir einen zweiten Schlüssel, toll ist auch der dazugehörige Parkplatz. Direkt um die Wohnung findet man sehr schöne Shops und Restaurants, der grosse Markt ist nur wenige Minuten  entfernt.

Thanks for letting me use your stunning apartment Sean. This is a spacious and stylish apartment in a great location for exploring the city. Comms were excellent and everything was simple on arrival/leaving. Great place!

L'appartement est idéalement situé, très central et dispose d'un parking largement accessible. Pour la localisation, un luxe. La décoration est contemporaine, design, conforme aux photos et l'on se sent tout de suite bien. Nous avons profité d'une longue terrasse donnant au calme pour déguster un café ou une coupe de champagne. Meubles de grande qualité. Il faut savoir que les chambres donnent sur rue, dans un environnement urbain mais le double vitrage est de qualité. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.
Witziger Wohnungsgrundriss, sehr geräumig, schöne Terrasse, super Lage, leider etwas lauter, da Schlafzimmer zur Straße, trotzdem super tolle Wohnung und Stadt
I can really recommend this appartment! It is beautiful, clean and perfectly situated close to everything - and Sean is really helpful :-)

Шон отличный хозяин! Из-за пробок опоздали к заселению на 6 часов, Шон вошел в положение и вежливо нас подождал, это было очень мило с его стороны! Сами апартаменты шикарные! 2 этажа, 2 спальни, гигантская кухня, собственная терраса и все это в самом центре города! Надеюсь в следующую поездку это жилье будет свободно, так хочется теперь останавливаться именно там!

Sean’s apartment is beautiful, modern, very spacious, easily accessible and with added bonus of parking! We could walk everywhere we wanted to go, but could also relax indoors as it so big and light. It had everything we needed!

The only thing that is a bit of an issue are the trolleys of the grocery store below the apartment. They make a big noise from very early in the morning.

We had a toddler with us and found the apartment was quite child friendly.
Amazing place, clean, comfortable and well located. Sean is an amazing host

Sean's appartment is very nice. I was traveling on a business trip with a colleague and it was really nice to have two bedrooms that were equally nice. We did not spend much time in the appartment, but the living area and the terrace were definitely also a huge plus. Checkin and checkout were very flexible and all was good. When in Antwerp again, I would book the appartment again. The only reason for the missing star is that there was a lot of noise at night. Maybe that was just due to the soccer championships? Since it was quite warm we slept with open windows. The place is more quiet with closed windows.
Very nice and comfortable flat! We are family of 4 people and the flat was really pretty good for as! Everything you need is in the flat and also it’s very good location!

N’hésitez pas!! L’appart est grand (même plus grand qu’il parait sur les photos) propre, bien situé.
Communication facile, en anglais français ou néerlandais!!
Aucun soucis. Si nos devons retourner à Anvers , nous irons la!!

The apartment is ideally situated in the centre of Antwerpen. It was lovely to have a small terras to eat breakfast on. The bedrooms and the kitchen and living areas are very nice also. Doubleglazing in high windows cut down on the noise that living in the center of a big city can entail. A parking spot was an important bonus for us as well. Highly recommendable, in other words!
Very nice appartement, well situated and a very accommodating host.

Die Wohnung ist wunderschön! Super hell und sehr modern, Schlafzimmer sind zwar zur Straße gerichtet aber das hat uns nicht gestört. Die Lage ist optimal, man braucht ungefähr 10 min zur Einkaufsstraße und 10-15min zum Hafen. Wir haben die Stadt komplett zu Fuß erkundet und direkt neben der Wohnung war ein Supermarkt. Die Küche war sehr gut bestückt und die Tiefgarage war sehr von Vorteil, da man in der Straße von der Wohnung. Je schwer einen Parkplatz findet. Der Aufenthalt war super! Würden jederzeit wieder kommen!
Very nice space in heart of Antwerp. Much bigger than it looks from photos, spotlessly clean, checkin very easy and the host was very helpful throughout the booking process and stay.
Geweldig apartement, alles is aanwezig en perfecte locatie.

Tolle Lage, um diese wunderbare Stadt zu erkunden!
Perfekt saubere und zweckmäßig eingerichtete Wohnung!
Jederzeit erreichbarer Vermieter!!!!!
Super location!!

Very stylish and modern flat with great equipment and all amenities in the heart of a fantastic city. The interior is very clean and completely corresponds with the pictures. There is no picture from the backyard roof terrace which we enjoyed a lot - a definite plus! As others have noted: You should have a deep sleep as the bars and clubs at the corner tend to play quite loud music specifically during the weekend. And the very early morning delivery of stocks for the small supermarket downstairs may shorten your sleep as well. We were prepared and had our earplugs with us - and enjoyed very relaxed nights. :)
The flat is perfectly placed right between the historic center and the modern and upcoming Eilandje district. You are able to reach nearly everything by foot. We also enjoyed the velo-station right in front of the flat and explored the city by bike - another great plus! The immediate neighbourhood offers some great bars, nice cafes, interesting shops and restaurants - all at your fingertips.
Sean is an outstanding and very reliable host and responds immediately. We really enjoyed his flat and hospitality which enabled us to fully explore the great and colourful city of Antwerp. We hope many more will benefit from this amazing place.
Erg goed!

We were positively surprised when we arrived at the apartment. It was very spacious, clean and pretty. Also, the location was just perfect. We could walk to all the places we wanted to visit. A supermarket was located right underneath the apartment. The beds were very comfy and the kitchen had a dishwasher. We also enjoyed the small terrace a lot! One minor negative point that we encountered was the fact that the kitchen bin was not emptied when we arrived. All in all, we had a great stay at Sean's place!

A spacious, clean apartment in a convenient easy location in the city to get around. Free parking. Supermarket extremely close, tram stop around the corner. Plenty of eateries.
Check in and out was smooth and hassle free. Would stay again.
Un apartamento precioso, con todas las comodidades, cerca del centro, hemos pasado una estancia muy agradable.

Onze eerste ervaring met AirBnB en de lat is meteen hoog gelegd! Sean is een aardige en behulpzame verhuurder en biedt een top appartement met een hoogwaardige afwerking op een fijne locatie. Ons verblijf was zeer plezierig en in de toekomst komen wij graag nog eens terug. Eén weekend is sowieso te kort om van het Antwerpse te proeven en ook in cultureel opzicht is er nog genoeg te ontdekken.
Bij een appartement middenin het centrum op slechts enkele minuten van de Grote Markt en de cathedraal kan het niet anders dat er enigszins geluidsoverlast kan zijn van café's en door bevoorrading van winkels in de vroege morgen. Voor ons geen probleem maar ben je niet gewend aan wonen in de stad, dan is het wellicht verstandig om oordopjes mee te nemen.

Wir haben unserer Aufenthalt in der Wohnung wirklich genossen!!!!
Der Ort ist fantastisch, die Wohnung sehr modern eingerichtet. Die Lage ist großartig, sehr zentral und auch Nah am Wasser und am Hafen.
Auf jeden fall empfehlenswert!!!!

Apartment est bien situé,c’est près du villeux quartier .grand appartement très propre et confortable,malheureusement les chambres sont dans le côté rue,on a eu les bruits toute la nuit,c’est compliqué de bien dormir.

Sean was a very hospitable host with a spacious, clean and comfortable place. Great location minutes from old city, marina. Just next door to a supermarket and bike share rack and tram, with some great small bars, cafes and eateries within a stones throw . We’ll certainly be back again and would recommend Sean’s place if you need a self contained apartment in Antwerp.
Super gepflegte Wohnung in der Nähe des Altstadtzentrums. Echt zu empfehlen, alles fußläufig zu erreichen.

Sean place is located in a very lovely area in the centrum. The place is even bigger than its pictures! It is very clean, well maintained, nicely decorated, functional and efficient. I highly recommend people to rent Sean's place. Communication was very easy and Sean was very eager to offer us his help.
Centraal gelegen in Antwerpen, proper en ruim appartement met een mini dakterrasje, lichte slaapkamers met zachte matrassen, ruime kuiken, tv, kortom alles aanwezig voor een fijn weekend in Antwerpen

Ruim, schoon en prettig appartement om in te verblijven! Inclusief parkeerplek! Wij verbleven er met 4 volwassen en alles is aanwezig om bijvoorbeeld zelf een lekker ontbijtje te maken. Supermarkt is heel dichtbij, dat is prettig, maar het lossen en laden vroeg in de ochtend is iets minder prettig. Tip: oordopjes mee.
Mijn moeder is wat slecht te been, daardoor zijn de trappen zonder trapleuning in het appartement niet heel handig voor mensen op leeftijd.

Super schöne coole , moderne Wohnung.
Ausstattung perfekt, alles sehr sauber und gut ausgestattet.
Sean war immer zu erreichen und hilfsbereit .

Lage ist absolut zentral, mitten in der Innenstadt.
Dadurch bedingt natürlich auch nachts etwas Lärm....

An unserem WE in Antwerpen waren sämtliche Straßen gesperrt, also wurden wir von Sean (bzw. seinem Bruder) an unserem „Standort“ abgeholt und zur Wohnung gebracht.
Sie waren sehr bemüht uns zu helfen.

Absolut empfehlenswerte Unterkunft!

Great experience. Easy walk to Antwerp center, market next door for supplies, washing machine in unit, and covered parking . Everything made for a fun visit. A little late night and early morning street noise, but expected for such a central location. Highly recommend.

Super mooi appartement, heel ruim!
Midden in de stad dus een ideale plek.

Nice, spacious place with 2 roomy bedrooms and big living/dining/kitchen area upstairs. We could walk to the old town as well as the shopping street. You can take a tram nearby to get to the train station. Also nice to have a safe, indoor parking space included.
Great location. Cafes, brasseries and town center within a stones throw. Comfortable, clean and as it says on the ad! Thanks again!

Very spacious and modern apartment with excellent kitchen facilities and comfortable beds. Exactly as per the photographs. Close to many restaurants and old town. Supermarket next door - very convenient. Light sleepers might be disturbed by late night noise from local bar bar if windows are left open.

Uns hat die Wohnung sehr gut gefallen und die Lage ist auch perfekt! Allerdings kann es wirklich abends (Bar gegenüber) und morgens (Anlieferung des Supermarkts) etwas laut sein in den Schlafzimmern. Die Kommunikation mit Sean war ebenfalls sehr gut!
This is a lovely recently refinished apartment in a very convenient part of town. The beds are comfortable, and the kitchen/living room is quite spacious.  Sean is a warm and responsive host.
Had a great stay. Everything was perfect and Sean is a great host.

The apartment was very clean and nicely furnished. We immediately felt at home and the location of the apartment made it possible to explore the whole city of Antwerp by foot. The parking garage is also a huge plus because you do not have to think about finding a reasonably priced parking spot in the city centre. Communication with Sean was great and he was always available and quick to answer any questions. Overall we really enjoyed our stay in the apartment and we would definitely recommend it.
large place

Sean is een zeer gastvrije host. Hij reageerde snel op onze berichten zodat we ook op de juiste manier naar binnen konden en ook weer konden vertrekken. Erg fijn dat er een ondergrondse parkeerplaats aanwezig is. Teven is het appartement zeer ruim en net. Alle voorzieningen zijn aanwezig! Ook ligt het appartement erg centraal waardoor we met een paar minuten lopen in het centrum waren. We hebben het erg naar onze zin gehad hier!
Sean was quick with helpful replies and suggestions. His place was clean, comfortable, and quiet. From there it was very easy to reach lots of places of interest to us.

Danke für den tollen Aufenthalt! Die Kommunikation und Organisation war super unkompliziert. Sean ist sehr nett, antwortet schnell und kümmert sich prima, obwohl er in unserem Fall nicht vor Ort war. Das war aber gar kein Problem. Die Wohnung ist groß, hell, sauber, schön eingerichtet und liegt zentral in Antwerpen. Somit konnten wir viele Dinge fußläufig erreichen. Ich würde die Unterkunft jederzeit wieder buchen!

We had a wonderful stay at Sean’s place. The apartment is huge, has all amenities you can think of (washing machine, dishwasher, coffee machine etc.), a lot of storage place and a big bathtub. Location is very central, and communication with Sean was fast, efficient and pleasant. Moreover, this time we did not use it but Sean has a parking place in the garage and this can be a huge plus. Highly recommended.

This apartment is in a brilliant location in the city centre and has a useful supermarket located below.  it is spotlessly clean and the beds are very comfortable.  Sean met us on arrival and was very helpful in every way.
Sean's place was perfect for us. It was very close to the main square, was very spacious and extremely clean. I would definitely recommend this flat to anyone going to Antwerp.
Het appartement was super geregeld. Centrale plek in het centrum en goed bereikbaar per auto. Deze kon in een garage staan. Contact was snel en het appartement was zeer groot en netjes!
Topappartement in hartje Antwerpen! Je kan niet beter zitten!

El apartamento es incluso mejor que en la fotos. La ubicación es de 10 a pocos minutos andando del centro. Es un apartamento muy grande con todo lo necesario, ideal para 4 personas. Sin duda para repetir.

Der Kontakt mit Sean war super. Er hat uns kurzfristig aus einer Wohnungsnot gerettet und wir konnten sogar früher in die Wohnung. Das Appartement ist wirklich super zentral gelegen. Die Fenster sind gut isoliert, so dass man auch ruhig schlafen konnte. Alles war sehr sauber. Insgesamt eine schöne Wohnung und eine klare Empfehlung von uns
Very spacious apartment right in the centre of Antwerp, with a wonderful open living/dining area. We loved staying here!
Fantastisch appartement, van alle gemakken voorzien, prima bedden, op top locatie. Je bent midden in de stad met supermarktje, leuke winkels en cafeetjes en restaurants op loopafstand.

We haven’t met with Sean but he managed to let us in earlier thanks to the maids. Very clean place with quality interior. The indoor parking is a big plus. It’s near to the city centre as well. Shop downstairs in the very same building. The kitchen is well equipped as well. Only downside is that the WiFi is only available on the first floor but not in the other parts of the place. Perfect to fit 5 guests.
Het ruime, nette appartement ligt op een super locatie van waaruit de stad fijn te bewandelen is.
Ruim modern appartement. Schoon en stijlvol. Snelle communicatie en vriendelijk ontvangst. Locatie kan niet beter.
Great location and Sean very helpful/quick when the internet wasnt working fully. Nice and airy space.
Toplocatie, parkeergarage eronder, supermarkt ernaast, voorzien van alle luxe en goede gastheer!
Just go and enjoy

Super appartement met goede bereikbaarheid. Snelle communicatie tijdens het inchecken en heel gastvrij. Appartement voldoet aan de omschrijvingen en is schoon. Enige kleine nadeel is het geluid van de vrachtauto die ‘s ochtends onder de slaapkamer aan het laden/lossen was maar hier is weinig aan te doen.
Great location, beautiful apartment
Really location near old town. Only problem is if you’re a light sleeper as flat sits above market and deliveries are loud in early morning.
Mooi en schoon appartement op een super locatie. Beter kon niet!

En plein centre ville, superbe logement avec salon/kitchenette très agréable.
Propreté irréprochable et accueil parfait !
A conseiller !
Perfect location in the center of Antwerp. Clean and spacious. We would definitely book again.
Spacious, clean, light appartement  in the city center of Antwerp walking distance to bars, restaurants, shopping, museums.
Very much recommended. I would for sure go there again.
the best place to stay in Antwerp!
Modern en schoon appartement met 2 slaapkamers. Prima gelegen vlakbij Grote markt!

Great location downtown Antwerp, two fully equipped bedrooms, a lounge and kitchen upstairs, and parking included for one car in the building. Sometimes it can be (too) perfect. Indeed some noise in the early morning from truck delivery to the supermarket downstairs. Still highly recommended!
Mooi en net appartement in het centrum met een eigen ondergrondse parkeerplek. Ideaal als uitvalsbasis voor een weekend Antwerpen.
This place was absolutely terrific, great location, super clean and all the amenities you could ask for.  Sean has set a high standard for quality.

Handy location - walking distance to many interesting places, supermarket next door.  Right opposite a gay bar :) The apartment is on two levels, with the bedrooms downstairs - that was handy for us as we had heavy luggage. Sean was great to deal with, quick to respond and happy to help. Apartment was nicely furnished and comfortable.
Perfect for holiday in Antwerp!
Great communication, apartment and overall a great place to stay :)
Alles wie beschrieben. Sehr gute Lage, tolle Wohnung und ab und an mal etwas lauter. Die Kommunikation mit Sean war erstklassig.

The host went above and beyond to accommodate our group - made last minute late night checkin arrangements (after a previously booked air bnb in another town fell through) and we wish this is the one we booked from the beginning! A lovely and unique apartment, extremely clean and in a great location easily within walking distance of anything you need.

Niets meer dan lof over dit appartement! Alles is brandschoon, nieuw, strak en een zeer grote woonkamer incl. keuken voorzien van alle gemakken. Perfecte locatie midden in het centrum dus alles beloopbaar. Supermarkt aan het appartement (8 tot 8 open) erg fijn en de privé parkeerplek is ook prima geregeld (achter slot en grendel). Sean ontving ons persoonlijk en reageert snel en behulpzaam op berichtjes. Super prijs/kwaliteitsverhouding, ik zou zeggen dus gewoon boeken!

Sean was a wonderful host. We were thankful to have a clean and central place to stay with underground parking. The building was safe and very close to great restaurants. The grocery store downstairs was a bonus. Great for a weary traveling family!

L'appartement est idéalement situé avec un parking qui est un luxe dans cette belle ville d'Anvers.
Le gros soucis est le logement est au dessus d'un supermarché avec les livraisons à 5 h du matin, les réserves et la porte du garage qui s'ouvre en permanence. Pas top pour une semaine de repos !
This location is phenomenal. Great neighborhood, great apartment. Really enjoyed staying here, wish we could have stayed longer.

Beautifully appointed two bedroom apartment with lift from ground floor. Bring your earplugs!! Bedrooms located above street intersection so traffic stops all night long with motorcycle and vehicles reving engines. Bar across street with loud drunks yelling, fighting, calling obscenities until 3:00am

Lovely space, well decorated all amenities

Sean’s place is in the middle of everything. Super great location if exploring Antwerp.  Sean is also accommodating and communicates well. The only thing I would recommend is to shut the windows at night.  There is a shop downstairs and they do stocking of Inventory in the early mornings.  It will wake you if the windows are open.  Other than that, it is clean, big and a great place to stay!  Felt very safe.

Super zentrale Lage, tolles Apartment, Parkplatz in Tiefgarage direkt im Gebäude, sehr guter Gastgeber! Wirklich zu empfehlen!!!

Geräuschempfindliche Schläfer könnten sich an der Ladezone unterhalb der Schlafzimmerfenster oder an der Tanzbar direkt gegenüber stören - Ein paar Oropax helfen sicher!

Supermarkt direkt nebenan (also im selben Haus und 7 Tage die Woche geöffnet) spart einem Geschleppe!
Excellent appartment at perfect location!
Het is een prachtig appartement. Super handig dat er een supermarkt onder het appartement zit. In de slaapkamer kan je geluidshinder ervaren. We hebben genoten!

Location is very convenient and there is even a supermarket below the flat. The flat is accurately described on Airbnb, very modern. Although we have only contacted via the app, Sean is reachable whenever we had questions.

The apartment had a perfect location. We easily explored everything by foot.
The internet was not working.
However, we overall had a nice stay at Sean‘s.
Great space! Very large and close to everything. The beds were the best. Would definitely stay here again. Great communication as well.
It was a wonderful stay at Seans apartment! Clean, quick communication, located in the city centre (just a bit noisy).
Prachtig ruim appartement midden in de stad. Ook heel goed dat je je auto kan parkeren. Als je een mooie plek in het midden van het centrum wil dan is dit appartement zeker aan te raden!

We had an amazing time and wish we would have stayed longer. We were within walking distance to amazing shopping, dining and night life. There were no surprises, previous reviews were accurate, we weren’t surprised by anything. Sean is a great host and made our stay in Antwerp amazing.

Kris & Doina
Lovely decorated room. Convenient location for business to the south. At the time of my visit room was partly open as some of the doors had been removed to be painted. Friendly host.
Mariona's house was full of good vibes and very cosy. You have everything you need here. The garden is perfect. Very good experience.

Mariona is heel gastvrij. Een zeer vriendelijke en behulpzame gastvrouw! Super leuk appartement om een weekendje te verblijven. De foto's geven een goed beeld weer. De tram richting het centrum van Antwerpen stopt om de hoek.

Everything went perfectly. Mariona and her partner are very friendly, and the place is comfortable, well-equipped and quiet.

We hadden een heerlijk verblijf bij Mariona! Ze is een enthousiaste en attente gastvrouw. Zeer verzorgde kamer en badkamer. Overal verrassende details! Lekker ontbijt, ongedwongen contact. Een aanrader...

Mariona gaf ons alle vrijheid, en liet ons begaan. Een fijne weekendje uit voor ons zonder kleine kinderen. Allemaal positief. Prima ervaring dus.

Modern ingericht appartement in een wel oudere woning, gelegen aan de zuidelijke rand van de stad Antwerpen.

easy communication and check-in, thoughtful touches.

Definitely recommend, and make sure to sign her guestbook!
Super verblijf! Zeker een aanrader!

Wir hatten zwei ruhige Nächte in Christels Appartment, von welchem man in 20 Minuten Fußweg die Altstadt erreichen kann. Die Zimmer sind wie beschrieben und das Schlafzimmer gemütlich. Leider haben wir bereits bei unserer Ankunft einen unangenehmen Geruch angetroffen, der vermutlich aus dem Abfluss in der Küche kam, was den Eindruck leider etwas getrübt hat.

Cet appartement est situé dans la ville, avec le problème de stationnement que cela suppose, mais la station de Tram est toute proche et possibilité d'utiliser les vélibs.
Situé au 2ème étage, l'accès est difficile à des personnes à mobilité délicate.
Nous avons eu l'impression agréable, d'être dans un appartement d'étudiant.

Goed plekje! Zowel centrum als eilandje goed beloopbaar (beide ong 15-20 min lopen). Prijs/kwaliteit verhouding uitstekend. Lekker bed. Het appartement bevindt zich op een zolder, waar het behoorlijk warm kan worden als het lekker weer is. Gelukkig staan er 2 ventilatoren die genoeg verkoeling bieden. Netjes en erg schoon en Christel is goed bereikbaar wanneer je vragen hebt. Enige minpuntje was de druk op de douche - hier komt erg weinig water uit helaas. Verder absoluut een aanrader!
Excellent location close to central station and areas of interest. Cute and cozy flat good for couples or lone travellers.
Appartement très mignon et fonctionnel, la terrasse est un plus très apprécié pour l'apéro !

We didn't personally meet Christel but the communication was really easy. The apartment is perfect for spending a few days in the city. It was clean but unfortunately there was a bad smell coming from the bathroom so make sure to keep the door closed! Apart from that our stay was good. Everything is in walking distance from the apartment.

Der Austausch mit Christel war schnell und unkompliziert. Das Appartment liegt in einem multikulturellen Teil der Stadt, zu Fuß ist einiges gut zu erreichen. Es ist sauber, allerdings kam ein unangenehmer Geruch (wahrscheinlich Abwasser) aus dem Bad. Christel war bemüht, uns diesbezüglich weiterzuhelfen. Ansonsten war alles gut!
This was a wonderful place to stay, very clean and spacious. I would definitely stay here again if ever in Antwerp.

Christel's place is very close to Antwerpen Centraal station, literally just a 10 mins walk. What truly surprised me was the size of the studio. I was expacting a smallish flat just enough for one or two people. However, when I arrived, the reality exceeded my expectations! The flat is really nice, tidy and spacious! Christel was a brilliant host, even though I haven't met her in person. She was very prompt at replying to my messages and gave clear instructions about check in.
When I asked her for some suggestions to what to visit in the city, she sent me some links and also made some suggestion where to go and what to see. The maps she left in the flat were lifesavers! Overall, I had an amazing stay in Antwerp, and I can recommend this flat to everyone, who would like to spend some time in Antwerp. Thank you Christel!

Christel's studio was clean and as advertised. Enough kitchen utensils to make meals and comfortable bed, it is also well decorated. It wasn't too hot at night, and there are fans if needed. The location is perfect, very close to the train station and you can visit the city center by foot from there. There is also public transportation nearby. Check-in and check-out were easy and Christel was very nice.

Christensen e la sua famiglia sono stati decisamente disponibili nel risolvere tempestivamente dei problemi nell'appartamento insorti al nostro arrivo. Gentili e rapidi nella risoluzione. Purtroppo il cattivo odore proveniente dal bagno era davvero forte. Consigliamo la porta chiusa del bagno. Ubicazione ottima. Pulizia più che sufficiente.
Really cute unit with more room than expected. Slightly noisy outside due to location and in an interesting multicultural neighborhood with really neat Turkish supermarkets near by.
Leuk en gezellige studio! Wel warm, maar het was eenmaal 30 graden toen wij in Antwerpen waren. Verder is er ook een ventilator, dus prima te doen!

Very nice sized apartment, cozy and quaint. Christel is very nice and has great communication. Only negative thing would be, according to the locals it's not the best area to be out at night. We went out all day and had no issues.
Buena comunicación con el centro,tranvía en la puerta de casa, el apartamento está muy bien, con todo tipo de información para facilitar el viaje en la casa.

Geräumiges Studio, leider etwas runter gekommen. Alte Verschmutzungen und Beschädigungen in der ganzen Wohnung. Nägel stehen aus dem Holzboden hervor. Die Lage ist nah an der Metro aber in einem fragwürdigen Viertel.
No ha sido mala experiencia pero podría ser mejor...

This is a spacious apartment in a great location. My girlfriend and I stayed here in Antwerp for 2 nights. The apartment has a large double room with an ensuite, kitchen and lounge area. The station and centre of Antwerp is no more than a 15/20 min walk. We'd recommend!

Die Unterkunft liegt etwa 10 min Fußweg vom Hauptbahnhof Antwerpen und etwa 20 min Fußweg von der Innenstadt (Grote Markt) entfernt.
Straßenbahnanbindung ist direkt 1 min Gehweg entfernt.
Das Vierteil, in dem die Wohnung liegt, ist zwar relativ gut erreichbar, allerdings ist die Parkplatz-Situation schlecht. Ich würde einen P+R Parkplatz empfehlen (Olympia P+R). Ansonsten ist das Viertel nachts etwas gewöhnungsbedürftig.

Es gab schnelles und gut funktionierendes WLAN und in der Küche hat man die nötigsten Dinge vorgefunden, um auch mal schnell Nudeln zu kochen oder zu frühstücken.
Zu bemägeln haben wir die Sauberkeit und den etwas sehr unangenehmen Geruch in der Küche/oberern Etage der Wohnung. Ansonsten kann man für das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis absolut nicht mehr erwarten.
Wir waren dennoch zufrieden mit der Wahl der Unterkunft :)

Had a lovely stay in Christel's studio. The studio is in a great place and you can easily walk to the old town and to other places in the city. The studio was so much bigger than I was expecting! It's nicely decorated and has everything you need for a few days in the city. Hopefully i will be back again to stay!
We very much enjoyed our stay here we were close to everything and had plenty of space, only thing stopping me from a full 5 stars is the toilet

The top floor apartment is very nice. It is located close to the central station (10 minutes walk). Everything was taken care of in terms of wifi accessibility, keys, towels, tourist guides etc.. A small issue for me was the noise from the tram and street nearby, but this depends on the person and how easy you can wake up.
The Apartment was amazing. The room was cleaned and comfortable.

Prima locatie, 7min naar het centraal station (Astrid) met de tram of lopend kan natuurlijk ook. Melkmarkt binnen 7min te bereiken, erg gezellig! Tram komt  door de straat heen en fornuis deed het nauwelijks. Hier en daar gebreken maar niet hinderlijk. Alles kraakt wel erg maar het is een heerlijke grote ruimte en geen last van buren e.d. Belgische Broodjeszaak om de hoek en supermarkt ook. Bed ligt lekker en alles goed schoon. Via een lockbox makkelijk met binnentreden. Gratis parkeren bij P&R kinepolis (15min) naar de stad of in de straat parkeren €0.70 p/u tussen 9/19u.

Il breve soggiorno nell'appartamento di Christel è stato molto piacevole. Lo studio è in una location molto conveniente e tranquilla. L'ambiente è informale, stilish ed accogliente. Christel è stato sempre disponibile a fornire le informazoni richieste ed a risolvere piccoli inconvenienti. Il mio unico rammarico è di essere sempre stato fuori per lavoro e non avere goduto appieno dell'ambiente accogliente dello studio. La prossima volta che viaggerò ad Anversa sarà il mio posto favorito !
Marco
Conveniently located and well decorated !
Good value, close to Antwerp Centraal, flexible check-in/out time thanks to a magic lockbox.

Bastante bien ubicada ya que está a 5-10 minutos de la estación del tren y a unos 20 del centro. Limpia y acogedora aunque no muy grande. Tiene unas escaleras para acceder bastante empinadas pero si no tienes problemas de accesibilidad no es una pega. La cama es muy cómoda y el apartamento es cálido. Hemos estado a gusto

Heel goed geschikt voor een weekendje antwerpen! We hebben er genoten. Heel fijn huisje, het heeft veel voorzieningen, tv, koelkast, koffiezetautomaat etc. Enige puntjes waren dat er geen licht was in de wc zowel als in de slaapkamer en er zaten wat vlekjes in het beddengoed. En de douche had een hele zachte straal.
Christel's place is big, clean, perfectly decorated and in a really convenient location. I would definitely recommend it to everyone who travels in Antwerp!

Very easy with Christel.
We have spent a great time in Belgium. This studio is very confortable and only at 10min to the central station.
We recommend it!

Fijne communicatie met de gastvrouw. Check-in was erg fijn om zelfstandig te kunnen doen. Mooi appartement voor twee mensen. Alles zag er keurig uit en voorzieningen waren top. Leuke lounge-zit in de bovenste verdieping. Locatie alleen niet geheel centraal. Kortom, fijn weekend gehad erg genoten samen!

Perfect and cosy flat in Antwerpen.
We loved it :-)
Best Regards, Manu und Maya
Een fijne uitvalsbasis voor een paar dagen in de stad.
Goede locatie, mooi huis! Niks op aan te merken. Christel was extreem gastvrij. Helaas ziek geweest tijdens mijn verblijf, Christel is meteen langs gekomen. Enorm zorgzaam! Top host!
Prima verblijf gehad, met name geschikt voor een citytrip

We stayed in this place during our anniversary trip from Florida, USA. My wife and I really enjoyed this place, and we appreciated the funky colors throughout and the IKEA style furniture.

The skylights over the bed area were our favorite part and the unit was easy to get in/out of. Overall we really liked the place.

Some of the simple finishes could use a touch up like most AirBNB’s but overall the place was very clean.

Christel's studio was the perfect place for our stay in Antwerp. It's close to the central station and it's located in a quiet street. The room is quite bigger than I expected! Me and my boyfriend really enjoyed the skylights above the bed and in the kitchen, it makes the studio super cosy and nice to be at. It's definitely the kind of place you wish to get to after a long day!

Lovely apartment that is perfect for a couple. The bedroom is much more spacious than shown on the photos, and the terrace is also much bigger. Easy check-in and out system. We also loved the neighborhood and it is definitely worth a look around.

Très bon séjour, il a été très facile de communiquer avec Christel, nous ne l'avons pas rencontrée mais l'arrivée s'est faite très simplement. Le studio est au deuxième étage, très fonctionnel, les équipements sont très biens. La literie était incroyable, et le tout étant propre. Situé à deux pas du centre et des commerces, ce studio est idéal pour un petit voyage  à deux. Nous recommandons vivement le studio de Christel!
A lovely place to stay in Antwerp. Great value for money.
Super appartement, bien placé ! Hôte très gentille sur les horaires :)
We had a very nice stay in Cristel's flat !  We highly recommand it !

Το τυπικό βελγικο ύφος του σπιτιού σου αφήνει μια μοναδική εμπειρία διαμονής..!!! Καλαισθητος και προσεγμένος χώρος, με πολύ καλές παροχές που σε κάνει να νιώθεις σαν το σπίτι σου..!! Καταλυτικός παράγοντας να αγαπήσω την πρώτη μου airbnb εμπειρία..!! :) Συνεχίστε έτσι..!!

Christel's place is amazing! I highly recommend for anyone staying in Antwerp. It is very spacious, comfy, and cozy. There is a lovely loft, two bathrooms, a sizable bedroom, and very functional kitchen/cooking area (we even cooked two lovely meals on the stove). The bed was wonderful, and the blackout lights allow one to sleep until noon. Christel even provided a guidebook to help your stay in Antwerp be as lovely as possible. I recommend Christel without any hesitation!

De studio van Christel had alles wat je nodig hebt voor een paar dagen verblijf. Goede ligging tov centrum. Jammer dat we om 12 uur al moesten uitchecken, terwijl we op moment van boeking begrepen dat het flexibeler zou zijn. In het algemeen wel een goede ervaring!
Great apartment, in a great location, walking distance to all things we needed! Perfect space for two people. We loved our stay, would definitely go back!
Lovely clean studio apartment in Antwerp
Perfect little flat, very cosy with a nice terrace and just a few minutes away from the center

Christel's place is in a perfect location. You can walk to the train station as well as all the main highlights such as the main Square,  fort and Rubenshuis, etc. If you are North American and have never been to Europe before a reminder that in Europe the second floor means what we would call for the third floor. She was always quick to respond to any questions and I was able to leave my things at the flat earlier because of my flight. The bedroom is large, yo

It was very pleasant to stay at Christel's place. The apartment is very spacious, perfect for a couple! It is not central but you can do anything by walk from it. We didn't meet Christel but she was kind and was answerring very quickly to my messages. I highly recomend this place!

Потрясающее жилье, великолепное расположение, в пешей доступности вокзал, автовокзал и исторический центр города. Квартира очень стильно оформлена, и очень чистая.  На кухне есть все необходимое для приготовления еды. Отзывчивая хозяйка, всегда была на связи. Заселение проходит по инструкции, которую заранее высылают. Очень удобно продумано все. Всем советую это жилье.

Christels Wohnung ist eine schöne stylische Dachgeschosswohnung, gut gelegen in der Nähe des Bahnhofs.

Es ist alles vorhanden, eine Küche, in der man sich etwas kleines kochen kann, ein 140er Doppelbett mit Bad daneben und eine schöne Dachterrasse Halbetreppe.

Die Dachterrasse lädt ein für ein Willkommenagetränk oder ein kleines Frühstück zu zweit.

Einiges könnte erneuter werden, insgesamt ist die Wohnung perfekt für 2.

Wir mochten die Lage zwischen Bahnhof und dem Sportpaleis. Dies war ideal für uns.
Um die Ecke gibt es einige Leihfahrräder und nachts gibt es Spätgeschäfte .

Wir kommen gerne wieder.

Il nostro soggiorno da Christel è stato molto piacevole. Il letto è comodo, la casa spaziosa e ben attrezzata (anche la cucina). Ci sono anche ventilatori e anti zanzare per le nottate più calde. E poi è vicinissima alla stazione e al centro. La vera chicca è il terrazzino: perfetto per fare colazione o per bersi un ultima birra prima di rimettersi in viaggio. Lo consiglio!

El alojamiento de Christel está muy bonito, acogedor, amplio y perfectamente limpio, con una ubicación excelente pues se encuentra a 6 minutos caminando, de la estación de tren. Un lugar donde cualquier viajero quiere llegar.

Good location, spacious and well equipped apartment, 2 toilets, nice kitchen, 3 sinks, 2nd floor, walking distance to everything, it was very nice. Mattress is a bit outdated, also main apartment slide doors  don't give a feeling of security. Everything else was perfect, 5stars.

Studio propre.
Quelques points négatifs:
-le quartier sâle
-le manque de finition : pas de bouton pour la chasse d'eau de la toilette, le robinet de la salle de bain qui tenait à moitié.
-le fait qu'on ressens que la personne ne vit pas là

Overall was good stay. Easy checkin with lockbox. The apartment was largish for a studio, but is in the attic, so it  had some short sloped ceilings, so for tall people like me navigating in the kitchen and spare room was tough. The bed was kinda soft and seemed pretty old, so was not so comfortable, but other than that everything was fine.
I'm natively from the area. This apartment is really good, clean and cosy. Thank you christel for the hospitality.
Idéal pour un week end en amoureux !
Het appartement is erg ruim en schoon. Fijne locatie met tramhaltes dichtbij. Prettige verblijf voor tijdens een stedentrip!
Studio et hôtesse très agréables avec un point particulier pour la terrasse dont nous avons très bien profité !

Perfect apartment for visiting Antwerp for business or pleasure! 10 min walk to the city center. The building is located on a cozy, clean and quiet street. The apartment is well-equipped, stylish and very comfortable to stay in for a couple of days or for a week, I’d recommend it to anybody.

The appartment is quite big and confortable, but we didnt love the neighborhood which was not very clean. The appartment could use a little painting and a few repairs but overall it is Nice. Christel was very welcoming and she set up à super useful information box with Maps and activites.
Отличная квартира, просторная, со всеми удобствами, кроме стиральной машины. Не совсем понравилось местоположение - в радиусе километра очень сильно неприятные запахи

A convenient location near the central station and lots of room for two people! We didn’t do much in the way of cooking but everything is there if you need it. We really enjoyed our time in Antwerp at Christel’s studio.

Уютная квартира. Благодаря инструкции без проблем смогли найти ключи от дома, в квартире был хорошо работающий вай-фай, в ванной горячая вода и полотенца, на кухне вся необходимая посуда. Не понравился  запах канализации, который присутствовал несколько суток на кухне и не самая чистая посуда. Квартал,  так же грязноват, но это не зависит от хозяев. В доме очень крутая лестница и нет лифта, поэтому, если у вас большой багаж, могут возникнуть проблемы и неудобства при занесении багажа в квартиру. Остальное было хорошо, в целом,  рекомендую данное жилье. Спасибо Кристел за гостеприимство!

Très bon rapport qualité prix emplacement.
Je recommande cette appartement qui nous a permis de passer un excellent séjour à Anvers.
Located at 15 minutes by foot from the center and with very well designed custom furniture this place is a good and cheap way into Antwerp.
Great spot to stay in a diverse neighborhood of Antwerp.
Kontakt zuverlässig und freundlich.
Een leuke studio van alle gemakken voorzien!
Good location within walking distance of central station. Nice addition of a balcony you can use.

We throroughly enjoyed our stay at Christel's studio. The studio was clean, and larger than expected. Location is brilliant - about a 20 minute walk into central Antwerp. Check in was very easy, and Christel was a very responsive host. Thank you!
Very clean and confortable.
Appartement propre et calme et bien situé
We liked staying at Christel's! The Apartment was perfectly located to discover the wonderful city by foot.

Der Austausch mit Christel war schnell und sehr nett. Das Appartment liegt in einem multikulturellen Teil der Stadt, alles ist in 15-20 min zu fuß gut zu erreichen. Leider kam immer wieder ein unangenehmer Geruch aus dem Bad, besonders an Regentagen.
Für eine Woche ein kleines aber feines Apartment.
Great location and lovely cosy apartment

Fijn, leuk en betaalbare studio voor met z’n 2en. Alles goed geregeld en volgens afspraak.
Aanrader!
It’s a nice place close to the station. Easy to find and central.  Te bed is very soft, I battled to sleep on it.  Bring mosquito repellent! For the rest a top location.
Nice place for a short stay, area not the best for walking around at night ,  but Christel and her partner were very responsive to any questions
Perfect studio for couples! We enjoyed the vibrant neighborhood as well, might not be the chique place one would look for, but definitely a special and interesting area.
Great place that is very close to the city centre ! Thanks for having us stay !

We loved staying at Christel's place, we spent 5 nights here and used this as a base for exploring Belgium. The apartment was surprisingly larger than we were were expecting. The bed was very comfortable, the WiFi is fast and the location is situated just a short 10-15 minute walk from the main train station. We cooked most nights as the Lidl and Aldi grocery stores are only about a 5 minute walk away. We loved the skylights in the apartment, and loved seeing the stars before falling asleep. Check-in and check-out was easy and we also appreciated the late 12hr check-out time offered. The only downside we have to say is that the bathroom did have some sewerage smells. We also wished we had some proper cooking knives and a dish-drying rack included in the kitchen. But other than these things, we had a fantastic time visiting.

Christel Studio is really a work of art. You wouldn't expect that as you enter the building but once you've entered the studio you get a cozy and stylish apartment furnished with everything you need, from the kitchen to the bathroom. There's plenty of light coming from the ceiling's windows and even having breakfast feels like a situation you should take a picture of since everythins look soo fancy!
The neighborhood is great, you are surrounded by other old fashioned houses but there are shops just around the corner, and of course it's within a walking distance from the city center.
The chek-in/out is easy and smooth.
Even thought we didn't met Christel in person she still managed to show what a great host she is: since it's december she stepped by just to leave a tiny christmas tree to put into the studio to "get in the mood".
Totally recommended.

We really enjoyed Christel's place. It's very cozy and comfortable, we felt like at home (if not better). The studio is very close to the central station (about 10 minutes walking) and there are a lot of maps that can help you to orient. The small living room on top was really a plus :) everything was clean and the check-in was really fast.
I really loved this studio. If i'll ever come back to Antwerp, for sure i'll come back here.
Thanks to christel for an amazing time in anwerp! Super friendly,  felt right at home.
Great host! Place is great, bigger than it looks.
Christel is heel gastvrij en goed bereikbaar! Gemakkelijk in en uitchecken door sleutellockerbox. Fijne ruimte en prima locatie. 8 min lopen van centraal!
Very cozy apartment , feel myself like at home:)
Très bon endroit, agréable et bien situé!
La verdad es que el alojamiento nos ha encantado. Muy original y bonito. Un gustazo haber podido alojarnos en él.

Our stay in Christel’s apartment was lovely. Within a 15 minute walk of the station, it was the ideal location to explore Antwerp, as well as further cities. The check in process was very flexible and easy, and the apartment was as lovely as it is pictured. The sloping windows over the bed and the loft nook were delightful and really added to the experience. Definitely would come back again.

We arrived in Antwerp for the first time and we were very lucky that we chose Christel's apartment.
Continuous Internet, supermarket and train station within walking distance, extremely cute interior, and especially the view from the window in the bedroom, namely the endless traces of airplanes that cut the sky - all this will forever remain in our hearts.
Staying at Christel's studio was truly magnificent. Comfortable, clean and beautiful. Definitely recommend!!!

We had a lovely stay at Christels apartment. Within walking distance from the central station and the city center but in a more remote neighbourhood it is perfectly located. The appartement was neat and bigger then we thought, with a comfortable bed and a good bathroom. Christel was very polite and responded very quick on messages, incheck procedure was very easy! Thanks Christel for letting us stay in your apartment!
Great apartment that has all the amenities that you need and its a 10min walk to the center. Very easy check in and check out. I recommended for everyone.
Thank you for being so welcoming to us.

Very cute maisonette studio with many amenities like coffee machine including coffee and tea.
Good location, only 20 min by foot to the grand place.
Public transport directly around the corner.

Dear Christel,

thank you for having us in your cozy apartment with very interesting layout. We enjoyed our stay in Antwerp. The location was just perfect to walk to the central station. There are different restraunts and shopping possibilities only about 5-10 min walk from the apartment.

Liebe Grüße aus Deutschland
Mina
Nice. Cosy flat. Great host. Good location.
Very good value for money. Spacious and clean apartment!
Nous n'avons pas fait la connaissance de notre hôte mais l'appartement était bien équipé et assez accueillant.

Had a beautiful stay in this cute apartment, super clean, nicely decorated and pretty central. Christel is also very kind and wrote as all the information way before our check in. Would recommend this one to everyone who wants to visit Antwerp together with a friend

Christel's charming apartment is easy to get to from the central train station. Thanks to its convenient​ location, getting to any main attraction or cool area in Antwerp was incredibly simple. I would definitely recommend the apartment to anyone wanting to stay in Antwerp for a few nights.
Very nice and comfortable place, lovely decoration, a bit further from the center than expected but very close to transportation. Christel was very kind and prompt to help in anyway she could
Chistel's is what she says it is,very well located and Christel is very responsive. The apartment was very clean and had nice decorative touches.
De studio is netjes en schoon. Het centrum en bezienswaardigheden zijn veelal op loopafstand.

Well equipped apartment at the top of some narrow stairs. Clean and tidy inside with good WiFi,
Comfortable bed and a desk. Only 10 minutes walk from the station so great choice for a few days in Antwerp on business.

The appartment is located in a cute small house, the terrace is also very nice. You can find everything you need there.
It's not far from the city center to walk or to use escooters.
I really recommend this accommodation for a short stay in antwerpen.

Much more spacious than one would anticipate. There are several narrow flights of stairs to climb to get to the top. It gets a bit hot but there are large windows and the floors are squeaky but it's an adorable place and definitely a good choice if you are looking for value!

En cercanías de la estación de Central de Amberes
Bien de limpieza
Posiblemente caluroso en verano, ya que es un ático

Für einen kurzen Aufenthalt ist die Wohnung absolut in Ordnung! Der Kontakt (Nachrichten) mit Christel war nett, der Check-in / -out absolut problemlos. Die Stadt ist fußgängig zu erreichen, ein Supermarkt gleich um die Ecke.
Die Küche und das Geschirr waren nicht super sauber und aus dem Abfluss kam ein unangenehmer Geruch.

Well placed, walkable and close to most of the stuff you want to do and see.  Even the further reaches to the MAS is not all that far! The appartment is on a side street, helping with quieting the general city noise. A snug fit but comfortable, clean and a very decent stay for 2. Well worth it!
Great Stay! Not far from city centre, very simple check-in procedure and fantastic communication from Christel. Would recommend !
Great place - clean, well located and comfortable place. Much recommended!
Schattig appartement, precies goed voor accommodatie tijdens een city trip!
Heel tof verblijf! Plus goed te voet te bereiken vanaf het centrum/centraal station. Zeker aan te raden

Christel's place is great value for money. It felt nice and homely and the bed is very comfortable which is a huge plus for a bad sleeper like me. Christel was very helpful with her responses. Also, the apartment is in a colourful area of the city with plenty of shops and places to eat. The central train station is just a 10 minute walk from the apartment. I would stay here again.
Everything was wonderful, lovely apartment!!!
Nice place! easy to get to the city center and close to transport too ,

It's a very cool place, close walking distance to the train station, which is what we needed. The host was responsive, and the self check in was very convenient. We did visit in high summer, which makes the attic style non-airconditioned space sweltering at times, however the host does provide fans. My only note of concern is the bathroom and lack of ventilation, which caused a humidity smell in the space no matter how much we tried airing it out.
Lovely studio not far from the central station. The check-in was very easy and Christel was a great host.

Gemütliches Dachgeschossapartment, zentral gelegen. An heißen Tagen kann es dort sehr warm werden, aber es sind einige Ventilatoren vorhanden. Die Wohnung hat keinen Mückenschutz, daher gibt es viele Mücken. Kaum freie Parkplätze in der Nähe. Öffentliche Verkehrmittel in der Nähe. Christel hat auf alle Anfragen schnell geantwortet. Der Check in mit einer Schlüsselbox war problemlos.
Christel's appartment is very clean and within walking distance to the city center. The kitchen is well equipped and the living room is lovely. Highly recommend!
Ruime studio, prima voorzieningen. Duidelijke communicatie vanuit Christel. Niet heel centraal gelegen en in de slaapkamer hoor je geluiden van buiten (o.a. de tram).
Appartement très cosy et bien situé dans quartier calme, proche du tram. Bon rapport qualité prix.
Christel’s apartment is great for anyone looking to explore Antwerp. Within easy distance from the train station, it’s easy to get around. Great value for money too, with plenty of space

As advertised. Self check in was easy and responses from host were quick. Several fixtures were broken but still worked (both toilet flushers, and a bathroom faucet)

Diverse local neighbourhood, but never felt unsafe. 20 minute walk from downtown, 12 minute walk to train station.
Excellent little place to visit Antwerp. Cosy and comfortable place. Very comfy bed.
Sitio bonito, decorado con mucho gusto, comunicación perfecta.

Very pretty and functional house: super reccomended!
Easy to check-in and check-out and very nice location!!
Goed...
The apartment is nice, is situated fairly close to the centre (20min walk), but the area is maybe not the safest at night. Overall, good
Prima accommodatie

Beautiful studio. It was as described, conveniently placed, clean, modern, fully equipped and warm when we needed it.

Great flexibility for the check-in and out. That helped us a lot in order to manage our time more efficiently.

Recommended.
super Aufenthalt, gerne wieder!
The apartment was charming and an easy walk from the train station as well as several streets of restaurants, but the neighborhood itself was quiet. I'd stay here again!

Praktisch in het centrum, op loopafstand van station, MAS en centrum een stijlvol ingerichte studio. Schoon en gezellig.
Heerlijk met mijn dochter de achterafstraatjes, de vrijdagmarkt en het MAS bezocht. De Japan tentoonstelling tot maart '20 is zeer de moeite waard.

Our stay was delightful! The check in process was very easy and the apartment was larger than expected! Always nice and warm. Was a bit further from the city centre but a very manageable walk. Thanks Christel :))
Gute Lage, wenige Minuten von Bahnhof und Diamantenviertel entfernt. Toller Supermarkt ist auch in der Nähe und der Kontakt zu Christel war angenehm.
Bigger than it looks in the photos. Good location. Quick responses. It worths the price.

Très bien situé. À pied : 15 min de la Gare centrale, 20 min du centre piéton.
Appartement spacieux!
On entend le tram la nuit mais sinon : parfait!
Prima appartement op goede locatie in de stad. Paar aandachtspuntjes qua netheid en stank, maar communicatie en inchecken verliep soepel.

Endroit super chaleureux, super pour un city trip d'un week end en amoureux.
Café et thé à disposition. Cuisine à l'équipement tout a fait suffisant!
On recommande vivement!

Nous conseillons de se munir de l'antwerpen city card, disponible en ligne, pour faciliter les déplacements et les visites, vraiment un atout!

Apartamento cómodo, limpio y confortable a 12 minutos de la Estación Central de Amberes. Llegada autónoma (el anfitrión da instrucciones sencillas para obtener las llaves). El apartamento está equipado con todo lo necesario para que la estancia sea cómoda y agradable. Muy recomendable.
Een keurige ruimte voor twee personen op een bescheiden wandelafstand van het Centraal Station van Antwerpen.

A nice studio with an access to a terrace. The keys were in a lockbox which was really practical because we arrived around midnight, no need to make a meeting to get them. The floor is squeaky but the flat is spacious so it is pleasant for two and for a longer stay.
Not far from the city center (20 min by foot), It was a pleasant stay, I'd recommend

A lovely space with all the supplies one might need. Plenty of stuff to cook with, plenty of information about the city, and a really pretty place overall. The location is really close to Centraal station, so a perfect staging area for adventures :)

Die Wohnung war wie beschrieben.
Sauber und an Kleinigkeiten gedacht (Kaffee, Tee, Gewürze...usw.)
Für längere Aufenthalte, etwas klein. Durch die Schrägen, nichts für große Menschen.
Leider kein deutsches Fernseh. Gab leider nur Antennen- Fernsehen.
Nice and cozy appartement with a good location
Nice charming 1,5 room flat in the center of Antwerp. Everything for the daily was available. Especially the terrace was nice.
a 10 minutes de la gare, commerces a proximité calme
Snelle communicatie en een goed appartement (is groter dan wat de foto’S laten blijken. Goede locatie!
Nice location, many shops around. It’s only 10’ from the center. Cozy place to stay, definately 5/5
Veel groter dan de foto's doen blijken! Op wandelafstand van het centraal station en het openbaar vervoer.

Merci pour cette petite semaine, un appartement très cocoon, parfait pour un couple de vadrouilleur !

Je recommande
Bedankt voor het verblijf, het is heel goed verlopen. Antwerpen is een erg mooie stad. Goedendag!

Heel gezellige plek in een levendige buurt vlakbij het centrum, ideaal om de stad te verkennen. Alles wat we nodig hadden was aanwezig, en de zithoek in het bovenste gedeelte van het appartement is een heerlijke plek om te zitten lezen of een beetje bij te kletsen. Bedankt Christel!
Logement très agréable et bien situé
Cozy place
Enjoyed my stay @ Christel’s studio! Perfect for a couple visiting Antwerp for a few days. The terrace is definetely a PLUS.

Vele groter als op de foto’s blijkt.

Christel is een super host. Heel goed bereikbaar en heel behulpzaam. De studio is zeker in orde, je hebt alles wat je moet hebben om een tijdje te overnachten in centrum Antwerpen.
Mooie grote accomodatie met vriendelijke mensen! Inchecken en uitchecken gaat heel vlot.
Cozy appartement in a top location, clear and friendly communication and easy check in. Recommended!
The apartment was charming and an easy walk from the train station and walking distance to the city centre too!  A good place to stay for a few days in Antwerp.
Joli studio bien aménagé. Bon rapport qualité prix mais quelques petits détails a  revoir (taques de cuisson, pression eau chaude...)
Everything went smooth. Good location, 20 min walk to the city center. Would recommend!

Een gezellig verblijf waar alles aanwezig is wat je nodig hebt.
Alleen waren voor mij persoonlijk (1m86) sommige ruimtes (zoals badkamer en deeltje keuken) wat krap in hoogte.
Voor het overige , vlotte communicatie, ruime slaapkamer en rustig gelegen.
Thanks Christel

Très bonne communication avec la propriétaire qui s'est montrée serviable, cordiale et arrangeante, ce qui est très agréable ! L'espace est bien optimisé et le logement est agencé avec goût. Il est en plus bien localisé et le quartier alentour, agréable, se trouve assez  près du port, de commerces et de plusieurs musées. Ce logement nous a permis de pouvoir visiter la ville qui est de surcroît vraiment charmante et regorge de choses à faire. Nous recommandons !
Well located place. The terrace is very nice.

Great spacious studio! Close to downtown, great location. Very neat and tidy!
Will be back!
Duidelijke communicatie vanuit Christel. Zij reageert snel. Verder is het een top verblijf dichtbij het centrum van Antwerpen.

Would definitely recommend this lovely apartment in the center of antwerp.
It was super clean and has everything you need during your stay. The host is also very friendly. 10/10
Bon petit flat, sympa et cosy. Localisation un peu excentrée dans un quartier multiculturel à 20min à pieds du centre.

Samen met mijn lief 4 nachten verbleven in de rustige buurt dichtbij centraal station. Makkelijk te bereiken met tram 12. De ruimte is zeer schoon en ruimtelijk met eigen keuken. Christel was zeer vriendelijk en alles was duidelijk doorgegeven. Altijd een tip is om eigen fietsen te huren, makkelijk te doen bij Centraal Station. Dagje Gent ook altijd aan te raden.

Check in ist dank Schlüsselkasten super unkompliziert und jederzeit möglich.
Die Lage der Wohnung ist für eine Tour durch die Stadt super geeignet (ca. 15 min zu Fuß). Jedoch, ist wer einen leichten Schlaf hat hier nicht so gut aufgehoben, da die Straßenbahn direkt vor dem Haus Fährt.
Mit geschlossenen Fenster geht es, jedoch wird es dann recht schnell warm(DG Wohnung)
Sonst war alles sauber und gut ausgestattet

Studio très agréable pour un couple. Bien positionné dans Anvers (pas dans le centre-même, mais à 10min à pieds), accessible par tram. L'intérieur et la décoration sont très cosy. Attention cependant à réfléchir avant à l'endroit pour se garer (la rue est payante).

Fijne, nette en ruime studio. Alle basis spullen zijn voorhanden. Ik heb enkel last gehad van de tram, die rijdt tot na middernacht nog voorbij. Ook ‘s nachts redelijk wat lawaai van de populatie die in de buurt woont. Verder zeker een aanrader!!

Een nette en schone studio, op een goede lokatie.
10 min lopen naar Centrum/Centraal station.
Parkeren kan voor de deur van 09:00 tot 19:00 ( €13.90) Wanneer wij weer naar Antwerpen zouden gaan, kiezen we weer voor deze studio.

This is a charming, comfortable little flat about a ten minute walk from Antwerp Centraal. It's in a diverse neighborhood with excellent food options. The bed is comfy and the room is dark.

The floors are extra creaky, but I felt like that really added to the charm of the place.

Don't miss out on the neat upstairs sitting area! I almost didn't notice it.
Heel mooi, gezellig en licht appartement. Sympathiek en makkelijk contact. Ik zal definitief terug komen!
Had a great stay. Nice place and good location. Easy to check in and out.

Fijn verblijf in een leuke multiculturele wijk. We hebben genoten van alle faciliteiten in het appartement. Prima bed, handig keukentje en een aparte knusse living. Tip: wat extra handdoeken voor wat langer verblijf.
Todo según la descripción!

A nice studio for its price. The neighbourhood might be a bit loud in the mornings, also the main apartment door is a sliding one and there's a small gap even when it's locked. Other than that, it pretty much matches the description, all good, the WiFi works perfectly well. Special thanks for having separate containers for waste recycling!
L'appartement est proche de la gare, et le centre ville est accessible à pieds. Tout est super propre et conforme à l'annonce. Très bon séjour !
The studio was clean, warm & conveniently located in the Station area. Great places to get coffee or breakfast items in the area.
Ottima posizione facilmente raggiungibile dalla stazione e dal centro. Tutto pulito e ben attrezzato. Facile check-in e check-out grazie alla cassetta di sicurezza. Ottimo rapporto qualità prezzo.
Great apartment and host, thanks for having us!
Christel is very available and kind

Prima verblijf. Erg schoon en netjes en goede communicatie. Fijn dat er een balkon was. Goede prijs - kwaliteit verhouding en met een btje restyling is veel meer potentie uit deze ruimte te halen.

Wel veel huisregels die echt overal hingen, boetes bij overtreding, en op mij ongastvrij overkwamen. Zelfs je bed op moeten maken bij vertrek. De voordeur zachtjes dicht doen was bovendien onmogelijk.

(Schuif)Deur van de studio sluit moeilijk en niet volledig af waardoor ik me in deze buurt niet echt veilig voelde.
We enjoyed our stay in the loft, it is very spacious and has a good atmosphere. It is within walking distance on Antwerp Central station which was convenient. I would recommend people to stay here.

This loft is perfect for people who wants to have space, relaxing and to visit Antwerp! We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment, it's spacey, comfortable, modern and clean. The beds are soft and cosy and the living room is perfect to drink a cup of coffee with a view over Antwerp at the background! After a long day walking you can make a kings meal in the well-equipt kitchen. It's quite basic but just enough for a city trip. Just for your info, there are no locks on the bathroom and toilet doors, not a big issue but maybe something to think about. Unfortunately we had a small issue with Marie and she directly threatened us with taking the deposit. Not a really fancy way to have contact with your guests, so thats why we don't give 5 stars. The loft itself is definitely worth it!
Verbleven voor een weekend in Antwerpen met 6 meiden. Iedereen vond het super mooi. In het echt is de grootte van het huis nog beter dan op de foto's. Marie was een goede host.

We had a wonderful stay at Marie's place. The flat is awesome. Cosy, spacious and very unique. Meeting Marie was nice as well. She handed us the keys and gave us great tips for getting around in Antwerp. We definitely recommend her place and Marie as an easy going host. We'd love to come back on day.

From now on this will be the place where I stay when visiting Antwerp. It's a gorgeous apartment with all the practical things you need and Marie is a great host. We visited with 6 guys and had the best time. Marie thanks for everything!

Wij hebben het erg naar ons zin gehad in het appartement. Prima keuken, fijne bedden en veel ruimte met z'n zessen. Genoten van het uitzicht. De locatie is gunstig ten opzichte van het station en centrum.

Let wel op dat je bij het plannen van de route Borgerhout (district binnen Antwerpen) invult, anders kom je verder buiten het centrum terecht (wat ons overkwam) en dat is jammer van je tijd!

nous avons été très bien accueillis par notre hôte; celui ci nous a d'emblée parlé français et a mis du café à notre disposition; l'appartement très lumineux et très propre était tout à fait conforme aux photos et descriptif.

Ieder jaar gaan wij met 6 vriendinnen een weekend weg. Ditmaal mochten wij verblijven in deze luxueuze loft. De ruimten zijn groot en op te delen. Waardoor je zowel knus kunt samenzijn als wel een moment voor jezelf pakken. Onze gastheer Ian stond altijd paraat en is zeer vriendelijk en behulpzaam. Het huis ligt op loopafstand van het station, is een verborgen parel en heeft de lekkerste dekbedden ooit. We raden deze loft ten zeerste aan!

De ontvangst door Marie was flexibel! We mochten/konden er wat eerder in. Dat was top. Goede tips gehad om door de stad te struinen, leuke plekken en openbaar vervoer. Lekkere restaurant tip aan de overkant.
Het appartement zag er 'in het echt' beter uit als op de foto's. Het was van alle luxe en gemakken voorzien om een heerlijk weekend in Antwerpen te hebben.
Ian en Marie, bedankt! Jullie hebben ons verblijf in Antwerpen nog plesanter gemaakt dan verwacht!!

Groet
Paul
Fijn en zeer ruim appartement, van alle gemakken voorzien. Tram stopt voor de deur. Aanrader!

Ian and Marie were most helpful and great hosts.
The apartment is magnificent and the views from the lounge and bedroom spectacular.
My wife and I liked walking into the city centre, the other couple with us preferred to catch the tram. Either way you have easy access to the Meir shopping and historic districts.
We really enjoyed our stay here - the stairs are quite big for carrying the bags up, so glad we only had to do that on arrival and departure.
Een uitstekende plek voor een weekendje Antwerpen.

Fantastic appartment in the typical belgium style: light, quietness, very confortable with 2 bathrooms and separated rooms. Very well equiped !
close from central station and city center with ligne 10 or 24 tram.
Ian even prepared a Christmass tree which was very appreciated in this period
Appartement très spacieux et agréable proche des transports publics vers le centre ville (tramway 10)

We were 6 girls that spent New Year's Eve in Marie's appartment. The appartment looks exactly like on the the photos, maybe even prettier ;-) Marie was an easy going host that welcomed us and gave us some tipps what to see and do in Antwerp. Furthermore, there was still a decorated Christmas tree in the appartment which made us feel at home from the first second. The kitchen is well equipped and the two bathrooms were also enough for 6 persons.
The appartement is located 2 tram stations from the Central station on a main road. However, as the appartment is on the third or fourth floor and there is also a quiet backyard, you don't hear any noise from the street and the location of the appartment is a big advantage. As the tram station is directly in front of the house door, it is very easy to get to the main shopping street, the habour or any restaurants/bars. Thus, the appartement was perfect for a girls trip!
We can really recommend Marie's appartment and would like to thanks her for the nice stay!

Ruimte is prachtig. Alleen ontbraken wc papier en een goedwerkende WiFi. Voor de prijs hadden we ook wel een vaatwasser verwacht. Marie is een hele vriendelijke en behulpzame dame. We voelden ons zeer welkom.

Clean, spacious, and even better than in the photographs; I'd fully recommend Marie's beautiful apartment to anyone looking for a place to stay in Antwerp. Marie was an extremely helpful and diligent host, and made everything very easy and clear. Definitely a 5/5 Airbnb experience.

The Loft and the whole house is soo beautiful.
Never seen something like this bevore on airbnb! And ian is a very nice komunicative Lady.
Maybe we come again to Antwerp, but when, were looking fourward to stay again in this house.
Thank you ian!

Het appartement is mooier en groter dan op de foto's lijkt. Marie was erg behulpzaam en de locatie is ongeveer 10 minuten vanaf de binnenstad. Je zit wel in een drukke straat met veel winkels en het openbaar vervoer is direct voor de deur. Als ik weer naar Antwerpen toe ga dan is dit mijn eerste keus!

Our trip in Antwerp was great. The flat was perfect, really big for 5 people. There is everything you need. Its well located, near the center. We were greatly welcome, Marie was really Nice And she gave us lots of information for the week end ! It was great
Very spacious, stylish apartment with good views of the city and walkable from the main station. Nicely equipped kitchen and very friendly hosts. Thanks!
Super nice and spacious loft. We had a great time! Ian, Jande and Marie were very helpful and flexibel when needed.
Bijzonder appartement en erg mooi qua uitzicht. Kamers met sfeer. Netjes onderhouden. Dichtbij bij Centraal Station.
Comfortable and excellent stay. Easy to find, good check in and very spacious. Would recommend.
Very spacious apartment with good view. Kitchen is well equipped. Enjoyed the stay. The apartment is located on the fourth floor; quite some stairs for ppl with big luggage.
Wir haben zu viert ein Wochenende in der tollen Altbauwohnung von Marie verbracht. Die Wohnung ist noch schöner als auf den Bildern. Absolut empfehlenswert!!

Supermooi appartement!
We hebben met 5 vriendinnen een heel leuk weekend doorgebracht in Antwerpen en het appartement voldeed helemaal aan onze verwachtingen.
Ik zou een verblijf hier zeker aanbevelen en zou zelf ook zeker terugkeren als ik weer naar Antwerpen ga!

the Apartment is very fine, very big, Equipment is best, we didn´t miss anything. The Location is Close to the central Station, Supermarket and bakery in Walking distance, round the block is a bike Rental Station, so it´s quite easy to explore the City by bike. We missed an functional wifi and a reaction of the host. We didn´t suppose this great Apartment behind the facade and in the neighborhood, which is multi culturell. All in all the Apartment is highly recomended.

Très jolie demeure d'époque. Balcon un peu petit comparer au 160m2 d'appartement.
Très bon séjour !!..

Sehr gelungener Wochenendtrip nach Antwerpen. Etwas holprige Anreise, da es die Straße nicht nur einmal in Antwerpen gibt.
Ansonsten: Toller Ausblick! Sehr schöne und charmante Wohnung!

Een fijn en groot appartement! Heerlijke ruimtes. We hebben hier met 7 dames een erg leuk weekend gehad! 10 minuutjes lopen vanaf het centraal station. Antwerpen op de fiets verkennen  is een aanrader (fietsstation om de hoek).
Prachtig huis, en fijn verblijf!

The apartment is really spacious with an old world charm and contains more than the expected amenities. There is a great coffee machine with coffee beans. The beds are very comfortable and there is ample room for relaxing. The location is not ideal but there is public transport close to the apartment which can be used to get to the sights of Antwerp. We enjoyed our stay very much.

We were on the final part of the journey through Europe via motorcycles. When we arrived Marie greeted us and took us up to the apartment. Marie was a great haste explained everything about the apartment and even left some notes on local restaurants and bars and with a map showing where they were.

The apartment is truly fantastic. Looking at the photos it looks very nice but they really don't do it justice it is absolutely beautiful. Everything is well-equipped including espresso maker fridge oven et cetera and Wi-Fi which works very well.

Marie kindly arranged with one of her neighbours for us to use their garage for the evening to store the motorcycles.

A great apartment, a great stay, would love to come and visit again perhaps longer next time.
Een fijn luxueus stijlvol huis met vier prima slaapplaatsen, vrij dicht bij het station, om langer te verblijven heel geschikt. Fijne vriendelijke behulpzame verhuurder.
Mooi ruim appartement op een steenworp afstand van centraal station. Fijne bedden! De communicatie verliep gemakkelijk. We hopen snel nog een keer terug te komen.
Grote sfeervolle woning, op loopafstand van het Centraal Station.
We had such a great time in this flat. Exactly as shown in the photos. Veto bikes close by and the hosts were very helpful. Beautiful flat!!
