Our stay was very pleasant! The apartment is very beautiful, nicely decorated and clean! Our host Lauren, was very helpful and explained us everything we had to know for our stay. Highly recommended!!!

Huge flat with plenty of space and magnificent period features.  The walk up the stairs has been mentioned but this keeps you fit.  Other guests in apartments were a little noisy and seemed to be there for a party.  The walk into the centre of town is perfectly doable - we walked back with two kids aged 6 and 10.  Tram trip for family cost Euro 12 into town - a surprisingly high price - maybe we didn't get best value tickets.  Surrounding area is 'up and coming'.  Roadworks in town provided a challenge getting to the flat by satnav with a number of detours.
Such an amazing experience ! Gorgeous apartment located conveniently and easy to find. Marie was a great host and took care of anything we needed ! We enjoyed our stay and will be back again !
Un viaje excepcional. Amberes una delicia.

We visited this loft with six girls for a fun weekend trip! It is a very impressive place with all you need! It accommodates six very easily and comfy. Everything was around you need, even a fully equipped espresso and cappuccino machine! Check in and check out was very easy, we highly recommend this place!
Alles prima in orde, prachtig pand, wel op 4de verdieping! Vele trappen ! Zeker een aanrader !

We hebben een heerlijk weekend gehad in het Appartement van Jan en Marie. Mooi ruim appartement met een prachtige ruime keuken! Op 15/20 minuten lopen vanaf het centrum, wij hebben fietsen gehuurd, de fietsafstand was minder dan 5 minuten.

Het kan gehorig zijn in het gebouw, bij aankomst werd dit verteld en werd er nadrukkelijk verzocht om rekening met de buren te houden. Ondanks dat er onder ons een groep jongeren verbleef hebben we hier weinig tot geen last van gehad!

Al met al een heerlijk weekendje gehad, zeker een aanrader!
Een bijzonder smaakvolle en verrassend grote loft. We waren blij verrast.

Die Wohnung ist noch schöner als auf den Fotos. Sie ist sehr liebevoll eingerichtet und es war alles vorhanden, so dass wir uns nach dem ausräumen der Koffer sofort zuhause gefühlt haben. Sie hat zudem einen wunderschönen Ausblick über die Stadt ! Der Central Station, Zoo und das Diamantenviertel sind gut zu Fuß erreichbar. Die Wohnung liegt in einem kulturellen Viertel mit Flair.
De foto's zijn zoals het appartement ook echt is! Ruim,licht en vooral schoon appartement. We hebben ervan genoten.

This is the 6th year that we have stayed at Marie's place.
As every year it was a pleasure.

Een fantastisch huis met veel karakter en meer dan genoeg ruimte! Het was iets verder lopen van het centrum dan verwacht. Het parkeren in de buurt is wat lastig in de buurt maar verder een top verblijf gehad!
Wonderful house, spatious and confortable, according to expectations. Marie is a perfect host! Highly recomendable

This place is downright incredible! It was a great oasis for our family to enjoy. Beds were very comfortable and the two living rooms were so relaxing and beautiful. The kitchen is also very well equipped and was a pleasure to cook in. The hosts were very responsive and made sure every detail was right upon arrival.

Some things to keep in mind for travelers...the apartment is up four flights of stairs, no lift. The public tram can take you right into the center of Antwerp. If you have a car, street parking is very cheap on the backstreets off of Tournhoutsebaan and it is not too hard to find.
Beautiful and comfortable apartment with all amenities. Highly recommended.
Great apartment, good (though at first surprising) location and wonderful guests. This is a holiday apartment, so don't expect a really personal touch.
Apartament extraordinari, confortable,ben equipat i fet amb molt bon gust! Per recomanar!!!!!

The place was gorgeous gorgeous gorgeous!!! Almost wanted to stay and just hang at the apartment it was so stunning. There was even a pretty Christmas tree up for the holidays. Communication with hostess was great and when we were out of sugar for coffee and lost wifi, she responded immediately. It's about a 15-20 minute walk to the city center--straight, easy walk--and there is a tram very close by, but almost better to walk since the tram schedule is a bit difficult to figure out.
There are several nice bakeries within a block of the apartment. Lots of suggestions for places to eat and visit and a guidebook to peruse for your stay.

A large and versatile apartment in a grand building located in a cosmopolitan suburb within walking distance of the central station and zoo.  Five flights up (no lift) the views from the balcony are excellent.  The kitchen is spacious with a large table but equipment is basic and sparse.
房子很漂亮很宽敞房东人很好
Perfecte plek, schitterende locatie, heerlijke bedden!
Impressive and beautiful apartment. Great host!
Mooie locatie, was voorzien van alles. We misten niets.

Perfecte plek - schitterend pand - ruimte is gigantisch en inrichting stijlvol. Trams en bussen voor de deur.
Een aanrader

Ontzettend mooie en fijne airbnb!
Het was erg ruimtelijk en authentiek, overdag veel licht in huis en een balkon aan de zon zijde. Bedden liggen fijn,
we hebben het ervaren als een luxe airbnb. Alle benodigdheden zijn aanwezig, ook hebben we bij aanvangst overal duidelijk uitleg over gekregen. De host was altijd goed telefonisch bereikbaar wanneer nodig. Het huis is vrij gehorig, maar hier hebben wij geen last van gehad. Met de tram/bus halte voor de deur is alles goed bereikbaar! Doordat de dag van vertrek geen nieuwe gasten arriveerde was ook de uitcheck tijd flexibel, erg fijn! Aanrader :)

Wir haben ein wunderschönes Familienwochenende mit sieben Personen in Antwerpen verbracht. Die Wohnung war dafür perfekt. Sehr geräumig, schick eingerichtet, große Küche mit allem Drum und Dran, großer Esstisch etc.
Die Lage ist ideal, um die Stadt zu erkunden. Vor der Haustür fährt die Tram ins Zentrum, man ist aber auch gut zu Fuß in 30 Minuten dort. Etwa 15 Minuten zum Bahnhof. Uns hat es sehr gut gefallen, wir würden gerne wiederkommen.

Super mooie woning.
Hartelijk ontvangst
Een prachtig appartement als basis om Antwerpen te bezoeken. Ruim, licht, schoon en voorzien van alle gemakken. Een aanrader!
Wir hatten einen tollen Aufenthalt in dieser fantastischen Wohnung, besonders mit Kindern ist sie sehr zu empfehlen. Sehr nette und hilfsbereite Gastgeberin, wir wuerden gerne nochmal wiederkommen!
Great, stylish apartment with a lot of space. Very nice hostess. Very uncomplicated. The apartment is highly recommended.
Mooi appartement, stijlvol ingericht en prima locatie. Tegenover appartement is een tram/bus halte. Wel jammer dat de gordijnen zo weinig verduisteren, hierdoor werden we vroeg wakker.

Prachtig, ruim en schoon appartement. Met de velo-fietsen om de hoek, is het centrum zo te bereiken, aanrader om deze voor een dag of weekend te gebruiken. Het appartement is voorzien van alle gemakken, met z'n 7-en ook heel goed te doen door de 2 badkamers. We hebben erg genoten, ook van de bakker om de hoek ;)
Wir waren rund um zufrieden
Really beautiful apartment in a multicultural neighbourhood in walking distance to the main station. I would recommend a stay here.
Музей, а не квартира! Чисто, красиво, просторно. Вид из окна и с балкона на ратушу от души.

This apartment is absolutely beautiful. It's spacious, clean, supplied with everything you need, well designed and styled and perfectly located near the city centre and shops for groceries etc. Besides the fact the host was a little bit too late, we have nothing to complain. We highly recommend this place! Thanks for a lovely stay!
We had a perfekt stay and the apartment is even more beautiful then on the pictures!
This is a lovely apartment, conveniently located, in an interesting neighbourhood. We thoroughly recommend it.
Nice stay at Antwerp!Very beautiful and sweet house, good choice for a family and friends!

Erg ruimtelijk en fris. Supermarkten, bakkers en de tram op loopafstand.
Bedden sliepen heerlijk, alle voorzieningen waren aangenaam en schoon.

Over het algemeen een fijn verblijf, zeker voor herhaling vatbaar.
Prachtige stijl van de woning. Heel ruim en alles aanwezig.
It was a great experience and the house is really very comfortable for a large group of people... only drawback was the internet connection..

Het is een prachtig huis en de fotos laten precies zien wat je krijgt. De locatie is heel goed, 5 á 10 minuutjes lopen van het centraal station en de dierentuin en als je een fiets huurt ben je zo in de oude stad. Marie was een goede host. Het appartement was zelfvoorzienend en het ontbrak ons aan niks. Geweldig balkon, fijne bedden en heerlijke dekens. Twee grote woonkamers, waarvan er een tot extra slaapkamer was omgedoopt, en een hele grote keuken met een gezellige eettafel waar je 's avonds met zijn alle omheen kan zitten. Niks op aan te merken.

Een klein puntje is dat er twee straten met dezelfde straatnaam in Antwerpen zijn, wij hadden hier zelf beter op moeten letten want de goede postcode staat gewoon in je reservering maar let erop dat als je alleen de straatnaam + nr op je navigatie intoets de kans bestaat dat je naar de verkeerde word gestuurd. Dit is geen verwijt aan Marie, maar voor toekomstige huurders, let hier wel op.
Prachtig verblijf en warm ontvangst! Een echte aanrader. Wij komen zeker terug!
Wat een gewéldig penthouse! Een enorme ruimte, heerlijke bedden en banken, én leuk detaill; een heel schattig verborgen badkamer. Zoals de scandinaviërs zeggen; hygge!

Bel et grand appartement dans une ancienne bâtisse. Il est bien équipé avec une belle vue à l’arrière. Le quartier adjacent est agréable avec de bonnes petites adresses. La rue est très animée et populaire. Un tram passe devant la maison.

Goed verblijf gehad met onze familie in dit appartement. Ligt een stukje van het centrum af maar dat is geen probleem. Appartement is ruim genoeg voor de 5 personen waar wij mee waren. Enige truttige vond ik dat er door de onderburen geklaagd werd dat wij overdag met schoenen aan door het appartement liepen, de verhuurder gaf deze klacht door aan ons.

The place is as it says - stylish. Everything worked smoothly and as expected. Unfortunately our conference week was so tightly scheduled that we did not really have time to enjoy this apartment enough.

A very nice, large and cosy appartment. The location is close to the train station and the city center can be reached quickly by public transport. We stayed for a weekend with 7 friends and we can definitly recommand it. Thanks

We hebben een heerlijk familie-weekend gehad met drie stellen. De woning ligt net buiten het centrum maar is goed te belopen. Twee kamers hebben volledige privacy, één van de kamers ligt in de tweede woonkamer. Het appartement is mooi ingericht en ligt op de bovenste verdieping van een herenhuis. Hiervoor moet je wel goed ter been zijn. Al met al een echte aanrader voor een weekend weg in Antwerpen!
Super mooi en groot appartement, goede voorzieningen en prettig om met 7 mensen te verblijven. Centraal gelegen, 10 minuten lopen van het station.
Prachtige loft en goede locatie. We hebben een fantastisch verblijf gehad!
Die Wohnung ist geräumig, blitzsauber, einfach großartig , Parkplatz vor der Türe, fussnahe zum Centrum, viele Restaurants und Supermärkte in der Nähe !!
very nice apartment with good equipment. Very friendly hostess and beautiful city with friendly people.
这个屋子十分的巨大 特别舒服，房东特别热情设施应有尽有如果有机会我们还会来的。
L'appartement est très spacieux. Parfait pour un week-end à Anvers en famille ou amis.  On vous recommande largement cet appartement.

An absolutely stunning, very unique apartment with everything you could want. Beautiful views of the old town hall. Exceptionally well looked after. Perfect for our group of two couples - we pretty much had a wing each. Marie was very accommodating when our train was delayed. The local pub - Cafe Mombasa - is brilliant - we went 2 nights in a row.
The apartment was spacious and in walking distance to the center of the city. The landlord was accurate and very polite. Recommended
Very beautiful flat, was very clean and had everything you need. Would definitely come back
Het was een erg stijlvolle ruimte! Mooie ruimtes met schone lakens en handdoeken. Als vriendinnengroep hebben wij erg genoten!
Lovely place in Antwerp!
Lekker royaal huis, schoon en van alles voorzien. Tien minuten lopen naar start van centrum.  Ideaal met pubers die een eigen ruimte willen om even te chillen :))

Perfect stylish spacious and clean Apartement, good for two couples as there are two twin bedrooms with each a own toilet and bathroom, divided by a nice kitchen in the middle.
Some nice bars around the corner, like Bar Mombassa with over 100 different Belgium beers to choose of.
Nice fresh fish restaurants at a good price/ Quality in the street, like 5 to choose of.

The appartment was really nice, lot of space, the kitchen well equipped. Notice that the appartment is on 2nd floor (66 steps) no lift. You need to go one of the bath room  down some steps, which could be dangerous, if you go there half sleepy. Very easy to travel to city centre, the tram is stopping nearly front of the appartment.
mooi pand, wel kans op overlast van andere huurders die dronken bij het zwembad zitten

공간이 매우 넓어 아주 편리하였다
다만 엘리베이터가 없어서 무거운 캐리어를 가지고 가기는 힘들다
다른 분에게도 추천합니다

Im Prinzip eine schöne Wohnung in einer sehr belebten Straße, schöne Aussicht vom Balkon nach hinten. Kein Aufzug, die Wohnung ist über vier Treppen erreichbar. Gute Verbindung mit der Straßenbahn ins einige Kilometer entfernte Stadtzentrum. Leider bot der Fernseher keine laufenden Programme, und Netflix war wegen des schlechten WLAN kaum nutzbar. Allerdings bot die Vermieterin uns an, in eine andere Wohnung zu gehen, um dort fernzusehen.
Excelente!!!
Marie, was a great host and the flat was fabulous! Always again!
Great place to stay! Comfy and stylish Apartment in the heart of Antwerp. Nice and uncomplicated host. Thanks for having us as guests!
Prachtige karakteristieke loft, met zeeën van ruimte. Zeer sfeervol.
Tweede keer dat we dit prachtige appartement bezoeken! Het was weer super!
Marie has a lovely apartment, perfect for a family of four. She was extremely helpful during the check in and during our stay!

Het is een mooie, stijlvolle en schone loft voorzien van alle faciliteiten die nodig zijn. Het beddengoed en de handdoeken zijn aanwezig. De locatie is ook perfect. 10 minuten lopen naar het station. Vanaf het centrum is het 20/25 minuten lopen. Zeker een aanrader als je met een groep van 5 personen naar Antwerpen wil gaan.
uitstekend
Had a wonderful weekend in Antwerp thanks to Marie and company. The place is in a great location for our needs, clean, bright and just beautiful. Thank you!
Bon accueil dans un vaste appartement au charme ancien avec une très agréable vue sur jardin d’un côté.

Een heel fijn licht appartement met mooie architectuur. Op loopafstand van het centrum en centraal station. Goede zorg van de hostes. We waren met een groep van 5 meiden die een heerlijke tijd hebben gehad in het appartement. Een aanrader!
The apartment was just as described. We fell in love with the decor and high ceilings. Lots of rooms to lounge and relax! Will recommend to friends

Jande was kindly waiting for us at the apartment to check in. She gave us two entrance keys and lots of information. The apartment is located on the third floor. If you like architecture this place is for you. Both building entrance hall and staircase are magnificent. Both bedrooms have their own bathroom and sitting rooms. These are connected by the kitchen / dining area. If there were six of you, tee Wei would be sleeping on couches. There is a balcony with stunning views across the neighbourhood. The apartment very clean and well presented. Location in is near Bar Mombasa and Brutal restaurant. We got in late Friday and went to Brutal for a few glasses of wine (friendly & accommodating staff) . We walked everywhere (30mins into the centre or Park Spoor Noord) we took the no 30 bus from the Fomu (bottom of Kloosterstraat) back to the apartment (25mins) The apartment is not in the centre but it is easy to get in and out.
Taxis were a bit of an issue - better to take public transport, walk or better ride a bike.
Top tip would be to sign up for the Velo Antwerpen app (Website hidden by Airbnb)

This is a charming apartment in a cool area of Antwerp with convenient access to the city centre. The living space is huge, which makes it particularly practical for a family as everyone can have their own space. Although beautiful, it’s a little tired compared to the photos and there were a couple of minor maintenance issues, but overall we enjoyed the stay.

Alles in allem war es gut bis sehr gut: Top ausgestattet Küche, viel Platz, sehr schön eingerichtet (inkl. Weihnachtsbaum). Zentrum von Antwerpen ist Fußläufig in 10 min erreichbar.
Mankos: Unzuverlässiges, schlechtes WLAN und ZWEI kleine Bäder ohne jegliche Haken oder Stangen zum Aufhängen von Handtüchern etc.

Das Loft ist ein idealer Ausgangspunkt um Antwerpen unsicher zu machen. Nach der Städtetour bietet es einen idealen Rückzugsort um zu kochen, mit den Kindern zu spielen oder einfach zu verweilen. Das Loft  bietet auch für zwei Familien ausreichend platz und Rückzugsmöglichkeiten.

We hebben met 6 vriendinnen een heerlijk weekend in Antwerpen gehad. Je zit al snel aan een half uur lopen tot waar je wilt zijn, maar wij vonden dit helemaal niet storend. Het is sowieso veilig. De tram stopt ook voor de deur en is een goed en gemakkelijk alternatief. Taxi vanuit 't Zuid kostte € 15 dus dit zijn ook de kosten niet.

Het appartement is gezellig en charmant. Ook goed uitgerust voor een avondje thuis qua servies en keukengerei. Koffie en thee etc ook aanwezig voor de eerste ochtend. Het beddengoed is schoon en lekker en ook de bedden lagen goed (ook die in de woonkamer). De gordijnen lieten wel wat licht door, maar wij hebben hier persoonlijk geen last van gehad.
A very spacious and comfy apartment. Would definitely recommend this apartment and the host.
Alles wirklich super!
Fijn verblijf op een toplocatie.
Great place. Very spacious and cosy.
Super aangenaam verblijf in een prachtig  loft!

The apartment was beautiful and 2 adults and 4 kids fit perfectly. The two separate living rooms gave us all privacy and space. An easy walk to central shopping and quite a few cafés, bars and restaurants nearby.

A diamond in a rougher neighborhood. The apartment is very spacey and perfect for the 6 of us. The host is fantastic and very responsive. I like the fact that you can split up the rooms so it was ideal for the kids that had to work and study where others were just relaxing. The location might be a bit intimidating but I always felt safe. You are very close to a lot of Antwerp activity and a quick hop on the tram or a rental scooter gets you a long way. Really enjoyed our stay! Will definitely do it again. Only downside if you arrive after 6 pm and want a parking spot in the surrounding streets will be a challenge. So after six, park in parking 10 minutes away at central station.

Erg mooi verblijf. Van buiten verwacht je dit niet. De straat voelt heel anders aan dan het verblijf zelf. In het verblijf merk je ook niks van wat er buiten op straat allemaal gebeurd.
Zeer ruim allemaal. Wij waren met 2 koppels en hadden heerlijk onze eigen ruimtes incl badkamers.
hébergement d d'exception ,accueil chaleureux  merci pour qualité excellente de cet appartement

Great to be back at this wonderful flat - the whole apartment is beatiful, the view from the balcony is superb & everything in the flat is kept to a high standard - everything from the chairs / fixtures, to the espresso machine to the beds - all excellent. Wonderful! Many thanks from Ed, Kate, Tom, Zoe & Josh :-)

Erg mooi en net verblijf met vriendelijke hosts! We verbleven met een groep van 5 en daar was deze ruimte zeer geschikt voor. Alle benodigde faciliteiten waren aanwezig en de dubbele badkamer was zeer welkom.

Everything was very good, the apartment is not directly in the city center but in a walking distance to it. The apartment was very beautiful and nicely renovated.
The house lord was very friendly and gave us all the information that we needed.
Wonderful spacious house, near the city center of Antwerp

Het is een fijn en ruim appartement, dat prachtig ingericht is. Centraal gelegen en op loopafstand van het centrum, terwijl de tram ook voor de deur stopt. De gastvrouw kan goede tips geven, maar de praktische communicatie via berichten ging niet heel prettig.

Zeer ruim, prettig, comfortabel en fraai appartement. In een levendige, gevarieerde buurt. En niet heel veel ver van het centrum. Een dringend verzoekje werd meteen ingewilligd. Meest geschikt voor drie koppels. Een van de drie slaapplekken heeft iets minder privacy dan de andere twee en wat dunne gordijnen. Heerlijk verblijf gehad.

Heel fijn huis. Alles was aanwezig wat je nodig kon hebben aan keuken- en badkamerspullen. Locatie was op loopafstand van centrum. We konden mooi wandelen. En geweldige host. Erg behulpzaam en vriendelijk.

We had a very great Time staying at Klaas appartment. We booked very last minute but everything was super clean and tidy, even gave us bikes which was very useful to discover the city. Very friendly excellent host, if we ever back at the city we will stay there again.

Very nice place to stay in the center of Antwerp. The house is fully equipped and very clean. The room is big and confortable. The owner has been very kind loaning us two bikes to visit the city. So long as its available, we will book this place again next time we visit Antwerp!

Klaas is a great host. He was quick to respond and when we arrived let us put our bikes safely away in the garage in place of his own! The house is lovely, has a great kitchen and is in a good location. Klaas is helpful and friendly and we would recommend staying here!
The host canceled this reservation 3 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
My host welcome us.

Klaas was erg gastvrij en heeft ons welkom ontvangen met wat te drinken. Alles was erg schoon en alle voorzieningen waren aanwezig. Het was erg fijn dat we twee fietsen konden lenen, zo konden we op ieder moment bepalen waar we naartoe wilden en waren we nergens van afhankelijk.
Klass is a great guy, ever so friendly and welcoming. the house itself is very well maintained and is really cosy. I would recommend his place to anyone who's planning to visit Antwerp.

Klaas is a really nice young guy who allowed me to cook at the kitchen any time I wanted. He has two bikes which are always available for guests. The bedroom is big and comfortable. Highly recommend! I would come again.

Had an amazing stay with Klaas! He's such a sweetheart and had a beautiful home that is really close to the city center. He even has bikes you can use to get around the city. Loved staying with him in his beautiful flat and would definitely stay again in Antwerp :)

Klaas bied een supermooi huis wat fijn dicht bij het centrum en station van Antwerpen ligt. Toen we aankwamen stonden er twee fietsen klaar waar we meteen gebruik van konden maken,  heel fijn!  Het huis zelf is schoon en mooi  ingericht,  precies zoals de foto's weergeven.  Verder was de communicatie dikke prima en Klaas zelf ook heel vriendelijk. Aanrader!

This is a great place to stay at in Antwerp, the room is spacious and the bed is comfy. Klaas was really nice and it was so good being able to use the free bikes to get around. We really enjoyed our stay here and would definitely recommend!

We booked our stay just a few hours before we arrived and Klaas accommodated us without any problems. Klaas was friendly, has a fantastic apartment, great value, comfy bed, would recommend to all. We travelled by car and it was easy to find street parking nearby.
Bien situé pour visiter Anvers la chambre est agréable Klass est un hôte sympathique.

Our stay at Klaas's house was just perfect. Klaas is a very welcoming person who takes great care of his guests. In addition to being very nice, he puts a lot of attention in providing you with everything you need to feel at home : a very clean and tidy house and room, pieces of advice and even bicycles ! We'd happily stay at his place again.
Klaas is a very friendly and kind host, the room was clean and had a very convenient position in the city.
Perfect and calm location for a room in Antwerp. Great and friendly host !

The place is in a quiet residential street without traffic. The room is at the top floor. Klaas greeted us at the agreed time, offered us towels and tips to the nearby restaurants. We didn't seem him much as he had to work but he seemed a nice guy.

The place is a 10 min walk from the central train station.

I would recommend this place to anyone considering a stay in Antwerp.
We were nicely welcomed by Klaas, the house is clean and calm. The room is big and well situated in the second floor. We slept in good conditions, the area is calm.

Trams to the area is very frequent and only 1 stop from Antwerp Central station. You need to walk for 5 mins to the house. If you have big luggage, you will need to ask the host to help you as your room is on the 3rd floor.
It is a large room with a comfortable bed.

Klaas is a kind, welcoming and respectful guy. The room is on the top of his nice 3-floor house, in a luminous garret. The neighborough may seem caotic and multiethnical, but the house is in a quiet and pictoresque street. It is not a supercentral position, but it is close to Antwerp Central Station and you can reach the centre with tram and metro in 10 min, or with a 30 minutes walk. Nice stay and nice host!

Klaas was a kind and hospitable host that responded quickly to messages. He provided fresh towels daily and many plasters when I got ravaged by mosquitos.

The room was lovely - very bright, spacious and clean. Location is ideal too, my friend and I didn't have to use public transport at all during our stay. Would stay again!
The room is large and clean, it's a nice neighborhood. Klaas was very friendly and helpful, I would recommend this place and would definitely stay again next time I'm in Antwerp. Cheers!

Klaas had the perfect place for my one night stay in Antwerp.
Central in the city, a short walk from the central station with plenty of amenities nearby.
His home was very clean, modern and definitely receives 10/10 for being well furnished and stylish!
The room was on the top floor, spacious and clean - probably the best night sleep I had on my short European trip.
Though I arrived quite late and interrupted his evening, (late flight) he was very friendly, informative and check in was smooth.

I would happily recommend Klaas and his listing and would love to return.

A friend and I stayed at Klaas's place for 5 nights. It was clean and comfortable. Klaas was very kind to us and was very easy to talk to. He also helped answer some questions we had since it was our first time visiting Belgium. There was a market right around the corner which he told us how to get to. We enjoyed our stay with Klaas very much and recommend him as a host.
Nicely furnished and clean apartment. The location in the centre of Antwerp is very convenient. Klaas was easy to contact and helpful with check-in/out and information about the local area.

Klaas reageerde altijd direct op mijn berichten en dit was enorm prettig. Direct bij aankomst overhandigde hij de sleutel en kwamen we terecht in een mooi appartement. Schone kamer, mooie badkamer en centraal gelegen. Absoluut een prima verblijf gehad!

Klaas explained in details how to get to his place and met us in late evening. The place looks nice, pictures don't lie=)
The bed is comfortable, wi-fi is stable, bathroom is clean.
Tips only thing to remember: the bathroom is shared and the door is transparent. Also the kitchen is a part of Klaas's living room. But we had no issues because of that, our schedules were not conflicting.
We had a nice time there=)
Klaas waited for us at home to show us all important things. He gave us some advices for visiting Liege. Appartement was calm, nice, good to relax in the night after  'wallking 'day.
Zimmer, Küche und Wohnzimmer waren, wie auf den Fotos schön eingerichtet und gemütlich. Klaas hat uns freundlich empfangen, war sehr unkompliziert und flexibel.

Klaas est très accueillant et très disponible. La chambre est confortable, se trouve dans une charmante petite maison dans une rue piétonne et donc calme.
A 10 minutes de la gare centrale, on est donc aussi proche du centre d'Anvers.
Bref, super endroit que je recommande!

Klaas was a great host! Always willing to go the extra mile to help with any questions i had about the city. Very friendly and regularly offered suggestions of where to go and what to do.
I had a great stay here and would be happy to stay at klaas's place again in future.

Klaas heeft altijd snel antwoord gegeven op berichtjes, de communicatie was prima. Het huis is heel mooi ingericht. De kamer schoon en de straat heel rustig. Makkelijk lopen naar het station. Wij hadden een hele goede tijd!

Unser Aufenthalt bei Klaas war sehr nett, so wie beschrieben! Wir konnten in der Wohnung alles benutzen und Klaas hat uns brauchbare Tips für unseren Besuch in Antwerpen gegeben. Er ist ein sehr freundlicher Gastgeber. Der Schlafraum ist klasse, so wie auf den Bildern gezeigt.

Klaas was very quick to respond to messages and we were warmly welcomed to the accommodation which was in an old house, very tastefully renovated and kept in very clean condition. The bed was a good size and perfectly comfortable and everything needed was there, apart from the pillows which were dreadful.
The house is in a pedestrianised street which you would expect to be quiet. However there was still car traffic and raised voices outside, both late at night and early in the morning. We were especially unlucky with the arrival of a construction crew right outside our window at 6:45 and constant loud hammering and banging for the following 3 hours, but even before that we were awoken many times by noisy water pipes (apparently the neighbours' plumbing system passes through the guest bedroom and they work very late shifts, so they tend to use the shower/bath at 4am - 5am) as well as other comings and goings next door.
I don't blame Klaas for any of this of course, amazingly to me he slept through all of the above (though my girlfriend who is also a heavy sleeper and unlike me, very used to city noise, did not - neither of us got more than 3 or 4 hours in 12 hours in bed) and there may be nothing he can do about it. It's a lovely house and a very nice host, but if you are sensitive to noise when sleeping, this may not be the ideal place to stay.
Prima verblijf gehad, Klaas was zo vriendelijk om de sleutel op mijn werk te komen brengen. Simpel & goed en zeer dichtbij station.
Klaas was a great host! We had a nice time there!

We had a really nice stay at Klaas' place. It was clean large room, a big and comfortable bed and a rather close walk to the city centre. For us the close neighborhood did not offer us specially much with restaurants/bars/shops etc but it was safe and city centre was just a 15 min walk away.
Klaas was a kind and welcoming host, could definitely stay there again!
Big thanks!

Klaas is a very friendly host. We enjoyed our stay at his place very much. The house is big and cosy, the room is too. The neighborhood is quite diverse and busy, while the street is very quiet. We would definitely return. Thanks Klaas!
Prima locatie! Dichtbij het station. Helaas waren de fietsen, die waren beloofd, net gestolen. De kamer was schoon en ruim. Kortom, prima verblijf!

A lovely house and great host ! Location is also perfect !
Thank you very much
Klaas was a very nice host. Place was as described, no issues at all. I definitely recommand this room!

Check in and check out smooth,  communication fast.  Quiet residential neighborhood, not far from central train station (10 minutes walk).  House is clean and simple -  not a luxury, but everything you need is there.  Good value for money

This a pleasant spacious room at the last floor. very calm.
Klass is a nice guy. The communication between us was very good. Antwerpen is a very beautiful city! and we really enjoy discover it.
Zeer tijdig van wijzigingen op de hoogte stellen. Flexibel en bereid!
Nice, clean, quiet and comfortable place to stay.
Everything was great, the room was more spacious than anticipated. I would book here again.
Dicht bij het station, zeer propere accomodatie en een aangename gastheer: een aanrader!
Very good value stay — close to the city centre, quiet street, private room on top floor. I recommend.
Heerlijk geslapen in een prettige kamer aan een erge stille straat. Dichtbij het station en een tramhalte. Klaas reageerde zeer snel op mijn berichten, dat was erg prettig. Fijne tijd gehad daar!
Nice clean house and a nice host.
Leuke plek in het hartje van Borgerhout !
Een lekker rustige verblijfplaats (lekker stil 's nachts, dus je kunt goed uitgerust Antwerpen verkennen) vlakbij station en Zoo, dus je bent ook zo in het centrum van Antwerpen.

Anatoly was also very kind and welcoming, and quick to respond to messages. The only thing that you should know ahead of time, is that it was unclear whether or not we could actually park for free. The apartment does not have separate parking spaces, and so you have to get lucky to park in the street (though this for us was not a problem upon arrival), and Anatoly advised us to pay 5 euros a day to park there, to be sure the city did not bother us. Mes parents et moi avons passé un très bon week end dans cet appartement de charme, au dernier étage d'un immeuble privatisé. Il faut un peu de courage pour monter les étages mais l'appartement en vaut l'effort avec une charmante terrasse et une jolie vue. L'appartement ressemble à un loft d'artiste avec une décoration de goût, de nombreux livres, tableaux, peintures, sculptures etc...  Il est constitué d'un grand salon (avec canapé convertible), cuisine ouverte, espace salle à manger et un premier lit double (il n'y a donc pas 2 chambres mais 1 chambre et un lit dans le fond du salon) puis, séparée, une grande chambre avec placard et lit king size. La salle de bain est un demi étage plus bas (il faut descendre d'un demi étage dans la cage d'escalier mais étant au dernier étage d'un immeuble privatif cela ne pose pas trop de problème). L'appartement pourrait être un tout petit mieux équipé pour un séjour un peu plus long (pas de micro onde, casseroles, four en panne, fer à repasser et manque de quelques "basique" consommables et de rideaux sur les velux pour la lumière le matin) mais le principal est là (poêles, fait tout, verres à bière, grille pain, frigo, sèche cheveu, couverts etc...)! Le quartier est très calme, pratique avec une station de tram à coté desservant la gare central et le centre de la ville d'Anvers ! Commerces à proximité très pratiques. Nous n'avons pas eu la chance de rencontrer Orlando et Annie car ils étaient en déplacement mais nous avons eu un très bon contact. The bathroom is down a short flight of steps and again is very spacious. The bath is quite deep so again bear this in mind if you have mobility issues. Ein kleines, süßes Häuschen im Grünen an zwischen einem Waldpfad und einer autofreien Nebenstraße. Das Häuschen ist im Grunde mit fast allem ausgestattet, was man braucht (siehe Beschreibung), einige der erwähnten Ausstattungsmerkmale waren allerdings nicht vorhanden. Außerdem hatte zur Zeit unserer Verweildauer die Heizung nicht zuverlässig funktioniert, aber es ging einigermaßen und Ines wollte bzw. konnte sich spätestens nach unserer Abreise darum kümmern.

Besonders toll fand ich die Möglichkeit, mein Auto unweit vom Eingang des Hauses kostenfrei parken zu können! Tatsächlich befindet sich direkt an dem Haus ein Pfad, der zu einem großen und schönen Parkgelände und Erholungsgebiet führt, in welchem man stundenlang spazierengehen oder -fahren kann. Ebenso in Laufnähe befinden sich mindestens zwei Supermärkte (Lidl und Colruyt) sowie ein Nachtkiosk, Restaurants, Haltestelle des öffentlichen Nahverkehrs (Bus, Straßenbahn) - innerhalb von 20 Min ist man in der Altstadt Antwerpens :-)

Ines hat auf Anfragen immer schnell reagiert, einige Vorabinfos über Restaurants und Umgebung geliefert und auch den etwas komplizierten Weg zum Haus und zur Schlüsselübergabe sehr detailliert und verständlich beschrieben, so dass es kein Problem für uns war, zum und ins Haus zu kommen.

Eine Kleinigkeit jedoch muss ich anmerken: Das Häuschen ist meiner Ansicht nach aufgrund der Aufteilung eher für Singles, Vertraute und Pärchen geeignet. Ein Bett befindet sich im Wohnbereich/Küche in der Parterre, ein weiteres Bett befindet sich in einem über eine Holzleiter erreichbaren Zimmer im 1. Stock, in welchem dann über eine weitere, etwas wackelige Leiter noch ein Alkoven mit einem weiteren Bett befindet, welches zu erreichen für einige Menschen doch einigen Mut erfordern wird. Von diesem Zimmer geht es durch einen nur durch einen Vorhang dürftig verschließbaren Durchgang in das Badezimmer bzw. die Toilette. Für Pärchen und Vertraute sicherlich kein großes Problem, für gegengeschlechtliche Zweckgemeinschaften vielleicht nicht ganz so geeignet - es sei denn, man ist locker genug oder versteht sich sehr gut. Da Boden und Leitern aus Holz sind, ist es kaum möglich, nachts ohne einen im 1. Stock schlafenden Menschen zu stören auf die Toilette zu gehen oder das Bad zu benutzen.

Das Bad selbst gefiel mir sehr gut, es enthielt neben der Toilette auch eine Badewanne inkl. Dusche - ich fand es recht schön. Leider waren für mich die Wandspiegel viel zu hoch, aber auf Zehenspitzen ging es einigermaßen :-) Leider gab es keine Seife, also sollte man sich sicherheitshalber welche mitbringen.

Aber alles in Allem habe ich mich dort sehr wohl gefühlt, kann das Angebot empfehlen und würde gern erneut dort unterkommen.

My trip to Antwerp was to attend a convention at the expo with evening events in Granplaats, so this studio was a very good location. The walk to the Granplaats subway and the Cathedral was about 7 minutes along Nationalstraat which is a well trafficked shopping street with bars/restaurants and stores all along the street.
The studio itself has a drop down bed and enough space and amenities for two sharing the double bed, I left the bed down and the studio did not feel crowded. Everything I needed to store food, make breakfast and a small evening meal were all there and in good condition. Oh yes, and the shower is very good with good water pressure and the iron worked great!!!
What made this studio a big plus is that there is a good small supermarket directly opposite, an ATM about 50m along Nationalstraat toward Granplaats and the Granplaats subway is only 2 stops from Central Station.

The apartment itself is rather simple. A pull down hide-a-bed, fully functional kitchen, big windows that allow plenty of light, and a bathroom that offers great water pressure and never-ending hot water. Seems like it's an older place; I could occasionally hear the TV from the upstairs neighbors, and the hallway echos, but no noise was bothersome enough to upset my sleep.

Would I change anything? Probably not. Tom and Carla's simple studio apartment offers a single or set of travellers the perfect pit stop for exploring Antwerp and even a day trip to Bruges!

Pro tip: skip the metro and buy a week-long city bike pass for €10! It'll be cheaper, more reliable, and WAY more fun!

Great location and very clean apartment. Very good idea for a visit to Antwerp
Zeer nette en ordelijke studio op een leuke locatie in het centrum van Antwerpen!

It was a pleasant stay at yours! Great location, lots of historical places nearby, couple of parks ... groceries right across the street. Everything went pretty smooth.

Het appartement is een aanrader. Het ligt centraal met mogelijkheden dichtbij om gratis te parkeren. Het appartement is niet groot maar verrassend praktisch ingericht en keurig onderhouden. Contact met de gastvrouw is makkelijk te maken snel en heel plezierig.

Het was een fijn verblijf, een top locatie voor een weekendje Antwerpen. Goede centrale ligging. Fijne lokale tips voor eet tentjes. De communicatie en gastvrijheid was ook top. Het enige min punt is dat het verblijf wat gehorig is. Wij kijken in ieder geval terug naar een top weekendje Antwerpen.
Perfection! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Tom and Carla were lovely hosts! The flat is quite small but they truly know how to make most of a small, cosy space. There wasn't anything missing and we felt comfortable from the first second! The location is amazing as well. Thanks again!

Uns hat die zentrale aber auch ruhige Lage (da Richtung Hinterhof gelegen) sehr gut gefallen. Alles ist fußläufig zu erreichen. Weiterhin war der kostenlose Parkplatz ein guter Tipp. Alles in allem war es ein sehr schöner Aufenthalt und auf jeden Fall weiter zu empfehlen.
Un super endroit très bien placé et décoré, vraiment parfait !
The communication with Carla was very easy. The place is bigger than on the pictures, super practical, clean and very well located. Highly recommended !

In simple words, it was really a great stay at Tom & Carla's house.. it seems they have taken a great effort to make house that much comfortable. Everything was so neat & clean..and well organized.. Location wise: lots of shops & restaurant s near by... very near to some famous tourist spots.....Centraal station is little far but we didn't have any issues as we love walking.. Antwerp is comparatively small.. but in case one has any issue.. they can take bus n trams available near by... In summary: if given a chance.. we'll definitely stay here again!
Deze stijlvol ingerichte studio is de perfecte uitvalsbasis voor een verblijf in Antwerpen.
Carla and Tom offer a really clean and spacious two-room studio. The location was perfect and it was easy to communicate with Carla. I would definitely recommend it to other people!

What a great place to stay. This little gem is in the best part of town, its clean, quiet and near the best shops and cafes. Easy to travel to and from too.

Tom we met briefly, but Carla checked us in, showed us around and was really helpful. Thanks for the Beer!
Very nice and we'll located place. The hosts are really nice and helpful.

The apartment is exactly like the pictures. We didn’t meet Carla but we kept in touch constantly and the check in and out instructions were super clear. Perfect to visit Antwerp!

Booked this cute place for my 18 yr old daughter to visit Antwerp with her dad. This is what she wrote: "It was truly wonderful to stay in Tom & Carla's apartment! Carla's appartment is in the heart of Antwerpen's fashion district with great shops, restaurants and cafés. It's easy to walk the city and get to see all sights from there. This lovely appartment is perfect for two people and we found everything we needed for our 5-days-stay!
Wonderful quiet place in the heart of the old town. Minutes from everything. Look forward to going back!

Carla made our stay there just perfect! She was very nice and friendly, welcomed us at the apartment although we arrived very late in the evening. She and her husband helped us to find the right bus and tram connections and also recommanded us things to do in and around Antwerp! Also the Groenplaats and Meir is very close and there are a lot of restaurants, bars and shops. The communication with Carla was always ongoing. We can highly recommend you!
Very nice apartment, great beds, all clean and new. I had a great stay in Antwerp :)

We spent 4 nights in Antwerp! The location of the apartment is great! Right in the center and everything is easy to reach by foot or bike (I would define recommend a day by bike in Antwerp!!) Ma sœur et moi nous le recommandons très vivement, pour finir, Anvers est une ville à voir !

Perfect apartment for a citry trip and perfectly located. The beautiful historic centre is easy to reach (within 10 min. walking), the neighbourhood "het Zuid" offers many lovely cafés and shops. I definitely recommend Carla&Tom as hosts and  their studio as a wonderful accommodation for 1 or 2 people.

Tom and Carlas apartment was perfect for our five days in Antwerp. It was small but had everything we needed. The apartment also had a great location with walking or biking distance to everything. Une hôtesse accueillante un appartement soigné j’ai passé un agréable séjour merci

Friendly and helpfull. Neat and cosy place.

Would definitely come back to visit Antwerp and stay here again.

Apartamento hermoso, bien funcional, exelente ubicacion y con todo lo necesario para disfrutar de Amberes
Muy recomendable, esperamos lo disfruten como nosotros.

Nice and clean apartment.
