Can’t rate this anything other than 5 stars. The place is perfect, the rooms are big, the location is ideal and the communication with Zola is outstanding and quick. Would highly recommend.

Heerlijk huis vlak bij het centrum aan de ene kant en de Universiteit aan de ander kant. Heerlijke koffie direct om de hoek. Leuk ingericht pand met vier mooie slaapkamers. Zola is een hele plezierige host. Zeker een aanrader als je met grote of kinderen naar Antwerpen gaat.

Roomy, there are 4 full sized bedrooms. Comfortable living room and kitchen. Very quiet location and walking distance to the relevant areas. Wifi is fine and TV works with the Netflix account of the house. Unusual, it really is a full (narrow) building of your own, three stories high.

Maison originale, spacieuse et très bien située pour visiter Anvers à pieds ou en transports collectifs. Un petit bémol si vous avez une voiture car le stationnement est très très coûteux dans la rue (10€ pour 3hrs) ou au parking situé à 200m (22€/jour). Sinon, le reste est impeccable.

Het huis was erg netjes en schoon en van alle gemakken voorzien. Het Harry Potter thema is super doorgevoerd (we kwamen leuke verrassingen tegen!), maar ook als je niets met Harry Potter hebt is het huis sfeer- en smaakvol ingericht. De communicatie met Zola verliep goed. Het was voor ons de perfecte uitvalsbasis voor ons weekendje Antwerpen!
Au top

We stayed in the house with a group of friends and a couple of small children with the house all to ourselves. We had everything we needed, the 4 bedrooms were all comfortable and we had plenty of space with a full kitchen and also by using the downstairs space as a living room. The Harry Potter touches are cute rather than overwhelming or cheesy, it was fun discovering things like an unexpected potions cabinet and the sorting hat on the stairs. The bathrooms are a little unique, with separate showers but it is very functional and clean. We had a great time and we found it to be located conveniently for our trip.

A clean, comfortable and beautifully decorated house. Zola's place is situated in a quiet street but is close to everything you'd want in the centre of Antwerp. It features four comfortable rooms, a well-equipped kitchen and a everything you could possibly expect from a rental place!

We had a very pleasant stay at Zola's magical Airbnb. Very clean and comfortable. Also a great location in a pretty quiet neighborhood (10 minute walk from the center). Zola was very quick in answering the messages and friendly.

Can only recommend, especially for groups from 4 to 6 people.

Zola haar huis was fantastisch! We hebben genoten van het huis. Het was een waar magisch verblijf. Alles was schoon en goed geregeld. Je bent in het centrum en dichtbij zijn allerlei faciliteiten. Was echt TOP!! En voor herhaling vatbaar!

Top airbnb! Tweede keer dat ik hier heb geslapen. Heerlijke ruime slaapkamers, prima bedden. Het is schoon en leuk ingericht. Harey Potter thema maakt het bijzonder. Contact is prima. Steegje waar de ingan zit is wat lastig misschien maar eenmaal gevonden heel duidelijk. Locatie is goed, je loopt zo het centrum in. Wij parkeren bij de grote bios en dan met de tram lijn - luchtbal/zuid sta je zo voor de deur.

Een heel fijn huis in Antwerpen.
Van alle gemakken voorzien, ruime slaapkamers, meerdere douches aanwezig.
Chocolaatjes in de keuken
Lies' apartment was an architectural dream, the space made for interesting navigation but was comfortable and homely space to be in. The view from the roof is not to be missed!  Thanks for having us~
Lies’ place is simply amazing. Beautiful interior and a spacious feel make this quirky place in the center of Antwerp a true gem.

I stayed at Rev's place for a 17 days.
Communication, check-in and check-out were impeccable.
The apartment itself is very close to the train station, it is not the best neighborhood in Antwerp, but i did not felt uncomfortable, and it is close to the main attractions of the city.
If you are coming during the cold period, you will find the heating system a bit strange and noisy.
When i arrived, in the kitchen were only glasses, cutlery, and plates. After asking and explaining that i will stay for 17 days, and that i need equipment for making some food, reheating the milk or so, Rev brought me 2 pots and a (Website hidden by Airbnb) was ok, but still missing a lots of amenities if you want to use the kitchen.
Some things are quite new, but some are outdated, as for example, work surface in the kitchen, and in the bathroom...
Overall, it was good value for money i paid, but need a small improvements.

This apartment is near the station,  which was perfect for us. Communication with the owner went very smoothly. The apartment is clean,  spacious and has all the amenities you might need. I would definitely book again and recommend it to anyone visiting this lovely city!
Bon emplacement. Ponctualité de part des propietaires. Ils m'ont laissé rester un jour de plus, car mon vol avait été annulé. Je le recommande

Great location close to Antwerpen-Centraal. Rev was a great host, we got a bit later than expected and she waited for us.

The apartment was simple but had everything we needed. I'll definitely recommend Rev's apartment

Good apartment.. Furniture was fine, TV, internet and everything was Ok. The location is great, 2mn walk from central station.
The only problem maybe was the stairs, second floor with no elevators,, a bit difficult with the suitcases but it wasn't a big deal.

Ho utilizzato l'appartamento per 6 giorni per ragioni di lavoro e avevo necessità di essere vicino alla stazione ed effettivamente vi dista 2 minuti a piedi. Situato al secondo piano senza ascensore e con un vano scale abbastanza stretto, l'accesso con grandi bagagli può essere un po' difficoltoso. Non ho mai cucinato ma ho usato il comodo bollitore per il the o caffè solubile. Non ho conosciuto personalmente Rev ma un suo collega molto gentile che mi ha mostrato la casa. Il wifi funziona perfettamente e cosi anche la tv (riceve anche rai1 e canale 5). Unico problemino è il fatto che manca un aeratore nel piccolo vano wc e che la cucina abbia un pannello di truciolato che non sigilla perfettamente il vano wc retrostante lasciando fuoriuscire cattivi odori. Nel complesso per brevi soggiorni è sicuramente comodo soprattutto per chi deve recarsi alla stazione frequentemente.

Super location, un appartement très fonctionnel et grand qui permet de visiter facilement anvers. Tout est à 10 minutes à pied.
Rev est très arrangeante que ce soit pour l'arrivée ou pour le départ.
Merci beaucoup
the apartment is really nice.
This apartment is a short walk from Antwerp Central station, it's nice and quiet, and more spacious than it looks in the pictures. There's a really good supermarket close by. Recommended.

Me encantó todo, lo único que me hizo un poco de falta fue no haber horno microondas porque me gusta comer en la casa algunas veces además que tiene una ótima tv con Netflix seguro voy a volver antes de irme a mi casa de hecho estoy en eso.. La localidad no podría ser más perfecta cerca de todo! Yo recomiendo a todos..

Hallo Rev. Im Prinzip waren wir mit der Wohnung zufrieden. Aber: die Schiebetür war ausgehängt und müsste erst kompliziert eingehängt werden.
Der Abwaschschwamm war eklig benutzt und fettig, es gab keinen Ersatz trotz Anfrage.
Das Bettzeug war für die Wetterlage viel zu dick, es gab keine Einzeldecken.
Das WLAN funktionierte fast einen ganzen Tag nicht.
Der Lüftungskanal geht von der Küche ins Klo und vom Klo in die Küche, einen Abluftventilatir gibt es nicht..
Kaffeemaschine wäre nicht schlecht gewesen...
Nice place. Good location.

Appartement très bien situé , et très bien aménagé. Dommage quil y est une mauvaise odeur d' égouts dans l appartement.
Pas de place de parking donc a prévoir car stationnement payant .
Très bonne communication.
Great location and a memorable stay.
bon séjour a 2 pas de la gare proche du centre historique

Un appartement confortable et bien chauffé. L'appartement est situé très près de la Gare Centrale, on peut y aller à pied très facilement. Il y a de nombreux commerces ( supermarché ) et la rue est calme même si on est dans un quartier vivant.

Globalement notre séjour s'est bien passé dans cet appartement. La communication avec Rev était très simple. L'appartement n'est pas très loin du centre d'Anvers et à 2min à pieds de la gare. Cependant quelques détails sont à prendre en compte, ou à améliorer pour les futurs locataires. Le quartier est assez bruyant la nuit et il n'y a pas de double vitrage dans l'appartement, des bouchons d'oreille sont donc à prévoir... En revanche le chauffage fonctionne très bien, il n'y a pas de problème de froid l'hiver.
3 couchages sont indiqués, mais il n'y a pas de drap ni oreiller ni couverture pour le canapé lit du salon. Pour la vaisselle tout est pour 2 personnes, difficile encore une fois si vous êtes 3.
Un torchon et une nappe seraient un plus... Le WiFi fonctionne parfaitement bien et la télévision avec chromecast est très appréciable.
Top

The studio is very well positioned, with a great view, in the city center, near the bus and tram station . Very clean, cosy, intimate, everything you need for a short or long term stay. The host is very kind and helpful and we loved it there.

L'appartement est bien situé à quelques minutes de la vieille ville, commerces et cinéma proximité. Il a été refait à neuf tout récemment, il est donc très propre, bien décoré et bien équipé. L'immeuble a quelques défauts (air chaud et très sec, ascenseur vieillot). Les propriétaires sont très accueillants et très disponibles en cas de problème. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Anvers !

El apartamento ha sido perfecto: amplio, limpio, muy luminoso y perfectamente ubicado en la ciudad (está a 7 minutos de la estación central). La zona está llena de locales comerciales para poder comer, hacer compras...El anfitrión se ha mostrado amable y disponible durante la estancia. Sin duda, volvería a alojarme aquí y se lo recomendaré a mis amigos.
Nice and cozy. Highly recommended.
Central location, great for Tour of Flanders
This place is at perfect location, very well presented. Almost everything is at walking distance. Very highly recomended.
Wonderful spot, good communication and would recommend it for all travellers who want value for money!
Very nice apartment in the centre of Antwerp. Kwaisum was a great host and made sure we were comfortable with everything when we settled in. And he was always contactable during our stay.
Mooie studio op een top locatie in Antwerpen!

I had a great stay in Kwaisum appartement!
It's very central, 5 min walk from the central station.
The flat is very nice with all you need
Perfect bed, nice bathroom
Great internet!
Definitely a place to stay in Antwerp
One of my best Airbnb!

We were met at the door, at the pre-arranged time, by one of the Kwaisum's friends who introduced us to the building and the apartment and made us most welcome with a potted history of the city and striking points of interest to visit.

The spacious apartment was a great change from the two cramped accommodation sites we had in Amsterdam. The elevator was a big plus too after flights of stairs in Amsterdam. Kwaisum's apartment is conveniently placed to downtown Antwerp. It's nicely buffered from the busy adjacent bus mall by a row of thick green-leafed trees and within easy walking distance of Centraal railway station or indeed nearby markets and must-see points of interest.

We did enjoy our few days here and the ease of access that it provided to so many aspects of this part of the City of Antwerp.

All the communication with Kwaisum was good. He met  us at the apartment and gave us helpful sightseeing tips.  His studio apartment is light, spacious, nicely decorated, and conveniently located.  We really enjoyed our stay.

We had a great stay at this studio. It is located in the city center and you can reach pretty much everything within minutes (Shops, the Harbour, City Center, Central Station)! The communication was very easy and Kwaisum was courteous letting us check out a little later than planned. The studio is clean, nicely decorated and well equipped for short stays. I would definitely recommend a stay! Thx

Large open space, nicely decorated and clean. It was extremely hot outside and very uncomfortable in the apartment so we had to leave window wide open the entire time.
Extreme street noise, faces onto very busy city bus depot, window opens above a bar, road construction during the night even jack hammering!
Disgusting lift...reeks of stale cigarette and stench, carpeted walls full of burn holes.
No hot water in the kitchen for the dishes (Not Sanitary) or laundry.
Tub/shower very slow to drain.
No (chopping, slicing, bread) knives...only knife was a butter knife.
Water leaking onto floor in front of fridge?
Kwaisom out of town...his friend did the check in and said "if you need anything just let Kwaisom know and he will get a hold of me to deal with it"...we did this re: the fan, etc and the response we got was that he was not available either so didnt deal with anything.  same when told water leaking on floor.
Would not stay here again.

A decoração é uma graça e um capricho nos detalhes. Fácil acesso a tudo. O anfitrião é super amigável e atencioso.
Voltaria com certeza!

With a group of three, we visited the beautiful city of Antwerp and our stay at Kwaisum's apartment was lovely and very recommendable! The apartment has the ideal location to explore the city withins minutes, very closely located to the city centre and the main train station. The bathroom door does not leave a lot of privacy while in the bathroom, but in general the apartment was perfectly equipped with everything you can think of being necessary for a perfect stay. Due to the close location to the city centre, it is a bit noisy  and currently there is a lot of traffic and refurbishments going on outside, but the central location makes up for that. Kwaisum is a very reliable and friendly host, he always responded very quickly and helpful, thanks for everything!

We had a nice stay at Kwaisum´s studio. It´s really close to the main station, city center and there´s a bus sation right in front of the apartment.
The studio is very clean and nicely decorated but it´s really warm and sticky in there (it´s been 34 degrees outside ) which is one negative thing to say. The bathroom has no (lockable) door, so theres not much privacy, but we knew this before.
Kwaisum was also always reachable when we had questions even though he wasn't in Antwerpen when we stayed in his studio.
I´d definelty recommend his studio but wouldn't stay there again at midsummer.
Good and comfortable bed. Good location in the city centre. Rather quiet and calm unless you leave the window open. Good means of transport near the studio (trains and buses). Thank you for the stay!
房間的佈置讓人感覺舒適，需要的傢俱等等都不缺。房東人很好，如果有遇到任何問題也都很快回覆。非常好的經驗。
Very good location great host

We have very nice days at Johan flat. It's a fantastic studio with all kind of comodities: Kitchen, washmachine, very comfortable bed... It's close to Central station, maybe 10min. We recommend Johan's flat to everyone who wants visit beatiful Antewerp

Deze studio is top als je een paar dagen in Antwerpen verblijft. Het ligt op loopafstand van het centrum en het station, waardoor alles goed te bereiken is. Er is bovendien een busstation voor de deur. De studio is schoon en goed ingericht. En de verhuurder was heel gastvrij en behulpzaam. Dit is zeker een aanrader!

Kwaisum's place was great! Close to the center, clean, everything what we needed was there! Kwaisum was very nice and welcoming. Communication was very good and easy. He gave us tips during our stay. Beds were great, and there is a very nice bathroom with a good shower. I would definitly recommend this place to everyone!

The appartment is very conveniently located, near the railway station and main city attractions. It is cozy, suited for two or a group of close friends, as it is a studio appartment. It has everything you need.

Bra läge mellan centralstationen och gamla stan. Lägenheten är som ett hotellrum fast större, billigare och bättre. Vår värd hade ordnat en fiffig lösning så att vi kunde checka in och ut själva när vi ville. Stället rekommenderas starkt!

Everything is there that you need. It was clean and neat. There is a lot of room in the suite and the bathroom is fully equipped.  I would highly recommend this place. City centre is an easy 20 minute walk away. The host is very responive to emails. All in all a great place to stay.

Kwaisums appartment is a very nice place to stay. It's clean and tidy, spacious, with a well-equiped kitchen. Bathroom, with bathtub, is great.
It's lcoated in the centre of Antwerp, on a 5 minute walk from the Central Station. Lots of restaurants etc in the neighbourhood.
I recommend Kwaisums place for everyone who likes to discover the lovely city of Antwerp.
Kwaisum was a great host, it was very easy to communicate with him. The apartment was very clean and nice, very close from the train station and the city center.
Very nice location. Splendid q/p ratio!

Pasamos unos excelentes días en Amberes. La estancia en el departamento de Kwaisun es muy recomendable. Esta ubicado a 5 minutos a pies de la terminal de trenes lo que en nuestro caso facilito muchísimo el recorrido por distintos puntos de Bélgica. A su vez esta a poco minutos caminando del casco histórico. El departamento es muy amplio, tranquilo, luminoso y limpio. La zona esta llena de locales comerciales y restaurantes. Hay un supermercado casi enfrente. El anfitrión ha sido muy amable durante nuestra estancia y ha estado disponible en todo momento. Si volviera, sin duda volveria a elegir este alojamiento.
Kwaisum is een vriendelijke vent die zijn best doet om het verblijf zo goed mogelijk te laten verlopen.
Very nice studio, great location (walking distance to main station and city center) and a very nice host!

Apartament d'un sol ambient, ens hem allotjat quatre persones i hem estat molt còmodes. Molt cèntric, molt ben comunicat i amb múltiples serveis a la vora. I l'amfitrió, molt atent i amable. Molt recomenable!
------------
One-room apartment, we have accommodated four people and we have been very comfortable. Very central, very well connected and with many services on the edge. And the host, very attentive and kind. Very recommendable!
----------
Apartamento de un solo ambiente, nos hemos alojado cuatro personas y hemos estado muy cómodos. Muy céntrico, muy bien comunicado y con múltiples servicios al borde. Y el anfitrión, muy atento y amable. Muy recomendable!
Perfect space. Larger than in the photos. Antwerp is amazing. Lovely host.
Ideale locatie in Antwerpen, op loopafstand van het centraal station. Hele mooie ruimte en precies wat je nodig hebt voor een leuk weekendje!

We all had a great time in Antwerp. The studio is central, just 5 minutes from the central station. We found there some really helpfull city guides so that we could plan every day. Kwasium is a really nice host, everytime I had a question he answered just after few minutes and we could rely on him in every situation. We could even make a deal that we check out a little bit later. I  would definatelly recommend it! <3

Kwaisum was very communicative even before we arrived in Antwerp. The studio was beyond my expectations and had more than enough room for the 3 of us. From the tall ceilings, modern furniture, as well as floor to ceiling windows, we felt at home right away.
kwaisum人很好，很细心，只是去的时候那边刚好在修路，加上比利时很多单行道，就在眼前的停车场愣是绕了好久才开进去。房间很好，东西很齐全。卫生间浴缸下水需要改进一下
mooi centraal gelegen accommodatie, wel een beetje rumoerig op straat maar dat hoort bij de stad
O apartamento é muito acolhedor, está muito bem decorado e a localização é excelente. Só tenho a referir a falta de ar condicionado, porque durante a estadia as temperaturas rondaram os 30 graus.
Kwaisum's place is close to both the central station and the old town area. There are a few supermarkets and many shops nearby. Kwaisum was very good at communicating with us.
Schoon appartement in het centrum van Antwerpen, ideaal voor verblijf van een paar dagen.

Great host, very helpful and flexible in accommodating our needs, very much appreciated.
The apartment is in central location. 6 min walk to Central Station. Close to China Town, plenty of choices for meals.
The apartment is not suitable for young children.
We had a nice stay, host is excellent and appartment is very bright and great location. As in every city you can have noise from street or neighbours.
Great place location is excellent to explore Antwerpe
Good
Gute Lage, Schönes Studio, netter Vermieter, Vorsicht: Antwerpen hat eine Umweltzone, wer mit dem Auto anreist sollte dieses vorab registrieren um ein Bußgeld zu vermeiden.

El apartamento es ideal para dos personas, muy bien ubicado y con carácter. Kwaisun nos contestó de forma inmediata a todos los mensaje y fue muy atento, nos permitió dejar las maletas unas horas más.
I HIGHLY suggest this studio, great location, easy access to the train, lots of places shop and have food, pharmacy and super market also close by.
Amazing location, Kwaisum was always available to answer questions. It's close to everywhere we wanted to go and the stay was clean and perfect.
Het is een mooi appartement op een goede plek dichtbij het centrum. Kwaisum is heel erg aardig en helpt je graag. Perfect voor een paar dagen Antwerpen.

We had a great time in the house Riet. She is a wonderful host and responded very fast.
The house is very child friendly and clean. The house is next to a big nice park. To go to the centre is the easiest with the tram, the tram station is next to the house.
thanks from us.
Esther
Amazingly gracious hosts, very very family friendly location, transport to the city center only meters away. My family had a perfect stay!
maison super equipee pour familles ou groupe d amis avec enfants. Jeux, grand salon et cuisine, parc à côté, tram juste en face... Et hôtes très flexibles !

Nous avons passé 4 nuits dans la maison de Riet et Matias. Le rez de chaussée est vraiment agréable et idéal avec de jeunes enfants car il regorge de jeux. La cuisine est bien équipée.
La maison est très bien situé en face du tram qui mène au centre ville.
Riet et Matias nous ont accueilli de manière très sympathique et chaleureuse. Merci.
The host canceled this reservation 11 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
A beautiful house in a lovely location perfect for families with young children. The two nearby parks are fantastic and kept our boys entertained.

Super séjour d'une semaine dans cette grande maison très bien située (proche du tram menant au centre-ville, parc avec aire de jeux juste en face), parfaitement équipée (notamment pour les familles) (Website hidden by Airbnb) d'un petit jardin. Riet et Mathias sont des hôtes très sympathiques et accueillants. De quoi passer un excellent séjour !
Ideas house for families! Riet is a great host, giving you great tips to move around Antwerp!
Big lovely house, with everything you need. Not to far from Antwerpen.

Nice house and indeed nearby the central of Antwerpen! There is a lot to see and to do and the house is spacious indeed! You'll easily fit your whole family in it and still have enough space to have fun!

Snelle, goeie communicatie met verhuurder. Flexibel in tijd van komen en gaan.
Appartement is netjes, schoon en van alle gemakken voorzien. Bij aankomst stond er een heerlijk biertje voor ons klaar. Top locatie, het appartement is rustig gelegen maar wel ik de buurt van cafe's, restaurantjes en shops. Veel te voet bereikbaar en anders is het openbaar vervoer ook in de buurt.

Toplocatie met leuke barretjes en restaurants om de hoek, rest van de stad op loopafstand. Het appartement is een goede uitvalsbasis met een overheerlijke douche. Evert is een prima host, communicatief, flexibel: ik zou het verblijf dan ook zeker aanraden.

The appartment looks exactly like on the fotos and is very well located! I loved the south area of Antwerpen because it has very nice cafes and bars and a beautiful street with antiq shops leads directly to the center. Evert was very nice and was very helpful! All in all it was a trip total worth it in a very beautiful and cosy city with a stay at a nice appartment!

We were very happy with Evert's place – it's in a great area, easily walkable from the city centre. It was very clean, cozy, and it had everything we needed. Evert and his wife were very friendly and welcoming.
Hope to stay here again!

Our stay at Everts apartment was really good! His wife and his daughter welcomed us in a super friendly way. The flat was clean and the area is awesome. You can pretty much walk to all the important places around town.

We had a great time staying at this apartment. The location was perfect for us. Lots of restaurant and bars nearby and the historic city centre in walking distance. Evert was easy to communicate with and the apartment was clean. Would recommend!

Mooi centraal gelegen appartement met alles wat je nodig hebt voor een fijn verblijf. Met de leenfiets (Velo Antwerpen) ben je zo overal in de stad. In de buurt ook veel leuke eetgelegenheden. Aanrader!

Simply AMAZING!! This has been the best airbnb experience I've had. The apartment is beautiful modern and in the best neighborhood of Antwerp. Comunication with Everet was excelent... We are definitely coming back!
Prima appartement in een leuke buurt, alles op loopafstand. Prima communicatie met verhuurder.
Fijn appartement. Ruim en van alle gemakken voorzien. Leuke locatie, in een buurt vol restaurantjes.

The location was fantastic!!
The pictures and reviews all do the place justice.
Couldn't critisice Evert's place at all.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Evert's apartment. It was clean, organized
and centrally located in a cool neighborhood. Evert checked in on us before we arrived, during our stay and towards the end, so the communication was excellent. We appreciated that he provided multiple towels for our stay, and while we never met him, the check in was seamless. We loved staying in a true neighborhood and not the touristic center, where there were many cafe, restaurants and nice shops. Highly recommended!

Le séjour dans l’appartement d’Evert a été formidable. L’appartement est propre, fonctionnel et bien situé. Evert fait en sorte que tout se passe bien.
Je recommande vivement
De locatie en het appartement zelf waren top. Ook de eigenaar, Evert, communiceerde snel en was erg attent. We hebben genoten!
Evert’s place was great.  Only a 10 minute walk from the heart of the city.  Would highly recommend!

Logement bien situé, hôte très réactif, agréable et prévenant.
Notre séjour fut plaisant et nous recommandons cet appartement!
Erg mooi en net appartement met alle voorzieningen. Centrum met de stadsfietsen goed bereikbaar.
Beautiful apartment in a great location. Would definitely recommend staying in Evert’s apartment!
Mooi gelegen,  rustig appartement,  perfect voor een paar dagen on Antwerpen te verkennen. We werden met een plezierig flesje lokaal bier ontvangen,  erg leuk!

Zowel de buurt als het appartement zelf waren erg leuk. Het appartement zag er heel netjes uit en was heel ruim. De bedden sliepen fijn en vooral de regendouche was heerlijk!
Het lag wel wat verder van het centrum maar wel in een nette buurt. Fietsen kun je huren op de hoek van de straat en dan ben je in 5 minuutjes fietsen midden in het centrum. De communicatie met Evert verliep ook goed en snel. Kortom, een top appartement dus zeker een aanrader!

A lovely, spacious and stylish apartment in a really cool area of Antwerp. A short walk from Old Town, but my boyfriend and I really lovely having the opportunity to explore The Zuid as well as the rest of the town. Loads of great bars, cafes and cool shops - just generally a great vibe, and the apartment is a great base to make your home in Antwerp! Thank you, Evert!

Wat een ontzettend fijn appartement in een gezellige buurt. Het overtrof onze verwachting. Erg sfeervol en netjes appartement van alle gemakken voorzien; lekker bed, heerlijke bank, fijne douche. Heel Antwerpen (binnen de Leien) is te voet bereikbaar. In de buurt zijn volop leuke cafeetjes en restaurantjes aanwezig (Dansing Chocolat veruit onze favoriet). The home is in a great part of Antwerp but still quiet and peaceful. Walking distance to great shops, restaurants, etc. The pictures are all accurate and the home is extremely comfortable, with high quality furnishings.

That said, there are some critical things not disclosed about the home and the host, which take away from the stay.

First, there are two sets of extremely steep stairs that you must navigate, one to get up to the living area and another to get up to the bedroom. This was pretty sketchy with our big, heavy bags (we were in the middle of a two week trip across Europe). We are relatively young and fit so managed, but I could see how this might be a dealbreaker for some guests. The host must disclose this in the listing and include pictures.

Second, the check-in with the host was not pleasant. First, she demanded a 500 euro damage deposit/hold on a credit card. We explained that this should be covered by Airbnb, but she refused to allow us to check-in without putting a hold on our credit card. We were tired after a long day of travel and figured we could take it up with the credit card company if anything sketchy happened, but this is unacceptable. After arguing through that, the host then demanded an additional 2 euros per day of our stay for a “tourist tax”. Again, we said all should be handled through Airbnb. After some back and forth, she relented on collecting that from us.

Finally, after confirming both via Airbnb message, requesting a modification to our reservation, and in-person confirmation that we would be checking out two nights earlier, the host repeatedly refused to issue a refund. We resorted to contacting Airbnb support, who helped immediately.

In summary, the home is beautiful, but there are a few issues that the host should disclose and future renters must know.

Philip welcomed us personally, showed us all we needed to know and gave us tips on what to do, where to eat, what to see, ... Very helpful. I recommend this apartment and Philip as a host to everyone who plans to spend some time in Antwerpen.

Great location lots of bars & restaurants nearby, and about a 15min walk to the old town. Philippe was a very efficient host. Very large modern apartment and very clean. There was hanging space for clothes in the laundry area, but would be even better if bed-rooms had a wardrobe. The parking space was very handy. Our family of 4 really enjoyed ourselves.

Hebben een super verblijf gehad in het appartement van Philippe! De communicatie was erg goed en snel en ook in het appartement was alles geregeld en goed schoon. Het appartement is groot en mooi modern ingericht. Ook de garage was erg fijn. Onze onverwacht late aankomst (autopech en veel file) was gelukkig geen probleem. Graag een volgende keer weer! :-)

I booked this apt for my parents and their friends who were visiting me in Antwerp. The 3 bedroom apt is extremely spacious, well lit and spotless. There were fresh towels and the bathrooms were well equipped. Philippe was very accommodating about the check in time and was great with communication.

The apt is located extremely close to the river and the MAS (museum) and the tram and bus lines are only a few min walk away. There are lots of nice restaurants close by and grocery stores and bakeries if you feel like cooking yourself.

The only downside i can think of is that the kitchen could be a bit better equipped.

Een groot appartement op een fijne locatie en het contact met de verhuurders was erg positief. Wel is het appartement er basic/kaal ingericht. Daardoor galmt de ruimte en voelt het niet heel huiselijk aan.

Wij zijn met enkele collega's in het appartement verbleven. De ligging was perfect vlakbij de Waagnatie maar tegelijk ook vlakbij het Mas en veel restaurantjes. We hadden na een dag werken het gevoel van 'thuiskomen', heel tof! Een aanrader :-)

Very nice place. Three spacious bedrooms and a great living area. We loved it. Very close to the Mas museum and walking distantie to city center, while still in a hip and new neighbourhood (Eilandje). We could park our car in the private parking of the building.

We loved the tips for local restaurants from Philippe. Very helpfull.

The place was perfectly clean and had all the stuff we needed, including different coffeemakers, spacious kitchen and bathrooms.

A Very good choice for a stay in Antwerp.

Excellent place to stay in Antwerp! Communication with Philippe was really fluid. The apartment is really clean and big with three separate bedrooms. Also a parking possibility in the garage. Highly recommended!

Philippe’s place is huge, clean, modern and comfortable. We loved our stay there and would recommend it to others.
The location is a bit of a walk from the centre but is close to water and nice. The flat itself is exactly per pictures (in fact we were surprised how big it is).
Clean apartment and Philippe is a very nice guy.
This is a nice place. A bit far from the main touristy area but location is safe and nice. Host is very responsive and having parking was a great bonus!
Spacious, relaxing and extremely clean and well located
Heel vriendelijk onthaal,  goeie tips,  idd een toplocatie en heel ruim appartement met alles wat nodig is

It was a great experience! Big (!) apartment with a lot of extra space in a nice area right next to the MAS museum, good communication with the host, and easy check-in and check-out. Would love to come back someday!
Goede locatie om heerlijk in Antwerpen n aantal dagen te verblijven.

Een geweldig ruim en licht appartement op loopafstand van het centrum van Antwerpen en de tramhalte op de hoek. Een parkeerplek onder het appartement maakt dit adres geweldig makkelijk aan te rijden. Philippe verraste met geweldige snelle en effectieve communicatie en geeft graag en goede tips voor lekker eten en drinken in de buurt. Een extra plus waren de lokale en authentieke bakker en slager op de hoek bij Philippe: open op zondag! Schot in de roos! Heerlijk adres: absolute aanrader!
Très grand appartement, lumineux et agréable, avec un bel accueil de Philippe.

Superfijn, ruim en schoon appartement met alle voorzieningen. Prima locatie met cafés en restaurant. Goed te wandelen naar het centrum. Gastheer is top, fijn dat we niet om 11 uur het appartement uit hoefden en relaxt ons weekend konden afsluiten.

Great place
Fantastic host
Parking at the premises
Het Eilandje area , stylish
Everything in walking distance
zeer ruim appartement. fijn communicatie met de verhuurder. op loop afstand van het centrum. maar in

Philippe's place was very clean and comfortable and in a good area of town.  We had six people and it was very adequate and spacious. The arrangement of the three bathrooms was a plus.   The location was excellent for riding the tram and walking to the Lotto Arena. Lots of nice restaurants, grocery store, etc. nearby.  Would highly recommend and would definately come back.
Heel ruim en mooi appartement. Super locatie in hippe buurt, dicht bij centrum. Veel leuke tips gekregen van Philippe. Echte aanrader!

Superbe appartement ou nous avons passé un excellent séjour à Anvers !
Nous avons apprécié le style, le calme et l'emplacement géographique car l'appartement est situé a 10 mn en tramway du centre ville grâce a la station situé en bas de l’immeuble ou 20 mn a pieds
Merci Philippe pour votre accueil.

Alles in allem TOP!

Wir (6 Freunde) hatten trotz Regen vier wundervolle Tage in Antwerpen. Die großzügige Unterkunft von Philippe befindet sich in sehr guter Lage. Zu Fuß erreicht man in Kürze Bäcker, Metzger, Supermarkt sowie zahlreiche Restaurants (für alle Burger-Fans empfehlen wir "De Burgerij", befindet sich direkt um die Ecke). In ca. 15 Gehminuten erreicht man das Zentrum (Grote Markt, etc.).

Die Kommunikation mit Philippe war sehr gut, er hat bei Fragen in kürzester Zeit per E-Mail geantwortet.
Wir konnten auch später in die Unterkunft einchecken, da wir uns aufgrund des hohen Verkehrsaufkommen leider verspätet haben.

Hinweise:
Schlafzimmer 3: Die vorhandene Matratze ist etwas hart, aber da hat jeder natürlich ein anderes Empfinden.
Badezimmer 1: Der Einstieg in die Badewanne ist höher als es bei unseren Badewannen in Deutschland der Fall ist.

Wir würden jederzeit die Unterkunft weiterempfehlen!
Zeer ruim en fijn appartement dat van alle gemakken is voorzien. Philippe was goed bereikbaar waardoor het in en uit checken soepel verliep.

très bon séjour sur Anvers, appartement très bien placé près du MAS à 10 min à pied du centre historique
les trois chambres donnent sur la cour intérieur, le salon est vaste et lumineux
la cuisine est fonctionnelle et il y a un lave vaisselle!
petit plus: excellente boulangerie/pâtisserie au coin de la rue avec du jus d'orange frais, de très bonnes viennoiseries et même du brie de Meaux :)

Wat een geweldig appartement. Het is ruim en erg mooi, netjes en schoon.
Op het eilandje, restaurants en supermarkt op loop afstand. Oude centrum is 15 min lopen en meire is op 30 min lopen. Dit is prima te doen.
Gewoon een top lokatie!!!

Prachtig appartement! Het is supergroot en heeft 3 heel ruime slaapkamers met heerlijke bedden. Het was superschoon en er lagen voldoende handdoeken voor ons klaar. De ontvangst was heel prettig (contact van tevoren ook prima) en ook heel fijn dat er een eigen parkeerplaats is onder het gebouw. Fijne douches ook! (2 badkamers, ruim voldoende dus als je zoals wij met 2 pubers gaat :-)
De wijk waarin het appartement ligt is heel leuk met hippe ‘strand’tenten om de hoek.
Op loopafstand van het appartement zitten allemaal leuke plekken om te eten en te ontbijten en leuke terrassen. Het MAS is ook op loopafstand. Naar het centrum lopen is redelijk goed te doen.
Kortom: aanrader. Als we weer naar Antwerpen gaan dan zou ik zéker dit weer proberen te huren.

Een fijn huis voor als je met vijf of zes personen Antwerpen bezoekt. Goede locatie, verschillende leuke restaurants en barretjes op loopafstand. Philippe is een goede host, reageert snel op berichten en de ontvangst verliep vlot.
Lovely spacious apartment in great location.

Philippe es un gran anfitrión, estaba esperándonos en la calle a la puerta del edificio y nos recibio muy cordialmente.
Nos informó puntualmente de todo lo necesario, transporte, supermercado, restaurantes ... para facilitarnos nuestra estancia.
Todo lo que se informa sobre el apartamento es totalmente cierto.
Además nos dejó su teléfono por si lo precisábamos para cualquier cosa.

Ruim en prettig appartement op een geweldige locatie. Op een steenworp afstand van onder andere het MAS. Je loopt in een kwartier naar het centrum. Supermarkt, koffietentjes en restaurants binnen handbereik. Communicatie met Philippe verliep soepel. Het appartement is schoon en goed uitgerust. We komen zeker terug!
Mooi en ruim appartement, Philippe was zo vriendelijk om de tijd te nemen om nog wat lokale tips te geven
Fijn verblijf op een hele leuke locatie!
Mooi ruim appartement, vriendelijk ontvangst, goede locatie. Perfect voor een vriendengroep!
Een super ligging, enkele stappen van het MAS en een kwartiertje van het centrum. Ideaal voor een citytripje Antwerpen :-)
Perfekte ligging in rustige buurt, dichtbij  bezienswaardigheden, tram en winkels  vlak bij. Gemakkelijke kommunikatie met Philip. Éen aanrader eerste klasse!
Top verblijf. Goed ontvangen. Top plaats. Super verblijf!
Een zeer ruim appartement dat duidelijk niet de sfeer heeft van een doorleefde woning maar wel functioneel is, zeker gezien de locatie (huurfietsen en tram voor de deur) en de faciliteiten (keuken).
Supergroot appartement op toplocatie! 10 - 15 min lopen naar centrum. Aardige ontvangst ook.

Philippe a été très accueillant et réactif lorsque nous avions des questions. Nous avons beaucoup aimé le quartier moins touristique tout en étant proche du centre. Je recommande cet appartement pour découvrir Anvers.
Mooi appartement op mooie locatie
Excellent flat, good location

Philippe was a great host - he met us at the apartment and guided us into the secure parking below the apartment.  We only stayed for 2 nights but found the flat very spacious and immaculately clan.  Very convenient for our needs!
Phillippe's is a very helpful and friendly host.  The place is very spacious and nice. Location is superb and walking distance from central Antwerp.  We enjoyed our stay and would stay there again.
Just perfect! And just a 10 minute walk to the city center.. Highly recommended with three spacious bed rooms and a nice living room. Great deal!
Everything was great. Lovely spacious apartment. Highly recommend and Philippe was there to greet us and help with any questions.
Zeer ruim appartement op een mooie locatie. Philippe is erg vriendelijk, wij kunnen iedereen een verblijf hier aanraden.

We thought the flat was fantastic. The location was sublime, the check in was smooth and welcoming by Phillippe and his wife, the flat had everything we needed. Having so much open space was very nice for a group like us. The place was very clean and tidy and tastefully done with decorations unique to Antwerp such as art related to the red star line.
Echt fijn appartement om te verblijven !
Conseille énormément

Het appartement van Philippe in Antwerpen is leuk gelegen (op 't eilandje), zeer ruim en mooi ingericht. Alles is aanwezig zoals beschreven. De ontvangst verliep prettig en soepel. Goede communicatie. De afstand tot het centrum is te voet prima te doen. We hebben een goed verblijf gehad met een groepje vriendinnen. Nogmaals bedankt Philippe!
Zeer ruim, proper, goede voorzieningen, middenin hippe buurt, tram voor de deur, parkeren in garage.

The place is very spacious with lot of light and much bigger than you may imagine from the photos. It is immaculately clean, and close to some nice pubs and restaurants. The kitchen is well equipped, and we found it safe for a stay with young children.  There’s a burger restaurant  just round the corner with a great indoor play area, the park with a playground  is 15 min walk and food is easy to find too. It’s easy to walk (or tram ) into centre but still really quiet. Great stay all round!
Big spaces, nice view, clean ambient, comfort

Nice apartment close to the center of Antwerpen. The apartment appeared to be very large, much larger than we expected. It is perfectly clean and Philippe was very kind, quick in responses and personally met us in the apartment and explained everything. One of the benefits of this apartment is a nice parking inside the building, so you may keep your car without any additional costs.
Goed
Essentials and lots of space in a great location.
Ruim tip top appartement op een mooie locatie. Zelfs parkeerplaats was geregeld! Philippe is stipt in zijn afspraken en heeft heerlijke locatie tips!
Very nice place and welcoming host.
Zeer ruim, licht en schhon appartement van alle gemakken voorzien op een perfecte locatie. Geweldig ontvangst door Phillipe.

Ruim comfortabel appartement, mooi ligging onder het huis parkeren .
Phillipe is aardig en attent.
De locatie is geweldig .
Mit Philippe hat alles super geklappt. Gerne wieder.
Ideaal om met meerdere mensen te verblijven.
Place is huge and very convenient to everything in Antwerp.

Schoon en groot appartement op hele goede locatie met eigen parkeerplaats. Goede ontvangst en communicatie. Paar leuke tips gekregen. Slaapkamer waren wat aan de warme kant en zouden best airco kunnen gebruiken

Great place: exactly as advertised

Great location to explore Antwerp. Very large and spacious apartment.

De foto's zijn mooi maar het appartement overtreft de verwachtingen : mooi ingericht, heel ruim, kraaknet, aan alles is gedacht. Heel goeie locatie, vlakbij het centrum en toch een plaats om tot rust te komen.  De parkeerplaats in het gebouw is een pluspunt. Philippe is een superhost die heel snel reageert op berichten zorgt dat alles perfect geregeld is bij aankomst. Een absolute aanrader.
Great host! We had a nice stay in Antwerpen! Thans for all. :)
Communication with Philippe was very easy, and he shared lots of good recommendations. The apartment is spacious and within easy walking distance of the city centre. Would recommend.
The flat was huge and very clean, with a well equipped kitchen. Perfect location for our conference at Waagnatie and walking distance into town.
Nice and roomy apartment thats close to tram and Antwerp city. Philppe was a great host.

Dit is al het derde jaar op rij dat ik voor de organisatie het Verre Reizen Event in de Waagnatie in het appartement van Philippe kom overnachten met enkele collega's. Het appartement is ruim en leuk ingericht, vlakbij de Waagnatie, vlakbij leuke restaurantjes en het MAS. Een absolute aanrader!

Philippe’s place was amazing, such a huge space and beautifully stylish and clean. Philippe communicated with me to ensure a smooth check in and was there to greet us, show us around and give us tips on the immediate area. The Airbnb was around 15 minutes walk from the centre with the tram stop just around the corner. Everything was great and highly recommended. Thanks Philippe
We had a wonderful time in Anvers, staying at Philippe's place. He's reacting, and the flat is well located and very confortable.

Einen Aufenthalt in Philippe‘s Wohnung kann ich uneingeschränkt empfehlen. Noch schöner und größer als auf den Bildern. Wir haben das Auto in der Tiefgarage gelassen und Antwerpen zu Fuß erkundet. Wunderbar!!!
The apartment is really spacious, clean, good location. Philippe was responsive and friendly.
Very nice appartment and Philippe is a very friendly host!
Lejlighed med god plads og indretning. Nærliggende restauranter og dejligt havnemijø at spadsere i.

This is a second visit to Philippe's place. It's huge with two large bathrooms both with separate bath and shower. One ensuite and the other with separate toilet and shared with the third bedroom. The apartment has everything you need with supermarkets, bakeries and restaurants close by. Philippe was there for check in and had some very useful information about navigating the area and recommendations. Straightforward walk into the centre with tram stops outside if you prefer. Very quiet location for a city, very clean, felt safe and comfortable accommodation. The secure onsite parking was useful (tip you need to register your vehicle to take it to the city centre (Website hidden by Airbnb)
Thanks for being a great host Philippe, until next time....

Het is een uitstekend onderkomen!
Het is ruim en dichtbij het centrum.

Ik wil dit appartement zeker aanbevelen

Zeer grote ruimte, gunstig gelegen in Antwerpen vlak bij het MAS,  en met goede parkeervoorzieningen (ingang onder het bord GAMMA). De slaapkamers waren netjes opgemaakt. Philippe was always available during our entire stay. He personally received us at the place, gave us a tour and a lot of local tips. We'd highly recommend his place
great place, great host, great airbnb tot rent
Lovely apartment in a fantastic area. Would recommend it in future!
Een geweldige verblijf op een toplocatie en snelle communicatie! Zeeer tevreden!!!

Great flat in one of the trendy neighbourhoods of Antwerp.  Philippe is a great host. Communication was excellent.  If you don’t know Antwerp, he’ll give you lots of advice on what to do, where to eat etc...
Zeer ruim appartement op een trendy locatie. Alle voorzieningen aanwezig en Philippe is een zeer joviale gastheer.

Super ruim appartement met een hele goede ligging! De communicatie met Philippe verliep super vlot!
We hadden een leuk verblijf met onze 3 kids met de nodige ruimte voor ons allen. Parking onder het gebouw en voor de kids een speeltuin om de hoek.

very nice 3 bedrooms apartment, very well situated. Philippe was extremely reactive and always available to answer all our practical questions about his city.

Christel and Paul are such a lovely couple! They own such a beautiful, bright and spacious apartment just a 7 minute walk away from the Zoo and Central Station. They were very welcoming and always willing to help us. If I ever come back to Antwerp there is no other place I would rather stay in!

Dit huis is groot, licht en rustig - terwijl het zo centraal ligt en zich in een levendige volkswijk bevindt.

Bedankt voor het fijne verblijf en tot ziens!

Hippe flat ! De foto's doen de plek niet helemaal eer aan. Het is een ruim , smaakvol ingericht en zeer proper appartement. Het is rustig gelegen voor de binnenstad, en toch zeer centraal. Wij vonden dit een topadresje!

This was my first Airbnb booking and if this was anything to go by, it will not be my last. All in all, a great success!

Wat. Een. Appartement. Groot, mooi en goed onderhouden. Perfecte ligging, diversiteit in buurtbewoners die  zelf eens kwamen aanbellen voor een buurtfeestje. Het bed ligt fantastisch, ruime woonkamer, eetkamer, klein knus keukentje dat alles heeft wat je nodig hebt. Heel Antwerpen is op voetafstand te bereiken. Prijs/kwaliteit is erg goed, zou er gerust meer aan willen gegeven hebben. Ik ben verkocht! Als het kan kom ik hier terug.

Mooi appartement (inderdaad mooier dan de foto's doen vermoeden) in een levendige wijk. Het ligt iets buiten het oude centrum (20 min lopen) maar daarom vonden wij het juist een leuke optie. Zeker een aanrader.

Christel & Paul's apartment is a true hidden gem – located 8 minutes away from the Central Station it is at a stone-throw distance from the Chinese district and comfortably close to the centre of the city. The apartment itself is gorgeously spacious, beautifully furnished and cosy with a terrace adding to its charm. We'd be happy to come back!

It is a big Yes. Yes, the apartment was much more than we expected. Yes, we loved the terrace, yes, Christel and Paul gave us a warm welcome with Belgian Beer + ideas to spend our two days. Yes, we loved the apartment, all the details. No IKEA, but love, no Design-Master-Plan, but love. Izzitlove? Yes it was, on the first sight. Now, if not before, we are beer lovers. Now, if not before, we love Belgium. Now we think of coming back to Antwerpen.
Thank you two for the experience.

De foto's doen geen eer aan dit grote, schone appartement met een zeer gastvrije eigenaar die ons praktische tips gaf waar we zeker gebruik van hebben gemaakt! Danken Paul hiervoor, helaas Christel niet ontmoet. We komen graag nog een keer terug en bevelen familie en vrienden graag dit adres aan

The house is wonderful and personalized. For the three of us it was big and comfortable. You really fell at home!
Paul warmly welcomed us and stayed for a beer in the terrace, giving us very useful tips about Antwerp. We enjoyed a lot our stay in the neighborhood (we had a delicious dinner nearby) and in the city. For people travelling by car, the house is easily reacheable and well located for exploring the city and the surroundings (there are many interesting things to see outside the city centre!).
Everything was perfect and I strongly recommend this accommodation.
Christel and Paul were amazing hosts. I would definitely recommend there place and can't wait to go back myself.

Charming, very spacious apartment slightly off the historical centre. The location is great - walkable distance from sights and the nightlife, in the middle of a diverse area of Antwerp.

The hosts could not be more welcoming - we had a pleasure to meet both during the check in and they turned out to be most lovely people who gave us many recommendations over a glass of some fantastic local beer :)

Thank you and hope to see you again!

Ontvangst zeer ongedwongen en charmant. Appartement heeft stijl. Eenvoud en klasse en is in werkelijkheid groter dan het lijkt op de foto's. De communicatie is uiterst vriendelijk en concreet. TOPPER.
We had an amazing time at Christel & Paul’s place! Their home is fantastic, stylish and located superbly. We felt very welcome and they are very quick to respond. Definitely coming back.

Christel and Paul are really nice, generous and accessible,
The apartment is (Really) large, clean, comfortable and well equipped,

all we could ask for when going on vacation.

Super air bnb op loopafstand van Sportpaleis (30 min) en historisch centrum (30 min). Uiteraard kun je tram ook pakken, maar wij houden van lopen. Voor ons de ideale plek om te verblijven voor bezoek aan concert in combinatie met de stad ontdekken! Goede hosts met veel tips. Nogmaals bedankt :)

thank's again Christel and Paul for the nice welcome and the really amazing flat!
I can definetly recommend this Place.

has enough space for 4 People!

- mooi en ruim appartement, alles aanwezig. heel rustig.
- vlakbij centraal station, en alles op wandelafstand.
- heel vriendelijke ontvangst. we kregen vele handige en leuke tips.

Christel and Paul were perfect hosts and gave us valuable tips for Antwerp and other places in the area over a nice beer. The apartment exceeded all expectations, was very quiet and very comfortable. We would immediately rent this apartment again and can only recommend it to anyone interested! Thank you for everything, Christel &Paul!

This apartment is incredible in every possible way. Spacious and beautiful, fantastically located, and the patio feels like the cosiest place in the whole of Antwerp. Christel and Paul are extremely nice and make you feel so welcome. Hope to return there next time.

This stay was our very first experience with Airbnb, and it definitely did not disappoint! Our host, Paul (Christel was away for work), went above and beyond our expectations to welcome us and to make sure we had enough local information to enjoy visiting Antwerp. He was very flexible and patient with our arrival and departure times which changed slightly. We enjoyed a relaxed introduction to Antwerp and an overview of the apartment upon arrival, and he took lots of time to mark important sites on the map for us. We found this extra help especially valuable because we could do a number of things that are not in tour books, which were very memorable and highly enjoyable. We enjoyed a great conversation with Paul late into the evening of our arrival. The apartment is located a short walk from the central train station in a safe neighborhood, and it is easy to find restaurants nearby. The apartment is also beautiful, spacious, and spotless. An outdoor terrace is available to welcome in the morning or to close down the evening. Just to sum up, we would highly recommend staying at Paul and Christel’s apartment when you’re in Antwerp. It was the perfect introduction to Airbnb and we will definitely be back to both.

Heel mooi en propere kamers. Vriendelijk ontvangst en snelle reactie op onze berichten. Wat een fantastisch huis! En een heerlijk bed! Ook het praatje met Paul was erg leuk en we komen heel graag hier weer eens terug!
Great place, lovely hosts and a real gem on this side of Antwerp!

Gastvrij. Enthousiast ontvangst.Mooie en wederom enthousiaste tips om de stad te verkennen. Ze nemen persoonlijk de citymap met je door. Fijne omgeving, mooi huis, alles op loopafstand. Wij hebben een heerlijk weekend gehad.

Strongly recommended! Nice space, all in the lenght, with splendid light all day long, a nice terrace - and another nice terrace, on a lower level, quietness in a busy neighborhood, a taste for the arts and for the atmosphere in the whole space: everything was perfect! Thank You, both, Christel & Paul!

Brilliant home with helpful and cinsiderate hosts.  Pictures do not do the space justice, stylish, large open loving areas and great location.  Paul and Christel provided some insight to the city and a beer on arrival which made the expeience of this home even better.  Would defintley stay here again !!!
Ruim appartement met alle faciliteiten op loopafstand van het Centraal Station. De ontvangst door Christel en Paul was hartverwarmend. Zij gaven ons alle info die wij wensten.

de loin le plus spacieux des Bnb que jai pu avoir. très typique dans un quartier calme à proximité des points d'intérêt. Christel & Paul nous on très bien accueilli. je recommande vraiment !

The single room in which I stayed had clean and fresh linen over a sofa, surprisingly comfortable despite not being a proper bed. The room is tiny, yet if the main purpose is to explore museums and you are of a spartan inclination, then it should be fine. The towels were clean and fresh, too. The floor is wooden and rooms are close to each other, so you hear all sounds of people passing - which, again, is normal given that it is a private home and the owners live in it. The breakfast is bread with sweet speads or cheese&ham. The internet works only in common area, which is,however, huge and has space to accommodate everyone. There is only one shower, yet despite being more than 4 people it was not a problem. Manuel makes you welcome with a drink, shares stories and prepares breakfasts, making sure you feel welcome! The house has a bit of a humidity smell, yet this is a building problem outside of owners’ control. Manuel also helped me wash my clothes - a favor appreciates greatly by anyone who travels! Getting around is very easy (tram costs 15 eur per 10 travels and leaves in front of the house), by walking it is 1h to the centre. 8min easy walk to the station. Bottom line is: this place is safe, flexible and friendly.

I have stayed in a lot of AirBnb's and hotels over the years and this is definitely one of the best places I have stayed.  This unit seems to be a purpose-renovated character building - built specifically to comfortably house large groups.  It is 6 floors, with a kitchen on the main, bedroom on 2, common room/living room on 3 and bedrooms on 4 and 5.  3 of the 5 levels have washrooms.  The basement houses a washer/dryer and extra towels.  Our group was only 5 people but the unit could easily host 10 people.  Within the unit is everything you would need - from shampoo in the showers to two towels per bathroom and a well-stocked kitchen.  The host left us a bottle of wine and Nespresso pods for the coffee maker.  The wifi was fast on all levels and everything worked perfectly.  Each room, but most notably the ground level has large windows.  Being 6 levels there was quite a few steep stairs and no lift/elevator in the unit.  This wasn't an issue for us, but if you have any mobility issues at all, the stairs would be challenging.  The area is very quiet at night and super central.  We never took one taxi the whole trip.  The host was very responsive (even at night) and there was a keypad system, which for a group is quite nice because no one needed keys.  Check-in and check-out were easy, everything was spotlessly clean and the beds were very comfortable.  This is a truly 5-star experience and a gorgeous place to stay.  I would 100% recommend this unit to anyone.
