Tonys Wohnung ist wirklich ein kleines zu Hause in Antwerpen. Wir haben uns dort sehr wohl gefühlt. Tony hat zwei Reiseführer für uns hingelegt, die uns wirklich geholfen haben, bei unseren Entdeckungstouren. In 20 Minuten erreicht man zu Fuß den Hbf und auch alle anderen Orte sind gut zu erreichen, dabei liegt die Wohnung in einer ruhigen Straße. Da wir Geburtstag hatten, hat uns Tony auch noch eine kleine Überraschung hingelegt :)
Ich würde auf jeden Fall wieder hier wohnen, wenn ich in Antwerpen bin.

Super mooi appartement dat heel stijlvol en rustig is ingericht. Binnen 5 min ben je bij het metrostation of een tramstation. De locatie is vanuit het centum ook goed beloopbaar, in een kwartiertje ben je er. Tony had ook een map achter gelaten met allerlei goeie tips voor de in de hele stad en ook lokaal. Echt een top verblijf!

Wir haben eine Woche in der Wohnung von Tony gewohnt und haben uns super wohl gefühlt. Alles war perfekt und entspannt. Wir konnten unser Auto ganz in der Nähe parken (3,80€) pro Tag und hatten unsere Fahrräder vor der Tür abgeschlossen. Wir konnten gut schlafen, da es sehr ruhig war.  Dinge des täglichen Bedarfs gibt es auf der nahe gelegenen Hauptstraße. Die Bar am Krugerplein war super für den Sundowner und das Eis nebenan ebenso.

Die Wohnung ist sehr schön eingerichtet und hat mir ausgesprochen gut gefallen! Das einzige, was ein bisschen schwierig war, war die Parkplatzsuche. Aber mit Geduld haben wir doch noch einen gefunden.
Tony hat uns per Email den Check-in sehr einfach gemacht. Top organisiert!
Very nice appartment! We enjoyed our days in Antwerpen.

Ontzettend naar onze zin gehad in dit appartement. Schoon, mooi ruim en hip. We voelde ons hier direct thuis.

Ook de communicatie met de verhuurder was super. Gelijk bij aankomst kregen we ook een berichtje met informatie over het ov. Ook lagen er mapjes en boekjes met informatie over de stad, erg Fijn!

Overall echt een aanrader!
Een fijn, net en stijlvolle plek om te verblijven...prima locatie om de stad te verkennen!

Tony's house is great. It's one of the few places left that's actually someone's home, which makes the experience even more special. You feel like a local since you are in a residential area. We really loved this! And everything is still walking distance. There's a bunch of nice's bars and coffee places near the house. Our favourite for breakfast was 'september' right next door. We definitely recommend his place!
Tony's appartment is both, very comfortable and very cool - we definitely love his style! It's, the perfect place for a visit to Antwerp.

Tony’s apartment is beautiful, absolutely clean en very stylish. Even more nice than on the photos. The communication went really well. We really enjoyed  our stay in Antwerpen and at Tony’s place. Highly recommended!!

appartement spacieux, propre et bien équipé. Tony a été très réactif à mes questions et à mis à disposition un welcome book avec toutes les informations nécessaires. juste un petit bémol: l'appartement n'a pas de volets (store et rideaux) donc la lumière prend tôt possession de la chambre.
非常滿意

Nous avons séjourné deux nuits dans l'appartement de Tony. Nous avons apprécié l'arrivée autonome car nous sommes arrivées un peu tard le soir... Tony est très réactif et disponible. L'appartement est extrêmement propre, très lumineux, décoré avec goût et on se sent vite chez soi ! Tony met à disposition du café (ce qui est très appréciable lorsque l'on est juste de passage sur la ville) ainsi que des livres avec les endroits à visiter ou de bonnes idées de restaurants. Nous avons passé un excellent séjour.

Although we didn't meet Tony, he was very responsive to messages which ensured a smooth check in and comfortable stay. The apartment was beautiful and within walking distance from central station. Only downside was there was not a great deal to do around the area (cafe next door closed for holidays while we were there), but most things fairly accessible by cycling in about 20 minutes ride. Overall a great stay!

Wij hebben hier echt een super weekend gehad! Het appartement was heel stijlvol ingericht en van alle gemakken voorzien. Tony zijn instructies voor het in- en uitchecken waren duidelijk, we hadden alles zo uitgevogeld. Tony reageerde snel op onze berichtjes en was al met al een heel goede gastheer :) Overigens liggen er in het appartement veel infoboekjes en foldertjes met informatie over Antwerpen. Superhandig!

A really nice, clean and spacious apartment with tasteful design and cool details. Tony answered quickly and gave a detailed welcome in a neat binder in the apartment.

Very nice and quiet neighbourhood with good restaurants, bars and coffee places.

I really enjoyed staying at Tony's place. It was very well located for the conference I was attending. It was clean and stylish.

Tony was a helpful and responsive host who got back to me quickly in response to questions.

I would have preferred a bit more storage space for clothes, and a slightly firmer bed, but these are minor points.

Overall I was happy with my stay. Thank you Tony!

Nice apartment within walking distance from the city center(20 min) but also great connection to the city centre by bus/metro (every 10 min). The apartment is nice and stylish. The communication with Tony is good and is available for any questions. We had a great weekend staying at Tony’s apartment!
Top

Tony ist ein super Gastgeber mit einer tollen Wohnung - so macht Airbnb Spaß! Die Kommunikation war easy und zuverlässig. Das Check-in klappte problemlos über eine Schlüsselbox und dann standen wir in einer wirklich super coolen, geschmackvoll eingerichteten Wohnung und fühlten uns sofort richtig wohl. Alles roch herrlich duftig und war blitzblank. Tony hatte uns zwei Reiseführer und einen Hefter mit nützlichen Tips bereit gelegt - eine perfekte Grundlage für ein paar schöne Tage in Antwerpen. Die Wohnung liegt praktisch, um entweder zu Fuß oder mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln die Stadt zu erkunden. Nachts war es traumhaft ruhig und das Bett sehr kuschlig. Wir haben die Tage in Tonys Wohnung sehr genossen - Danke, lieber Tony!!!!
Erg schoon en ruim appartement vlakbij het centrum van Antwerpen.

Had a great stay at Tony’s place! Photos are exactly as it is. Very cosy and warm in the evening, with all amenities needed. Walking distance into town and a cute cafe/restaurant right on the corner.
We would definitely come back . Cheers !

Our we at Tony’s place was perfect ! His flat is really Nice, is in a calm neigbourhood close to the subway/tramway, and smells really good ☺️ Tony was reactive and flexible and lets tips for his hosts in a notebook. I definitely recommand !!
Ruime en lichte studio op loopafstand van het centrum en de Lotto Arena
Tony's apartment is super cosy and clean. It was perfect for our short trip to Antwerp!
Nice place! We had a pleasant stay and would recommend it. Neighbourhood has some nice restaurants and bars and with metro you are very quick in city center.
Tony’s apartment is stylish, clean and very pleasant to stay in. The location is great and Tony is an excellent host. We can also highly recommend the September cafe below the apartment.

De air bnb was zeer netjes, lichtrijk met een huiselijke gezellige sfeer.
De communicatie met Tony verliep heel vlot waarbij ook het betreden van de air bnb ook vlot verliep met goede instructies.
In het pand zelf was een schriftje voorzien met allerlei tips over Antwerpen en restaurants.
Vlot vervoer en bereikbaar vanuit Antwerpen Centraal op maar 20 min tevoet.
De ligging zelf van het pand was uitstekend en rustig, geen nachtlawaai enkel als vrouw 's nachts op straat kan het misschien gevaarlijk zijn.
Ik kom met plezier terug! Zeer mooie lichtrijke air bnb en fijne communicatie.
Goeie ruimte, alles schoon, vriendelijke host die de term Superhost helemaal waar maakt. Zou het zeker aanraden.

What you see is What you get! Prachtige ruime schone woning, dmv de velo fietsen ben je overal super snel!
Aanrader.

Super fijne plek net buiten het centrum. De buurt is rustig met gezellige plekjes. Het appartement was ruim en schoon. We konden zelf heel makkelijk in en uitchecken wat fijn was. Tony had boekjes vol met tips over Antwerpen achtergelaten waar we veel gebruik van hebben gemaakt.
We had a great weekend in Antwerpen. Toni’s Flat is very clean and tidy. The Insider Tips were perfect. We enjoyed our stay.

Unser Aufenthalt in Tonys Apartment war einfach super. Die Lage ist sehr schön und eher ruhig gelegen. Trotzdem ist man super schnell im Zentrum von Antwerpen. Das Apartment war sehr stilvoll eingerichtet und sehr sauber. Der Balkon zum Hinterhof des Hauses ausgerichtet ist ein absolutes Highlight. Auch wenn er eher klein ausfällt kann man wunderbar morgens bei Sonnenschein sein Frühstück genießen. Alles in allem ein rundum gelungener Service!

Meine Freundin und ich waren für 3 Nächte in Tony‘s Appartment und wir waren sehr zufrieden. Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber und hat einen umwerfenden Stil. Das Nachbarscafe September. ist sehr zu empfehlen. Hier haben wir jeden Morgen gefrühstückt.
Fijn appartement en locatie!

It was a perfect experience staying at Tony's: the apartment is super clean, very comfy and furnished tastefully. We also liked the atmosphere in the neighbourhood very much. There are some nice bars and cafés and it's close enough to the centre of Antwerp.
Mooi appartement net buiten het oude stadscentrum. De communicatie is snel en duidelijk, inchecken en uitchecken gaat precies zoals je wilt.

Tony’s place was a great spot to stay at. We travelled from London to Brussels via Eurostar, following which it is a short train ride from Brussels to Antwerp before a 20 minute walk out to Tony’s apartment.

The location is a nice distance from the centre and has some really good spots to eat/drink at locally - September (a food spot literally below the apartment on street level) was a handy spot which does great food, and others are covered in the info pack Tony provides.

Tony’s apartment was sparkling clean, spacious and the bed very comfy. It was perfectly located for our trip and was easily walkable into the town and to local shops. Tony was a very responsive host and communicated well. We enjoyed our stay.
Appartement situé à 5 minutes du tram et bus.Très propre et très agréable pour y séjourner et visiter Anvers.

Tony's place is lovely - the pictures show it accurately. Tony himself is very nice, quick to respond, and accommodating. He tries to make your stay as pleasant as possible! We feel lucky to have found this apartment, so much so that we asked Tony to extend our stay. :)

The fact that I'm writing my second review says it all. :) Tony's place is just lovely. It is great for 2 people with all the home basics you could need, including a clothes washer. Tony himself is easy going, easy to communicate with, and very nice to meet. The neighborhood is great as well. You will enjoy staying at Tony's.

Fantastic location right in central Antwerp. Clean. Comfy bed. Up on the 4th floor but there's a lift! Susha stocked the kitchen with all the right tools to cook and even left us some cold beverages to enjoy in the fridge. Be aware that the toilet is on the first floor of this two-story loft and the bed and shower are upstairs so if you need to use the bathroom at night, it's down a spiral stair. That said, this is an AMAZING location from which to base a trip to Antwerp - a vibrant, funky, and friendly city!

Perfect stay in a great, cosy apartment set in a perfect location, a stone throw from the Cathedral and Groenplaats. Great contact with Susha, Peter and Roel, all very accomodating and didactic.

Aux premières loges pour profiter du délicieux carillon de Notre Dame, appartement parfait et un contact facile et très chaleureux avec nos hôtes.

A heaven of peace and quiet in the middle of the old beautiful part of Antwerp . The place is absolutely great . Marvellously designed , spacious and spotless clean  . Had an excellent stay , will come back and recommend it to everyone ! Adam !

Susha is one of the most recommendable hosts we've ever met since we started with our AirBnB experience 5 years ago. We had a great time in her appartment  which is located close to the grand place in the center of Antwerpes. Thank you so much Susha for giving us this opportunity!

Wonder stay. Peter welcomed us with his charming smile was super hospitable. The place was clean and charming. Delicious coffee awaited us in the morning. Super understanding for a mishap we had. Everything we needed was available. The elevator broke upon our arrival and we had to walk the stairs but he was most apologetic. These things happen. Would love to stay again. Highly recommend their place for anyone considering a stay in Antwerp.

This place is perfect for two people travelling to Antwerp! It's in the perfect location in the center of everything, right near the cathedral, and had all the amenities we needed. The host was very welcoming and the place was lovely and clean. I'd definitely stay here again!
Top locatie, midden in 't hart van Antwerpen zonder last te hebben van geluiden van buitenaf. En zeker niet onbelangrijk: service van Susha & Zepp was heel fijn, er werd goed voor ons gezorgd!

One of our best Airbnb experiences.  Susha was extremely hospitable--welcomed us with beer and wine and cookies in the apartment, and spent time with us explaining Antwerp.  The apartment is tastefully decorated, immaculate, and well-equipped.  It's located steps from the cathedral and main square, so it couldn't be more central.  5 stars!

Great place! Peter came to lett us in and is super friendly and willing to give you a lot of tips for Your visit to antwerp. Also during our stay Peter was very easy to communicate with and checked in on us every now and then to see if there was anything we needed. Also gave us some really nice recomendations wich made our stay extra pleasant.The appartment has everything you need and some extra's like fresh flowers and cookies wich make you feel right at home.
The location is also really Nice! When you walk out if the door there are a lot of restaurants and bars within 5 minutes walk.
Would definetely come back here!

Peter and Susha’s apartment was incredibly beautiful and right in the center of town: the perfect location for our brief stay in Antwerp. Peter was there to welcome us when we arrived, and was incredibly kind and thoughtful, showing us around the place, where to find coffee, utensils, etc. He also provided an entire booklet of recommendations, from museums, to restaurants, to activities, and the like. We would absolutely recommend this to anyone planning a trip to Antwerp, and hope we can return in the future!

By far the best experience staying at an airbnb. Was not able to meet Susha, but Peter's enthusiasm and amazing personalty was noticed immediately upon arrival. When we checked in, Peter went over an entire map of Antwerp and highlighted all we need to see, including many not as well known local spots. We were greeted with beer in the fridge, wine, and some snacks. Apartment was clean and everything we needed was readily available. Peter even introduced us to some awesome neighbors (market and cafe right on the block). I'm sure I'm missing more great details you will find out about if you stay here.

This experience was over and above what we were expecting. Highly, highly recommend staying here for anyone coming to Antwerp.
Wonderful apartement in the center of Antwerp, Susha and Peter are very hospitable, all has perfect :) I recommend this apartement and Susha and Peter

This place is an absolute gem: a gorgeous flat in a perfect location, only a stone's throw from the sights of the city! The flat contains everything one might need - and in addition to the essentials, the hosts had provided lots of lovely little extras: a bottle of delicious wine, great eco coffee, a bunch of gorgeous flowers, ... Susha and Peter were fantastic hosts: incredibly friendly and helpful. They made us feel completely at home in their beautiful flat. I would highly recommend this place to anyone planning to visit Antwerp!

Fantástico loft decorado con todo tipo de detalles. Céntrico, sin ruidos y a un paso de la mejor zona de la ciudad.
Los anfitriones Susha y Pether geniales, atentos y siempre al cuidado de todo y en todo momento.
A nuestra llegada nos esperaban en la puerta, nos compraron la guia en español de la ciudad, nos dejaron la nevera con 2 cervezas y una botella de vino española.
Todos los detalles y la ciudad han acompañado para una gran experiencia.
Sin lugar a duda súper recomendable

This place is amazing. It is so central, with a view of the cathedral, it's lovely inside, and the hosts Susha and Peter are so, so helpful. It's a great deal for a lovely trip to Antwerp. Susha was right there waiting for us when we arrived and helped us get settled. Peter messaged to see if we were doing well. We could walk everywhere so easily and their recommendations on food and drink were on point.

Book this place id you want to have a great time in Antwerp!

Спасибо Peter! Очень стильная квартира, в самом центре города, вид из окна просто нереальный! Все есть в квартире , что нужно, кухня, хорошая ванна и спальня на втором этаже! Однозначно рекомендую! И Peter встретил нас с бутылочкой белого французского, что очень было приятно! Thank Peter, all was perfect!

This place is gorgeous. The bed is comfy, the shower is good, the host is very helpful, and you literally couldn't get more central. If you don't like church bells this isn't the place for you, but everyone else should stay here, it's lovely!

Sushas und Peters "birdnest" ist eine helle, wunderschöne und mit Kunst gefüllte Wohnung mitten im Zentrum, in 30 Sekunden ist man am Rathaus - und trotzdem ist von Touristenmengen und Stadtlärm nichts wahrzunehmen! Ein hervorragender Rückzugs- und Erholungsort.
Obendrein befindet sich in direkter Nachbarschaft ein kleines Lädchen mit einem umfangreichen Eissortiment und allem, was man vergessen haben könnte und auch ein außergewöhnlicher Bäcker (Brot und Spiele) ist unbedingt empfehlenswert.
Susha und Peter sind phantastische Gastgeber, jederzeit erreichbar, unkompliziert, fröhlich... Außerdem haben sie noch etliche weitere Tipps und Ideen, denen man folgen sollte, denn man kann Wunderbares und Unbekanntes entdecken, auch wenn man schon oft in Antwerpen gewesen ist. Wir freuen uns schon jetzt auf nächsten Aufenthalt.
Lovely apartment in the centre of Antwerp close to the sights and restaurants. Amazing view from the fourth floor. Lots of helpful tips from Peter and bottles of wine and beer in the fridge.

A really wonderful, magical place. Lovely views, spacious and airy feel, lots of privacy. Everything you need and then some. The space was clearly put together with thought and love. Susha and Peter are incredible people and wonderful hosts. We had a lovely time.

Susha et Peter ont été extrêmement agréables et accueillants. Ils ont tout fait pour faciliter notre arrivée et notre départ, et nous on donné beaucoup de conseils de sorties sur Anvers. Ils se sont montrés disponibles en permanence et très réactifs. Et le plus important : leur appartement est vraiment exceptionnel, situé en plein centre de la ville et au dernier étage d'un immeuble avec ascenseur : la vue est sublime, on se réveille avec tous les toits d'Anvers sous les yeux chaque matin. C'est exceptionnel !

Die Unterkunft ist einfach herrlich. Wundervoll und liebevoll eingerichtet und der ideal Platz für eine tolle Zeit in Antwerpen. Es fehlt an nichts. Die Lage ist super, sehr zentral, um die ganze Stadt zu Fuß zu erkunden. Wunderbare Gastgeber runden das Gesamtpaket ab.

Cet appartement est idéalement  situé (à 50m de la grand place). La décoration est parfaite et on se sent comme chez soi! Peter et susha sont des hôtes très sympathique et d'une grande disponibilité. Leurs nombreux  conseils vous aideront à découvrir cette magnifique ville!  Un sans faute.

One of the best Airbnb experience so far.

The hosts - Peter and Susha - are super friendly and helpful. When we arrived, Peter gave us a very thorough orientation of Antwerp and offered us some great takeaway advices.

The flat itself is very cozy, clean and comfortable. You can find everything you need and the best thing is you get to have complementary beer and wine!

The location is very good, locating near the City hall close to the shopping area with lots of restaurants.


Highly recommend this flat!

Прекрасная квартира в самом центре. Расположение - лучше не придумать. Красивый вид, все как на фотографиях. Удобная кровать, достаточно большая ванная. Хорошая, оборудованная кухня, чай, кофе, молоко и даже пиво и бутылка вина. Питер и его жена Суша дружественны и предупредительны, всегда на связи.

Séjour chez Susha pour un long week-end! Nous avons passé 3 jours très agréables, et l'appartement est parfait. Il est situé à 2 pas de la place centrale et est donc parfait pour visiter les points d'intérêt de la ville rapidement et à pieds.
La vue sur les toits d'Anvers et sur le clocher de la cathédrale au réveil est des plus agréable.
Super adresse, foncez!!
Beautiful apartment in a perfect location. It's cozy, comfortable and clean. Peter was a wonderful host! Very helpful and friendly. I would highly recommend this place!!!
Stijlvol en gezellig appartement in het hartje van Antwerpen. Het bed is heerlijk, alles was brandschoon en de eigenaren waren ontzettend behulpzaam. Aanrader!
Really cozy and clean apartment. Located in the centre of Antwerp close to the old parts of the city. A parking is close, too. Thanks for the advice on local shops and food places, Peter.

This apartment is an AirBnB gem! Every detail was thoroughly considered to provide the ultimate local experience - If you’re traveling solo or as a couple to Antwerp, this is where you want to stay! Check in/out was super easy and communication was clear and constant. I could have spent all night chatting with Zzepp, one of the fantastic hosts, who shared so much information I was never without something to do. Steps outside of the front door is one of the most beautiful squares in Europe with more restaurants, bars, and clubs than you can count. Staying at this apartment made me want to extend my stay in Antwerp, or at least come back as soon as possible. I’m already looking forward to my next visit! A+++

We had a veeery good stay! very nice people, with a beautiful apartment in the city center. they thought about every little detail. nice local tips, some tea , coffee.. and beers!! the bed is super comfy! and the hospitality great! thanks:) X

This is a lovely apartment, decorated with great individuality and style and right in the heart of Antwerp. I was a little late arriving, but Zzep not only waited for me but also helped to locate a taxi which was a matter of urgency as I had to get to an appointment. I loved staying here, I hope I can come again for a longer time!

Een heerlijk licht appartement om de hoek van de Grote Markt. Voorzien van alle gemakken. We werden zeer gastvrij onthaald door Susha en Peter. Een warm welkom. Dit kom je nog maar weinig tegen. Het verblijf was fijn. Een appartement dat met veel zorg en aandacht is ingericht en waar je heerlijk tot rust komt. Om de hoek gezellige cafe's en eettentjes. Voor een weekend Antwerpen een aanrader!

Amazing location in the heart of Antwerp! Susha and Peter were fantastic and accommodating hosts and checked in with us several times throughout our stay. They gave many great recommendations for places to eat and drink as well as things to do. The apartment itself is very cozy, complete with coffee, tea, cookies, beer and wine. We would definitely stay with Susha and Peter again!

Susha & Peter's place in the middle of Antwerp's beautiful center is truly fantastic. It looks even better in real life than on the photo's. The place is cosy, arty and at a great location.. A recommendation for a get away you will remember... And not to forget, Peter and Sushi are great hosts that look after you during your stay! Great place, great people xo

Susha en Peter zijn erg hartelijke mensen die hun gasten fijn verwelkomen! Prettige communicatie en ze zijn bereid je te helpen bij alle vragen die je hebt, ook tijdens je verblijf kan je hen ten alle tijde 'lastig' vallen. Het appartement was super, van alle gemakken voorzien en is gelegen op een perfecte locatie. Je loopt zo de grote markt op en er zit een erg goede bakker op 30m van het appartement! De ideale uitvalsbasis voor een citytrip en zou zeker hier nog een keer willen verblijven.

Ons verblijf bij Susha en Peter was top! Appartement zeer mooi ingericht met alle nodige voorzieningen. De communicatie was uitmuntend en ook de tips voor lokale commerce waren super. Zeker het bakkertje om de hoek testen. Een echte aanrader!!

Very central, cosy, and very helpful host. The flat is on the doorstep of what Antwerp offers.
The flat is super comfortable and Susha explains and makes you feel right at home in a very well decorated apartment with all the amenities you would need for a weekend away.
Heerlijke plek, top ontvangst, loft is van alle gemakken voorzien, fijne badkamer en keuken...en dat alles hartje centrum!
Peter was great and gave us lots of good advice about what to do and see in Antwerp. The apartment was also lovely, comfortable and clean. I would definitely stay again.
Lovely and clean apartment, just 10 steps away from de ''Grote Markt'' and all other sights and attractions of the city!

Susha's apartment is one of the best AirBnb's we've ever stayed in in Europe - for numerous reasons.

One, the apartment looks amazing. Stylish, with a dash of rock n roll, it just oozes charm and personality. The two floors distribute the space amazingly well, and the views behind the Cathedral are pretty spellbinding.

Which brings us to two - location. Could this apartment get any better? You walk out and literally spill into the main square and front entrance of the Cathedral - it's kind of mind blowing how ideally situatuated this apartment is.

Third - the hosts themselves. Susha and her boyfriend are AMAZING and incredibly friendly - with a million tips on where to go, and what todo. They replied to messages instantly, and made us feel more like extended family than weary travellers - which was very appreciated.

An amazing place to stay.

Sushas place was perfect for a short stay in Antwerp but I'd also recommand Sushas flat for a longer stay... it is perfectly located and you have absolutely everything around. Susha was very helpful and always endeavour to make our stay comfortable and easy. She even took care about our late check out request. I'm very fussy regarding cleanliness but there is nothing to complain... Everything I can say: "it was a perfect stay!" :) Thank you Susha!
Susha and Peter are fantastic hosts, very responsive and considerate. Their place is very cosy and couldn’t be in a better spot to explore old Antwerpen. Very recommendable!!!
Geweldige loft in hartje Antwerpen, alle voorzieningen om de hoek of binnen loopafstand. Aanrader.

We would certainly recommend this beautiful accommodation that provides everything you could wish for.
It is right in the centre of Antwerp amongst all the 16th century houses and Cathedral, the chiming of the cathedral from outside our window was a delight.

Transportation was very simple to understand with numerous tram lines and buses practically at your doorstep.

We shall definitely be returning to this wonderful apartment, and most importantly the wonderful hosts Zzepp and Susha.

The Stay at Susha's and Peters appartment was perfect.
Both are very obliging hosts and it was really nice to talk to them.
The flat is absolutly beautiful and peppered with many little messages which is very funny. The View through the windows to the old town of Antwerp is awesome!

Wat een geweldige plek. Het ligt naast de grote markt midden in het centrum van Antwerpen. Het is echt een super locatie. We werden hartelijk ontvangen door Peter die ons allerlei tips over de buurt gaf en ons het appartement liet zien. Dit was de mooiste en schoonste Airbnb waar we ooit in hebben gezeten. Ook had Peter al een biertje voor ons in de koelkast gelegd wat erg attent was. Het is erg ruim voor twee personen en van alle gemakken voorzien. Het ziet er ook erg strak uit qua design en er hangt mooie kunst. Als wij teruggaan, gaan we zeker weer hier in! Een enorm fijne plek in het centrum van het mooie Antwerpen. Bedankt Peter en Susha!
Lovely hosts, fantastic location, very clean and just a really great place to stay.
Can’t beat the location!

2. de ligging is dus heel centraal maar wel wat gehorig 's nachts. Het ligt net voorbij een aantal kroegen en met mooi weer verblijven mensen buiten en zijn luidruchtig. Als ik dit van te voren had geweten had ik oordoppen meegenomen.

Al met al zouden wij zeker nog een keer teruggaan, we hebben erg genoten van Antwerpen en het appartement!

Joachim's apartment is a perfect location for those looking visit Antwerp.  It's within walking distance to everything and on an amazing street.  It can be a bit loud at night but not if you close all the windows.  We highly recommend this apartment.
We’ve really enjoyed our stay. The appartment was beautiful and very well located.

Joachim's appartment is great. It's very central, so you can reach many restaurants and bars in a few minutes. So it could be, that sometimes it is a bit louder. No problem for us. For sightseeing the appartment is also perfect. Joachim is a very good and polite host. If you have any questions or problems, he is always helpful. If we will come back to Antwerpen, only in his appartment. Everything was perfect.

Sofort und immer wieder gerne würde ich in die Wohnung von Joachim zurück kommen!! Sie liegt im Herzen der Altstadt und ist super Zentral zu allen Orten die man erkunden möchte. Leckere Kaffees für Brunch oder Kaffee und Kuchen (Bubble Waffle Café, Salon de the Claude), viele Restaurants und tolle Bars (Dogma Cocktails) befinden sich gleich um die Ecke... Fürs Shoppingherz ist auch gesorgt... die Hauptshoppingstrasse befindet sich ca. 15 Minuten von der Wohnung entfernt. Wir haben die Stadt zu Fuss erkundigt, man kann jedoch auch überall Fahrräder mieten... Die Wohnung ist genau wie auf den Fotos und sehr sauber, die Kommunikation mit Joachim war unkompliziert und sehr freundlich und man hat sich gleich wie zuhause gefühlt! :)
Was man vielleicht wissen sollte, wenn man nicht so gut auf den Beinen ist, die Wohnung befindet sich im 3. Stock ohne Lift, ein eher enges Treppenhaus führt in die Wohnung. Auch für Lärmempfindliche ist es eventuell nicht so geeignet, da man vorallem am Wochenende den Lärm der gegenüberliegenden Bars hört... uns hat es aber nicht gestört, wir waren selbst ab und zu mit dabei :)

Super appartement situé au cœur de la vieille ville, avec sa vie nocturne à 2 pas de l’appartement. Pour y accéder il faut quand même monter 3 étages. Cette localisation a un prix à payer (il n’y a pas d’ascenseur). Mais pour nous ça été plus que parfait. Tout est situé à moins de 20 minutes de marche. L’endroit est lumineux le jour et peut paraître bruyant en soirée. Pour nous ca ne fut pas un problème.

This flat is one of the most stylish and practical airbnbs I ever stayed in. It's right in the heart of the city with bars and restaurants all around. Check-in was as smooth as could ever be possible. We would love to come again!
Apartment is in a great location, great value and really clean. So would thoroughly recommend. Thanks Joachim.
Prachtig appartement met een fantastische ligging. De communicatie was snel en zeer vriendelijk. Een echte aanrader!
Sehr stylische Wohnung mitten in der Stadt. Gute Ausstattung und sehr sauber.
Really a great location for holidays. Very clean. Joachim is very responsive. Thank you!

Diese Wohnung ist der absolute Traum! Es ist die sauberste und größte Wohnung, die ich je gebucht habe. Die Lage ist 1A, denn man ist direkt im Herzen Antwerpens. Man kann direkt von der Bar ins Bett fallen. Dementsprechend ist es keine ruhige Lage. Wen das nicht stört, der sollte die Unterkunft unbedingt buchen.
Nice place, fun location- thanks for letting us stay in your place!

The location is fabulous and the apartment is spacious, with lots of sunny windows. For two people staying in the apartment, a duplicate set of keys is a necessity. One of us got locked in the apartment before we realized we would have to leave the door unlocked to allow the other person to get out.
Excellent host. Easy to check in. Fast communication. Accurate description. Will return!
Joachim‘s apartment is just perfect. A clean and modern flat located right in the center of old town Antwerp.
Leuke locatie! Midden in het centrum. Ook was het appartement fijn, goeie voorzieningen.
Het huis is heerlijk! Mooi ruim en alles wat je nodig hebt is aanwezig. Ik heb er een heerlijke tijd gehad!

Great appartment! Really enjoyed my stay!

The apartment is simply amazing. Everything was clean, the furniture is in excellent condition, in kitchen and bathroom was everything you need and it has a fantastic location. beautiful apartment! in city center super comfortable.

Joachims flat is really nice and well positioned in the centre of Antwerp. The flat is very modern and perfect for a short stay for sightseeing and shopping. The communication as well as the check-in was super easy and fast. We will definitely come back again!
Coole Location , Central gelegen, deshalb leider auch in der nachts lauten Partyzone. Fenster gut isoliert.

Great location so central. Easy to communicate with host. Only issue may be that it’s beside a loud pub with music until 4-5am -  so bring your earplugs. The apartment was spotless and well equipped. If noise doesn’t bother you I would highly recommend.

The apartment is really nice and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. I would say the highlight is the gorgeous view of the church out of one of the many windows. To caution and as others have mentioned-it is very noisy outside due to throngs of people, the tram and a nightclub. It was hard to sleep, but we knew when booking that this may be the case. Overall a really nice stay!

Fantastic location in Antwerp, clean and beautiful apartment equipped with everything you need and had lots of places to go and see nearby with lovely people! Check in very easy too! Highly Recommend! Thank you, Emma & Jose
Very nice apartment, perfectly located to do sightseeing in Antwerp and enjoy your stay there.
great place!

This apartment was perfect for us! The location is totally central and you are right in the city centre. From here you can get everywhere super fast. The apartment was totally well designed, clean, bright and had everything we needed. We would book the apartment again in any case. It´s the perfect city apartment in Antwerp.

The location is central and a hive of activity with great bars and restaurants right next to the apartment (yes, this does mean it can be loud and lively at night!) The house was beautifully presented with everything we needed and spotlessly clean.

Большая светлая квартира прямо напротив собора Антверпена.

Amazing Appartement! Great Interior! We loved it! Thank you!

Joachim’s flat is in the perfect location.  Cafes, shopping, etc all in walking distance: Grote Markt, Schipperskwartier, Mechelsplein, etc.  The place was very clean and stylish.  There are stairs to climb and it’s close to bars so a bit of noise but not a problem for us.  Highly recommend.

This is a great apartment in Antwerp. The location is great, very close to the shops and nice restaurants. Also the host is very helpful and friendly. Would totally go here again.

Heerlijk verblijf gehad, locatie is top!

Die Wohnung ist sehr liebevoll und modern gestaltet. Die Küche ist gut ausgestattet. Gewürze, Öl und Kaffee stehen bereit. Hier muss man nicht erst loslaufen und die Grundausstattung besorgen. Ein kaltes Bier für den Empfang steht auch bereit. Die Badezimmer sind hervorragend. Die Lage ist super. Im direkten Umfeld gibt es kultige Kneipen, tolle Restaurants und sehr fröhliche Menschen. Es gibt auch Touristen, aber daran sollte man sich als Tourist ja nicht ernsthaft stören. Es gibt genug Möglichkeiten Antwerpen jenseits der Tourismusströme zu erleben. Der Gang um die Ecke und in die Gassen lohnt hier ganz besonders. Wirklich toll ist die Mentalität der Belgier. Sprache dient nur der Verständigung und es ist egal was Du sprichst. Man will verstehen und sich verständlich machen. Das gilt für den alten Mann auf der Straße, wie für die junge Frau in der Boutique. Hab muht, sei fröhlich und es wird Dir dort sicher gutgehen.
Abschließend noch ein Wort über die Wohnraumumnutzung. In Paris, Berlin und Barcelona (etc.) nutze ich keine "privat" Wohnungen mehr. Die Auswirkungen auf den Wohnungsmarkt sind brutal und für mich nicht vertretbar. Diese Wohnung wurde aber mit viel Liebe und Verstand zur Ferienwohnung umgebaut. Eine reguläre Nutzung als Wohnung ist aufgrund der Lage und der Fläche allenfalls als Studentenapartment möglich. Ich hatte hier nicht den Eindruck, dass ich hier als Tourist dem Wohnungsmarkt schade.
Location is excellent, close to everything. Apartment is clean and tidy. Check in very easy. Communication from Joachim was excellent also.

Die Wohnung von Joachim ist sehr schön für einen Aufenthalt in der schönen Stadt Antwerpen! Alles entspricht den Bildern und Beschreibungen, es handelt sich um ein tolles Appartement mit schicker Ausstattung, bequemem Bett und toller Aussicht auf die Kathedrale. Wir haben es sehr genossen, dass man mitten in der Stadt ist und alles zu Fuß erreichen kann.
Die Fenster isolieren sehr gut, sodass man in der lebhaften Umgebung auch gut schlafen kann.
Vielen Dank, wir empfehlen es gerne weiter!

A comfortable and convenient stay in Antwerp - will definitely check for availability here on my next visit :)

The place is in a great location, nicely furnished and absolutely clean. We appreciated that there were lots of towels, a good hairdryer and all amenities that are needed available. And there is a club right below so it was quite loud at night on the weekend (but as this is in the middle of the city, that could be expected). Otherwise great place in a fantastic location and super nice and easy communication, check in and check out.

Heerlijk appartement, van (bijna) alle gemakken voorzien. Netjes, ruim en centraler kun je in Antwerpen niet zitten. Uitstekend bed maar we zijn bevooroordeeld want zo’n Auping hebben we thuis ook. Kortom een echte aanrader (TIP: Croissanty, twee panden verderop, serveren een uitstekend ontbijt).

My stay at Chrisje’s place was amazing! The location is perfectly central to the best parts of the city and very walkable to public transportation, restaurants, museums, shopping, cafes, and great pubs. The most amazing old world parts of the city are steps away from the front door. Be aware that the apartment is on the second floor, which in reality is considered the third floor in the United States. Chrisje was quick to respond anytime I needed assistance which was so appreciated. Personally I like the energy of urban life so the noise can sometimes be a bit much if you are not accustomed to that. The apartment has huge windows you can open to let the outside in and look out at the fun activity on the streets below, which I found quite enjoyable. The windows are insulated so once closed it is very quiet and peaceful. Also of note, the stairways leading up to the apartment are a bit narrow and traditional to EU but I found them charming. I will definitely be back to visit the wonderful city of Antwerpen and I will look to see if this apartment is available again.

We also weren’t sure what was meant for guests and what wasn’t, so we tried not to touch anything. An exceptional accommodation.

Heel goed ontvangen in prachtig gerenoveerde woning. Echt een aanrader.

Veerle en Nicolette nogmaals bedankt!

Wil je Antwerpen verkennen, dan is dit je ideale plek om te overnachten.

Io e la mia amica abbiamo passato 2 mesi in questo appartamento. A causa di una cancellazione del volo, siamo arrivate con 6 giorni di ritardo e di conseguenza abbiamo prolungato il nostro soggiorno di una settimana. L'host non ci ha avvisato dell'obbligo di modificare la prenotazione per non perdere l'affitto di quei 6 giorni e non ha acconsentito a rimborsarci il denaro dei giorni di affitto persi né delle tasse di soggiorno del periodo in cui non ci trovavamo nemmeno in suolo belga (nonostante questo sia stato suggerito dall'assistenza Airbnb). La casa era in condizioni igieniche precarie: peli ovunque in bagno, cucina sporca e utensili incrostati, superfici impolverate e tappeti sporchi. La presenza di piccoli scarafaggi, ovviamente non segnalata, ha peggiorato il tutto. Situazione inaccettabile data la pandemia in corso e la garanzia della pulizia avanzata. Il denaro pagato per le pulizie ci è stato restituito su richiesta. Il check in è stato inesistente: l'host non era presente al nostro arrivo e non ci ha accolto nessuno perché era in viaggio; solo dopo le lamentele per la sporcizia si è presentato e ha cercato di fare chiarezza. Il soggiorno non è stato affatto tranquillo, poichè il rispetto del silenzio dalle 10 di sera alle 7 del mattino valeva solo per noi ma non per i vicini del piano di sopra, i quali puntualmente ogni mattina iniziavano a fare chiasso dalle 6 (la bambina del piano di sopra correva in continuazione sopra la nostra camera da letto con un rumore fortissimo, grida continue sul pianerottolo davanti alla nostra porta a orari improponibili, nessun rispetto della nostra tranquillità). Al contrario, qualora io e la mia amica avessimo fatto un singolo rumore dopo le 22 (e con rumore intendo chiacchiere o risate con un tono di voce normale) ricevevamo immediatamente un messaggio o una bussata alla porta dall'host. Perfino gli orari della lavatrice/asciugatrice erano condizionati, tant'è che una volta ci ha obbligato a interrompere l'asciugatura dei panni alle 19.45 per non disturbare i vicini. Una sera, dopo aver riso tra noi, abbiamo ricevuto immediatamente il messaggio di richiesta di quiete dall'host totalmente ingiustificato: ho risposto dicendo che per quasi due mesi avevamo dei vicini rumorosissimi e che non ci eravamo lamentate una sola volta del chiasso infernale alle 6 del mattino e delle grida sul pianerottolo OGNI GIORNO. L'host ha risposto dicendo di aver inviato il mio messaggio ai vicini, ovviamente senza chiedere la mia autorizzazione e senza avvisarmi, compiendo una grave violazione della mia privacy. L'host non ha mai rispettato gli orari stabiliti per aggiustare il wc: un pomeriggio avevamo appuntamento alle 17 e si è presentato un'ora dopo, interrompendo il nostro lavoro online in videochiamata e trattenendosi per chiedere il denaro delle tasse di soggiorno in un momento decisamente inopportuno; il mattino seguente doveva presentarsi alle 10 e si è fatto vivo alle 13, senza mai avvertire telefonicamente ma bussando direttamente a casa. Inoltre, ci ha accusato di avere sempre il motorino aspira aria del bagno acceso (il quale si accende in automatico con la luce del wc), con la scusa della protezione dell'ambiente: ovviamente al mattino lo sentiva acceso, visto che andavamo in bagno. Prima del nostro arrivo, non sapevamo che la chiave di casa era unica anche per il portoncino del palazzo, e che dunque ogni inquilino del palazzo potesse aprire tranquillamente la nostra porta durante la nostra assenza; ora invece è segnalato nella descrizione. Ci aspettavamo anche un divano letto, che era presente nella descrizione, ma che non era presente (ora anch'esso rimosso dalla pagina descrittiva). La disponibilità dell'host è dunque solo apparente, con la proposta di farci il letto e cambiarci le lenzuola - che abbiamo rifiutato - e con un cioccolatino lasciato sulla porta il giorno di Pasqua. L'appartamento si trova in una zona ottima, vicino alle fermate dei tram e a 2 supermercati; peccato che la gestione pessima abbia reso la nostra permanenza ansiosa e insoddisfacente. L'impressione che si ha è quella di un host che ha più a cuore il benessere degli altri inquilini del palazzo a scapito degli ospiti del suo appartamento, i quali pagano per un servizio quasi del tutto assente. Il rispetto degli spazi dell'ospite e della sua privacy è inesistente, poichè l'host bussava a qualsiasi ora senza avvisare e i vicini si comportavano come se non ci fosse nessuno nell'alloggio Airbnb. Perfino l'ultimo giorno abbiamo avuto conferma del pessimo atteggiamento nei confronti del cliente da parte dell'host, poichè l'inquilino che doveva prendere possesso dell'appartamento dopo di noi si è presentato con tre ore circa di anticipo e, dopo una litigata, l'host lo ha cacciato urlando e sbattendogli la porta in faccia. Dispiace essere così dure, ma l'illusione che viene dalle recensioni positive per noi è stata totalmente fasulla.

good price - value.

duidelijke en snelle communicatie!  het was ongeveer 15-20 lopen naar het centrum, dus dat was ideaal.
Great and very welcoming host! All was perfect and the studio was very comfortable. Loved it, will definitely be back!

My stay was uneventful and pleasant. Ia is a kind hostess.

Nette, fijne studio met alles wat je nodig hebt op een prima locatie.

The location is in a bustling multicultural area next to Sint Jansplein, 10 minutes walk from the city centre, and the only downside was the street noise from the nearby late-opening cafes. Parkplatzsuche schwierig, Parkhaus war eine Nacht auch versperrt.

The location of the apartment is perfect, right next to the  cathedral. The check-in time is really flexible which made things easy. Leentje always replied really fast if we had any questions.  We would highly recommend this Airbnb.

Mooie, comfortabele, gezellige plek in het hartje van Antwerpen. Top!

The Apartment is located in a great spot, very clean and has everything you need.

recommendable!

Fijne ruimte in het centrum, goede voorzieningen en makkelijke communicatie met verhuurder. Wij hebben een heerlijk weekend in Antwerpen gehad.

A noter, le lit en mezzanine (j'ai bien aimé mais il faut être apte à grimper l'échelle) et un peu de bruit de la rue/du tram (mais boules quies fournies et climatisation donc pas gênant)
Muy buena ubicación, apartamento cuidado y fácil comunicación con el propietario

Really cool place to stay.  If your goal is to be close to the center of town and tons of restaurants and bars then this is your place.  It can be a bit loud because your so close to bars.  Bed requires you to climb a ladder.  Super clean and updated apartment.
Heel fijn appartement op een toplocatie!

Leentje’s apartment was fantastic. The location was perfect, and allowed me to stop by anytime I needed while touring the city. The bed was very comfortable, and the dark curtains were a huge plus. Communication was super fast and courteous.
很棒的位置，正在老城区里，每天经过大教堂都有不同的美，公寓东西很齐全，我住了2周，非常舒适，下次来工作也会选择入住这里的
Great place. Nice kitchen with all you need to cook meals there. Nice bed and space. Excellent location and value. Slightly cramped bathroom, but overall one of the best Airbnb’s I’ve been to.
Très bon séjour, appartement propre, bien équipé et bien situé.

Very nice room and perfect location in the middle of Antwerp. The appartment had everything we needed and the bed was very comfortable.  The AC was very much appreciated in the summer heat! Our only remark is that it would have been nice to know, that there is no door or ceiling in the bathroom/toilet, which is placed under the mezzanine bed and is only shielded from the living room by a wall. Also the toilet is placed so there is no room for one's legs because of the placement of the sink/cabinet just in front of the toilet. But apart from that it is a very nice place, that we would consider staying at again!

Leuke loft in hartje Antwerpen. Parkeren in een garage dichtbij, in de buurt van genoeg cafe’s en restaurants.

Het loft zelf was erg netjes zoals getoond op foto’s en van alle gemakken voorzien en zelfs extra’s zoals een internationale reisstekker voor gasten.

Mooie airbnb voor een paar nachtjes en wij zullen deze locatie / verhuurder zeker aanbevelen!

Casa in una posizione comodissima e praticamente dietro la piazza principale!

In cucina abbiamo trovato già a disposizione sale, zucchero, spezie ecc.
C'è anche una stanzina adibita a guardaroba.

La zona è vicina a bar e ristoranti e ai primi luoghi di interesse.
Fijne airbnb met goede service, op een perfecte locatie en voor een goede prijs! Zeker aan te raden!
Die Wohnung war wirklich sehr schön, super Lage und auch der Kontakt zur Gastgeberin war problemlos! Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen!

A few things to note-- the bathroom area (shower and toilet) is small if you are a larger person;  make sure you ask for extra pillows if you prefer to sleep more upright like us; and there is no door between the bathroom and rest of the flat.  We would recommend this AirBnB for solo travelers and couples visiting Antwerp!

Ik heb echt genoten van mijn verblijf in de studio! Het was een heel gezellige studio, die erg vernieuwd leek en bovendien zeer netjes was. Very cosy apartment in the city center by walking distance to everything important in the old town. Apartment is clean, well furnished, easy to find. Leentje is very responsive for every additional question you have. Highly recommend for a few days trip to Antwerp.

I would totally recommend here, since you are sourrunded by nice bars and restaurants.

It was and felt extremely cramped in and you can basically not sit with your leg on the toilet facing forward. The shower was equally small and the shower curtain clung to one's body like syrup to a blanket when you used the shower. We enjoyed the place but I won't reconsider staying here if I ever visit Antwerp again if I'm completely honest. It's also kind off impersonal not being greeted or shown around by the host on the day we arrived wich adds a personal touch. All and all, we enjoyed our brief stay.

It was walking distance from the train station (~10-15 min) in a safe area that was well lit at night to walk. Although there is not a separate entrance for the loft, you do feel that it is your own place upstairs with your own private mini-kitchen, bathroom, and shower. With us arriving so late at night, we didn't really run into Lenny or her boyfriend at all during our short stay except when we checked in. She was super flexible seeing as how we were only in town for Tomorrowland and understood that often we would be back very late (3-4am).

Vlotte communicatie, wat op zich al een must is. Perfecte locatie als uitvalsbasis voor Antwerpen. Openbaar vervoer vlakbij. Alle voorzieningen zijn aanwezig, zeer gezellig appartement om te verblijven. Zeker een aanrader!
Alles perfekt wie beim ersten mal

Super appartement, très propre située dans un quartier très récent (encore en construction).
Le salon-salle à manger est très agréable : lumineux (traversant), cosy...
Il y a tout le nécessaire pour cuisiner correctement.
Il est très spacieux.
Un grand merci à Stijn pour sa disponibilité et réactivité.

Stylish house, comfy beds, a lot of space for families or friends, we had a wonderful stay. Everything is within walking distance. Elly didn't meet us personally but her friend Saartje welcomed us and responded quickly to all our requests.
Great Host. Beautiful apartment.
Elly is a great host, very helpful to accommodate any wishes.  Her house is gorgeous, the location is superb, silent at night, close to all the cool places in Antwerp.

L'appartement est parfaitement situé dans le cœur d'Anvers, tout est accessible à pied.
L'appartement est très beau, décoré avec beaucoup de recherche.
Il est juste à noter pour les personnes âgées ou handicapées qu'il y a beaucoup d'escaliers

This a great house full of art, artifacts and books. It's walking distance to all the major sites with relaxed local pubs and restaurants in the neighbourhood. Check-in was very easy and David (who did the keys and the intro) had lots of helpful recommendations. Ground floor is a very nice spot for yoga practice. Overall a great base for exploring Antwerp.

Elly's place was fantastic. It's in an outstanding location, walkable to many great areas of the city. It felt safe, clean, and was decorated amazingly. Elly spent time to give us some ideas to check out in Antwerp which ended up being great. I really enjoyed my stay there and would go back.
House is really nice and in style. Big living room and dining room then we can stay together at once. House is near a convenience store a d restaurant then easy to stay.
We travelled as a group of 8 and had a great time at Elly’s place. The house is actually a gallery and it’s one of the most stylish places I’ve stayed at with Airbnb!

Large 4-story townhouse beautifully decorated with art and antiques very centrally located in Antwerp. Excellent for design-loving guests. Elly was a gracious host throughout. Very comfortably accommodated our family of 5. We had a wonderful time in Antwerp.

Iaorana
Un grand appartement très bien placé, près de la gare et on peut tout faire à pied. Rev est toujours disponible et ses renseignements nous ont bien aidés.
Pour ma première fois à Anvers j'ai été très satisfait de mon séjour.
Merci
Gerald

Het appartement is ruim, modern en de woonkamer heeft een luxe uitstraling.
De ligging is heel centraal op loopafstand van het centraal station en de zoo.
Ik miste keukendoeken in de keuken. Verder is het appartement behoorlijk compleet.

Het was een leuk appartement 5 minuten van het station af. Leuke restaurants en barretjes in de buurt en op ongeveer 10/15 min lopen van de Meir. Huis was netjes en schoon. Was met de zomerse dagen wel warm binnen, maar met de ramen open goed te doen. 2 handdoeken per persoon en ook genoeg servies. Helaas geen keukendoeken maar dat hebben we op kunnen lossen. Er is een trap en een liftje aanwezig. Rev reageerde snel op al mijn vragen en ook de gastvrouw ter plekke was zeer vriendelijk! Voor een weekendje is het prima vertoeven... We zijn veel weg geweest met het mooie weer! Prijs/kwaliteit verhouding is prima.
The appartment is comfortable and very well located, 500 metres walking distance from the Central train station and very near from supermarkets, restaurants and historical center.

The location of the apartment is fantastic. Previous reviews mention close to a busy road, this can not be heard, especially in the bedrooms so it is a non-issue. Apartment is spacious (4 adults on our trip) and immaculate - an perfect base for a city trip. Pictures are accurate and the main space of the apartment is bigger than you think.
Our host was brilliant, very flexible both with check-in times and check-out times - highly recommended
Dit appartement is mooi, ruim en compleet. De locatie is perfect, en de prijs/kwaliteitverhouding super.

Great apartment very close to the station (which has left luggage lockers) and only a 15 min walk to historic centre. Supermarkets close by.
Yes it is on a busy road which you can hear a bit in the living area but the bedrooms are at the back and extremely quiet so not an issue.
Apartment is bigger than expected with excellent living area and large dining table. Kitchen small but perfectly adequate- has large fridge/ freezer, hob, microwave (no dishwasher). Towels and soap provided (and hairdryer- thank you!).
Only thing we didn't like was that we found the beds uncomfortable- one too hard and one too soft.... but then maybe that's us!

Dit weekend naar Antwerpen met vrienden. Voor het eerst gebruik gemaakt van AirBnB. En dat is ons heel goed bevallen.
Fijn ontvangst en communicatie, perfecte ligging, groot appartement, heel schoon.
Klein puntje van nadeel is gehorigheid (maar dat is nu eenmaal in een appartement) en de bedden waren iets doorgezakt.
Maar als wij weer naar Antwerpen komen komen we zeker terug.

My wife, Kat, and I were in Antwerpen for the World Beard and Mustache Championship and could not have asked for a better place. We were joined by friends of our from London and the apartment was spacious enough for all of us.

The location was great. Across the street from Elizabeth Hall and the Antwerpen Zoo and one block from Chocolate Nation. We didn’t get a chance to go to Chocolate Nation, but will definitely check it out on our next visit to Antwerpen.
Great place ! Thank you Rev for making our stay magical and for being flexible according to our expectation
Amazing Host!

Rev’s place is spectacular. Very open and inviting place and much better than expected. The location is more than ideal. It is quiet even though it’s in the center. Rev was very responsive and happy to help with anything. Highly recommended!
Als je een appartement zoekt in Antwerpen, is dit appartement zeker een aanrader
Good apartment, Clean and well located near central station and 10 mn walk to historic center of Antwerp. I recommend

Квартира соответсвует фото и описанию. Отличное расположение, если вам интересна мобильность за счёт центрального вокзала Антверпена и близости достопримечательностей. Как и в предыдущих отзывах можем отметить очень шумную гостиную, но довольно тихие спальни. Однако скрипучие кровати и неудобные матрасы остались неизменными. На кухне не хватает полотенец, посуды, столовых приборов. Всего ровно по 4 штуки. Ровно 4 чашки и 4 стакана. Нет даже геля для душа, о чем мы были предупреждены, но исходя из стоимости 120 евро в сутки можно было бы предоставить и его. Вы также не найдёте здесь пледы или дополнительные подушки. Для чувствительных к запаху людей не рекомендуется, потому что квартира для курящих. Все остальное было очень хорошо.
Really nice apartment located at the station. Would definitly go to this apartment again. Rev and the guy who welcomed us were really kind aswell. Communication is fast and clear.
Leuk appartement en fijne communicatie!

El apartamento tiene todo lo necesario y está bastante (Website hidden by Airbnb) encuentra a tan sólo 20minutos del centro andando.
Tanto Dries como su novia fueron muy atentos en todo momento . Gracias
Very clean and great communication with Dries in a safe neighborhood. Beds were very comfortable as well!

El alojamiento no está mal para una noche que estuvimos. Es un sofa cama lo que se ve en la foto. Está a unos 25-30 min del centro andando, en transporte publico no lo se porque llevabamos coche. Está a pie de calle y se escucha todo aunque es una calle poco transitada.
It's OK for a weekend, the flat is on the ground floor so it is a bit noisy. Generally a good place for it's price.
The appartment was cosy and clean. Communication with Dries was great, he was very kind. We stayed for one night and I can really recommand it.

The studio pictures were as posted in the ad, the location is centric.
I have a couple of bad experience at this place, The shower doesnt have a door so when showering expect the bathroom flooded and then cleaning it after, the sofabed is bad for the back as it splits when it transforms to a bed, one part of the mattress lays on one level and the other on another lower, so the experience is like the upper part of the body is up and the other part is down resulting in painfull back, the last thing not mentioned is the noise, the studio is on the ground floor and the isolation is not good.
Its really a cosy studio as the description says. Driss and his mother are very nice people,  everything went well
Estudio muy cómodo y bien ubicado

Dries is a kindly host who answer questions in English quick way - with a lot of good advises. The apartment is small but nice. It located in a residential area in the ground floor. The most important things are included. While our stay a window of the shower was missing so me have to be careful. The WiFi exercises us in patience.
We had a pleasant stay in Dries’ apartment. The Apartment is really small and little bit loud, but sufficient for a weekend in Antwerp. Check in was really flexible. Thank you!

Dries' place is perfect for a single or couple, with all the basic facilities you could need! Close to city center, shopping and old town districts. We will be recommending to anyone we know who is traveling to Antwerp, and would love to stay again in the future. Thanks Dries!

I came to the appartement and got greeted by dries his girlfriend (who is also very friendly) and got a good explanation about the appartement and how the bed works. On my first day I noticed that the microwave didn't seem to work, so I contacted dries; he explained how to properly use the microwave (but he concluded it really did not work). The next day he had a new one installed, so great work on communication and "customer service". The only downside is the bed;which I only had a problem with when I was laying on my side; bit this was maybe more because of my height.

The place was clean, pretty central and the communication with Dries was impeccable. I do however think the apartement was a little bit low value, impersonal and the couch-bed was really uncomfortable, so could not get much sleep.
Prima prijs kwaliteit locatie. Klein maar fijn. Slaapbank was goed.

Great little studio, with a nice kitchen and a luxurious shower. We had a great stay. The self check-in was a breeze and although we didn't get to meet Dries  in person, he was very communicative and helpful online.
Heerlijk weekend in Antwerpen gehad! Prima vertoeft in deze airbnb, klein maar fijn.
房子内部很不错，可是房东做事实在是不靠谱。第一天来，本来约好来。可最后就没有来。房间里有什么，和怎么用全靠我们自己去找。第一天没有找到被子，冷的根本没法睡。第二天才解决问题。无线网络也不好用，10秒钟断一次。出来的这几天全靠自己的4G.房东总说找人来解决从来没修好过。
Het appartement van Dries is wat betreft prijs kwaliteit in een woord geweldig! We hebben hier na een leuk oud en nieuw feest heerlijk geslapen! Dichtbij het centrum en makkelijk bereikbaar.

Dries' appartement was 10 minuutjes van het centraal station lopen, vanaf het centrum wat meer maar de fietsenhuur (Velo) is dichtbij. We hebben het heerlijk naar ons zin gehad, echt een aanrader als je een paar dagen Antwerpen wilt verkennen!
Très serviable
Had a great time, Dries and his mom where very thoughtful and I had everything I needed!
Cooles kleines Apartment am Rande des Stadtkerns gelegen. Es gibt alles was man braucht, nur Gewürze sollte man selbst mitbringen  ;) weiter zu empfehlen!
Dries is a wonderful host. The studio is in the center. Self check-in was also great.

A peaceful spot in a residential area of Antwerp. I found Dries to be flexible and prompt with his responses.  Dispite lacking some basic amenities like coffee, tea, city/tram maps etc, I found it a cozy landing pad from which to explore the city.
This apartment is small but so functional! A great space. The beds were comfortable and the shower was amazing. Would definitely recommend this place!

All good.

> I did sleep exceptionally well,
or it's the room,
or I was very very tired.
Its a good, cosy studio, where the sofa converts to a bed itself, so its very practical, not to comfortable, but not bad at all

Dries was a great host and was quick to respond to any of my questions. The apartment was clean and within walking distance to the town center. It was perfect for a quick stay in Antwerp. Definitely recommend!
It 's a really cozy studio, close to the centre of Antwerp!!! :-)
We hadden zeer laat gereserveerd bij Dries maar hij reageerde snel en alles was in orde. Goede kamer en het bed is ook zeer goed voor een slaapbank. Ik zou er zo weer terugkomen.

Het was een hele fijne studio. Wel een eindje van het centrum maar met de velo fietsen is het prima te doen. Slaapbank was prima, er stak alleen aan één kant een beetje omhoog. De rest van de voorzieningen waren helemaal goed.

Very comfortable, clean and functional studio in a quiet area. The city center is in 10-minute walk. Public parking is available on the same street. The studio is on the 0th floor, so there is no need to carry your luggage upstairs. Dries was very prompt and pleasant in communication. He suggested a very convenient variant of check-in, despite the fact that he was unable to attend.
Dear Dries, thank you for a wonderful accommodation in Antwerp.
Recomendo para quem quer ficar só uma noite. De resto é muito pequeno e acolhedor. Obrigado :)
The place is super cute, close to the centre and clean! Although we only stayed for one night I would definitely recommend to stay there :)
Ottima posizione, l'appartamento è perfetto per un breve soggiorno in questa splendida città.
The apartmenet is cute and close to the centre. It is on the ground floor, so very convenient when you have heavy luggage.
It’s a cosy and clean, central located apartment. Good distance to walk or to ride a bike to the city center with its main attractions.

Le logement était tout à fait adapté à notre attente : nous allions à Anvers pour assister à un concert le samedi soir et nous voulions passer le week - end à Anvers. Nous avions besoin d'un endroit simple et propre pour dormir et nous laver ; nous n'avons pas mangé là.

Dries ist ein unkomplizierter Gastgeber. Alles hat reibungslos funktioniert, von Schlüsselannahme bis -abgabe und sich vor Ort zurechtfinden. Er war persönlich nicht anwesend, aber seine Mutter hat mir mit dies und jenem geholfen. Das Studio ist nicht sehr gross und optimal für eine Person. Alles ist sehr sauber und funktional eingerichtet. Ich komme sehr gerne wieder und kann Dries´Unterkunft wärmstens empfehlen.
A nice studio apartment with a comfy sofa bed. It is not as comfy as a regular bed but more comfy than most sofa beds we have slept on.

Cozy apartment with a good sleeping couch. The place is not big, but the essentials are there. Dries was helpful in communication even though he couldn't be there personally and the location in the city is also nice; very close to the city park.

Kleines schönes Zimmer was echt super war für eine Nacht in Antwerpen. Für einen längeren Zeitraum soll ich es für zwei Personen zu klein finden. Die Ausstattung war auch gut. Check-in und check-out waren sehr einfach und unkompliziert.
C’est très bien, coin relativement tranquille et proche de la gare central ce fait très bien a pieds

Het verblijf bij Dries was kort maar krachtig. Ik heb Dries niet kunnen ontmoeten, maar de communicatie verliep goed via berichten. De studio ziet er netjes uit en is van alle basis benodigdheden voorzien. Het is op loopafstand van het centrum en gelegen in een rustige buurt. Als we weer naar Antwerpen gaan, komen we terug!

Had a nice 8 day stay in the apartment in June 2018. Even though I didnt have much personal contact with the host Dries, he was very quick in  responding via AirBnB / E-Mail. The apartment is nice, not too much space when the sofa is tranformed to a bed, however for 1-2 people absolutely sufficient. The sofa-bed was also pretty comfortable! The kitchen provides you with basic equipment for cooking and even some coffee was available (which my girlfriend appreciated a lot :) In total a nice stay in Antwerp, thank you again!
I really enjoyed my stay. The location and self check-in were good. As I was there to study, it would have been helpfull if the wifi-connection would have worked better.

Would definitely recommend for a stay in Antwerp! Everything was within walking distance and although the apartment was small, it was stylish as well as clean. The sofa beds were fine for our two-night stay.

Appartement très propre et agréable pour deux. Dries et sa maman ont été très attentifs et réactifs à nos demandes. Seul point négatif, la présence en nombre de moustiques en cette période de forte chaleur.

The studio is small but cosy, perfect for a single person or a couple. It is quite clean and near the centre of the city (20 minutes on foot). The neighbourhood is quiet and there are a lot of fast foods and public transports.

Dries’s apartment was a lovely place to spend a week. It was perfect for me, a solo traveler. The neighborhood was quiet. I was able to eat breakfast in and cook a simple meal on nights I didn’t want to eat out. The apartment was very clean and the bed was very comfortable.
everything was fine, dries responds very quickly if you contact him, the place is clean and well located and is ideal if you don't plan to stay long/stay inside.

The studio is bright, cozy, fully equiped and the space is very well used,  situated in a quiet neighbourhood.  The Wi-Fi was having some issues sometimes, but overall it was OK. The tram station and supermarket are 6 min. away as well as nice little places to eat. Dries was always very fast to respond. Thank you, Dries!

Very nice and cozy studio not so far from Antwerp Central Railway Station. Unfortunately, we couldn’t meet Dries in person, but he was really polite, answer all our questions and gave us very precisely instructions how to check in. The stay was a pleasure and if you gonna visit Antwerp you can choose this studio without hesitation!
perfect area, private place, good value.
We had amazing weekend! Great place and easy communication.
Dries' apartment is perfectly located in a quiet neighborhood. He was quick to answer and made it easy for me at every moment. The apartment was clean and comfortable.

The studio was well located and had all the basic amenities. We had a little bit of trouble checking in but it was resolved in a matter of minutes. All and all a nice place to stay a couple of nights.

Een super fijn appartement, die alle benodigdheden heeft die je nodig hebt.
Fijne communicatie en een slaapbank die fijn ligt.
Het appartement ligt perfect gelegen in Antwerpen.
Dries is a great host. The apartment is great for two people, very comfy mattresses and the area is nice, close to the train station and the city centre.
Uns hat der Aufenthalt in Dries Unterkunft gut gefallen. Der Check-in war unkompliziert und die Kommunikation mit Dries war perfekt.
Had a lovely time! Dries is ever helpful! Highly recommended!
Good location, convenient flat

The flat is situated in the most beautiful part of the city. Such inspiring area, full of beautiful people, good restaurants, close to the city center, calm and safe. We just fell in love with the city and would love to come back because we didn't have enough time to discover everything.  The flat is quite small but very good and clever way furnitured. Cosy and user friendly. You just really have to be quiet and respect silent hours because neighbors can hear everything in the house, what wasn't problem for us. Small balcony is nice benefit of the flat. :) I recommend Dries's accommodation.  Love Antverps.

Very cute, small studio just a little outside of downtown. We walked everywhere with no issue but public transportation was also an easy option. We found the best chocolates nearby and there’s a grocery store just down the street. This place is pretty small but its very comfortable and we cooked a couple of meals very easily. The pullout couch was a simple design but was actually the best nights sleep we’d had in a while.  The host was very easy to communicate with and self checkin! Yes yes yes we love self checkin when you’re train hopping and traveling can be unpredictable.
Petit studio très agréable à seulement 15minutes de la gare centrale. Accueil chaleureux

Piccolo e accogliente, lo studio è situato in un quartiere tranquillo, da cui si può raggiungere facilmente il centro storico a piedi o con i mezzi pubblici.
Ottima esperienza, raccomando l'alloggio di Dries per un soggiorno ad Anversa.
Excelente estudio muy cómodo, limpio y acogedor, el anfitrión es de lo mejor y la ubicación estupenda, está cerca de todo, caminando a 20 minutos del centro.
The studio is very well located. It is nice and also well equipped. And from the host, thank him for the attention he gave us and for making things easier.

Stayed for 3nights. Room is small but equipped with basic amenities. It was a smooth self check in and check out. Wifi connection is good but we were losing connection sometimes. Kitchen is only good for cooking small meals. It has decent TV but no english channels. The sofa bed is comfy but the bed sheets/cover felt itchy. The room is next to the street so we can easily hear noises from the outside. It has big windows opening directly to the street so we had to pull down the curtain blinds to make sure no one can see us from the outside especially at night. Overall, we had a nice stay.
Appartement wie erwartet. Gute Kommunikation, super Lage und Top Preis-Leistungsverhältnis!
We hebben een prima verblijf gehad in het appartement. Inchecken ging probleemloos.

It is a cute place, nicely furnished but it is very small with no possibility to hang clothes. The area is central and there is parking space. The appartment is on street level and next to the entrance door so it is quite noisy and the sofabed was bot very comfortable. For holidays and if alone, it is good value for money, if you need to be well rested at 6am or if you are two people with a bit of luggage, not quite as ideal.
Très bon emplacement
Tres bien
Nice and cozy apartment, clean and has everything you need for your stay. Dries is also a very good host and he made possible for me to stay another night without reservation. Thank you :)
I had a nice stay at Dries's place. The neighborhood is a little noisy when the window is open. cooking possibilities are limited but overall the place is good value.
I had lovely stay in Antwerp, the studio also allowed to work from home. Overall great!

Dries's place is a great choice for one or two persons. The place is well equipped and all the space is nicely used and organized. The location is great, it is close to the center and the public transport (as well as velo bikes), and there are several of stores nearby.  From my point of view, the only thing that missed was a washing machine, but there is a place for this very close to the studio.. Also, Dries was a great host, always available and eager to help.

Studio was goed voorzien van benodigdheden.
Minpuntje : soms een luidruchtige buurt

I have been in this studio for one month and I have been very well. At my arrival, I found it very clean and cosy. The owners are friendly and helpful. The position is good, very close to the tram and bike stops and 20 minutes walking to the historical center of Antwerp.
Mooi ingericht en gezellig! Leuk ontvangst!!! En een super gezellige restaurant/cafeetje beneden :)

Allie's place is a historic house with steep narrow wooden stairs that connect the three floors. The house has recently been renovated and the furnishings are very up to date. I would recommend it to everyone except people with knee or mobility problems.

You can't beat the location of Allie's place for a stay in Antwerp! It's a block away from the cathedral, right in the middle of the old city.
The house is pretty incredible - while it dates back to the 16th century, the inside is very modern, just like in the pictures. Everything was super clean.
Allie is the kind of host you hope to stay in touch with after your Airbnb stay ends - she is friendly, interesting, very knowledgeable about the city (and Belgium in general). Communication about check in and check out was easy and she responded very quickly when I couldn't find a towel - actually, all I had to do was open a drawer...

Très bonne expérience; atypique puisque l'entrée se fait directement par ce petit restaurant vegan au rez de chaussée; Appartement surprenant; sur plusieurs étages et bonne situation; Néanmoins prix un peu élevé puisque l'appartement n'est pas complètement terminé et pas de porte de séparation entre le petit restaurant et l'appartement (heureusement fermé lors de notre séjour)
Je recommande sans hésitation pour un petit séjour à Anvers; en amoureux ou en famille!
I spend Christmas with my family on this place. We really felt like home. Everything was perfect.
Very stylish appartement, great location, beautiful interior and great hospitality. Everything was perfect.

Een geweldig appartement in hartje centrum van Antwerpen. Het appartement lijkt recentelijk gerenoveerd en wij hadden een heel appartement voor onszelf. Het zag er heel schoon en mooi ingericht uit.

Onder het appartement hebben Allie en haar vriend hun eigen ontbijt/lunch zaakje ' Plant B', ze hebben ons gastvrij ontvangen en we hebben zo nu en dan een praatje met ze gemaakt. De communicatie voorafgaand en tijdens ons verblijf verliep heel soepel, Allie reageerde heel snel. Ook gaven ze bij aankomst aan dat wanneer er iets was we ze altijd konden bellen/smsen, dit vond ik een gastvrij gebaar. Over het algemeen verliep de communicatie heel ontspannen.

Qua locatie ben je op loopafstand van alles, midden in het centrum en maximaal 15 minuten lopen naar 't Zuid; dicht bij allemaal boutique winkeltjes én koffietentjes. Ondanks het appartement midden in centrum zit, ligt het in een rustig zijstraatje. Ook heb je geen last van lawaai aangezien de slaapkamer op de 3e verdieping ligt.

Het appartement in compleet met keuken etc. Dit vonden wij fijn zodat we ook thuis konden eten.

Kortom, een heel fijn verblijf die ik aan iedereen aanraad!

We stayed only one night, but we enjoyed staying in this historical house so much that we wished we had stayed for longer. You get to stay in pretty much the whole 3 story building and not only that, Allie runs a lovely cafe on the ground floor, with loads of healthy foods right downstairs (sadly haven't had a chance to try any because we had to leave quite quickly, but read the menu thoroughly and wished we had)  and amazing coffee which we really appreciated! The space is quite unusual and the rooms very spacious, lovely decorated in a Nordic style. The heating in the bedroom suite wasn't as good as in the lower ground rooms though, so it was a bit chilly up there since we visited in January. Overall, one of the better Airbnb flats we had stayed in and would definitely recommend it! Thanks, Allie :)

This apartment is very very charming and combines the both the original architecture of the building with a modern interior. Also the location is superb! Allie was a lovely host and quick to respond to my messages.

The only downside to this apartment is the lack of door to the space. A spiral staircase brings you up from the cafe into the apartment, and even though you are an entire floor up, sound travels freely during the cafe's business hours. It was off-putting and felt as if anyone could walk into the apartment. With that being said, the cafe closes very early in the evening and tranquility is restored. It didn't affect our stay since we were sightseeing the majority of the day anyway.

Het appartement van Allie is mooi ingericht, het is heel sfeervol.
We hebben op een prettige manier contact gehad met Allie, ze reageert snel en is gastvrij en vriendelijk.
Het appartement ligt boven de lunchroom Plant B waar we ook gebruik van hebben gemaakt. 's Morgens hebben we een ontbijtje gehaald en dit mochten we opeten in het appartement.
De ligging is uitstekend, de auto konden we parkeren op de Groenplaats Parking, het appartement is vanuit daar slechts 2 minuten lopen, ideaal.
Allie, nogmaals bedankt voor je gastvrijheid!

Allie's apartment is incredibly well located and very stylish. Although it's in an old building, everything was renewed and is super modern (with a great bathroom for example). It is also located above Allie's café, which not only makes the check-in very convenient, but also gives the opportunity to enjoy coffee or breakfast without leaving the house. Also, Allie is a super nice person and a great host. I fully recommend her and the apartment!
We had a very nice time in Antwerp. The location is very nice and spacey.
