Wanneer je in het centrum een mooie locatie wilt vinden dan is deze locatie super vertrouwd. Je dient wel trap te  kunnen lopen omdat er drie rondlopende trappen zijn naar de woon en daarna slaapkamer.

Allie's place was very outstanding.

The top floor of apartment (bedroom / bath / shower) is actually better than it appears in the photos.

The living and kitchen are also very well appointed and spacious.

Situated in the older part of the Meir, it is literally steps aways from dozens of restaurants / shops, and a short walk to several museums and sights. Antwerp itself is undergoing a lot re-development in the downtown area, so it was actually better to be at Allie's location.

An ideal location for singles or couples who enjoy a great location for exploring in the day and the feeling of home, comfort and quality at night.

Schoon, trendy, goed gelegen appartement. Het appartement ziet er piekfijn uit en heeft alles wat je nodig hebt. Allie is makkelijk te bereiken en reageert snel. Ik en mijn zus hebben een erg fijn verblijf gehad.

Allie was a great host and her place had so much style and charm. It was also so very convenient, with the location being right in the city center. We had no lack of things to do or places to walk being in such close proximity to everything going on. We slept so good in her space and would definitely stay at Allie's place again if we're in Antwerp again :)
Well located, perfect !
Such amazing place in such an amazing location, u couldn't  ask for any more , from your holiday

Een perfecte plek voor een weekendje weg in Antwerpen. Super centraal gelegen met volop Parkeergelegenheid nabij.
Een leuk, charmant appartement met alle basisvoorzieningen voorhanden.
Een absolute aanrader! En vergeet vooral niet te ontbijten bij Allie! We komen graag nog een keer terug.

Merveilleux appartement surprenant car sur 3 étages dans un immeuble. Restaurant vegan/végétarien au rez de chaussée. En fait on loue l’immeuble
Experience tres agréable
Parfait accueil
À recommander
Nice authentic place in the heart of Antwerp. if you want to sense the soul of the city, stay here. Very central in the vicinity of many restaurants, cathedral, marketplaces, supermarkets, shops.
Mooi appartement in het midden van de stad. Toplocatie. Zeer vriendelijk ontvangst.
Wij hebben een fijne paar dagen gehad in Antwerpen op deze top lokatie. Een heel stijlvol appartement met alle noodzakelijke voorzieningen. Zeker een aanrader!
Fijn verblijf, centraal gelegen en zeer vriendelijk ontvangen

Das Appartment ist wunderbar. Mitten in der Altstadt in einem schönen restaurierten Haus und trotzdem ruhig. Sehr schicker Loftstyle. Alles was man braucht ist da. Sehr gute Matratze und tolle Dusche, sowie Badewanne. Die Wohnung hat sehr viel Atmosphäre. Das Frühstück nimmt man unten in Allies Bistro ein und es war fantastisch mit viel Liebe für Details und hervorragender Kaffee. Allie achtet offensichtlich auf Qualität und möchte, dass sich ihre Gäste besonders wohl fühlen. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

What can I say?! Top location, super stylish, very clean, lovely smell in the apartment, great help and tips from Allie,...

The old staircase is an art piece on itself. It is however a challenge to get your things upstairs and not always easy to smoothly go down it to go to the bathroom, but with some good balance you’ll do well. It has character, that’s for sure.

Lastly, during the day you might hear some people talking from down in the restaurant/bar, but definitely not a disturbance!!

Great stay!
Great place and great host. Beautiful apartment. The street level is actually a breakfast bar where we had a great end of our little weekend in Antwerp.

Allie has a very comfortable, clean, and newly remodeled 3 level apartment. We had a great stay, though my wife & I both had a travel illness.
Breakfast is normally included, but unfortunately we could only enjoy one (with fresh squeezed orange juice, espresso, bread, & fruit & yoghurt) on our last day leaving, as she also was not feeling well at this cold, rainy time of the year. Allie is a Super Host, for sure! Thank you, Allie.

Allie's place is very central, very well connected and furnished with style! We enjoyed the place but there are a couple of things that are not very standard and maybe not so convenient for all: there is no door to the apartment, no separation between the main bathroom and the bedroom and the apartment is split in 3 floors...
Excellent location - a beautiful place right in the old centre
Great location in a fun quirky home!

We enjoyed our stay in Antwerp, the apartment provides anything needed for a stay, it is clean and spacy.
Allie is always ready to help.
The only entrance is through a restaurant and the staircase is really steep, but we knew before booking.
My wife and I recommend the apartment.

Schicke und großzügige Unterkunft für zwei Personen mitten in der Altstadt von Antwerpen. Eine sehr nette junge Gastgeberin, die eine angenehme Atmosphäre für ihre Gäste schafft - wir würden immer wieder dorthin gehen.

What a GEM!  Steps from tram and only two stops from Antwerp Central station.  Right in the middle of EVERYTHING.  Book here and you will not be disappointed. Allie is a fantastic hostess with quick if not immediate responses and a joy to get to know.  Take advantage of Planet B’s delicious menu while there.  The building is amazing but beware.... 4 spiral staircases to take you to your living spaces so pack lightly.

Lovely stylishly decorated spacious flat over 3 floors. Location is superb being very central. Pictures do the place justice. Small round staircase not ideal for carrying up a big suitcase (see another review), which did not bother us as we were there for a weekend trip. Downstairs is Allie's breakfast place, which you do not hear in the bedroom, but slightly in the kitchen and lounge on the 1st floor. The yummy smell of food being prepared was the only thing that I noticed while having a morning snooze before leaving! You do need to walk all the way through the breakfast place in order to go upstairs to the flat or leave. All in all a great stay. Thank you Allie.

Mooi en sfeervol ingericht, 3 verdiepingen tellende appartement boven het restaurant van Allie. Pal in het centrum van Antwerpen.
Het is even wennen om via het restaurant, achter de bar langs, de trap naar het appartement te betreden.
Allie was zeer goed bereikbaar en bood ons zelfs de mogelijkheid onze tassen alvast voor de inchecktijd bij het appartement achter te laten.
Very nice place, perfect location and Allie is very easy to communicate with and when possible flexible in terms of check in and check out!
Es war ein wunderbarer Kurzaufenthalt in sehr zentrale Lage. Die Wohnung hat das besondere etwas und die Kommunikation mit Alice verlief ganz reibungslos. Gerne wieder.
Very clean and large. In an amazing area. Would 100% recommend !!
Amazing spot just in the heart of Antwerpen
Eine besondere und tolle Wohnung! Die Treppen sind recht steil. Aufpassen!

An incredible flat and a dream to stay in! Great location amongst the city and super quiet and stylist apartment! Super friendly greeting and very helpful with any questions we had! Can not wait to get back and stay again! Highly recommended!!

The house is very close to the Cathedral and the area of restaurants. The house is an old building, but refurbished recently. Very recomendable for a stay in Antwerp. Allie was very nice, and our experience was excellent.
Het was top! Super mooi appartement!

Light filled, contemporary, split level, comfortable apartment, very centrally located minutes from the Cathedral, above Allie's" Plant B "cafe, which was great as she put supper in the fridge for us! A delightful hostess who provided an adapter and also organised taxi to airport for us. Stairs are narrow, steep and very windy but Allie will help you with luggage.
We enjoyed our stay.
Thank you Allie.
Super locatie middenin de stad. Mooie, moderne inrichting. Je moet wel goed traplopen en houden van stadsgedruis in ieder geval op Zaterdagavond. Beneden kun je lekker ontbijten en lunchen.

Allie’s place was incredible. It is a 3-story apartment over the top of her coffee shop Plant B. The location is fantastic right in the middle next to the cathedral and right on restaurant row.

Allie is a fantastic host and offered many suggestions and responded so quick to any communication or needs.

The stairs in the apartment are still from the 17th century or something and are super cool but very steep just a warning but we loved it.

Would recommend to anyone staying in Antwerp.
Great location & stylish airbnb. Host was very friendly!

The apartment is unique in style and character and very relaxing to stay in, and the cafe under the apartment is fantastic. I stayed for 5 nights and had a great stay. Allie and Bert were very welcoming hosts. Will be back again soon!

Mooie plek boven Allie’s lunchroom. Uitstekende locatie, super centraal maar rustige straat. Loft is mooi ingericht en heeft een lekker matras.
Allie is erg aardig en communicatief.
Wc is 1 verdieping lager dan de slaapkamer.

Allie was welcoming when we arrived at her place - which sits above a restaurant. The staircase in the restaurant is your way up to the 3 other floors which is old and narrow, but very cute. It goes well with the new and modern spaces of the flat. Lots of light! Great showers and great amenities. The staircase could be a burden if you have large luggage. And, since the living room and kitchen (main), bathroom (mid), and bedroom (upper) were all on different floors, it was about planning accordingly so you didn't have to do too many steps unnecessarily. Great location in town, and steps from a great little beer bar called Billie's (recommended). Even though we only stayed one night in Antwerp, it was great! Thanks Allie.
The apartment is a beautiful space with a great location. Allie is a fantastic host and we would stay here again!

Allie’s space is as beautiful as it looks in the photos. It’s so unique and comfortable, and the location absolutely cannot be beat. I would definitely recommend to anyone, as long as your are comfortable with spiral stairs!

Samen met een vriendin heb ik gebruik gemaakt van het appartement van Allie in het centrum van Antwerpen. Een geweldige buurt! Onze auto op 20 meter afstand in een parkeergarage (Brabo, kosten vrijdag t/m zondag 37,50 euro). Het appartement is schoon en verzorgd. Wel moet je rekening houden met veel trappen, smal en stijl. Geen probleem voor ons, maar het kan een uitdaging zijn ook met je bagage wellicht.
Bij aankomst goed ontvangen. Allie is toenaderbaar en amicaal. Bij inchecken hadden we nog geen handdoeken en Allie is in de avond deze vergeten klaar te leggen. Helaas heeft Allie ook niet gereageerd op mijn bericht hierover via AirBnB. We hebben 2 zakken in het pand zien staan en hier zelf toen handdoeken uitgehaald. I.p. geen probleem, maar ik had het zelf prettig gevonden als Allie een bericht had verstuurd op tijd om te laten weten of ze het redt om handdoeken te verzorgen. Wij hadden hier rekening mee gehouden met het inpakken van onze weekendtas.
Advies is dus om even goed met elkaar af te stemmen wat de afspraken zijn en op welke manier er het beste contact met elkaar opgenomen kan worden (wellicht sneller via (Hidden by Airbnb) ). Alsnog echt genoten en Allie is zeer gastvrouw en vriendelijk. Er heerst een groot vertrouwen van haar richting haar gasten!

We loved staying at Allie's apartment.  This modern and clean apartment is super trendy.  It is the top three floors of her coffee shop which super neat historic touches.  The stairs are pretty serious, but not an issue, even with  our 65 liter backpacks.  The apartment is right in the middle of shops and plenty of restaurants to choose from.
Allie's place is in the perfect location for a visit to Antwerp. The apartment is clean, stylish, and spacious.
Bijzonder appartement op toplocatie in het centrum.

Centraal gelegen appartement. Ingang via de lunchroom, dan achter de toog door naar boven. Leuk ingerichte woning, we hebben er niet veel tijd doorgebracht want we hadden een druk schema in Antwerpen.
Aanrader als je in het centrum wilt verblijven!

Alles sehr schön, lage, Ausstattung, Gastgeber
Nur eines gibt es zu bedenken: es gibt 3 hohe und enge Treppen
Great place in an excellent location.

schöne und gut ausgestattete wohnung. ideale lage am rande der altstadt, das auto kann man bequem im nahegelegenen parkhaus abstellen.

die wohnung ist auf drei etagen verteilt, daher muss man recht oft über die sehr steilen und engen treppen, die nach unten offen sind. man sollte also gut zu fuß sein ;)

allie war sehr nett, die kommunikation und check-in/out liefen reibungslos.

저희가 30분 늦었는데도 기다려 주고 친절하게 맞이해 주었습니다. 안트베르펜 지역의 특징적인 폭이 좁은 건물에서 하루를 보낼 수 있어서 좋은 경험이 되었습니다. 특히 맨 위층에 침실이 있는 점이 좋았습니다. 샤워실도 깨끗했습니다. 다만 건물적 특징때문에 있는 아주 좁고 가파른 계단이 캐리어를 옮기때 힘들고 화장실이 침실과 붙어있지 않고 한층아래에 있어 가파른 계단을 내려갔다 올라갔다 해야 합니다. 그점을 뺀다면 아주 좋은 숙소였습니다.
Allie's place was awesome and clean. Nicely and spacious decorated. The Airbnb is well located, right in the city centre. If I would stay another night in Antwerp, definitely would come back!
Utterly fantastic.  Great location, great place, great hosts!  Unless you have issues with the narrow staircase, this is a can't miss place, truly!
Had a great stay. Great location in the old town. Over Allie’s cafe which serves delicious food. Be aware loads of winding stairs and bit noisy with the windows open.
We would like to come back! It was such a great apartment!

Splendide appartement au coeur du centre historique d'Anvers, Allie était toujours présente pour répondre à nos questions/demandes et nous a très bien accueilli ! L'appartement est d'une propreté irréprochable et est très moderne et lumineux. En plus il est proche de tout et très calme malgré la situation au coeur de la ville. Enfin le restaurant végétarien/vegan au rez de chaussée y est excellent et pas trop cher et je le recommande vivement pour y déjeuner !
It was wonderful at Allie‘s apartment. You have the entire building to yourself. It‘s a beautiful house with a stunning staircase in the perfect location. Couldn‘t have been any better!

Allie's appartement really was the perfect location for us as it's close to public transport and to a huge variety of cafés, restaurants etc.

The apartment itself is really beautiful - very calming with beautiful natural light and views over the rooftops of Antwerp.

We would definitely recommend this apartment for a kid-free getaway!

This is a wonderful accommodation in the heart of a city brimful of things to see and do.
Allie is a great hostess and runs an exceptional vegetarian cafe downstairs!
Allie could not do any more for us and I would not hesitate to recommend to anyone who wants a stay in a surprisingly brilliant city. Go and see for yourself!
Super Airbnb. Genoten van Mn dagen in antwepen mede dankzij dit heerlijke appartement. Super locatie in het centrum.

You can’t get more centrally located than this place. It’s situated in an historic building and occupies the top two floors (with very high ceilings). It has a romantic, almost magical quality to it. Antwerp is a sensational place to visit. This is a must!

Één nachtje overnacht in het appartement van Allie om er nog even tussenuit te zijn met ze tweeën voordat we weer aan de slag moet. Op de foto’s zag het appartement er al prachtig uit, maar in het echt was het nog mooier. Stijlvol ingericht met veel mooie schilderijen en veel klassieke details in het appartement. Het was hartstikke schoon en alles wat we nodig hadden was aanwezig. Voor mensen die niet van trappen houden is het niet ideaal, er waren namelijk drie of vier trappen om in de slaapkamer te komen. Voor ons geen probleem, wij vonden dat de trap een prachtig deel was van het appartement.

Allie was een lieve gastvrouw, goed contact vooraf hoe en wat. + je kan lekker ontbijten in de ochtend onder het appartement. Wij raden het appartement zeker aan!

My Daughter and I stayed at Allies apartment for a long weekend.  Allie & Bart are lovely people and great hosts.  We loved the apartment, it's very spacious and very clean.  It looks exactly like the photos.  It is in a great location, with lots of  restaurants and cafes nearby.  There are plenty of places to visit that are all in walking distance of the apartment. We asked Allie about getting a taxi to the local airport and as Bart was there and he had a day off work, he very kindly drove us to the airport, which made things really easy for us and was very much appreciated.  We will definitely be going back for another visit.
Zeer ruim appartement op toplocatie!
Schitterend app. op een toplocatie, pal in het centrum. Alles aanwezig om een topweekendje Antwerpen te beleven!

Allie’s place is incredible. The location is great—close to public transportation and within walking distance of all of the top destinations. The apartment itself has tons of charm and is also incredibly clean. Allie is a very kind and helpful host, and her restaurant is delicious! I cannot recommend Allie and her flat highly enough! We will not soon forget our trip to Antwerp!

Erg fijn appartement. Heel erg centraal gelegen; het ligt in een straat met allemaal restaurantjes. Parkeren kan in de parkeergarage 2 min verderop. Thuis eten kon prima, maar wij zijn vooral uiteten geweest. Trappen zijn stijl, maar zijn te doen. Erg genoten van onze trip naar Antwerpen. Zeker aan te raden!
Great place at a central location.  Very smooth check-in / out process.   Guest should only be mindful that the stairs are very steep and the place has 3 floors.
Eine wirklich schöne, geschmackvoll eingerichtet Unterkunft über drei Etagen über dem Cafe von Allie  in super Lage.  Alles verlief nett und absolut unkompliziert.
Het appartement is zeer ruim en stijlvol. De locatie is super centraal waardoor het een ideaal verblijf is voor een weekendje Antwerpen. Wij hebben genoten!

Such a unique place in the middle of historic Antwerpen  Location could not be better. The multiple level accommodations made it a very memorable and interesting experience.  My wife and I really enjoyed our stay!

If you want to travel around Antwerp you should stay in Allie’s  apartment because it has a marvelous location and a trendy interior. Moreover, it’s clean and spacious. There is no noise at all. The Allie’s  apartment is a perfect place to stay!

Heel ruim appartement, licht en met alle voorzieningen die je nodig hebt.
De locatie is perfect als je dichtbij het centrum wil zitten. In de straat zitten een aantal cafées, maar daar heb je geen geluidsoverlast van.
Great place at a perfect location!
Simply wow!! Everything about this space is so much fun, location, style and close proximity.. we’d love to stay again!
Appartement très agréable et central. Seul bémol (mais précisé dans l’annonce), les escaliers qui sont plutôt raides et étroits.
Super fijn, groot, romantisch en prachtig huisje! Jammer dat we er maar 1 nachtje waren!

Prachtig appartement, sfeervol, ruim en gunstig gelegen. Mogelijkheid om dichtbij te parkeren. Antwerpen direct toegankelijk zodra je de deur uit gaat. Binnen een fijne plek om even te rusten en te ontspannen. Niet voor mensen die slecht ter been zijn vanwege de smalle trappen. Maar verder echt een aanrader!
Absolutely perfect experience - amazing location, super cool apartment, wonderful host. Would stay again in a heartbeat.
Heel fijn verblijf, top ligging! Onder het appartement baat Allie een leuk zaakje uit waar wij hebben genoten van een heerlijk ontbijt. Zeker een aanrader!
Nice apartment in central Antwerp. The whole place is very stylish and modern. Everything looks recently renovated, including the kitchen and bathroom. We had a great stay!

Really cosy appartement, perfectly located in the centre of the city. close to many hot spots! really nice style, romantic and historical. we had 3 days in antwerp and would definitively stay hehe again. would really recommend :)
The apartment is in a great location - right in the centre of Antwerp but still quiet - and very stylish. Allie was welcoming and helpful. All in all a perfect stay.
bel appartement, plein de charme, bien décoré et équipé
Really awesome loft in the (old) city center of Antwerpen. Highly recommended! =)

Allies place is super central, and parking is located very close by.  The space is modern with an amazing (albeit steep) old staircase in the center. Check in was very easy and the restaurant on the ground floor helmed by Allie is adorable, though we arrived too late to eat there. It has a huuuuuuge bathtub which came in very handy after a day of walking to soak and relax. We didn’t use the kitchen but it was fully equipped.

Allie is a great host and speaks English very well so she can provide tips on what to do and where to eat.  Her place is in a great location (very close to the cathedral).  The apartment has a washing machine which was great since my husband and I were backpacking and needed to wash some clothes.  There are a lot of stairs and the living space is spread across 3 different floors so this apartment definitely isn't for everyone.  We only had backpacks so we did not have a lot of luggage to haul up and down.  I would stay here again.

Wir waren wirklich sehr zufrieden und kommen sicher noch mal wieder. Sehr ausgefallenes, modern eingerichtetes Apartment mitten in der Altstadt von Antwerpen. Wir könnten alles zu Fuß erreichen.
Toll auch, dass wir direkt die Möglichkeit hatten, in Allie’s süßen Plant B Café zu frühstücken. Es befindet sich unterhalb der Wohnung und sie bietet tolle leckere Speisen an. Selbst vegetarische und vegane Köstlichkeiten werden dort mit Liebe angerichtet.
Wirklich eine ganz besondere Unterkunft, und ideal für einen Kurztrip in dieser bezaubernden Stadt.

Great location, and spacious apartment. A bit of an odd layout, with the living space on one floor, the toilet on the next, and the shower and bedroom on the top floor. A bit tough to get up and down the stairs but not too hard as long as you’re in good shape and careful. A cool space overall.

You enter apartment through the restaurant Allie runs and it consists of multiple floors. We really only used the top floor but it was a great jumping off point for exploring the city.  It has styled beautifully and was very clean and comfortable. Great stay!
Perfecte locatie, goede sturing en Allie is heel flexibel. Zeer positief dus.

Allie's place is in a fantastic area to explore Antwerp from.  Cathedral, waterfront and many bars and restaurants within a 5 min walk.  Cheap parking close as well.  The place was clean and had some awesome character.  We loved our stay!
vriendelijk onthaal. Leuk ingerichte appartement en een toplocatie! Zeker een aanrader!

Amazing place, right in the city centre, Allie is a great host.

Just be aware the flat is spread across 3 floors connected by a very stilish but quite narrow stairs
The apartment is charming and Allie was very accommodating to my needs. Would certainly look to see if it's available next time I'll be in Antwerp.
Perfect location to stay overnight in Antwerp!
The apartment is perfectly located in the center of Antwerp. The design and decoration are amazing. Everything was very clean. Highly recommended for a perfect romantic week end!
Awesome place, great host, loved it

We had a great time in Antwerp while staying in the lovely apartment of Allie. The location is amazing, and we’ve enjoyed a great breakfast in Allie’s own restaurant. Would definitely recommend this apartment when staying in Antwerp.

I can understand the appeal for this Airbnb. The location was great, close to basically everything and had a restaurant attached that looked cozy.  Unfortunately, we weren’t able to check in at the normal Airbnb check in time and being a cold rainy, day it was a let down.  When we were able to get into the apartment, the towels were wet and the bed was wet. Being it was a cold and rainy day a warm bath and sleep would have made everything much better. This was a series of unfortunate mishaps and I’m sure that otherwise it would have been a more enjoyable stay.

A very nice appartment on a perfect location. The fact that she has her own lunchroom under the appartment makes it super convenient.
We really enjoyed our stay here.
Mooie ruimtes in een prachtig oud pand. Ideale locatie en fijne communicatie met Allie. Aanrader!
Allie's place was really nice, everything was as described and Allie was responsive. The location was amazing, everything within 10 min walk. Thank you for letting us stay.
Awesome place in the centre of Antwerp. Perfect base to explore the city for a few days. Recommend highly

Perfect spot in the heart of Antwerpen. The apartment is stunning and what a pleasure to get latte in the morning without going outside (there is a cafe at the ground floor). I'll save this place for further trip in the city!
Nice location! Fully renovated. I loved the rooftop bedroom with lovely bath. Defo recommand to visit!
Prachtig appartement, mooi ingericht en heel schoon. Geweldige locatie!

Allie's place is great!  It's a unique experience living above a cafe, but it was pretty quiet while we were visiting because of the Christmas holidays.  The extremely steep stairs were interesting to climb with our large suitcases, plus our dog had to learn how to maneuver on them! The location is fantastic, and even though it's right in the center, the bedroom is on the top floor so it stays pretty quiet.  I'd definitely recommend this place to travelers wanting to stay right in the action of Antwerp!

Logement très bien situé mais sans porte de séparation avec le restaurant situé au rez-de-chaussée, pas très intime. Problème de ménage rencontré, les toilettes n avaient pas été nettoyés, les poubelles des prédécesseurs non vidées, une attitude assez désinvolte de la part de l hôte quand nous lui en avons fait part, bref pas une bonne expérience !

If you ard looking for a charming, super-clean,  stylish and centrally located place to stay in Antwerp, Allie's is the place to go. You should also try a delicious breakfast in her café on the ground floor.
Great place to stay in Antwerpen, we loved the interior and wooden beams. Perfect location right in the city center, all the sight are just a few minutes away! Many restaurants and bars around.

Allies appartement is geweldig als je heerlijk met zijn tweeën wil genieten van een lang weekend Antwerpen. Het appartement ligt super centraal en in een van de gezelligste straten van het centrum. Wij zijn helemaal uitgerust teruggekomen van ons weekend en vonden het bad en de regendouche in dikke plus. Daarnaast laat Allie je lekker je gang gaan maar staat ze ook open voor een praatje en is super vriendelijk. Wij raden dit appartement aan iedereen aan!

Allies appartment is situated in the perfect location: right in the heart of the ancient city centre, nearby restaurants and bars. We enjoyed the hospitality of the partner of Allie, who arranged our check-in. The appartment is located in an old building (16xx) and still has that historical feel, but when it comes to comfortness, the appartment is brand new and living up to modern expectations. Also very trendy decorated. Good to know is that you can park your car just around the corner at the Brabo Parking. All in all a very pleasant stay in a beautiful city.
Beautiful place, great service
Super appartement op een perfecte locatie!

Midden in het centrum ligt een schattig appartement verscholen boven Allies biologische winkel. De verschillende verdiepingen zijn verbonden met elkaar via de antieke wenteltrap en de slaapkamer bevindt zich op de bovenste verdieping. Daardoor heeft het alles weg van een penthouse, alleen het uitzicht heeft wat te wensen over. Gelukkig maakt de locatie en de stijlvolle afwerking van het appartement alles goed.
Prachtig appartement, centraal gelegen en Allie was een erg lieve gastvrouw!
Een prachtig & authentiek appartement, perfecte locatie. Ideaal voor een romantisch weekendje weg!
Zeer gewaardeerde kunst van hans notenboom. Mooi appartement
Super nice house, very well located! I highly recommend this place for a lovely weekend in Antwerp.

Die Unterkunft war sehr originell und super sauber. Alles ist verteilt auf vier Stockwerken. Parkhaus sofort nebenan. Die Unterkunft liegt direkt in der Stadt. Sehr freundliche Gastgeberin. Nur zu empfehlen!

Alie's place is exceptionally well located, right in the middle of the old town of Antwerp. It's a lovely old building with a restaurant (which Alie also operates) at the bottom floor. Entry to the apartment is through the restaurant and once in the place is quiet and feels perfectly private. There's a kitchen and a living room room with each weed rrr4rrf*f-oom and on top of them a main space with a bed and a bathroom. Staying felt cosy and the bath tub is a nice touch. Alie was fair and friendly and prompt in her response. Great stay.

Perfecte ligging, ideaal dat je ‘beneden’ kan ontbijten of lunchen in het vegan restaurant van Allie. We hadden een aangenaam verblijf in dit zeer ruime appartement voor 2 :) De trappen kunnen lastig zijn met veel bagage of als je reist met grotere honden. Wij konden die van ons gelukkig dragen, want ze durfden niet meer naar beneden te gaan ;-) al met al prima voor een weekend “à deux”. Parking Brabo ligt heel dichtbij erg handig!
fantastische locatie en prachtig appartement!

Quite stylish appartement in the heart of Antwerp. The appartment is above the restaurant of the owner. That is special, but also a bit strange for there is no possibilty to close any door. Yet all together a nice place.

We had a great stay at Allies place. The apartment has a lot of historic charme which makes it really unique.
The location was perfect for our short trip to Antwerp. Thanks Allie! :)

Best location you will ever find in a big city. Allie is a great host and runs a busy small vegan restaurant. Step out of the door and in 5 mins you find everything, from top restaurants to culture. The apartment is greatly decorated. Super place to stay.
Zeer mooi en ruim appartement waar alles perfect werkt. Allie is zeer gastvrije host en reageert snel en kordaat als er vragen of opmerkingen zijn - een absolute aanrader.

Lovely and stylish 3 floor apartment! Great location, right near the station. We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment and in Antwerp in general. Would definitely return here!

Special thanks to Allie for hustle-free check in even though we arrived quite late!
We hebben genoten in Allie' s mooie appartement...Uitstekende lokatie! Voor ons is het voor herhaling vatbaar!

The house is super quirky and located in the very centre of a the city! You can get to anywhere from there :)
Of course be ready to climb lots of very narrow stairs and sometimes you can hear the people in the cafe downstairs if you’re in the house during the day but Allie is a great host, with excellent communication and always helpful during the stay. Enjoy Antwerp!
Perfect location for a city trip. The condo is very well located and beautiful. We would stay there again for sure
We loved Allie’s place.  She was very nice and welcoming.  Here apartment was very nice as we.

This is a very cool apartment split over three floors above a cafe.  There is a very steep spiral staircase (which looks original from 1600's!) and don't recommend you have little kids in there, but it is so perfect for a couple.  The apartment is perfectly located in the old town, but ion the Zuid side which is very cool for shopping/ restaurants and the Friday Market etc etc.
GENIETEN in een sfeervol oud pand midden in het centrum. Mooie grote, stijlvolle ruimtes. Houd in het weekend wel rekening met een beetje geluiden van uitgaand publiek.
Erg genoten van het sfeervolle, mooi ingerichte appartement. Schitterend gelegen in het centrum van Antwerpen, boven een gezellige eetplek.

Great location, payed parking around the corner, renovated Belgian style 3 floor design apartment with a FEW floors of spiral stairs between tree floors, which helps train off the beers well :D
Excellent staring to point to explore the whole city and all that it offers!
We loved staying here. The space is beautiful, the food in Allie's cafe is lovely and the location couldn't be easier.
A really stylish and comfortable stay at Allie's apartment. Allie is very welcoming and the flat was in a perfect location for exploring nearby. Would highly recommend.
Heerlijk verblijf gehad en keurig appartement! Zeker een aanrader
Allie´s place is a cool and stylish apartment! The apartment is in a good location, shops, cafes and restaurants nearby. Would definitely return here!
Perfect location, wonderful host and the most beautiful apartment I've ever been in. I wish I stayed longer, as I was able to have the perfect Antwerp experience here. Will definitely come back!

Allie’s place is well located in the center, a stylish place right above her restaurant. The view there is just amazing. I met her personally during check-in and she is nice and smooth in communication. I recommend this place!

Allie’s place is in the perfect location. Allie is a lovely host with a spectacular Air bnb.

I would highly recommend staying here!
Heerlijk modern ruim appartement midden in het centrum. Alles op loop afstand. Goede gastvrijheid. En een relaxte sfeer.
Amazing amazing amazing! The perfect weekend away!

We have chosen to stay at Allie's place because of the amazing reviews and the description of the apartment. Indeed, the place was very stylish and beautiful as we imagined it. The location is also perfect and very convenient with payable parking spot very close. When it comes to the check-in we had a bad experience which never happened to me (yet) in all the places I visited. We were asked to check in at 5 pm instead of 1 pm since we booked the place quite last minute the night before. Totally understandable and we agreed. We then messaged Allie to tell her we were outside and she said to knock the door and that the cleaner should have been there. But she wasn't and Allie told us that the cleaner was late, they had a miscommunication and that "Apparently she still needs to change the sheets etc, but it will be ready by 6pm". We waited for 20 minutes until the cleaner came together with a friend and their boyfriends. We felt very uncomfortable to be welcomed by 4 people who clearly were in a super rush and that were not advised properly about our arrival. We sat in the bar (they offered us a drink) while they were cleaning and then got the place at around 6. This led to the fact that the apartment was not clean as I'm sure it normally is. I am sure this is a great place to stay and that normally this doesn't happen. We understand that sometimes miscommunications happen too but we feel that the host could have apologized for the delay instead of making us feel she was even doing us a favor to fix the problem she caused.

My partner and I had a wonderful stay at Allies flat. A bright, clean and beautiful base for our time in Antwerp. Very easy to get to and travel from. Allie was a great host and made sure we were comfortable. Would stay again.

Allies place is very clean and has a lot of open space. It is a great option if you wanted to be located right in the old city. Allie was very accommodating to us when we arrived late, and welcomed us warmly.
Leuk verblijf op een ideale locatie, en Allie was heel gastvrij, aan te raden.

Lovely spacious apartment right in the centre of the historic area. Not the quietest at night because the area is lively but great if you want to be near everything. There is no door between the cafe and the apartment just the spiral staircase.
Niets op aan te merken, mooi appartement, goede locatie

Wir genossen den Aufenthalt in Allies Wohnung inmitten der Antwerpener Altstadt sehr. Schnell gewöhnten wir uns an die steilen Treppen und das Leben auf den drei Stockwerken über Allies gemütlichem Café. Wir wären gerne noch ein bisschen geblieben.

We had a really nice weekend in Antwerp with this beautiful and charming accommodation. Allie answered all of our questions very quick, so the communication was great. The location in the middle of the historic center with many restaurants, bars etc. was perfect and you can walk most of the outlying sights within 10-15 minutes. We would come back.

A bit of a funky space; ie you enter and exit from a cafe and the 3 floors of the apartment are connected by an old steep staircase, but I like funky and it is located in the heart of the city.
It was great for our short stay.
Very pretty and really, really spacious appartment. Great location; nevertheless very quiet. The different levels make ir really interesting! Loved it!!!

We had a lovely stay at Alie’s charming house in Antwerpen. It’s located directly in the old center which makes it super easy to explore the city. You should definitely try the food at her restaurant just downstairs, it’s delicious.

Eine tolle Unterkunft mit interessanten Baustil. Die Lage war super, mitten in der Stadt. Alles zu Fuß erreichbar. Um in die Wohnung zukommen, musste man durch das Bistro ( kein extra Eingang) was für uns kein Problem war. Die Treppe ist schmal und steil aber auch das war kein Problem. Wir sagen vielen Dank und würden wieder kommen!
Absolutely stunning space, ancient wooden stairs that show the age of the building in a lovingly worn way. Highly recommend!
Geweldige ruimte, mooie locatie vlak bij de winkels.
Ontzettend fijn en mooi appartement midden in het centrum van Antwerpen. Allie is een goede host. We konden onze tassen al vroeg afzetten bij haar lunchroom, wat heel fijn was.
Excellent location and modern outfitting.

Prachtig appartement over 2,5 laag. Ruim, open en vrijheid. Bad is top, bed is fijn, ruimte is groots, plek is ideaal.

Ontbijten kan beneden in haar vegan eet tentje (ook de doorgang naar het appartement).

Doen!

This is a great places. Stylish, very spacious and clean. Allie is a fantastic host and super easy to communicate with. The apartment is very central and all of Antwerp’s sights as well as lots of cool cafes, shops and restaurants are in walking distance. The flat is right above a lovely vegan/vegetarian cafe which is also run by Allie and which has super nice food. The only thing that I will say is that access to the apartment is via a very steep and old staircase which may make the place unsuitable for those with heavy luggage, little kids or mobility issues. In general, I would highly recommend the apartment and I would definitely stay there again.

Clean, nicely decorated, and spacious apartment in the middle of Antwerp located over 2,5 floors, connected by four flights of very steep and slightly uneven stairs (not well suited for the less mobile).

Appartement idéalement situé dans le centre d’Anvers, propre et joliment décoré. Possibilité de laisser ses affaires avant et après la réservation.
Thank you very much

Stunning apartment with a unique staircase that shows the buildings history. Fantastic location near shopping district. Walking distance from the train with many great food and drink options nearby. Cute cafe downstairs with many vegan options. Very clean. Very safe. We really enjoyed our stay here.

Beautiful and incredible apartment right in the heart of Antwerp! Allie is a wonderful, kind and helpful host with an amazing vegan cafe! It was an absolute pleasure and delight to stay here! Big thanks to Allie for everything :-)

We had a great stay in a very unique 17th century town house in the heart of the town centre. The flat you rent stretches over three floors that are refurbished to a very stylish modern standard. From the location you are in the middle of a very lively neighbourhood with lots of trendy restaurants, bars, shops and sights. Nevertheless, it is really quiet and we slept very well. The flat has lots of atmosphere and we really liked to spend time indoors, too. There is a lot you can do and see nearby, so it was a perfect location for a couple of nights away. If you come by car you should really use the free car park by the river at Sint-Michielskaai, which is an easy 10 minutes (max) by foot, basically just down the street. I can personally advise to visit the museum Plantin-Moretus (10 min by foot) which offers a unique and fascinating insight into early book printing and life in 16th century Antwerp. And for food the Falafeltof (another 10 mins) serves the best falafels I have ever tasted. I’d happily stay here again.

Perfect location, a lot of space, clean, good bed, friendly welcome, ...
Just be careful with the stairs.
Perfect location in old Antwerp City Centre. Good communication and checkin went smooth. We had a comfortable stay and would return to Allies place in the future. Highly recommended.
Highly recommended!
Perfect place very well located

This apartment is located right in the center of the city, and served as a perfect place to wind down after roaming the streets. Allies place has a great atmosphere, especially due to the old staircase and wooden beams in the top floor. There’s plenty of room for two, and communication with Allie was very clear and punctual. All amenities are present. Great place if you’re visiting Antwerp for a few days!
Great apartment in a fantastic central location. Allie was helpful, and gave us some great tips.
Super locatie en een heel mooi huis! Allie is ook een hele lieve host!

Leider nicht sauber gewesen, Wohnung an sich erstreckt sich über eine super enge, kleine Holztreppe über 3 Etagen (nichts für Leute mit Gehproblemen), allerdings hat die Wohnung eine super zentrale Lage.

Erg mooi en groot appartement in hartje Antwerpen. Gastvrij ontvangst.
Tip: Voor mensen die slecht te been zijn, zou ik dit appartement wel afraden in verband met stijle trappen
Allie was super helpful and went an extra mile with setting up some special requests. Would definitely stay here again next time!
A clean and comfortable space above a great vegan diner! The stairs are fun and whimsical, but be careful! This place is a dream.
A beautiful apartment in a very good location.
mooi appartement op een mooie locatie!

Allie's place is extremely comfortable and beautifully and tastefully done up. The building has a lot of character (well preserved centuries old wooden structures) and is very cosy, perfect located right in the old centre of Antwerp. Larger and nicer even than the already very appealing pictures on Airbnb.

The restaurant downstairs really makes one feel part of the soul of the city, but still with full privacy (bedroom and shower and very top - 3rd floor). I would recommend for sure (!!) and return any day. Thank you Allie, you have a truly wonderful space... and to all of you future guests, enjoy!!
Allie’s place feels like home and is really nice and clean. Allie is a perfect host and is really flexible. Will definitely remember this place when I visit Antwerpen for another time.

Allies place is charming and wonderful! Allie was flexible when my meeting time changed a bit and met me when I arrived. The photos show this place exactly as it is; 3 floors full of whimsical history. I dont need to say anything else about the stairs that other reviewers havent already said; I thought they were a fun and unique feature to this home. I would happily stay at Allie's place again.

Zeer mooi appartement op een toplocatie. We hebben een heel fijne overnachting gehad. Een minimaal "probleempje" was dat het nogal lang duurde voor het water in de douche warm werd, maar het is dan ook een historisch pand met de badkamer op de 4e verdieping. Dus geen probleem an sich.  Prachtige ruimtes!

The apartment was absolutely beautiful. 3 floors all by yourself, with a stunning  historical staircase in the centre of it all. Very spacious. Location couldn't have been more central, all highlights are at walking distance. We also enjoyed a lovely breakfast at Plant B the café underneath the apartment.
Heel comfortabel en fraai appartement midden in het centrum van Antwerpen. Allie is een super vriendelijke host en alles was tip top in orde! We komen graag nog een keer!

Apparemment très bien situé en plein centre d'Anvers. À 20 minutes à pied de la gare centrale. Proche des rues commerçantes et de nombreux restaurants.
Propre et conforme à la description.
Rien à signaler, merci pour ce chouette séjour nous avons très bien dormi
A wonderful accommodation in the old part of Antwerp. All city highlights & greats bars near by. Fully to recommend!

Allie is a very sweet person. Because i made such a last-minute booking, i did not have to appartement to myself but shared it with her and her friend. She compted me with a wonderful breakfast. The stairs were previously mentioned in other reviews, and i must say they were intense. Beautiful but not comfortable. Allies friendliness makes up for a lot!

Het appartement was geweldig! De locatie, de oude trap, de gecreëerde ruimtes, echt top! We mochten onze koffers eerder brengen en ook later weer ophalen, zo hebben we optimaal gebruik kunnen maken van 2 dagen Antwerpen. Allie weet veel van de stad en ook veel leuke plekjes om te eten. De keuken was wat smoezelig, maar de badkamer en wc waren brandschoon! Ik raad het iedereen aan!
Beautiful apartment in a perfect location. Despite the fact Antwerp went into lockdown, we were able to enjoy Allie’s lovely spacious apartment, which is perfectly located to explore the city.

Very much enjoyed my stay
The apartment has a great location, and everything you need for a comfortable stay. Allie is the perfect host!
Net appartement midden in t centrum
Great location if you like a historical style and be close to bars and restaurants.
Nice place near the center.

Manchmal ist man müde von Hotels - sind immer gleich, riechen nach der gleichen Seife und man bekommt immer das gleiche zum Frühstück. Bei diesem Unterkunft ist aber alles überraschend - die Lage ist super zentral, das Apartment ist über 3 Stockwerke verteilt (die sind mit einem sehr alten schmalen Treppenhaus miteinander verbunden - leider nichts für Paare mit Kinder und ältere Menschen) und man kann unten beim Café den ganzen Tag frühstücken! Allie, die Gastgeberin war sehr freundlich und immer bereit uns zu helfen! Auf jeden Fall würde ich dieser Unterkunft weiter empfehlen und hoffe selber auch irgendwann wieder zurück zu kommen!
Interesting narrow historical staircase for your fitness. Great location for restaurants and nightlife on a busy narrow street. Close to the Cathedral and city hall.
Top

It’s a nice apartment in a small townhouse and Allie is a friendly host. Downstairs Allie runs a little vegetarian café and you use the same entrance to the apartment. You should know that there is no door between the cafe and the other floors. Small stairs lead to the apartment which is located in the top three floors, where you barely notice the people in the cafe. The location is perfect as the house is located in the historic center of Antwerpen with lots of restaurants. We can recommend it!
Perfect getaway in Antwerpen!
Very nice location in the city center

Le logement correspond tout à fait à la description : il est très agréable à vivre.
L’accueil était très sympa et la remise des clefs très simple.
Le traiteur Indien juste à côté est délicieux !

Allie’s place was clean and in a perfect location. We were a bit surprised we had to enter and exit through a café. It felt a bit strange but it was our fault for not reading the reviews that mentioned this. She did allow dogs which we were very happy about but because they could essentially go down the stairs and wander around the cafe we didn’t leave them alone at all.
Mooi appartement met goede voorzieningen. Super voor een weekend weg!

I would say I have hit the lottery in finding the right apartment to stay in Antwerp! Zeynep's humble abode is without a doubt charming; the aesthetics and furnishings are modern and elegant. The apartment is perfectly situated within walking distance of city center, where you can find great restaurants and shops. It is reasonably priced. I sure would have paid twofold to stay in this wonderful apartment!

A beautiful and stylish apartment - 5* luxury with everything we needed to cook and relax for the weekend.

Zeynep is a great and communicative host who did everything she could to make sure our stay was comfortable and that we were well informed on restaurants / places to visit.

The apartment is located a walk from the historic centre or there is a rental bike rack just across the road from the apartment so you can cycle tour the city for 4EUR a day. So much to do - just wish we could have stayed longer.

Definitely recommend this apartment and host.

Zeynep is such a great Host, helpful and responsive. The place was super central in the city of Antwerp. If anyone is looking for a hip spot in this area, then I would definitely recommend this place.
Wonderful apartment! Wonderful host! Would whole-heartedly recommend to anyone staying in Antwerp.

Fijne, vlotte communicatie vooraf de reservering, tijdens het verblijf en zelfs erna. Hartelijk ontvangst een een super mooi en modern appartement, alles is voorhanden. Lokatie is top! Supermarkt om de hoek en hier ook snel een huurfiets te pakken. We komen graag nog een keer terug!
Ontzettend stijlvolle en schoon lokaal gelegen appartement. Zeker een aanrader!
Great place great location great host would definitely stay again

Geweldig appartement, op een ideale locatie. Alles is super luxe en van alle gemakken voorzien. Communicatie met Zeynep was uitstekend, we werden heel gastvrij ontvangen, een perfecte host! Voor een verblijf in Antwerpen een absolute aanrader!

Het is fantastisch vertoeven in het mooie appartement van Zeynep. De ontvangst en de communicatie waren heel hartelijk en vlot. Het appartement zelf overtrof onze stoutste verwachtingen, zo mooi, smaakvol en met aandacht ingericht, echt een feestje om er te mogen verblijven. De locatie is voor de wijk 't Eilandje en het centrum ook heel goed, alles op loopafstand te bereiken.
Een aanrader!

Zeynep is a great  host, she’s really nice, always available to help you and smiling. The apartment is simply amazing. It has everything that you might need, all is nicely decorated (it’s really charming) and its perfectly clean. I recommend it. And thanks Zeynep for the the little gift, it’s always nice to have a good beer after a long drive

The appartement is wonderful for a visit in Antwerp. In about 15 minutes by foot you are in the City Center.
The interior is beautiful and well chosen. Its very comfortable and you will find everything you need!

Zeynep gave us many recommandations for our visit in advance and welcomed us very warm.

We would definitely come back!

Wonderful, wonderful apartment in Antwerp .  Contemporary, stylish, IMMACULATE and centrally located.  Our Hostess Zeynep was wonderful and helpful in every way....especially meeting us at the front door when we arrived, assisting us with parking and getting settled, stocking Nespresso and making sure we had her contact information if we needed her.

L'apartament és moníssim i molt nou, acabat de reformar. Els llits són molt còmodes, la dutxa fantàstica i és ampli. L'edifici és molt tranquil .
Està a prop de casc antic de la ciutat i a 15 minuts caminant de l'estació de tren. Té dues botigues de comestibles a prop, i a més té plaça de pàrquing a l'interior.
L'anfitriona, la Zeyneb, és encantadora i ens va donar tota mena d'explicacions i informacions sobre la ciutat.
Un lloc molt recomanable!
Wat een heerlijk appartement. Het is fijn gelegen en heel stijlvol ingericht. We vonden het jammer dat we maar een nachtje bleven! Zeker een aanrader :-)

Heel stijlvol appartement op een leuke locatie. Zeynep was een hele goede host. Wij werden heel gastvrij ontvangen en zij gaf ons allemaal leuke tips voor Antwerpen. Voor een verblijf in Antwerpen zeker een aanrader!

The apartment is wonderful for a visit in Antwerp. The interior is beautiful with a lot of attention to details. The apartment is suitable for staying with a small kid, Zeynep put travel bed for our 2 years son. Zeynep gave us many recommendations for child-friendly places in Antwerp. Thank you!
Een absolute aanrader! Een smaakvol ingericht appartement, het ontbrak ons aan niets. En Zeynep is zeer gastvrij! Een prima locatie om Antwerpen te verkennen.

Appartement exceptionnel digne d'un magazine de déco. Les photos nous avaient fait craquer au moment de réserver et l'endroit s'est avéré être à la hauteur de nos espérances (voire plus encore !). Une déco scandinave impeccable et très épurée, des équipements neufs, le tout situé entre la vieille ville et le quartier plus récent du MAS avec ses bars et ses restaurants.
Zeynep est pleine de bons conseils et n'a pas hésité à nous dresser la liste des lieux qu'elle fréquente pour qu'on s'éloigne des lieux trop touristiques. C'était parfait !

Prachtig appartement!
Een plezier om te verblijven, werkelijk alles is aanwezig en je komt niets tekort! Goed gelegen eigenlijk heel centraal, dichtbij MAS, eilandje, mmar ook de groenplaats bijvoorbeeld is makkelijk te voet bereikbaar.
Wij komen graag nog eens terug!!
Nice place - prima accomodatie - goede gastvrouw - alles op loopafstand

De woning van Zeynep is stijlvol en schoon en ligt ca 15 min lopen van het centrum en 10 minuten van Het Eilandje. Fietsen kunnen aan de overkant van de straat worden gehuurd via de app Velo Antwerpen. Zeynep is heel vriendelijk en gastvrij en geeft goede tips om het verblijf in Antwerpen nog leuker te maken. Ga in ieder geval een heerlijke koffie drinken bij Cuperus!

Zeynep is a very friendly and nice host who welcomed us very warmly in her cozy and beautiful flat. Thanks to her we had a wonderful stay in Antwerp and Flanders.
The location of the flat is absolutely perfect. You can reach by walk in a couple of minutes the MAS museum; in 13-15 minutes you are in the city centre. Around the flat you have great bars and restaurants. The flat was very clean and cozy; the rooms are decorated in the best minimalistic taste. Zeynep made us feel like at home. She is a lovely person who helped us with many insider informations around Antwerp and Flanders. I hope to meet you again dear Zeynep. Absolutely recommended place!
Kraaknette en stijlvolle moderne flat in hartje van Antwerpen, aangevuld door een feilloos en warm onthaal.  Kortom een aanrader.
Zeer gastvrij en behulpzaam. Echt een aanrader
There's nothing I can say expect stay in Zeynep's flat for she is a wonderful person and host and enjoy her flat and the wonderful things that city has to offer. there's noting more to say!

Zeyneps appartement is een fijn plekje om je 'thuis' te voelen in Antwerpen. Bij aankomst stroomden, naast de gastvrije lach van Zeyneb en haar dochter, de eerste zonnestralen de mooi ingerichte woonkamer-keuken in. De keuken en badkamer zien er zeer verzorgd en schoon uit. Lekkere koffie binnen handbereik. Ons (theater)bezoek aan Antwerpen in combinatie met dit plekje is voor herhaling vatbaar. Kortom: een aanrader.

Een heerlijk heldere plek is het appartement van Zeynep, een lieve dame met wie we trouwens zeer vlot communiceerden. Middenin centrum en toch geen lawaaihinder. Goed uitgekiende inrichting en zeer smaakvol gerealiseerd. Met oog voor kleine details, maakt het zoveel leuker te verblijven. Wij weten waar te logeren, de volgende keer we naar A'pen komen :)

Nice an cosy apartment for our weekendtrip to Antwerp. The apartment was exactly like on the photos. Zeynep was very friendly and the comunication was very easy. She gave us many useful tips. You can reach the city centre and many spots around by foot. I would come back if i am again in the city. Many thanks to Zeynep, we realy enjoyed our stay!
Prachtig appartement met leuke details. Het was schoon, mooi ingericht en de communicatie met Zeynep verliep heel snel en soepel. Ik zou het iedereen aanraden!

Wow! Mega wow! I do Airbnb loads and this was by far the best place and best host! It was stunning! The apartment is nearly too good. It is amazing with great living room, fantastic kitch, huge bathroom, and lovely bathroom. Wow! I spent a while just taking photos of the place for ideas for my own home. Great location in between the old and the new located to good fresh food shops. 12/10!
Très joli petit appartement, bien équipé bien situé et très bien tenu. Zeynep est une hôtesse discrète mais efficace et de bon conseil. N'hésitez pas à y aller....

Super mooi verblijf, en super goede host Zeynep!

Zeer warm welkom en goede uitleg van het verblijf, daarnaast Zeynep super behulpzaam en gaf mij voor mijn verblijf al goede tips voor Antwerpen!

Nogmaals bedankt Zeynep!

Eine sehr gemütliche und helle Wohnung im ersten Obergeschoss. Die Wohnung war sauber, es gibt frische Bettwäsche und frische Handtücher. Die Kücheninsel ist schön groß, befindet sich im Wohnzimmer und ist voll ausgestattet: Herdplatte, Backofen, Geschirrspüler, Kühlschrank mit Gefrierfach, Dunstabzugshaube, Kaffepadmaschine inklusive Pads, dann alles an Geschirr welches man üblicherweise auch Zuhause hat und Besteck. Das WC und die Dusche/Badezimmer sind getrennt voneinander, allerdings lässt sich die Tür zum Badezimmer nicht abschließen. Even more annoying I find this comment in view of the fact that Jeff has not left us a 100% clean apartment.

The toilet was dirty (under the toilet seat many urine stains), the toilet brush was broken and fell in use in 2 parts. In addition, an empty pack of soap in the bathroom and the shower door did not close properly. Throughout the apartment, the water pressure was very low. In the sink were leftovers. On the bed and sofa we can find many hair and the dining table was dusty. In addition, no dish towels were available.

On exact demand, what exactly we have left dirty, he said that the dishes were not in the right place, a towel lay on the floor (as you do in hotel rooms) and the kitchen floor was not clean. Een mooi, modern en ruim appartement van alle gemakken voorzien. Gelegen op een ideale locatie, namelijk op 15 minuten lopen van het station en een halfuurtje van het centrum. A charming top floor apartment, minimal and clean, easily warmed up, and in a quiet part of the city. 10-15min walk from the central station. Easy enough to get to and fro but a taxi is encouraged.
perfect

great apartment to stay at! easy to get to the centre, has nice fish and fruit shops in the street, very bright and fully equipped;)
Lovely spacious apartments, there is everything you need. Corresponds to the description. The owner is very hospitable and responsive.
Leuk en ruim appartement met veel daglicht. Alles is aanwezig en werkt goed. Dichtbij metro. Op loopafstand niet zoveel leuke plekken. Alles bij elkaar prima, goed tarief ook.
Prima lokatie, supermarkten, nachtwinkel en warme bakker op 50 meter. Voor ons goed bevallen na concert bezoek in sportpaleis. Tramhalte erheen was ook op 300 meter.  Een Aanrader

Nice, calme and clean apartment in a lively neighborhood!
Perfect if you are a fresh fish lover: just cross the street!

Simply incredible,  the location, near metro stations and you can walk to anywhere easily; the comodations, good ilumination, very clean, 2 tv, one big living room and the hospitality of Gaetan was amazing, so likeable, very responsive, gave us informations anda map for the city! I really recommend this house and thanks for everything Gaetan!!

Gaetan’s apartment is exactly as in the photos. It’s large, spacious and quiet. The metro is a 5min walk away and takes you to the heart of Antwerp in a couple stops. El piso es espacioso, luminoso y muy limpio. Piso céntrico y en una zona donde hay de todo (supermercado, fruterías, tiendas, etc) . Gaetan fue muy bueno y comprensivo, muy agradable. Tiene todo lo que puedas necesitar en el piso y si necesitas algo Gaetan te responde muy rápido.
Si vuelvo a Antwerp sin duda alguna volvería a alquilar su piso. 100% recomendable.
the floor is very well unicapped and has everything you need.
Gaetano was polite and very informative on the details of the apartment. He was attentive and available for communication. The apartment has great amenities.

Everything was fine, the apartment was spacious, clean and luminous, the neighbourhood is nice and at walking distance from a lot of places in the city and Gaetano was super quick to respond and efficient for the check-in and out.
Wonderful quiet apartment in a bustling area of the city. 10 minute walk from the centre / station. A very pleasant place to stay.
Het is een prima locatie op steenworp afstand van het oude centrum met veel winkeltjes waar je fruit, groente, brood en vis kunt kopen. Gaetano is een zeer gastvrije verhuurder.
We have got nothing to complain about, very clean and nice place to stay. Also  Gaetano is a really kind host.

Super fijn appartement! Hartelijke ontvangst en fijne communicatie. Alles was heel schoon en van alle gemakken voorzien. Heel fijn bed. Een aanrader als je een aantal dagen in Antwerpen wil vertoeven.

Great location. 15 walk from Antwerp central. 15 minute walk from Lotto arena and Sportspalais.  was not able to meet us but his friend gave us a grand tour of the apartment. The host was very nice and accommodating. I would highly recommend this apartment. Thank you for being a great host!

Very clean and stlyish space about 10 minute walk from the downtown core of Antwerp and 3 minute walk to the nearest metro. Gaetano was very quick to respond to any questions and offered clear and simple instructions for arrival and departure. Would reccomend !

Charming apartment close to the historical center of Antwerp (~20 minutes by walking or 10 minutes with the metro). Very calm neighborhoud.
The place itself is great, very clean and Gaetano was really reactive and the communication easy.
Great place to stay, host was extremely welcoming and the flat has everything you could need. Made my arrival in Antwerp very good.
Gaetano was a great host! The apartment was nice and clean. He was very flexible (check in/chevk out). Recommended!
The place was great and Gaetano was super friendly and welcoming! The apartment is big and well-furnished, very silent and cozy. Extremely recommended for a weekend in Antwerp!

Gaetano was a very nice and welcoming host. He presented us the appartment personally and was always contactable through the entire stay. The appartment was clean and spacious. We can warmy recommend it!
Wij hebben een heerlijke tijd gehad in het appartement. Alles was top geregeld, communicatie goed. Een heerlijke uitvalsbasis om Antwerpen in te gaan!
Recommandation à 100%. Propreté, localisation, réactivité, communication, tout était top.

Great place. Very clean, very homey with all the amenities I needed. The owner checked in to make sure everything was going well. If you stay here, I highly recommend the fish restaurant right accross the street.
Great apartment located in a quiet, friendly neighborhood and within walking distance to most places. Gaetano was an excellent host and available for any questions. Would recommend to anyone.

We zijn ontzettend vriendelijk ontvangen door Gaetano en hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad in Antwerpen. Je zit op 5 minuten fietsen van het bruisende centrum, maar in het appartement is het heerlijk rustig.
Trotz der angehenden Pandemie haben wir uns bei Gaetano sehr wohl gefühlt.

Great accommodation at a fantastic spot.

The apartment looks even better than on the pictures. It was clean and modern, but not “clinical”... it’s cosey enough to spend a night playing boardgames and drinking some great Belgian beers (2 Duvels on the house, thanks for that!). Bit noisy maybe, but no problem for us.

10 mins walk from the historic city centre, but also great bars, lunchrooms and restaurants in a minute walk at the same site as the MAS museum (where you can spend your rainy day perfectly).

Appartement super propre super calme,largement mieux en vrai,bien équipés,super pratique et Carine a été super gentille attentionnée et flexible niveau (Website hidden by Airbnb) la recommande fortement.

Wij verbleven van 2 januari t/m 5 januari 2018 in dit appartement in Antwerpen tijdens het begin van de 'Solden'. Een jarenlange traditie die wij als kinderen samen met onze ouders nog lang willen voortzetten.

Bij vertrek uit Groningen (Nederland) zouden wij een appje sturen hoe laat de aankomsttijd ongeveer zou zijn en op de grens van België hebben wij een telefoontje gepleegd hoe laat de exacte aankomsttijd zou zijn. We werden keurig volgens de afgesproken tijd ontvangen bij het appartement. het oogde bij het eerste moment licht, proper en netjes! Verder verliep de communicatie (bijvoorbeeld over het doorgeven van de WiFi code) heel vlot! Sterker nog, binnen enkele seconden hadden we al een SMS terug ontvangen. De bedden sliepen prima, twee aparte van de badkamer gescheiden wc's waren erg schoon en de locatie is ook dik in orde (ongeveer 12 min. lopen naar de Meir). Enige aanmerkingen waren het verstopte doucheputje en een losse deurklink van de WC, maar deze kleine gebreken hebben onze vakantie er niet minder op gemaakt. Ík zou zeker nog eens terug willen komen!

We had a very nice weekend at Carine's place. MAS is just around the corner, and the city centre a quick 15 min away. It's a street away from the red light district but the neighborhood isn't seedy! The apartment is safe and secure, and didn't hear a peep from outside when indoors. We would love to come back!

Carine en haar man hebben gezocht voor een hartelijke ontvangst (met een leuke attentie - een flesje cava - bij aankomst). Het appartement is zeer mooi ingericht en qua locatie goed gelegen (aan het MAS). Een aanrader om een weekendje Antwerpen te bezoeken!

Carine's apartment is very well-situated, 10min of walking distance to the old town city centre.  The apartment itself is beautifully and modern furnished. We didn't miss anything. Also Carine is a very nice host, who did everything to make our stay a pleasant stay in Antwerp, welcoming us at our arrival and being there at our departure. Thanks a lot! We would always return and recommend the apartment to anyone who wants to have a pleasant stay in Antwerp!

Wonderful place to stay :-) very Close to the MAS and the red star line Museum! Everything was very easy to communicate...Carine and her husband were super helpful hosts! We’re  really enjoyed to stay there :-)
Magnífico y precioso apartamento en una zona muy cercana al centro, al lado del MAS, y a un paseo de la Catedral y la Plaza del Mercado. Y Carine muy atenta en todo. Magnífica experiencia.

We have a complicated flight to Brussels and we arrived very late to the airbnb. Carine and her husband were really implicated in trying to help us all the time. They were very kind, patient and helpful!!
The flat is amazing and beautiful. Absolutely clean and very well decorated. I undoubtedly recommend this place!

We stayed at Carine's place with four adults. The apartment is at a fantastic location within short walking distance from MAS, the harbor and a lot of nice restaurants just around the corner. It was very spacious and comfortable, and communication went very well. Highly recommendable!
Carine's apartment is very stylish in a great neighbourhood in Antwerp.  Carine and her husband are very friendly and welcoming.
Très joli appartement en duplex, confortable, très bien situé. Propriétaires très aimables. Une adresse sûre.
Superschöne Wohnung in toller Lage. Antwerpen von seiner hipsten Seite.

Very cosy appartment, ideal place to relax after a long day of walking or cycling around Antwerp. There is a bicylcle station just down the road where (after signing in) you can easily hire bicycles. There are some nice cafés and restaurants in both directions (towards MAS and towards town). Highly recommended!

Die schöne Maisonette-Wohnung von Carine entspricht den Fotos, sie ist sehr sauber und ganz neu renoviert. Sie liegt im ersten und zweiten Stock und ist über eine schmale Stiege erreichbar. Für Menschen mit einer Gehbehinderung ist sie also nicht geeignet. Ein Schlafzimmer liegt zur Straße hin, eines in den Hinterhof. Die Betten sind bequem, ca. 160 / 180 cm breit und haben je nur eine Bettdecke (Pärchen müssen sich also sehr lieb haben). Wie bei allen Apartments in der Stadt muss man mit Wohngeräuschen der Nachbarn und dem Verkehrsrauschen rechnen. Es ist aber nicht übermäßig laut.
Die Lage der Wohnung am nördlichen Rand der Altstadt ist praktisch, wir konnten alle Museen, Kirchen, Restaurants usw. sehr gut zu Fuß erreichen. Vor der Haustüre gibt es viele Parkplätze, wo man allerdings maximal 3 Stunden (ca. 8 €) parken kann. Die Parkplätze an der Schelde in unmittelbarer Nähe sind mit ca. 25 € am Tag auch teuer. Wir haben also das Gepäck nur ausgeladen und das Auto dann auf dem kostenlosen Parkplatz südl. der Altstadt am Vlaamsekaai abgestellt.
Die Kommunikation mit Carine hat prima geklappt, was die An- und Abreisezeit angeht, ist sie uns ganz entgegengekommen. Spontan hat sie uns den Schlüssel sogar zum Park Vorderstein (Tipp für Gartenliebhaber) in Schoten, einem nördl. Vorort, gebracht, den wir auf dem Hinweg besichtig haben. Supernett!!

Lovely place in a great neighborhood- eilandje with some cool places around the corner! Perfect place to stay for a weekend in Antwerpen. Carine and her husband were friendly and advised us where to go. Definitely a recommendation!

Die Unterkunft ist sehr schön und sauber und liegt sehr zentral, so dass man in kürzester Zeit in der Stadtmitte von Antwerpen oder an der Schelde ist.
Carine ist eine sehr nette Gastgeberin, alles hat hervorrgend geklappt und wir kommen sehr gerne wieder.
We had an awesome stay here. Very friendly and responsive owner. Easy communication, everything clean, nice location. Nothing to complain about, it was just perfect. Would book there again
Very nice and new duplex apartment. We stayed with 2 small kids and enjoyed it.

A very very nice looking and furnished apartment with only a few little things to improve like: providing a towel for hands, providing soap on the washbasin,.. it is only details that can be easily improved.

Ruime en mooie plek in een goede buurt.
Een aanrader.

Carine was a great host, friendly and accommodating to our requests. The place was very tidy, stylish and cozy at the same time - love the natural light. Located around the corner from the MAS and good base for exploring Antwerp on the weekend. Highly recommended !

Dit heerlijke appartement is ideaal voor een weekendje Antwerpen! Om de hoek bij vrijwel alle hotspots van de stad, maar zeker ook gezellig genoeg om ook ‘thuis’ een wijntje te drinken. Het huis smaakvol ingericht en in het echt nog mooier dan op de foto’s. Carine en haar man verwelkomden ons zeer hartelijk en de communicatie ging erg soepel. Kortom; een echte aanrader!

very nice apartment and ideally located between the old centre, just 10 minute walk or less, and the new developments with many trendy bars and restaurants. Very flexible host with the check in and check out, which makes it very convenient.

We enjoyed so much our stay in Carine's light, spacious, airy and comfortable apartment. Her kindness and concern for our well being went beyond what we would have expected. The location, although a little edgy, is very convenient for the city centre and the newly developed dockside.

Carine is a warm, friendly and communicative host. Highly recommended.

We would definitely stay here again.

A beautiful large apartment (it is bigger than it appears in the photographs). It is spotlessly clean, stylish and comfortable. We were 2 couples and there was plenty of room. Het appartement is erg groot en ruimtelijk. Het is schoon en heeft veel faciliteiten zoals een goede keuken. Locatie is goed voor leuke restaurants en bars. Uitgaansgelegenheden zijn om de hoek.

On Sunday the parking in front of the house is free of charge. For those, who arrive by car, think of checking if your vehicle meets the conditions for admission to the low emission zone in Antwerp and register on their website.
The communication with Carine and her husband went very smooth and easy. They were very kind to let us stay longer on the check-out day. Thanks again for a nice stay!
Super house, very good location
Stylish apartment with good amenities in a great location. Very friendly hostess.

Super appartement, très bien placé pour visiter Anvers a pied ou a vélo. Appartement très propre et très agréable! Merci encore et a bientôt!

Super Wohnung für einen Städtetrip! Die Lage ist super und die Wohnung absolut super. Perfekt für 2 x Pärchen!
Die Unterkunft von Carine ist gemütlich und schön eingerichtet. Auch die Kommunikation mit Carine verlief sehr unkompliziert, schnell und sehr höflich! :)
Heel fijn weekend gehad hier, prachtig appartement!

The spacious room can be a good thing but at the same time meaning it would be vastly cold and hard to heat up. We didn’t expect any heater and slept somewhat chilly but I could imagine in winter time, it would be a real game changer if you are not prepared. I would certainly not return to this property.
