The location was not super central but we didn’t mind walking and were more concerned about having something close to the train station. Check-in was easy and Rick is super responsive! Thanks for everything :)
A beautiful Apartment. It was a very nice stay there. And the owner is also very friendly
Clean, stylish and in a quiet neighbourhood. Suggestions on some local attractions are given and they are worth checking out. This air bnb was a great place and I would recommend staying here!

Appartement super bien équipé !
Le quartier est calme et plaisant . Un peu excentre mais accessible par tram .

We have stayed a few times at Rick's place and it's always a pleasure to come back: very nice apartment with great amenities, very clean, and in a great location, close to the center of Antwerp and with public transportation at your doorstep.

Rick’s place is very comfortable and clean. Little touches like providing tea and coffee to spare toothbrushes if needed. Would highly recommend. We loved exploring the area. Rick has been a great host.
Excelente anfitrión Rick. Departamento muy limpio y bien ubicado nos encanto! Definitivamente recomendable.
Nice new apartment in a quiet location out of the city.  There were a few teething problems with the stay but Rick did his best to sort them out on the first evening

Rick is very friendly and knows how to make you feel like home. We are here for the second time because the place is very quiet, nice, modern in the heart of a beautiful quarter. It is the best place to visit Antwerpen and to have a good time! GREAT!
Perfect apartment with kids - nice playgrounds are nearby. Very good restaurants just arround the corner. Everything was very clean and lovley decorated. It really felt like home! We loved it!;-))))
Really good apartments , very      nice place and very good owner .

Super cozy appartment with all the amenities you can imagine. The place feels welcoming, luminous and modern. I loved the fact that Rik let us welcoming beers, explanations of the area and much more. He was always attentive and quickly reacting. I had a really great time in the appartment. Perfect place to disconnect visit the city (super well connected and located) and cook some great meals in that heaven kitchen! Thanks for everything Rik
Rick's place is really lovely, everything was spot on. Will definitely try to book again when back.
Great place. Central location.
Best place we have stayed! No doubt! Location is great, beautiful place and very nice host. I stayed with my wife and 15  months old daughter. The crib made our life very easy. Thanks, Rick!!!
We recommend this place, it is well located and amazingly designed ! Rick is a great host with good communication.
Keurige. Bedankt voor de service
Perfect space!
Great host.
Not much to add to what was already said about Rick and his lovely apartment except  vouching for its accuracy.
beautiful apartment . mordern and stylish! Rick was a great host with quick replies even at an unsociable hour :) thank you for a great stay!

Rick a toujours été très réactif et attentif à nos besoins durant notre séjour. L'appartement est vraiment spacieux, impeccable et très  agréable, tout comme le quartier que nous avons particulièrement apprécié : Groen Kwartier est un très bon plan avec des enfants.

We had a big time in Rick’s apartment! Great location, especially if you’re traveling with kids and there’s a hip neighborhood just 15 min on foot. And a cool Café nearby, where you can easily spent lots of hours without noticing it!
It’s easy to reach by car or by public transport. There’s a train station 10min walk from the apartment, with good connections (if you want to go to Brussels, for example, it takes only 45min!).
The apartment is very modern and with good taste decorated, it’s very clean, the WiFi is super fast... actually it has everything you may need to feel on a great vacation!
We strongly recommend it and we’ll repeat for sure!
We had a perfect time in the apartment. Everything was like the description in the Inserate. The communication with Rick went very good and he has always answered within a few minutes!
Great stay. Eye for detail. Location was super. Very clean.
Super verblijf!

Très bel appartement spacieux, très propre et vraiment bien équipé ! Il est parfaitement situé dans un quartier paisible et vivant à la fois.
Rick a été très réactif et accommodant, nous l’en remercions .
Nous avons passé une excellente semaine !

Rick is a great host who did everything to make our stay comfortable.
The apartment has a great location in a calm neighborhood near the city center.
Everything was as advertised and more!

Thanks Rick
Fijne kerel Rick. Flexibel. Locatie perfect. Appartement is prachtig en brandschoon. Van alle voorzieningen voorzien. Zeker voor herhaling vatbaar!
Amazing host and superb place! Highly recommended. :))

The place was exactly as pictured. Rick answered very quickly to any messages and the location was good for our needs. Also the complementary treats were a pleasant addition. For the price everything was 5/5.

an absolutely fantastic host... knows what it means to treat your guest... the little touches in the apartment made it feel like home... this is the "home" to come to whenever I have to come again... excellent location, quiet and shopping for groceries, etc. is about a 5 minute walk...

We absolutely loved staying at Rick’s place, it is like a 4-star hotel, no exaggeration. Impeccably clean, modern, fully equipped (kitchen even has spices, oils, condiments, the bathroom has everything from flat iron to ear sticks). Very quiet and restful. The neighborhood is great, even in the times of the Corona and especially with small kids. There’s a lot of place to run around, multiple playgrounds, convenient shops nearby. Communication with Rick was excellent and we much appreciated the self check in. Parking is available right in front of the apartment for 5 EUR/day. If we ever visit Antwerpen again, this is the place to stay.
Een heel fijn en ruim appartement waar je alles vindt wat je maar nodig hebt. En de buurt is ook nog eens top!

We stayed at Rick’s  place for a month. It was even better than we expected. It was spotlessly clean and bright. The rooms were large and it was tastefully decorated. Entry with Nuki passcode was simple. Beds were comfortable. All appliances worked and everything we needed was supplied... even adapters for electronics. There are multiple outlets as well. The apartment was very quiet and  the neighborhood is perfect..cafes, groceries, and bakery are within a 2 minute walk away. I especially enjoyed sitting in the community garden every day. It was delightful. Trams to center city are very close as well. We highly recommend Rick’s place to anyone visiting Antwerp.
Zeer mooi appartement, perfect gelegen op een rustige, aangename plaats in het centrum van Antwerpen.

Prachtig appartement! Heerlijke combinatie tussen mooi én functioneel ingericht. Werkelijk alles is voorzien (wasmiddel, theezakjes, keukenrol, kruiden, reservehanddoeken, anti-muggen, etc.). Uitstekende bedden met voldoende kussens. We waren er tijdens een hele warme week (buiten +30 graden) en binnen bleef het lekker fris. Het is gelegen in een rustig deel van het Groen Kwartier: het is er stil en rustig, ook 's avonds en 's nachts. Tegelijk is het op wandel- en fietsafstand van de leukste terrasjes in Antwerpen. Absolute aanrader!
Goede communicatie

The apartment is clean and super charming. It was pretty cool (temperature wise) even though the weeks we stayed there were really hot. Also, the area is really quiet (awesome).

Rick was an awesome host. He answered incredibly fast and even had a few really nice suggestions for sightseeing and eating out for us.

Overall we can definitely recommend! We enjoyed our stay very much, are sad to go and hope we can return soon!

Erg nette Airbnb met leuke hotspots in de buurt (PAKT, een bierbrouwerij etc.). Daarnaast ben je met de fiets of tram ook zo in het centrum van de stad of het Eilandje. De host communiceert snel en uitgebreid; groot pluspunt!
Troisième séjour chez Rick et toujours un plaisir: calme, propreté, design, endroit idéal pour visiter la Belgique  ! Le top de l’air bnb!!
Fijn verblijf, vlot contact met Host

Rick’s place is one of the few Airbnbs that turns out be even better than it looks! The location is perfect, right in the middle of the green quarter, with the big Berchem station within walking distance, and quite a few restaurants within a couple of mins..
The place itself has the perfect layout, the kitchen is well equipped, the working area is great… WiFi works, the bathrooms are spacious, the bedroom is comfortable and the place has everything you can ask for, and is beautifully set up!
5/5 on everything from checkin to checkout really!

This was my second time at Rick’s and the place continues to be very comfortable and well taken care of! The area is calm and quiet - some road works on one of the streets but you don’t hear the noise or anything..
The apartment itself remains well equipped and Rick communicative..
Nothing much to be said, the place is perfect!
The best apartment in Antwerp I have ever been!

Appartement tout simplement parfait. spacieux, moderne et décoré avec goût et un certains minimalisme très agréable.
Tout le nécessaire était présent.
Le quartier est calme, près de commerces et restaurants.
Il est facile de se rendre aux lieux touristiques avec les différentes lignes de métro ou les bus.
Nous avons préféré marcher pour mieux découvrir la ville.
Je le redis, tout était parfait que ce soit l'appartement en lui même, la communication avec Rick ou le quartier.

We spent a week at Rick's place and I can only tell good things about it. From the checkin, till the checkout, everything went smooth and great, the apartment is well equipped and you can find whatever you need for cooking, washing and entertainment for the evenings. The location is easy to access and it is always possible to find a parking spot nearby, no matter what time it is. The apartment looks exactly like it's advertised, the cleanliness is spot on, just like the communication with the host.  Whatever questions I had, it was instantly answered, thank you for that. :)
We had an amazing 3 days in Antwerpen also because of this amazing appartment. It was great!
nice apartment in a nice location. it was the ideal for what we needed
Goede prijs-kwaliteitverhouding. Nare nicotinelucht.

We zijn met 4 vrienden 2 dagen verbleven in Antwerpen. Het verblijf zag er geweldig uit en was zeer netjes! Bij aankomst was ik helemaal vergeten te laten weten hoe laat ik er zou zijn. Na een telefoontje stonden ze na 10 minuten gewoon voor de deur om ons binnen te laten! Dit vond ik heel prettig en een geweldige service. Het appartement is zelf heel ruim en laat veel licht binnen, alles ziet er netjes uit! De locatie op nog geen 100 meter lopen van het station dus je kan overal naartoe vanaf deze locatie! Ook is er vlakbij een Albert Heijn waar je makkelijk alle je nodige boodschappen kan doen! Verder heb ik eigenlijk geen minpunten over het verblijf, alles was zeer naar wens! Ik zou het zeker aanraden!

Het verblijf bij Rev was geweldig.

Wegens omstandigheden waren wij eerder in Antwerpen en was ik vergeten om Rev dit te melden. Gelukkig was dat niet erg en stond ze binnen 5 min voor de deur. Het contact was continue via de site en dat ging prima, ze reageerde erg vlot.

Al met al heb ik erg genoten van het appartement en was de locatie ideaal om de stad te bezichtigen.

Rev was a great host with excellent communication. The place is large and a very short walk from the train station. We couldn't have asked for more on our trip. Definitely recommended for anyone traveling to Antwerp.
Great location great host, perfect communication and check in cool trendy  apartment fantastic comfortable beds what more could you ask for!

This place is in a great location and there is so much to do. You see the Ferris wheel from the window., and it is a 4 min walk to the central station.There was plenty of space and the decor was fabulous. I recommend you stay in this apartment.
Rev’s apartment is closed to the center station. convenient transportation and nice house. There are many restaurants near the apartment. I would like to live here again if I come to Belgium.

Big apartment in a good location in Antwerp, very close to the train station and the historic center. Good for 4 people in the two rooms. The hosts were very helpful checking in and out. Recommended for a weekend visit in Antwerp
great stay! Clean, comfortable, and the check-in/out process was easy and simple. The living room was very spacious as well.

Das Apartement von Rev war genau wie im Inserat beschrieben.
Tolle Lage. Super Komminikation.
Rev war stets zu erreichen. Einfaches und unkompliziertes Check-In sowie Check-Out.

A simple furnished and tiny but clean apartment. Good location, very central.
Unfortunately we were checked-in in a smaller apartment then we booked.

Main living room is very nice
Bedrooms and bathrooms a bit old.

Mooi appartement, super centraal gelegen. Ruime woonkamer met fijne meubels. Beter voor 4 personen, dan voor 5, want slaapbank is geen slaapbank maar een grote bank en aantal spullen zijn er ook maar voor 4 personen. Er is geen afwasmiddel aanwezig, dus dit is handig om mee te nemen. Lichten in de woonkamer zijn wat sfeerloos. Het was een prima appartement voor een weekendje, maar goed om te weten nog, het stonk echt flink naar sigaretten.
Bel appartement, agréable, bien équipé, bien décoré, très bon emplacement pour passer quelques jours à Anvers.
Appartement moderne super bien situé
Very beautiful the apartament and location !
Proprietario simpatico e puntuale. L'appartamento è spazioso, completo di tutto edp è in una ottima posizione vicino alla stazione e molto strategica.

Het appartement ligt op een toplocatie! Perfect gelegen in het centrum en alles met de voet bereikbaar. Het appartement was heel schoon en de bedden heel fijn. We kregen zelfs handdoeken! Enige minpuntjes waren de douche die niet top is en dat de advertentie voor 5 is, maar alles in t huis eigenlijk berust op 4 personen (borden/bekers/bestek). Dat is dus een beetje karig, maar voor de rest is het een prima appartement met mooie woonkamer en toplocatie!
Eigendlich ein gutes renoviertes Appartement. Leider stinkte der Gang am Eingang immer stark, sowie Badezimmer könnte sauberer sein. Sonst alles in Ordnung.

Amazing host .i must say the level of care was outstanding as the host replies within seconds.
Place is near the station 2 min walk and close to everything you need.
I had a great time
Hope to see you soon
Super séjour. L’appartement est hyper bien situé. Je vous le recommande. Niveau qualité prix c’est vraiment l’idéal !
Appartement is listed for 6 persons, but there are glasses etc. for 4 persons. Location close to the central station is a plus, just like the big couch in the living room.

un apartamento en todo el centro de la ciudad tienes todo muy cerca tiendas súper mercados una zona maravillosa con unas vistas soñadas el apartamento Excelente de lujo todo impecable la anfitriona súper educada amable y muy servicial recomiendo mucho este apartamento
Mooi en ruim appartement op een goede locatie. Wel jammer dat er geen beddengoed voor de (slaap)bank was, ondanks dat we voor 5 personen hadden geboekt.
It was great
Great large and very clean apartment

Rev a hostess always attentive, friendly and understanding, we had a couple of inconveniences and everything resolved immediately, the apartment well located, spacious and clean, perfect! recommended 100%

Spacious living room with two bedrooms. The location is great! It is very close to the central station with many shops nearby (groceries, fast foods...). We were 5 to stay. The host provided us with an extra bed. However, kitchen utensil is not sized to accommodate many people. The beddings are confortable but I've known better. I might be particularly picky about this aspect.
The host was accommodating and replied quickly which I appreciated a lot.
If you have a car, try booking a parking in advance. Parking in the street can turn out very expensive.
extreem goede locatie. lekker ruim appartement met alle toplocaties op loopafstand. zalig

Zeer mooie kamer met eigen badkamer. Alles is erg verzorgd en leuk afgewerkt.
Dietrich en Sofie zijn zeer vlot bereikbaar via de gsm en de ontvangst was erg hartelijk. We voelden ons dadelijk op ons gemak hier ! Een aanrader.
Had a great stay! Hosts are friendly and easy-going. Would visit this place again!
The best place in town nice location too
Mooie en schone kamer. Zeer vlakbij het centraal station. Het contact verliep zeer soepel. Tevens een goede prijs-kwaliteit verhouding. Ik beveel deze kamer van harte aan.

Sofie is een erg goede gastvrouw! Ze zorgde ervoor dat we niks tekort kwamen en bood ons handige tips. We hebben met veel plezier verbleven in de kamer. De kamer is prachtig, erg schoon en voorzien van attente details die je verblijf aangenaam maken. Ik zou hier zeker terug willen komen!

Perfectly located within walking distance from Antwerp's central station, this little space is good for the single or couple travelers. A stone's throw away from hip pubs and cafés, yet quiet and peaceful - you couldn't ask for more. Dietrich was there on arrival and provided a great list of eating options. I also loved the coffee station in the room. Can't say thank you enough and hope to be back soon.
Really nice place with lots of nice little touches and attention to detail.  Would definitely stay here again.  Thanks guys!

Our stay had all ingredients for an unforgettable weekend: most helpful and friendly hosts, neat and stylish room with incredible make-your-own coffee facilities, and the appartenent close to the beating heart of Antwerpen. Best price-quality deal!

Fijne schone kamer, vriendelijke ontvangst, en mooi ingericht! Een kamer waar je je gelijk thuis voelt,erg fijn dat er een badkamertje en eigen toilet bij zit. Ook is er de mogelijkheid  om een kopje koffie of thee te maken.
Beter dan dit kun je het eigenlijk niet treffen. Alles was tot in de puntjes goed verzorgd, we werden vriendelijk ontvangen en kregen goede tips voor wat te doen!
Hele mooie/schone kamer. Op een steenworp afstand van het Centraal Station en een hele fijne communicatie met Sophie!
Very nice and sweet place ! Right in the center of Antwerp :-)

I thoroughly enjoyed and appreciated my stay with Sofie & Dietrich. They are the soul of thoughtfulness and most accommodating. The very lovely room and adjoining bathroom are sparkling, spotlessly clean. The bathroom is quite modern & there is good space for toiletries. The towels are big and fluffy and the bed is cozy and extremely comfortable. There are so many thoughtful touches , such as pen and paper and a nice-sized silent clock, plus their personal recommendations for restaurants, etc. are all written out.
The location is great -- easy walking distance from the train station and there are interesting ethnic enclaves nearby. Sophie gave me a map and there are guidebooks and brochures in the room.
It might be a little cramped for a couple with a great deal of luggage, but I found it perfect for my needs.

Zeer mooie kamer, voldoende groot met enkele boeken over wat er te doen is in Antwerpen. De badkamer ook tip top in orde. De gastheer en gastvrouw waren er niet op het moment van inchecken maar het verkrijgen van de sleutels was prima geregeld. Voor het vertrek hebben we nog aangenaam kennis gemaakt.

Lovely room directly at the central station of Antwerp.
Dietrich and Sofie are friendly and have a lot of ventures to offer. They did everything for me to feel like being home.
I have nothing to object to them or the flat and can highly recommend them!
Fijne kamer en goede prijs/kwaliteit verhouding!

What is there not to like? Dietrich and Sofie have a great eye for detail in the design of their room and together with the impeccable cleanliness this ensured making our stay very pleasant. This was only amplified by the presence of a couple of nice gestures like fresh fruit and a can of water as well as the possibility (professional instructions included) to make a delicious coffee with fresh coffee beans.

Visiting Dietrich at his work was a good decision; he welcomed us warmly and we were able to have a nice and interesting conversation. The food and coffee he prepares is also delicious, by the way. So if you can, we recommend you visiting him. :)

Taken together, we have found them to be excellent hosts and we have felt very comfortable during our stay. We would recommend the them to anyone to the full 100%. :)

What a wonderful stay! The accommodations were everything we could have asked for. The dinner recommendation was perfect, and the coffee in the morning really topped it all off. I couldn’t recommend this place any more! We wouldn’t hesitate booking this again.
The apartment looks absolutely gorgeous. Sofie and Dietrich gave us a very warm welcome and made us feel very comfortable.

Mijn vriend en ik hebben erg genoten van dit prachtige appartement! Dietrich en Sofie waren erg gastvrij en dit maakte het verblijf ook prettig. Het appartement is mooi en stijlvol ingericht, erg rustgevend. S’ochtends werden we verrast met een bakje fruit en schone handdoeken. Ook de koffie was aanwezig door deze zelf te malen en klaar te maken. Op 5 minuten lopen lag het Centraal station en op 10 minuten lopen kwam je terecht bij de Meir. Vóór het appartement had je ook plek om buiten te zitten, lekker plekje om s’ochtend je eigen gemaakte koffie te drinken!
Voor een fijn verblijf raden we zeker dit appartement aan!
Groetjes,
Fay en Raven
It was so nice to pass this 2 days , Dietrich and sofie are so nice and helpful .

We only had one night in Antwerp but we had a wonderful stay with Dietrich and Sofie. They are located a few minutes walk from the central station. The room is cosy and lovely decorated! They have unique coffee with a step by step guide on how to grind and make it.. it definitely was an added touch! We highly recommend this place

Dietrich and Sofie's Airbnb was wonderful! Great location, beautifully decorated and lovely touch with the coffee. They were great hosts with helpful tops and quick communication. We would definitely stay there again! :)
These guys are really kind. We stayed there during our visit to Tomorrowland and this place is perfect. Really recommend this place to everyone, we had a great stay.

The stay at Dietrich & Sofie’s was more than fantastic! I enjoyed every minute in the apartment.
The Airbnb was extremely detail oriented with its interior design. I had a little coffee machine with instructions on how to use it, there have been books and personal recommendations on what to do in Antwerp and more then enough towels and some fruits and sweets.
The area where the Airbnb is located is perfect for exploring Antwerp, everything was close by and easy to reach even by foot. Nearby is a really cool pub that you should definitely check out.
Whenever there was a question, they were super fast in replying and have always been nice and helpful. When possible also check out this super sweet cafe of Dietrich. The same nice interior design as well as great coffee and even better cakes!
I had a great stay here and can recommend that Airbnb 100% and will always come back to it when visiting Antwerp. :)
We stayed only one night by Dietrich and Sofie. It was great! Everything was very clean and we get good tips to visit Antwerp!
Dietrich and Sofie were great hosts. Nice people and very easy to communicate with. Their place is super cool as well. Would reccomend to stay here!

Een rustige, nette, schone en mooi ingerichte kamer. We hebben heerlijk geslapen. De kleine attenties geven je het gevoel echt welkom te zijn. Je kunt zelf thee en koffie (verse bonen!) zetten. Sofie heeft ons heel hartelijk ontvangen. De kamer was zelfs al gereed, terwijl wij ruim voor inchecktijd aanwezig waren.
Zéker voor The Golden Gate kiezen, als je op zoek bent naar een fijne plek om te onverdachten in Antwerpen.
Sofie was erg vriendelijk, ze had wat tips om Antwerpen te verkennen en was heel flexibel met het inchecken en de sleutel. De kamer was schoon en netjes, we hebben een fijn verblijf gehad!

Nous avons passé un très agréable séjour chez Dietrich et Sofie !
L’appartement est très bien placé, dans une rue très calme et facilement accessible.
Dietrich est très sympathique, il nous a même communiqué de bonnes adresses.
Dietrich et Sofie sont très agréables et ont fait preuve de jolies attentions !
Nous reviendrons avec plaisir !

Great place, well located close to the station but also walking distance to the old town centre. Really excellent layout meant that the private room felt like its own "Entire Home".  Dietrich was super nice and helped us checked us in even though we arrived later than we expected. Overall an excellent stay!
Kamer is proper. Mooie locatie lekker stil. Wij zijn hartelijk ontvangen alles is op loop afstand richting  centrum Antwerpen. Ideaal om tot rust te komen.
We waren heel erg tevreden met de voorziening en de gastvrijheid. Zeker aan te raden!

De airbnb van Dietrich en Sofie is in één woord: geweldig! Er is nagedacht over de inrichting, die erg tof is. Er is zelfs een mogelijkheid om je eigen koffie te maken, waarvoor je eerst de bonen moet malen. Heel leuk om te doen! Het bed ligt heerlijk, waardoor je goed kunt uitrusten voor een nieuwe dag in deze prachtige stad :) Daarnaast zijn Dietrich en Sofie super gastvrij, wat het verblijf helemaal afmaakte. Een échte aanrader wanneer je in Antwerpen bent!

Als je dicht in het centrum wil zitten maar wel een rustige airbnb wil in Antwerpen dan is dit een top adres! De studio is mooi ingericht, schoon en er is weinig overlast. wij hebben een fijn verblijf in Antwerpen gehad!

Nette kamer met eigen ingang en badkamer vlak bij het station. We waren eerder dan inchecktijd in Antwerpen, maar het was gelukkig geen probleem om onze koffers alvast te brengen. Het was zelfs zo dat Dietrich en Sophie de kamer al klaar hadden toen we aankwamen zodat we eerder konden inchecken, echt top! Daarnaast hadden ze nog tips voor in de stad, helaas zijn we aan de meeste niet toegekomen, maar zullen deze zeker onthouden voor een volgende keer.

Dietrich & Sofie are great hosts. They left the key for us in a café nearby so we could decide for our own when to check-in. They even moved their car for us so we could park in the spot right in front of the house. The guestroom is beautiful and clean. Unfortunately we didn't use the coffee maker but we read in the comments of the guestbook that it's definitely worth a try :-)

You have your own private studio, with your own bathroom and a small patio. The room is light, clean, and beautifully decorated. Dietrich and Sofie left a list with nice places in the area (coffee, dinner, breakfast, etc.). Also, you can make your own coffee with a french press. Its quite, no noise at night. Nice neighbourhood.

Dietrich & Sofie are very welcoming and the place was perfect.

I recommend it !
Ons verblijf hier was perfect! Leuke kamer met een toffe inrichting. Geweldig om Antwerpen te ontdekken!
It was a pleasent stay in your lovely apartment. Totally recommended that place!

Wat een paradijsje midden in het mooie Antwerpen! We ontmoetten alleen Dietrich, die uiterst vriendelijk was en er werd snel gereageerd op onze berichtjes. De kamer is sfeervol, prachtig ingericht en heel schoon. We hebben heerlijk geslapen in het zachte bed en genoten van al het moois om ons heen. Ontzettend bedankt voor jullie gastvrijheid, ik ga dit adresje zeker tippen aan vrienden die een weekendje naar Antwerpen willen!

Very cosy snug room with own private entrance and bathroom. Bed was extremely comfortable.
Would definitely recommend staying here as a base to explore Antwerp from.
Very good communication and stylish details made this stay very nice:)
Clean room perfect for a night's sleep.
Fijn ontvangen, Dietrich kwam ons zelf nog even gedag zeggen omdat hij ons graag wilde ontmoeten. Wat een oprechte gastvrijheid!! Hele nette, rustige kamer. Fijn bed en fijne douche!

It was a very nice time in the beautiful accommodation from Dietrich and Sofie!
We really enjoyed our time in Antwerp. The accommodation is in a perfect location near to the central station (which is the most beautiful in the world I guess)!
From there you can reach all areas easy by foot. The room was quiet and very clean. The check in and - out were very easy!

If we will come back we will choose your accommodation again!

Nice private place, almost like a hotel room. Super quiet. If you like soft beds this is for you :) Dietrich is a barista and provides facilities to make coffee in the mornings. Two small caveats: (a) there are not really a lot of breakfast options in the area if you've got to be out early and (b) the room was moist like a mountain shelter in rainy weather -- hope they'll fix this by adding a dehumidifier or something soon ...
Heel mooie en erg nette kamer. Vlotte communicatie met de vriendelijke eigenaars. Aanrader!

Dietrich & Sofie zijn super attent en heel makkelijk te bereiken via (Hidden by Airbnb) .

Not to complain (since we gain nothing) but for a more accurate advertisement for future guests who would like to stay. We just communicated these issues and the host called me to inform me that if I don’t like the place how it is, we can look for another one, instead of apologizing, thanking for the “help” and started to be rude stating that we were just bad guests wanting to only complain.

She then told us that we are over the top and should have taken a hotel instead. While the rules of Airbnb clearly say that you need to provide for the amount of people and the length of their stay, everything that you list in the advertisement. So we just apologized to not make things worse, noticing that she was emotional and took everything personal.
She reacted very emotionally to everything we communicated.
As an advice, as shown in reviews, she already had few bad experiences with guests and if she is still dishonest with what was advertised, I would keep looking for another one. If you end up choosing this appartment, I would limit to only “urgent” communication with her to avoid having our same experience.

Ik kan Marleen's appartement zeker aanbevelen voor een ontspannen en prettig verblijf in Antwerpen.

Before we begin this review, I would like to take a moment to say that our time in Antwerpen was absolutely amazing. Antwerpen is such a a nice, beautiful city. The people are so kind. Only the traffic is horrible, and the way that Belgium citizens drive isn’t exactly what we’re used to over in Holland. But that’s just a side note!

The apartment was excellent and had no huge drawbacks. It felt very spacious and is certainly large enough to accommodate 2 people. The listing shows the apartment can accommodate over 10 persons, don’t do it. You’ll get cramped up and there’s not many space to eat or relax.

The kitchen has nothing to improve, it has enough resources. Coffee is included and free to use, same goes for tea! Every appliance functioned like it should. As of hygiene, there’re no huge improvements to be made.

The bathroom is certainly not the “jewel" of the mansion. It gets the job done and is very clean. The floor can be quite slippery. Lights could be a bit brighter. Bedroom felt great and spacious and left nothing to be desired. A few points off improvement, there’s a lot of dust and dirt underneath the bedframes. We haven’t experienced any negative situations with it, but there’s a quite loud AC unit just outside the window. But the noise is not that awful. The living is cozy and felt very charming, you can sit by the windows and have a great view of the busy street below. If you love to, the heating can get very warm. For al those cold winter days.

Our experience has been awesome and had a great time! The apartment is an absolute marble. Very good value for and great price!

We would like to thank Willem and Luca for hosting such a great apartment and would recommend this cozy flat to everyone.
Roomy apartment in an excellent location.

Top locatie aan de rand van het centrum, je bent zo op de grote markt. Goed ontbijt is vlak bij en je loopt ook zo naar de voetgangerstunnel onder de schelde.

Communicatie met Luca en Willem ging prima, stipt op tijd aanwezig met de sleutels en en ook heel handige informatie over de parkeergelegenheden.

Enige minpuntje was dat de aankleding van het appartement wat sober was.
Host friendliness, good and central location. I only stayed one night but enjoyed it!
Great place!

Very friendly and wonderful host! Great location being close to both the city central and harbor areas. Very comfortable beds, and flexible options for sleeping if you have a larger group, mattresses available that can be put in the main room, or else the bedroom sleeps 5.

My stay at Willem’s place was great from start to finish. They were so accommodating with check-in and checked me in at the earliest time possible as I got an early flight in. My check-in host, Kobe, was also amazing. He was so friendly and even told me some of the best places to check out for food and drink in Antwerp!

The apartment was spotless when I arrived and the location is fantastic: only a 5 minute walk from the metro that can take you to pretty much any station! I would highly recommend anyone who is looking for a place to stay in Antwerp to stay here, or in any other apartment of Willem’s that’s available. You won’t find another place to stay in Antwerp that beats the price, quality and location that this apartment has!

Location wise it’s absolutely perfect. A quiet street, convenient and close to many hotspots, and I (young woman, traveling alone) felt safe in the area. Check-in with one of Luca’s colleagues was easy and quick, check-out was even easier. The bed I slept in was comfortable.

Sadly, the apartment wasn’t clean. I’m convinced that it hadn’t been cleaned before my stay. I even found a used q-tip on a bathroom shelf.
Other dirty aspects: dead mosquito bodies on the walls (and even curtains), lots of dust, and especially the living room floor hadn’t been mopped in what seemed like forever (slippery and dirty floor, footprints all over).

If the cleanliness of the apartment would be improved, I'd be happy to return, but based on my current experience I wouldn't go here again.

We had such a great stay in Antwerp and would definitely consider coming back for another visit in this beautiful, cosy flat :)!
The location of the apartment is just simply AWESOME! We were able to reach everything (museums, restaurants, our parking spot, etc.) within a few minutes of walking! Another pleasant surprise was the fact that the host provided everything we needed for a great stay - a microwave and coffee machine, towels, bed linen, even shampoo and conditioner (and so much more)! Also, although we were quite late for our chek in (different than anticipated by us), our chek in host was not annoyed about this but waited patiently until we finally arrived at the flat and explained everything very nicely.
The only thing that maybe could be improved: The apartment could be a bit cleaner - specifically the floor and the bathroom area. Also, the apartment description on the Airbnb website says, that there are no surveillance cameras on the property. A"House Rules" sheet, however, said, that there are in fact hidden cameras in the hallways and outside the building (but not whithin the flat) that would constantly monitor visitors / residents. Also, there are very strict rules concerning all visitors (extra people that are not on the reservation are never allowed in; Also, not for "a short visit" or to "quickly use the toilet"), which were a little disappointing for us (we were visiting my cousin and wanted to invite her in). If you break these rules, your reservation and stay can be cancelled immediately without a refund and depending on what happened a fine can be charged.
But overall, we had a great stay and are very thankful for being able to have stayed in this awesome apartment! Clear recommendation!

Stylish and outstanding apartments (we had use of both for 5 guests) and used one of the apartments to meet, and have breakfast,Dinner etc. Had plenty of space for all guests in one kitchen/Lounge(one street entrance, 2 self contained apartments). Is in easy walking distance from Station and main attractions (circa 20minutes). The apartments are stylishly decorated that give a warm atmosphere and can certainly recommend.

We rented both of Klaartje's apartments for our four night stay in Antwerp for our family and friend (two couples and a single) and had a wonderful time. The apartments are beautiful and modern, and very clean. We had everything we needed in terms of amenities in the apartment, and in the close surrounding area there is a great cheese shop, deli, supermarket, Panos quick pastry shop and laundry, among others. When we were there there was a transit strike so we really appreciate how well located Klaartje's place was to almost everything we wanted to do, museums, restaurants and the train station were walking distance or a very short cab ride. Klaartje herself is awesome. We had an issue with our originally planned accommodation, and I contacted her the afternoon we arrived. She offered to have us come over immediately to drop off our luggage while she cleaned following the guests who had just departed. She couldn't have been nicer. For those travelling with a smaller group, each apartment is separate and private and can be locked. For us using both, it was very easy to move between apartments so we could be one group when we wanted to be. I highly recommend Klaartje's place.

Super verblijf gehad in Antwerpen in een mooi huis met een prachtig terras. Ontvangst was ook super en lekker genoten van het huis en de ligging op loopafstand van het centrum

Bij aankomst lag er al wat lekkers in de koelkast. Heerlijke ruimte voor 6 personen. Grote slaapkamers,  ruime badkamer en heerlijke keuken. Ideaal voor een weekend weg met de familie!

Tolle Unterkunft, mit Garten, sauber und liebevoll eingerichtet. Der Kühlschrank war für das erste Frühstück gefüllt und Yannick war immer Ansprechpartner. Leider fehlte noch unserer Meinung nach, kleine Info zu Antwerpen,wie sonst immer in den Unterkünften.

We spent four great days in Antwerp. Yannick's house is situated in a beautiful, quiet area and offers everything you need for a short holiday. In the closer surroundings you can find some nice bars and restaurants as well as various supermarkets, bakers, etc.. The living and dining area of the house is spacious and beautiful. The beds in all bedrooms are very comfortable. The bathroom is well equipped and huge, while the toilet is tiny. The communication with Yannick was always very good and uncomplicated, as was the check-in via the key box. We would choose the place again at any time. Thank you very much.

A small drawback: Unfortunately, the outdoor area was not usable because it was very overgrown and dirty. However, as the weather was quite changeable, this is not included in the rating.
Fijn huis en goede gastheer.
Yannick should be example for all the other landlords. He was amazing and treated us like a family members. I can’t ask for better host than Yannick. I will definitely rent from him.

Wij kunnen Yannicks huis zeer aanraden. Het is ontzettend ruim, schoon en mooi ingericht, met oog voor detail. Ook heeft het appartment een fijne keuken waar je heerlijk kan koken. We hebben er met zn 6en een leuk weekendje antwerpen beleefd!

Yannick’s place is a true gem! It’s was exactly as shown in the pictures. The neighbourhood itself is nice and quiet but at the same time restaurants, bars and train station are just few minutes walk away. Yannick was quick in responding to messages and even went a further step to find us a printing shop as we needed to print out boarding passes. would totally recommend this place!
Awesome place in a nice and interesting part of town, close to some nice restaurants. The converted military hospital nearby is a nice place.

This a spacious house with 3 large bedrooms and an extra-large bathroom, well laid out living accommodation, comfortable and clean bedding,  situated in a very attractive and quiet part of the city.  There are good quality local shops and public transport is a short walk away, although we always walked into the city centre and back.  Thoroughly recommended.  We would return without hesitation.

Charming house and typical of Antwerp. Quiet green courtyard, road with little traffic. Center quickly accessible by tram. Residential area with supermarket around the corner. Enough space for six people. We were there as a family with two grown children and their friend and girlfriend. Perfekt. Big kitchen, but cooking was difficult as only one pot available. But there are so many good restaurants in Antwerp that it would be a shame to (Email hidden by Airbnb) pletely uncomplicated check-in and check-out. We had a late return flight and could leave the luggage in the house until departure. There are only common bedcover. Certainly unusual for some. We felt very comfortable.

Das Haus ist so hübsch, wie es auf den Bildern aussieht. Wir mochten die kleine Terrasse sehr und hatten das Glück, sie fast täglich nutzen zu können. Alles war sauber und schön hergerichtet. Der Kühlschrank war mit ein paar Kleinigkeiten zum Essen und Trinken gefüllt; eine sehr nette Geste! Yannick hat unglaublich schnell und hilfsbereit auf jede Frage geantwortet und war super geduldig. Wer mit dem Auto kommt: parken kann man tatsächlich (mit etwas Glück) vor der Tür. Ein Ticket für den ganzen Tag kostet 3,80 €. Das Viertel hat uns gut gefallen; die Anbindung zum Zentrum ist gut und es gibt tolle Restaurants. Ein Supermarkt ist nur ein paar Meter entfernt. Wir würden definitiv wiederkommen!

Yannick‘s house is the perfect place to stay if you like to be in a calm but very nice neighborhood. There are lots of recommended restaurants and bars in the area. Also, you’re in the middle of the City within a 10 minutes tram ride. The interior of the house is amazing. The most cozy AirBnB I‘ve ever been to. We‘ll be back to explore even more of Antwerp.
Gemütliche Unterkunft und super netter Gastgeber.
Het huis is prachtig ingericht en erg schoon. Yannick is erg gastvrij en reageert snel. Heerlijke bedden, woonkamer, badkamer en tuin. Wij hebben het heel fijn gehad!
Das Haus von Yannick hat einen ganz besonderen Charme. Es war alles sehr sauber und der Kühlschrank war sogar mit ersten Lebensmitteln gefüllt - toll.

This is one of my favourite air bnb’s that I’ve ever stayed in. Really beautiful place that immediately feels like home. The place is tucked away from the centre of Antwerp but in a lovely area and a very easy walk / bike ride to get into the centre. Couldn’t recommend it more.
Perfect voor een weekendje Antwerpen met het gezin! Ideale locatie en aangename ruimtes. Het openbaar vervoer is ook op wandelafstand waardoor je erg snel in het centrum bent. Topverblijf!

Mooi en leuk huis is een prima en rustige buurt. Leuk voor een weekend met vrienden! Alles netjes en schoon, goede bedden en grote badkamer. Parkeren is prima te doen in de buurt. Gemakkelijk te lopen naar eventuele tramhaltes

WOW. This is a beautiful house in a really cool part of town. Yannick is an outstanding host. I've stayed in several Airbnbs and this is one of my favourites. Not central - but in a lovely area that we would not have otherwise discovered - great bars and cafes nearby and it was cool to stay in an authentic, safe and welcoming part of the city. IT's not far to the touristy bits either - we walked everywhere from there.  The house is so gorgeous we ended up just staying in one evening, drinking wine and pretending it was our own home! Also immaculate and lots of thoughtful, welcoming touches.  Very comfortable - we all loved it. Thank you very, very much Yannick.
Mooi huis! Alles prima verzorgd alleen best ver van het centrum. Fijne bedden, grote badkamer en leuk gedecoreerd.

Prachtig huis in de stad Antwerpen, zeer stijlvol, ruim en mooi ingericht. Fijne bedden en de badkamer is prachtig. Superleuk dat er wat kleinigheden lagen en er zelfs boter en ontbijtbeleg is. Wij hebben echt een top weekend gehad.

I cannot say enough good things about Yannick’s place!! The beds were so comfy, the design was so lovely and peaceful, the neighborhood was a DREAM. Easy parking, cute little grocery store and great restaurants close by etc etc. But the best part was when I needed help with the something (the smoke detectors were beeping needing new batteries) she responded right away and sent someone over to fix them within 20 mins. 10/10 recommend this haven

Wij hadden het er super!
Yannick reageerde altijd snel en alles was top geregeld, van inchecken tot tips! Het huis was super leuk en erg netjes! Ik zou hier zeker nog een keer heengaan als ik in de buurt ben!
Heerlijke plek, mooi ingericht! ❤️
Het huis van Yannick is erg mooi, ruim en licht. Goede bedden. Yannick reageert snel en is erg behulpzaam. Heel prettig en dus zeker een aanrader!

Een heel mooi, proper en gezellig huis.
De communicatie met de verhuurder verliep heel vlot en snel en het inchecken is heel makkelijk. Het huis heeft alles wat je nodig hebt voor een leuk verblijf!

La maison est dans un quartier très agréable et proche des transports pour aller au centre ville. Yan nous a donné plein de bons conseils et de bonnes adresses alentours et est resté très disponible pour nos questions. Petit bémol car nous avons eu du mal à avoir de l'eau chaude correctement et nous n'avons pas trouvé la maison très propre. Aussi, ne prévoyez pas d'avoir à cuisiner car l'équipement est minimal.

Onwijs mooi huis! Met 3 stellen hadden wij genoeg ruimte. Ook de afstand naar het centrum vonden wij goed te doen. Met 30 min lopen zit je midden in het centrum. Zeker een aanrader. Daarnaast verliep het contact echt super. Leuke tips gehad voor in de omgeving. Als wij nog is naar Antwerpen gaan, komen wij zeker terug!
Prachtig en sfeervol huis op een leuke plek naast het Groen Kwartier.
Heerlijk meidenweekend gehad in dit prachtige herenpand. We kwamen niks te kort en het huis is gelegen in een prettige omgeving. We komen graag nog eens terug!
What a lovely, cosy and clean house! It’s a nice neighborhood and a 30 minute walk to the city center. I would recommend it to everyone!
seriously really nice place!

La maison a beaucoup de charme, est très spacieuse, et l’on s’y sent très bien. La maison est bien chauffée et les lits hyper confortables.  Les petites attentions en arrivant sont vraiment sympathiques. Enchantés par notre week-end, nous y reviendrions sans hésiter.
Good place
Beautiful house in a really convenient location close to the Antwerp Berchem station with everything you need and super comfy beds
Lovely place, lovely neighborhood, great communication!

The house was stylish and comfortable. Easy access via keylock. Yan had left a box of goodies for our arrival which was much appreciated. We stayed with our family of 6 adults to attend family wedding. The house was 3 storeys high. Lovely large rooms with high ceilings. Very clean. We used taxis to get around. We would definitely return when next in Antwerp.
Super stijlvol huis met goede bedden! In de keuken is alles aanwezig, erg fijn. De locatie is helemaal prima, je kunt alles lopen of dichtbij een tram pakken naar het centrum. Aanrader!
Lovely home close to all amenities in Antwerp. Highly recommended
We had a lovely stay.
Erg aan te raden! Het huis overtreft de verwachtingen en de attenties van de verhuurders zijn ongekend! Hoop nog eens terug te komen.
Beautiful, spacious ultra-design house in upcoming area. Near some great bars and restaurants and more authentic experience than staying in touristy centre.
Belle maison bien équipée et propre dans un quartier sympa à découvrir. Idéal pour un séjour familial ou entre amis.
Wij verbleven 2 dagen in Antwerpen in dit hele gezellige en royale huis. Om de hoek het Groenkwartier met meerdere restaurants en barretjes waar het heerlijk vertoeven was. Voor herhaling vatbaar.

Het huis is prachtig! de tuin geeft je de kans om even buiten te kunnen zitten als dit nodig zou zijn. Daarnaast was alles netjes en proper. Alles zag er ook geweldig uit, de inrichting was heel mooi en stijlvol.

Yan heeft een prachtig huis dat erg fijn voelt om een paar nachten in te verblijven. De locatie is goed en met de Velo fiets ben je zo in het centrum. Yan denkt goed mee, reageert snel en hield erg veel rekening met onze wensen. Top!
Top-Airbnb! zeer goede waarde voor jouw geld!
Super stijlvolle locatie!
Perfect place, great contact with host Yan. Very recommend!
Perfect house for a weekend Antwerp. Everything you need for having a cosy stay is there!
Super logement
Zeer stijlvol huis in een leuke buurt, op 10 minuten van het openbaar vervoer. Super dichtbij een velo- station waardoor we gezellig door de stad konden fietsen.
Prachtig huis op een toplocatie !

The house was clean and the location was perfect.
Host was very helpful. Very spacious rooms, beds are very comfy and the heater was working perfectly!!!
Much bigger than expected! Bathroom amazing!!
Terrace was very cute.
Just small thing that told the host already, some door handle were coming off and should definitely get fixed. No biggie but need to be done.

Will definitely come back !!!

De woning is heel mooi ingericht. De slaapkamers waren veel groter dan we verwachtte. Verder was de badkamer echt een plaatje. Zeker een aanrader als je in Antwerpen wilt verblijven. Supermarkt en station/tram op loopafstand.
Nice & cost house.
L’appartement est vraiment top, et Yan est très compréhensif
We had a great time. Lovely house, everything present to have a great werken. I will definitely return
We hebben enorm genoten van ons verblijf in Antwerpen. Het huis is ruim en charmant. De gastheer geeft veel leuke tips en is steeds bereikbaar.

Great classical style house in a peaceful residential area next to cool bars and restaurants. Easy check-in with lockbox. The rooms are spacious and clean. The house would need some clean-up for some details like the garden area that is not totally useful. Other than that great place I definitely recommend.
Ruime Airbnb en met een paar minuten ben je in het centrum. Handdoeken, wc papier en vaatdoekjes zitten er niet in dus meenemen.
Lieber  Yan, wir hatten ein super Wochenende in deinem schönen Haus, vielen Dank!
Great, spacious home in a great location. Easy self-check in. Rooms are nicely decorated and the beds are very comfy.
Yan’s apartment was incredible. Very spacious, well designed with lots of light. His communication was perfect and the apartment was very clean. Would definitely recommend staying there.
Leuk authentiek huis in een leuke buurt. Goedkoop parkeren voor de deur.

Fijne uitvalsbasis om Antwerpen te verkennen! Het huis is erg groot; ruim genoeg voor 6 personen. De locatie is goed. Lopend ongeveer een half uur naar het centrum, maar met de Velo fiets (welke je aan het eind van de straat kunt huren) ben je er in 10 minuten. Er is hier en daar wat achterstallig onderhoud (loshangende stopcontacten, deurklinken die los zitten en één van de dakramen lekte na een hevige bui), maar daarentegen is het huis wel stijlvol ingericht en zijn de bedden heerlijk!

Maison très agréable et très bien située dans une rue très calme.
Yan est très réactif aux messages laissés
Nous y retournerons avec grand plaisir
Prettige communicatie!

Das alte, schmale, tiefe Stadthaus ist schön renoviert und liegt ca 3,5 km von der eigentlichen Altstadt entfernt. Um in die oberen Etage zu kommen, sind sehr steile Treppen zu erklimmen. Das Viertel, in dem das Haus liegt, ist ruhig und sicher und es sind Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nähe. Das WC ist separat und wirklich winzig. Außerdem könnten die Wasserhähne und die Nespresso-Maschine repariert / entkalkt werden. Die Betten sind sehr bequem und der Gastgeber Yan antwortet schnell auf Anfragen.
Very cozy house in an lovely city, worth the stay
We had a great time at Yan's beautiful apartment. It was clean, spacious and cosy and it is located in a great area.

Das Haus befindet sich in einer guten Nachbarschaft. Der Supermarkt ist nur 1 Minute entfernt. Nette Restaurants und Cafés sind fußläufig erreichbar. Die Ausstattung des Hauses ist gut. Die Einrichtung ist ordentlich, das Sofa bequem.
Yan war immer erreichbar und half bei unvorhergesehenen Ereignissen prompt. Wir hatten eine schöne Zeit im Haus und haben uns wohl gefühlt.
Leuk huis op goede locatie!

Compleet huis met veel ruimte en drie aparte slaapkamers. Huis leuk ingericht met smaak. Locatie is prima, op steenworp van oude militair hospitaal met mooie restaurants als the Jane, August en Standard. Voor centrum heb je tram 4 nodig op 5 minuten lopen.
Mooie, propere woning. Goede communicatie, vlotte verbinding naar alles wat je wil doen.

The house is spacious with a structure that feels part of the historic urban block, But at the same time inside the historic structure is comfortable and contemporary. We enjoyed the comfortable location which is within walking distance of the historic center of Antwerp. The neighborhood itself is relaxed quiet and renewable with several points of interest restaurants and bars. It was a pleasure and we would love to come back!
Fijne accomodatie op een toplocatie in Antwerpen!
Leuk ingericht en een hele fijne locatie. Een aanrader in Antwerpen!

Lenka is extremely welcoming and helpful. She was very proactive in giving us tips on what to do in the area and Antwerp in general, and checking that everything was ok. She was very friendly, and it was easy to contact her for any questions. She even let us use her bike for no extra costs! The apartment is in an amazing location, surrounded by many great bars and restaurants. It was also very clean and nicely decorated. I would definitely recommend this airbnb to anyone!

Goede lokatie mooi appartement met alle nodige voorzieningen. Lenka is super gastvrij en heeft goede tips.
Dus als je een weekend Antwerpen wilt ervaren is dit the place to stay

Lenka’s apartment was perfect for us: tidy, spacious, very comfortable (very large bed and nice shower), equipped with all things you would need on traveling, decorated with beautiful paintings and plants, close to the city center, with free parking lot and quite some good bars and restaurants nearby. She also prepared some Belgien beers upon our arrival. Lenka was away for work when we arrived, but the communication with her was very easy. She sent us clear and helpful tips per email beforehand and responded emails very timely also during our stay. 

Thank you very much for everything Lenka. We really enjoyed our stay in Antwerpen!

Eindelijk weer een Airbnb adres waar iemand ook echt woont. Heel fijn. Geen uniforme Ikea inrichting zonder persoonlijke toevoeging maar mooie kunst aan de muur en veel persoonlijke details. Opgeteld bij een super vriendelijke, flexibele en gastvrije verhuurder en het feit dat dit huis in de leukste wijk van Antwerpen ligt een absolute aanrader. En dan heb ik het nog niets eens over het fantastische bed gehad en ook niet over hoe schoon het huis was.  Kortom: niet twijfelen maar boeken.
Great apartment!

It is definitely recommended to all coming visitors. The flat locates in a quiet neighbour and near to the central part of Antwerp. The room are very lovely with stylish decoration and everything you need for loving. Lenka gave us a warm greetings introducing the flat, traffic and great places to visit.

This is the host's own home, and so it is very much a 'lived in' apartment with many of her personal effects around. This means that all the required facilities are available, including a well equipped kitchen. I liked a lot of the art work that the host has decorated her home with, and the furnishings were very comfortable. Extremely comfortable bed, and a brilliant shower in a large bathroom.

Place is easy to locate, lots of restaurant , supermarket etc close-by.
Apartment is neat and clean with most amenities.

I generally leave even 5 star hotels with recommendations to improve upon. For this flat I have none. It's perfect in its own way.
Felt like coming home
dank voor het fijne verblijf! de ruimte was super schoon en gezellig en het bed geweldig! en een super locatie!
très bien placé pour les musées, dans un environnement calme, appartement spacieux et bien équipé.

Alles fijn! De goede zorgen en bereikbaarheid van Lenka om goed aan te komen, de voelbare gastvrijheid als je er bent, de locatie van het appartement (zeker als je gebruik maakt van de stadsfietsen). Absoluut een aanrader als uitvalsbasis voor een bezoek aan Antwerpen.
Amazing hospitality and amazing location. The place has what you need and more. Bus and tram stations are all a walking distance from the apartment. That’s definitely my go-to-place in Antwerp.
Nice appartement next to the center by foot. Big parking and facilities next to the flat

Lenka's apartment is beautiful, spacious and clean. It is very conveniently located, within walking distance from bars, restaurants and all main attractions in Antwerpen. And if you come by car, there is a free public parking just 2 minutes away. We didn't meet Lenka personally but the communication was very easy. We would definitely recommend it!

Lenka’s apartment was ideal for our 2 night stay in Antwerp. It was large and well laid out for 2 friends traveling together while still having privacy. Everything we needed and most importantly- king sized tempurpedic bed is amazing! Best sleep of our trip and much appreciated after days of moving around traveling. I must add that the ease of communication with Lenka and her friendly and kind responses were the best I’ve received so far in Belgium and Airband b in general. She was truly welcoming, kind and seems like an all around awesome person.
Bien situé. Gentillesse et réactivité.

The place was very clean and tidy and equipped with everything we could wish for. Communicating with Lenka was always very easy, quick and friendly. To make it short: Thanks to Lenka we had a perfect stay in Antwerp!
Lovely spacious ground-floor  flat in a great neighbourhood,  I throughly recommend!
Nice flat, nice area, well supplied, local amenities are good. great communication. What more could you look for
This is great place for a visit to answer, it's cosy, central, lots of bars and restaurants close by.

Bright, modern and spotless clean apartment in the historic center of Antwerp between Groenplaats and Grote Markt. Checkin and Checkout also went super smooth. Note that you reach apartment and bed via a country typical steep staircase - an ideal option for all travellers without mobility limitations. Thank you Leentje for making our weekend trip a success! We will return...
Perfecte ruimte en heerlijke airco! Leuke dagen gehad
Prima
Top appartement! Midden in het centrum.
Aanrader!

L'appartement est situé en plein coeur de la vielle ville d'Anvers et est très accessible. Plusieurs parkings à proximité permettent de garer votre véhicule. Il est très lumineux, propre et neuf. La prise des clés est trés simple par une boite à clés sécurisée.
Il correspond bien à la description faite sur le site.
J'ai cependant 3 déceptions :
il s'agit d'un logement professionnel (oubliez donc l'objectif initial de AirB&B, le charme de loger chez quelqu'un, les conseils pratiques, etc)
Le Tramway passe aux pieds de l'appartement et s'entend même fenêtres fermées (heureusement le propriétaire fourni des boules quies)
Il n'y a pas de cloisons entre le salon, la douche, et même les WC... ce qui est génant si l'on est plusieurs !
The apartment was fantastic, very close to the city centre. There is a shop, a number of different bars and restaurants 1 minute away which made our stay very easy and fun! Would recommend.
Top locatie en super mooi appartement!
mooie locatie midden in stad
My father came to visit and stayed at Leen’s place. Ideally located (I should know I live round the corner...), clean and comfortable.

Stylish and very well located studio. Best suited to the most sure-footed (and sober!) of us. Very well equiped, every aspect of the stay has been properly thought through. I came for a 5 days conference and found everything at my fingertips. I enjoyed my stay in Antwerpen enormously.

Très beau logement, situé non loin du Meir, moderne et confortable. On y trouve de tout pour passer un petit séjour un Anvers, y compris des produits de base comme du gel douche, shampoing, café, thé, etc. Un four à micro-ondes, et ce serait juste parfait !
Le bruit du tram dans la rue n’était pas gênant en ce qui me concerne, j’ai très bien dormi.
L’arrivée avec boîte à clés est très pratique si vous arrivez tard le soir. Leentje a envoyé les instructions bien à l’avance, et c’était très facile d’y accéder.
Notez que les escaliers pour accéder au studio (2e étage) sont assez étroits. Le lit en mezzanine, accessible par une échelle et assez proche du plafond, pourrait ne pas convenir à tout le monde. Les fenêtres sont grandes, certes, mais seules des tentures opaques permettent de briser la vue (logement en coin et vis-vis avec tous les logements à proximité)... N’oubliez pas de tirer les tentures quand vous prenez votre douche. ;-)
Hormis ces petits détails, je recommande ce logement très confortable. Je le garde dans mon carnet d’adresses !

在Antwerp住的这一间公寓我真的很喜欢，首先他的位置很好，距离Antwerp最主要的几个景点像是大教堂和广场以及海边都很近，可以说是一步之遥，到了晚上，楼下很近的位置就会有当地人喝酒吃东西趴体的地方，非常的方便，也适合我这个夜猫子。而且有很多扇窗子，看出去景观也不错。距离火车站会稍微远一点，但是楼下就有有轨电车，大概2欧左右就可以直达火车站也是很方便，只不过有轨电车的声音会比较大，早晚会影响一点点睡眠，建议对声音敏感的旅客慎重，不过房间内有提供耳塞可以用一下，我自己是对声音无所谓的。整体的装修风格也是我喜欢的，厨房的设施餐具很齐全。房间本来的设计是有一个小夹层然后做了一个床，感觉上来下去的比较麻烦，而且睡起来也觉得有点压抑，所以我两天都睡在了沙发床上面，也是很舒服的，而且早上可以被阳光唤醒，感觉很好。总体上很喜欢这个公寓，性价比很高，下次来Antwerp还会住这边。
Top locatie!! , precies zoals op de foto en de verhuurder reageert snel. Ik zeg doen :)

I loved staying here. Clean, cool apartment. Location could not be better. Step outside and you’re in the heart of Antwerp. Check-in was easy. Host was great and really quick to respond to anything. Thank you!
Echt een geweldig verblijf gehad! Super locatie, heel netjes en super gezellig appartementje. Oprecht zo leuk dat ik al voor een 2e keer heb geboekt haha
Perfect spot to use as Home base! There are stairs and the loft bed is not for the claustrophobic, but I found it a spacious place for just me.
Wij hebben erg genoten tijdens ons verblijf in het stijlvolle appartement. Echt een aanrader!
Favoriete verblijf plek in Antwerpen! Geweldige locatie, super schoon en leuk appartement.
Leuke en nette studio op super plek om Antwerpen te verkennen!
I really enjoyed my stay in Leentje’s apartment. The location is really good, and it was super clean.

Heerlijke ruimte, prima bed, keurig en schoon.
Het is even wennen aan het tram geluid vroeg in de ochtend maar prima te doen (en ik ben lastig qua geluiden). WiFi was minder maar had ik niet nodig. Fantastische locatie om Antwerpen te bezoeken!
Leuk appartement, centraal gelegen, Makkelijk inchecken, netjes.
Great location! The ladder up to the loft bed may be hard for less mobile people.
Fijne communicatie! Reageert snel en heeft goede tips!
Very good !
Stijlvol schoon compact appartement midden in het centrum. Snel en prettig contact; Leentje denkt mee en geeft goede suggesties voor restaurantjes. Aanrader!
Bedankt voor het fijne verblijf in Antwerpen. De locatie is super en de woning beschikt over alles wat nodig is.

Appartement op een top locatie!! Midden in het centrum van Antwerpen. Ik zou het zo weer boeken. Het is wel een appartement voor jonge/mobiele mensen vanwege de steile trappen naar het appartement en vanwege de hoogslaper, die een beetje moeilijk kan zijn om in te komen. Maar dat hebben wij niet als een probleem ervaren. Het appartement was ook schoon en netjes. Leentje reageerde ook snel en met duidelijke instructies. Ik raad deze plek aan.
Super mooie locatie/appartement. Alles was schoon en we hebben geen last gehad van de trams.
Es war ein wirklich toller Aufenthalt ! Super tolle Lage im Zentrum.

If you are visiting Antwerp solo or as a couple, this is THE place to stay. Leentje's apartment is beautiful, amazingly located and has everything you need for a city break or a longer visit. The location is very central, a few minutes walk from the central square of the city (Grote Markt), several shops nearby and great public transport links. At the same time it is quiet because it is in a side street, there is practically no street noise. Because the house is old and the apartment is on the ground floor, you will occasionally hear the upstairs neighbours. They are actually quiet but because of the way these houses are built, it still sounds like elephants walking around sometimes - this will probably not be an issue for most people though, especially for short stays. The bedroom does not have a window (there is some light coming from one corner of the ceiling). This does make it dark etc. but the advantage is that there is really no noise from the outside. Being a ground floor apartment, the whole place is a bit dark and cold compared to other apartments, this might be an advantage or disadvantage depending on what you are looking for. It was great during the summer heatwave while I was there (most building in Belgium do not have air conditioning) but would probably not recommend it for the winter for someone who does not like cold.
There is a washing machine, however apparently it is common practice in Antwerp to take clothes to laundrettes to wash and many people do not seem to have a washing machine at home. Accordingly, Ann suggested that I could take my clothes to the laundrette instead of washing them in the apartment. To me this was very strange, where I come from, it would be considered a huge inconvenience to take clothes outside the house to wash them and especially now with Covid around, I think many people do not feel comfortable to use a laundrette. Anyway, I guess for Belgians it seems normal to use a laundrette and for me and many other people it does not.
Apart from these minor issues, I felt comfortable in the apartment and found everything I needed. If you are looking for a place to stay in the center of Antwerp, you will probably not be disappointed in this one.
