Wij hebben een heerlijk verblijf gehad in Antwerpen. Het appartement was groot genoeg, gezellig ingericht, schoon en rustig gelegen maar toch midden in het centrum van Antwerpen.
Sandra is een zeer gastvrije dame en het in- en uitchecken was zeer flexibel. Dank Sandra, wij hebben genoten!

Sandra and Michael,
Thanks for hosting us in your fabulous apartment. We loved your style. The flat was very comfortable and cheerful with everything we could have needed. We couldn’t have been more central. We fell in love with Antwerp: so many cool bars, cafes, restaurants and shops - and especially the people. Much more to do and see than we had expected! Would definitely stay again with you and recommend your flat and the city.
Excellent location and welcome at this apartment from Sandra and Michael. Great for exploring the city and for the restaurants and cafes nearby.    Loved it.
Trivelig og reint.  Midt i « smørøyet» i Antwerpen .  Anbefales

Die Wohnung ist super und genau so wie beschrieben. Sandra war nicht da, aber ihre Mama hat sich um alles super gekümmert. Ansonsten war die Kommunikation mit Sandra super und sehr schnell.
Als einziger Punkt war es schwierig für unsere Tochter einzuschlafen, da ihr Zimmer zur Tramlinien nach Aussen lag und diese sehr laut war. Ansonsten alles super! Ganz lieben Dank an Sandra!

We stayed at Sandra's place while visiting my relatives in Antwerp. The location is simply perfect: right in the old town, on several different tram/bus routes. The apartment was spotlessly clean and tastefully decorated. The kitchen had everything we needed, and more. The bedroom is at the back of the apartment, so it's quiet and the queen size bed was super comfortable! Sandra replied to messages instantly and was extremely helpful before and during our stay. We will definitely be staying here again!

Central and well maintained with everything you need. Hosts were available and friendly. We had a great time exploring Antwerp by bike, and city rentals were just outside. Would definitely stay here again.

This apartment has a convenient location with sights within easy walking distance.  It has all the amenities you need for a great stay and the hosts are warm and welcoming. Great shower, comfy bed and an inviting environment.
Awesome place, I think you can’t be mir central and Sandra is a very kind host
Very nice stay in the middle of Antwerp! Perfect hosts and location
Je recommande vivement. Emplacement de rêve.

The apartment is absolutely beautiful and in a perfect location, close to main shopping area and transit. Many hidden gems in the neighborhood to be found.

The apartment is easy to get to from Antwerp Central via the tram, and Michael came to greet us and hand us the keys when we arrived. Very quick and easy communication with Sandra to coordinate our arrival. Overall a great stay and would definitely recommend!

Guests can expect a very clean apartment and a responsive hostess. The apartment is light and bright - even at night in the living room. The windows in the photo have no curtains or shades. The bedroom can be made dark. The appliances all worked well and were fairly easy to figure out for someone from the USA. The furniture was comfortable, and the rooms are spacious. The sheets and towels were clean and felt good. We had the bad luck to be there the 3 nights workers were repaving the street below and down a block. When the tram went by the wheels made a terrible shrieking sound on the bare tracks. Hopefully that work is done now. Sandra also had bad luck in that the upstairs apartment had a water leak that affected the electricity in her apartment's bathroom. Fortunately she provided a good light for us to use. Obviously these two problems she could not have foreseen and she did her best to make us feel welcome and comfortable.
The location is fabulous. We walked from the Central Station with our luggage - approx. 20 minutes. Grote Market is less than 5 minutes walk. There are so many shops and restaurants, it was difficult to choose a place for dinner. The huge grocery store under the plaza was less than 10 minutes walk.
Great location. Clean and stylish apartment.

Eine sehr gemütliche Wohnung mitten im Herzen von Antwerpen, sehr schön eingerichtet und mit einer sehr gut ausgestatteten Küche. Die wichtigsten Sehenswürdigkeiten sind alle leicht zu Fuß zu erreichen und es gibt etliche Restaurants, Cafes und Geschäfte in der Nähe. Sandra ist eine sehr nette, sympathische und hilfreiche Gastgeberin (sie und ihre Familie wohnt ganz in der Nähe). Trotz der zentralen Lage und der am Haus vorbeifahrenden Tram ist das große Schlafzimmer, das zu einem Innenhof geht, sehr ruhig. Sie ist die Wohnung insgesamt eine echte Wohlfühloase zu einem fairen Preis!
Perfect place, in the nicest part of town.

Die Wohnung von Sandra ist der perfekte Ausgangspunkt  für einen Städtetrip- zentral gelegen und super gemütlich. Wir haben uns sehr wohl gefühlt und können die Unterkuft definitiv weiter empfehlen. Die Kommunikation mit Sandra war sehr unkompliziert und freundlich. Besser geht es nicht.

Wir hatten einen super Aufenthalt in Sandra's Wohnung. Die Lage ist perfekt, um alles zu Fuß zu erreichen. Sandra hat sich sehr um uns bemüht, uns auch schon vor der Anreise mit Tipps versorgt. Die Wohnung ist sehr hübsch und wir können sie sehr empfehlen.
Sandra’s apartment is very charming and is in a great part of town. Close to everything! She was very responsive to our needs. Would highly recommend!
Very nice host. The flat is very central. All good
nous remercions Sandra et son ami pour leur accueil ! l'appartement très confortable et bien situé

Sandra, has a clear passion for hosting. Her apartment is modern, clean and beautifully decorated. Well equipped kitchen and wash facilities. A warm welcome from her family. The location is perfect for exploring the older posts of the city with plenty of places to eat.

Great place in the center of antwerp.
Sparkling clean and a joy to stay (even for families.

The location of this very stylish and comfortable apartment is ideal for exploring Antwerp. All major attractions and interesting areas are within an easy walk and there are many nice cafés and restaurants close by. While the street in the front can be a bit noisy at times, the bedroom lies in the back and is very quiet. The apartment is spotless and very well equipped even for a longer stay. We were greeted warmly by Sandra, who had already provided us with valuable information about the city before our arrival. Very recommendable!

Sandra's apartment was like our home away from home. Roomy, clean, so comfortable,  great amenities (including good coffee!). It is perfectly located in a beautiful part of Antwerp and walking distance to all attractions. Sandra is so lovely, it was like meeting an old friend. We were so reluctant to leave, can't wait to come back. Liz
Leuke locatie!
A fine place to stay while in town for a conference.

We had a great stay at Sandra's apartment. Well equipped apartment in the center of town. Our 1 year old loved the toys. We would definitely come back. We left something in the apartment and Sandra was kind enough to notify us and send it to us. Many thanks!

Sandra’s place was beautiful, with huge windows, wood floors, and modern decor. It had a well appointed kitchen, a very comfortable bed, and light blocking shades in the bedroom. Sandra was wonderfully flexible about my arrival and departure time, allowing me to leave my bags after checking out. She gave great recommendations for places to eat and things to see un Antwerpen. The location was also great, within walking distance of various shops and cafes. I was especially touched by Sandra’s help with getting to the Central train station after my stay: she actually walked with me most of the way there, helping me to carry my bags. If I visit Antwerpen in the future, which I’d love to do, I would definitely stay at Sandra’s place again, if available.
Een betere locatie ga je niet vinden! Daarnaast een werkelijk fantastisch appartement met excellente gastvrijheid. Wij komen zonder twijfel terug!

A very stylish and comfortable apartment located right in the historic centre of this atmospheric and friendly city.  Sandra and Michael were great hosts and seem to have thought of everything to ensure the most pleasant of stays. They also provided lots of information and customised advice and were genuinely keen for us to make the best of our break.  Thank you.
Perfect location, very friendly host and cool apartment.

Wij, moeder en dochter, hebben geweldig genoten van dit mooie, verzorgde, gezellige, complete en schone appartement dat ook nog eens op een super locatie in de stad is. Sandra en Michael hadden allerlei  attenties in het appartement en goede tips voor ons bezoek aan Antwerpen. We voelden ons super welkom! We komen zeker terug!

Our stay in Antwerp at Sandra’s place was so lovely! She was really welcoming and accommodating, especially when I’d forgotten to book for the 3rd person staying! The little personal touches in the apartment made it all the more cozy, such as the handwritten recommendations for local places to get mussels after we’d asked.

The apartment is in a great location, so close to many great pubs in the old part of Antwerp. I cannot recommend staying here, enough!

Great place. 2nd time
I visited and will come back next year again! Tnx Sandra!
Trevlig lägenhet med perfekt läge i staden.

Ons verblijf in Sandra’s appartement was super! Het appartement ligt centraal (prima te lopen vanaf station en dichtbij leuke cafés en restaurants) en is prettig om te verblijven. Contact met Sandra verliep soepel en snel! We zouden zeker terugkomen.

We had a great time here. We were traveling with our 10 month old daughter and can recommend the facility for families. Toys, a baby bed as well as baby furniture are available. That was amazing. The location around the apartment has a lot to offer and is right in the center.
Great communication throughout booking and stay. Ideally located apartment

Tout s’est bien passé chez Sandra. Deco et petites attentions agréables. Literie très confortable, et situation exceptionnelle. Le seul bémol est qu’une des deux chambres donne sur une rue bruyante : un tram passe juste devant et les voitures sur les pavés. Hormis cela, nous avons été ravis de notre séjour!
Eine sehr schöne, geräumige Wohnung im Herzen von Antwerpen. Es ist sehr vieles fußläufig zu erreichen. Die Wohnung haben wir sehr sauber vorgefunden. Alles funktionierte.
Super séjour chez Sandra et Michael !! Tout était parfait avec des petites attentions qui font plaisir ☺️
Zuckersüße kleine Wohnung im Herzen von Antwerpen. Cooler Stil, genau wie auf den Fotos.

Świetna lokalizacja w samym sercu starego miasta w Antwerpii, bardzo ładny rejon zresztą, zabytkowy, wręcz jakby z pocztówki. Mieszkanie w samym sobie wielkie, piękne, czyste i gustownie udekorowane. Udogodnienia na najwyższym poziomie. Gospodarze bardzo mili. Polecam, i dziękuję Sandrze oraz jej mężu za takie otóż warunki wysoko ponad średnią AirBnb!
A very great place to stay.  Joyful experience.
This is a lovely, light-filled apartment, perfectly located for exploring Antwerp. Sandra and Michael were very welcoming, communicative and flexible - recommended!

In een woord: woow! Geweldige locatie. Weg van het toeristische, drukke en ‘goedkopere’ Antwerpen... Fijne kroegjes en restaurants om de hoek, letterlijk! Via Via Reiscafe is echt een aanrader. Elfde Gebod een must! Fijn en lekker Mexicaans eten kun je bij Caramba... we hebben genoten.
Wel een klein minpuntje: het is erg gehorig in appartement. Als je aan straatkant wilt slapen, tip om oordopjes mee te nemen. Tram en verkeer begint vroeg en eindigt laat... Communicatie met Sandra verliep soepel en prettig!
Sehr schönes Appartement geschmackvoll eingerichtet. Sehr zentral gelegen. Ruhiges Schlafzimmer nach hinten. Perfekt

Superfijne en met veel stijl ingerichte plek op een perfecte, gezellige locatie midden in hartje Antwerpen. Het contact met Sandra is zeer snel, uitgesproken vriendelijk en attent. Een aanrader - wij komen er graag weer!

Perfect place for a weekend in Antwerp! Sandra is very quick in answering and the friendly neighbor was there quickly for the key exchange. Very informative email with tips on the current corona rules, and the general information of arrival and stay in Antwerp!
Sandra and her husband are simply adorable, and the apartment is simply perfect to see the city! Definitely recommended!

Sandra is a great host and very kind person, featuring all kind of information and being interested to get to feel yourself comfortable. Her personalized service is also visible in her flat, that provides everything you need. The photos are 100% real.

Other highlight: the very central position of the flat, where you can explore the whole city from and where the best restaurants and bars are just around the corner.

Ambos fueron muy amables el Señor nos recibió y nos espero durante dos horas, muchas gracias por eso. Nos sentimos como en casa, todo estaba cerca de la Gran Plaza de Amberes y el centro, muchos restaurantes y bares para comer en familia y tomarse algo con sus amigos. Volvería sin duda alguna y lo recomiendo, También me dejaron salir un poco mas tarde de la hora de check out. DE  MEJOR IMPOSIBLE. MUCHAS GRACIAS, LOS RECOMIENDO...
Leuk, ruim appartement dat zeker aan alle verwachtingen voldoet. Helemaal zoals op de foto’s. Zeer centraal gelegen en toffe hosts, die vlot zijn in hun communicatie met oog voor attente details! :-)

Ons verblijf in dit appartement was supergoed. De locatie is fantastisch en in het appartement is alles aanwezig. Mooi ruim en licht. De communicatie is ook heel goed gegaan en hetzelfde geldt voor het in- en uitchecken. Ik zou dit zeker aanraden voor een leuke week/weekend/midweek in Antwerpen. Gezellige stad!

A wonderful appartement in the best district.
Don’t tell everybody, I think it’s the best place for a trip to Antwerpen ;)

Very spacious and bright (huge windows) apartment. Perfect location in the old town of Antwerp.
To be recommended.
We waren heel tevreden met ons verblijf. Het appartement is heel gezellig, mooi ingericht, super proper en heel goed geleden in het hartje van Antwerpen! Tot een volgende keer!
Appartement agréable et idéalement situé dans le centre ville :-)
Tout correspond, Sandra et son compagnon sont très rapides pour répondre aux questions, l'appartement est vraiment très bien situé au centre d'Anvers, tous les magasins nécessaires tout près !

Ondanks dat we ons nog steeds in een periode bevinden waarin corona ons leven overheerst, hadden wij toch even dat vakantiegevoel.
Zeer gezellig en stijlvol ingericht appartement. Ruim genoeg en er is werkelijk aan alles gedacht. Zowel oven, microgolf als vaatwas bijvoorbeeld. Bij lang verblijf, kan je er zelfs je was doen. Supergoed gelegen ook!
De verhouding prijs/kwaliteit zit zeer goed!

Appartement super bien situé, on peut tout faire à pieds. Très propre, joliment décoré, tout est pensé pitre être pratique. Petites attentions de l'hôte et très bonne communication. A recommander sans hésiter! :-)

Stylish, bright, clean apartment in a very central location close to all the amenities and sights in the best part of historic Antwerp. Very friendly and accommodating hosts! Thanks again for a wonderful one month stay.
Heel aangenaam verblijf op een zeer goede locatie.

My girlfriend and I booked this apartment on very short notice and that was no problem. Responses to messages very quick and very clear. The apartment was perfect for a short stay. Clean, well decorated and an absolute A location!

We had the absolute best experience at this apartment in Antwerp. The location is perfect - right in the center and close to transport. The apartment is bright and stylish. Sandra and her husband were so hospitable! They also gave great recommendations for restaurants in the neighbourhood.

A clean and comfortable flat located on a lovely historical street. It can be quite noisy in the living room and in the smaller bedroom. The check-in was a bit tricky since we had to wait in the rain. We also had some difficult exchanges with Sandra regarding access to the flat and our privacy, so we ended up being quite frustrated with this experience.

Een geweldig gaaf appartement op een zeer centrale plek in de stad. Ik heb Sandra niet persoonlijk ontmoet omdat ze op vakantie was maar zeer fijn en perfect contact gehad via de mail. De honneurs werden prima waargenomen door de buurman.
Het contract verliep erg soepel met Sandra, wij hebben haar zelf niet gezien maar desalniettemin leek het een vriendelijk persoon die ook tussendoor ervoor wilde zorgen dat alles naar wens was.
Cute appartement, great location

Sandra is the nicest, most accommodating host you could wish for. The Apartment is is the ideal place to stay if you want to discover beautiful Antwerpen. Next time we come to Belgium, we‘ll definitely try to stay here again.

l'appartement est impeccable, propreté irréprochable, déco cosy, tout ce qu'il faut pour passer un bon séjour à Anvers (l'emplacement est central et top). Sandra est super, nous avons été vraiment plus que bien reçus ! à recommander vraiment !!

We really had a great stay in Antwerp. The location of the apartment is just perfect - you can walk everywhere, it's quiet, and a very nice area in general with good cafés just around the corner. You can find everything you need for your stay in the apartment. Also, the communication with Sandra was very easy and nice. THANKS! :)
Superbe loft, tout equipé avec une déco de très bon goût. Je recommande !
Great location, great apartment and amazing facilities! Very trendy place.
Het was een geweldig verblijf in deze loft. Met een pooltafel en een megagroot scherm om films op te kijken. En een heerlijke stortdouche. Echt heel tof!!

Hippe Wohnung in Antwerpen. Es ist alles vorhanden, was man braucht, inkl kostenlosen Parkplatz. Einkaufsmöglichkeiten ca 5 Min - ins Zentrum auf den kürzesten Weg ca 20 Min per pedes. Balkon inkl Sitzgelegenheit ist praktisch/minimalistisch und ist wunderbar geeignet für ein Bier am Abend oder zum rauchen.
Kommunikation war schnell, klar und problemlos.
Logement très bien

Un excellent week-end chez Sten ! Très bon emplacement avec parking gratuit et transports à proximité. Un très bel appartement tout équipé et très propre. Et pour parfaire le tout, un hote disponible et fort sympathique ! Je recommande à 200%

Die Unterkunft ist sehr gemütlich, toll aufgeteilt, zentral gelegen und es ist alles da, was man braucht. Die Kommunikation mit Anneke war super und auch ihre Tipps haben uns weiter geholfen. Eine sehr offene Familie, die bereit ist, ihr eigenes zu Hause fremden Gästen zur Verfügung zu stellen. Es ist ein schönes Gefühl, wenn einem dieses Vertrauen geschenkt wird.

Es una perfecta residencia ,no sólo porque está en bien comunicada sino también por estar bien amueblada.Anneke es tan amable,nos responde con rapidez y paciencia.En cada sitio de la casa,nos deja algunas notas ,que nos facilitan mucho.En todas maneras,la casa merece ser recomendar.

Anneke and her family have a wonderful home, even with an abundance of toys to play with for our 4 year-old son. The location is great, especially if you like to scope out the trendy Antwerpen-Zuid area! Anneke was very helpful in providing tips for the area and making us feel welcome  - thnx!
Lovely stylish property. Close to shops and bars and only a short bus, tram or cycle from the centre of Antwerp
Well equipped family house over 3 floors in a very lively location of Antwerps-Zuid. Happy to have stay there and would blindly recommend it to anyone.
Prachtig ruim herenhuis op prima loopafstand van centrum en voorzieningen. Goede, snelle communicatie met Anneke. Nuttige tips ontvangen. Een aanrader!
The host canceled this reservation 103 days before arrival. This is an automated posting.
Big house. Great place. Nice garden. Location ok.

Fijn en licht huis van een gezin met kleine kinderen. Alles in huis vrij toegankelijk, het huis is goed schoon en ligt op een prettige plek.
Anneke had veel tips over wat te doen. Prima plek om te zijn !

Très belle maison, propre et agréable à vivre dans un quartier calme mais vivant tout de même. Une bonne adresse pour visiter Anvers à pied en famille. Annecke nous a très bien conseillé pour profiter des cafés et endroits à voir le temps d’un week-end. Bref une adresse à garder dans son carnet pour un prochain séjour !

Wat een fijn familiehuis met persoonlijkheid! Daardoor voel je je heel snel thuis, maar tegelijkertijd is het heel schoon en netjes waardoor je je toch even in een hotel waant. Echt een must voor gezinnen, maar ook voor vrienden of stelletjes. Zo is er ook een fijn dakterras waar je lekker kunt chillen. De buurt is super, mooiste koffiebar om de hoek, leuke restaurantjes en afhaal en ook geweldig park met speeltuin dicht in de buurt. De straat is weer heel rustig, dus je hebt totaal geen overlast. Echt een aanrader dus!

This town house accommodation provided a great base for a long weekend in Antwerpen.  Being able to have our own privacy and access to a great kitchen helped.  Anneke was very welcoming and helpful.  We would love to return again!
Nice area, really nice house, very welcoming and helpful host : perfect conditions to enjoy Antwerp.
We really enjoyed our stay in Annekes wonderful townhouse. No complaints, only praise!

Very nice place and well situated for the 4 of us (2 adults and 2 kids). It is a real airbnb place where Anneke is usually living with her family. So the house is perfectly functioning.
Bedrooms and beds are confortable. The dining-living room is very large so that everyone can relax there. The kitchen is a pleasure to use for cooking and breakfast. Bathroom is really huge with nice shower and bath. There are several wc, and a very nice office for working if needed.
The house has 4 floors. The first one is an apartment used by some very quiet people. Then the next 3 floors were for us. At the beginning it is a bit surprising to go through the main stairs for going to one floor to the other. But since it is used only by us, it is in practice more an inside stair and we could let the doors open.
We definitively recommend this place.
Een heerlijk huis op een ideale plek. Zeer aan te bevelen.
Heerlijk huis op een toplocatie! Vooral met kleine kindjes fijn om te verblijven vanwege de faciliteiten.

Het huis is ruim en van alle luxe voorzien. Op loopafstand zijn vele leuke restaurantjes en winkels te vinden. Met het openbaar vervoer en de voor Antwerpen bekende deelfietsen om de hoek staat niets een prettig verblijf in deze gezellige stad je in de weg.
Omdat het parkeren, zoals in de meeste drukbezochte steden, steeds lastiger wordt raad ik iedereen aan om Antwerpen met de trein te bezoeken. Dit geeft je meteen de gelegenheid om een van de meest fraaie Europese stations te bewoneren.
Anneke is bovendien een erg vriendelijk en behulpzame gastvrouw. Bij aankomst stond er zelfs een flesje Cava voor ons klaar
Es ist eine wundervolle Unterkunft, super gute Ausstattung, viel Platz, Raum und Freiheit. Wundervolle Gastgeber, die uns dieses Reich zur Verfügung gestellt haben. Wir kommen immer wieder gern!!!
Very well equipped bnb over 3 floors in a lively location in Antwerp. Fantastic AirBnB experience!

Super fijn huis in een leuke wijk. Op de Troonplaats om de hoek kun je heel goed wat eten en drinken. Het huis was echt heel fijn en netjes. Anneke heeft hele goede tips en zorgt voor een fantastisch verblijf. Aanrader!

Wat een heerlijk huis is dit; ruim, schoon, voorzien van alles wat er nodig is en nog meer. De locatie is top met aan het einde van de straat diverse cafés met terrassen en ook een standplaats van Velo - de Antwerpse leen-fietsen. Met deze fietsen is het Zuid in 3 minuten bereikt en het Centrum in 10 minuten. De straat zelf is heerlijk rustig en stil, in combinatie met de goede bedden is het heerlijk slapen.
De communicatie met Anneke verloopt heel soepel en gemakkelijk!
We komen hier zeker terug.
Fanatisch mooi en kindvriendelijk huis als perfecte uitvalsbasis voor een bezoek aan Antwerpen. Op wandelafstand van tram, resto en winkels.

Ein herrliches Haus für Familien in toller Lage!
Modern und voll ausgestattet mit allem was man braucht. Interessant geschnitten und verteilt auf 3,5 Etagen - man sollte also gut mit Treppen umgehen können.
Die gemütliche Terrasse läd zum Entspannen ein.
Öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sind ganz in der Nähe und bringen einen überall hin. Natürlich kann man vieles auch bequem erlaufen. Supermarkt und Restaurants sind ebenfalls fußläufig erreichbar.
Der Kontakt zur Vermieterin war sehr gut und unkompliziert.
Sehr zu empfehlen!

nice house to stay, stairs can be tricky, but that just how Belgian houses are. On the ground floor couple of other people are living, but they are very quite. Airbnb area starts from the first floor, there is no door to separate it from ground floor, so each floor has its own key. Terrasse is very nice, so is the location.

Very central and very local! Close to everything needed. Public transport and great spots! Spacious and clean apartment for decent value and a very, very good host! Can't recommend this more!!

P.S I've read that allot of previous guests wrote about the constant police sirens! The area is close to several police stations and close to the main road. That's it ☺
It is a great place to stop in Antwerpen for a couple of days.

We spent 10 nights at Rev's apartment and I can describe the stay as comfortable. The apartment is newly renovated and sparkling clean. Great value for what you pay. We were also provided with a baby crib which was highly appreciated. What is also great is that the host is very prompt when it comes to replying to questions and replies within minutes. Big plus for the lift in the building which was quite handy for my elderly aunt and baby.
I wouldn't really describe the apartment as quiet since it overlooks a very busy central street and the windows are not double-glazed, meaning we could hear everything happening on the streets, and in the apartment next-door.
It would have been appreciated if more basics were provided in the kitchen like oil, salt, pepper...etc since it was a long stay. Still, I would describe the kitchen as well-equipped with utensils.
All in all, I would really recommend staying here and it was a positive experience for us.

This apartment is very well located, across from the central station and close to the main shopping area. We were greeted warmly and looked after well.
The bathroom is lovely and the beds were comfortable.
One note, there was a lot of noise from neighbouring apartments on Saturday night as I assume they had a party, but this is not the fault of our host.
Overall a pleasant stay and I would recommend it.
Thanks for host us. Good apartments. Awesome location

We couldn't have asked for a better
place. Very comfortable and super clean. Ideal location near the central station for restaurants, bars, and groceries. It's an easy walk to the historic city or you can take a tram that runs right by the apartment
If my travels take me back to Antwerp I'll be renting from this host again.

The apartment is at an excellent location, close to the Zoo and the Centraal Station. Excellent place to be based and move to various cities via train. walking distance to the shopping belt of Antwerp as well. Highly recommended.

Fast support for any questions you have, clean rooms and excellent location, walking distance to all main points of historical center. A little bit noisy but it is ok for this district I think. So, highly recomemded.

We hebben tijdens ons verblijf enorm genoten van de Airbnb. De locatie was top, dichtbij centraal station. Het wandelingetje naar het centrum (grote markt etc.) was goed te doen. Het appartement zelf was van alle gemakken voorzien. Ook was het schoon en netjes opgeruimd. Ik zou het zeker aanbevelen!
we enjoyed our stay in Rev place, the host were very helpful. The place is close to the center in a very good location

A very nice, renovated apartment in the heart of Antwerp. Only a few minutes away from the main shopping street and the beautiful Central Station.

The beds were very comfortable and the apartment was very clean. At night there is quite some noise coming from the street but you’re in the middle of Antwerp so you can expect that :-)

Overall it was a very nice stay and I would definitely come back!
Nice Location for exploring Antwerpen and Belgium by train.
Bon emplacement. Très propre. Appartement récemment refait. Un peu de bruit de la rue.
Amazing apartment in a great location, apartment had everything we needed .. would definitely stay again

Great location with everything you need for a short stay.  The bed and sofa bed were comfortable, the shower was fine, and can’t comment on the kitchen as we didn’t use it except to make coffee.  The place was very clean.  Unfortunately the lift was out of order for most of our stay, which as the apartment is on the third floor was annoying.

A nice light and spacious apartment well located close to the train station and the main shopping area. We stayed a whole week while attending a conference. We found the bed comfortable and the bathroom very modern although the water pressure was on the low side. The wifi was the best we’ve had travelling around Europe so I was able to do some work without any hassles. The lift was useful when we arrived as it is a third floor flat however it stopped working mid week. It appeared to be related to an issue in the neighbouring building. If accessibility is an issue for you check with the owner it’s working again.
Appartement au calme très proche du centre d anvers. Au moment où nous y séjournions l ascenseur était en panne. Quelques petits défauts dans le logement mais agréable pour passer 3 jours.
Great value apartment, perfectly clean, close to the grand central station and other public transport.  Close to several restaurants and groceries. The host was great!
Really nice and cozy appartment, excellent location!

Très bel appartement idéalement situé. Pas loin de la gare, de la rue commerçante, de nombreux sites culturels... Propreté, accueil et disponibilité irréprochables ! Mon séjour était parfait, merci encore !

Prima plek, schoon en dichtbij het centrum. Had wat sfeervoller ingericht mogen worden, de woonkamer is vrij kaal en basic ingericht. Er was maar 1 koffiecup beschikbaar, dat was wat karig. Verder goed contact met de verhuurder.

Great location, clean spacious apartment, smooth check in-check out, nice host, everything was just perfect! Thanks for the opportunity to leave the baggage in the flat after check out, that was a great help!
The apartment is absolutely lovely! It has everything you could need for a nice stay in Antwerp and the location is perfect.
Mooi sfeervol appartement! Goede locatie direct aan de winkelstraat de meir! Fijn contact met de eigenaresse! Aan iedereen aan te raden!

Very good welcome from Isa ! Appartement was perfectingly corresponding to what we expected. Clean, good taste in decoration, and well situated.
Some issues to sleep because of one neigbourg who didn’t want to sleep, but except that : perfect

Appartamento ben arredato e accogliente, situato al terzo piano di una palazzina su una strada pedonale, in zona molto silenziosa e nel contempo in ottima posizione centralissima. Isa è stata gentilissima nell'accoglierci e segnalarci tutto il necessario. Materasso comodo, riscaldamento regolabile in ogni stanza tramite grandi termosifoni. Box doccia grande. Manca solo un armadio più capiente per mettere i vestiti. E purtroppo nel nostro periodo l'ascensore non funzionava, ma fare un po' di moto non fa male. Tutti i servizi sono vicinissimi: panificio, supermarket, farmacia, ristoranti; anche la stazione, a 400 metri.

Had a great stay. The house has a perfect location. Everything on walkong distance. A small supermarket on the other side of the street was nice aswell. We stayed with a baby, so we did everything walking. The elevator wasnt working, but nothing Isa could do about it.

One neighbour kept us awake for a bit. But after letting him know, the noise was shut down. So not really a thing to complain.

Appartment was very clean, spacious and located perfectly!
Good place right down town in Antwerp. Great host. Great communication and flexibility!

Isa is very welcoming and answers quickly to messages
the appartement is very well placed, clean and with space
The posibility of parking the car a few metres away is very convenient
L’appartement est très bien situé et nous avons pu bénéficier du parking situé à 250m ce qui fut très pratique!
Highly recommended, stylish, clean and cozy in the city center
Lovely apartment 2 minutes from the pedestrian street and train station.  next to everything you need for a comfortable stay.  very nice hostess.  the apartment has everything you need, very clean.

Lisa nous a reçu chez elle à 22h
excellent accueil emplacement idéal pour visiter Anvers
l’ascenseur fonctionne très bien ...!!!
Literie confortable
Petite touche d’attention comme café et Thé disponible

Had a really great time.  The location is perfect and we were able to walk to all areas of Antwerp  easily. It is also useful that there is a shop directly opposite the flat, as well as some good food options (Poke) a few doors round. Neighbour played some loud music over one night - not a problem for us but it might be if you are a light sleeper (generally road noise can be heard but that is what comes with a central location). Overall would recommend staying here.

Just a great place in the heart of Antwerp with very good communication by Isa before, during and after our stay in this splendid appartement with a free closed parking just a block away. Be happy to book again at a next occasion!
The appartment is well located in the city center and the private parking place is really useful. The check-in with Isa was easy and the appartment is clean and well equipped. We would recommend it!

Erg mooi appartement op een perfecte locatie in het centrum met privé parkeerplaats.

Helaas een vervelende buurman die tot diep in de nacht zijn muziek erg hard had staan en op straat aan het zingen was. Dat was dus wel even een tegenvaller.
Wir kommen gerne wieder
Prima appartement dicht bij alles. De sushi tegenover is een aanrader.

The flat is perfectly located besides a mayor shopping street. The personal parking space is a big plus for this Airbnb. Everything was perfectly clean and tidy. Supermarket is straight across the street. The personal parking space is a big plus for this Airbnb. Host Isa is answering fast and helpfull. Strongly recommend!

Antwerpen is definitly worth a visit, it offers a lot of great food and beer between an interesting mix of classic and modern buildings.
Fantastic location and the accommodation was more than big enough for the 6 of us. We had a great stay and the communications were very quick!

Super séjour chez Isa en plein centre d'Anvers. Isa est vraiment super sympa, s'adapte à nos demandes, explique tout super bien. Son appartement est en parfait état, très pratique, avec une vue géniale. Vraiment très très bien situé, à 5min de la gare et 2min de la rue commerçante principale. Le parking est un vrai plus. Bref, on recommande à 100% :-)

Hele fijne gezellige studio! Warme sfeer met veel hout. Alles wat je nodig hebt voor een paar daagjes Antwerpen, zeker als stel. Alexander ontving ons heel vriendelijk en reageerde snel. Ook de locatie is perfect. Je zit direct in het centrum en 10/15 minuten lopen naar het centraal station. Aanrader!
Helemaal top! Mooie details en bloemen.

Perfect place to visit Anvers , right in old town everything is 2 minutes by foot. Alexander is a very charming host and the flat clean and perfect , and with coffee and tea , I appreciate it after my journey !
I recommend him !
Erg leuke studio in de leukste buurt van Antwerpen. Alles is voorzien. Een aanrader!
Een sfeervolle studio middenin het centrum. Perfect adres voor een heerlijk weekendje Antwerpen.
Mooie en schone studio, heel praktisch gelegen en gastvrije gastheer!
everything was as expected. a special mention to Alexander's availability in giving precious information
Hele joviale man, goede locatie. Alles wat je nodig hebt is er. Zeker een aanrader. Meerdere ontbijtmogelijkheden in de buurt.

Alexander has a lovely space just above a plant/flower shop in Antwerp and a very short walk to the Grote Markt.  Communication was excellent and everything sparkling clean.  Wish I had more time in this lovely place.  Thanks Alexander!

No sé cómo será en verano, pero desde luego en invierno no es nada recomendable. La casa no está bien aislada, la calefacción no es suficiente y no hay mantas. Además, ducharse es una lucha entre el agua hirviendo y helada.

The appartment is nice and clean, as You can see in the pictures. I would just suggest that it should have another mirror. It’s difficult for a small girl to put on your make up in the one at the bathroom. There’s no elevator. There’s a supermarket really near, and the location of the appartment is perfect, You can go on foot to the centre. Alexander was nice to us and easy to contact.
It was a great experience. The host kindly welcomed us. The location is the perfect distance away from the city centre. We’ll definitely stay here again if there is another chance.
Great place in a beautiful old house, perfectly located. You have everything you need in a cozy room.
Studio très pratique pour y manger et très bien situé dans le centre pour tout faire à pied. Décoration moderne et chaleureuse. Propriétaire charmant et attentionné.
Gastvrij ontvangst, mooie sfeervolle ingerichte kamer op zeer centrale ligging. Fijn dat er koffie en thee was op de kamer. Boeket verse bloemen op de tafel maakte het wel af. Erg genoten!
非常好！房东很好.房间鲜花装饰.地理位置也好.一切都很好.

Die Wohnung ist super geeignet, um Antwerpen zu erkunden. Die Lage ist wirklich einmalig und die Wohnung bietet alles, was man benötigt, um einen schönen Städtetripp zu erleben. Ein toller Strauß Blumen auf dem Tisch sorgten direkt für einen herzlichen Empfang. Wir würden jederzeit wiederkommen und können Alexanders Wohnung nur weiterempfehlen!
Heel fijne locatie, super flexibele verhuurder doordat hij zelf ik de winkel aanwezig is, aanrader :)
Alexanders place is really nice and clean, a perfect spot for a weekendtrip to Antwerpen!
Zeer mooi gelegen, alles wat je nodig had was zeker aanwezig. Veel eetgelegenheden in de buurt en niet ver van het centrum.
Heel fijn om verse bloemen op de kamer te hebben. Fijne uitvalsplek om Antwerpen verder te verkennen. Zeker een aanrader!
Die Lage ist perfekt. Alles ist Fußläufig zu erreichen. Das Zimmer war sehr sauber und Alexander unfassbar herzlich.
Ik heb hier al eens eerder overnacht en nu was het weer net zo fijn en leuk! Warm welkom van Alexander gekregen, schone ruimte, top locatie. Kortom, een aanrader.
Everything was just wonderfull. The room was so pretty. We didn‘t want to leave. I am happy to come back some time
Alexander es un buen anfitrión con el que puedes estar comunicado vía (Hidden by Airbnb) . La habitación es tipo apartamento, amplia, bien equipada y muy cerca de todo lo que hay que ver.
Mooie Airbnb, precies op een hele leuke locatie in Antwerpen. Schoon en gezellig. Bovendien is Alexander ook erg vriendelijk!
We had a great stay at Alex beautiful appartement in the heart of Antwerp!  We can highly recommend it!
Alexander is a great host, very responsive and considerate. Apartment is nice and cozy.
Cet appartement est joli, chaleureux, parfaitement propre et situé en plein cœur de la vieille ville. C’est absolument charmant et très confortable! Nous le recommandons fortement !

Appartement super mignon, à l'étage d'une boutique de fleurs. Il y avait donc de jolis bouquets de fleurs en décoration, ce qui rajoutait une touche de charme au lieu. La situation est idéale : en 5 min de marche, on atteint les rues les plus touristiques du centre-ville et il y a de bons restaurants au pied de l'immeuble. Le parking gratuit le plus proche est cependant assez loin à pieds et il y a peu de places libres dans les rues aux alentours, il faut donc opter pour un parking payant ou un peu de marche :).  Sinon, je recommande vivement ce logement et cet hôte !
The appartment is confortable, real flowers inside, it was very nice!

Het appartement zit op een mooie locatie dicht bij het centrum. Het appartement was schoon en zag er opgeruimd uit. De verhuurder was vriendelijk en reageerd ook snel op berichten en vragen.

Ik raad dit appartement zeker aan!

Il soggiorno presso Alexander é stato magnifico! L'appartamento molto pulito molto ben arredato e curatissimo nei dettagli! Alexander ha pensato veramente a tutto per rendere il soggiorno piacevole ( un bouquet di fiori al centro della tavola, cucina fornita di ogni cosa , thé e caffè disponibili) . Una delle cose che mi ha fatto più piacere é stata trovare un bigliettino attaccato alla porta con scritto " benvenuta Teodora"..una piccola attenzione che trovo magnifica!
Grazie Alexander!

Studio cosy et bien entretenu. Très bien situé.  Notre hôte était très disponible. Seul petit inconvénient, l'acoustique de la chambre avec les autres chambres pas très bonne. Nous avons passé un très bon séjour.

El lugar tiene su encanto es maravilloso llegar y encontrarte las flores sobre la mesa y todo tal cual lo has visto en las fotos, el trato de Álex es excepcional, inmejorable... recomiendo a todo el que tenga que venir a Amberes de quedarse donde Alexander!
Such a beautiful place! Close to lovely bars and shops and Alexander was very helpful and lovely. Would definitely stay again!
2nd time, different room, same wonderful hospitality, thankyou and till next time Alexander!

Alexander was a very friendly & helpful host. The apartment was clean, tidy, well equipped & even decorated with flowers. It’s located in the heart of Antwerp in a safe neighbourhood & you can reach everything like the Cathedral, the Grote Markt, but also little cafés & small shops in short walking distances. There was also a supermarket just around the corner. We enjoyed our sunny days in Antwerp, especially in Alexander’s flat a lot & would definitely recommend to stay in that place!
Une halte très accueillante, bien située, bien équipée. Tout ce qu'il faut pour un séjour agréable à Anvers. Merci Alexander !

Dit is een toplocatie. Gelegen in het centrum van de stad, heel rustig, mooie en zeer nette kamer met bovendien alles erop en eraan (douche, ijskast, keukentje, koffie is voorzien, enz....., wat wil een mens nog meer.
Wij komen terug!!!!
A very sweet studio to call home in Antwerp, pleasant, airy and spotless, with nice vibes from the flowers below!

The apartment is in an old beautiful building just above a flower shop which for us meant that we also had some beautiful flowers in the apartment. The style is very unique and we enjoyed staying there.
However if you sleep lightly I recommend to bring earplugs because the windows are facing the street and we experienced some people who passed by during the night and weren't entirely quiet. We left the window open though, so it also might help to close it.

Overall I highly recommend Alexanders apartment. The location is perfect to explore the Old Town and there's a public bike station just 2 minutes down the road.

There's free parking close to the river which is also easy to reach by bike. Unloading and packing the car was possible just in front of the building.
Alexander was very available and accommodating. The apartment is welcoming and very cosy. You can reach the city center very easily by feet and still have a night in a quiet area.
De studio van Alexander is een prettige ruimte. Je vindt er alles wat je nodig hebt voor een aangenaam verblijf. Alexander is een goede gastheer, die het je graag naar de zin maakt.

Bellissimo posto in cui soggiornare , pulizia impeccable , host amichevole e molto gentile . Alloggio a 8 minuti dal centro e pochi metri da trasporto pubblico , si trova su una via piena di negozi e fastfood e qualche ristorante  e girando all’angolo si trova un supermercato . Consigliatisso
We had a lovely time at Alexander’s apartment. He location was perfect, especially with the Velo. He made us feel welcome and topped it off with a beautiful bouquet.
Wir hatten eine super Nacht in Antwerpen - perfekte Lage, gute Kommunikation mit Alex und dazu noch ein sehr schönes Zimmer mit frischen Blumen! Wir können es nur weiterempfehlen!

We enjoyed our stay in Alexander's studio a lot! The studio is perfectly located in the old city center of Antwerpen and reflects with a lot of authentic details the charme of this wonderful part of the city. Alexander beautifully decorated the studio and upon arrival there was even a lovely bouquet of flowers on the table. The communcation with Alexander went very well and thanks to the key box we could also easily and flexible check in and out. On our last day we wanted to go on another discovery trip through the old city; we had already checked out but Alexander kindly allowed us to store our baggage in a little storage cabine, we appreciated that a lot. Thanks again for this great stay, Alexander:-)!!
Un beau appartement, et très pratique. Je vous recommande vivement
Great appartment located in the center of the city. Ideal for short or long stay to visit Belgium.

Great spacious room with a kitchenette in a location close to city centre. Alexander is really lovely and helpful! Just be warned there’s lots of narrow stairs to walk up to the rooms. Wouldn’t recommend if you have lots of wheeling luggage as it was a bit of a task to get them up there
Gezellig en knus appartement op geweldige locatie! Perfect voor een citytrip.
Friendly host in a nice and cozy little studio apartment. It’s not a luxurious place, but definitely more than sufficient for a short stay in Antwerp!

This is a wonderful place, full of flowery scents since it is right above a flower shop. The place is clean, stylish, beautifully arranged with fresh flowers set on the table. Alexander is a great host, who remains flexible to his hosts’ needs. He is extremely welcoming and friendly, and will give you great tips to discover the city. I thoroughly enjoyed this stay, and I will try to book his room again whenever I come back to Antwerpen!
Everything was perfect! The very cozy apartment with a beautiful view of a window, friendly host, perfect location.
Centrale ligging en alle nodige voorzieningen.

Emplacement idéal pour visiter la ville.
Manque un peu d'équipement pour la cuisine
Een gastheer aanwezig voor uitleg en een studio heel goed gelegen. Je kunt alles lopend doen. Een ruime en heel schone studio.
Propre , pratique pour les visites très bien !
I loved staying in Alexander’s beautiful flower shop/studio. It’s perfectly located, clean and totally comfortable for my quick stay in Antwerp.
Nice studio, perfect location!

Een erg leuk en knus appartement op een super locatie. Het inchecken ging soepel en alles was dik voor elkaar. Zeker een aanrader als je een leuke plek voor jezelf zoekt om in Antwerpen te verblijven. Alles was goed te bereiken en ook was de host erg gastvrij en goed bereikbaar.

Sehr schönes Apartment, einfach perfekt zentral gelegen, Gastronomie und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in unmittelbarer Umgebung. Alexander hat uns kurzfristig früher als vereinbart empfangen und war sehr freundlich und herzlich. Gerne wieder!

Alexander is a realy friedly host! He eben welcomed us with Some flowers in the room and was very flexible with the Check-in & pur. Communication was quick and easy. The Location of the Appartement is very good and you can reach the City Center in a des Minutes Walk. The Appartement is a Little small but perfekt for a Weekend Trip! It is really cozy and with a Great Stile! All in all a Perfect Place to stay :)

Alexander’s cute studio was the perfect place for my partner and I on our 5 day trip to Antwerp. Location was great, we walked and biked everywhere. Only thing to note would be the staircase is quite narrow so we had to be a bit careful with our luggage. Overall a pleasant stay and would happily come back :)

We had a wonderful and charming stay at Alexander studio. It was such a lovely and cosy place, very well located 5mn walking from the Grote markt. Very bright studio with a great bed and shower. Alexander was kind and put a pretty flowers bouquet in our room. The only thing if you 're sensitive too : no shutters in the bedroom and light curtains. You cannot make a mistake by choosing Alexander s place for a cool stay in Antwerpen! I hope to come back again
Alexander's place is beautiful, clean, and wonderfully situated, close to monuments and several hip bars. There were fresh flowers in the room and it was very cozy.
Alex's place is spacious and well located. It was perfect for a weekend trip.

The apartment is perfectly located down the street from the cathedral and Grote Market. Easy walk to Meir for shopping as well!
Alexander is a great host and very kind and helpful. His flower is shop gorgeous and made for a beautiful home base. The apartment has fresh flowers which is a nice touch.
Huge bed for a European apartment and very comfortable. Would stay again and happily recommend to anyone visiting Antwerp.

Die Wohnung ist super süß und mit vielen kleinen Details eingerichtet. Sie liegt gut zentral, wir konnten alles zu Fuß erlaufen. Ein Supermarkt ist keine 5 Minuten weg.
Alles war sauber, gut vorrätig und hat super geklappt :)
Tof appartementje met een uitstekende ligging om Antwerpen Noord of Zuid te ontdekken.
Zeer leuke studio en ideaal gelegen! Een aanrader!

Logement très agréable et superbement bien placé pour visiter Anvers avec commerces de proximité et restaurants à quelques pas. Alexander nous a donné de précieux conseils pour laisser notre véhicule en dehors de la zone de la basse emmission.
Es war perfekt. Tolle Ausstattung, super zentral gelegen und ein sehr netter Gastgeber. Wir hatten einen wundervollen Aufenthalt und würden jederzeit wiederkommen.
Pleasant and lively stay in the heart of Antwerp
We had a lovely stay at Alexander's place. Great location and a beautiful little studio above his flower shop, very quaint.
Amazing studio that far exceeded our expectations. Everything was so clean and organised! Perfect for a little getaway.

Alexander is a lovely person and his apartment is very charming. It's perfectly located close to the old town and there are lovely shops and some outstanding restaurants and bars around. We loved Alexanders recommendations and had the best weekend! Thanks a lot. We'll definitely be back!
Un alojamiento céntrico
Mooi appartement op een goede locatie voor een weekend in Antwerpen! Alexander was uiterst vriendelijk.
It was nice staying at Alexander’s place. It’s in old town and at walking distance to many places.
Great location, very close to a wealth of amenities and entertainment, very easy assess and good host.

Alexander’s flat is so lovely and cosy, we highly recommend this one. Accessed through a great florist shop, the flat is spotless and well thought out. It is also right in the centre of things, and has many great breakfast spots nearby!
We had a lovely stay in Alexander’s studio. Thoughtful touches and a well thought out place meant an easy stay. Great location too. Alexander was a great host and I would recommend him to my friends.

Gezellig appartement in een leuke straat vol voorzieningen en op goede loopafstand van allerlei bezienswaardigheden/winkels/restaurants etc. De locatie van het appartement, boven de bloemenwinkel van Alexander, geeft een leuke extra dimensie aan het verblijf.  Alexander is een vriendelijke, relaxte host.

The place is as cute and lovely as in the pictures! The fact that it's right above the host's flower shop is adorable. The place is clean, spacious and has all amenities (microwave, kettle, fridge etc). The bed is large and comfortable.

It's very central, close to the Cathedral, metro station and bars and restaurants. Unfortunately, the bars being close by meant that it was very noisy during the nights, with drunk people walking by shouting. Maybe it's because we stayed over the weekend, but we couldn't really sleep at all due to rowdy people.

Also just a small note - there's no elevator (which is fine) but the stairs are small and irregular, and slightly dangerous, especially since the light is automatic and it doesn't switch on until you go up. Had quite a bad fall, could've easily broken a bone.
Cosy studio with a large comfortable bed. The apartment is well located, right in the center of Antwerp. Alexander is a nice and helpful person.

Appartamento elegante e intimo,piacevole entrare accolti dal profumo del negozio di fiori di Alexander.

Consigliato.

Excellent location, Alexander is very responsive and helpful. The apartment was clean and fresh flowers were very much appreciated. The only improvement point for me is the noise isolation.
Thanks Alexander!

Sterk aanbevolen en wij komen er ook graag terug.

Alexander es encanto, el apartamento está bien, la localización es perfecta y es muy bonito. Huele a flores frescas todo el tiempo, su floristería es muy bonita.
Los únicos puntos negativos que pondría al alojamiento es que la wifi no funcionaba en la habitación, lo hablé con él pero seguía sin funcionar. Se escuchan todos los ruidos de la escalera y de la calle. Y si te gusta dormir hasta tarde lo tendrás complicado porque las cortinas son muy finas y dejan pasar mucha luz por lo que mejor llevarse un antifaz.
Pero como digo por lo demás está bien para pasar una estancia corta en Amberes.
Great and nice host, apartment is perfectly located in the heart of Antwerp. Parking possible for 20 Euro per 24h in a public garage down the street (5 Min walk)
Super séjour, loft très agréable pour une nuit à Anvers.
Lovely place! The location is great and the space is really nice - it’s right above the owner’s flower shop! He is very nice as well. Highly recommend!

We had a wonderful time in Alexander’s apartment, nicely decorated. The fresh flowers were beautiful too.

localisation super+ lit agréable+propreté=niquel

Had a great stay at Alexander's place. Highly recommended.
To be recommended!

Très bon logement, très bien situé !

Een gezellig plekje met alles er op en er aan. Lekker groot bed, gratis pads voor het koffiezetapparaat, veel verschillende pannen om mee te kunnen koken. De buurt is gezellig, niet al te druk. We hebben er 4 dagen verbleven en zijn vooral in huis gebleven ivm Corona, maar daar was het zeer geschikt voor. perfect place to stay for a weekend in Antwerpen, central and calm location

Great location and lively neighborhood, easy check-in. The apartment is beautiful and very comfortable, we had a great time!
Un charmant appartement, et surtout un emplacement idéal pour visiter et apprécier la ville d'Anvers.
We had a great stay and would definitely recommend that place!

We had a wonderful stay at Alexanders Airbnb! :) The interieur is very nice and cozy and the location is super central!
Huge recommendation!

Secondly, we were given hand towels (not bath towels) which we couldn’t even wrap around ourselves!
Thirdly, the kitchen was not well equipped.. no salt or oil which meant we had to go and buy a few basics. This would have been appreciated.

To be fair, the apartment is stunning and if it was cooler or we had a fan there would have been no complaints but the lack of sleep made this quite a difficult place to relax in!

Appartement totalement conforme aux photos, localisation et équipements parfaits ! Nous avons passé un excellent séjour dans cet appartement ! À réserver les yeux fermés !

Très bel appartement et des hôtes réactifs !

The apartment is very clean, beautifully furnished and very conveniently located! We had had some trouble on our way to Antwerp and arrived a lot later than announced - Tobias went out of his way to make us feel extra welcome and was extremely friendly! Would definitely come back! :)
Very clean and fully equipped flat right in the city centre. Sofia and Tobias are very helpful and responsive! We recommend!
Excellent host thanks for everything!
Het was een heerlijk verblijf alles netjes en verzorgd, erg goede locatie in het centrum. De communicatie en service was erg prettig. Zeker aan te raden.

I was browsing for a nice place in Antwerp city center, trying to spot that 'gem' I am always looking out for. Price is usually not the first thing in mind, location and fresh, modern design is. To our surprise this nice place was available and it took about 15 minutes to 'close the deal'. The location seemed to be just perfect, mere minutes from the most central areas within the historic center of Antwerp.

The apartment was stunning. Design was nice and everything was right, from a nice big fridge to the Nespresso machine. 3 flights of stairs were most welcome after a day of delicious treats (chocolate, chocolate and more chocolate). I wouldn't hesitate booking the place again if we were to visit Antwerp for a nice trip.

AH and CRU was only a few minutes away for morning groceries, a simple Carrefour Express was near opposite the place for standard stuff. Nearby Velo Antwerpen stalls were only 150 meters away. But after we discovered Lime (Electric Step Sharing plan) we were immediately hooked. Tourism Flanders had advised us with many great restaurants in the nearby area. We ended up having lovely meals at Nathan, Izumi, and a few other great places.

We did standard drinks during day time, but at night we went for cocktails, once at Cocktails at Nice and another night at BelRoy's Bijou. Both recommended!!

Parking in Belgian cities isn't really our thing, so we parked our car at P+R Kinepolis. From here we had two options, either the metro or a Velo Antwerp bike. We chose the latter, since this would mean we could go straight to the apartment. The bike ride took us about 10/15 minutes as we already found several reasons to stop along the route. Biking isn't for everyone, but for us a very nice way to get there. Good thing is that we didn't have much luggage on the way to the place, the way back to the car was a totally different story :).

Anyway. Our stay at Tobias's place was 5 stars perfect. Need a cozy, spacious and nicely decorated place right smack in the center of Antwerp, this is your best bet!

Das Airbnb ist super schön und gemütlich. In dieser tollen Wohnung fehlte es uns an nichts und es war sehr sauber. Tobias und Sofia haben immer schnell auf unsere Nachrichten geantwortet, waren uns gerne bei jeder Frage behilflich und haben uns viele Tipps gegeben. Das Airbnb ist traumhaft und ich würde es jedem nur empfehlen. Wir kommen bestimmt nochmal wieder :)

De AirBnB is perfect gelegen in het historisch centrum van Antwerpen. Dichtbij de grote markt, Groenplaats, de Meir en allerlei gezellige restaurantjes. Ik ben een aantal keer in Antwerpen geweest maar dit is het beste verblijf tot nu toe. Als ik weer een keer naar Antwerpen ga dan kijk ik meteen of de AirBnB van Tobias nog beschikbaar is.
Zie voorafgaand.

The place to sleep is unusual and charming due to its diversity. The house has all the amenities included in the offer. The only problem was communication with the host, in the same room there were two reservations and we had to change the place that was not prepared to receive guests.

this room is in a rather peculiar house: in an atmosphere of belgian bourgeoisie of the turn of the century, it is basically a self-check-in hostel with nobody there to accomodate you. after coming back from dinner we found other guests in our room, who had been told they could stay there as well. we sorted it out, strange nonetheless with all our belongings lying around.
each room is themed differently, some with unabashed colonialism. while the rooms are in pretty good condition, there are some details that show that the owner doesn't care too much about the guests:
dirty towels & bed linen in the bathrooms & in the corridors; old food in the oven; no sockets to load your devices or even connect the lamps that are standing around as dummies; plus: broken lighting in the steep staircase, which makes it quite dangerous to look for the bathroom at night.
you should also know that the house is located at a very noisy intersection - cars & freight trains.
for 1, 2 nights it is ok to experience the unique atmosphere.

Can really recommend this place.

Wij hebben genoten van dit verblijf; een gezellige inrichting, gastvrije en geïnteresseerde hosts, en een goede locatie. We hebben heerlijk gegeten op het Dageraadsplein en om de hoek bij Mokkakapot, aanraders! Verder is Antwerpen een hartstikke leuke en bruisende stad en was het fijn om er weer te zijn. Bedankt Sven en Beatrijs!
Nice place and nice people
We would definitely recommend this studio to our friends and (Website hidden by Airbnb) was stylish , quiet , well situated and clean .
lovely place, with very friendly hosts!!!!
Everthing was perfect. House is amazing and peaceful. Location was perfect. Thank you againn.
Heel fijne plek om te verblijven! Hartelijke ontvangst, rustige plek in een leuke buurt dichtbij het centrum en een stijlvolle studio. Perfect dus!

We only stayed a short while, but it was a perfect stay in Antwerp. Rather than heading into the city on the first night, on Sven's suggestion we walked to a little square near to the house. We had a great night here and a short walk back. The house is gorgeous and Beatrice's art beautifully decorates the room. Very chic (I have no idea about this stuff, but thats what my girlfriend said).

Thoroughly enjoyed my stay with Sven and Beatrice. The Studio was ideal for me, lovely and cool at night during a very hot spell of weather, with excellent restaurants nearby.  The Velo bike stand 100m away was especially convenient.

Super schone lichte en fijne studio. Prachtige kunst! Fijne buurt, toch heerlijk rustig.
Sven en Beatrijs zijn fantastische gastheer en gastvrouw.

Sven en Beatrijs zijn erg fijn in de omgang. We voelden ons welkom, terwijl ook onze privacy werd gerespecteerd:) Het verblijf was alles wat we hadden verwacht: knus, op loop afstand van het centrum en in een rustige buurt. Heerlijk voor als je een weekendje tot rust wilt komen! Een echte aanrader!
Een erg mooie studio dichtbij het centrum. Aardige host en heel mooie kunst van Beatrijs in de studio om van te genieten tijdens het verblijf.
We loved Sven’s gallery room! It is a one of a kind stay. The hosts very sweet and want honest feedback which is probably why the place is so wonderful:) we definitely recommend!

Un très bel endroit, au calme et plein de goût, dans un quartier typique, tendance mais relax, proche du centre-ville et des commodités (bars, magasins, gare, transports...). Sven et Beatrijs sont accueillants, aux petits soins mais aussi très discrets. Merci à eux pour leur accueil et leur gentillesse.

I spend a lovely stay in the studio. The flat is perfectly clean, quiet and beautiful, with everything you need for a quick stay.
Sven are really arranging, with a late check out for me. I can definitely recommend this hoste, thank you very much !
Nice, clean room with a small kitchen and bathroom about 10 minutes away from the train station. Communication with the hosts runs very smoothly.

Fijn rustig appartement in Antwerpen, met prachtige schilderijen aan de muur die door de gastvrouw zijn gemaakt. Een prima bed, lekkere douche en handig keukentje met koelkast zorgen ervoor dat je alles hebt, wat je nodig hebt. Een grote plus; als je mazzel hebt, kan je voor de deur parkeren en middels de Parkline app staat je auto een heel weekend lang voor onder 10 eur. Ook meer dan handig, de fietsen van Velo Antwerpen, waarmee je je heel makkelijk en snel kunt verplaatsen richting het centrum. Je scoort een dagpas op internet en vindt de fietsenstalling om de hoek.

Fijne kamer en zeer gastvrij. Reageert super snel op berichte . Het pand is prachtig en er zijn leuke eet en drink gelegenheden in de buurt. Het centrum is echter net een stukje verder dan je zou willen.

Het is alsof je in een atelier verblijft. Modern met jaren 60 accenten en mooie kunstwerken. De eigenaren zijn heel hartelijk en ook bescheiden. Als je wilt mag je het echte atelier zien. De plek is echt rustig en als je Antwerpen niet kent, de locatie is prima. De wijk waarin het ligt is leuk en naar het centrum is goed te lopen en er zijn ook 'witte fietsen'. Voor 4 euro koop je een dagpas. Prima systeem.
Prachtige studio die heel sfeervol is ingericht, wij voelden ons er meteen thuis. Daarbij was de locatie ideaal, dus onze verwachtingen zijn zeer overtroffen!

We had an excellent stay at Sven and Beatrijs house ! The house was charming, well located, calm and very clean
Thank you very much for your very warm welcome
Breatrijs workshop is very interesting and her painting are beautiful

I had a wonderful time in Sven & Beatrijs’ apartment! Everything was exactly as described, the hosts were more than welcoming and the location was perfect if you are looking for a quiet place in antwerp but are still looking to get into the city in no time. 10/10 would definitely go again!

We had a lovely stay with Beatrijs and Sven. The accommodation was well equipped, clean and very nicely decorated. The lovely atmosphere greatly contributed to our trip to Antwerpen!

I would highly recommend them!

Een prachtige studio, in een geweldige buurt op loopafstand van het centrum.
Het verblijf was uniek, Sven en Beatrijs waren vriendelijk, flexibel en de communicatie verliep altijd snel en gemakkelijk.
We komen zeker een keer terug!

Na een lange fietstocht kwamen we aan in dit klein paradijsje in Antwerpen. Je zit midden in de stad, maar toch is het zalig rustig. De kamer is prachtig gedecoreerd met, en het is zalig om in slaap te vallen en wakker te worden met zoveel kunstwerken om je heen.
Meest bijzondere plek:rustig slapen in galerie met prachtige tuin!

Petit écrin de calme dans la ville, l'endroit dispose d'une terrasse couverte où on peut déjeuner au calme. On se croirait à la campagne. Pourtant on peut se rendre à pieds pour visiter chaque endroit incontournable d'Anvers. Le gîte est très propre, très agréable, joliment décoré des oeuvres de l'artiste. Sven est très gentil, à l'écoute. Nous avons passé un weekend magnifique. Et le soleil était de la partie. What else ?

Een zeer goeie ervaring gehad bij dit verblijf.
Aangenaam ontvangst, de rust, gezellige ruimte en ook zeer vriendelijke host.

Super endroit.
Un charme au calme dans la ville.
vous ne serez pas déçu de l'endroit, l'accès et l'accueil.
je recommande vivement d'aller y séjourné.
Great studio in very close to the city center. Sven was very helpful and communicative and everything went without a hitch. Great host
Echt een aanrader! Fijne communicatie, leuke buurt en ook veilig!! Het is ongeveer 25 minuutjes lopen naar het centrum maar met een e-step ben je er zo :) We hebben een leuke tijd gehad bij Sven!
Sven est disponible et à l'écoute, l'accès au logement est charmant, la chambre très agréable, nous avons passé un très bon séjour à Anvers et nous avons pu nous reposer au calme dans ce studio.

Heerlijk rustig plekje voor een gezellig weekend in Antwerpen. Een fijne studio waar het net voelt alsnog je in een kleine galerij bent. Alle benodigdheden heeft het, ook om een kleine maaltijd te maken. Met een huur fiets, step of scooter ben je zo in het bruisende centrum.

We had a very nice stay in this studio. It is super quiet, in a nice residential neighborhood in Antwerpen. Velo bikes are a one minute walk away, Dageraadplaats is 5 minutes walk (nice square with many restaurants!) and even closer there are some nice restaurants and a cafe. Communication with Sven was super easy and he was helpful with suggestions and questions. The studio is nicely decorated and has a good vibe.

Nous avons séjourné chez Éline car nous nous rendions à un mariage nous ne sommes donc pas en mesure de juger la situation de l’appartement. Une chose est sure nous n’avons manqué de rien ! C’est très chaleureux et l’hôte est très serviable. L’équipement est au top ! Nous recommandons fortement !

When I saw the ad on airbnb for Eline's place it immediately caught my attention. The flat looks great on the pictures but after have spent a few days there recently it looks even better in person. Eline as hostess was great and very helpful beyond expectations.
I recommend Eline's flat for anyone looking for a confortable and safe stay in an quiet area really close to the city center.

Ik heb Eline helaas niet kunnen ontmoeten (mijn schuld) maar ons contact via sms en telefoon was altijd heel hartelijk. Eline reageert snel en is heel erg flexibel. Je zit tegenover Park Spoor Noord en hoog (lift aanwezig) wat de nodige rust meebrengt. Toplocatie, topverblijf en heerlijk slapen. Dank je wel en wellicht tot binnenkort!

Eline is een hele goede gastvrouw! Ze reageert snel en verzorgt alles tot in de puntjes. Ze was erg gastvrij en altijd bereikbaar. Appartement is erg mooi, schoon en heeft mooi uitzicht. Locatie is ook goed, ongeveer 20 minuutjes lopen. Kortom, een aanrader!
Amazing flat with amazing view on park!! The kitchen  is new and  fully equipped. Eline is really nice host, the communication was without any problem.

Prachtig appartement met een nog prachtiger uitzicht! Veel ruimte, kraaknet, ruim voldoende kookgerief, zeer mooie badkamer en je kan zelfs je kleren wassen en strijken! De gastvrijheid van Eline is echt TOP en ook communicatie verloopt super snel en vlot!

Je conseil cette appartement ! Appart moderne Top qualité ! Encore mieux que sur les photos ! La localisation est top pour découvrir un nouveau quartier ! Eline est super ! Souriante accueillante ! Petit plan dans l’appart elle nous a même indiqué des bonnes adresses pour manger le soir !

Très bel appartement avec une jolie vue sur le parc. La décoration est moderne, la cuisine entièrement équipée, une douche à l'italienne.

Très bien
L'appartement d'Éline est très bien situé, la vue est magnifique. Il est propre et très bien équipé. Merci encore à elle. Je recommande fortement.
Wir haben uns wirklich wie zuhause gefühlt und wurden lieb empfangen. Die Kommunikation lief sehr schnell und gut ab und wir würden dies jederzeit wieder machen. Ein klare wohnempfehlung!

Super super super plek en appartement. Plaats is ideaal, huisje is ideaal.. Ik kan alleen maar goede dingen opsommen..  Een dikke 10

Eline is een aardig, gastvrij en open persoon die er met alle liefde alles aan doet om jouw verblijf in Antwerpen tot een mooi eind te leiden. Bedankt voor alles Eline, het ga je goed!

Uitstekende uitvalsbasis voor een kort of langer verblijf in Antwerpen. Communicatie vooraf helemaal top. Leuk en mooi appartement. Kortom een aanrader voor iedereen!
A great apartment with a beautiful view of Antwerp over the park. Close to everything yet a quiet location.

But Eline! She was such a nice, welcoming host! She was so warm and attentive, she gave some tipps and kept sending us messages if everything was all right.
Perfect host and place. We had very warm welcome, and it was a pleasure all the time.

Prachtig uitzicht en het appartement is erg mooi en verzorgd.

Tolle Gastgeberin, sagenhaft Wohnung, eindrucksvoller Stadtteil... absolute Empfehlung!!!

Lovely apartment, clean, stylish, nice view from the living room with a balcony, good location, equipped with everything to feel like home. A “book” with advices from the owner helped to save time finding pub/dinner/taxi/etc. Highly recommended!

Kwinten's place is pretty best the best located room you'll find in Antwerp! Kwinten was open to let us check-in early which was an awesome touch for a short trip like ours. The room was spacious, heated (which was great for the current weather),  had a confortable bed, private toilet, and a kitchen upstair. Of course we recommend it and we thank Kwinten for his hospitality and quick reply!
Great location, very easy communication. Thank you!
Een goede locatie. De gastheer was erg relaxed. Door de locatie was het wel enigzins gehorig.
The apartment is very well located. Kwinten is a great host. He replied all the messages very quickly and was always available for any further question we might have.
A very nice space and a very nice host full of nice tips!
Great location, very central, exactly as described and therefor great value compared to other places in this part of town.
nice place ,  interesting neighbours and  kwinten being an amazing host as well, recommended !
Wonderful location, great host, perfect stay!

Prima kamer op een T O P locatie. De kamer, begane grond, bevind zich in een voormalig winkellocatie. Wel gehorig overigens. De algehele locatie kan beschreven worden als een studentenflat. Gezamenlijke keuken op de 1e verdieping. De gezamenlijke douche bevindt zicht op de 3e verdieping. Laat dit je echter niet tegenhouden. Genoten van Antwerpen in prima verblijf zoals beschreven. Overal dichtbij.
Fijne kamer op een toplocatie in Antwerpen. Zeker een aanrader :)
It's in a great location for exploring the city, close to the centre. I was there for work so it was a little noisy with being so central. Very cute and quirky place. Expect steep stairs.
Excellent location near Grote Markt and Cathedral at great Value pricing
Good location, perfect house; highly recommended.
Everything was ok ! Kwinten is a super host with some good local tips !

It was great to stay at Kwinten's place! The location is amazing, right in town. Everything is walking distance. Trams around the corner. Supermarkets and nightshops as well. The bed was amazing. Very comfortable. Will be coming back to this place next time!

Kwinten’s place is okay for a night in Antwerp, but probably not longer than that. It is centrally located with a great coffee shop on the corner. The room has very dusty floors and as an old storefront none of the windows can open, making it quite stuffy especially in the loft bed. We were there during a heat wave which was of course not Kwinten’s fault, but when asked for a fan he delivered it a day later after using it himself upstairs (he does not live there). The kitchen and bathroom have character but are not the cleanest.

Kwinten is a great place to crash if you come to the Tomorrowland and you're not demanding persona. Only like 10 mins walk from the Main Station where you can take the train to Boom (another 20mins) We enjoyed our stay and Kwinten was always very responsive. Thanks again!
Top locatie! Alles op loopafstand. Erg leuk, oud huis. Wel erg gehorig en de kamer was wat stoffig.
Great place to spend a few nights in Antwerp. Very centrally located so everything is within walking distance.
Kwinten is an interesting charismatic host. Relaxed and careful that you feel comfortable as his guest. Price and performance were appropriate for me personally. Thank you and gladly again.

Kwinten was on holidays during my trip in antwerp. Nevertheless, he prepared and arranged my arriving. It was perfect. The house has a really good localisation. Kwinten is gastvrij en behulpzaam! De kamer is wel erg donker, gehorig en koud. Het was een soort logeren in een studentenhuis idee, maar dat was ook wel weer gezellig. De ligging van de woning is top!

Kwinten was very nice and he even gave us some recommendations on what to see in Antwerpen.
Hele fijne plek, zeer centraal gelegen. Goede communicatie met Kwinten die ook handige tips had voor ons. Badkamer op de derde verdieping.

Excellente localisation, très bonne communication avec l'hôte, propre et spacieux. Cette chambre reste très bien pour un weekend mais n'oubliez vraiment pas vos boules quies, même pour ceux au sommeil lourd !

The room is very nice and the location is perfect. The communication with Kwinten was super easy and if you ask for some Bar recommendations, he will have some great tips for you. We really enjoyed our short stay there.

Very great location. Spacious room and a walking distance to the city center. Toilet is on the 3rd floor. Noise from outside easily gets into the room. Near to the centre, classic room, great service!

Kwinten was super friendly and helpful, the communication was really good, he was always there to answer any question and always with useful information. The place is in the very center of Antwerpen and has a very nice flare to it. Thanks, Kwinten for a very nice stay.

Das Zimmer war zweckmäßig und das "Hochbett" war sehr cool und etwas Besonderes. Kwinten war beim Einchecken persönlich da und hat uns sehr freundlich und mit guten Ratschlägen für die Besichtigung der Stadt empfangen. Für kurze Aufenthalte auf jeden Fall empfehlenswert.
The house is perfectly located and the room is great. Kwinten is super helpful and responsive.

Partez l'esprit tranquille, pour un bon moment détente, votre hôte fera en sorte que tout se déroule parfaitement! Entre indications et informations utiles, il prend le temps de tout vous expliquer et mets à votre disposition un très bel endroit de confort.

Great!

Great apartment, clean and cozy and much bigger than I expected. Super easy to get around Antwerp from there.

Das separate Schlafzimmer geht dagegen nach hinten raus, d.h. hier kann man ungestört vom Straßenlärm schlafen.
Ansonsten ist das Apartment top eingerichtet. Besonders gut hat mir der große Esstisch für 6 Personen gefallen. Im Wohnbereich kann man es sich abends mit der richtigen Beleuchtung auch sehr gemütlich machen, so dass wir uns am Ende hier doch sehr wohlgefühlt haben.

Auch zum Bahnhof (Centraal Station) oder abends zum Ausgehen in Het Eilandtje ist man nicht länger als 15min zu Fuß unterwegs. Es gibt jede Menge Restos, Bars und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten in der Nachbarschaft. Haltestellen von mehreren Tram-Linien sind in unmittelbarer Nähe.

The apartment is decorated in a modern and fashionable way. There is a lot of white in the apartment, which looks good but is also unforgiving, meaning it shows every stain or scratch or bump. The apartment therefore could do with a fresh coat of white paint, some luting fixes in the bathroom, and a new sofa, because this one had a screw sticking out of the seat of the sofa, which one of our party hurt themselves on. I hope they fix that last part soon, so no one else gets hurt.

That said, this apartment is still lovely and amazing value for money for the location it's in. Would book again.
